analyzed: vyākaraṇa śāstra pravartaka pāṇini ādi munitraya ādi namana rūpam maṅgalam nibadhnan prekṣāvatām pravṛtti siddhaye idhikāri viṣaya saṃbandha prayojana ākhyam anubandha catuṣaṭyam pradarśayan śiṣya avadhānāya cikīrṣitam nivedayati

original: pāṇiṃnikātyāyanapatañjalimunīn, raṅgojibhaṭṭanāmānaṃ pitaraṃ, ḍhuṇḍhiṃ siddhivināyakaṃ praṇamya prakṛṣṭaṃ sāṣṭāṅgatvaguṇaviśiṣṭanamaskāraṃ kṛtvā gautamajaiminivacanavyākhyātṛbhirdūṣitān siddhāntān--vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntān-dhātoreva bhāvanāvācakatvaṃ tiṅāmeva ca kartrādivācakatvamityevaṃrūpānityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pāṇiṃni kātyāyana patañjali munīn raṅgoji bhaṭṭa nāmānam pitaram ḍhuṇḍhim siddhi vināyakam praṇamya prakṛṣṭam sāṣṭāṅgatva guṇa viśiṣṭa namaskāram kṛtvā gautama jaimini vacana vyākhyātṛbhiḥ dūṣitān siddhāntān vaiyākaraṇa siddhāntān dhātoḥ eva bhāvanā vācaka tvam tiṅām eva ca kartṛ ādi vācaka tvam iti evaṃrūpān iti arthaḥ

original: upapattibhiryuktimiḥ prakaṭaye, siddhāntānāmupapannatve yuktīḥ prakāśaye, ityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ--gautamajaiminīyavacovyākhyātṝṇāmādhunikatārkikamīmāṃsakānāṃ vaco yuktiśūnyatvenānupapattidoṣagrastamiti ca sthāpaye, ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: upapattibhiḥ yuktimiḥ prakaṭaye siddhāntānām upapanna tve yuktīḥ prakāśaye iti arthaḥ teṣām gautama jaiminīya vacaḥ vyākhyātṝṇām ādhunika tārkika mīmāṃsakānām vacaḥ yukti śūnyatvena anupapatti doṣa grastam iti ca sthāpaye iti arthaḥ

original: namaskāraśca svaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatānirūpitaparaniṣṭhotkṛṣṭatābodhanānukūlaḥ karaśiraḥsaṃyogātmako, namaḥśabdoccāraṇātmako vā vyāpāraḥ| vyākhyātṛbhirdūṣitāniti| vyākhyātṛśabdaprayogeṇa jaiminigautamādimunināṃ pāṇinyādibhiravirodha eveti sūcyate| pāṇinirādiryeṣāṃ te ca te munayaśceti bahuvrīhigarbhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ|
analyzed: namaskāraḥ ca sva niṣṭha apakṛṣṭa tā nirūpita para niṣṭha utkṛṣṭa tā bodhana anukūlaḥ kara śiraḥ saṃyoga ātmakaḥ namaḥ śabda uccāraṇa ātmakaḥ vā vyāpāraḥ vyākhyātṛbhiḥ dūṣitān iti vyākhyātṛ śabda prayogeṇa jaimini gautama ādi muninām pāṇini ādibhiḥ avirodhaḥ eva iti sūcyate pāṇiniḥ ādiḥ yeṣām te ca te munayaḥ ca iti bahuvrīhi garbhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ

original: bahuvrīhiśca sarvādīnītivattad‌guṇasaṃvijñānaḥ| tena pāṇinerapi namaskāryatvalābhaḥ| gautamajaiminīyavacanāni tu nyāyasūtrāṇi mīmāṃsāsūtrāṇi ca| pitṛvyasya vidyāpradagurutvena sūcanātsvapitū raṅgojibhaṭṭasyāvidvattvamāśaṅkyetātastaṃ viśinaṣṭi-dvaitadhvāntetyādi| dve ita āśrayatvena prāpto dvīto bhedaḥ, tasyedaṃ jñānaṃ dvaitam|
analyzed: bahuvrīhiḥ ca sarva ādīni iti vat tad guṇa saṃvijñānaḥ tena pāṇineḥ api namaskārya tva lābhaḥ gautama jaiminīya vacanāni tu nyāya sūtrāṇi mīmāṃsā sūtrāṇi ca pitṛvyasya vidyā prada guru tvena sūcanāt sva pituḥ raṅgoji bhaṭṭasya avidvas tvam āśaṅkyeta atas tam viśinaṣṭi dvaita dhvānta ityādi dve itas āśraya tvena prāptaḥ dvītaḥ bhedaḥ tasya idam jñānam dvaitam

original: anekatvāvagāhijñānamiti yāvat| tadevā''cchādakatvād‌dhvāntaṃ tamo moha iti yāvat| tasya nivāraṇaṃ nirasanaṃ, tat--ādi prathamaṃ phalaṃ yasyāḥ sā, etādṛśīṃ, puṃbhāvavāgdevatāṃ--puṃso bhāva ākāro yasyāḥ sā puṃbhāvā, puruṣākṛtiketyarthaḥ| sā cāsau vāgdevatā ca sarasvatī tadrūpamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: aneka tva avagāhi jñānam iti yāvat tat eva ācchādaka tvāt dhvāntam tamaḥ mohaḥ iti yāvat tasya nivāraṇam nirasanam tata ādi prathamam phalam yasyāḥ sā etādṛśīm puṃbhāva vāgdevatām puṃsaḥ bhāvaḥ ākāraḥ yasyāḥ sā puṃbhāvā puruṣa ākṛtikā iti arthaḥ sā ca asau vāgdevatā ca sarasvatī tad rūpam iti arthaḥ

original: vāgdevatāṃ pitaramityanayorajahalliṅgatvāt `strī pradhānaṃ' itivatsāmānādikaraṇyam| anenādvaitapratipādakottaramīmāṃsāyāṃ sarvātiśāyinaipuṇyaṃ sūcitam| ḍhuṇḍhimityapi pitṛviśeṣaṇam| tadyathā--na kevalaṃ vāgdevatāsvarūpo'pituṃ mahāgaṇapatisvarūpo'pīti| anyathā pitṛnamanānantaraṃ mahāgaṇapatinamanamatyasaṃgataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: vāgdevatām pitaram iti anayoḥ ajahat liṅga tvāt strī pradhānam iti vat sāmānādikaraṇyam anena advaita pratipādaka uttara mīmāṃsāyām sarva atiśāyi naipuṇyam sūcitam ḍhuṇḍhim iti api pitṛ viśeṣaṇam tat yathā na kevalam mahāgaṇapati sva rūpaḥ upitum iti anyathā pitṛ namana anantaram mahāgaṇapati namanam ati asaṃgatam syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: `siddhāntānupapāttebhiḥ prakaṭaye' ityuktyā vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntā viṣayaḥ, viṣayagranthayoḥ pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tajjijñāsuradhikārī, tajjñānaṃ ca phalamiti sūcitamiti bodhyam|| 4 ||
analyzed: prakaṭaye iti uktyā vaiyākaraṇa siddhāntāḥ viṣayaḥ viṣaya granthayoḥ pratipādya pratipādaka bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tad jijñāsuḥ adhikārī tad jñānam ca phalam iti sūcitam iti bodhyam

original: pratyūhaprācuryaśaṅkyā punarapi gaṇeśādinamanarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ vidadhatsvakīrtyanuvṛttaye svanāma svacikīrṣītagranthasya ca nāma nibadhnāti--natvā gaṇeśeti|
analyzed: pratyūha prācurya śaṅkyā punar api gaṇeśa ādi namana rūpam maṅgalam vidadhat sva kīrti anuvṛttaye sva nāma sva cikīrṣīta granthasya ca nāma nibadhnāti natvā gaṇeśa iti

original: gaṇānāṃ śivagaṇānāmīśo niyantā gaṇeśastasyetyarthaḥ| yadvā bhaktagaṇānāmiḥ kāmaḥ, kāmetyupalakṣaṇaṃ krodhādīnāmapi| tathā ca kāmakrodhādiṣaḍ‌vargaṃ śyati tanūkarotīti gaṇeśaḥ| tasya pādābjaṃ pādāvevābjaṃ kamalaṃ, atiśayaśliṣṭatvādekavacanam| gṛṇātyajñānaṃ nāśayati jñānopadeśadvāreti guruḥ| kṛgroruccetyauṇādikaḥ kuḥ|
analyzed: gaṇānām śiva gaṇānām īśaḥ niyantā gaṇeśaḥ tasya iti arthaḥ yat vā bhakta gaṇānām iḥ kāmaḥ kāma iti upalakṣaṇam krodha ādīnām api tathā ca kāma krodha ādi ṣaḍvargam śyati tanūkaroti iti gaṇeśaḥ tasya pāda abjam pādau eva abjam kamalam atiśaya śliṣṭa tvāt ekavacanam gṛṇāti ajñānam nāśayati jñāna upadeśa dvārā iti guruḥ kṛ groḥ ucca iti auṇādikaḥ kuḥ

original: nigūḍhamarthaṃ gṛṇātyupadiśatīti vā guruḥ| saro'mṛtasarastadvatī sarasvatī| vyākaraṇaṃ śāstramadhīyate vidanti vā vaiyākaraṇāsteṣāṃ bhūṣaṇamalaṃkāramiva śobhādāyakamityarthaḥ| tadetadanvarthaṃ granthanāma|
analyzed: nigūḍham artham gṛṇāti upadiśati iti vā guruḥ saraḥ mṛta saraḥ tadvatī sarasvatī vyākaraṇam śāstram adhīyate vidanti vā vaiyākaraṇāḥ teṣām bhūṣaṇam alaṃkāram iva śobhā ādāyakam iti arthaḥ tat etat anvartham grantha nāma

original: arthaprakriyāpratipādakamamuṃ granthamanadhītya kevalaśabdaprakriyāgranthādhyayanena vaiyākaraṇā analaṃkṛtā iva na paripūrṇatayā śobhanta iti yāvat| etena vyākaraṇaśāstrādhyetṝṇāmetad‌granthasyāvaśyopādeyatvaṃ sūcitam|
analyzed: artha prakriyā pratipādakam amum grantham an adhītya kevala śabda prakriyā grantha adhyayanena vaiyākaraṇāḥ analaṃkṛtāḥ iva na paripūrṇa tayā śobhante iti yāvat etena vyākaraṇa śāstra adhyetṝṇām etad granthasya avaśya upādeya tvam sūcitam

original: anenaiva kauṇḍabhaṭṭena mahāviduṣā naiyāyikamīmāṃsakaproktārthapratipādanarītyupapādanatatkhaṇḍanapuraḥsaraṃ suvistṛtaṃ pāṇḍityapracuraṃ yad‌vyākhyānaṃ kṛtamasti tadeva `vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇaṃ' ityucyate, kvacittu vistṛtatvād' bṛhadbhūṣaṇaṃ' ityuktam|
analyzed: anena eva kauṇḍa bhaṭṭena mahā viduṣā naiyāyika mīmāṃsaka prokta artha pratipādana rīti upapādana tad khaṇḍana puraḥsaram su vistṛtam pāṇḍitya pracuram yat vyākhyānam kṛtam asti tat eva vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇam iti ucyate kvacid tu vistṛta tvāt bṛhadbhūṣaṇam iti uktam

original: taduttamādhikāriṇāmevopakārakaṃ, na madhyamādyadhikāriṇāmityālocya teṣāmapyupakārārthaṃ sārabh‌tān siddhāntānādāya saṃkṣepatastadupapādanenedaṃ vyākhyānaṃ niramāyītyasya `vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāraḥ' ityeva nāma suprasiddham| nāmaikadeśe nāmagrahaṇamiti nyāyena vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇamityuktaṃ mūle|
analyzed: tad uttama adhikāriṇām eva upakārakam na madhyama ādi adhikāriṇām iti ālocya teṣām api upakāra artham sārabhtān siddhāntān ādāya saṃkṣepataḥ tad upapādanena idam vyākhyānam niramāyi iti asya vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇa sāraḥ iti eva nāma su prasiddham nāma eka deśe nāma grahaṇam iti nyāyena vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇam iti uktam mūle

original: ubhayatrāpi vyākhyeyabhūtāḥ kārikāḥ svagurubhaṭṭojidīkṣitapraṇītāḥ samānā evetyagre sphuṭībhaviṣyatīti bodhyam|| 5 ||
analyzed: ubhayatra api vyākhyeya bhūtāḥ kārikāḥ sva guru bhaṭṭojidīkṣita praṇītāḥ samānāḥ eva iti agre sphuṭībhaviṣyati iti bodhyam

original: idānīṃ vyākhyānamūlabhūtakārikākṛdbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaścikīrṣitasvagranthapratibandhakavighātāya samuciteṣṭadevatāsmaraṇarūpaṃ maṅgalamācaratītyāha--prāripsitetyādi| prārabdhumiṣṭo yo grantha- `phalavyāpārayordhātuḥ' ityādikārikāsamūharūpaḥ, tatra pratibandhakāni yāni duritāni teṣāmupaśamo nāśastasmā ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: idānīm vyākhyāna mūla bhūta kārikā kṛt bhaṭṭojidīkṣitaḥ cikīrṣita sva grantha pratibandhaka vighātāya samucita iṣṭadevatā smaraṇa rūpam maṅgalam ācarati iti āha prāripsita ityādi prārabdhum iṣṭaḥ yaḥ grantha phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātuḥ iti ādi kārikā samūha rūpaḥ tatra pratibandhakāni yāni duritāni teṣām upaśamaḥ nāśaḥ tasmai iti arthaḥ

original: atrā''hatya pratibandhakopaśamanāyetyuktatvādalaukikāvigītaśiṣṭācārānumitaśrutipramāṇakasya maṅgalasya na samāptāvupayogaḥ, nāstikagranthe vinaiva maṅgalaṃ samāptidarśanena maṅgalasya samāptyupayogitvābhāvāt| kiṃtu kāryamātre pratibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatayā klṛptatvātpratibandhakanāśa eva maṅgalasyopayogaḥ|
analyzed: atra āhatya pratibandhaka upaśamanāya iti ukta tvāt alaukika avigīta śiṣṭa ācāra anumita śruti pramāṇakasya maṅgalasya na samāptau upayogaḥ nāstika granthe vinā eva maṅgalam samāpti darśanena maṅgalasya samāpti upayogi tva abhāvāt kiṃtu kārya mātre pratibandhaka abhāvasya kāraṇa tayā klṛpta tvāt pratibandhaka nāśaḥ eva maṅgalasya upayogaḥ

original: samāptistu navanavonmeṣaśālimatibuddhyādiryā granthaviracanasāvadhanasāmagrī tayaiva sidhyatīti sūcitam| phaṇismaraṇeti| mahābhāṣyasthasakalasiddhāntaprāptaye, iṣṭadaivataṃ śeṣākhyaḥ phaṇī, mahābhāṣyakārasya śeṣāvatāratvāditi phaṇismaraṇarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ samucitameveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: samāptiḥ tu nava nava unmeṣa śāli mati buddhi ādiḥ yā grantha viracana sāvadhana sāmagrī tayā eva sidhyati iti sūcitam phaṇi smaraṇa iti mahābhāṣya stha sakala siddhānta prāptaye iṣṭa daivatam śeṣa ākhyaḥ phaṇī mahābhāṣyakārasya śeṣa avatāra tvāt iti phaṇi smaraṇa rūpam maṅgalam samucitam eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvathāpi maṅgalasya granthādau niveśane kiṃ prayojanamiti jijñāsāyāmāha--śiṣyaśikṣārthamiti| granthārambhasamaye śiṣyairapi tādṛśanibaddhaśloke paṭhite sati te'pi, `maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāni hi śāstrāṇi prathante vīrapuruṣakāṇi āyuṣmatpuruṣakāṇi ca bhavanti adhyetāraśca vṛddhiyuktā yathā syuḥ' iti
analyzed: nanu atha api maṅgalasya grantha ādau niveśane kim prayojanam iti jijñāsāyām āha śiṣya śikṣā artham iti grantha ārambha samaye śiṣyaiḥ api tādṛśa nibaddha śloke paṭhite sati te api maṅgala ādīni maṅgala madhyāni maṅgala antāni hi śāstrāṇi prathante vīrapuruṣakāṇi āyuṣmat puruṣakāṇi ca bhavanti adhyetāraḥ ca vṛddhi yuktāḥ yathā syuḥ iti

original: mahābhāṣyakāroktamaṅgalaphalabhājo bhaveyurityevamarthamityarthaḥ| cikīrṣitamiti| kārikāvalīrūpaṃ grantham| pratijānīta iti| kartavyatvena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| pratyupasargaviśiṣṭajñādhātoḥ kartavyatvena bodhānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ| tatra kartavyatvena bodho viṣayatāsaṃbandhena cikīrṣitagranthaniṣṭhaḥ| tādṛśabodhānukūlavyāpāraśca granthakāraniṣṭhaḥ|
analyzed: mahābhāṣyakāra ukta maṅgala phala bhājaḥ bhaveyuḥ iti evamartham iti arthaḥ cikīrṣitam iti kārikāvalī rūpam grantham pratijānīta iti kartavya tvena bodhayati iti arthaḥ pratyupasarga viśiṣṭa jñā dhātoḥ kartavya tvena bodha anukūlaḥ vyāpāra ūrthaḥ tatra kartavya tvena bodhaḥ viṣayatā saṃbandhena cikīrṣita grantha niṣṭhaḥ tādṛśa bodha anukūla vyāpāraḥ ca granthakāra niṣṭhaḥ

original: sa ca vyāpāraḥ `mayā amukagranthaḥ kriyate' ityevaṃśabdaprayogarūpaḥ|
analyzed: sa ca vyāpāraḥ mayā amuka granthaḥ kriyate iti evam śabda prayoga rūpaḥ

original: kenod‌dhṛta ityuddharaṇakriyākartṛjijñāsāyāmāha-asmābhiriti| śabdakaustubhakartṛtvena bhaṭṭojidīkṣitānāṃ suprasiddhatvādasmābhirityasya bhaṭṭojidīkṣitairityarthaḥ| tatra--śabdakaustubhe| iha--kārikāvalīrūpe gramthe|
analyzed: kena uddhṛtaḥ iti uddharaṇa kriyā kartṛ jijñāsāyām āha asmābhiḥ iti śabdakaustubha kartṛ tvena bhaṭṭoji dīkṣitānām su prasiddha tvāt asmābhiḥ iti asya bhaṭṭoji dīkṣitaiḥ iti arthaḥ tatra śabdakaustubhe iha kārikā āvalī rūpe gramthe

original: tathā ca śabdakaustubhe yena yo'rtho nirṇītastenaiva so'rthaḥ iha--kārikāvalīgranthe saṃkṣepeṇa kathyate ityarthasya pratyāsattyā lābhācchabdakaustubhakārikāvalīgranthakartroraikyāvagamādvaiyākaraṇasiddhāntakārikā bhaṭṭojidīkṣitakṛtāḥ, iti paryavasyati|
analyzed: tathā ca śabdakaustubhe yena yaḥ ṛthaḥ nirṇītaḥ tena eva saḥ ṛthaḥ iha kārikāvalī granthe saṃkṣepeṇa kathyate iti arthasya pratyāsattyā lābhāt śabdakaustubha kārikāvalī grantha kartroḥ aikya avagamāt vaiyākaraṇa siddhānta kārikāḥ bhaṭṭojidīkṣita kṛtāḥ iti paryavasyati

original: etena kārikāvalīgranthakarturatiśayitapāṇḍityaprakāśanadvārā tatkṛtakārikāvalīgranthasyāvasyopādeyatvaṃ sūcitam| śabdakaustubhoddharaṇe'vaditvena bhāṣyābdherupādānasya prayojanamāha--śabdakaustubhoktetyādinā nirāsāyetyantena granthena| ādhunikotprokṣitatvanirāsasya phalamāha--anyatheti| uktavaiparītye|

original: nanu haripadādupasthitayosūryasiṃhayoḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya(ādhārādheya)bhāvenānvayabodhānanubhavāt, `vā syādvikalpopamayorevārthe'pi samuccaye' iti kośādvāśabdopasthitavikalpāḥ dyoraryayoḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvenānvayasyādṛṣṭatvācca vibhinnapadopasthitayorevānvaya iti niyamāṅgīkārāvasyakatvenaikapadopasthitayoḥ

original: atha pṛthak‌śaktipakṣe gamanamiti padātsvātantryeṇa phalasya pratītyā gamanaṃ na vyāpāra iti pratītyāpattistadvāraṇāyaikaśaktipakṣa evāṅgīkartumucita iti cettadapi na| prathamopasthitatvenāntaraṅgatvātphalavyāpārayostāvatprathamato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenānvayo bhavati paścāttvarthāntareṇa|

original: atra prathamaviśeṣaṇadale janyatve satītyetāvanmātroktau vibhāgajanyasaṃyogādirūpe patatyādyarthe vibhāgasya kṛtīsādhyatvena janyatvātphalatvāpattiḥ syāttadvāraṇāya janyatve nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena dhātvartho viśeṣaṇam| dhātvarthanirūpitajanyatve satītyarthaḥ| niruktavibhāgasya ca dhātvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ|

original: nanvevamapi vibhāgasya uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpagamyādiyatkiṃciddhātvarthajanyatvātphalatvāpattistadavasthaiveti cenna, dhātostaditi viśeṣaṇāt| pratyāsattyā yaddhātvarthatvaṃ yaddhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatvaṃ vā taddhātvarthanirūpitajanyatve satītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu evam api vibhāgasya uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra rūpa gamya ādi yat kiṃcid dhātvartha janyatvāt phalatva āpattiḥ tad avasthā eva iti ced na dhātoḥ tat iti viśeṣaṇāt pratyāsattyā yat dhātvartha tvam yat dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā āpanna tvam vā tad dhātvartha nirūpita janyatve sati iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca niruktavibhāge patidhātvarthasaṃyoganiṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatve'pi patidhātvarthatve'pi ca patatidhāthvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvānna phalatvam| nanvevaṃ prayāgātkāśīṃ gacchatītyādau gamyādyarthavyāpārajanyatvādvibhāgasya phalatvāpattiriti cenna| taddhātvarthatvamiti viśeṣyopādānāt| taddhātujanyopasthitiviṣayatvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca nirukta vibhāge pati dhātvartha saṃyoga niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā āpannatve pi pati dhātvartha tve pi ca patati dhāthvartha nirūpita janyatva abhāvāt na phalatvam nanu evam prayāgāt kāśīm gacchati ityādau gami ādi artha vyāpāra janya tvāt vibhāgasya phalatva āpattiḥ iti ced na tad dhātvartha tvam iti viśeṣya upādānāt tad dhātu janya upasthiti viṣayatvam iti arthaḥ

original: uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlo vyāpāro gamyādyarthaḥ| tatra pūrvadeśavibhāgamantarottaradeśasaṃyogasyātyantāsaṃbhavena nāntarīyakatayā vibhāgasyottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpagamidhātvarthajanyatve'pi gamidhātūpasthitiviṣayatvābhāvānna phalatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ gami ādi arthaḥ tatra pūrva deśa vibhāgam antara uttara deśa saṃyogasya atyanta asaṃbhavena nāntarīyaka tayā vibhāgasya uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra rūpa gami dhātvartha janya tve api gami dhātu upasthiti viṣaya tva abhāvāt na phala tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevamapi parṇaṃ patatītyatra vibhāgajanyasaṃyoge patatidhātvarthavibhāgajanyatve sati taddhātvarthatvātphalatvāpattiriti cet| tadvāraṇāya taddhātvarthaniṣṭhetyādisatyantaṃ dvitīyaviśeṣaṇam| tataśca niruktasaṃyogasya patatidhātvarthajanyatve'pi patatidhātvarthatve'pi ca patatidhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatvābhāvānna phalatvam|
analyzed: nanu evam api parṇam patati iti atra vibhāga janya saṃyoge patati dhātvartha vibhāga janya tve sati tad dhātvartha tvāt phala tva āpattiḥ iti ced tad vāraṇāya tad dhātvartha niṣṭha ityādi sati antam dvitīya viśeṣaṇam tatas ca nirukta saṃyogasya patati dhātvartha janya tve pi patati dhātvartha tve pi ca patati dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā āpanna tva abhāvāt na phalatvam

original: evaṃ ca patatidhātvarthe vibhāgasaṃyogayormithaḥ phalatvavāraṇāya satyantaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayam| tena vṛkṣātparṇaṃ bhūmau patatītyādau vibhāgāśrayasya vṛkṣādeḥ, saṃyogāśrayasya bhūmyādeśca na karmatvamityūhyam| idaṃ ca kvacidakarmakadhātau vyāpāramātraṃ dhātvartha iti matena| phalavyāpārayordhāturiti prāyovādābhiprāyeṇa|
analyzed: evam ca patati dhātvarthe vibhāga saṃyogayoḥ mithas phalatva vāraṇāya sati antam viśeṣaṇa dvayam tena vṛkṣāt parṇam bhūmau patati ityādau vibhāga āśrayasya vṛkṣa ādeḥ saṃyoga āśrayasya bhūmi ādeḥ ca na karmatvam iti ūhyam idam ca kvacid akarmaka dhātau vyāpāra mātram dhātvarthaḥ iti matena phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātuḥ iti prāyovāda abhiprāyeṇa

original: tanmatānaṅgīkāre tu satyantaṃ dvitīyaviśeṣaṇaṃ na deyamiti vodhyam| tena taddhātvarthajanyatve sati taddhātvarthatvam| ityeva phalalakṣaṇam| atra janyatvaṃ cā''ropitānāropitasādhāraṇaṃ grāhyam| teneśvarastiṣṭhati, patye śete, ityādau nāvyāptiḥ| īśvarasthiteḥ patyuddeśyakaśayanādeśca vastuto dhātvarthājanyatvātsthitau śayanādau ca janyatvāropāt|
analyzed: tad mata anaṅgīkāre tu sati antam dvitīya viśeṣaṇam na deyam iti vodhyam tena tad dhātvartha janya tve sati tad dhātvartha tvam iti eva phala lakṣaṇam atra janya tvam ca āropita anāropita sādhāraṇam grāhyam tena īśvaraḥ tiṣṭhati patye śete ityādau na avyāptiḥ īśvara sthiteḥ pati uddeśyaka śayana ādeḥ ca vastutas dhātvartha ajanya tvāt sthitau śayana ādau ca janya tva āropāt

original: tatra gopaniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāttaddhātvarthanirūpitaprakāratāpannatvāttaddhātvarthatvācca goniṣṭhavyāpārasya phalatvaṃ, vibhāgasyāpi goniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāttaddhātvarthaniṣṭhetyādiviśeṣaṇaviseṣyobhayayuktatvācca phalatvaṃ bodhyam| ādipadādajāṃ grāmaṃ nayatītyādi|

original: nanvevamagnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatītyādau saṃyogānukūlavyāpārābhāvasyeva saṃyogasyāpi māṇavakaniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāditritayayuktatvātphalatvāpattiriti cedastu nāma| nahi tāvanmātreṇa kaściddoṣo bhavati|
analyzed: nanu evam agneḥ māṇavakam vārayati ityādau saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra abhāvasya iva saṃyogasya api māṇavaka niṣṭha tad dhātvartha vyāpāra janya tva ādi tritaya yuktatvāt phalatva āpattiḥ iti ced astu nāma nahi tāvat mātreṇa kaścid doṣaḥ bhavati

original: uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāre nīdhātvarthe'jāniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvādiviśiṣṭasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayatvād‌grāmasyevāgnerapi karmatāyāṃ dvitīyāpattiriti tu na vācyam| karmasaṃjñāyāmabhāvapratiyogivyāpārajanyaphalasyāgrahaṇāt| anyathā vāraṇārthānāmiti sūtraṃ karturīpsitatamamityasyāpavādaḥ syāt|
analyzed: uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra anukūla vyāpāre karmatāyām dvitīya āpattiḥ iti tu na vācyam karma saṃjñāyām abhāva pratiyogi vyāpāra janya phalasya agrahaṇāt anyathā vāraṇa arthānām iti sūtram kartuḥ īpsitatamam ityasya apavādaḥ syāt

original: tataśca māṇavakamityatrāpi dvitīyānāpatteḥ| taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau karmasaṃjñāyāścaritārthatvāt| paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādau dṛśidātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyātānirūpitaprakāratāpannatve'pi dhāvanāderna phalatvam| dṛśidhātvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvād‌dṛśidātvarthatvābhāvācca| anyatā pradhānānurodhikarmatvasya balavattvānmṛgasya kartṛtvaṃ na syāt|
analyzed: tatas ca māṇavakam iti atra api dvitīyā anāpatteḥ taṇḍulam pacati ityādau karma saṃjñāyāḥ caritārtha tvāt paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati ityādau dṛśi dātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyātā nirūpita prakāra tā āpanna tve pi dhāvana ādeḥ na phalatvam dṛśi dhātvartha nirūpita janya tva abhāvāt dṛśi dātvartha tva abhāvāt ca anyatā pradhāna anurodhi karmatvasya balavat tvāt mṛgasya kartṛ tvam na syāt

original: evaṃ māṣeṣvaśvaṃ badhnātītyādau yadā puṣṭyarthe māṣabhakṣaṇāyaiva māṣakṣetre'śvabandhanaṃ tadā bhakṣaṇasya badhnātyarthajanyatvābhāvād‌badhnātyarthatvābhāvacca na phalatvamiti bhakṣaṇāśrayatve'pi māṣāṇāṃ na karmatvamiti bodhyam|
analyzed: evam māṣeṣu aśvam badhnāti ityādau yadā puṣṭi arthe māṣa bhakṣaṇāya eva māṣa kṣetra īśvara bandhanam tadā bhakṣaṇasya badhnāti artha janya tva abhāvāt badhnāti artha tva abhāvat ca na phalatvam iti bhakṣaṇa āśraya tve api māṣāṇām na karma tvam iti bodhyam

original: evaṃ phalaṃ nirūpya vyāpāraṃ nirūpayativyāpārastviti| vyāpāralakṣaṇaṃ cadhātvarthaphalajanakatve sati dhātuvācyatvam| pacatītyādau viklittyādidhātvarthaphalajanakatvāddhātuvācyatvācca phūtkārādervyāpāratvamityarthaḥ| dhātuvācyatvamityetāvanmātroktau viklittyādervyāpāratvaprasaṅgaḥ| ato dhātvarthaphalajanakatve satītyantaṃ viśeṣaṇam|
analyzed: evam phalam nirūpya vyāpāram nirūpayati vyāpāraḥ tu iti vyāpāra lakṣaṇam ca dhātvartha phala janaka tve sati dhātu vācyatvam pacati ityādau viklitti ādi dhātvartha phala janaka tvāt dhātu vācyatvāt ca phūtkāra ādeḥ vyāpāra tvam iti arthaḥ dhātu vācyatvam iti etāvat mātra uktau viklitti ādeḥ vyāpāra tva prasaṅgaḥ atas dhātvartha phala janaka tve sati ityantam viśeṣaṇam

original: tāvanmātroktau kāṣṭhaistaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau kāṣṭhataṇḍulaniṣṭhaprajvalanāvayavasaṃyogamārdavārhatvasvasvāvāntarakriyayorviklittyātmakadhātvarthaphalajanakatvād‌vyāpāratvāpattau tṛtīyādyanāpattiḥ| ato dhātuvācyatvamiti viśeṣyam| tathā ca devadattaniṣṭhaphūtkārādivyāpārasya dhātuvācyatvavivakṣaṇena kāṣṭhādigatakriyāṇāṃ dhātuvācyatvābhāvānna doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tāvanmātra uktau kāṣṭhaiḥ taṇḍulam pacati ityādau kāṣṭha taṇḍula niṣṭha prajvalana avayava saṃyoga mārdava arha tva sva sva avāntara kriyayoḥ viklitti ātmaka dhātvartha phala janaka tvāt vyāpāra tva āpattau tṛtīya ādi anāpattiḥ atas dhātu vācya tvam iti viśeṣyam tathā ca devadatta niṣṭha phūtkāra ādi vyāpārasya dhātu vācya tva vivakṣaṇena kāṣṭha ādi gata kriyāṇām dhātu vācya tva abhāvāt na doṣaḥ

original: kāṣṭhādigatakriyāṇāṃ dhātuvācyatvavivakṣāyāṃ tu bhavatyeva tāsāṃ vyāpāratvam| ata eva sthālī pacati kāṣṭhāni pacantītyādi saṃgacchate| dhātuvācyavyāpārāśrayasyaiva kartṛtvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca phalānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvartho bodhyaḥ|
analyzed: kāṣṭha ādi gata kriyāṇām dhātu vācya tva vivakṣāyām tu bhavati eva tāsām vyāpāra tvam atas eva sthālī pacati kāṣṭhāni pacanti ityādi saṃgacchate dhātu vācya vyāpāra āśrayasya eva kartṛ tvāt iti bhāvaḥ evam ca phala anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: nanu kiṃ karotīti praśne yathā pacatītyuttaraṃ bhavatyevamastītyuttarābhāvādastyādīnāṃ kriyāvācakatvaṃ na syāditi cenna, ayameva phalānukūlo vyāpāraḥ kriyāśabdena bhāṣyādiṣu vyapadiṣṭa ityāśayenava bhūṣaṇasārakṛtā bhāvanābhidhā sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānā kriyā' iti vyāpāralakṣaṇasyoktatvāt|

analyzed: vakṣyati ca granthaka āropi vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā sā eva utpādanā sā eva ca kriyā iti vyāpārasya eva kriyā tvam utpatti arthaka bhūdhātu prakṛtika ṇi antāt iti bhāve yuvā niṣpannaḥ bhāvanā śabdaḥ utpatti anukūla byāpāram ācaṣṭe abhidhā śabdaḥ tu abhidadhāti janayati phalam iti vyutpattyā phala janaka vyāpāram ācaṣṭe

original: tatrābhipūrvāddadhāteḥ `ātaścopasarge' iti kartari kapratyayaḥ| tathā ca bhāvanābhidhāparaparyāyā sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānārthātmikā kriyā vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| atra bhāvanābhidhetyuktistu vyāpārasya dhātvarthatve'pi bhāvanādipadavācyasyārthaviśeṣasyā'khyātārthatvamiti bhramanirāsārthā|

original: kriyetyuktistu bhavaterṇyantasya śuddhena karotinā tulyārthatvapradarśanārtheti bodhyam| na caivaṃ dhātvarthavyāpārasya kriyātvoktau sāmānyaviśeṣatayā praśnottarabhāvena sāmānādhikaraṇyātpacyādyarthavyāpārasya kriyātvasiddhāvaṣi astyādīnāṃ kriyātvānupapattiḥ purvoktā tadavasthaiveti vācyam|

original: āsannavināśaṃ kaṃciduddiśya kiṃ karotīti praśne astītyuttarasya sarvasaṃmatatvenāstyādīnāmapi kriyātvasya sūpapādatvāt| kriyāśabdapravṛttinimittasya `padāntarasamabhivyāhāramantarā sādhyatvena pratīyamānatvasya' karotītyādāvivāstyādāvapi sattvena kriyātvasyāyatnasiddhatvācca|
analyzed: āsanna vināśam kaṃcid uddiśya kim karoti iti praśne asti iti uttarasya sarva saṃmata tvena asti ādīnām api kriyā tvasya sūpapāda tvāt kriyā śabda pravṛtti nimittasya pada antara samabhivyāhāram antarā sādhya tvena pratīyamāna tvasya karoti ityādau iva asti ādau api sattvena kriyā tvasya ayatna siddha tvāt ca

original: atra sādhyatvaṃ mukhyatvātpadāntarārthanirapekṣaṃ svataḥ siddhaṃ grāhyam| padāntarārthasāpekṣasya tasya gauṇatvāt| evaṃ ca padāntarasamabhivyāhāraṃ vināpi sādhyatvarūpeṇa pratīyamānatvaṃ vyāpāratvamiti yāvat| ghaṭaṃ karotītyādau karotisamabhivyāhāre dhaṭādīnāmapi sādhyatvena pratīyamānatvādativyāptivāraṇāya padāntarādivinaivetyantasya niveśaḥ|
analyzed: atra sādhyatvam mukhya tvāt pada antara artha nirapekṣam svatas siddham grāhyam pada antara artha sāpekṣasya tasya gauṇa tvāt evam ca pada antara samabhivyāhāram vinā api sādhyatva rūpeṇa pratīyamāna tvam vyāpāra tvam iti yāvat ghaṭam karoti ityādau karoti samabhivyāhāre dhaṭa ādīnām api sādhyatvena pratīyamāna tvāt ativyāpti vāraṇāya pada antara ādi vinā eva iti antasya niveśaḥ

original: karotyādyasamabhivyāhāre tu ghaṭādīnāṃ siddhatvenava pratīteḥ| karotyādiprayoga eva ghaṭasya sādhyatvaṃ pratīyate karotestu siddhatvenava pratīteḥ| karotyādiprayoga eva ghaṭasya sādhyatvaṃ pratīyate karotestu svato'pītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: karoti ādi asamabhivyāhāre tu ghaṭa ādīnām pratīteḥ karoti ādi prayogaḥ eva ghaṭasya sādhyatvam pratīyate karoteḥ tu pratīteḥ karoti ādi prayogaḥ eva ghaṭasya sādhyatvam pratīyate karoteḥ tu svatas api iti arthaḥ

original: adhiśrayaṇādyadhaḥ śrayaṇāntakriyāsamūhasya padāntaraprayogamantarā'pi sādhyatvena pratīyamānatvāduktavyāpāratvamakṣatamiti bhāvaḥ| uktārthasya nirmulatvaṃ nirasitumāhauktaṃ cetyādi| yāvaditi| sakalamityarthaḥ| sakalapadārthameva vivṛṇotisiddhamityādinā| tathā ca dvaividhyameva sakalapadārthaḥ|
analyzed: adhiśrayaṇa ādi adhas śrayaṇa anta kriyā samūhasya pada antara prayogam antarā api sādhya tvena pratīyamāna tvāt ukta vyāpāra tvam akṣatam iti bhāvaḥ ukta arthasya nirmula tvam nirasitum āha uktam ca ityādi yāvat iti sakalam iti arthaḥ sakala padārtham eva vivṛṇoti siddham ityādinā tathā ca dvaividhyam eva sakala padārthaḥ

original: apākṣīdityādo siddhaṃ, pacati pakṣyatītyādāvasiddhaṃ vā vastu sādhyasvarūpeṇa tatprakāreṇābhidhīyamānaṃ kriyetyucyata ityarthaḥ| kimiyaṃ tādṛśe'(svata eva sādhyatvena pratīyamāne)rthe kriyāśabdasya rūḍhiriti cennetyāhaāśritakrameti|

original: āśritaḥ kramo yena(rūpeṇa)tadāśritakrasaṃ, tadeva rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ yasyāḥ sā''śritakramarūpā, tasyā bhāva āśritakramarūpatvaṃ tasmāt kriyetyabhidhīyate| kriyāsvarūpaṃ hiyadavayavāḥ krameṇotpadyante tat| krameṇotpadyamānāvayavasamūhasvarūpeti yāvat| ayaṃ bhāvaḥāśritakramarūpatvādityetatkriyāśabdārthapradarśanam| tathā ca kriyata iti kriyā|
analyzed: āśritaḥ kramaḥ yena rūpeṇa tad āśrita krasam tat eva rūpam sva rūpam yasyāḥ sā āśrita krama rūpā tasyāḥ bhāvaḥ āśrita krama rūpa tvam tasmāt kriyā iti abhidhīyate kriyā svarūpam hiyat avayavāḥ krameṇa utpadyante tat krameṇa utpadyamāna avayava samūha svarūpā iti yāvat ayam bhāvaḥ āśrita krama rūpa tvāt iti etat kriyā śabda artha pradarśanam tathā ca kriyate iti kriyā

original: tatra kena kriyate kiṃ ca kripata ityākāṅkṣāyāṃprattyāsattyā avayavānāṃ krameṇotpattyā tad‌dvārā yatkriyate sādhyate samūharūpaṃ vastu tatkriyetyucyata ityarthaḥ| kramikāvayavotpattisādhyasamūhātmakaṃ vastveva kriyāsvarūpamiti yāvat| anena kriyāyā āśritakraparūpatvaṃ pradarśitam|
analyzed: tatra kena kriyate kim ca kripate iti ākāṅkṣāyām pratti āsattyā avayavānām krameṇa utpattyā tad dvārā yat kriyate sādhyate samūha rūpam vastu tat kriyā iti ucyate iti arthaḥ kramika avayava utpatti sādhya samūha ātmakam vastu eva kriyā svarūpam iti yāvat anena kriyāyāḥ āśrita krapa rūpa tvam pradarśitam

original: kramavatī kriyetyabhiyuktoktavivaraṇāmapi kriyāyā āśritakramarūpatvādeva saṃgacchate| āśritakramarūpatvādeva ca kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvena pratītirnirvahatīti vodhyam| adhiśrayaṇādyadhaḥśrayaṇāntānāmavayavānāṃ krameṇotpatteḥ pacyādivācyavyāpārasamūhasyoktarūpaṃ kriyāsvarūpamakṣatam|
analyzed: kramavatī kriyā iti abhiyukta ukta vivaraṇām api kriyāyāḥ āśrita krama rūpa tvāt eva saṃgacchate āśrita krama rūpa tvāt eva ca kriyāyāḥ sādhya tvena pratītiḥ nirvahati iti vodhyam adhiśrayaṇa ādi adhas śrayaṇa antānām avayavānām krameṇa utpatteḥ paci ādi vācya vyāpāra samūhasya ukta rūpam kriyā svarūpam akṣatam

original: yatra cā''śrayatādau na kramikāvayavotpattimān vyāpārastatra kramikāvayavotpattimattvasyā''ropaḥ kāryaḥ| phale'pi svajanakavyāpāragatakramikāvayavakatvārepaḥ| ata eva phalamātravāckasya kriyānibandhanadātutvasiddhiḥ| evaṃ ca vyāpārasamudāyaḥ kriyeti sidhyati|
analyzed: yatra ca āśraya tā ādau na kramika avayava utpattimān vyāpāraḥ tatra kramika avayava utpattimat tvasya āropaḥ kāryaḥ phale ipi sva janaka vyāpāra gata kramika avayavaka tva ārepaḥ atas eva phala mātra vāckasya kriyā nibandhana dātu tva siddhiḥ evam ca vyāpāra samudāyaḥ kriyā iti sidhyati

original: nanu bhavatvevaṃ vyāpārasamūhasya kriyātvaṃ tathā'pi tasya sādhyatvaprakāreṇa pratītau kiṃ pramāṇamiti jijñāsāyāṃ kvacitkriyāntarāṅkṣākvacitkriyāntarānākāṅkṣādarśanarūpapramāṇena sādhyatvarūpeṇa pratītiṃ byavasthāpayitumāhapacati pāka ityādi|
analyzed: nanu bhavatu evam vyāpāra samūhasya kriyā tvam tathā api tasya sādhya tva prakāreṇa pratītau kim pramāṇam iti jijñāsāyām sādhya tva rūpeṇa pratītim byavasthāpayitum āha pacati pākaḥ ityādi

original: pacatītyatra pac‌vātoḥ, pāka ityatra ghañ‌pratyayācca viklittyanukūlavyāpārasya dhātvarthasya pratītau samānāyāmapi pacatiśabdena kriyāvagatauḥ punaḥ kriyāyā ākāṅkṣā na bhavati atastādṛśakriyāgataṃ kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpaṃ sādhyatvamityāhatathā cetyādi kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthitipratibandhakatāvacchedakatayā siddho yo

original: jātiviśeṣastadrūpaṃ sādhyatvamityarthaḥ| idameva ca kārakānvayayoggratāvacchedakaṃ pūrvāparībhūtāvayatvasamānādhikaraṇaṃ ca bhavati| siddhajātiviśeṣa eva vaijātyaśabdena vyavahriyate| tacca vaijātyamatiriktaṃ pacatyādiśabda eva vetyanyadetat| tacca sādhyatvaṃ sarvatravai dhātupratipādyam|
analyzed: jāti viśeṣaḥ tad rūpam sādhya tvam iti arthaḥ idam eva ca kāraka anvaya yoggratā avacchedakam ca bhavati siddha jāti viśeṣaḥ eva vaijātya śabdena vyavahriyate tat ca vaijātyam atiriktam pacati ādi śabdaḥ eva vā iti anyat etat tat ca sādhya tvam sarvatra vai dhātu pratipādyam

original: pāka ityādau ghañante'pi pac‌dhātunā sādhyatvenaiva kriyā'bhidhīyate| ata eva odanasya pāka ityatraudanapadottaraṃ kartṛkarmaṇoriti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī siddhā| anyathā kārakāṇāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānakriyāyāmevānvayaniyamāt sā na syāt| ghañādinā tu siddhatvena kriyā'bhidhīyate| pāka ityukte bhavati naṣṭo vetyādikriyāntarākāṅkṣotthānāt|
analyzed: pākaḥ ityādau ghañ ante api pac dhātunā sādhya tvena eva kriyā abhidhīyate atas eva odanasya pākaḥ iti atra odana pada uttaram kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī siddhā anyathā kārakāṇām sādhya tvena pratīyamāna kriyāyām eva anvaya niyamāt sā na syāt ghañ ādinā tu siddha tvena kriyā abhidhīyate pākaḥ iti ukte bhavati naṣṭaḥ vā ityādi kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā utthānāt

original: siddhatvaṃ ca kriyāntarākāṅkṣotyāpakatāvacchekarūpam| kriyākāṅkṣotthāpakatāvacchedakatayā siddho yo jātiviśeṣo(vaijātyaṃ)tad‌rūpamityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca pac‌dhātvarthe'nvaye śobhanaṃ pākaḥ ghañarthe'nvaye śobhanaḥ pāka iti sādhyatvasiddhatvavyavasthayā vyavasthitaḥ prayogaḥ|
analyzed: siddha tvam ca kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā utyāpaka tā avaccheka rūpam kriyā ākāṅkṣā utthāpaka tā avacchedaka tayā siddhaḥ yaḥ jāti viśeṣaḥ vaijātyam tat rūpam iti arthaḥ evam ca śobhanam pākaḥ ghañ arthe nvaye śobhanaḥ pākaḥ iti sādhya tva siddha tva vyavasthayā vyavasthitaḥ prayogaḥ

original: etacca granthakāro'pyagre vakṣyatisādhyatvenaṃ kriyā tatra dhāturūpanibandhanā| siddhabhāvastu yastasyāḥ sa ghañādinibandhanaḥ|| iti| tatreti pāka ityādighañādyanta ityarthaḥ| viśeṣastvagre vakṣyate| na caivaṃ hirugādyavyayānāṃ kriyāpradhānatvavyavahārasya taddhitaśceti sūtre bhāṣye kriyamāṇasyānupapattistadarthānāṃ sādhyatvenābhānāditi vācyam|
analyzed: etat ca granthakāraḥ api agre vakṣyati sādhya tvena kriyā tatra dhātu rūpa nibandhanā siddha bhāvaḥ tu yaḥ tasyāḥ sa ghañ ādi nibandhanaḥ iti tatra iti pākaḥ iti ādi ghañ ādi antaḥ iti arthaḥ viśeṣaḥ tu agre vakṣyate na ca evam hi ruk ādi avyayānām kriyā pradhāna tva vyavahārasya taddhitaḥ ca iti sūtre bhāṣye kriyamāṇasya anupapattiḥ tad arthānām sādhya tvena ābhānāt iti vācyam

original: tādṛśavyavahārasya tadarthānāṃ ktvāntādivātkriyāmātra viśeṣaṇanibandhavanatvāt| yathā dhātusaṃbandhādhikāravihitaktvāntādyarthasya vrajatītyādikriyāmātraviśeṣaṇatvaṃ tadvaddhirugādyavyayārthānāṃ kriyāmātraviśeṣaṇatvam| mātrapadena nāmārthanirūpitaviśeṣaṇatvavyāvṛttirityarthaḥ| tathā ca gauṇastatra tathā vyavahāra iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśa vyavahārasya tad arthānām yathā dhātu saṃbandha adhikāra vihita ktvā anta ādi arthasya vrajati ityādi kriyā mātra viśeṣaṇa tvam tadvat hi ruj ādi avyaya arthānām kriyā mātra viśeṣaṇa tvam mātra padena nāma artha nirūpita viśeṣaṇa tva vyāvṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca gauṇaḥ tatra tathā vyavahāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: hirugādyarthānāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānakriyātvābhāvādeva na tatra kārakānvayaḥ| sādhyatvena pratīyamānakriyāyāmeva kārakānvayaniyamāt| hirugādyarthānāṃ kriyāntarākvāṅkṣāsattvena pratīyamānakriyātvābhāvāt|
analyzed: hi ruj ādi arthānām sādhya tvena pratīyamāna kriyā tva abhāvāt eva na tatra kāraka anvayaḥ sādhya tvena pratīyamāna kriyāyām eva kāraka anvaya niyamāt hi ruj ādi arthānām kriyā antara ākvāṅkṣā sattvena pratīyamāna kriyā tva abhāvāt

original: nanvevaṃ dhātutaḥ kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpeṇāperithatau kṛṣṇaṃ nameccetsukhaṃ yāyādityatrā''kāṅkṣāyā abhāvena namanasukhaprāptirūpakriyayorhetuhetumadbhāvenānvayo na syāditi cenna| cecchavdasamabhivyāhārasācivyonā''kāṅkṣotthāpanāt| pare tuvastutaḥ sādhyatvaṃ niṣpādyatvameva| tenaiva rūpeṇa bodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāt|
analyzed: nanu evam dhātutaḥ kṛṣṇam namet ced sukham yāyāt iti atra ākāṅkṣāyāḥ abhāvena namana sukha prāpti rūpa kriyayoḥ hetu hetumat bhāvena anvayaḥ na syāt iti ced na ced śavda samabhivyāhāra sācivya ūna ākāṅkṣā utthāpanāt pare tu vastutas sādhya tvam niṣpādya tvam eva tena eva rūpeṇa bodhasya anubhava siddha tvāt

original: spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ `suṭ‌kātpūrvaḥ' ityatra bhāṣye| tatra hidhātūpasargayoḥ kāryamantaraṅgamityādyuktvā`naitatsāraṃ pūrvaṃ hi dhātuḥ sādhanena yujyate paścādupasargeṇa, sādhanaṃ hi kriyāṃ nirvatayati, tāmupasargo viśinaṣṭhi' ityuktam|

analyzed: adhiśrayaṇa tva ādīnām śakyatā avacchekānām buddhi viṣaya tva rūpeṇa śakyatā saṃpannā iti viṣayatā saṃbandhena śakyatā avacchedaka tā avacchedakaḥ dharmaḥ buddhiḥ sā ca buddhiḥ samūha ālambana rūpā ekā eva iti tādṛśa buddhi gatam ekatvam adhiśrayaṇa ādi vyāpāreṣu āropya kriyā ekā eva iti vyavasthā iti bhāvaḥ athavā tādṛśa buddhi stha samūha gatam ekatvam gṛhītvā eva iti arthaḥ

original: svoktārthe vākyapadīyaṃ pramāṇayatiuktaṃ cetyādinā| guṇabhūtairiti| krameṇa janma yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ buddhisthānāmadhiśrayaṇādīnāṃ vyāpārāṇāṃ samūhaṃ prati guṇabhūtaistattadrūpeṇa phūtkāratvādinā bhāsamānairavayavairyuktaḥ saṃkalanātmikayā(samūhālambanātmikayā)ekatvaviṣayakabuddhyā prakalpito yo'bhedastadrūpo yaḥ samūhaḥ sa kriyeti vyavahriyata
analyzed: sva ukta arthe vākyapadīyam pramāṇayati uktam ca ityādinā guṇa bhūtaiḥ iti krameṇa janma yeṣām teṣām buddhi sthānām adhiśrayaṇa ādīnām vyāpārāṇām samūham prati guṇa bhūtaiḥ tad tad rūpeṇa phūtkāra tva ādinā bhāsamānaiḥ avayavaiḥ yuktaḥ saṃkalana ātmikayā a samūha ālambana ātmikayā ekatva viṣayaka buddhyā prakalpitaḥ yaḥ bhedaḥ tad rūpaḥ yaḥ samūhaḥ sa kriyā iti vyavahriyata

original: ityarthaḥ| atra guṇabhūtairityasyāṅgabhūtairityarthe paunaruktyāpattirato guṇaśabdo dharmaparaḥ, bhūtaśabdo `ye prāptyarthāste jñānārthāḥ, iti nyāyena bhū prāptāvityukterjñānaparo vartamānaktapratyayānta iti tattadrūpeṇa bhāsamānairityarthakaḥ| pratyāsattyā samūhaṃ pratītyuktam| kṣaṇanaśvarāṇāṃ vastubhūtasamūhāsaṃbhavād‌buddhyetyuktam|
analyzed: iti arthaḥ atra guṇa bhūtaiḥ iti asya aṅga bhūtaiḥ iti arthe paunaruktya āpattiḥ atas guṇa śabdaḥ dharma paraḥ bhūta śabdaḥ ye prāpti arthāḥ te jñāna arthāḥ iti nyāyena prāptau iti ukteḥ jñāna paraḥ iti tad tad rūpeṇa bhāsamānaiḥ iti arthakaḥ pratyāsattyā samūham prati iti uktam kṣaṇa naśvarāṇām vastu bhūta samūha asaṃbhavāt buddhyā iti uktam

original: evaṃ ca samūhavyavahāro buddhikṛto vikalpa eva na vāstava iti bhāvaḥ| śabdajñānānupātī vastuśūnyo vikalpa iti patañjalyuktaḥ| śabdajñānāmātreṇa buddhāvanupatanaśīlaḥ bāhyārtharahitaḥ viśeṣeṇa kalpyata iti vikalpaḥ buddhiparikalpita iti tadarthaḥ| avāvayavāśrayaṃ paurvāparyaṃ samudāyāśrayamekatvaṃ ceti spaṣṭameva labhyate|
analyzed: evam ca samūha vyavahāraḥ buddhi kṛtaḥ vikalpaḥ eva na vāstavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ śabda jñāna anupātī vastu śūnyaḥ vikalpaḥ iti patañjali uktaḥ śabda jñāna amātreṇa buddhau anupatana śīlaḥ bāhya artha rahitaḥ viśeṣeṇa kalpyate iti vikalpaḥ buddhi parikalpitaḥ iti tad arthaḥ ava avayava āśrayam paurvāparyam samudāya āśrayam ekatvam ca iti spaṣṭam eva labhyate

original: buddhisthatvādirūpaśakyatāvacchedakānugamakabodhakamidaṃ vacanamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu yadi vyāpārasya samudāyātmakatvaṃ tarhi adhiśrayaṇādyekaikāśayena stālī pacatīti prayogo na syāditi cenna| ekaikāvayave'pi samūhatvarūpasyā'ropāttadupapattiḥ| ārope ca tādṛśapratītireva pramāṇam| ata evoktaṃ hariṇāekadeśe samūhe vā vyāpārāṇāṃ pacādayaḥ|
analyzed: buddhisthatva ādi rūpa śakyatā avacchedaka anugamaka bodhakam idam vacanam iti bhāvaḥ nanu yadi vyāpārasya samudāya ātmaka tvam tarhi adhiśrayaṇa ādi ekaika āśayena stālī pacati iti prayogaḥ na syāt iti ced na ekaika avayave api samūha tva rūpasya āropāt tad upapattiḥ ārope ca tādṛśa pratītiḥ eva pramāṇam atas eva uktam hariṇā eka deśe samūhe vā vyāpārāṇām paca ādayaḥ

original: svabhāvataḥ pravartante tulyarūpaṃ samāśritāḥ| iti| tulyarūpamityasya tulyenābhinnena svabhāvena yuktā ete dhātavo'bhinnā ityarthaḥ| etena pacatīti buddheḥ sarvatrānuvartamānatvātpratyavayavamaparisamāptasya samūhasya ekaikāvayave'pi āropaḥ svaṣṭa evokto bhavati|
analyzed: svabhāvataḥ pravartante tulya rūpam samāśritāḥ iti tulya rūpam iti asya tulyena abhinnena svabhāvena yuktāḥ ete dhātavaḥ bhinnāḥ iti arthaḥ etena pacati iti buddheḥ sarvatra anuvartamāna tvāt pratyavayavam aparisamāptasya samūhasya ekaika avayave pi āropaḥ su aṣṭaḥ eva uktaḥ bhavati

original: vastutastu adhiśrayaṇādirapi naikakṣaṇātmakastasyāpi hastaprasāraṇapātrādānacullīsaṃyojanādayo'vayavāḥ santyeveti so'pi samūharūpa eveti bodhyam| adhyāsagṛhītayaiva kriyayā ākhyātasya śaktirūpasaṃbandhagraho bodhyaḥ| ata eva phūtkārasyātītatvamātreṇa vyāpārāntaravartamānadaśāyāmapākṣīditi na bhavati bhūtatvādeḥ samudāyena saṃbandhāditi jñeyam|
analyzed: vastutas tu adhiśrayaṇa ādiḥ api na eka kṣaṇa ātmakaḥ tasya api hasta prasāraṇa pātra ādāna cullī saṃyojana ādayaḥ vayavāḥ santi eva iti saḥ api samūha rūpaḥ eva iti bodhyam adhyāsa gṛhītayā eva kriyayā ākhyātasya śakti rūpa saṃbandha grahaḥ bodhyaḥ atas eva phūtkārasya atīta tva mātreṇa vyāpāra antara vartamāna daśāyām apākṣīt iti na bhavati bhūta tva ādeḥ samudāyena saṃbandhāt iti jñeyam

original: nanu tattadrupeṇa vācyatvena viklittyanukūlaḥ phūtkārādirityeva śābdabodhaḥ syānnatu viklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti sāmānyarūpeṇeti cenna| dhātūnāmanekārthatvātkadācitsāmānyarūpeṇa kriyātvena bodhāṅgīkārāt| tatra yadā yo vaktṛbuddhisthaḥ sa tadā vācyaḥ| tadaiva tadāśrayaḥ kartā| dhātunoktakriye nityaṃ kārake kartṛteṣyate, iti haryukteḥ|
analyzed: nanu tad tad rupeṇa vācyatvena viklitti anukūlaḥ phūtkāra ādiḥ iti eva śābda bodhaḥ syāt na tu viklitti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti sāmānya rūpeṇa iti ced na dhātūnām aneka artha tvāt kadācid sāmānya rūpeṇa kriyā tvena bodha aṅgīkārāt tatra yadā yaḥ vaktṛ buddhi sthaḥ sa tadā vācyaḥ tadā eva tad āśrayaḥ kartā dhātunā ukta kriye nityam kārake kartṛ tā iṣyate iti haryukteḥ

original: ata eva kāṣṭhaṃ pacati sthālī pacatīti saṃgacchate| etena kāṣṭhena pacatītyapi nānupapannam| tadā tad‌vyāpārasya dhātvarthatvenāvivakṣaṇāt| evaṃ ca kāṣṭhākriyāyā vācyatve tṛtīyā na syāt| avācyate prathamā na syādityādyapāstam| atra śaktanāvacchedakaṃ pacitvādikaṃ tattadānupūrvīviśeṣarūpaṃ, natu dhātutvam|
analyzed: atas eva kāṣṭham pacati sthālī pacati iti saṃgacchate etena kāṣṭhena pacati iti api na anupapannam tadā tad vyāpārasya dhātvartha tvena avivakṣaṇāt evam ca kāṣṭhā kriyāyāḥ vācyatve tṛtīyā na syāt a vācyate prathamā na syāt ityādi apāstam atra paci tva ādikam tat tad ānupūrvī viśeṣa rūpam natu dhātu tvam

original: gacchatyādāvapi tasya(dhātutvasya) sattvenātiprasaktatvāt| atiprasaktasya ca śaktatānavacchedakatvāt| anyūnānatiriktavṛttidharmasyaivāvacchedakatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: gacchati ādau api sattvena atiprasaktatvāt atiprasaktasya ca śaktatā anavacchedaka tvāt anyūna anatirikta vṛtti dharmasya eva avacchedaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ saṃkṣepato dhātvarthaṃ nirūpya vaktumārabhateāśraye tvitīti| phalavyāpārayormadhye vyāpārasyotsargataḥ prādhānye'pi laḥ karmaṇi ceti sūtre, phalavyāpārayordāturiti mūle ca phalāśrayasya karmaṇaḥ| prāṅnirdeśāttadanurodhenā''haphalāśraye, phalāśrayaḥ karmetyādi|
analyzed: evam saṃkṣepataḥ dhātvartham nirūpya vaktum ārabhate āśraye tu iti iti phala vyāpārayoḥ madhye vyāpārasya utsargataḥ prādhānye pi laḥ karmaṇi ca iti sūtre phala vyāpārayoḥ dātuḥ iti mūle ca phala āśrayasya karmaṇaḥ prāk nirdeśāt tad anurodhena āha phala āśraye phala āśrayaḥ karma ityādi

original: kṛtrimākṛtrimanyāyena phalāyavyāpārāśrayayoreva karmakartupadābhyāṃ grahaṇasyocitatvaṃ natu laukikayoḥ spandakṛtimatorityarthaḥ| svatantraḥ kartoti sūtreṇa dhātūpāttapradhānībhūtavyāpārāśrayasyaiva svatantrasya kartṛsaṃjñāvidhānāt| kṛtimata eva kartṛsaṃjñāvidhāne ghaṭo bhavati kāṣṭhāni pacantītyādau ghaṭādeḥ sā na syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kṛtrima akṛtrima nyāyena phala āya vyāpāra āśrayayoḥ eva karma kartu padābhyām grahaṇasya ucitatvam na tu laukikayoḥ spanda kṛtimatoḥ iti arthaḥ svatantraḥ kartā iti sūtreṇa dhātu upātta pradhānībhūta vyāpāra āśrayasya eva svatantrasya kartṛ saṃjñā vidhānāt kṛtimataḥ eva kartṛ saṃjñā vidhāne ghaṭaḥ bhavati kāṣṭhāni pacanti ityādau ghaṭa ādeḥ sā na syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tatra phalavyāpārayordhātulamyatvānna tadaṃśe ākhyātasya śaktiḥ, kiṃtvāśrayamātra ityāhatatretyādinā| anyalamyatvāditi| ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāditi nyāyāt| phalavyāpārayordhātunaiva lābhe sati punastatrā'khyātasya śaktikalpanaṃ gauravāpādakamiti bhāvaḥnanu āśraye śaktisvīkāre āśrayetvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ vācyam| āśrayatvaṃ cā''dhāratvam|
analyzed: tatra phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātu lamya tvāt na tad aṃśe ākhyātasya śaktiḥ kiṃtu āśraya mātre iti āha tatra ityādinā anya lamya tvāt iti ananya labhyasya eva śabda artha tvāt iti nyāyāt phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātunā eva lābhe sati punar tatra ākhyātasya śakti kalpanam gaurava āpādakam iti bhāvaḥ nanu āśraye śakti svīkāre āśraye tvam śakyatā avacchedakam vācyam āśraya tvam ca ādhāra tvam

original: tacca nirūpakādibhedādbhinnam| tathācā''śrayatvasya nānātvāccha| ktinānātvāpattiḥ syādata āhatattaditi| kartṛtvādyakhaṇḍaśaktisvarūpamityarthaḥ| yadyapi kartṛtvādiśakterapi nirūpakabhedānnānātvamavaśyamaṅgīkāryaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tat ca nirūpaka ādi bhedāt bhinnam tathāca āśraya tvasya nānātvāt śa kti nānātva āpattiḥ syāt atas āha tat tat iti kartṛ tva ādi akhaṇḍa śakti svarūpam iti arthaḥ yadi api kartṛ tva ādi śakteḥ api nirūpaka bhedāt nānātvam avaśyam aṅgīkāryam bhavati

original: anyathā `adya bhuktvā'yaṃ vdyahe vdyahādvā bhoktā' ityatra `ityatra `saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye' iti sūtrasthākārakaśabdasya śaktiparatve'pi kartṛtvaśakterekatvena kartṛtvaśaktidvayamadhyasthakālavācakād‌d‌vyahaśabdāt saptamīpañcamyoranupapattiḥ syāt|
analyzed: anyathā adya bhuktvā ayam vdyahe vdyahāt vā bhoktā iti atra iti atra saptamī pañcamyau kāraka madhye iti sūtra stha a kāraka śabdasya śakti paratve pi kartṛ tva śakteḥ ekatvena kartṛ tva śakti dvaya madhya stha kāla vācakāt dvi aha śabdāt saptamī pañcamyoḥ anupapattiḥ syāt

original: adyatanabhujikriyāvdyahottarīdanīyabhujikriyābhyāṃ kartṛtvaśakterbhede tu na kācidanupapattistathā'pi āśrayatātvenānugatasya tasya(āśrayatvasya)śakyatāvacchedakatve śaktinānātvādidoṣāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu phalāśrayavyāpārāśrayayorākhyāta(tiṅ)vācyatve kiṃ mānam?| na ca pacatītyukte āśrayapratīti rjāyamānā''vyātasya tatra śaktiṃ kalpayet|
analyzed: kartṛ tva śakteḥ bhede tu na kācid anupapattiḥ tathā api āśraya tā tvena anugatasya śakti nānātva ādi doṣa asaṃbhavāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu phala āśraya vyāpāra āśrayayoḥ ākhyāta tiṅ vācya tve kim mānam na ca pacati iti ukte āśraya pratītiḥ jāyamāna a vyātasya tatra śaktim kalpayet

original: yathā ghaṭapadātkambugrīvādimadarthapratītirjāyamānā ghaṭapadasya kambugrīvādimati śaktiṃ kalpayati, yadyasmātpratīyate tattasya vācyamiti nyāyāditi vācyam| anyathā'nupapadyamānāyā eva pratītermānatvāt| anyathā gaṅgādipadasya tīrādāvapi śaktikalpanāpatteḥ|
analyzed: yathā ghaṭa padāt kambu grīva ādimat artha pratītiḥ jāyamānā ghaṭa padasya kambu grīvā ādimati śaktim kalpayati yat yasmāt pratīyate tat tasya vācyam iti nyāyāt iti vācyam anyathā anupapadyamānāyāḥ eva pratīteḥ māna tvāt anyathā gaṅgā ādi padasya tīra ādau api śakti kalpanā āpatteḥ

original: tatra lakṣaṇayaiva nirvāha iti cet‌prakṛte'pi anyathā nirvāhasaṃbhavādityāśayavān pṛcchatinanvanayorityādinā| mīmāṃsakamateneyamāśaṅkā| te hi phalaṃ dhātvartha ākhyātārtho bhāvanā(phalānukūlavyāpāraḥ)iti vadanti| pacatītyādyukte jāyamānāmāśrayapratītimanyathā yojayitumāhapratīteriti| phalāśrayavyāpārāśrayapratītorityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra lakṣaṇayā eva nirvāhaḥ iti ced prakṛte api anyathā nirvāha saṃbhavāt iti āśayavān pṛcchati nanu anayoḥ ityādinā mīmāṃsaka matena iyam āśaṅkā te hi phalam dhātvarthaḥ ākhyāta arthaḥ bhāvanā phala anukūla vyāpāraḥ iti vadanti pacati ityādi ukte jāyamānām āśraya pratītim anyathā yojayitum āha pratīteḥ iti phala āśraya vyāpāra āśraya pratītoḥ iti arthaḥ

original: asyāḥ saṃbhavādityatrānvayaḥ| saṃbhavaṃ pradarśayatilakṣaṇayeti| gaṅgāpadāllakṣaṇayā gaṅgātīrasyeva bhāvanāvācakādākhyātāttadāśrayasya grahaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| nanvākhyātasyā''śraye lakṣaṇāyāṃ bhāvanāpratītirna syāt|
analyzed: asyāḥ saṃbhavāt iti atra anvayaḥ saṃbhavam pradarśayati lakṣaṇayā iti gaṅgā padāt lakṣaṇayā gaṅgā tīrasya iva bhāvanā vācakāt ākhyātāt tad āśrayasya grahaṇam iti bhāvaḥ nanu ākhyātasya āśraye lakṣaṇāyām bhāvanā pratītiḥ na syāt

original: tatpratītyarthamākhyātasyabhāvanāyāṃ śaktikalpane āśraye lakṣaṇāyā asaṃbhavo yugapad‌vṛttidvayavirodhāt bhāvanāśrayatvena bhāvanāśraye lakṣaṇāyāmapi bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyena pratītirnasyāt| viśiṣṭe lakṣaṇāyāṃ gauravaprasaṅgāccetyarucerāhaākṣepāditi| ākṣepo nāmārthāpattirmīmāṃsakamate| tārkikamate tvanumānam|
analyzed: tad pratīti artham ākhyātasya bhāvanāyām śakti kalpane āśraye lakṣaṇāyāḥ asaṃbhavaḥ yugapad vṛtti dvaya virodhāt bhāvanā āśraya tvena bhāvanā āśraye lakṣaṇāyām api bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyena pratītiḥ nasyāt viśiṣṭe lakṣaṇāyām gaurava prasaṅgāt ca iti aruceḥ āha ākṣepāt iti ākṣepaḥ nāma arthāpattiḥ mīmāṃsaka mate tārkika mate tu anumānam

original: arthāpattiryathāyena vinā yadanupapannaṃ tena tatkalpyate| pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅkte, ityatra bhojanaṃ vinā'nupapannena yogābhyāsādyajanyapuṣṭatvena bhojanaṃ kalpyate tacca diva| na bhuṅkte iti niṣedhāt rātribhojanamādāya paryavasyati tadvatprakṛte bhāvanāyā(vyāpārasya)kartāraṃ vinā'nupapattyā kūrtṛrūpaṃ svāśrayaṃ sā kalpayati iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: arthāpattiḥ yathā yena vinā yat anupapannam tena tat kalpyate pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atra bhojanam vinā anupapannena yoga abhyāsa ādi ajanya puṣṭa tvena bhojanam kalpyate tat ca na bhuṅkte iti niṣedhāt rātri bhojanam ādāya paryavasyati tadvat prakṛte bhāvanāyāḥ avyāpārasya kartāram vinā anupapattyā kūrtṛ rūpam svāśrayam sā kalpayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: tārkikamate tu bhāvanaṃ pakṣīkṛtya sakartṛkatvaṃ sādhyate kāryatvāt, paṭavadityanumi| tijanakaṃ vyāptijñānādikamākṣepa ityarthaḥ| evaṃ phalasyāpi svāśrayaṃ vinā'nupapattyā tenasa ākṣipyeta| ākṣepalabhyasyāpi śābdabodhaviṣayatvābhyupagamādākhyāṃtajanyaśābdabodhe bhāvanāyāḥ pratītirna viruddheti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tārkika mate tu bhāvanam pakṣīkṛtya sakartṛkatvam sādhyate kāryatvāt paṭa vat iti anumi ti janakam vyāpti jñāna ādikam ākṣepaḥ iti arthaḥ evam phalasya api svāśrayam vinā anupapattyā ākṣipyeta ākṣepa labhyasya api śābdabodha viṣayatva abhyupagamāt ākhyāṃta janya śābdabodhe bhāvanāyāḥ pratītiḥ na viruddhā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu pṛttyā padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ śābdabodhahetutvenā''kṣepalabhyasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvaṃ vaktumanucitam| kiṃ cā''kṣipte kartrādāvākhyātārthasaṃkhyānvayānupapattiḥ| kartrādervṛttyā'nupasthitatvāt| śābdī hyākāṅkṣā śabdenaiva pūryata iti nyāyāt|
analyzed: nanu pṛttyā pada janya padārtha upasthiteḥ śābdabodha hetutvena ākṣepa labhyasya śābdabodha viṣayatvam vaktum anucitam kim ca ākṣipte kartṛ ādau ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā anvaya anupapattiḥ kartṛ ādeḥ vṛttyā anupasthita tvāt śābdī hi ākāṅkṣā śabdena eva pūryate iti nyāyāt

original: śābdabodhaviṣayasiddhisaṃpādanena nivāryata iti tadarthādityarucerāhaprathamāntapadādveti svasamabhivyāhṛtadevadattādiprathamāntapadādeva āśrayapratīteḥ saṃbhavānna pratītirākhyātasyā''śraye śaktikalpanāyāṃ pramāṇamiti tātparyam| ata āhaatrocyata ityādinā| phalāśraye vyāpārāśraye ca tiṅāṃ śaktirityarthe pāṇinisūtraṃ pramāṇayatilaḥ karmaṇioiti|
analyzed: śābda bodha viṣaya siddhi saṃpādanena nivāryate iti tad arthāt iti aruceḥ āha prathama anta padāt vā iti sva samabhivyāhṛta devadatta ādi prathama anta padāt eva āśraya pratīteḥ saṃbhavān na pratītiḥ ākhyātasya āśraye śakti kalpanāyām pramāṇam iti tātparyam atas āha atra ucyate ityādinā phala āśraye vyāpāra āśraye ca tiṅām śaktiḥ iti arthe pāṇini sūtram pramāṇayati laḥ

original: nanvidaṃ sūtraṃ tiṅāṃ karmaṇi śaktiṃ grāhayenna kartari, tatra kartṛpadāśravaṇādityāśaṅkyā''haatra hītyādi| cakāreṇa `kartari kṛt' iti pūrvasūtrasthaṃ kartarīti saptamyantaṃ padaṃ prakṛtasūtre'nukṛṣyata ityarthaḥ| bhavatu kartarītyasyānukarṣastathā'pīdaṃ sūtraṃ lakārāṇāmeva kartrādyarthe śaktiṃ bodhayedata āhabodhakatārūpāmityādi|
analyzed: nanu idam sūtram tiṅām karmaṇi śaktim grāhayet na kartari tatra kartṛ pada āśravaṇāt iti āśaṅkya āha atra hi ityādi cakāreṇa kartari kṛt iti pūrva sūtra stham kartari iti saptamī antam padam prakṛta sūtre nukṛṣyate iti arthaḥ bhavatu kartari iti asya anukarṣaḥ tathā api idam sūtram lakārāṇām eva kartṛ ādi arthe śaktim bodhayet atas āha bodhaka tā rūpām ityādi

original: bodhajanakatārūpāmityarthaḥ| tibādiśaktim| tibādiniṣṭhāṃ śaktimityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥprayogadaśāyāṃ tibādīnāmeva śravaṇāttata eva cārthabodhasya jāyamānatvārttibādiniṣṭhāmarthabodhakatārūpāṃ śaktiṃ lāghavena prakriyānirvāhāya nibādisthānitvena kalpite lakāre āropya karmaṇi kartari cānena sūtreṇa lakārā vidhīyanta iti tātparyam|
analyzed: bodha janaka tā rūpām iti arthaḥ tip ādi śaktim tip ādi niṣṭhām śaktim iti arthaḥ ayam bhāvaḥ prayoga daśāyām tip ādīnām eva śravaṇāt tatas eva ca artha bodhasya jāyamāna tvāt tib ādi niṣṭhām artha bodhaka tā rūpām śaktim lāghavena prakriyā nirvāhāya nip ādi sthāni tvena kalpite lakāre āropya karmaṇi kartari ca anena sūtreṇa lakārāḥ vidhīyante iti tātparyam

original: tathā cā''khyātapadavācyasya tiṅa āśraye śaktiriti kaṇṭharaveṇoktaṃ pāṇininā''cāryeṇeti bhāvaḥ| nanu tibādibhya evārthabodhasya siddhatvāllakārasya kvāpi prayogeṣvaśravaṇāllasyetyanuktvā tiptasityādisūtreṇa svātantryeṇaiva tibādayo vidhīyantām|
analyzed: tathā ca ākhyāta pada vācyasya tiṅaḥ āśraye śaktiḥ iti kaṇṭharaveṇa uktam pāṇininā ācāryeṇa iti bhāvaḥ nanu tip ādibhyaḥ eva artha bodhasya siddha tvāt lakārasya kvāpi prayogeṣu aśravaṇāt lasya iti an uktvā tipta sityādi sūtreṇa svātantryeṇa eva tip ādayaḥ vidhīyantām

original: vartamāne tiṅ, tiṅaḥ śatṛśānacāvaprathamāsamānādhikaraṇe, ityevaṃ rotyā laṭ‌padasthāne tiṅ‌padaghaṭitanyāsānvidhāya tibādyanuvādena vartamānādikālāśca vidhīyantāmiti cenna| ṭito lakārasya sthāne vihitānāmātmanepadānāṃ ṭeḥ sthāne etvavidhāyakasya ṭita ātmanepadānāṃ ṭere, ityāderasāṃgatyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: vartamāne tiṅ tiṅaḥ śatṛ śānacau a prathamā samāna adhikaraṇe iti evam rotyā laṭ pada sthāne tiṅ pada ghaṭita nyāsān vidhāya tip ādi anuvādena vartamāna ādi kālāḥ ca vidhīyantām iti ced na ṭitaḥ lakārasya sthāne vihitānām ātmanepadānām ṭeḥ sthāne e tva vidhāyakasya ṭitaḥ ātmanepadānām ityādeḥ asāṃgatya āpatteḥ

original: ṭito lakārasyaivābhāvātnanu vartamāne tiṅṭ, anadyatane tiṅṭ, ityādinyāsān kṛtvā tattatkālārthakati bādestattadanubandha āsajyatām| tathā ca ṭita ātmanepadānāmityādernāsāṃgatyamiti cet tathāpi liṭastajhayoreśirec, luṭaḥ prathamasya ḍāraurasaḥ, ityādarasaṃgatiḥ syāt| tatra tatra nyāsāntararacane gauravāpatterityāstāṃ tāvat|
analyzed: ṭ itaḥ lakārasya eva abhāvāt nanu vartamāne tiṅṭ anadyatane tiṅṭ ityādi nyāsān kṛtvā tat tat kāla arthakati ba ādeḥ tat tad anubandhaḥ āsajyatām tathā ca ṭ itaḥ ātmanepadānām ityādeḥ na asāṃgatyam iti ced tathā api luṭaḥ prathamasya iti ādara saṃgatiḥ syāt tatra tatra nyāsa antara racane gaurava āpatteḥ iti āstām tāvat

original: ādeśaniṣṭhāyā bodhakatāśakteḥ kalpite sthāninyārope dṛṣṭāntamāharāmān rāmaiḥ, ityādau nakāravisargādita eva tattadarthapratītyā tanniṣṭhāṃ bodhakatāśaktimarthavatyeva sthānyādeśabhāva iti niyamāttatsthānighaṭite samudāye āropya karmakaraṇādau yathā śas‌bhisādayo vidhīyante tadvaditi bhāvaḥ| laḥ karmaṇīti sūtrārthaviṣaye śaṅkatena ceti|
analyzed: ādeśa niṣṭhāyāḥ bodhaka tā śakteḥ kalpite sthānini ārope dṛṣṭāntam āha rāmān rāmaiḥ ityādau nakāra visarga āditaḥ eva tad tad artha pratītyā tad niṣṭhām bodhaka tā śaktim arthavatī eva sthāni ādeśa bhāvaḥ iti niyamāt tad sthāni ghaṭite samudāye āropya karma karaṇa ādau yathā vidhīyante tadvat iti bhāvaḥ laḥ karmaṇi iti sūtra artha viṣaye śaṅkatena ca iti

original: laḥ karmaṇīti sūtre karmakartṛpade karmatvakartṛtvarūpadharmārthake| bhāvapradhānanirdeśāt,(bhāvaḥprakṛtijanyabode prakāraḥ, pradhānaṃ viśeṣyaṃ, yatretyetādṛśanirdeśācchavavdoccāraṇādityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇayā svārāsikaviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyatayā diśeṣyasya ca viśeṣaṇatayā bodhajanakāditi tātparyam|
analyzed: laḥ karmaṇi iti sūtre karma kartṛ pade karmatva kartṛ tva rūpa dharma arthake bhāva pradhāna nirdeśāt bhāvaḥ prakṛti janya bode prakāraḥ pradhānam viśeṣyam yatra iti etādṛśa nirdeśāt śavavda uccāraṇāt iti arthaḥ lakṣaṇayā svārāsika viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣya tayā diśeṣyasya ca viśeṣaṇa tayā bodha janakāt iti tātparyam

original: yathā ghaṭaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatvamityevaṃ ghaṭatvaviśeṣyakaṃ ghaṭapadamiti)lāghavānurodhācca| dharmiparatve tu ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭe ghaṭaśabdasyeva karmatvaviśiṣṭe karmaṇi kṛtiviśiṣṭe kartari ca śaktiḥ kalpyā| anantānāṃ phalānāṃ kṛtīnāṃ ca śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svīkartavyaṃ bhavati| tathā cātigauravaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: yathā ghaṭa niṣṭham ghaṭa tvam iti evam ghaṭa tva viśeṣyakam ghaṭa padam iti lāghava anurodhāt ca dharmi paratve tu ghaṭa tva viśiṣṭa ghaṭe ghaṭa śabdasya iva karmatva viśiṣṭe karmaṇi kṛti viśiṣṭe kartari ca śaktiḥ kalpyā anantānām phalānām kṛtīnām ca śakyatā avacchedaka tvam svīkartavyam bhavati tathā ca ati gauravam bhavati

original: kṛteḥ śakyatve tu kṛtitvasya jātirūpatayai katvāt śakyatāvacchedakaikatvena lāghavaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| kartṛtvaṃ kṛtiḥ karmatvaṃ ca phalamiti| nanu kartṛtvakarmatvayoḥ khataṃ kṛtiphalarūpatvamiti cetucyate| yatnārthakakṛñ‌dhātoḥ kartari tṛc‌pratyayena niṣpannaḥ kartṛśabdo yatnavānityarthaṃ vakti|
analyzed: kṛteḥ śakya tve tu kṛti tvasya jāti rūpatayai ka tvāt śakya tā avacchedaka eka tvena lāghavam bhavati iti arthaḥ kartṛ tvam kṛtiḥ karma tvam ca phalam iti nanu kartṛ tva karma tvayoḥ kṛti phala rūpa tvam iti ced ucyate yatna arthaka kṛñ dhātoḥ kartari tṛc pratyayena niṣpannaḥ kartṛ śabdaḥ yatnavān iti artham vakti

original: taduttarastvapratyayaśca prakṛtijanyabodhīyaviśeṣaṇībhūtayatnavācakaḥ| yatnaśca kṛtiriti kartṛtvasya kṛtirūpatvaṃ, karmaśabdasya phalāśraye pāribhāṣikatvāttaduttaratvapratyayena prakṛtyarthaprakārībhūraphalabodhanātkarmatvasya phalarūpatvaṃ ca siddhamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tad uttaraḥ tu a pratyayaḥ ca prakṛti janya bodhīya viśeṣaṇībhūta yatna vācakaḥ yatnaḥ ca kṛtiḥ iti kartṛ tvasya kṛti rūpa tvam karma śabdasya phala āśraye pāribhāṣika tvāt tad uttara tva pratyayena prakṛti artha prakārībhūra phala bodhanāt karma tvasya phala rūpa tvam ca siddham iti arthaḥ

original: phalavyāpārayośca dhātunaiva pratipādanāllakārasya punastatra śaktikalpanamatyantāyuktamiti nedaṃ sūtramākhyātasya kartṛkarmaṇoḥ śaktiṃ bodhayatīti bhāvaḥ| darśanāntarīyarītyeti| anyaddarśanaṃ darśanāntaraṃ, mīmāṃsādarśanaṃ tadrītyetyarthaḥ| dhātvarthatvābhāvāditi| viklittyādiphalameva dhātvarthaḥ, pyāpāraḥ pratyayārthaḥ iti mīmāṃsakā manyante|
analyzed: phala vyāpārayoḥ ca dhātunā eva pratipādanāt lakārasya punar tatra śakti kalpanam atyanta ayuktam iti na idam sūtram ākhyātasya kartṛ karmaṇoḥ śaktim bodhayati iti bhāvaḥ darśana antarīya rītyā iti anyat darśanam darśana antaram mīmāṃsā darśanam tad rītyā iti arthaḥ dhātvartha tva abhāvāt iti viklitti ādi phalam eva dhātvarthaḥ pyāpāraḥ pratyaya arthaḥ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ manyante

original: bahūnāṃ dhātūnāṃ vyāpāre śaktikalpanāpekṣayā'lpānāṃ tibādipratyayānāṃ tatra śaktikalpane lāghavāt| pacatītyasya pākaṃ karotīti vivaraṇāt phalaṃ dhātorarthaḥ| `ti' ityākhyātasya bhāvanārthakakṛdhātunā vivaraṇācca pratyayasyai(ākhyātasyai) va vyāpārā(bhāvanā)rthakatvaṃ yuktam| vivriyamāṇavivaraṇayoḥ samānārthakatvasya klṛptatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bahūnām dhātūnām vyāpāre śakti kalpana apekṣayā alpānām tip ādi pratyayānām tatra śakti kalpane lāghavāt pacati iti asya pākam karoti iti vivaraṇāt phalam dhātoḥ arthaḥ iti ākhyātasya bhāvanā arthaka kṛ dhātunā vivaraṇāt ca vyāpāra a bhāvanā arthaka tvam yuktam vivriyamāṇa vivaraṇayoḥ samāna arthaka tvasya klṛpta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca dhātulabhyatvābhāvād‌vyāpāre lakāravidhiḥ saṃbhavet| evaṃ phalasya dhātulabhyatve'pi tadāśrayatvarūpe karmatve lakāravidhiḥ syādityucyate cet| tarhi kartrādyarthe vihitānāṃ ṇvul‌tavyadādīnāṃ kṛt‌pratyayānāmapi kartṛkarmārthavācakatvaṃ na syāt|
analyzed: tathā ca dhātu labhya tva abhāvāt vyāpāre lakāra vidhiḥ saṃbhavet evam phalasya dhātu labhya tve pi tad āśraya tva rūpe karma tve lakāra vidhiḥ syāt iti ucyate ced tarhi kartṛ ādi arthe vihitānām ṇvul tavyad ādīnām kṛt pratyayānām api kartṛ karma artha vācaka tvam na syāt

original: kartari kṛt, tayorevao ityādisūtrasthakartṛkarmapadayoḥ, laḥ karmaṇi cao itisūtrasthakartṛkarmapadavatkartṛtvakarmatvaparatvāṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: kartari kṛt tayoḥ eva o ityādi sūtra stha kartṛ karma padayoḥ laḥ karmaṇi caḥ iti sūtra stha kartṛ karma pada vat kartṛ tva karma tva paratva aṅgīkārāt

original: yadi lāghavamātrapakṣapātena laḥ karmaṇītisūtrasthakartṛkarmapadayoḥ kartṛtvakarmatvārthapratipādakatvaṃ svīkriyate tarhi kartari kṛdityādisūtrasthakartṛkarmapadayorapi kartṛtvakarmatvārthapratipādakatvasvīkāra ucitaḥ, laḥ karmaṇītisūtrasthakartṛkarmapade kartṛtvakarmatvarūpadharmapare, kartari kṛdityādisūtrasthakartṛkarmapade tu
analyzed: yadi lāghava mātra pakṣapātena laḥ karmaṇi iti sūtra stha kartṛ karma padayoḥ kartṛ tva karma tva artha pratipādaka tvam svīkriyate tarhi kartari kṛt ityādi sūtra stha kartṛ karma padayoḥ api kartṛ tva karma tva artha pratipādaka tva svīkāraḥ ucitaḥ laḥ karmaṇi iti sūtra stha kartṛ karma pade kartṛ tva karma tva rūpa dharma pare kartari kṛt ityādi sūtra stha kartṛ karma pade tu

original: dharmaviśiṣṭadharmipare ityevaṃ vaiṣamyakaraṇe bījāyāvāditi bhāvaḥ| tathā ca phūtkāratvādikaṃ ṇvulādīnāṃ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ, viklittitvādikaṃ tu tavyādīnāṃ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ syānna tvāśrayatvamiti tātparyam| tulyayogakṣemamiti| tulyo yogakṣemo'rthapratipādakatvaṃ yasyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: dharma viśiṣṭa dharmi pare iti evam vaiṣamya karaṇe bīja āyāvāt iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca phūtkāra tva ādikam ṇvula ādīnām śakyatā avacchedakam viklitti tva ādikam tu tavya ādīnām śakyatā avacchedakam syāt na tu āśraya tvam iti tātparyam tulya yogakṣemam iti tulyaḥ yogakṣemaḥ ūrtha pratipādaka tvam yasya iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pācako devadatta ityevaṃ devadattonābhedānvayānubhavabalātkṛtāṃ kartrādivācakatvamāvaśyakaṃ bhāvanāyāstvākṣepeṇa lābhaḥ setsyati, tadvat devadattaḥ pacatītyatrābhedānvayadarśanādākhyātānāṃ kartṛvācakatvamāstāṃ, bhāvanāyā ākṣepeṇa lābhasaṃbhavādvācyatvaṃ mā bhūdityāhaapi ceti| mīmāṃsakānāmiti| mate, iti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pācakaḥ devadattaḥ iti evam kartṛ ādi vācakatvam āvaśyakam bhāvanāyāḥ tu ākṣepeṇa lābhaḥ setsyati tadvat devadattaḥ pacati iti atra abheda anvaya darśanāt ākhyātānām kartṛ vācakatvam āstām bhāvanāyāḥ ākṣepeṇa lābha saṃbhavāt vācyatvam mā bhūt iti āha api ca iti mīmāṃsakānām iti mate iti śeṣaḥ

original: nanvākhyātānāṃ kartṛvācakatve tataḥ kathaṃ bhāvanāpratītirityata āhabhāvanāyā evetyādi| tathā satiākṣepalabhyatve sati| na syāditi| bhāvanāyā ākhyātavācyatvābhāvātprādhānyaṃ na syādityarthaḥ| vācyārthasyaiva prādhānyena bhānamiti niyamāditi bhāvaḥ| anyathā'gnimānayetyādāvākṣiptapātrasyāpi prādhānyena bhānāpatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu ākhyātānām kartṛ vācaka tve tatas katham bhāvanā pratītiḥ iti atas āha bhāvanāyāḥ eva ityādi tathā sati ākṣepa labhya tve sati na syāt iti bhāvanāyāḥ ākhyāta vācya tva abhāvāt prādhānyam na syāt iti arthaḥ vācyārthasya eva prādhānyena bhānam iti niyamāt iti bhāvaḥ anyathā agnim ānaya ityādau ākṣipta pātrasya api prādhānyena bhāna āpatteḥ

original: uktāmaniṣṭāpattiṃ niṣedhatiiti cenneti| tiṅante ākṣepalabhyāyā api bhāvanāyā mukhyaviśeṣyatvamupapādayatighaṭamānayetyādāviti|
analyzed: uktām aniṣṭa āpattim niṣedhati iti ced na iti tiṅ ante ākṣepa labhyāyāḥ api bhāvanāyāḥ mukhya viśeṣya tvam upapādayati ghaṭam ānaya ityādau iti

original: kartṛkarmasaṃkhyākālāḥ| tatreti| kartrādyarthānāṃ madhye| kartā vyāpāre viśeṣaṇamādhārādheyabhāvasaṃbandhena vyāpāranirūpitaviśeṣaṇatāvān kartetyarthaḥ| kartṛniṣṭho vyāpāra iti bodhāt| evameva karma phale viśaṣaṇaṃ phalanirūpitaviśeṣaṇatāvatkarmetyarthaḥ| taṇḍulādiniṣṭhā viklittyādiriti bodhāt| saṃkhyeti|

original: kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre kartari saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvayaḥ| karmapratyaye karmaṇi saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvaya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: kartṛ pratyaya samabhivyāhāre kartari saṃkhyāyāḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena anvayaḥ karma pratyaye karmaṇi saṃkhyāyāḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena anvayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu dhātvarthasya phalavyāpārātmakasya prakṛtyupasthāpitatvena tasyāpi pratyāsannatayā tatra kuto na saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu dhātvarthasya phala vyāpāra ātmakasya prakṛti upasthāpita tvena tasya api pratyāsanna tayā tatra kutas na saṃkhyāyāḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena anvayaḥ

original: kiṃ ca saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyayārthatvāt prakṛtyarthe dhātvartha eva tadanvayasya nyāyyatvātsubarthasaṃkhyāyāḥ prakṛtyartha evānvayasya dṛṣṭāvāccā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāyā api dhātvartha evānvaya ucita ityāśaṅkāṃ nirākurvan kartrādau saṃkhyānvaye hetumāhasamānapratyayopāttatvāditi yena pratyayena kartṛkarmārtha uktastenaiva pratyayena saṃkhyārtho'pyukta iti
analyzed: kim ca saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyaya artha tvāt prakṛti arthe dhātvarthe eva tad anvayasya nyāyya tvāt subartha saṃkhyāyāḥ prakṛti arthe eva anvayasya dṛṣṭa āvācca ākhyātārtha saṃkhyāyāḥ api dhātvarthe eva anvayaḥ ucitaḥ iti āśaṅkām nirākurvan kartṛ ādau saṃkhyā anvaye hetum āha samāna pratyaya upātta tvāt iti yena pratyayena kartṛ karma arthaḥ uktaḥ tena eva pratyayena saṃkhyā arthaḥ upi uktaḥ iti

original: hetordhātvarthāpekṣayā pratyāsattyatiśayātkartṛkarmaṇoreva saṃkhyānvayasya nyāyyatvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca samānābhidhānaśruteḥ samabhihārātmakavākyāpekṣayā prabalatvenaikapratyayopāttārthe saṃkhyānvayamakṛtvā prathamāntārthe saṃkhyānvayakaraṇaṃ naiyāyikānāmatyantānucitamiti sūcyate|
analyzed: hetoḥ dhātvartha apekṣayā pratyāsatti atiśayāt kartṛ karmaṇoḥ eva saṃkhyā anvayasya nyāyya tvāt iti arthaḥ evam ca samāna abhidhāna śruteḥ samabhihāra ātmaka vākya apekṣayā prabala tvena eka pratyaya upātta arthe saṃkhyā anvayam a kṛtvā prathama anta arthe saṃkhyā anvaya karaṇam naiyāyikānām atyanta anucitam iti sūcyate

original: tathā ca yādṛśaḥ kāryākāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitasyaṃ nirdiśatiākhyātārthasaṃkhyeti| ākhyātaśabdo mīmāṃsakādibhiḥ kevalatiṅkṣu prayujyate, vaiyākaraṇaistu tiṅanteṣu prayujyate, ākhyātamākhyātenetyatra bhāṣye tathā darśanāt|
analyzed: tathā ca yādṛśaḥ kārya akāraṇa bhāvaḥ nirdiśati ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā iti ākhyāta śabdaḥ mīmāṃsaka ādibhiḥ prayujyate vaiyākaraṇaiḥ tu tiṅ anteṣu prayujyate ākhyātam ākhyātena iti atra bhāṣye tathā darśanāt

original: ākhyātaṃ tiṅ, tadarthaḥ saṃkhyā, sā prakāraḥviśeṣaṇaṃ yatra tādṛśabodhe viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena ākhyātajanyā yā kartṛkarmārthopasthitiḥ sā hetuḥ tādṛśabodhe kāraṇamiti kāryakāraṇamabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ| tatpratyayapratipādyasaṃkhyāyāstatpratyayapratipādyakartṛkarmarūpe'rthe'nvaya iti yāvta| atra kartṛkarmaviśeṣyaketyaṃśo'pi niveśyaḥ|
analyzed: ākhyātam tiṅ tad arthaḥ saṃkhyā sā prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇam yatra tādṛśa bodhe viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena ākhyāta janyā yā kartṛ karma artha upasthitiḥ sā hetuḥ tādṛśa bodhe kāraṇam iti kārya kāraṇam abhāvaḥ siddhaḥ tad pratyaya pratipādya saṃkhyāyāḥ tad pratyaya pratipādya kartṛ karma rūpa īrtha anvayaḥ iti atra kartṛ karma viśeṣyakā iti aṃśaḥ api niveśyaḥ

original: tathā cā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakakartṛrūpārthaviśeṣyakabodhatvaṃ, tādṛśakarmarūpārthaviśeṣyakabodhatvaṃ ca kāryatāvacchedakam| ākhyātajanyakartṛbhūtārthopasthititvaṃ tādṛśakarmarūpārthopasthititvaṃ ca kāraṇatāvacchedakam| kāryatvakāraṇatvayoravacchedakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ samavāya iti bodhyam|
analyzed: tathā ca ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka kartṛ rūpa artha viśeṣyaka bodha tvam tādṛśa karma rūpa artha viśeṣyaka bodha tvam ca kāryatā avacchedakam ākhyāta janya kartṛ bhūta artha upasthiti tvam tādṛśa karma rūpa artha upasthiti tvam ca kāraṇatā avacchedakam kārya tva kāraṇa tvayoḥ avacchedakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaḥ iti bodhyam

original: atra kāryatāvacchedakakoṭau kartṛkarmarūpārthaviśeṣyakabodhaṃ pratītyevoktau paktā pācaka ityādāvākhyātajanyakartṛkarmopasthityabhāvena hetorvyabhicārātkartṛpratyayenābhīṣṭaḥ kartrādiviśeṣyakabodho na syāditi tatrā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāprakāraketyaṃśo niveśitaḥ|
analyzed: atra kāryatā avacchedaka koṭau kartṛ karma rūpa artha viśeṣyaka bodham prati iti eva uktau paktā pācakaḥ ityādau ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upasthiti abhāvena hetoḥ vyabhicārāt kartṛ pratyayena abhīṣṭaḥ kartṛ ādi viśeṣyaka bodhaḥ na syāt iti tatra ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka iti aṃśaḥ niveśitaḥ

original: tathā caākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhaṃ prati ākhyātajanyakartṛkarmopasthiterhetutvena paktā pācaka ityādau yatkiṃcidarthaprakāraka(dhātvarthavyāpāraprakāraka)kartṛviśeṣyakabodho nirābādhaḥ| ākhyātārthakālaprakārakabodhāpattivāraṇāya saṃkhyāpadaṃ niveśitam|
analyzed: tathā ca ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka bodham prati ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upasthiteḥ hetutvena paktā pācakaḥ ityādau yat kiṃcid artha prakāraka dhātvartha vyāpāra prakāraka kartṛ viśeṣyaka bodhaḥ nirābādhaḥ ākhyāta artha kāla prakāraka bodha āpatti vāraṇāya saṃkhyā padam niveśitam

original: nanu paktetyādau vyāpāraprakārakabodhopapattaye saṃkhyāprakāraketyetāvataiva siddhau saṃkhyāyā ākhyātārtheti viśetu ṣaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cenna| ākhyātajanyakartṛkarmopāpasthiterabhāvena ghaṭa ityādau subarthaikatvādisaṃkhyāprakārakabodho na syāt|
analyzed: nanu paktā ityādau vyāpāra prakāraka bodha upapattaye saṃkhyā prakārakā iti etāvatā eva siddhau saṃkhyāyāḥ ākhyāta arthā iti viśetu ṣaṇam kimartham iti ced na ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upa apasthiteḥ abhāvena ghaṭaḥ ityādau subartha eka tva ādi saṃkhyā prakāraka bodhaḥ na syāt

original: ākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhe hi tādṛśopasthitiniyamaḥ, na tu subarthasaṃmakhyāprakārakabodhe iti tatsārthakyāt| kāraṇatāvacchedakakoṭau kartṛkarmapadaṃ parityajyā''khyātajanyopasthitirheturityevoktauvartamāne laṭ ityādisūtravihitalaḍādīnāṃ vartamānādikālavācitvapakṣe kālasyāpyākhyātajanyopasthitiviṣayatvāttatra pacatītyākhyātārthasaṃkhyāyāḥ
analyzed: ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka bodhe hi tādṛśa upasthiti niyamaḥ na tu subartha saṃmakhyā prakāraka bodhe iti tad sārthakyāt kāraṇatā avacchedaka koṭau kartṛ karma padam parityajya ākhyāta janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ iti eva uktau vartamāne laṭ ityādi sūtra vihita laṭ ādīnām vartamāna ādi kāla vāci tva pakṣe kālasya api ākhyāta janya upasthiti viṣaya tvāt tatra pacati iti ākhyāta artha saṃkhyāyāḥ

original: prakāratayā'nvayaḥ kartavyo bhavet| tadvāraṇāya kartṛkarmeti viṣayatayopasthiterviśeṣaṇaṃ dattam| tathācā''khyātajanyoparithativiṣayatve'pi kālasya kartṛkarmarūpatvābhāvānna tatrā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāyāḥ prakāratayā'nvaya iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: prakāratayā anvayaḥ kartavyaḥ bhavet tad vāraṇāya kartṛ karma iti viṣayatayā upasthiteḥ viśeṣaṇam dattam tathā ca ākhyāta janya uparithati viṣaya tve pi kālasya kartṛ karma rūpa tva abhāvāt na tatra ākhyāta artha saṃkhyāyāḥ prakāratayā anvayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu devadattastaṇḍulaṃ pacati, devadattena taṇḍūlaḥ pacyate ityādau ākhyātārthaikatvasaṃkhyāyāstaṇḍularūpe karmaṇi prakāratayā'nvayaḥ syāt| tathā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāyā devadattarūpe kartari prakāratayā'nvayaḥ syāt| tayostaṇḍuladevadattapadābhyāmupasthitisattvāt| tathā ca tatra vyabhicāraḥ syāt|
analyzed: nanu devadattaḥ taṇḍulam pacati devadattena taṇḍūlaḥ pacyate ityādau ākhyāta artha ekatva saṃkhyāyāḥ taṇḍula rūpe karmaṇi prakāratayā anvayaḥ syāt tathā ākhyāta artha saṃkhyāyāḥ devadatta rūpe kartari prakāratayā anvayaḥ syāt tayoḥ taṇḍula devadatta padābhyām upasthiti sattvāt tathā ca tatra vyabhicāraḥ syāt

original: tadvāraṇāya kartṛkarmaṇorākhyātajanyatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ dattam| tathā ca niruktaprayoge ākhyātārthaikatvabahutvasaṃkhyāyāstaṇḍuladevadattapadāntarādupasthitayoḥ karmakartrorna prakāratayā'nvayaḥ| kiṃ tvākhyātādupasthitayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇorevānvayaḥ|
analyzed: tad vāraṇāya kartṛ karmaṇoḥ ākhyāta janya tvam viśeṣaṇam dattam tathā ca nirukta prayoge ākhyāta artha ekatva bahutva saṃkhyāyāḥ taṇḍula devadatta pada antarāt upasthitayoḥ karma kartroḥ na prakāratayā anvayaḥ kim tu ākhyātāt upasthitayoḥ kartṛ karmaṇoḥ eva anvayaḥ

original: kāṣṭhaistaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatratyākhyātapratyayena svārthasaṃkhyāprakārakakaraṇādiviśeṣyakānvayabodhājananāttatra vyabhicāravāraṇāya kartṛkarmāviseṣyakatyektaṃ kāryatāvacchedakakoṭau| evaṃ cā''khyātajanyakartṛkarmopasthitirākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakakartṛkarmaviśeṣyakabodhaniyāmiketyarthaḥ| atredaṃ bodhyam| vyabhicāro nāma kāryakāraṇabhāvabhaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: kāṣṭhaiḥ taṇḍulam pacati iti atratya ākhyāta pratyayena svārtha saṃkhyā prakāraka karaṇa ādi viśeṣyaka anvaya bodha ajananāt tatra vyabhicāra vāraṇāya kārya tā avacchedaka koṭau evam ca ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upasthitiḥ ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka kartṛ karma viśeṣyaka bodha niyāmikā iti arthaḥ atra idam bodhyam vyabhicāraḥ nāma kārya kāraṇa bhāva bhaṅgaḥ

original: vyabhicāraśca dvividhaḥ| anvayavyabhicāro vyatirekavyabhicāraśca| tatra kāraṇasattve kāryābhāvādādyaḥ| kāryasattve kāraṇābhāvād‌dvitīyaḥ| kāṣṭhaistaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatra ākhyātajanyakartṛkarmopasthitirūpakāraṇasattve'pi ākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakakaraṇaviśeṣyakānvayabodharūpakāryābhāvādanvayavyabhicāraḥ|
analyzed: vyabhicāraḥ ca dvividhaḥ anvaya vyabhicāraḥ vyatireka vyabhicāraḥ ca tatra kāraṇa sattve kārya abhāvāt ādyaḥ kārya sattve kāraṇa abhāvāt dvitīyaḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ taṇḍulam pacati iti atra ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upasthiti rūpa kāraṇa sattve pi ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka karaṇa viśeṣyaka anvaya bodha rūpa kārya abhāvāt anvaya vyabhicāraḥ

original: paktā pācaka ityādau kartṛpratyayena kartṛviśeṣyakabodharūpakāryasattve'pi ākhyātajanyakartṛkarmopasthitirūpakāraṇābhāvavād‌vyatirekavyabhicāra iti| ubhayatrāpi niruktavyabhicāravāraṇāyatattadviśeṣaṇaṃ dattamityanyat|
analyzed: paktā pācakaḥ ityādau kartṛ pratyayena kartṛ viśeṣyaka bodha rūpa kārya sattve pi ākhyāta janya kartṛ karma upasthiti rūpa kāraṇa abhāvavāt vyatireka vyabhicāraḥ iti ubhayatra api nirukta vyabhicāra vāraṇāya tat tad viśeṣaṇam dattam iti anyat

original: evaṃ svamate kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ nirūpya naiyāyikamate kāryakāraṇabhāvaprayuktaṃ gauravaṃ darśayitumāhanaiyāyikādīnāmiti| tārkikāṇāṃ mate prathamāntārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodha ityākhyātārthasaṃkhyāyāḥ prathamāntārtha evānvayaḥ| yathā''khyātopāttakṛteḥ prathamāntārthe'nvayastathā''khyātopāttasaṃkhyāyā apītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam sva mate kārya kāraṇa bhāvam nirūpya naiyāyika mate kārya kāraṇa bhāva prayuktam gauravam darśayitum āha naiyāyika ādīnām iti tārkikāṇām mate prathama anta artha mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ śābda bodhaḥ iti ākhyāta artha saṃkhyāyāḥ prathama anta arthe eva anvayaḥ yathā ākhyāta upātta kṛteḥ prathama anta arthe nvayaḥ tathā ākhyāta upātta saṃkhyāyāḥ api iti arthaḥ

original: tathā caivaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo vaktavyaḥākhyātārthasaṃkhyāprakārakabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitirheturiti| so'pīti| uktakāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi| candra ivetyādi|
analyzed: tathā ca evam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā prakāraka bodhe prathamā anta pada janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ iti saḥ api iti ukta kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ api candraḥ iva ityādi

original: candra iva mukhaṃ dṛśyate, bhuktvā vrajati maitraḥ, ityatra candrasya ktvāntārthabhojanasya ca prathamāntārthatvena tatra dṛśyate vrajatītyākhyātārthasaṃkhyāyāḥ prakāratayā'nvaya āpadyeta| sa ca neṣṭaḥ| candrabhojanayorākhyātārthasaṃkhyānvayānanubhavāt| nanu ktvāntasya kathaṃ prathamāntatvamiti ceducyate|
analyzed: candraḥ iva mukham dṛśyate bhuktvā vrajati maitraḥ iti atra candrasya ktvā anta artha bhojanasya ca prathamā anta artha tvena tatra dṛśyate vrajati iti ākhyāta artha saṃkhyāyāḥ prakāratayā anvayaḥ āpadyeta sa ca na iṣṭaḥ candra bhojanayoḥ ākhyāta artha saṃkhyā anvaya ananubhavāt nanu ktvā antasya katham prathamā anta tvam iti ced ucyate

original: atra samānakartṛkayoḥ kriyārūpārthayormadhye pūrvakālasaṃbandhī yo'rthastadvācakātktvetyarthakena `samānakartṛkayoḥ' iti sūtreṇa ktvi tadarthajijñāsāyāṃ kartari kṛt' iti na pravartate| `avyayakṛto bhāve, iti vārtikārambhādbhāva eva ktvāpratyayasyārthaḥ| sa cāpyasattvabhūta eva| pāka ityādāviva liṅgasaṃkhyānanubhavāt|
analyzed: atra samāna kartṛkayoḥ kriyā rūpa arthayoḥ madhye pūrva kāla saṃbandhī yaḥ ṛthaḥ tad vācakāt ktvā iti arthakena samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti sūtreṇa ktvi tad artha jijñāsāyām kartari kṛt iti na pravartate avyaya kṛtaḥ bhāve iti vārtika ārambhāt bhāvaḥ eva ktvāpratyayasya arthaḥ sa ca api asattva bhūtaḥ eva pākaḥ ityādau iva liṅga saṃkhyā ananubhavāt

original: tathāca ktvāvācyakriyāyā asattvarūpatvena dvitvādyapratīterna dvivacanādi kiṃtvekavacanameva tasyautsargikatvena saṃkhyānapekṣatvāt| tacca prathamopasthitatvātprathamāyā eva| tasya cāvyayādāviti lugityanyat| nanu ktvāpratyayasya bhāvamātrārthakatvāṅgīkāre'haṃ bhuktvā vrajamītyādāvasmacchabdāttṛtīyāpattiḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca ktvā vācya kriyāyāḥ asattva rūpatvena dvitva ādi apratīteḥ na dvivacana ādi kiṃtu ekavacanam eva tasya autsargika tvena saṃkhyā anapekṣa tvāt tat ca prathama upasthita tvāt prathamāyāḥ eva tasya ca avyaya ādau iti luk iti anyat nanu ktvāpratyayasya bhāva mātra arthaka tva aṅgīkāra iham bhuktvā vrajami ityādau asmat śabdāt tṛtīyā āpattiḥ

original: na ca tiṅantena karturamihitatvānneti vācyam| tiṅantārthakarturuktatve'pi ktvāntārthakarturanabhidhānāditi cenna| pradhānatiṅantārthakriyānirūpitaśaktyabhidhānātktvāntārthaguṇakriyānirūpitaśakterapyabhidhānasya bhāṣye'ṅgīkārāt| taduktaṃpradhānetarayoryatra dravyasya kriyayoḥ pṛthak| śaktirguṇāśrayā tatra pradhānamanurudhyate| iti|

analyzed: tena jaḍībhūtam kāṣṭha vat ceṣṭā rahitam hasta pāda ādi avayava gata spanda śūnyam kalevaram śarīram yasya tāṭṭaśa puruṣe ūrdhva deśa saṃyoga anukūla yatna rūpa vyāpārasya vidyamāna tvena phala atyanta asaṃbhave pi tatra uttiṣṭhati iti prayogaḥ āpadyeta

original: tathā ca ākhyātārthakālasya kartṛkarmaṇoḥ phalavyāpārayoścāpyanvaye sarvapakṣeṣu dūṣaṇasya tulyatvād‌vyāpāre kālānvaya ityasyaiva pakṣasya samāśrayaṇamanucitam| phale kālānvayāṅgīkāre tadānīṃ phalānutpatterna tādṛśaprayogāpattiritiśaṅkakāśayaḥ| siddhāntī tādṛśaprayogāpattiṃ parihartumāhaparayatnasyeti|
analyzed: tathā ca ākhyāta artha kālasya kartṛ karmaṇoḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ ca api anvaye sarva pakṣeṣu dūṣaṇasya tulya tvāt vyāpāre kāla anvayaḥ iti asya eva pakṣasya samāśrayaṇam anucitam phale kāla anvaya aṅgīkāre tadānīm phala anutpatteḥ na tādṛśa prayoga āpattiḥ iti śaṅkaka āśayaḥ siddhāntī tādṛśa prayoga āpattim parihartum āha para yatnasya iti

original: yatnasyā''tmaniṣṭhaguṇatvanontaraṅgatvādanyaniṣṭhasya tasyānyena pratyakṣatayā jñātumasakyatvānna tādṛśaprayogaḥ| tādṛsārthaṃ bodhayiṣyamīticchayā śabdaprayogakaraṇe tādṛśārthajñānasyāvaśyāpekṣitatvādityarthaḥ|
