original: nanu paraniṣṭhaprayatnasyāpratyakṣatve'pi anumānena yatnāvagatau satyāmuttiṣṭhatīti prayogāpattirdurvāretyākṣipyeṣṭāpattyā pariharatikiṃ cicceṣṭetyādinā| hastapādādiśarīrāvayavagatākriyayetyarthaḥ| ādinā tadīyalekhādi grāhyam| anumānaprayogaścetthamcaitraniṣṭhaceṣṭāṃ pakṣīkṛtya, prayatnajanyatvaṃ sādhyate, ceṣṭātvāt, manniṣṭhaceṣṭāvat| iti|
analyzed: nanu para niṣṭha prayatnasya apratyakṣa tve pi anumānena yatna avagatau satyām uttiṣṭhati iti prayoga āpattiḥ durvārā iti ākṣipya iṣṭāpattyā pariharati kim cit ceṣṭā ityādinā hasta pāda ādi śarīra avayava gata akriyayā iti arthaḥ ādinā tadīya lekhā ādi grāhyam anumāna prayogaḥ ca ittham caitra niṣṭha ceṣṭām pakṣīkṛtya prayatna janya tvam sādhyate ceṣṭā tvāt manniṣṭha ceṣṭā vat iti

original: athavā jaḍībhūto'yamutthānānukūlayatnavān, vijātīyaceṣṭāvattvāt, ahamiveti| ayamuttiṣṭhatīti| utthānānukūlayatnavān vartate kiṃtu śaktyabhāvācchaktirūpasahakārikāraṇābhāvādūrdhvadeśasaṃyogātmakaṃ phalaṃ naiva janyata iti lokānubhavasiddhatvādāmavātajaḍīkṛtapuruṣaviṣaye uttiṣṭhatīti prayoga iṣyata eveti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ceti|
analyzed: athavā jaḍībhūtaḥ ayam utthāna anukūla yatnavān vijātīya ceṣṭāvat tvāt aham iva iti ayam uttiṣṭhati iti utthāna anukūla yatnavān vartate kiṃtu śakti abhāvāt śakti rūpa sahakāri kāraṇa abhāvāt ūrdhva deśa saṃyoga ātmakam phalam na eva janyate iti loka anubhava siddha tvāt āmavāta jaḍīkṛta puruṣa viṣaye uttiṣṭhati iti prayogaḥ iṣyate eva iti bhāvaḥ evam ca iti

original: pūrvoktānāṃ yuktīnāmavaśyāṅgīkaraṇīyatve cetyarthaḥ| catvāro'pi tiṅarthā viśeṣaṇānyeva dhātvartho vyāpāra eva pradhānaṃ viśeṣya iti bodhyam| viśeṣaṇānyevetyevakāreṇa tiṅarthe viśeṣyatvasya vyāvṛttiḥ| vyāpāra evetyevakāreṇa phalasya tiṅarthasya kartrādeśca vyāvṛttirbodhyā|
analyzed: pūrvoktānām yuktīnām avaśya aṅgīkaraṇīya tve ca iti arthaḥ catvāraḥ api tiṅarthāḥ viśeṣaṇāni eva dhātvarthaḥ vyāpāraḥ eva pradhānam viśeṣyaḥ iti bodhyam viśeṣaṇāni eva iti evakāreṇa tiṅarthe viśeṣya tvasya vyāvṛttiḥ vyāpāraḥ eva iti evakāreṇa phalasya tiṅarthasya kartṛ ādeḥ ca vyāvṛttiḥ bodhyā

original: nanu bhāvanāyā dhātūvācyatve kartrādeśca tiṅvācyatve tasyāḥ pratyayārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvāpattiḥ prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti vyutpatterityākṣipya pratyācaṣṭeyadyapīti|
analyzed: nanu bhāvanāyāḥ dhātū vācya tve kartṛ ādeḥ ca tiṅ vācya tve tasyāḥ pratyaya artham prati viśeṣaṇa tva āpattiḥ prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti vyutpatteḥ iti ākṣipya pratyācaṣṭe yadi api iti

original: paktā pācaka ityādau viklittyanukūlavyāpārarāśraya iti bodhānubhavātprakṛtipratyayārthayormadhye pratyayārthasya prādhānyaṃ dṛśyate tadvatpacatītyādāvapi tiṅarthakartrādeḥ prādhānyaṃ dhātvarthabhāvanāyāśca tannirūpitaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ syādityākṣepaḥ| tatrottaramāhatathāpi bhāvapradhānamiti| ākhyātāmityantamākhyātalakṣaṇapratipādakaṃ vākyam|
analyzed: paktā pācakaḥ ityādau viklitti anukūla vyāpāra rāśrayaḥ iti bodha anubhavāt prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ madhye pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam dṛśyate tadvat pacati ityādau api tiṅartha kartṛ ādeḥ prādhānyam dhātvartha bhāvanāyāḥ ca tad nirūpitam viśeṣaṇa tvam syāt iti ākṣepaḥ tatra uttaram āha tathā api bhāva pradhānam iti ākhyātām ityantam ākhyāta lakṣaṇa pratipādakam vākyam

original: atrā''khyātaṃ bhāvapradhānagityevamuddeśyavideyabhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ| anyathā prāthamyād‌bhāvapradhānamityuddeśyaṃ, ākhyātamiti ca vidheyaṃ syāt| tataśca tvayā mayā'nyaiścaidhanīyamityādau bhāvapradhānake nāmnyatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt|
analyzed: atra ākhyātam evam uddeśya videya bhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ anyathā prāthamyāt bhāva pradhānam iti uddeśyam ākhyātam iti ca vidheyam syāt tatas ca tvayā mayā anyaiḥ ca edhanīyam ityādau bhāva pradhānake nāmni atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt

original: uddeśyavideyabhāvasthale vidheye uddeśyatāvacchedakanirūpitavyāpakatvabhānamautsargīkam, iti niyamāt, ākhyāteākhyātatvāvacchinne pradhānabhāvārthapratipādakatvaṃ bodhyate| prakṛte uddeśyatāvacchedakamākhyātatvaṃ tacca vyāpyam| pradhānabhāvārthapratipādakatvaṃ vidheyatāvacchedakaṃ tacca vyāpakamiti bodyam| ākhyātaṃ tiṅantam|
analyzed: uddeśya videya bhāva sthale vidheye uddeśya tā avacchedaka nirūpita vyāpaka tva bhānam autsargīkam iti niyamāt ākhyāte ākhyāta tva avacchinne pradhāna bhāva artha pratipādaka tvam bodhyate prakṛte uddeśya tā avacchedakam ākhyāta tvam tat ca vyāpyam pradhāna bhāva artha pratipādaka tvam vidheya tā avacchedakam tat ca vyāpakam iti bodyam ākhyātam tiṅ antam

original: ākhyātamākhyātenetyatra bhāṣya tiṅanta evā''khyātapadasya śaktyavadhāraṇāt| prādhānyaṃ coparithatatvātsvavācakaprakṛtipratyayārthanirūpitam| svapadena dhātvarthabhāvanā| tadvācakaḥ pacādirdhātuḥ| tatprakṛtikaḥ pratyayaḥ pacatītyatra tiṅ‌pratyayaḥ| tadarthaḥ kartrādiḥ| tannarūpitaṃ prādhānyaṃ bodhyam|
analyzed: ākhyātam ākhyātena iti atra bhāṣya tiṅ ante eva ākhyāta padasya śakti avadhāraṇāt prādhānyam sva vācaka prakṛti pratyaya artha nirūpitam sva padena dhātvartha bhāvanā tad vācakaḥ paca ādiḥ dhātuḥ tad prakṛtikaḥ pratyayaḥ pacati iti atra tiṅ pratyayaḥ tad arthaḥ kartṛ ādiḥ prādhānyam bodhyam

original: tiṅantaṃ tiṅarthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitadhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākabodhajanakamityarthaḥ| lakṣyatāvacchedakaṃ ca tiṅantatvamiti yāvat| bhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ yasmiṃstaditi bahuvrīhiḥ| bhāvo'tra kriyā| sā ca kri yate'nenetikaraṇavyutpattyā vyāpāraṃ, kriyata iti karmavyutṣattyā ca phalaṃ pratipādayati|
analyzed: tiṅ antam tiṅ artha niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka bodha janakam iti arthaḥ lakṣya tā avacchedakam ca tiṅ anta tvam iti yāvat bhāvaḥ pradhānam yasmin tat iti bahuvrīhiḥ kriyā sā ca kri yatena inena iti karaṇa vyutpattyā vyāpāram kriyate iti karma vyutṣattyā ca phalam pratipādayati

original: tataśca tiṅante phalavyāpārayoḥ prādhānyaṃ, tatra kartā vācyo yasyeti bahubrīhiḥ| tiṅantaṃ cānyapadārthaḥ| kartṛvācake tiṅanta ityarthaḥ| evaṃ karmavācye, ityatrāpi bodhyam|kartṛvācye vyāpārasya karmavācye tu phalasya prādhānyamiti vibhāgaḥ| sattvapradhānānīti| atrāpināmāni sattvapradhānānītyuddeśyavidheyabhāvayojanā|
analyzed: tatas ca tiṅ ante phala vyāpārayoḥ prādhānyam tatra kartā vācyaḥ yasya iti bahubrīhiḥ tiṅ antam ca anya padārthaḥ kartṛ vācake tiṅ ante iti arthaḥ evam karma vācye iti atra api bodhyam kartṛ vācye vyāpārasya karma vācye tu phalasya prādhānyam iti vibhāgaḥ sattva pradhānāni iti atra api nāmāni sattva pradhānāni iti uddeśya vidheya bhāva yojanā

original: anyathā yathāśrute sattva(dravya)niṣṭhaviśeṣyatākabodhajanakatvamuddiśya nāmatvavidhāne pacatītyādau tiṅante āśrayatvasaṃkhyāniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitakartrādisattvaniṣṭhāviśeṣyatākabodhajanako'tiprasaṅgaḥ syāt|
analyzed: anyathā yathāśrute sattva dravya niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka bodha janakatvam uddiśya nāmatva vidhāne pacati ityādau tiṅ ante āśraya tva saṃkhyā niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita kartṛ ādi sattva niṣṭha a viśeṣyatāka bodha janaka utiprasaṅgaḥ syāt

original: sattvaṃ dravyaṃ liṅgādyanvayi tatpradhānaṃ yatreti vigrahālliṅgādiniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitamukhyāviśeṣyatāśālyarthapratipādakāni bhavantītyarthaḥ| etadeva ca nāmalakṣaṇam| lakṣyatāvacchedakaṃ svādipratyayavidhānādhitvarūpaṃ nāmatvam| bhūvādisūtrastheti| itthaṃ hi tatra sūtre bhāṣyampacyādayaḥ kriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavanti, iti|
analyzed: sattvam dravyam liṅga ādi anvayi tat pradhānam yatra iti vigrahāt liṅga ādi niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita mukhya viśeṣya tā śāli artha pratipādakāni bhavanti iti arthaḥ etat eva ca nāma lakṣaṇam lakṣya tā avacchedakam sva ādi pratyaya vidhāna ādhi tva rūpam nāmatvam bhūva ādi sūtra stha iti ittham hi tatra sūtre bhāṣyam pacya ādayaḥ kriyāḥ bhavati kriyāyāḥ kartryaḥ bhavanti iti

original: anena ca spaṣṭameva pacyādyarthakriyākartṛkabhavatikriyāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ bodhyate| anyathā prakṛtipratyayau sahārthaṃ brūta iti niyamena dhātvarthakriyāyā ākhyātārthakartrādiviśeṣaṇatvenāvaruddhāyāḥ padārthāntare viśeṣaṇatayā'nvaye nirākāṅkṣātvād bhavatyarthakriyāyāmākhyātārthakartrādiviśeṣaṇapacyādikriyāṇāmanvayapradarśanaṃ bhāṣyakṛtkṛtamasaṃgataṃ
analyzed: anena ca spaṣṭam eva paci ādi artha kriyā kartṛka bhavati kriyāyāḥ prādhānyam bodhyate anyathā prakṛti pratyayau saha artham brūtaḥ iti niyamena dhātvartha kriyāyāḥ ākhyāta artha kartṛ ādi viśeṣaṇa tvena avaruddhāyāḥ padārtha antare viśeṣaṇatayā anvaye nirākāṅkṣa tvāt bhavati artha kriyāyām ākhyāta artha kartṛ ādi viśeṣaṇa paci ādi kriyāṇām anvaya pradarśanam bhāṣyakṛt kṛtam asaṃgatam

original: syāt| tenā''khyātārthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaṃ prādhānyaṃ dhātvarthakriyāyā avagamyata ityarthaḥ| tathā ca bhāvapradhānamityādiniruktātpacyādayaḥ kriyāḥ, iti niruktabhāṣyācca dhātvarthabhūtabhāvanāyāḥ pratyayārthāpekṣayā'pi prādhānyaṃ niścīyate|
analyzed: syāt tena ākhyāta artha niṣṭha prakāra tā nirūpitam prādhānyam dhātvartha kriyāyāḥ avagamyate iti arthaḥ tathā ca bhāva pradhānam ityādi niruktāt paci ādayaḥ kriyāḥ iti nirukta bhāṣyāt ca dhātvartha bhūta bhāvanāyāḥ pratyaya artha apekṣayā api prādhānyam niścīyate

original: evaṃ ca pūrvoktaniruktabhāṣyaprāmāṇyābhyāṃ prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamasya tiṅante parityāgarūpaḥ saṃkoco'vaśyamaṅgīkāryaḥ, anyatā pratyayārthaprādhānyavādināṃ mīmāṃsakādīnāṃ bhavatāmeva niruktādivirodha iti bhāvaḥ| prakṛtipratyayārthayāḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamarayāsaṃkoce dūṣaṇāntaramāhaapi ceti|
analyzed: evam ca pūrvokta nirukta bhāṣya prāmāṇyābhyām prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti niyamasya tiṅ ante parityāga rūpaḥ saṃkocaḥ vaśyam aṅgīkāryaḥ anyatā pratyaya artha prādhānya vādinām mīmāṃsaka ādīnām bhavatām eva nirukta ādi virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ prakṛti pratyaya arthayāḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti niyama raya a saṃkoce dūṣaṇa antaram āha api ca iti

original: devadattaḥ pacatītyādau kartustiṅpratyayārthatvena pradhānyāttasya devadattādibhiḥ saha devadattābhinno yastiṅarthaḥ kartetyevamabhedānvayabodhātprathamāntārthasyāpi devadattādeḥ prādānyāpattau paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra mṛgakartṛkadhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityevaṃrūpaṃ bhāṣyakṛtpradarśitamekavākyatvaṃ na saṃgaccheta|
analyzed: devadattaḥ pacati ityādau kartuḥ tiṅpratyaya artha tvena pradhānyāt tasya devadatta ādibhiḥ saha devadatta abhinnaḥ yaḥ tiṅ arthaḥ kartā iti evam abheda anvaya bodhāt prathama anta arthasya api devadatta ādeḥ prādānya āpattau paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra mṛga kartṛka dhāvana karmakam darśanam iti evaṃrūpam bhāṣyakṛt pradarśitam ekavākyatvam na saṃgaccheta

original: bhāvanāyā dhātuvācyatve kartrādestiṅvācyatve prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti niyamena dhāvanakriyāviśeṣyasya prathamāntapadavācyamṛgasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatvenānvaye dvitīyāpatteḥ| tathā ca dhāvanāśrayamṛgakarmakadarśanāśrayastvamityarthe paśya mṛgaṃ dhāvatīti vākyasyaiva saṃbhavena tādṛśavākyasya vilaya eva syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhāvanāyāḥ dhātu vācya tve kartṛ ādeḥ tiṅ vācya tve prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti niyamena dhāvana kriyā viśeṣyasya prathamā anta pada vācya mṛgasya dṛśi kriyāyām karmatvena anvaye dvitīyā āpatteḥ tathā ca dhāvana āśraya mṛga karmaka darśana āśrayaḥ tvam iti arthe paśya mṛgam dhāvati iti vākyasya eva saṃbhavena tādṛśa vākyasya vilayaḥ eva syāt iti arthaḥ

original: mūle prathamāntetyādidvitīyāpatterityantena pratyayārthaprādhānyavādimate ekavākyatvānupapattā kāraṇaṃ pratipāditamiti bodhyam| atredaṃ bodhyamdhāvudhātoḥ kartari laṭā vā, śīghragativācinaḥ sṛdhātoḥ śiti dhaurādeśena vā dhāvatīti rūpaṃ sidhyati| dhāvanaṃ nāmottaradeśasaṃyogānukūla utkaṭavegavān vyāpāraḥ| laḍarthaḥ kartā|
analyzed: mūle prathama anta ityādi dvitīya āpatteḥ iti antena pratyaya artha prādhānya vādi mate ekavākyatva anupapattā kāraṇam pratipāditam iti bodhyam atra idam bodhyam dhāvu dhātoḥ kartari laṭā vā śīghragati vācinaḥ sṛ dhātoḥ śiti dhauḥ ādeśena vā dhāvati iti rūpam sidhyati dhāvanam nāma uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūlaḥ utkaṭa vegavān vyāpāraḥ laṭ arthaḥ kartā

original: tatra mṛgasyābhedenānvayaḥ| tathā ca mṛgābhinno yo laḍarthaḥ kartā tanniṣṭho deśaviśeṣasaṃyogānukūlo vegavattaro vyāpāra ityevaṃ vyāpāramukhyāviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodho vaiyākaraṇamate| tathā paśyetyatra loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ dṛś dhātoḥ paśyādeśaśca| dṛś‌dhātvarthaścākṣuṣajñānānukūlo vyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: tatra mṛgasya abhedena anvayaḥ tathā ca mṛga abhinnaḥ yaḥ laṭ arthaḥ kartā tad niṣṭhaḥ deśa viśeṣa saṃyoga anukūlaḥ vegavattaraḥ vyāpāraḥ iti evam vyāpāra mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ śābda bodhaḥ vaiyākaraṇa mate tathā paśya iti atra loṇ madhyamapuruṣa ekavacanam dṛś dhātoḥ paśyā ādeśaḥ ca dṛś dhātvarthaḥ cākṣuṣa jñāna anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ

original: tathā ca yuṣmadarthābhinnaloḍarthakartṛniṣṭhaścākṣuṣajñānākūlo vidhiviṣayo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ pṛthak| ekapadārthe'parapadārthasaṃsargaḥ saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsate na tatra saṃsargārthakaśabdāpekṣeti mṛgakartṛkadhāvanakriyāyāḥ karmatvena dṛśikriyāyāmanvaye mṛgābhinnalaḍarthakartṛkaścākṣuṣajñānānukūlo vidhiviṣayo vyāpāra ityekavākyatayā bodhaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca yuṣmadartha abhinna loṭ artha kartṛ niṣṭhaḥ cākṣuṣa jñāna ākūlaḥ vidhi viṣayaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ pṛthak eka padārtha ipara padārtha saṃsargaḥ saṃsarga maryādayā bhāsate na tatra saṃsarga arthaka śabda apekṣā iti mṛga kartṛka dhāvana kriyāyāḥ karma tvena dṛśi kriyāyām anvaye mṛga abhinna laṭ artha kartṛkaḥ cākṣuṣa jñāna anukūlaḥ vidhi viṣayaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti ekavākyatayā bodhaḥ

original: tatra dhāvanasya dṛśikriyākarmabhūtasya dhātuvācyatayā dhātośca prātipadikasaṃjñāviraheṇa na tasmād dvitīyāprasaktiḥ|
analyzed: tatra dhāvanasya dṛśi kriyā karma bhūtasya dhātu vācya tayā dhātoḥ ca prātipadika saṃjñā viraheṇa na tasmāt dvitīyā prasaktiḥ

original: pacati bhavatipacikriyā bhavatīti, pakṣyati bhavatibhaviṣyantī pākakriyā sūkṣmarūpeṇa bhavatīti ca bhāṣye kriyayoḥ kriyākārakabhāvenānvayāṅgīkārāttattulyanyāyātpaśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatrāpi kriyayostato'nvayabodho'bhyupagata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pacati bhavati paci kriyā bhavati iti pakṣyati bhavati bhaviṣyantī pāka kriyā sūkṣma rūpeṇa bhavati iti ca bhāṣye kriyayoḥ kriyā kāraka bhāvena anvaya aṅgīkārāt tad tulya nyāyāt paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra api kriyayoḥ tatas nvaya bodhaḥ abhyupagataḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: pratyayārthaprādhānyavādināṃ mate uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavegavattakhyāpāravān mṛga iti bodhāttāṭṭaśabodhe viśeṣyabhūtasya mṛgasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvayaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt| sa ca na saṃbhavati| karmabhūtasya mṛgasya prātipadikārthatayā paśyetyatratyatiṅā tadanabhidhānena cānabhihitādhikārīyakarmaṇi dvitīyeti dvitīyāpattivirodhāt|
analyzed: pratyaya artha prādhānya vādinām mate mṛgaḥ iti bodhāt tāt ṭaśa bodhe viśeṣya bhūtasya mṛgasya dṛśi kriyāyām karmatayā anvayaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt sa ca na saṃbhavati karma bhūtasya mṛgasya prātipadika artha tayā paśya iti atratya tiṅā tad anabhidhānena ca anabhihita adhikārīya karmaṇi dvitīyā iti dvitīya āpatti virodhāt

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥdhāvanaṃ prati viśeṣyabhūto mṛgaḥ| sa ca dṛśikriyāṃ pratisākṣādviśeṣaṇaṃ dṛśikriyā cātra pradhānam| tathā ca dhāvatītyatratyatiṅā mṛgarūpasya karturuktatvādabhihite prathameti mṛgapadottaraṃ prathamā prāptā, atha ca darśanakriyānirūpitakarmatvāttaduttaraṃ dvitīyā ca prāptā| tatra prathamā'ntaraṅgā, mṛgo dhāvatītyekavākyāśritatvāt|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ dhāvanam prati viśeṣya bhūtaḥ mṛgaḥ sa ca dṛśi kriyām prati sākṣāt viśeṣaṇam dṛśi kriyā ca atra pradhānam tathā ca dhāvati iti atratya tiṅā mṛga rūpasya kartuḥ ukta tvāt abhihite prathamā iti mṛga pada uttaram prathamā prāptā atha ca darśana kriyā nirūpita karma tvāt tad uttaram dvitīyā ca prāptā tatra prathamā antaraṅgā mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti eka vākya āśrita tvāt

original: dvitīyā tu bahiraṅgā, paśya mṛgo dha vatītyubhayavākyāśritatvāt| tataśca dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā prathamopasthitatvenāntaraṅgatvāt pūrvaṃ prathamayaiva bhāvyam| tato darśanakriyāyāṃ saṃbandhe'pi bhuktavantamiti nyāyenāntaraṅgātvājjātasaṃskārabādhāyogānna dvitīyāpattiḥ|
analyzed: dvitīyā tu bahiraṅgā paśya mṛgaḥ vati iti ubhaya vākya āśrita tvāt tatas ca dvitīyām bādhitvā prathama upasthita tvena antaraṅga tvāt pūrvam prathamayā eva bhāvyam tatas darśana kriyāyām saṃbandhe pi bhuktavantam iti nyāyena antaraṅga atvāt jāta saṃskāra bādhā yogāt na dvitīya āpattiḥ

original: nāpi ekavākyatayā mṛgakartṛkaṃ dhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityarthe paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogavilayāpattiriti cet| ucyatepadyapi bahiraṅgadarśanakriyāpekṣatvād‌dvitīyā bahiraṅgā tathā'pi tṛśikriyāyāḥ prādhānyātpradhānanirūpitakāryasya ca loke sarvato balavadattvadarśanādantaraṅgāmapi prathamāṃ bādhitvā pradhānakriyānurodhinī dvitīyā prasajyeteti|
analyzed: nā api ekavākyatayā mṛga kartṛkam dhāvana karmakam darśanam iti arthe paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti prayoga vilaya āpattiḥ iti ced ucyate padi api bahiraṅga darśana kriyā apekṣa tvāt dvitīyā bahiraṅgā tathā api tṛśi kriyāyāḥ prādhānyāt pradhāna nirūpita kāryasya ca loke sarvatas balavadattva darśanāt antaraṅgām api prathamām bādhitvā pradhāna kriyā anurodhinī dvitīyā prasajyeta iti

original: vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhavādimate tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ| mṛgasya dhāvanaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvenāntaraṅgatvājjātasya prathamārūpasaṃskārasyānivṛtteḥ| tārkikāṇāṃ mate phalānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ| lakārāṇāṃ kṛtau śaktirlāghavāt| kṛteścā''śrayatāsaṃbandhena prathamāntārthe'nvayaḥ| prathamāntārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśca śābdabodhaḥ|
analyzed: vyāpāra mukhya viśeṣyaka śābdabodha vādi mate tu na ayam doṣaḥ mṛgasya dhāvanam prati viśeṣaṇa tvena antaraṅga tvāt jātasya prathamā rūpa saṃskārasya anivṛtteḥ tārkikāṇām mate phala anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ lakārāṇām kṛtau śaktiḥ lāghavāt kṛteḥ ca āśraya tā saṃbandhena prathamā anta artha anvayaḥ prathamā anta artha mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ ca śābdabodhaḥ

original: tathā ca naiyāyikamate paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyasyetthaṃ śābdabodhaḥuttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtimānamṛgaḥ| paśyetyatra ca tamityadhyāhṛtya cākṣuṣajñānānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtimān yuṣmadarthastvamityarthaḥ pṛthageva na tvekavākyatayā mṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpatteriti| dvitīyāpattivāraṇamāśaṅkya nirākārotina caivamityādinā| evamiti|
analyzed: tathā ca naiyāyika mate paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti asya ittham śābda bodhaḥ uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra anukūla kṛtimān a mṛgaḥ paśya iti atra ca tam iti adhyāhṛtya cākṣuṣa jñāna anukūla vyāpāra anukūla kṛtimān yuṣmad arthaḥ tvam iti arthaḥ pṛthak eva na tu ekavākyatayā mṛga pada uttaram dvitīya āpatteḥ iti dvitīya āpatti vāraṇam āśaṅkya nirākārā ūti na ca evam ityādinā evam iti

original: mṛgaśabdād dvitīyāpattāvityarthaḥ| laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāviti sūtre'prathamāntena samānādhikaraṇasya laṭaḥ sthāne śatṛśānacorvidhānānmṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāprabuttau dhāvatītyatra prakriyādaśāyāṃ laṭaḥ sthāne nityaṃ śatā prasajyeta| tathā ca tibādyapravṛttibhiyaiva dvitīyā na kariṣyata iti śaṅkakāśayaḥ|
analyzed: mṛga śabdāt dvitīyā āpattau iti arthaḥ laṭaḥ śatṛ śānacau iti sūtre prathamā antena samāna adhikaraṇasya laṭaḥ sthāne śatṛ śānacoḥ vidhānāt mṛga pada uttaram dvitīyā prabuttau dhāvati iti atra prakriyā daśāyām laṭaḥ sthāne nityam prasajyeta tathā ca tip ādya pravṛtti bhiyā eva dvitīyā na kariṣyate iti śaṅkaka āśayaḥ

original: siddhāntī tu śatṛprasaṅgo na dvitīyāpravṛttipratibandhakaḥ| kiṃ tu karmaṇo'bhihitatvaṃ tatpratibandhakam| na hiśatari pravṛtte'pi karmaṇo'bhidhānaṃ bhavati, kartari laṭaḥ sattvāt| tataśca karmaṇo'nabhihitatvasya tadavasthatvād‌dvitīyāpattirduḥsamādheyetyanusaṃdhāyā''haevamapīti| śatari pravṛtte'patyirthaḥ|
analyzed: siddhāntī tu śatṛ prasaṅgaḥ na dvitīyā pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ kim tu karmaṇaḥ ubhihitatvam tad pratibandhakam na hi śatari pravṛtte api karmaṇaḥ abhidhānam bhavati kartari laṭaḥ sattvāt tatas ca karmaṇaḥ unabhihitatvasya tad avasthatvāt dvitīyā āpattiḥ duḥsamādheyā iti anusaṃdhāya āha evam api iti śatari pravṛtte pati irthaḥ

original: mṛgasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvaye sati karmaṇo'nabhihitatvena mṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpravṛtterduṣpariharatvād dhāvantaṃ mṛgaṃ paśyetyevaṃma vākyasyaiva yogyatvātpaśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogasya sarvathā'saṃbhava evetyarthāt|
analyzed: mṛgasya dṛśi kriyāyām karmatayā anvaye sati karmaṇā unabhihitatvena mṛga pada uttaram dvitīyā pravṛtteḥ duṣparihara tvāt dhāvantam mṛgam paśya iti evaṃma vākyasya eva yogya tvāt paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti prayogasya sarvathā asaṃbhavaḥ eva iti arthāt

original: mṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāyā aprasaktyā paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogasaṃbhavamāśaṅkya nirākurutena ca paśyetyatretyādinā| paśyeti darśanakriyāyāṃ karmatayā mṛgasya nānvayaḥ| kiṃtu tatra tamiti svatantraṃ karmādhyāhāryam| tathā ca yo mṛgo dhāvati taṃ paśyetyarthātpaśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogasaṃbhava iti saṅkāśayaḥ| adhyāhāro na yuktaḥ|
analyzed: mṛga pada uttaram dvitīyāyāḥ aprasaktyā paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti prayoga saṃbhavam āśaṅkya nirākurutena ca paśya iti atra ityādinā paśya iti darśana kriyāyām karmatayā mṛgasya na anvayaḥ kiṃtu tatra tam iti svatantram karma adhyāhāryam tathā ca yaḥ mṛgaḥ dhāvati tam paśya iti arthāt paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti prayoga saṃbhavaḥ iti saṅkā āśayaḥ adhyāhāraḥ na yuktaḥ

original: tathā sati mṛgo dhāvatītyekaṃ vākyaṃ taṃ paśyeti ca dvitīyamiti vākyabhedarūpagauravāpātādityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti vākyānmṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityekavākyatayā bodhasya sarvānubhavāsiddhād‌ dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatāsaṃbandhena mṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanasyaivānvayaḥ pratipādayitumabhīṣṭaḥ|
analyzed: tathā sati mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti ekam vākyam tam paśya iti ca dvitīyam iti vākya bheda rūpa gaurava āpātāt iti arthaḥ kim ca paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti vākyāt mṛga niṣṭha utkaṭa dhāvana karmakam darśanam iti ekavākyatayā bodhasya sarva anubhava asiddhāt dṛśi kriyāyām karmatā saṃbandhena mṛga niṣṭha utkaṭa dhāvanasya eva anvayaḥ pratipādayitum abhīṣṭaḥ

original: sa ca vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakabodavādināṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ mate sāmīcīnyenopapadyate| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlaṃ mṛgābhinnalaḍarthakartṛniṣṭhamutkaṭadhāvanamityevaṃ dhāvatītyasmādviśeṣyatayā pratītasyotkaṭadhāvanasya darśanakriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvayāt|
analyzed: sa ca vyāpāra mukhya viśeṣyaka boda vādinām vaiyākaraṇānām mate sāmīcīnyena upapadyate uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūlam mṛga abhinna laṭ artha kartṛ niṣṭham utkaṭa dhāvanam iti evam dhāvati iti asmāt viśeṣya tayā pratītasya utkaṭa dhāvanasya darśana kriyāyām karmatayā anvayāt

original: kartrādestiṅ‌vācyatvamaṅgīkṛtya pratyayārthaprādhānyavādināṃ mate prathamāntamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhavādināṃ tārkikāṇāṃ mate ca nopapadyate| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtyāśrayamṛgakarmakaṃ darśanamiti śābdabodhodayānmṛgapadottaraṃ prasaktadvitīyāyāḥ parihārārthaṃ darśane tamiti karmādhyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: kartṛ ādeḥ tiṅ vācya tvam aṅgīkṛtya pratyaya artha prādhānya vādinām mate prathama anta mukhya viśeṣyaka śābdabodha vādinām tārkikāṇām mate ca na upapadyate uttara deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra anukūla kṛti āśraya mṛga karmakam darśanam iti śābdabodha udayāt mṛga pada uttaram prasakta dvitīyāyāḥ parihāra artham darśane tam iti karma adhyāhāraḥ

original: tatra tamiti tacchabdena kevalamṛgasya dhāvanānukūlakṛtyāśrayamṛgasya vā parāmarśe'pi pratipipādayiṣitasya mṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityarthasya tadvākyātpratītyanupapatteḥ|
analyzed: tatra tam iti tad śabdena kevala mṛgasya dhāvana anukūla kṛtya āśraya mṛgasya vā parāmarśe api pratipipādayiṣitasya mṛga niṣṭha utkaṭa dhāvana karmakam darśanam iti arthasya tad vākyāt prati iti anupapatteḥ

original: nanūtkaṭadhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭamṛgasya tacchabdena parāmarśe sati `vidhipratiṣedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṃkrāmataḥ sati viśeṣye bādhe' iti nyāyena śikhī dhvasya ityatra viśeṣyabhūte śikhini dhvaṃsānvayaṃ parityajya tadviśeṣaṇabhūtaśikhāyāṃ dhvaṃsānvayaparyavasānavanmṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakriyāyā eva karmatayā darśane'nvayasya paryavasānena na
analyzed: nanu utkaṭa dhāvana kriyā viśiṣṭa mṛgasya tad śabdena parāmarśe sati vidhi pratiṣedhau viśeṣaṇam upasaṃkrāmataḥ sati viśeṣye bādhe iti nyāyena śikhī dhvasyaḥ iti atra viśeṣya bhūte śikhini dhvaṃsa anvayam parityajya tad viśeṣaṇa bhūta śikhāyām dhvaṃsa anvaya paryavasāna vat mṛga niṣṭha utkaṭa dhāvana kriyāyāḥ eva karmatayā paryavasānena na kaścitaḥ anyatra api anyatra api anyatra api anyatra api api api api api api api api api api api a

original: niruktavivakṣitārthānupapattiriti cenna| dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt| tathā hi śikhī dhvasya iti dṛṭānte viśeṣyabhūte śikhāviśiṣṭe puruṣe pratyakṣeṇa dhvaṃsānvayasya bādhāttadviśeṣaṇe śikhāyāṃ dhvaṃsānvayaparyavasānaṃ yuktam|
analyzed: nirukta vivakṣita artha anupapattiḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ vaiṣamyāt tathā hi śikhī dhvasyaḥ iti dṛṭānte viśeṣya bhūte śikhā viśiṣṭe puruṣe pratyakṣeṇa dhvaṃsa anvayasya bādhāt tad viśeṣaṇe śikhāyām dhvaṃsa anvaya paryavasānam yuktam

original: dārṣṭāntike paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra tu viśeṣyabhūte mṛge darśanakriyākarmatvasya bādhābhāvena viśeṣyabhūtamṛgasyaiva karmatāsaṃbandhena darśane'nvayasyocitvāttadviśeṣaṇabhūtotkaṭadhāvanakriyāyāḥ karmatayā darśane'nvayasyāprāmāṇikatvenātyantānucitatvāditi bodhyam| prakṛtaviṣayamupasaṃharatievaṃ ceti|
analyzed: dārṣṭāntike paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra tu viśeṣya bhūte mṛge darśana kriyā karmatvasya bādhā abhāvena viśeṣya bhūta mṛgasya eva karmatā saṃbandhena darśana invayasya ucitvāt tad viśeṣaṇa bhūta utkaṭa dhāvana kriyāyāḥ karmatayā darśana invayasya aprāmāṇika tvena atyanta anucita tvāt iti bodhyam prakṛta viṣayam upasaṃharati evam ca iti

original: ākhyātārthakartrādiviśeṣyaśābdabodhasvīkartṛmate prathamāntārthaviśeṣyakabodhavādimate ca bhāṣyakṛtsaṃmataikavākyatānupapattirūpadoṣaghrauvye cetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: ākhyāta artha kartṛ ādi viśeṣya śābdabodha svīkartṛ mate prathama anta artha viśeṣyaka bodha vādi mate ca bhāṣyakṛt saṃmata ekavākyatā anupapatti rūpa doṣa ghrauvye ca iti arthaḥ

original: bhāvanā saṃkhyākālādyatirikto dhātvarthavyāpāraḥ prakāro viśeṣaṇaṃ yasmiṃstādṛśabodhaṃ prati viśeṣyatayā prathamāntapadajanyārthopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ bodhopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo naiyāyikokto nā''daraṇīyaḥ| uktadoṣaduṣṭatvādityarthaḥ| svasaṃmataniṣkarṣamāhakiṃ tviti|
analyzed: bhāvanā saṃkhyā kāla ādi atiriktaḥ dhātvartha vyāpāraḥ prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇam yasmin tādṛśa bodham prati viśeṣyatayā prathamā anta pada janya artha upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam bodha upasthityoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ naiyāyika uktaḥ na ādaraṇīyaḥ ukta doṣa duṣṭa tvāt iti arthaḥ sva saṃmata niṣkarṣam āha kim tu iti

original: ākhyātārthastiṅartho yaḥ kartā tatprakārakabodhe jananīye viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena bhāvanāyā dhātujanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ bodhopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vaseyaḥ| devadattastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyasmāddevadattābhinno yo laḍarthaḥ kartā tanniṣṭhastaṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāt|
analyzed: ākhyāta arthaḥ tiṅ arthaḥ yaḥ kartā tad prakāraka bodhe jananīye viśeṣya tā saṃbandhena bhāvanāyāḥ dhātu janya upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam bodha upasthityoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ uvaseyaḥ devadattaḥ taṇḍulam pacati iti asmāt devadatta abhinnaḥ yaḥ laṭ arthaḥ kartā tad niṣṭhaḥ taṇḍula niṣṭha viklitti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhasya anubhava siddha tvāt

original: yadyapyayaṃ vyāpāraḥ phūtkāratvāditattdviśeṣarūpeṇa dhātuvācyastathā'pi dhātūnāmanekārthatvātkadācitsāmānyarūpeṇāpi dhātuvācyo bhavati| ata eva vākyārthapradarśanasamaye viklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti sāmānyarūpeṇa bodha ucyate, na tu viklittyunukūlaḥ phūtkārādirityevaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa nirdiśyata iti saṃgacchate|
analyzed: yadi api ayam vyāpāraḥ phūtkāra tva ādi tattad viśeṣa rūpeṇa dhātu vācyaḥ tathā api dhātūnām aneka artha tvāt kadācid sāmānya rūpeṇa api dhātu vācyaḥ bhavati atas eva vākya artha pradarśana samaye viklitti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti sāmānya rūpeṇa bodhaḥ ucyate na tu viklitti unukūlaḥ phūtkāra ādiḥ iti evam viśeṣa rūpeṇa nirdiśyate iti saṃgacchate

original: evaṃ ca mūle bhāvanātvāvacchinnaviṣayatayeti yaddhātujanyopasthiterviśeṣaṇamuktaṃ taddhātunā kadācidbhāvanātvaprakārakabodho janyata ityabhipretya bodhyam| evaṃ, tiṅarthakarmaprakārakabodhe jananīye tattātphalaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityapi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ svīkartavyaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca mūle bhāvanā tva avacchinna viṣayatayā iti yat dhātu janya upasthiteḥ viśeṣaṇam uktam tad dhātunā kadācid bhāvanā tva prakāraka bodhaḥ janyate iti abhipretya bodhyam evam tiṅ artha karma prakāraka bodhe jananīye dhātu janya upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti api kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ svīkartavyaḥ

original: nanu dhātvarthavyāpārasya kṛtpratyayārthaṃ pratyeva viśeṣaṇatvaṃ natu tiṅarthaṃ pratīti anubhūyamānaniyamasaṃpattaye bhāvanāprakārakaśābdabodhe jananīye kṛtpratyayajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ bodhopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyaḥ| tathā ca pacati bhavatītyāditaḥ kriyāprakārakakriyāviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodo'tyantāsaṃbhavī|
analyzed: nanu dhātvartha vyāpārasya kṛtpratyaya artham prati eva viśeṣaṇatvam na tu tiṅ artham prati iti anubhūyamāna niyama saṃpattaye bhāvanā prakāraka śābdabodhe jananīye kṛtpratyaya janya upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam bodha upasthityoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaśyam aṅgīkaraṇīyaḥ tathā ca pacati bhavati ityāditaḥ kriyā prakāraka kriyā viśeṣyakaḥ śābdaboda utyanta asaṃbhavī

original: kriyāprakārakabodhe hetubhūtāyāḥ kṛtpratyayajanyopastiterabhāvādityāśaṅkya nirācaṣṭebhāvanāprakāraketi| yathā gantetyādāvanyadeśasaṃyogānukūlavyārāśraya iti pratyayārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvādbhāvanā prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ yasmiṃstādṛśabodhe jananīye dhātvarthabhāvanāniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena
analyzed: kriyā prakāraka bodhe hetu bhūtāyāḥ kṛt pratyaya janya upastiteḥ abhāvāt iti āśaṅkya nirācaṣṭe bhāvanā prakāraka iti yathā gantā ityādau anya deśa saṃyoga anukūla vyāra āśrayaḥ iti pratyayārtha mukhya viśeṣyaka śābdabodhasya sarva anubhava siddha tvāt bhāvanā prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇam yasmin tādṛśa bodhe jananīye dhātvartha bhāvanā niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena

original: kṛjjanyārthopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ bodhopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇābhāvo'ṅgīkriyate tadvaddhātvarthabhāvanāprakārakabodhe jananīye dhātvarthabhāvanāniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyabhāvatopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityapi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ| niruktakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpane pramāṇamāhapaśya mṛga ityādi|
analyzed: kṛt janya artha upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam bodha upasthityoḥ kārya kāraṇa abhāvaḥ aṅgīkriyate tadvat dhātvartha bhāvanā prakāraka bodhe jananīye dhātvartha bhāvanā niṣṭha prakāra tā nirūpita viśeṣya tā saṃbandhena dhātu janya bhāvatā upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti api kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva kalpane pramāṇam āha paśya mṛgaḥ ityādi

original: pacati bhavatītyādāvekavākyatayā bhāvanāprakārakabhāvanāviśeṣyakabodhasya bhāṣyādisaṃmatatvādityarthaḥ| digiti| pacati bhavatītyādau tiṅantāt parasya tiṅantasya nighātavāraṇāya kṛtaṃ tiṅṅatiṅa' iti sūtrīyamatiṅgrahaṇaṃ niruktasthale ekavākyatvābhāve samānavākyasthatvavirahādeva nighātāprāptau vyarthaṃ sattiṅantasamudāye'pyekavākyatvaṃ
analyzed: pacati bhavati ityādau ekavākyatayā bhāvanā prakāraka bhāvanā viśeṣyaka bodhasya bhāṣya ādi saṃmata tvāt iti arthaḥ diś iti pacati bhavati ityādau tiṅ antāt parasya tiṅ antasya nighāta vāraṇāya kṛtam tiṅ ṅ atiṅaḥ iti sūtrīyam atiṅgrahaṇam nirukta sthale ekavākyatva abhāve samāna vākya sthatva virahāt eva nighāta aprāptau vyartham sat tiṅ anta samudāye pi ekavākyatvam

original: sūtrakārābhimatamiti sūcayatītyarthaḥ| yadvā dhāvanānukūlakṛtimānmṛga iti viśiṣṭārthavācino dhāvati mṛga iti vākyasya darśanakriyāyāṃ karmatāsaṃbandhenānvayaḥ| tathā sati nāmārthadhātvarthayorabhodenānvayo'pyutpanna iti vyutpattivirodho na| vākyasya nāmārthatvābhāvāt| nāpi dvitīyāpattiḥ| vākyasyāprātipadikatvāt|
analyzed: sūtrakāra abhimatam iti sūcayati iti arthaḥ yat vā dhāvana anukūla kṛtimān mṛgaḥ iti viśiṣṭa artha vācinaḥ dhāvati mṛgaḥ iti vākyasya darśana kriyāyām karmatā saṃbandhena anvayaḥ tathā sati nāma artha dhātvarthayoḥ abhodena anvaya upi utpannaḥ iti vyutpatti virodhaḥ na vākyasya nāma artha tva abhāvāt nā api dvitīya āpattiḥ vākyasya aprātipadika tvāt

original: tātparyānurodhācca darśanakarmatvasya dhāvane paryavasānamityevaṃ rītyaikavākyatvasaṃbhave'pi bhāvapradhānamiti vacanasya bhāṣyasaṃmatārthakasya virodho durvāro naiyāyikānāmityartha iti| itthaṃ ceti|
analyzed: tātparya anurodhāt ca darśana karma tvasya dhāvane paryavasānam iti evam rītyā eka vākya tva saṃbhave api bhāva pradhānam iti vacanasya bhāṣya saṃmata arthakasya virodhaḥ durvāraḥ naiyāyikānām iti arthaḥ iti ittham ca iti

original: pratyayārthasya kartrāderdhātvarthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇatve pratyayārthasaṃkhyāyāḥ pratyayārthakartrādiviśeṣaṇatve yadvā''khyātārthakartṛprakārakabodhe jananīye dhātvarthabhāvanopasthiteḥ, ākhyātārthakarmaprakārakabodhe jananīye dhātvarthaphalopasthiterhetutve cetyarthaḥ| pacatītyatraikartṛko viklittyanukūlo vartamānakāliko vyāpāra iti bodhākāraḥ|
analyzed: pratyaya arthasya kartṛ ādeḥ dhātvartham prati viśeṣaṇa tve pratyaya artha saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyaya artha kartṛ ādi viśeṣaṇa tve yat vā ākhyāta artha kartṛ prakāraka bodhe jananīye dhātvartha bhāvanā upasthiteḥ ākhyāta artha karma prakāraka bodhe jananīye dhātvartha phala upasthiteḥ hetu tve ca iti arthaḥ pacati iti atra aikartṛkaḥ viklitti anukūlaḥ vartamāna kālikaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodha ākāraḥ

original: bhāvapradhānamākhyātam, kriyāpradhānamākhyātam, iti niruktabhāṣyānurodhāt| evaṃ pacyate iti karmākhyāte'pi ekakarmikā yā viklittistadanukūlo vartamānakāliko vyāpāra iti vyāpāraviśeṣyako bodhākāraḥ prācīnamatena draṣṭavyaḥ|
analyzed: bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam kriyā pradhānam ākhyātam iti nirukta bhāṣya anurodhāt evam pacyate iti karma ākhyāte pi eka karmikā yā viklittiḥ tad anukūlaḥ vartamāna kālikaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti vyāpāra viśeṣyakaḥ bodha ākāraḥ prācīna matena draṣṭavyaḥ

original: navīnāstu pakvastaṇḍula ityādikarmakṛdantasthale vyāpāraprayojyaviklittyāśrayastaṇḍula iti bodātphalasya vyāpāraṃ prati prādhānyaṃ dṛṣṭamiti karmatiṅante'pi phalasyaiva mukhyaviśeṣyakatvaṃ yuktamiti vadanti| tiṅante'pi phalasya mukhyaviśeṣyakatvādeva pratyayārthe svaprakṛtyarthaviśeṣyānvayitvamiti niyamasya na tyāgaḥ|
analyzed: navīnāḥ tu pakvaḥ taṇḍulaḥ ityādi karma kṛt anta sthale vyāpāra prayojya viklitti āśrayaḥ taṇḍulaḥ iti bodāt phalasya vyāpāram prati prādhānyam dṛṣṭam iti karma tiṅ ante api phalasya eva mukhya viśeṣyaka tvam yuktam iti vadanti tiṅ ante api phalasya mukhya viśeṣyaka tvāt eva pratyaya arthe sva prakṛti artha viśeṣya anvayi tvam iti niyamasya na tyāgaḥ

original: pacyate ityatra pratyayārthe karmaṇi prakṛtyarthaḥvyāpārāvacchinnaphalaṃ, tatra viśeṣyaṃ yayphalaṃ viklittiḥ tasyā āśrayatāsaṃbandhenānvayāllakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| taṇḍulābhinnakarmāśrayikā vyāpārajanyā viklittiriti bodhāt| bhāvārthakatiṅāṃ dhātvarthānuvādakamātratvādbhāvatiṅantasthale dhātvarthamāvanaiva mukhyaṃ viśeṣyam|
analyzed: pacyate iti atra pratyaya arthe karmaṇi prakṛti arthaḥ vyāpāra avacchinna phalam tatra viśeṣyam yad phalam viklittiḥ tasyāḥ āśraya tā saṃbandhena anvayāt lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ taṇḍula abhinna karma āśrayikā vyāpāra janyā viklittiḥ iti bodhāt bhāva arthaka tiṅām dhātvartha anuvādaka mātra tvāt bhāva tiṅ anta sthale dhātvartha māvanā eva mukhyam viśeṣyam

original: na ca laḍādibhistatra vartamānatvaṃ na bodhyeteti vācyam| vartamānatvasya dhātvarthavyāpāraviśeṣaṇatayā tiṅo dyotakatvaṃ tathaivānubhavāt| vācakatvapakṣeḥ'pyagatyā'nubhavānurodhena tasya dhātvarthavyāpāraviśeṣaṇatvasvīkārāt| athaivaṃ tatra saṃkhyāpratyayo'pi kathamiti cenna|
analyzed: na ca laṭ ādibhiḥ tatra vartamānatvam na bodhyeta iti vācyam vartamānatvasya dhātvartha vyāpāra viśeṣaṇatayā tiṅaḥ dyotakatvam tathā eva anubhavāt atha evam tatra saṃkhyā pratyayaḥ api katham iti ced na

original: bhāvalakāre hi saṃkhyānvayikartṛkarmaṇorapratītestatratyā saṃkhyā'nanvitaiva| na ca vartamānatvavad‌bhāvanāyāmeva saṃkhyānvayo'stviti śaṅkyam| bhāvanāyā liṅgasaṃkhyānanvayitvenaiva dhātunopasthāpanāt| etadeva tasyā asattvarūpatvaṃmityucyate|
analyzed: bhāva lakāre hi saṃkhyā anvayi kartṛ karmaṇoḥ apratīteḥ tatratyā saṃkhyā ananvitā eva na ca vartamānatva vat bhāvanāyām eva saṃkhyā anvayoḥ tu iti śaṅkyam bhāvanāyāḥ liṅga saṃkhyā ananvayi tvena eva dhātunā upasthāpanāt etat eva tasyāḥ asattva rūpa tvam iti ucyate

original: kiṃtu na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā nāpi kevalā pratyaya iti niyameva sādhutvārthamekavacanameva prayujyate| tatrāpi naivaikatvasaṃkhyāpekṣā| ekavacanamutsargataḥ kariṣyata iti bhāṣyasiddhāntāt| ayaṃ bhāvaḥekavacanam, dvayordvivacanam, iti bhaṅktvā sūtranyāsaḥ| bahuṣu bahuvacanam, iti yathāsthitameva|
analyzed: kiṃtu na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā na api kevalā pratyayaḥ iti niyamā iva sādhu tva artham ekavacanam eva prayujyate tatra api na eva eka tva saṃkhyā apekṣā ekavacanam utsargataḥ kariṣyate iti bhāṣya siddhāntāt ayam bhāvaḥ ekavacanam dvayoḥ dvivacanam iti bhaṅktvā sūtra nyāsaḥ bahuṣu bahuvacanam iti yathāsthitam eva

original: tatra dvitvabahutvayordvivacanabahuvacananiyame sati tayoraviṣaye saṃkhyānapekṣaṇenaikavacanamiti labhyata iti tadartha iti|
analyzed: tatra dvitva bahutvayoḥ dvivacana bahuvacana niyame sati tayoḥ aviṣaye saṃkhyā anapekṣaṇena ekavacanam iti labhyate iti tad arthaḥ iti

original: kartṛvācakacaitrādipadasamabhivyāhārasthale tvākhyātopasthāpitakartuścaitrādibhiḥ samamabhedānvayaḥ| tathā caikataṇḍulāśrayikā yā viklittistadanukūlaikacaitrābhinnāśrayikā vartamānakālikī bhāvaneti taṇḍūlaṃ pacati caitra ityatra bodhaḥ|
analyzed: kartṛ vācaka caitra ādi pada samabhivyāhāra sthale tu ākhyāta upasthāpita kartuḥ caitra ādibhiḥ samam abheda anvayaḥ tathā ca eka taṇḍula āśrayikā yā viklittiḥ tad anukūla eka caitra abhinna āśrayikā vartamāna kālikī bhāvanā iti taṇḍūlam pacati caitraḥ iti atra bodhaḥ

original: evaṃ karmavācakataṇḍulādipadasamabhivyāhāre'pi ākhyātopasthāpitakarmaṇastaṇḍulādibhiḥ samamabhedānvayāttaṇḍulaḥ pacyate caitreṇetyatra ekacaitrāśrayikā ekataṇḍulābhinnāśrayikā yā viklittistadanukūlā sāṃpratikī bhāvanenati bodha ityāśayenā''hadevadattādipadaprayoge tviti| ākhyātārthakartrādibhiriti| samānavibhaktikanāmārthayorevābhedānvaya iti|
analyzed: evam karma vācaka taṇḍula ādi pada samabhivyāhāre api ākhyāta upasthāpita karmaṇaḥ taṇḍula ādibhiḥ samam abheda anvayāt taṇḍulaḥ pacyate caitreṇa iti atra eka caitra āśrayikā eka taṇḍula abhinna āśrayikā yā viklittiḥ tad anukūlā sāṃpratikī bhāvanena iti bodhaḥ iti āśayena āha devadatta ādi pada prayoge tu iti ākhyāta artha kartṛ ādibhiḥ iti samāna vibhaktika nāma arthayoḥ eva abheda anvayaḥ iti

original: vyutpatteḥ somena yajeta stokaṃ pacati, rājapuruṣa ityādau vyabhicaritatvena duṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: vyutpatteḥ somena yajeta stokam pacati rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau vyabhicarita tvena duṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ākhyātārthakartṛprakārakabodhe jananīye viṣayatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityuktaṃ, kiṃ tu dhātumātrasya vyāpāravācitvaṃ na dṛśyate naśyatītyādau vyāpārapratīterananubhavāt| tathā ca tatroktakāryakāraṇabhāvavyabhicāra ityāśayenā''haghaṭo naśyatītyatreti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥnaś dhātorna kevalaṃ nāśo'rthaḥ|
analyzed: ākhyāta artha kartṛ prakāraka bodhe jananīye viṣayatā saṃbandhena dhātu janya bhāvanā upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti uktam kim tu dhātu mātrasya vyāpāra vāci tvam na dṛśyate naśyati ityādau vyāpāra pratīteḥ ananubhavāt tathā ca tatra ukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva vyabhicāraḥ iti āśayena āha ghaṭaḥ naśyati iti atra iti ayam bhāvaḥ dhātoḥ na kevalam nāśaḥ arthaḥ

original: kiṃ tu `ṇaśa adarśane' iti dhātupāṭhātadarśanānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ| sa ca vyāpāraḥ pratiyogitāsahitanāśasāmagrīsamavadhānam| atra nāśasāmagryāḥ pratiyogitāsāhityaṃ ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena bodhyam| tathā ca ghaṭaniṣṭhā yā pratiyogitā, tannirūpikā yā nāśasāmagrī tatsamavadhānameva vyāpāra ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: kim tu adarśane iti dhātu pāṭhāt adarśana anukūlaḥ sa ca vyāpāraḥ pratiyogitā sahita nāśa sāmagrī samavadhānam atra nāśa sāmagryāḥ pratiyogitā sāhityam ca nirūpakatā saṃbandhena bodhyam tathā ca ghaṭa niṣṭhā yā pratiyogitā tad nirūpikā yā nāśa sāmagrī tad samavadhānam eva vyāpāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nāśasāmagrī ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kramikāvayavaviśaraṇādirūpā| evaṃ ca ghaṭābhinnāśrayako'darśanānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhānna kāryakāraṇabhāvabhaṅga ityarthaḥ| ata evanaś dhātoradarśanānukūlavyāpārārthakatvādeva| tasyāṃ satyāmitiḥ krameṇāvayavaviśaraṇādyātmikāyāṃ sāmagryāṃ satyāmityarthaḥ|

analyzed: yathaā gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra lakṣaṇayā upasthita artha gate gaṅgā tīra tva ātmake guru dharme lakṣya tā avacchedaka tvam svīkriyate tadvat phūtkāra tva ādi guru dharme api śakyatā avacchedaka tva svīkāre bādhaka abhāvāt iti arthaḥ tayoḥ vaiṣamya iti

original: śaktilakṣaṇayorubhayorapi padatadarthasaṃbandarūpatvāviśeṣeṇa lakṣyatāvacchedakatvaṃ gurudharme śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ tu na tatretyevaṃ vailakṣaṇyakaraṇasya pramāṇābhāvenānucitatvātpacatītyato viklittyanukūlo yatna iti bodhasyā''nubhavikānāmanudayācca sarvathā'yuktaṃ taṭasthāśaṅkitaṃ dhātoḥ kṛtivācakatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: śakti lakṣaṇayoḥ ubhayoḥ api pada tad artha saṃbanda rūpa tva aviśeṣeṇa lakṣya tā avacchedaka tvam guru dharme śakyatā avacchedaka tvam tu na tatra iti evam vailakṣaṇya karaṇasya pramāṇa abhāvena anucita tvāt pacati iti atas viklitti anukūlaḥ yatnaḥ iti bodhasya ānubhavikānām anudayāt ca sarvathā ayuktam taṭastha āśaṅkitam dhātoḥ kṛti vācaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu na kevalalāghavānurodhena kṛtitvasya dhātuvācyatāvacchedakatvamāśaṅ‌kitaṃ kiṃtu mānāntaragamyatvasaṃbhavasahakṛtenaiva lāghaveneti sūcayaṃstasya mānāntaragamyatvasaṃbhavamāśaṅkatena ceti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥkṛño yatnārthakatvamavaśyameṣṭavyam| yatnajanyatvānusaṃdhānadaśāyāmeva paṭaḥ kṛta iti kṛtavyavahāradarśanāt|
analyzed: nanu na kevala lāghava anurodhena kṛti tvasya dhātu vācya tā avacchedaka tvam āśaṅkitam kiṃtu māna antara gamya tva saṃbhava sahakṛtena eva lāghavena iti sūcayan tasya māna antara gamya tva saṃbhavam āśaṅkatena ca iti ayam bhāvaḥ kṛñaḥ yatna arthaka tvam avaśyam eṣṭavyam yatna janya tva anusaṃdhāna daśāyām eva paṭaḥ kṛtaḥ iti kṛta vyavahāra darśanāt

original: yatnajanyatvānusaṃdhānābhāve tu tatrāṅkuraḥ kṛta iti kṛtavyavahāradarśanāt| kiṃ tvaṅkuro jāta ityevamakṛtavyavahāradarśanāt|
analyzed: yatna janya tva anusaṃdhāna abhāve tu tatra aṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ iti kṛta vyavahāra darśanāt kim tu aṅkuraḥ jātaḥ iti evam akṛta vyavahāra darśanāt

original: itthaṃ ca pacatītyetaddhaṭakapac‌dhātoḥ pākaṃ karotītyevaṃ yatnārthakakarotinā vivaraṇāt, kiṃ karotīti yatnaviṣayakapraśne pacatītyuttarasya yatnārthakatvaṃ vinā'nupapatteśca yatna eva dhātorathaṃ iti śaṅkābhiprāyaḥ yatnaśca kṛtireva|
analyzed: ittham ca pacati iti etat dhaṭaka pad dhātoḥ pākam karoti iti evam yatna arthaka karotinā vivaraṇāt kim karoti iti yatna viṣayaka praśne pacati iti uttarasya yatna arthaka tvam vinā anupapatteḥ ca yatnaḥ eva dhātoḥ atham iti śaṅkā abhiprāyaḥ yatnaḥ ca kṛtiḥ eva

original: saṃbhavedevaṃ yadi kṛño yatnārthakatvaṃ suvacaṃ syāt, tadeva tu durlabhamiti dūre dhātoryatnārthakatvakathanamityabhipretyā''haratha iti| atra rathapadānupādāne gamanānukūlayatnasya caitrādicetananiṣṭhasya vidyamānatvena na tādṛśaprayogahānirato `rathaḥ' ityuktam|
analyzed: saṃbhavet evam yadi kṛñaḥ yatna arthaka tvam suvacam syāt tat eva tu durlabham iti dūre dhātoḥ yatna arthaka tva kathanam iti abhipretya āha rathaḥ iti atra ratha pada anupādāne gamana anukūla yatnasya caitra ādi cetana niṣṭhasya vidyamāna tvena na tādṛśa prayoga hāniḥ atas rathaḥ iti uktam

original: aṅkuraḥ kṛta ityetāvanmātroktau yatnāparaparyāyeśvarīyakṛtijanyatvamādāya niruktaprayogopapattirata uktaṃ bījādineti| evaṃ ca rathabījādāvacetane yatnasya sarvathā bādhāttādṛśaprayogāsaṃgatyā naiva kaॉño yatnavācitvamapi tu vyāpāravācitvaṃ vinā niruktaprayogānupapatteḥ kṛño vyāpāre lākṣaṇikatvānna tena yatnārthakatvabhaṅga iti vācyam|
analyzed: aṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ iti etāvat mātra uktau yatna apara paryāya īśvarīya kṛti janya tvam ādāya nirukta prayoga upapattiḥ atas uktam bīja ādinā iti evam ca ratha bīja ādau acetane yatnasya sarvathā bādhāt tādṛśa prayoga asaṃgatyā na eva kañaḥ yatna vāci tvam api tu vyāpāra vāci tvam vinā nirukta prayoga anupapatteḥ kṛñaḥ vyāpāre lākṣaṇika tvāt na tena yatna arthaka tva bhaṅgaḥ iti vācyam

original: saṃbhavati mukhyārthakatve lākṣaṇikārthakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt| tathā ca bahuśaḥ kṛño vyāpāravācitvadarśanena vyāpāra eva kṛñaḥ śaktiruciteti tādṛśārthakakarotinā dhātorvivaraṇād‌vivriyamāṇavivaraṇayoḥ samānārthakatvaniyamāddhātorvyāpāravācitvamavaśyaṃ svīkaraṇīyamityāśayaḥ| vivaraṇaṃ ca tatsamānārthakapadāntareṇa tadarthakathanam|
analyzed: saṃbhavati mukhya arthaka tve lākṣaṇika artha kalpanāyāḥ anyāyya tvāt tathā ca bahuśas kṛñaḥ vyāpāra vāci tva darśanena vyāpāre eva kṛñaḥ śaktiḥ ucitā iti tādṛśa arthaka karotinā dhātoḥ vivaraṇāt vivriyamāṇa vivaraṇayoḥ samāna arthaka tva niyamāt dhātoḥ vyāpāra vāci tvam avaśyam svīkaraṇīyam iti āśayaḥ vivaraṇam ca tad samāna arthaka pada antareṇa tad artha kathanam

original: pacatītyanena samānārthakaṃ yatpadāntaraṃ pākaṃ karotītyākārakaṃ tena pacatītyasyārthakathanamiti bodhyam|
analyzed: pacati iti anena samāna arthakam yat pada antaram pākam karoti iti ākārakam tena pacati iti asya artha kathanam iti bodhyam

original: atha kṛño'karmakatāpatteriti kārikottarārdhamavatārayituṃ bhūmikāmāracayatikiṃcetyādinā| bhāvanāyāḥvyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ| avācyatvedhātunirūpitavācyatvābhāve tiṅ‌nirūpitavācyatvābhāve ca satītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: atha kṛñaḥ ukarmaka tā āpatteḥ iti kārikā uttara ardham avatārayitum bhūmikām āracayati kiṃca ityādinā bhāvanāyāḥ vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ avācya tve dhātu nirūpita vācyatva abhāve tiṅ nirūpita vācyatva abhāve ca sati iti arthaḥ

original: tataśca phalamātrasya dhātvarthatve paryavasanne svajanakavyāpāravyadhikaraṇadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvaṃ, dhātvarthaphalāśrayatvameva vā karmatvaṃ vaktavyam| atra svapadena phalaṃ grāhyam|
analyzed: tatas ca phala mātrasya dhātvartha tve paryavasanne sva janaka vyāpāra vyadhikaraṇa dhātvartha phala āśraya tvam dhātvartha phala āśraya tvam eva vā karma tvam vaktavyam atra sva padena phalam grāhyam

original: evaṃ ca utpattyarthakād‌bhūdhātostadanukūlavyāpāravācake ṇic‌pratyaye kṛte ghaṭaṃ bhāvayatītyatra utpattirūpadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvena karmatvādyathā ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyā bhavati tadvad ghaṭobhavatītyatrāpi utpattirūpadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvena karmatvād ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpattiḥ syāt| atredaṃ bodyam|
analyzed: evam ca utpatti arthakāt bhū dhātoḥ tad anukūla vyāpāra vācake ṇic pratyaye kṛte ghaṭam bhāvayati iti atra utpatti rūpa dhātvartha phala āśraya tvena karma tvāt yathā ghaṭa pada uttaram dvitīyā bhavati tadvat ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra api utpatti rūpa dhātvartha phala āśraya tvena karma tvāt ghaṭa pada uttaram dvitīyā āpattiḥ syāt atra idam bodyam

original: ṇijantasthale svajanaketyādi prathamaṃ karmalakṣaṇaṃ, dvitīyaṃ tu śuddhe ṇijante ceti| ghaṭo bhavatītyatra ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpattiṃ vārayituṃ śaṅkatena cātra ghaṭasyeti| karmasaṃjñāyā bādhāditi|
analyzed: sva janaka ityādi prathamam karma lakṣaṇam dvitīyam tu śuddhe ṇic ante ca iti ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra ghaṭa pada uttaram dvitīya āpattim vārayitum śaṅkatena ca atra ghaṭasya iti karma saṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt iti

original: ghaṭo bhavatītyatra ghaṭasya kartṛtvena pratīteghaṭasyotpattirūpaphalāśrayatve'pi parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñāyā bādhānna dvitīyāpattiriti bhāvaḥ śaṅkakasya| yaduktaṃ ghaṭasya kartṛtvaṃ tanna saṃbhavatītyāhaanugateti| cetanācetanaitadubhayavṛttikartṛtvalakṣaṇasya tvayā vaktumaśakyatayā ghaṭasya kartṛtvābhāvād‌durnivārā dvitīyotyarthaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra ghaṭasya kartṛ tvena pratīteḥ ghaṭasya utpatti rūpa phala āśraya tve pi parayā kartṛ saṃjñayā karma saṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt na dvitīya āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ śaṅkakasya yat uktam ghaṭasya kartṛ tvam tat na saṃbhavati iti āha anugata iti cetana acetana etad ubhaya vṛtti kartṛ tva lakṣaṇasya tvayā vaktum aśakya tayā ghaṭasya kartṛ tva abhāvāt durnivārā dvitīya utyarthaḥ

original: gaṭasyākartṛtvameva pratipādayatikṛtyāśrayatvasyetyādi| yadi tattaddhāttvarthaphalānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvamucyate tarhi prayatnāparaparyāyāyāḥ kṛteścetanamātraniṣṭhadharmatvenācetane tadabhāvena ghaṭo'stītyādāvavyāptiḥ| kārakacakreti|
analyzed: gaṭasya akartṛ tvam eva pratipādayati kṛti āśraya tvasya ityādi yadi tad tad dhāttvartha phala anukūla kṛti āśraya tvam kartṛ tvam ucyate tarhi prayatna apara paryāyāyāḥ kṛteḥ cetana mātra niṣṭha dharma tvena acetane tad abhāvena ghaṭaḥ asti ityādau avyāptiḥ kāraka cakra iti

original: prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyānvayayogyakārakasamudāyapravartakatvaṃ taditi cetsthālī pacati asiśchinattītyādau sthālyāderacetanasya kārakacakrapravartakatvābhāvenāvyāptireva| abhāvāditi| ghaṭasyācetanatvātkṛtyāśrayatvasya kārakacakraprayoktṛtvasya cābhāva iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: prakṛta dhātu upātta kriyā anvaya yogya kāraka samudāya pravartaka tvam tat iti ced sthālī pacati asiḥ chinatti ityādau sthālī ādeḥ acetanasya kāraka cakra pravartaka tva abhāvena avyāptiḥ eva abhāvāt iti ghaṭasya acetana tvāt kṛtya āśraya tvasya kāraka cakra prayoktṛ tvasya ca abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca kṛtyādimata eva kartṛsaṃjñāyā uktatvātkṛtyādyabhāve kartṛsaṃjñāprāṣtyabhāvena karmasaṃjñāyā anapavādatvādvitīyāpattirdurvāretyarthaḥ| mama mate dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvena kartṛtvānna dvitīyā kiṃtu prathamaiveti na doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca kṛti ādimataḥ eva kartṛ saṃjñāyāḥ uktatvāt kṛti ādi abhāve kartṛ saṃjñā prāṣti abhāvena karma saṃjñāyāḥ anapavāda tvāt vitīyā āpattiḥ durvārā iti arthaḥ mama mate dhātu upātta vyāpāra āśraya tvena kartṛ tvāt na dvitīyā kiṃtu prathamā eva iti na doṣaḥ

original: evaṃ dhātorvyāpārāvācakatvāvādinaiyāyikamataṃ nirākṛtya phalaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, vyāpāraḥ pratyayārtha iti vādinaṃ mīmāṃsakaṃ pratyācaṣṭedhātvarthānukūleti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥsvatantraḥ karteti sūtre svātantryaṃdhātvartha phalānukūlavyāpārāśrayatvaṃ, tacca ghaṭe utpattyanukūlavyāpārasattvenābādhitameveti tādṛśasvātantryameva kartṛtvaṃ mayā manyata iti|
analyzed: evam dhātoḥ vyāpāra avācaka tva avādi naiyāyika matam nirākṛtya phalam dhātvarthaḥ vyāpāraḥ pratyaya arthaḥ iti vādinam mīmāṃsakam pratyācaṣṭe dhātvartha anukūla iti ayam bhāvaḥ svatantraḥ kartā iti sūtre svātantryam dhātvartha phala anukūla vyāpāra āśraya tvam tat ca ghaṭe utpatti anukūla vyāpāra sattvena ābādhitam eva iti tādṛśa svātantryam eva kartṛ tvam mayā manyate iti

original: tadapi na, ativyāptatvādityāhakārakamātreti| mātra śabdaḥ kārtsnye| karmakaraṇādisarveṣvapi kārakeṣu tattaddhātvarthaphalānukūlayatkiṃcitkriyāśrayatvasattvenātiprasaṅgaḥ| kriyājanakatvasyaiva kārakatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tat api na ativyāpta tvāt iti āha kāraka mātra iti mātra śabdaḥ kārtsnye karma karaṇa ādi sarveṣu api kārakeṣu tad tad dhātvartha phala anukūla yat kiṃcid kriyā āśrayatva sattvena atiprasaṅgaḥ kriyā janaka tvasya eva kāraka tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarveṣu kārakeṣu ghātvarthānukūlavyāpārāśrayatvarūpasvātantryasattve'pi yasya ākhyātopāttavyāpārāśrayatvena svātantryaṃ vivakṣyate tasyaiva kartṛsaṃjñā bhavati iti svatantraḥ karteti sūtrapraṇayanasāmarthyādavagamyate| anyathā parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhādapādānādisaṃjñā nirviṣayāḥ syuḥ|
analyzed: nanu sarveṣu kārakeṣu ghātvartha anukūla vyāpāra āśraya tva rūpa svātantrya sattve pi yasya ākhyāta upātta vyāpāra āśraya tvena svātantryam vivakṣyate tasya eva kartṛ saṃjñā bhavati iti svatantraḥ kartā iti sūtra praṇayana sāmarthyāt avagamyate anyathā parayā kartṛ saṃjñayā bādhāt apādāna ādi saṃjñāḥ nirviṣayāḥ syuḥ

original: tataśca kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāṃ taṇḍūlaṃ pacatītyādau karaṇādikārakaprayogasya vilaya eva syāt| ata eva laghumañjūṣāyāṃ nāgeśabhaṭṭairuktaṃ subarthavicāresarveṣāṃ svasvavyāpāradvārā svātantryeṇaiva kriyāniṣpādakatvātkartṛkārakatvam|
analyzed: tatas ca kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyām taṇḍūlam pacati ityādau karaṇa ādi kāraka prayogasya vilayaḥ eva syāt atas eva laghumañjūṣāyām nāgeśa bhaṭṭaiḥ uktam subarthavicāre sarveṣām sva sva vyāpāra dvārā svātantryeṇa eva kriyā niṣpādaka tvāt kartṛ kāraka tvam

original: atra svātantryetyasya svātantryavivakṣayaivetyatthaḥ tataḥ kena kaḥ kiṃ pacatītyādivivakṣāyāṃ svasvavyāpāravaśena karaṇāditvaṃ bhavatyeveti| harimā'pyuktamniṣpattimātre kartṛtvaṃ sarvatraivāsti kārake| vyāpārabhedāpekṣāyāṃ karaṇāditvasaṃbhavaḥ||
analyzed: atra svātantrya ityasya svātantrya vivakṣayā eva iti atthaḥ tatas kena kaḥ kim pacati ityādi vivakṣāyām sva sva vyāpāra vaśena karaṇa ādi tvam bhavati eva iti niṣpatti mātre kartṛ tvam sarvatra evā asti kārake vyāpāra bheda apekṣāyām karaṇa ādi tva saṃbhavaḥ

original: yathā putrajanmani pitroḥ kartṛtve'pi kaḥ kasyāṃ kā ca kasmāditibhedena vivakṣāyāmayamasyāmiyamasmātputraṃ janayatīti vyavahāro'pyupapadyata iti ca| kāraka iti sūtre bhāṣye'pyuktamsthālīsthe yatne kathyamāne sthālī svatantrā, iti| vivakṣitasvātantryavatīti tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā putra janmani pitroḥ kartṛ tve pi kaḥ kasyām kā ca kasmāt iti bhedena vivakṣāyām ayam asyām iyam asmāt putram janayati iti vyavahāraḥ api upapadyate iti ca kārakaḥ iti sūtre bhāṣye pi uktam sthālī sthe yatne kathyamāne sthālī svatantrā iti vivakṣita svātantryavatī iti tad arthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca svātantrsya vivakṣādhīnatvānnātiprasaṅgo nāpi ghaṭo bhavatītyatra dvitīyāprasaṅgaḥghaṭaniṣṭhadhātvarthaphalānukūlavyāpārasyaiva svātantryavivakṣaṇena kartṛsaṃjñāyā aparihāryatvādityata āhaapa cetyādi| ucchinnaḥ syāditi|
analyzed: evam ca svātantrsya vivakṣā adhīna tvāt na atiprasaṅgaḥ na api ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra dvitīyā prasaṅgaḥ ghaṭa niṣṭha dhātvartha phala anukūla vyāpārasya eva svātantrya vivakṣaṇena kartṛ saṃjñāyāḥ aparihārya tvāt iti atas āha apa ca ityādi ucchinnaḥ syāt iti

original: yadi vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā dhātuvācyā na syāttarhi sakarmako'yaṃ dhāturayaṃ cākarmaka ityevaṃ vibhāgaḥ sarvathā durupapāda ityarthaḥ| siddhāntasaṃmataṃ sakarmakalakṣaṇamāhasvārthaphaletyādi| svapadena dhāturgrāhyaḥ|
analyzed: yadi vyāpāra rūpā bhāvanā dhātu vācyā na syāt tarhi sakarmakaḥ yam dhātuḥ ayam ca akarmakaḥ iti evam vibhāgaḥ sarvathā durupapādaḥ iti arthaḥ siddhānta saṃmatam sakarmaka lakṣaṇam āha svārtha phala ityādi sva padena dhātuḥ grāhyaḥ

original: tathā ca dhātuvācyaṃ yatphalaṃ tādṛśaphalavyadhikaraṇo yo vyāpārastadvācakatvaṃ dhātoścedbhavati tadā so'yaṃ dhātuḥ sakarmaka ityucyate| bhūprabhṛtāvakarmake'tiprasaṅgavāraṇāya svārthaphalavyādhikaraṇeti vyāpāraviśeṣaṇam| tathā ca bhūprabhṛterakarmakadhātoḥ svārthaphalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakavānna sakarmakatvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca dhātu vācyam yat phalam tādṛśa phala vyadhikaraṇaḥ yaḥ vyāpāraḥ tad vācakatvam dhātoḥ ced bhavati tadā saḥ yam dhātuḥ sakarmakaḥ iti ucyate bhū prabhṛtau akarmaka iti prasaṅga vāraṇāya svārtha phala vyādhi karaṇa iti vyāpāra viśeṣaṇam tathā ca bhū prabhṛteḥ akarmaka dhātoḥ svārtha phala samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācakavān na sakarmaka tvam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bhūprabhṛtīnāmapi pacyādidhātvarthaphalavyādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvādatiprasaṅgastadavastha eveti cenna| phale svārthetiviśeṣaṇadānāt| svārtho yatphalaṃ tad‌vyadhikaraṇetyarthād‌bhūprabhṛtervyāpārasya pacyādidhātvarthaphalavyadhikaraṇatve'pi svārathaphalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvānna kṣatiḥ|
analyzed: nanu bhū prabhṛtīnām api paci ādi dhātvartha phala vyādhi karaṇa vyāpāra vācaka tvāt atiprasaṅgaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva iti ced na phale svārtha iti viśeṣaṇa dānāt svārthaḥ yat phalam tad vyadhikaraṇa iti arthāt bhū prabhṛteḥ vyāpārasya paci ādi dhātvartha phala vyadhikaraṇa tve pi svāratha phala vyadhikaraṇa tva abhāvāt na kṣatiḥ

original: nanu grāmaṃ gacchati caitraḥ, ityādau gamyādidhātvarthaphalasya saṃyogasya dviṣṭhatvena grāmacaitrobhayavṛttitvāccaitraniṣṭhavyāpārasya gamyādidhātvarthaphalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvenāvyāptiḥ| tathā ca gamyādidhātoḥ sakarmakatvaṃ na syāditi cenna|
analyzed: nanu grāmam gacchati caitraḥ ityādau gami ādi dhātvartha phalasya saṃyogasya dviṣṭha tvena grāma caitra ubhaya vṛtti tvāt caitra niṣṭha vyāpārasya gami ādi dhātvartha phala vyadhikaraṇa tva abhāvena avyāptiḥ tathā ca gami ādi dhātoḥ sakarmaka tvam na syāt iti ced na

original: phalavyadhikaraṇatvaṃ ca phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhena yatkiṃcittaddhātvarthaphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvaṃ vivakṣitam| phalādhikaraṇayordvayarmadhye kiṃcidekaṃ yatphalādhikaraṇaṃ tadapekṣayā bhinnavṛttitvaṃ vyāpārasyeti tadarthaḥ| vyāpārasya yatkiṃcitphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvaṃ grāhyaṃ natu yāvatphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvamiti yāvat|
analyzed: phala vyadhikaraṇa tvam ca phalatā avacchedaka saṃbandhena yat kiṃcid tad dhātvartha phala adhikaraṇa bhinna vṛtti tvam vivakṣitam phala adhikaraṇayoḥ kiṃcid ekam yat phala adhikaraṇam tad apekṣayā bhinna vṛtti tvam vyāpārasya iti tad arthaḥ vyāpārasya yat kiṃcid phala adhikaraṇa bhinna vṛtti tvam grāhyam natu yāvat phala adhikaraṇa bhinna vṛtti tvam iti yāvat

original: tathā ca gamyādivyāpārasya yāvatphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvābhāve'pi gamyādidhātvarthasaṃyogātmakaphalādhikaraṇayorgrāmacaitrayormadhye yadekaṃ phalādhikaraṇaṃ grāmaḥ, tadapekṣayā bhinno yaścaitrastad‌vṛttivyāpāravācakatvānna sakarmakeṣu gamyāderasaṃgraha ityarthaḥ| na ca ghaṭo bhavatītyatra utpattyanukūlo vyāpāro bhūdhātvarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca gami ādi vyāpārasya yāvat phala adhikaraṇa bhinna vṛtti tva abhāve pi gami ādi dhātvartha saṃyoga ātmaka phala adhikaraṇayoḥ grāma caitrayoḥ madhye yat ekam phala adhikaraṇam grāmaḥ tad apekṣayā bhinnaḥ yaḥ caitraḥ tad vṛtti vyāpāra vācaka tvāt na sakarmakeṣu gami ādeḥ asaṃgrahaḥ iti arthaḥ na ca ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra utpatti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ bhū dhātvarthaḥ

original: tatra vyāpārasya ghaṭavṛttitvaṃ, phalasya tūtpattyātmakasya kālikasaṃbandhena kālavṛttitvamiti kṛtvā svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvādakarmake bhūprabhṛtau sakarmakalakṣaṇātivyāptiriti śaṅkyam| phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandheneti niveśanāt|
analyzed: tatra vyāpārasya ghaṭa vṛtti tvam phalasya tu utpatti ātmakasya kālika saṃbandhena kāla vṛtti tvam iti kṛtvā svārtha phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tvāt akarmake bhū prabhṛtau sakarmaka lakṣaṇa ativyāptiḥ iti śaṅkyam phala tā avacchedaka saṃbandhena iti niveśanāt

analyzed: tathā ca phala tā avacchedakaḥ yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tena saṃbandhena kiṃcid yat phala adhikaraṇam tad apekṣayā yat bhinnam tad vṛtti tvam vyāpārasya vivakṣitam iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca ghaṭo bhavatītyādau bhūprabhṛtervyāpārasya kālikasaṃbandhena phalādhikaraṇakālāpekṣayā bhinno yo ghaṭastad‌vṛttitve'pi phalatāvacchedakasamavāyasaṃbandhena yadutpattirūpaphalādhikaraṇaṃ ghaṭastad‌vṛttitvena phalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvānnātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca ghaṭaḥ bhavati ityādau bhū prabhṛteḥ vyāpārasya kālika saṃbandhena phala adhikaraṇa kāla apekṣayā bhinnaḥ yaḥ ghaṭaḥ tad vṛtti tve pi phalatā avacchedaka samavāya saṃbandhena yat utpatti rūpa phala adhikaraṇam ghaṭaḥ tad vṛtti tvena phala vyadhikaraṇa tva abhāvāt na ativyāptiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu jīvatītyāditaḥ prāṇān dhārayatīti saṃpratyayātprāṇadhāraṇānukūlo vyāpāro jīvaterarthaḥ| tatra vyāpāro devadattādiniṣṭhaḥ| dhāraṇātmakaṃ phalaṃ ca prāṇaniṣṭham| dhāraṇaṃ samavasthāpanam| tathā ca svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvājjīvatyādāvakarmake'tiprasaṅga iti cetsvārthaphale dhātvarthāmaviṣṭāśrayakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam|
analyzed: nanu jīvati ityāditaḥ prāṇān dhārayati iti saṃpratyayāt prāṇa dhāraṇa anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ jīvateḥ arthaḥ tatra vyāpāraḥ devadatta ādi niṣṭhaḥ dhāraṇa ātmakam phalam ca prāṇa niṣṭham dhāraṇam samavasthāpanam tathā ca svārtha phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tvāt jīvati ādau akarmaka iti prasaṅgaḥ iti ced svārtha phale viśeṣaṇam deyam

original: dhātvarthāpraviṣṭāśrayakasvārthaphaletyādi lakṣaṇam| dhātvarthe'praviṣṭo'nantarbhūta āśrayo yasya phalasyeti tadarthaḥ| tathā cātra dhāraṇātmakadhātvarthaphalāśrayasya prāṇasya dhātvarthe'ntarbhūtatvānnātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| evamavivakṣitakarmakatvābhāvavattvamapi svārthe viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam|
analyzed: dhātvartha apraviṣṭa āśrayaka svārtha phala ityādi lakṣaṇam dhātvarthe praviṣṭaḥ ūnantarbhūtaḥ āśrayaḥ yasya phalasya iti tad arthaḥ tathā ca atra dhāraṇā ātmaka dhātvartha phala āśrayasya prāṇasya dhātvarthe ntarbhūta tvāt na atiprasaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam avivakṣita karmaka tva abhāvavat tvam api svārthe viśeṣaṇam deyam

original: vivigamanāvirahātprakārāntareṇa sakarmakatvaṃ lakṣayatisvārthavyāpāretyādi| svārthaḥdhātvarthaḥ, dhātuvācya ityarthaḥ| etādṛśo yo vyāpārastad‌vyadhikaraṇaṃ yatphalaṃ tadvācakatvaṃ sakarmakatvamityarthaḥ| vyāpāravyadhikaraṇatvaṃ ca vyāpārānadhikaraṇavṛttitvaṃ vodhyam|

original: dhātuvācyo yaḥ phūtkārādivyāpārastadadhikaraṇaṃ devadattādi, tadanadhikaraṇaṃ yattaṇḍulādi, tad‌vṛttiviklittyādiphalavācakatvātpacyādau lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhaniveśanādi pūrvavadvodhyam|
analyzed: dhātu vācyaḥ yaḥ phūtkāra ādi vyāpāraḥ tad adhikaraṇam devadatta ādi tad anadhikaraṇam yat taṇḍula ādi tad vṛtti viklitti ādi phala vācaka tvāt paci ādau lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ phalatā avacchedaka saṃbandha niveśana ādi pūrvavat vodhyam

original: asaṃbhavīti| niruktaṃ siddhāntasaṃmataṃ sakarmakatvamanyathānupapannamiti dhātorvyāpārarūpabhāvanāvācakatvamavaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| prakārāntareṇa sakarmakatvasya vyavasthitatvamāśaṅkya pratyācaṣṭeanyatamatvaṃ tattvamityādinā|
analyzed: asaṃbhavi iti niruktam siddhānta saṃmatam sakarmaka tvam anyathā anupapannam iti dhātoḥ vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanā vācakatvam avaśyam aṅgīkaraṇīyam iti bhāvaḥ prakāra antareṇa sakarmaka tvasya vyavasthita tvam āśaṅkya pratyācaṣṭe anyatama tvam tattvam ityādinā

original: yathā nadī vahatītyatra vahadhātoḥ syandane'rthe'karmakatvaṃ, bhāraṃ vahatītyatra prāpaṇārthake sakarmakatvaṃ ca| tatra sakarmakadhātusamudāye vaheḥ pāṭhe syandanārthake'karmake tasminnatiprasaṅgaḥ| tatrāpāṭhe tu prāpaṇārthake tasminnevāprasaṅga ityevamatiprasaktyaprasaktidoṣadarśanāditi bhāvaḥ| tadetaditi|

original: niruktaṃ doṣajātaṃ manasikṛtyā''hakṛño'karmakateti| nanu sakarmakatvaṃ nāma svajanakavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalavācakatvam| svaśabdena phalaṃ grāhyam| tathā ca phalajanako yo vyāpārastādṛśavyāpārānādhikaraṇavṛtti yatphalaṃ tadvācakatvamityarthaḥ| tādṛśaṃ ca sakarmakatvaṃ karotau sūpapādam|

original: tathāhiyatnaḥ, phalatāvacchedakaviṣayatāsaṃbandhena ghaṭādiniṣṭhaḥ, tajjanakavyāpārastvātmanaḥsaṃyogātmako devadattaniṣṭha iti kṛñaḥ svajanakavyāpāravyadhikaraṇaphalavācakatvāditi| niruktasakarmakabhinnatvaṃ cākarmakatvam| tacca karotau vaktumaśakyamiti kṛño'karmakatāpattirasaṃgatetyāhaayaṃ bhāva iti| phalamātramiti|
analyzed: tathā hi yatnaḥ phalatā avacchedaka viṣayatā saṃbandhena ghaṭa ādi niṣṭhaḥ tad janaka vyāpāraḥ tu ātmanaḥ saṃyoga ātmakaḥ devadatta niṣṭhaḥ iti kṛñaḥ sva janaka vyāpāra vyadhikaraṇa phala vācaka tvāt iti nirukta sakarmaka bhinna tvam ca akarmaka tvam tat ca karotau vaktum aśakyam iti kṛñaḥ ukarmaka tā āpattiḥ asaṃgatā iti āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti phala mātram iti

original: mātrapadena vyāpārasya vyāvṛttau satyāṃ karotītyādau yatnapratīteḥ phalasthānīyaḥ kevalayatnaḥ karotervācyo'rtha ityaṅgīkāryam| tathā ca yativaditi| yathā yatnārthako yatidhāturakarmakatvena suprasiddhastathā kṛño'pyakarmakatvāpattiḥ| yatikṛñorubhayorapi phalasthānīyayatnavācitvasya samānatvāt|

original: tataśaaca na pūrvoktaṃ svajanakavyāpāretyādisakarmakatvaṃ vaktumucitamiti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ tvasmadrītyā svārthaphaletyādimūloktameva sakarmakatvaṃ svīkāryam|

original: anyathā siddhāntamanādṛtya svoktasakarmakatvasyaiva svīkāre yatidhātoryatnatyāpi phalatāvacchedakaviṣayatāsaṃbandhena ghaṭādiniṣṭhatvatsvajanakamanaḥsaṃyogādivyāpārānīdhakaraṇavṛcitvena sakarmakatvāpattiḥ| tataśca siddhāntasaṃmataṃ sakarmakatvaṃ kṛño yatnamātravācitve na saṃbhavatītyakarmakatāpattirduṣpariharaiveti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvamevākarmakatvavyavahārakāraṇaṃ, tacca karotau nāstīti kathamakarmakatvāpattirityata āhauktarītyeti| siddhāntoktasakarmakadhātubhinnadhātutvamakarmakatvamityārthikoktarītyetyarthaḥ|

original: anyathā vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyā dhātvavācyatve phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvarūpākarmakatvāpatterasaṃbhavaduktikatvāpattyā yaterapyakarmakatvānāpatteḥ| phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca kṛñaḥ phalastānīyatvena yatno'rtho neṣṭa ityarthaḥ|
