original: nanu sarvasyāpi dhātorvyāpārāvācakatve dhātumātrasyākarmakatvasaṃbhavātkṛña iti viśiṣyoktiranucitetyāhakṛña iti| kṛñ‌padamajahallakṣaṇayā śakyalakṣyayāvaddhātusaṃgrāhakamityarthaḥ| akarmakateti| dhātumātrasya phalamātravācakatve vyāpārāvācakatvena sarveṣāmapyakarmakatā syāt| sakarmakateti|
analyzed: nanu sarvasya api dhātoḥ vyāpāra avācaka tve dhātu mātrasya akarmaka tva saṃbhavāt kṛñaḥ iti viśiṣya uktiḥ anucitā iti āha kṛñaḥ iti kṛñ padam ajahat lakṣaṇayā śakya lakṣya yāvat dhātu saṃgrāhakam iti arthaḥ akarmaka tā iti dhātu mātrasya phala mātra vācaka tve vyāpāra avācaka tvena sarveṣām api akarmaka tā syāt sakarmaka tā iti

original: phalavācakatvaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ cetsarveṣāmeva sakarmakatā syādityartha| tathā ca sakarmakākarmakavibhāgoccheda iti dhātumātrasya kevalaphalavācitvaṃ na yuktaṃ kiṃtu vyāpāravācitvamapyaṅgīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ| atha prakārāntareṇa kṛño'karmakatetimūlamavatārayituṃ bhūmikāmāracayatiathavetyādi| prasādhyeti|
analyzed: phala vācaka tvam sakarmaka tvam ced sarveṣām eva sakarmaka tā syāt iti artha tathā ca sakarmaka akarmaka vibhāga ucchedaḥ iti dhātu mātrasya kevala phala vāci tvam na yuktam kiṃtu vyāpāra vāci tvam api aṅgīkāryam iti bhāvaḥ atha prakāra antareṇa bhūmikām āracayati athavā ityādi prasādhya iti

original: vyāpāro bhāvaneti pūrvardhasya vivaraṇadvārā sarvasyāpi dhātorvyāpāravācitvāvaśyakatvaṃ prasādhyetyarthaḥ| taditi| phalāṃśasyāpi sarvadātuvācyatvāvaśyakatvaṃ pratipādayan jānātikarotītyādau savi jñānecchākṛtyarthakadhātāvityarthaḥ|ṣayārthakadhātau phalāṃśavarjaṃ kevalajñānādikriyāmātravācitvaṃ yaduktaṃ naiyāyikaistad‌dūṣayitumāhakṛña iti|
analyzed: vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā iti pūrva ṛdhasya vivaraṇa dvārā sarvasya api dhātoḥ vyāpāra vāci tva āvaśyakatvam prasādhya iti arthaḥ tat iti phala aṃśasya api sarva dātu vācya tva āvaśyakatvam pratipādayan jānāti karoti ityādau jñāna icchā kṛti arthaka dhātau iti arthaḥ saya arthaka dhātau phala aṃśa varjam kevala jñāna ādi kriyā mātra vāci tvam yat uktam naiyāyikaiḥ tat dūṣayitum āha kṛñaḥ iti

original: mātrapadaṃ phalavyāvṛttyartham| sakarmakāṇāṃ prāyaḥ phalavyāpāraitadubhayārthakatvam| jānātikarotyādīnāṃ tu jñānayatnādivyāpārārthakatvam| akarmakāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ na phalavācakatvaṃ, phalasya tato'nanubhavāt| kiṃtu vyāpāramātravācakatvameveti naiyāyikaiḥ kaiścidabhyupagatamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: mātra padam phala vyāvṛtti artham sakarmakāṇām prāyas phala vyāpāra etad ubhaya arthaka tvam jānāti karoti ādīnām tu jñāna yatna ādi vyāpāra arthaka tvam akarmakāṇām sarveṣām na phala vācaka tvam phalasya tatas ananubhavāt kiṃtu vyāpāra mātra vācaka tvam eva iti naiyāyikaiḥ kaiścid abhyupagatam iti arthaḥ

original: nanūktarītyā phalāvācakatve'pi phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvarūpaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ karotyāderapi saṃbhavatyeva| utpattyādirūpaphalavyadhikaraṇayatnādyabhinnavyāpāravācitvāt| tathā ca kathaṃ kṛño'karmakatvamityāśaṅkāṃ samādātumāhaayaṃ bhāva iti| dhātvartha iti|
analyzed: nanu ukta rītyā phala avācaka tve pi phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tva rūpam sakarmakatvam karoti ādeḥ api saṃbhavati eva utpatti ādi rūpa phala vyadhikaraṇa yatna ādi abhinna vyāpāra vāci tvāt tathā ca katham kṛñaḥ ukarmakatvam iti āśaṅkām samādātum āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti dhātvarthaḥ iti

original: sarvasyāpi dhātoryatkiṃcitphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitve'pi phalasya sarvatraiva dhātvarthatvābhāvena svārthaphaletyādisiddhāntoktasakarmakatvoccheda ityarthaḥ| samanantaroktaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ tu nā''śrayituṃ śakyaṃ, yatisyandyāderapi dhātvavācyayatkiṃcitphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvenātivyāptatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sarvasya api dhātoḥ yat kiṃcid phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vāci tve pi phalasya sarvatra eva dhātvartha tva abhāvena svārtha phala ityādi siddhānta ukta sakarmaka tva ucchedaḥ iti arthaḥ samanantara uktam sakarmaka tvam tu nā āśrayitum śakyam yati syandi ādeḥ api dhātu avācya yat kiṃcid phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tvena ativyāpta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu sakarmakatvavyavahārānurodhena pacyāderastu phalāṃśo'pi vācyaḥ| kṛñādestu yatnādirūpavyāpāramātravācitvameva| tatra sakarmakatvavyavahārastu karmānvitārthavācakatvanibandhano gauṇaḥ|
analyzed: nanu sakarmaka tva vyavahāra anurodhena paci ādeḥ astu phala aṃśaḥ api vācyaḥ kṛñ ādeḥ tu yatna ādi rūpa vyāpāra mātra vācitvam eva tatra sakarmaka tva vyavahāraḥ tu karma anvita artha vācakatva nibandhanaḥ gauṇaḥ

original: evaṃ ca tatra dhātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpamukhyakarmatvavirahe'pi viṣayatvarūpaṃ lākṣaṇikameva karmatvaṃ saṃbhavedityāśaṅkāmanusaṃdhāyā''hana ca kṛñādāvityādi yuktamityantam| bhāktatve'pīti| lākṣaṇikatve'pītyarthaḥ| asaṃbhavāditi| mukhye saṃbhavati tatraiva kāryasaṃpratyayo natu gauṇa iti nyāyādrauṇakamaṃṇi lakārāsaṃbhava ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca tatra dhātvartha tā avacchedaka phala śāli tva rūpa mukhya karmatva virahe api viṣaya tva rūpam lākṣaṇikam eva karmatvam saṃbhavet iti āśaṅkām anusaṃdhāya āha na ca kṛñ ādau ityādi yuktam ityantam bhākta tve api iti lākṣaṇika tve api iti arthaḥ asaṃbhavāt iti mukhye saṃbhavati tatra eva kārya saṃpratyayaḥ na tu gauṇe iti nyāyāt lakāra asaṃbhavaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: etadeva dṛṣṭāntena spaṣṭayatina hīti| gaṅgāpadasya tīre lakṣaṇānibandhanatve'pi na hi tenārthena snānapānādikāryaṃ nirvartayituṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ| utpattyanukūlayatnavācitve karoternoktadoṣaḥ samāyātītyāhaevaṃ ceti| yatnamātramiti| utpattirūpaphalavyudāsaḥ|
analyzed: etat eva dṛṣṭāntena spaṣṭayati na hi iti gaṅgā padasya tīre lakṣaṇā nibandhana tve pi na hi tena arthena snāna pāna ādi kāryam nirvartayitum śakyate iti arthaḥ utpatti anukūla yatna vāci tve karoteḥ na ukta doṣaḥ samāyāti iti āha evam ca iti yatna mātram iti utpatti rūpa phala vyudāsaḥ

original: evaṃ ca naiyāyikābhimatayatnamātravācitvaṃ niṣidhyate, utpattirūpaphalānukūlayatnārthakatvaṃ tu svābhīṣṭameveti bhāvaḥ|| 5 ||
analyzed: evam ca naiyāyika abhimata yatna mātra vācitvam niṣidhyate utpatti rūpa phala anukūla yatna arthaka tvam tu sva abhīṣṭam eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: ata eveti| kṛño ynamātrārthakatvasyāniṣṭatvādavetyarthaḥ| nanu tarhi kṛñaḥ kīdṛśārthakatvamiṣyate tadāhakiṃ tūtpādanamiti| utpādanapadasyotpattyanukūlayatnādyarthakatvenotpattirūpaphalasahitaṃ yatnādi kṛño'rtho'bhimata ityarthaḥ| yatnādītyādiśabdena yatnabhinnavyāpārasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ| bījādinā'ṅkuraḥ kṛta ityādyanurodhāt|
analyzed: atas eva iti kṛñaḥ yna mātra arthaka tvasya aniṣṭa tvāt ava iti arthaḥ nanu tarhi kṛñaḥ kīdṛśa arthaka tvam iṣyate tat āha kim tu utpādanam iti utpādana padasya utpatti anukūla yatna ādi arthaka tvena utpatti rūpa phala sahitam yatna ādi kṛñaḥ arthaḥ abhimataḥ iti arthaḥ yatna ādi iti ādi śabdena yatna bhinna vyāpārasya api saṃgrahaḥ bīja ādinā aṅkuraḥ kṛtaḥ ityādi anurodhāt

original: bījādāvacatane yatnasya bādāttattyāge'pi śaktyaiva yatnabhinnavyāpārapratītiriti bhāvaḥ| vācyatva iti| phalasya dhātuvācyatvāvaśyakatva ityarthaḥ| yuktyantaramiti| anyā yuktiḥ| mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsa iti bhāvaḥ| tadeva yuktyantaraṃ spaṣṭayatiata ityādinā|
analyzed: bīja ādau acatane yatnasya bādāt tad tyāge api śaktyā eva yatna bhinna vyāpāra pratītiḥ iti bhāvaḥ vācyatve iti phalasya dhātu vācyatva āvaśyakatve iti arthaḥ yukti antaram iti anyā yuktiḥ mayūra vyaṃsaka ādi tvāt samāsaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tat eva yukti antaram spaṣṭayati atas ityādinā

original: yasmātkṛño vyāpārasthānikayatnamātramartho na, kiṃtūtpattyanukūlayatnādirevetyata ityarthaḥ| karmavatsyāditi| tathā ca phalasyotpattirūpasya karmasthatayā karmavatkarmaṇeti karmavadbhāvātkarmakartari kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyādau yagādayo'pyupapadyanta ityaparamanukūlamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yasmāt kṛñaḥ vyāpāra sthānika yatna mātram arthaḥ na kiṃtu utpatti anukūla yatna ādiḥ eva iti atas iti arthaḥ karma vat syāt iti tathā ca phalasya utpatti rūpasya karma stha tayā karmavat karmaṇā iti karmavat bhāvāt karma kartari kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva ityādau yak ādayaḥ api upapadyante iti aparam anukūlam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi vyāpārasthānikayatnamātramevārthaḥ syāttadā karmavadbhāvo na syāt| vyāpārasthānikayatnasya ghaṭādau bādhāt| phalasyotpattirūpasya svīkāre tu pacyate odanaḥ svayamevetivat kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyupapadyata ityāśayaḥ| sūtraṃ lakṣyata iti| karmavatpadaghaṭitakarmavatkarmaṇetisūtravihitaṃ lakṣyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadi vyāpāra sthānika yatna mātram eva arthaḥ syāt tadā karmavat bhāvaḥ na syāt vyāpāra sthānika yatnasya ghaṭa ādau bādhāt phalasya utpatti rūpasya svīkāre tu pacyate odanaḥ svayam eva iti vat kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti upapadyate iti āśayaḥ sūtram lakṣyate iti karmavat pada ghaṭita karmavat karmaṇā iti sūtra vihitam lakṣyate iti arthaḥ

original: ata eva sūtravihitaṃ yagādītyanvaya upapadyate| sūtrasyaiva lakṣayatve tasya yagādityanenānvayo na syāt| kiṃtu sūtraṃ yagadītyananvitamevāvatiṣṭheteti bhāvaḥ| atredaṃ bodhyamkāryātideśapakṣe sākṣādeva karmavatkarmaṇetisūtravihitatvaṃ yagāderasti, śāstrātideśapakṣe tu paramparayeti| tanna syāditi|
analyzed: atas eva sūtra vihitam yak ādi iti anvayaḥ upapadyate sūtrasya eva tasya yak āt iti anena anvayaḥ na syāt kiṃtu sūtram yak ādi iti ananvitam eva avatiṣṭheta iti bhāvaḥ atra idam bodhyam kārya atideśa pakṣe sākṣāt eva karmavat karmaṇā iti sūtra vihita tvam yak ādeḥ asti śāstra atideśa pakṣe tu paramparayā iti tat na syāt iti

original: karmasthayā kriyayā tulyā kriyā phalarūpā phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpārarūpā vā yatra tādṛśaḥ kartā karmavadbavatītyarthakasya karmavatkarmaṇetisūtrasyāprāpteḥ, kṛñaḥ phalavācakatvābhāvāt, tadarthayatnasya tu ghaṭādāvacetane bādhenātyantāsattvādityarthaḥ| nanu tatra karmavadbhāvābhāve iṣṭāpattireveti cenna|
analyzed: karma sthayā kriyayā tulyā kriyā phala rūpā phala samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra rūpā vā yatra tādṛśaḥ kartā karmavat bavati iti arthakasya karmavat karmaṇā iti sūtrasya aprāpteḥ kṛñaḥ phala vācaka tva abhāvāt tad artha yatnasya tu ghaṭa ādau acetane bādhena atyanta asattvāt iti arthaḥ nanu tatra karmavat bhāva abhāve iṣṭa āpattiḥ eva iti ced na

original: karmavatkarmaṇotisūtre kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti karmavadbhāvodāharaṇaparabhāṣyavirodhāpatteḥ| nanu ghaṭādau karmaṇi samavāyasaṃbandhena yatnasyāsattve'pi viṣayatāsaṃbandhena yatnasya ghaṭaniṣṭhatvamabādhitameva|
analyzed: karmavat karmaṇā iti sūtre kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti karmavat bhāva udāharaṇa para bhāṣya virodha āpatteḥ nanu ghaṭa ādau karmaṇi samavāya saṃbandhena yatnasya asattve pi viṣayatā saṃbandhena yatnasya ghaṭa niṣṭhatvam abādhitam eva

original: ata eva ghaṭaṃ jānātītyatra phalatāvacchedakaviṣayatāsaṃbandhena jñānasya ghaṭaniṣṭhatvena karmatvavadyantasyāpi viṣayatāsaṃbandhena ghaṭaniṣṭhatayā tasya karmatvād ghaṭaṃ karotīti prayoga upapadyate| na caivaṃ ghaṭaṃ yatata ityapi syāditi vācyam|
analyzed: atas eva ghaṭam jānāti iti atra phalatā avacchedaka viṣayatā saṃbandhena jñānasya ghaṭa niṣṭhatvena karma tva vat yantasya api viṣayatā saṃbandhena ghaṭa niṣṭhatayā tasya karmatvāt ghaṭam karoti iti prayogaḥ upapadyate na ca evam ghaṭam yatate iti api syāt iti vācyam

original: yatidātupasthitayatnasya viṣayatayā phalatvavyavahārābhāvena viṣayatāyāḥ phalatāvacchedakatvānaṅgīkārāt| evaṃ ca kṛñaḥ kevalayatnamātrārthakatve'pi kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti bhāṣyoktaṃ karmavadbhāvodāharaṇamupapannameveti cenna| dṛśaayate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyādiprayogāpatterityāśayenā''hayathā dṛśyate ghaṭa iti| ghaṭāvṛttitbāditi|
analyzed: yati dātṛ upasthita yatnasya viṣayatayā phalatva vyavahāra abhāvena viṣayatāyāḥ phalatā avacchedaka tva anaṅgīkārāt evam ca kṛñaḥ kevala yatna mātra arthaka tve pi kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam evā iti bhāṣya uktam karmavat bhāva udāharaṇam upapannam eva iti ced na ghaṭaḥ svayam evā ityādi prayoga āpatteḥ iti āśayena āha yathā dṛśyate ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭa avṛtti tbāt iti

original: darśanasya=jñānasya ghaṭamātraniṣṭhatvābhāvena karmasthakriyakatvābhāvādyathā dṛśyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti karmavadbhāvo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā kṛñaḥ kevalayatnamātrārthakatve ghaṭaṃ karotītyāderupapādane'pi yatnasyāpi ghaṭamātraniṣṭhatvābhāvena karmasthakriyakatvābhāvātkriyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti karmavadbhāvo na syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: darśanasya ajñānasya ghaṭa mātra niṣṭha tva abhāvena karma stha kriyaka tva abhāvāt yathā dṛśyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti karmavat bhāvaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā kṛñaḥ kevala yatna mātra arthaka tve ghaṭam karoti ityādeḥ upapādane api yatnasya api ghaṭa mātra niṣṭha tva abhāvena karma stha kriyaka tva abhāvāt kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti karmavat bhāvaḥ na syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ`karmavatkarmaṇā tulyakriyaḥ' iti hi yo'yaṃ karmavadbhāva uktaḥ sa tu karmasthakriyakāṇāmeva bhavati, na tu kartṛstakriyakāṇāmiti siddhāntaḥ| yatra karmamātravṛtti phalaṃ sa karmasthakriyakaḥ| yathā pacati bhinattītyādau| na hi viklittidvidhābhavanādikaṃ kathamapi kartṛgataṃ bhavatīti|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ karmavat karmaṇā tulya kriyaḥ iti hi yaḥ ayam karmavat bhāvaḥ uktaḥ sa tu karma sthakriyakāṇām eva bhavati na tu kartṛ sta kriyakāṇām iti siddhāntaḥ yatra karma mātra vṛtti phalam sa karma sthakriyakaḥ yathā pacati bhinatti ityādau na hi viklitti dvidhābhavana ādikam katham api kartṛ gatam bhavati iti

original: yatra tu kartṛkarmobhayavṛtti phalaṃ bhavati sa kartṛsthakriyakaḥ| yathā paśyati ghaṭaṃ, gacchati grāmaṃ, ityādau| paśyateścākṣuṣajñānarūpasya phalasya samavāyaviṣayatosaṃbandhābhyāṃ kartṛkarmobhayaniṣṭhatvāt| gacchateḥ purodeśasaṃyogarūpasya phalasya ca samavāyasaṃbandhena kartṛkarmobhayaniṣṭhatvāt|
analyzed: yatra tu kartṛ karma ubhaya vṛtti phalam bhavati sa kartṛ sthakriyakaḥ yathā paśyati ghaṭam gacchati grāmam ityādau paśyateḥ cākṣuṣa jñāna rūpasya phalasya samavāya viṣaya tā saṃbandhābhyām kartṛ karma ubhaya niṣṭha tvāt gacchateḥ puras deśa saṃyoga rūpasya phalasya ca samavāya saṃbandhena kartṛ karma ubhaya niṣṭha tvāt

original: evaṃ hāsasyāpi cittavṛttiviśeṣasya samavāyaviṣayatāsaṃbandhābyāmubhayaniṣṭhatvaṃ bodhyam| evaṃ ca dṛśeḥ phalasya jñānasyobhayaniṣṭhatvena kartṛsthakriyatvātkarmasthakriyatvābhāvena yathā dṛṣṭānte karmavadbhāvo na prāpnoti tathā dārṣṭāntike'pi yatnasya samavāyaviṣayatāsaṃbandhābhyāmubhayaniṣṭhatvena kartṛsthakriyakatvātkarmasthākriyakatvābhāvena
analyzed: evam hāsasya api citta vṛtti viśeṣasya samavāya viṣayatā saṃbandha ābyām ubhaya niṣṭhatvam bodhyam evam ca dṛśeḥ phalasya jñānasya ubhaya niṣṭhatvena kartṛ stha kriyatvāt karma stha kriyatva abhāvena yathā dṛṣṭānte karma vat bhāvaḥ na prāpnoti tathā dārṣṭāntike api yatnasya samavāya viṣayatā saṃbandhābhyām ubhaya niṣṭhatvena kartṛ stha kriyakatvāt karma stha akriyakatva abhāvena

original: karmavadbhāvo naiva prāpnuyāditi paramārthaḥ| adhikamagre vakṣyate|| 6 ||
analyzed: karmavat bhāvaḥ na eva prāpnuyāt iti paramārthaḥ adhikam agre vakṣyate

original: atiprasaṅgamudbhāvya nirākartuṃ bhūmikāmāracayatievamiti| svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇetyādereva sakarmakatvavyavahāraprayojakatayā siddhāntasaṃmatatvena kriyate dhaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra karmavadbhāvasiddhyarthaṃ karoterutpattirūpaphalasahitayatnavācitvāṅgīkāre ityarthaḥ| kṛñāderiti| ādipadena pacyādisaṃgrahaḥ| jānātītyāderapīti|
analyzed: atiprasaṅgam udbhāvya nirākartum bhūmikām āracayati evam iti svārtha phala vyadhikaraṇa ityādeḥ eva sakarmaka tva vyavahāra prayojakatayā siddhānta saṃmata tvena kriyate dhaṭaḥ svayam eva iti atra karmavat bhāva siddhi artham karoteḥ utpatti rūpa phala sahita yatna vāci tva aṅgīkāre iti arthaḥ kṛñ ādeḥ iti ādi padena paci ādi saṃgrahaḥ jānāti ityādeḥ api iti

original: ādipadena gamyādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ| viṣayāvacchinnāvaraṇabhaṅgādiphaleti avacchedakatāsaṃbandhena viṣayaniṣṭhāvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphaletyarthaḥ| āvaraṇabhaṅgādītyādipadena saṃyogādigrahaṇam| anyatheti| uktavaiparītye| āvaraṇabhaṅgādiphalāvācakatve, ityarthaḥ| anāpatteriti|
analyzed: ādi padena gamya ādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ viṣaya avacchinna āvaraṇa bhaṅga ādi phala iti avacchedakatā saṃbandhena viṣaya niṣṭha āvaraṇa bhaṅga rūpa phala iti arthaḥ āvaraṇa bhaṅga ādi ityādi padena saṃyoga ādi grahaṇam anyathā iti ukta vaiparītye āvaraṇa bhaṅga ādi phala avācaka tve iti arthaḥ anāpatteḥ iti

original: svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇetyādeḥ sakarmarakatvavyavahāraprayojakasya tatrāvidyamānatvādityarthaḥ| tathāceti| āvaraṇabhaṅgādiphalavācakatve satītyarthaḥ| kiṃ na syāditi| kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra yathā ghaṭa utpattirūpaphalāśrayastathā''varaṇabhaṅgarūpaphalāśrayo'pi bhavatītyato jñāyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti kiṃ na syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: svārtha phala vyadhikaraṇa ityādeḥ sakarmarakatva vyavahāra prayojakasya tatra avidyamānatvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca iti āvaraṇa bhaṅga ādi phala vācakatve sati iti arthaḥ kim na syāt iti kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti atra yathā ghaṭaḥ utpatti rūpa phala āśrayaḥ tathā āvaraṇa bhaṅga rūpa phala āśrayaḥ api bhavati iti atas jñāyate ghaṭaḥ svayam eva iti kim na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca svārthaphaletyādirūpaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ siddhāntasaṃmatamapi svīkartumayogyaṃ bhavatīti gūḍhābhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ ca gamyate grāmaḥ svayamevetyādiprayogāpattirūpo doṣo'pītyāśaṅkyā''ha
analyzed: tathā ca svārtha phala ityādi rūpam sakarmaka tvam siddhānta saṃmatam api svīkartum ayogyam bhavati iti gūḍha abhiprāyaḥ kim ca gamyate grāmaḥ svayam eva ityādi prayoga āpatti rūpaḥ doṣaḥ api iti āśaṅkya āha

original: nirvartye cetyādi| nanu nirvartyavikāryakarmaṇoḥ karmavadbhāvo bhavati na prāpyakarmaṇītyatra kiṃ bījamityata āhasiddhānto'treti| karmavatkarmaṇeti sūtre bhāṣya ityarthaḥ| tatra hi dhātorekāca ityato dhātorityanuvartate|
analyzed: nirvartye ca ityādi nanu nirvartya vikārya karmaṇoḥ karmavat bhāvaḥ bhavati na prāpya karmaṇi iti atra kim bījam iti atas āha siddhānta utra iti karma vat karmaṇā iti sūtre bhāṣye iti arthaḥ tatra hi dhātoḥ eka a caḥ iti atas dhātoḥ iti anuvartate

original: dhātorvācyayā kriyayā tulyakriya ityarthātkaraṇatvādyavasthāyāṃ vastutaḥ sato'pyasisthālyorvyāpārasya dhātuvācyatvābhāvādevāsiśchinatti, sthālī pacatītyādau karaṇādhikaraṇābhyāṃ tulyakriye kartari doṣānatiprasakteratiricyamānaṃ karmaṇeti padaṃ karmasthakriyāṃ lakṣayatīti siddhānto vyavasthāpita ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: dhātoḥ vācyayā kriyayā tulya kriyaḥ iti arthāt karaṇa tva ādi avasthāyām vastutas sataḥ upi asi sthālyoḥ vyāpārasya dhātu vācya tva abhāvāt eva asiḥ chinatti sthālī pacati ityādau karaṇa adhikaraṇābhyām tulya kriye kartari doṣa anatiprasakteḥ atiricyamānam karmaṇā iti padam karma stha kriyām lakṣayati iti siddhāntaḥ vyavasthāpitaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: karmasthakriyakatvaṃ ca prāpyabhinnakarmaṇyeva saṃbhavatīti prāpyabhinnakarmasvarūpaṃ darśayitumāhaīpsitamiti| karturīpsitatamaṃ karma tridhetyarthaḥ| tenepsitabhinnakarmaṇa ādhikye'pi na doṣaḥ| prāpyatvaṃ ceti| ādyayorlakṣaṇe subarthanirṇaye granthakṛdeva vakṣyati| kriyākṛtaviśeṣeti| kriyākṛtaviśeṣeṇa tadviśiṣṭatvenānupalabhyamānatvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: karma sthakriyaka tvam ca prāpya bhinna karmaṇi eva saṃbhavati iti prāpya bhinna karma svarūpam darśayitum āha īpsitam iti kartuḥ īpsitatamam karma tridhā iti arthaḥ tena īpsita bhinna karmaṇaḥ ādhikye api na doṣaḥ prāpya tvam ca iti ādyayoḥ lakṣaṇe subartha nirṇaye granthakṛt eva vakṣyati kriyā kṛta viśeṣa iti kriyā kṛta viśeṣeṇa tad viśiṣṭa tvena anupalabhyamāna tvam iti arthaḥ

original: yadvā anupalabhyamānaḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣo yatreti bahuvrīhiḥ| rājadantāditvādviśeṣaṇasya paranipātaḥ| tathā ca yaddhātukarmaṇi prāyaḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣo naivopalabyate taddhātukarmaprāpyaṃ karmeti phalitam| vakṣyata iti| kriyākṛtaviśeṣāṇāmityādivākyapadīyenetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yat vā anupalabhyamānaḥ kriyā kṛta viśeṣaḥ yatra iti bahuvrīhiḥ rājadanta ādi tvāt viśeṣaṇasya para nipātaḥ tathā ca yad dhātu karmaṇi prāyas kriyā kṛta viśeṣaḥ na eva upalabyate tad dhātu karma prāpyam karma iti phalitam vakṣyate iti kriyā kṛta viśeṣāṇām ityādi vākyapadīyena iti arthaḥ

original: karmasthaviśepotpādakakriyārthakatvarūpaṃ karmasthakriyakatvaṃ karmavadbhāvaprayojakamiti spaṣṭayituṃ tadanvayaṃ tad‌vyatirekaṃ ca pratipādayatinahītyādinā| yatra karmadarśanasamasamayaṃ karmagataḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣaḥ kaścit jñātuṃ śakyate tādṛśaṃ karma nirvartyaṃ vikāryaṃ vā bhavati| ghaṭaṃ karotītyādau svarūpalābhātmako viśeṣaḥ|
analyzed: karma stha viśepa utpādaka kriyā arthaka tva rūpam karma stha kriyaka tvam karmavat bhāva prayojakam iti spaṣṭayitum tad anvayam tad vyatirekam ca pratipādayati nahi ityādinā yatra karma darśana sama samayam karma gataḥ kriyā kṛta viśeṣaḥ kaścid jñātum śakyate tādṛśam karma nirvartyam vikāryam vā bhavati ghaṭam karoti ityādau svarūpa lābha ātmakaḥ viśeṣaḥ

original: somaṃ sunotītyādau tu cūrṇībhāvarūpo viśeṣa iti jñeyam| yatra tu karmadarśanena karmabhagataḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣaḥ kaścidapi naivāvagantuṃ śakyastatprāpyaṃ karmeti ata uktaṃkenacidadṛṣṭaḥ, kenacidgata iti karmadarśanena jñātuṃ sarvathā'śakyamiti|
analyzed: somam sunoti ityādau tu cūrṇībhāva rūpaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti jñeyam yatra tu karma darśanena karma bhagataḥ kriyā kṛta viśeṣaḥ kaścid api na eva avagantum śakyaḥ tad prāpyam karma iti atas uktam kenacid adṛṣṭaḥ kenacid gataḥ iti karma darśanena jñātum sarvathā aśakyam iti

original: tadevamatretthamanvayavyatirekaprayogaḥyatra karmaṇi kriyākṛtaviśeṣo dṛśyate tatra karmavadbhāvaḥ, yatra tu naiva dṛśyate na tatra karmavadbhāva iti| tadāhaghaṭāderdṛśyādāviti| ghaṭāderityādiśabdena grāmasya saṃgrahaḥ| dṛśyādāvityādiśabdena gameḥ parigrahaḥ|
analyzed: tat evam atra ittham anvaya vyatireka prayogaḥ yatra karmaṇi kriyā kṛta viśeṣaḥ dṛśyate tatra karmavat bhāvaḥ yatra tu na eva dṛśyate na tatra karmavat bhāvaḥ iti tat āha ghaṭa ādeḥ dṛśya ādau iti ghaṭa ādeḥ iti ādi śabdena grāmasya saṃgrahaḥ dṛśya ādau iti ādi śabdena gameḥ parigrahaḥ

original: tathā ca dṛśadhātvarthanirūpitaghaṭarūpakarmaṇaḥ, gamadhātvarthanirūpitagrāmātprakakarmaṇaśca prāpyakarmatvādityarthaḥ| noktātiprasaṅga iti| na karmavadbhāvāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| dhātoḥ phalavācakatvasādhakamanyeṣāṃ yuktyantaramāhadhātunāmiti| phalāvācakatve dhātūnāṃ kevalavyāpāravācakatā paryavasyati|
analyzed: tathā ca dṛśa dhātvartha nirūpita ghaṭa rūpa karmaṇaḥ gama dhātvartha nirūpita grāmātpraka karmaṇaḥ ca prāpya karma tvāt iti arthaḥ na ukta atiprasaṅgaḥ iti na karmavat bhāva āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ dhātoḥ phala vācaka tva sādhakam anyeṣām yukti antaram āha dhātunām iti phala avācaka tve dhātūnām kevala vyāpāra vācakatā paryavasyati

original: saṃyogarūpaphalabhāne gamadhātoḥ, vibhāgarūpaphalabhāne ca tyajadhātoḥ samabhivyāhārasya niyāmakatvācca grāmaṃ gaclatītyatra na vibāgabodhaprasaṅgaḥ| nāpi vṛkṣaṃ tyajatītyatra saṃyogabodhātiprasaṅgaśca| tyajigamyoriti| tādṛśārthakayāvaddhātūpalakṣaṇam| paryāyatāpattiḥ, kriyāvācakatvāviśeṣāditi| tyajigamyorakajātīyakriyāvācakatvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: saṃyoga rūpa phala bhāne gama dhātoḥ vibhāga rūpa phala bhāne ca tyaja dhātoḥ samabhivyāhārasya niyāmaka tvāt ca grāmam gaclati iti atra na vibāga bodha prasaṅgaḥ na api vṛkṣam tyajati iti atra saṃyoga bodha atiprasaṅgaḥ ca tyaji gamyoḥ iti tādṛśa arthaka yāvat dhātu upalakṣaṇam paryāya tā āpattiḥ kriyā vācaka tva aviśeṣāt iti tyaji gamyoḥ aka jātīya kriyā vācaka tva aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: śakyatāvacchedakaikatve sati vibhinna śaktatāvacchedakatvasyaiva paryāyatāpadavācyatvādīti bhāvaḥ| ekasyā eva kriyāyāḥ saṃyogavibhāgajanakatvāttyajigamyoḥ paryāyatāpattiriti yāvat| tathā ca gacchati tyajatītyanayoraviśeṣāpattiḥ| grāmaṃ gacchatītyarthe tyajatīti prayogasya, vṛkṣaṃ tyajītyarthe gacchatīti prayogasya cā''pattirityarthaḥ|
analyzed: śakyatā avacchedaka ekatve sati vibhinna śaktatā avacchedaka tvasya eva paryāyatā pada vācya tva ādi iti bhāvaḥ ekasyāḥ eva kriyāyāḥ saṃyoga vibhāga janaka tvāt tyaji gamyoḥ paryāyatā āpattiḥ iti yāvat tathā ca gacchati tyajati iti anayoḥ aviśeṣa āpattiḥ grāmam gacchati iti arthe tyajati iti prayogasya vṛkṣam tyaji iti arthe gacchati iti prayogasya ca āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu tyajigamyoranukrameṇa vibhāgasaṃyogopalakṣitavyāpārārthakatvamaṅgīkriyate| tataśca na pūrvokto'viśeṣāpattirūpo doṣo'ta āhaphalasyopalakṣaṇatve'pīti| upalakṣaṇatvaṃ nāma tatpadajanyabodhaviṣayatvena śaktyaviṣayatvam| ekakriyāyā evetyādijanakatvāditi|
analyzed: nanu tyaji gamyoḥ anukrameṇa vibhāga saṃyoga upalakṣita vyāpāra arthaka tvam aṅgīkriyate tatas ca na pūrva uktaḥ viśeṣa āpatti rūpaḥ doṣaḥ uta āha phalasya upalakṣaṇa tve pi iti upalakṣaṇa tvam nāma tad pada janya bodha viṣayatvena śakti aviṣayatvam eka kriyāyāḥ eva ityādi janakatvāt iti

original: tathā ca saṃyogavibhāgayorgamityajidhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvasya samānatvād gamidhātvarthavyāpāre saṃyoga evopalakṣaṇaṃ na vibhāgaḥ, tathā tyajidhātvarthavyāpāre vibhāga evopalakṣaṇaṃ na saṃyoga ityatra vinigamakābhāvādubhayorapyubhayatra vyāpāre upalakṣaṇatvopagame niruktāpattirduṣpariharaiveti phale'pi dhātoḥ śaktiśvaśyamabyupagantavyeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ gami tyaji dhātvartha vyāpāra janya tvasya samāna tvāt gami dhātvartha vyāpāre saṃyogaḥ eva upalakṣaṇam na vibhāgaḥ tathā tyaji dhātvartha vyāpāre vibhāgaḥ eva upalakṣaṇam na saṃyogaḥ iti atra vinigamaka abhāvāt ubhayoḥ api ubhayatra vyāpāre upalakṣaṇa tva upagame nirukta āpattiḥ duṣpariharā eva iti phale api dhātoḥ śaktiḥ śvaśyam abyupagantavyā iti bhāvaḥ

original: dhātoḥ phalavācakatvavādamupasaṃharannāhatasmāditi| uktayuktibhyaḥ sakarmakadhātūnāṃ phalavācitvamavaśyameṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| nirvivādamiti| svārthaphalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvarūpākarmakatvasya dhātoḥ phalavācitvābhyupagamamantarā'saṃbhavādityarthaḥ| bhū sattāyāmiti|
analyzed: dhātoḥ phala vācaka tva vādam upasaṃharan āha tasmāt iti ukta yuktibhyaḥ sakarmaka dhātūnām phala vāci tvam avaśyam eṣṭavyam iti arthaḥ nirvivādam iti svārtha phala samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra vāci tva rūpa akarmaka tvasya dhātoḥ phala vāci tva abhyupagamam antara asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ sattāyām iti

original: bhvādigaṇe phalasyaiva nirdeśādbhavatītyāditaḥ sattādibodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvāccetyarthaḥ| ata eveti| sakaladhātūnāṃ phalavācakatvādevetyarthaḥ| saṃgacchata iti|
analyzed: bhvādi gaṇe phalasya eva nirdeśāt bhavati ityāditaḥ sattā ādi bodhasya sarva anubhava siddha tvāt ca iti arthaḥ atas eva iti sakala dhātūnām phala vācaka tvāt eva iti arthaḥ saṃgacchate iti

original: taṇḍulānodanaṃ pacatītyatastaṇḍulān vikledayannodanaṃ nirvartayatīti saṃpratyayāttaṇḍulānāṃ vikāryakarmatvamodanasya nirvartyakarmatvamabhimataṃ tannirvāhārthamutpattivikṛtirūpaphaladvayārthakatvaparameva `dvyarthaḥ paciḥ' iti bhāṣyam| ekasyaiva vyāpārasyoktaphaladvayajanakatvāt| vyāpāradvayaparatve tvasaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭaiveti bhāvaḥ| digiti|
analyzed: taṇḍulān odanam pacati iti atas taṇḍulān vikledayan odanam nirvartayati iti saṃpratyayāt taṇḍulānām vikārya karma tvam odanasya nirvartya karma tvam abhimatam tad nirvāha artham utpatti vikṛti rūpa phala dvaya arthaka tva param eva dvyarthaḥ paciḥ iti bhāṣyam ekasya eva vyāpārasya ukta phala dvaya janakatvāt vyāpāra dvaya paratve tu asaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭā eva iti bhāvaḥ diś iti

original: digarthastu akarmakāṇāmapi phalavācakatvamāvaśyakam| anyathā dhātuṣu sattādiphalanirdeśasya vaiphalyāpatteḥ| dhātusāmānyaśaktisvabhāvātpacyāderivabhvāderapi vyāpārabodhasaṃbhavāt| kiṃ ca jānātyādeḥ sakarmakatvāya jñānādyanukūlavyāpāravācitvamaṅgīkāryam| tathā ca cakṣurjānātītyapi syāt| cakṣuṣyapi jñānānukūlacakṣurmanaḥsaṃyogasattvāditi cenna|
analyzed: diś arthaḥ tu akarmakāṇām api phala vācaka tvam āvaśyakam anyathā dhātuṣu sattā ādi phala nirdeśasya vaiphalya āpatteḥ dhātu sāmānya śakti svabhāvāt paci ādeḥ iva bhva ādeḥ api vyāpāra bodha saṃbhavāt kim ca jānāti ādeḥ sakarmaka tvāya jñāna ādi anukūla vyāpāra vāci tvam aṅgīkāryam tathā ca cakṣuḥ jānāti iti api syāt cakṣuṣi api jñāna anukūla cakṣuḥ manaḥ saṃyoga sattvāt iti ced na

original: uktayuktibhirvyāpārasya tiṅantajanyabodhaviṣayatve siddhe'pi dhātuvācyatve'nirmayaḥ, pacatītyatra prakṛtipratyayayordvayoḥ krameṇa pākaṃ karotīti padadvayena vivaraṇadarśanādbhāvanāyāstiṅ‌vācyatvasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| na dhātoriti|
analyzed: ukta yuktibhiḥ vyāpārasya tiṅanta janya bodha viṣaya tve siddhe api dhātu vācya tve nirmayaḥ pacati iti atra prakṛti pratyayayoḥ dvayoḥ krameṇa pākam karoti iti pada dvayena vivaraṇa darśanāt bhāvanāyāḥ tiṅ vācya tvasya api vaktum śakya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ na dhātoḥ iti

original: pacatītyataḥ pākānukūlā bhāvanetyevaṃ prādhānyena pratīyamānavyāpārasya pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamādākhyāta(tiṅa)vācyatvasyaiva vaktumucitatvena dhātuvācyatvaṃ naiva vaktuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ| pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamasya tiṅupāttasaṃkhyāyāstadupāttakartari viśeṣaṇatayā'nvayātsaṃkhyādau vyabhicaritatvādāhatadāgame hīti|
analyzed: pacati iti atas pāka anukūlā bhāvanā iti evam prādhānyena pratīyamāna vyāpārasya pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti niyamāt ākhyāta tiṅ avācyatvasya eva vaktum ucitatvena dhātu vācyatvam na eva vaktum śakyam iti arthaḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti niyamasya tiṅ upātta saṃkhyāyāḥ tad upātta kartari viśeṣaṇatayā anvayāt saṃkhyā ādau vyabhicarita tvāt āha tad āgame hi iti

original: apiśabdena prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyameti nyāyasamuccayaḥ| so'pi nyāyo bhāvanāyāstiṅarthatvaṃ saṃsādhayituṃ nālaṃ, tasya dūṣayiṣyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ| bādhakamiti| bhāvanāyā dhātvarthatve prakṛtipratyayayoriti nyāyavirodha iti mīmaiṃsakoktaṃ bādhakamityarthaḥ| tanmatamiti|
analyzed: apiśabdena prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam eti nyāya samuccayaḥ saḥ api nyāyaḥ bhāvanāyāḥ tiṅ artha tvam saṃsādhayitum na alam tasya dūṣayiṣyamāṇa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ bādhakam iti bhāvanāyāḥ dhātvartha tve prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti nyāya virodhaḥ iti mīmaiṃsaka uktam bādhakam iti arthaḥ tat matam iti

original: pacatītyetad‌ghaṭakapac‌dhātoḥ pākamiti vivaraṇaṃ taduttaratipratyayasya tu kṛdhāturiti mīmāṃsakamatamityarthaḥ| dūṣayatidūṣaṇodbhāvanena pratyācaṣṭena tvasāvityādinā| asau kṛdhātusthiṅāṃ vyākhyānaṃvivaraṇaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadvivaraṇaṃ tu karotītyetad‌ghaṭakastipratyaya ityāśayaḥ| kṛdhātostiṅ‌vivaraṇatvābhāve hetumāhapakvavānityādāviti|
analyzed: pacati iti etad ghaṭaka pac dhātoḥ pākam iti vivaraṇam tad uttara tipratyayasya tu kṛdhātuḥ iti mīmāṃsaka matam iti arthaḥ dūṣayati dūṣaṇa udbhāvanena pratyācaṣṭena tu asau ityādinā asau vyākhyānam vivaraṇam na bhavati iti arthaḥ tad vivaraṇam tu karoti iti etad ghaṭakaḥ tipratyayaḥ iti āśayaḥ kṛdhātoḥ tiṅ vivaraṇa tva abhāve hetum āha pakvavān ityādau iti

original: siddhānte hi pakvavānityatra pac‌dhātvartho na karmakārakaṃ kiṃtu kriyārūpa eva| karma tu taṇḍulaḥ| prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasyaiva prādhānyamiti niyamasaṃrakṣaṇāya tiṅantasthale pratyayasyaiva vyāpārārthakatvaṃ mīmāṃsakairaṅgīkriyate| vaiyākaraṇaistu prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti vyutpattirna niyāmikā kiṃ tūtsargavacanaṃ tat|
analyzed: siddhānte hi pakvavān iti atra pac dhātvarthaḥ na karma kārakam kiṃtu kriyā rūpaḥ eva karma tu taṇḍulaḥ prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya arthasya eva prādhānyam iti niyama saṃrakṣaṇāya tiṅanta sthale pratyayasya eva vyāpāra arthaka tvam mīmāṃsakaiḥ aṅgīkriyate vaiyākaraṇaiḥ tu prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti vyutpattiḥ na niyāmikā kim tu utsarga vacanam tat

original: yadi ca sarvatra vyutpattyanusāreṇaiva bodhaḥ svīkriyeta tarhi pakvavānityatrānanvayāpattiriti dūṣaṇaṃ dīyate| tāmevānanvayāpattiṃ viśadayatiayaṃ bhāva ityādinā| sahārthaṃ brūta iti| saṃbaddhārthaṃ bodhayataḥ| arthadvayamadhye kasya viśeṣyatvaṃ kasya ca viśeṣaṇatvamityapekṣāyāmāhatayoriti|
analyzed: yadi ca sarvatra vyutpatti anusāreṇa eva bodhaḥ svīkriyeta tarhi pakvavān iti atra ananvaya āpattiḥ iti dūṣaṇam dīyate tām eva ananvaya āpattim viśadayati ayam bhāvaḥ ityādinā saha artham brūtaḥ iti saṃbaddha artham bodhayataḥ artha dvaya madhye kasya viśeṣya tvam kasya ca viśeṣaṇa tvam iti apekṣāyām āha tayoḥ iti

original: prakṛtipratyayārthayormadhye pratyayārthaḥ pratyayavācyo'rthaḥ pradhānaṃnāma prakṛtyarthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāvānityarthaḥ| pūrvoktavyutpattisiddhakāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ śabdataḥ pradarśayativiśeṣyatayeti| prakṛtyarthaniṣṭhaprakāratākabodhe jananīye viseṣyatāsaṃbandhena tādṛśaprakṛtyuttarapratyayajaḍanyārthopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ madhye pratyaya arthaḥ pratyaya vācyaḥ ṛthaḥ pradhānam nāma prakṛti artha niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita viśeṣyatāvān iti arthaḥ pūrvokta vyutpatti siddha kārya kāraṇa bhāvam śabdataḥ pradarśayati viśeṣyatayā iti prakṛti artha niṣṭha prakāratāka bodhe jananīye viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena tādṛśa prakṛti uttara pratyaya jaḍa nya artha upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: pakvavānityatra prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ parasparānvayaprayojakamubhayoḥ kārakatvaṃ pradarśayatipākaḥ karmakārakamiti| pākaḥ phalāṃśaḥ| tasya vyāpārajanyatvātphalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena phalāśrayatvācca karmatvamityarthaḥ| kartṛkārakamiti| kartari kṛt, ityanuśāsanātktavatupratyayārthaḥ kartṛkārakamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pakvavān iti atra prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ paraspara anvaya prayojakam ubhayoḥ kāraka tvam pradarśayati pākaḥ karma kārakam iti pākaḥ phala aṃśaḥ tasya vyāpāra janya tvāt phalasya api vyapadeśivat bhāvena phala āśraya tvāt ca karma tvam iti arthaḥ kartṛ kārakam iti kartari kṛt iti anuśāsanāt ktavatu pratyaya arthaḥ kartṛ kārakam iti arthaḥ

original: dvayoḥ kārakayoḥ parasparānvayāsaṃbhave prabhāmamāhaaruṇādhikaraṇarītyā'smadrītyā ceti| aruṇādhikaraṇehiaruṇayā piṅgākṣyā, ekahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇātītyatrāruṇayetyādipadatraye'pi tṛtīyopāttasya karaṇakārakasya pārthakyena krayabhāvanāyāmanvayaḥāruṇyakaraṇikā piṅgākṣīkaraṇikā ekahāyanīkaraṇikā ca yā bhāvanā tādṛśabhāvanāsādhyabhūtena krayeṇa somaṃ
analyzed: dvayoḥ kārakayoḥ paraspara anvaya asaṃbhave prabhāmam āha aruṇa adhikaraṇa rītyā asmad rītyā ca iti aruṇa adhikaraṇe hi aruṇayā piṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somam krīṇāti iti atra aruṇayā ityādi pada traye pi tṛtīya upāttasya karaṇa kārakasya pārthakyena kraya bhāvanāyām anvayaḥ āruṇya karaṇikā piṅgākṣī karaṇikā ekahāyanī karaṇikā ca yā bhāvanā tādṛśa bhāvanā sādhya bhūtena krayeṇa somam somam krīṇāti iti

original: bhāvayediti bodhaḥ| yā cā''ruṇyaguṇaviśiṣṭā gauḥ saiva piṅgalavarṇākṣimatī saiva caikahāyanaviśiṣṭetyevamabedabodhastu pārṣṭhikaḥ pratyāsattinyāyājjāyata ityuktam| tathā ca kārakāṇāṃ kriyāyāmevānvayo, na tu teṣāṃ parasparamanvaya iti spaṣṭameva pratipāditam| tathā karoti kriyāṃ janayatīti vyutpattyā kārakaśabdaḥ kriyājanakaparaḥ|
analyzed: bhāvayet iti bodhaḥ yā ca aruṇya guṇa viśiṣṭā gauḥ sā eva piṅgala varṇā akṣimatī sā eva ca eka hāyana viśiṣṭā iti evam abeda bodhaḥ tu pārṣṭhikaḥ pratyāsatti nyāyāt jāyate iti uktam tathā ca kārakāṇām kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ na tu teṣām parasparam anvayaḥ iti spaṣṭam eva pratipāditam tathā karoti kriyām janayati iti vyutpattyā kāraka śabdaḥ kriyā janaka paraḥ

original: kriyājanakamiti jñāte janakasya ca janyākāṅkṣāniyamena kā sā kriyeti jijñāsodayātkriyāyā api janyāyā janakākāṅkṣatayā ca tayoḥ kriyākārakayoreva parasparānvayaucityarūpayā kārakāṇāṃ kriyāyāmevānvayaniyamasādhikayā subarthanirṇaye vakṣyamāṇarītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: kriyā janakam iti jñāte janakasya ca janya ākāṅkṣā niyamena kā sā kriyā iti jijñāsā udayāt kriyāyāḥ api janyāyāḥ janaka akāṅkṣatayā ca tayoḥ kriyā kārakayoḥ eva paraspara anvaya aucitya rūpayā kārakāṇām kriyāyām eva anvaya niyama sādhikayā subartha nirṇaye

original: anavayāsaṃbhava iti na hyuktarītidvayena kārakāṇāṃ parasparamanvayaḥ kathamapi saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ| atrāyaṃ viśeṣo bodhyaḥyanmīmāṃsakamate arumayā piṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇātītyādau viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kriyāyāmanvayaḥ, parasparamanvayastu pārṣṭhiko mānasikaḥ| vaiyākaraṇamate tu viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaviśeṣyasyeti|
analyzed: iti na hi ukta rīti dvayena kārakāṇām parasparam anvayaḥ katham api saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ atra ayam viśeṣaḥ bodhyaḥ yat mīmāṃsaka mate arumayā piṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somam krīṇāti ityādau viśeṣya viśeṣaṇānām sarveṣām kriyāyām anvayaḥ parasparam anvayaḥ tu pārṣṭhikaḥ mānasikaḥ vaiyākaraṇa mate tu viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭa viśeṣyasya iti

original: ata eva nīlotpalamityādau sāmarthyātsamāsa upapadyate| niyamasyaivāsaṃbhaveneti| bhavanmate phalamātrasya dhātvarthatvena pakvavānityādisthale vyabhicārātprakṛtipratyayārthayoranvayaniyamasyaivāsaṃbhavena kva pratyayārthaprādhānyabodhakaḥ pūrvoktakāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ? sa tu sutarāmasaṃbhavīti kvaśabdena sūcitamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva nīlotpalam ityādau sāmarthyāt samāsaḥ upapadyate niyamasya eva asaṃbhavena iti bhavat mate phala mātrasya dhātvartha tvena pakvavān ityādi sthale vyabhicārāt prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ anvaya niyamasya eva asaṃbhavena kva pratyaya artha prādhānya bodhakaḥ pūrva ukta kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sa tu sutarām asaṃbhavi iti kvaśabdena sūcitam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pūrvoktarītyā kārakāṇāṃ mitho'nvayāsaṃbhave'pi bhaṭṭapādoktarīyā'nvayaḥ saṃbhavedityāśaṅkatena casaṃbandhamātramiti| yajetetyatra śrutyāsamānapadarūṣayā dhātvādiśrutyā, dhātvarthabhāvayoḥdhātvarthabhāvanayoḥ phalavyāpārayorityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu pūrva ukta rītyā kārakāṇām mithas nvaya asaṃbhave pi bhaṭṭa pāda ukta rīya anvayaḥ saṃbhavet iti āśaṅkatena ca saṃbandha mātram iti yajeta iti atra śrutyā asamāna pada rūṣayā dhātu ādi śrutyā dhātvartha bhāvayoḥ dhātvartha bhāvanayoḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ iti arthaḥ

original: saṃbandhamātraṃsaṃbandhasāmānyamuktaṃ, tatra tṛtīyādivibhaktyabhāvena karaṇatvādiviśeṣarūpeṇānvayāsaṃbhavātsaṃbandhasāmānyenānvayaḥ pratipāditaḥ, tadekāṃśaniveśetasya saṃbandhasāmānyasya ya ekāṃśaḥ karaṇatvādisaṃbandhāviśeṣastanniveśe tadbodhane, asyāḥśruteḥ, vyāpāraḥsāmarthyaṃ, na vidyatenāstītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: saṃbandha mātram saṃbandha sāmānyam uktam tatra tṛtīyā ādi vibhakti abhāvena karaṇa tva ādi viśeṣa rūpeṇa anvaya asaṃbhavāt saṃbandha sāmānyena anvayaḥ pratipāditaḥ tad eka aṃśa niveśe tasya saṃbandha sāmānyasya yaḥ eka aṃśaḥ karaṇa tva ādi saṃbandha aviśeṣaḥ tad niveśe tad bodhane asyāḥ śruteḥ vyāpāraḥ sāmarthyam na vidyate na asti iti arthaḥ

original: tathā prakṛte'pi pākasaṃbandhī kartetyanvayaḥ saṃbhavatīti karmatvādiviśeṣarūpeṇa bodha eva kriyāpekṣeti śaṅkivābhiprāyaḥ| phalasya kārakatvenāyogyatvāttathā'nvayo'pyasaṃbhavyevetyāhayogyatāvirahāditi| nanu arthābādho yogyateti tādṛśayogyatāyāḥ sattvādyogyatāvirahoktirayuktetyata āhaanvayaprayojakarūpavattvasyeti|
analyzed: tathā prakṛte api pāka saṃbandhī kartā iti anvayaḥ saṃbhavati iti karma tva ādi viśeṣa rūpeṇa bodhaḥ eva kriyā apekṣā iti śaṅkivā abhiprāyaḥ phalasya kāraka tvena ayogya tvāt tathā anvayaḥ api asaṃbhavī eva iti āha yogyatā virahāt iti nanu artha ābādhaḥ yogyatā iti tādṛśa yogyatāyāḥ sattvāt yogyatā viraha uktiḥ ayuktā iti atas āha anvaya prayojaka rūpavat tvasya iti

original: kārakānvayakaraṇe prayojakaṃhetubhūtaṃ yadrūpaṃ tādṛśarūpavattvasya tathātvādyogyatārūpatvādityarthaḥ| tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tu kārakāṇāṃ dhātūpasthāpyakriyayaivānvayaniyamātkriyātvaṃ, tadeva ca yogyatvamiti bhāvaḥ| taduktaṃ mūlekriyātvameva hītyādi vakṣyata ityantam| anvayaprayojakapadenānvayi tāvacchedakasyābhidhānam|
analyzed: kāraka anvaya karaṇe prayojakam hetu bhūtam yat rūpam tādṛśa rūpavattvasya tathātvāt yogyatā rūpatvāt iti arthaḥ tādṛśam rūpam tu kārakāṇām dhātu upasthāpya kriyayā eva anvaya niyamāt kriyātvam tat eva ca yogyatvam iti bhāvaḥ tat uktam mūle kriyātvam eva hi ityādi vakṣyate ityantam anvaya prayojaka padena anvayi tāvacchedakasya abhidhānam

original: yadavacchinne'nvayastasyaiva hyanvayitāvacchedakatvaṃ jñeyam| kārakāṇāṃ kriyātvāvacchinne'nvayaniyamātkriyātvameva hi kārakānvayitāvacchedakamiti tātparyam| tadetaditi| kārakāṇāṃ mitho'nanvayaprayojakamityarthaḥ| vivaraṇeneti| tatsamānārthakapadāntareṇa tadarthakathanenetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yad avacchinna invayaḥ tasya eva hi anvayitā avacchedaka tvam jñeyam kārakāṇām kriyā tva avacchinna invaya niyamāt kriyā tvam eva hi kāraka anvayitā avacchedakam iti tātparyam tat etat iti kārakāṇām mithonanvaya prayojakam iti arthaḥ vivaraṇena iti tad samāna arthaka pada antareṇa tad artha kathanena iti arthaḥ

original: pakvavānityatratyaprakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ karmatvakartṛtve darśayatikṛtavān‌pākamiti| ktvavatvarthakartrākṣipyamāṇabhāvanāyāṃ pākasya karmatvenānvayasaṃbhavānna pakvavānityatrānanvaya ityāśayāduktaṃ vastuta iti| pratyayārthaḥ pradhānamityasyeti| atroddeśyavidheyabhedena dvidhā niyamākāraḥ saṃbhavatītyāhayaḥ pradhānamiti, yaḥ pratyayārtha iti ca|
analyzed: pakvavān iti atratya prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ karmatva kartṛ tve darśayati kṛtavān pākam iti ktvavat vat artha kartṛ ākṣipyamāṇa bhāvanāyām pākasya karmatvena anvaya saṃbhavāt na pakvavān iti atra ananvayaḥ iti āśayāt uktam vastutas iti pratyaya arthaḥ pradhānam iti asya iti atra uddeśya vidheya bhedena dvidhā niyama ākāraḥ saṃbhavati iti āha yaḥ pradhānam iti yaḥ pratyaya arthaḥ iti ca

original: dvividhaniyame'pi vyabhicāramāhaajā'śvetyādi| yaḥ praprānamiti prathamaniyame'jāderviśeṣyasya pratyayārthatvābhāvāvdyabhicāreṇa prādhānyaṃ na syāt| kiṃtu strīpratyayārthasyaiva prādhānyapattiḥ| yaḥ pratyayārtha iti dvitīyaniyame vyabhicāramāhachāgyāderiti|
analyzed: dvividha niyame api vyabhicāram āha aja aśva ityādi yaḥ praprānam iti prathama niyama ija ādeḥ viśeṣyasya pratyaya artha tva abhāvāt vyabhicāreṇa prādhānyam na syāt kiṃtu strī pratyaya arthasya eva prādhānya pattiḥ yaḥ pratyaya arthaḥ iti dvitīya niyame vyabhicāram āha chāgya ādeḥ iti

original: atra strītvasya pratyayārthatve'pi dyotyārthasya prakāratayā bhānaniyamāvdyabhicāraḥ, prakṛtyarthasya prādhānyānāpattiśceti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca dūṣaṇagrastatvātpatyayārthaḥ pradhānamityayaṃ na niyamaḥ, kiṃtu sāmānyavacanamiti na tadbalāvdyāpārasyā''khyātārthatvaṃ vaktuṃ suśakamityāśayaḥ|
analyzed: atra strī tvasya pratyaya artha tve pi dyotya arthasya prakāratayā bhāna niyama avdyabhicāraḥ prakṛti arthasya prādhānya anāpattiḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ evam ca dūṣaṇa grasta tvāt patyaya arthaḥ pradhānam iti ayam na niyamaḥ kiṃtu sāmānya vacanam iti na vaktum suśakam iti āśayaḥ

original: kathaṃ tarhi pacatītyādau vyāpārasya viśeṣyatayā bodha ityata āhaviśeṣyatvādineti| vyutpattyanurodhāditi| vyutpattiḥśabdānāmaryāvabodhakaśaktigrahaḥ| tadanurodhādvākyārthāvabodhakaśaktigrahānurodhāt vyāpāraviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodha ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: katham tarhi pacati ityādau vyāpārasya viśeṣyatayā bodhaḥ iti atas āha viśeṣya tva ādinā iti vyutpatti anurodhāt iti vyutpattiḥ śabdānām arya avabodhaka śaktigrahaḥ tad anurodhāt vākya artha avabodhaka śaktigraha anurodhāt vyāpāra viśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca vyutpattiḥ arthāvabodhakaśaktigraha eva vyāpāraviśeṣyakaśābdabodaniyāmikā, na pratyayārthatvādīti bhāvanāyā dhātvarthatve'pi na prādhānyānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ| yato bodho hi vyutpattyanusārī, na tu bodānusāriṇī vyutpattirityabhiyuktānubhavāt|
analyzed: tathā ca vyutpattiḥ artha avabodhaka śakti grahaḥ eva vyāpāra viśeṣyaka śābda boda niyāmikā na pratyaya artha tva ādi iti bhāvanāyāḥ dhātvartha tve pi na prādhānya anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ yatas bodhaḥ hi vyutpatti anusārī na tu boda anusāriṇī vyutpattiḥ iti abhiyukta anubhavāt

original: mīmāṃsakaistu vākyārthabodhe bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadanusāreṇa tasyā ākhyātapratyayārthatvaṃ kalpyata ita yattad bodānusāreṇa vyutpattikalpanamiti abhiyuktānubhavaviruddhatvādatyantānucitamityāśāpaḥ| bodhasya vyutpattyanusāritvaṃ pradarśayatiata eveti|
analyzed: mīmāṃsakaiḥ tu vākya artha bodhe bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyam dṛṣṭvā tad anusāreṇa tasyāḥ ākhyāta pratyaya artha tvam kalpyate yat tat boda anusāreṇa vyutpatti kalpanam iti abhiyukta anubhava viruddha tvāt atyanta anucitam iti āśāpaḥ bodhasya vyutpatti anusāri tvam pradarśayati atas eva iti

original: tādṛśārthabodhajanakaśaktigrahavaśādeva prathamāntaviśeṣyaka eva śābdabodho naiyāyikairaṅgīkriyate| śakyatāvacchedakaprakāraka eveti|
analyzed: tādṛśa artha bodha janaka śaktigraha vaśāt eva prathama anta viśeṣyakaḥ eva śābda bodhaḥ naiyāyikaiḥ aṅgīkriyate śakyatā avacchedaka prakārakaḥ eva iti

original: yena rūpeṇa śakyārthabodhastasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatvaniyamādālaṃkārikairlakṣaṇāyāṃ gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣaḥ, jātā latā hi śaile, ityādau gaṅgātvalatātvādinaiva lakṣyārthapratītisvīkārādvilakṣaṇaśaittyapāvanatvādipratīticamatkāro viparītapadapratipādyaṃ vaiparītyaṃ ca saṃgacchata ityucyate|
analyzed: yena rūpeṇa śakyārtha bodhaḥ tasya eva śakyatā avacchedaka tva niyamāt ālaṃkārikaiḥ lakṣaṇāyām gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ jātā latā hi śaile ityādau gaṅgā tva latā tva ādinā eva lakṣya artha pratīti svīkārāt vilakṣaṇa śaittya pāvana tva ādi pratīti camatkāraḥ viparīta pada pratipādyam vaiparītyam ca saṃgacchate iti ucyate

original: naiyāyikāstu gaṅgātire ghoṣa iti vaktavye gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityuktisāmarthyādeva śaityapāvanatvādipratītirityāhuḥ| ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti| viparyayeṇavaiparītyena| vyutpannānāṃghaṭaḥ, karmatvaṃ, ānayanaṃ, ityevamasaṃbaddhaśabdadhaṭitavākye ādhārādheyabhāvasaṃbandhena ghaṭaprakārakakarmatvaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatāgrahavatāmityarthaḥ| naiyāyikanavyānāmiti|
analyzed: naiyāyikāḥ tu gaṅgā tire ghoṣaḥ iti vaktavye gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti ukti sāmarthyāt eva śaitya pāvana tva ādi pratītiḥ iti āhuḥ ghaṭaḥ karmatvam iti viparyayeṇa vaiparītyena vyutpannānām ghaṭaḥ karmatvam ānayanam iti evam asaṃbaddha śabda dhaṭita vākye ādhāra ādheya bhāva saṃbandhena ghaṭa prakāraka karmatva viśeṣyaka bodha janakatā grahavatām iti arthaḥ naiyāyika navyānām iti

original: karmadārayasamāse naiyāyikaśabdasya nyāyamadhīte vetti veti vyutpattyā kriyāśabdatvena pāṭhakapācakādivadaniyamena pūrvanipātaḥ kṛtaḥ| `ekapadasya padāntaravyatirekamayuktānvayānanubhāvakatvamākāṅkṣā' ityākāṅkṣāsvarūpam| padasyeti ṣaṣṭhyartho niṣṭhatvam| padaniṣṭhamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: naiyāyika śabdasya nyāyam adhīte vetti vā iti vyutpattyā kriyā śabda tvena pāṭhaka pācaka ādi vat aniyamena pūrva nipātaḥ kṛtaḥ eka padasya pada antara vyatirekam ayukta anvaya an anubhāvaka tvam ākāṅkṣā iti ākāṅkṣā svarūpam padasya iti ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ niṣṭhatvam pada niṣṭham iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca ghaṭapadaniṣṭhaṃ karmatvapadavyatirekaprayuktamanvayānanubhāvakatvaṃ samīkṣya niruktavākpācchābdabodho'bhyupeyate yaistannirdeśārthaṃ navyapadamupāttam| tathā ca tādṛśavākyādapi teṣāmarthabodho jāyate, tādṛśavyutpattirahitānāṃ tu na jāyate| taduktaṃanyeṣāṃ tannirākāṅkṣameveti| ādhārādheyabhāvasaṃsargeṇa śābdabodhe nirākāṅkṣamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca ghaṭa pada niṣṭham karmatva pada vyatireka prayuktam anvaya ananubhāvakatvam samīkṣya yaiḥ tad nirdeśa artham navya padam upāttam tathā ca tādṛśa vākyāt api teṣām artha bodhaḥ jāyate tādṛśa vyutpatti rahitānām tu na jāyate tat uktam anyeṣām tat nirākāṅkṣam eva iti ādhāra ādheya bhāva saṃsargeṇa śābda bodhe nirākāṅkṣam iti arthaḥ

original: ityādyuktaṃ sarvaṃ saṃgacchata iti bhāvaḥ| ata eveti| bodhasya vyutpattyanusāritvādedetyarthaḥ| pradhānapratyayārthavacanamiti|etatsūtrasvarasasiddhaḥyaḥ pradhānaṃ sa prayayārthaḥ, iti pakṣaḥ| sūtrasyārthastvevamatrāśiṣyamityanuvartate| tathā ca `pradhānaṃ pratyayārthaḥ, iti vacanaṃ na kartavyam| tatra hetumāhaarthasyānyeti|
analyzed: ityādi uktam sarvam saṃgacchate iti bhāvaḥ atas eva iti bodhasya vyutpatti anusāri tvāt eda iti arthaḥ pradhāna pratyaya artha vacanam iti etad sūtra svarasa siddhaḥ yaḥ pradhānam sa iti pakṣaḥ sūtrasya arthaḥ tu evam atra aśiṣyam iti anuvartate tathā ca pradhānam pratyaya arthaḥ iti vacanam na kartavyam tatra hetum āha arthasya anyā iti

original: arthasyaviśeṣyatvādinā bodasya lokavyutpattisiddhatvāditi| evaṃ satyapīti| vyutpattyanusāreṇa vyāpārasya viśeṣyatayā bodhasiddhau satyāmapītyarthaḥ| bhāvapradhānamitivacanameveti|
analyzed: arthasya viśeṣya tva ādinā bodasya loka vyutpatti siddha tvāt iti evam sati api iti vyutpatti anusāreṇa vyāpārasya viśeṣya tayā bodha siddhau satyām api iti arthaḥ bhāva pradhānam iti vacanam eva iti

original: avadhāraṇārthakaivakāreṇa prakṛtipratyayārthayorityasya vyāvṛttistasyautsargikatvātsāmānyavacanatvāccaitasya viśeṣavacanatvenāpavādatvādidameva dhātvarthatve'pi vyāpārasya viseṣyatayā śābdabodhe pramāṇatvenā''daraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| tatrā''khyātapadena dāturucyate| ākhyāyate sarvataḥ pradhānabhūto'rtho'neneti vyutpatteḥ| nāmādiprakṛtīnāmevoddeśāt|
analyzed: avadhāraṇa arthaka evakāreṇa prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti asya vyāvṛttiḥ tasya autsargika tvāt sāmānya vacana tvāt ca etasya viśeṣa vacana tvena apavāda tvāt idam eva dhātvartha tve pi vyāpārasya viseṣya tayā śābda bodhe pramāṇa tvena ādaraṇīyam iti bhāvaḥ tatra ākhyāta padena dātuḥ ucyate ākhyāyate sarvatas pradhāna bhūtaḥ ūrthaḥ ūnena iti vyutpatteḥ nāma ādi prakṛtīnām eva uddeśāt

original: `nāmānyākhyātajāni' iti niruktācca| na hyakhyātapratyayajanyaṃ tadantajanyaṃ vā nāma saṃbhavati?| ata eva `sarvaṃ nāma dhātujapāha vyākaraṇe śakaṭasya ca tokam' iti pūrvoktaniruktasamānārthakaṃ vākyaṃ mahābhāṣye paṭhitam| tathā ca vākye sarvāpekṣayā pradhānībhūtārthakatvaṃ dhātulakṣaṇaṃ paryavasyati|
analyzed: nāmāni ākhyāta jāni iti niruktāt ca na hi akhyāta pratyaya janyam tad anta janyam vā nāma saṃbhavati atas eva sarvam nāma vyākaraṇe śakaṭasya ca tokam iti pūrvokta nirukta samāna arthakam vākyam mahābhāṣye paṭhitam tathā ca vākye sarva apekṣayā pradhānībhūta arthaka tvam dhātu lakṣaṇam paryavasyati

original: prādhānyoktistu tanmukhyaviśeṣyaka eva bodho jāyata iti sphoraṇāya, na tu tasya lakṣaṇe niveśa iti būṣaṇakārasaṃmataḥ panthāḥ| navyavaiyākaraṇāstutatrā''khyātapadena tiṅantaṃ gṛhyate, ākhyātamākhyātenetyatra tathaivārthapratīteḥ| `catvāri padajātāni nāmākhyāte copasarganipātāśca' ityupakramācca| bhāvakālakārakasaṃkhaayāścatvāro'rthā ākhyātasya|
analyzed: prādhānya uktiḥ tu tad mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ eva bodhaḥ jāyate iti sphoraṇāya na tu tasya lakṣaṇe niveśaḥ iti būṣaṇa kāra saṃmataḥ panthāḥ navya vaiyākaraṇāḥ tu tatra ākhyāta padena tiṅ antam gṛhyate ākhyātam ākhyātena iti atra tathā eva artha pratīteḥ catvāri pada jātāni nāma ākhyāte ca upasarga nipātāḥ ca iti upakramāt ca bhāva kāla kāraka saṃkha ayāḥ catvāraḥ arthāḥ ākhyātasya

original: tatrabhāvapradhānamiti| bhāvo dātvarthaḥ| dhātvarthaśca phalavyāpārānyataro bodhyaḥ| padhānaṃ viśeṣyamiti yāvat| tathā ca bhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ yasminniti bahuvrīhiḥ| ākhyātāṃ tiṅantaṃ phalavyāpārānyatarapradhānakaṃ bodhaṃ janayati| nāmāniprātipadikāni| sattvapradhānānisattvaṃdravyaṃ liṅgasaṃkhyānvayi|
analyzed: tatra bhāva pradhānam iti bhāvaḥ dātvarthaḥ dhātvarthaḥ ca phala vyāpāra anyataraḥ bodhyaḥ viśeṣyam iti yāvat tathā ca bhāvaḥ pradhānam yasmin iti bahuvrīhiḥ ākhyātām tiṅ antam phala vyāpāra anyatara pradhānakam bodham janayati nāmāni prātipadikāni sattva pradhānāni sattvam dravyam liṅga saṃkhyā anvayi

original: tatpradhānānitadviśeṣyakāṇi jñānāni anvayabodhātmakāni janayantīti bhāvaḥ| yathā pacatītyatra vyāpārapradhānako bodhaḥ| pacyate ityatra phalapradhānako viklittyādirūpārtho bodhyata ityādikamāhuḥ|
analyzed: tad pradhānāni tad viśeṣyakāṇi jñānāni anvaya bodha ātmakāni janayanti iti bhāvaḥ yathā pacati iti atra vyāpāra pradhānakaḥ bodhaḥ pacyate iti atra phala pradhānakaḥ viklitti ādi rūpa arthaḥ bodhyate iti ādikam āhuḥ

original: evaṃ pradhānaṃ pratyayārtha ityasyānādaraṇīyatvaṃ pratipādya yaḥ pratyayārthaḥ sa pradhānamityarthe mūlasya, tadāgame hīti nyāyasyāpyanādaraṇīyatvaṃ darśayitumāhatadāgame hītyādi| ativyāptamiti| ativyāptaścātivyāptaṃ ceti puṃnapuṃsakayo `napuṃsakamanapuṃsakena' iti napuṃsakaikaśeṣaḥ, ekavacanaṃ ca| ativyāptamatiprasaktaṃ vyabhicaritāmiti yāvat|
analyzed: evam pradhānam pratyaya arthaḥ iti asya anādaraṇīya tvam pratipādya yaḥ pratyaya arthaḥ sa pradhānam iti arthe mūlasya tad āgame hi iti nyāyasya api anādaraṇīya tvam darśayitum āha tad āgame hi ityādi ativyāptam iti ativyāptaḥ ca ativyāptam ca iti pum napuṃsakayaḥ napuṃsakam anapuṃsakena iti napuṃsaka ekaśeṣaḥ ekavacanam ca ativyāptam atiprasaktam vyabhicaritām iti yāvat

original: vyabhicaritatvameva spaṣṭayatikṛñoti| atra kiṃ kṛtam? iti praśnaḥ, pakvamityuttaram| evaṃ ca praśnottararūpaṃ vivaraṇam| tatra kiṃ kṛtamiti praśne kiṃviṣayako vyāpāraḥ kṛta ityarthapratītyā vyāpāraviṣayasya jijñāsyatvamavagamyate| pakvamityatra karmaṇi ktapratyayaḥ sāmānye nupaṃsakatvaṃ ca|
analyzed: vyabhicarita tvam eva spaṣṭayati kṛñā iti atra kim kṛtam iti praśnaḥ pakvam iti uttaram evam ca praśna uttara rūpam vivaraṇam tatra kim kṛtam iti praśne kiṃviṣayakaḥ vyāpāraḥ kṛtaḥ iti artha pratītyā vyāpāra viṣayasya jijñāsya tvam avagamyate pakvam iti atra karmaṇi ktapratyayaḥ sāmānye nupaṃsaka tvam ca

original: tathā ca pakvamityato jijñāsyaviṣayānavagamenāsyottaratvāsaṃgatyā vyāpārabodhakatve svīkṛte tasya pratyayārthatvābhāvāvdyabhicāra ityarthaḥ| pakvamityapītyapinā pakvavānityasya samuccayaḥ| tatrāpi bhāvanāyā ākṣepādinā pratīyamānatve'pi pratyayārthatvābhāvena vyabhicārasaṃbhavāt| pakvamityatrāpīti|
analyzed: tathā ca pakvam ityatas jijñāsya viṣaya anavagamena asya uttaratva asaṃgatyā vyāpāra bodhaka tve svīkṛte tasya iti arthaḥ pakvam iti api iti apinā pakvavān ityasya samuccayaḥ tatra api bhāvanāyāḥ ākṣepa ādinā pratīyamāna tve pi pratyaya artha tva abhāvena vyabhicāra saṃbhavāt pakvam iti atra api iti

original: yathā pacatītyatra pac‌dhātoḥ pākamityanena tipratyayasya ca karotītibhāvanārthakakṛdhātunā vivaraṇādākhyātasya bhāvanāparaparyāyavyāpāravācimatvasvīkārātkṛñā vivaraṇaṃ prādhānyena vyāpārapratītiśca manyate mīmāṃsakaistadvatpakvamityatrāpi ktapratyayasya bhāvanārthakakṛñā vivaraṇaṃ bhāvanāpratītiścāstīti pakvavān pakvamityatrāpi bhāvanā
analyzed: yathā pacati iti atra pac dhātoḥ pākam iti anena ti pratyayasya ca karoti iti bhāvanā arthaka kṛ dhātunā vivaraṇāt ākhyātasya bhāvanā para paryāya vyāpāra vācimatva svīkārāt kṛñā vivaraṇam prādhānyena vyāpāra pratītiḥ ca manyate mīmāṃsakaiḥ tadvat pakvam iti atra api kta pratyayasya bhāvanā arthaka kṛñā vivaraṇam bhāvanā pratītiḥ ca asti iti pakvavān pakvam iti atra api bhāvanā pratītiḥ ca asti iti pakvavān pakvam iti atra api bhāvanā pratīt

original: pratyayavācyā syāditi tadāgame hīti nyāyasya kṛñā vivaraṇasya cātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu yathā kṛñā vivaraṇāttadāgame hīti nyāyācca tiṅāṃ bhāvanā vācyetyaṅgīkṛtaṃ tathā kṛtpratyayānāmapi sā vācyeti svīkriyatāṃ, tathā ca nātivyāptiriti cedāhaapīti| apinā'rthāntaraṃ samuccīyate| tadevārthāntaraṃ prakaṭayatitathā ceti|
analyzed: pratyaya vācyā syāt iti tad āgame hi iti nyāyasya kṛñā vivaraṇasya ca ativyāptiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu yathā kṛñā vivaraṇāt tad āgame hi iti nyāyāt ca tiṅām bhāvanā vācyā iti aṅgīkṛtam tathā kṛt pratyayānām api sā vācyā iti svīkriyatām tathā ca na ativyāptiḥ iti ced āha api iti apinā arthāntaram samuccīyate tat eva arthāntaram prakaṭayati tathā ca iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥtiṅante pacatītyādau, kṛdante paktā pakvavānityādau cobhayatrāpi bhāvanāpratītirastīti tāvannirvivādamubhābhyāmapi vādiprativādibhyāṃ svīkṛtam| tatra kiṃ sā bhāvanā dhātunā pratipādyate'thavā pratyayeneti jijñāsāyāṃ pratyayeneti cetpratyayānāmanekatvenānekeṣu śaktikalpanāpattyā gauravaṃ bhavati| tasmāddhātunā pratipādyata iti mantavyam|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ tiṅ ante pacati ityādau kṛt ante paktā pakvavān ityādau ca ubhayatra api bhāvanā pratītiḥ asti iti tāvat nirvivādam ubhābhyām api vādi prativādibhyām svīkṛtam tatra kim sā bhāvanā dhātunā pratipādyate thavā pratyayena iti jijñāsāyām pratyayena iti ced pratyayānām aneka tvena anekeṣu śakti kalpanā āpattyā gauravam bhavati tasmāt dhātunā pratipādyate iti mantavyam

original: dhātustūbhayatrāpi pacireka evetyekaspriñchaktikalpanayā'tilāghavaṃ bhavatītyāśayenā''haubhayasādhāraṇyetyādi| tiṅantakṛdantobhayānugatatvena bhāvanāpratīteḥ sattvādityarthaḥ| dhātureveti| ubhayatra ghaṭakatayā'nupraviṣṭo dhāturevaikatvena lāghavādbhāvanāvācaka ityeva kalpanaṃ samañjasamati| dūṣaṇāntaramapyāhaprādhānyāpattiśceti|
analyzed: dhātuḥ tu ubhayatra api paciḥ ekaḥ eva iti ekaspriñchakti kalpanayā atilāghavam bhavati iti āśayena āha ubhaya sādhāraṇya ityādi tiṅanta kṛdanta ubhaya anugata tvena bhāvanā pratīteḥ sattvāt iti arthaḥ dhātuḥ eva iti ubhayatra ghaṭakatayā anupraviṣṭaḥ dhātuḥ eva ekatvena lāghavāt bhāvanā vācakaḥ iti eva kalpanam samañjasam ati dūṣaṇa antaram api āha prādhānya āpattiḥ ca iti

original: tiṅāṃ bhāvanāvācakatve bhāvanayaivā''kṣepātkarmakartrarthamatītilābhasaṃbhavena pratyayārthatvādbhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyaṃ yathocyate mīmāṃsakaistadvatkṛtāmapi bhāvanāvācakatve bhāvanāyā eva prādhānyāpatti| tathā ca pakvastaṇḍulaḥ paktā caitra ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānāpattiruktātivyāptiparihārāsaṃbhavaśca syāditi bhāvaḥ|| 8 ||
analyzed: tiṅām bhāvanā vācaka tve bhāvanayā eva ākṣepāt karma kartṛ artham atīti lābha saṃbhavena pratyaya artha tvāt bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyam yathā ucyate mīmāṃsakaiḥ tadvat kṛtām api bhāvanā vācaka tve bhāvanāyāḥ eva prādhānya āpatti tathā ca pakvaḥ taṇḍulaḥ paktā caitraḥ ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇya anāpattiḥ ukta ativyāpti parihāra asaṃbhavaḥ ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: dhātoreva bhāvanāvācakatvamityatra sādhakāntaraṃ pradarśayannāhakiṃ kāryamiti| atra kiṃśabdo na praśnārthakaḥ kiṃtu pūrvatropaktāntatvāttadanusaṃdhānamātreṇa chandogatākṣarasaṃkhyāpūraṇārthaṃ prayuktaḥ| ata eva taṃ parityajyaiva vyākhyātikāryamityatreti| ṛhalorṇyaditi śāstreṇa karmaṇi ṇyadvihita iti śeṣaḥ| anīyariti|
analyzed: dhātoḥ eva bhāvanā vācaka tvam iti atra sādhaka antaram pradarśayan āha kim kāryam iti atra kim śabdaḥ na praśna arthakaḥ kiṃtu pūrvatra upakta anta tvāt tad anusaṃdhāna mātreṇa chandaḥ gata akṣara saṃkhyā pūraṇa artham prayuktaḥ atas eva tam parityajya eva vyākhyāti kāryam iti atra iti śāstreṇa karmaṇi ṇyat vihitaḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: pacanīyamityādau `tavyattavyānīyaraḥ' iti karmaṇyanīyarvirdhīyate ṇiniriti| bhūte, ityadhikṛtya `karaṇe yajaḥ, iti sūtreṇa yajerbhūte kartari ṇinirvihita ityarthaḥ| etekarmādyarthakā ṇyadādayaḥ| kriyāyogamantareṇāsanta iti|
analyzed: pacanīyam ityādau iti ṇiniḥ iti bhūte iti adhikṛtya karaṇe yajaḥ iti sūtreṇa yajeḥ bhūte kartari ṇiniḥ vihitaḥ iti arthaḥ ete karma ādi arthakāḥ ṇyad ādayaḥ kriyā yogam antareṇa asantaḥ iti

original: kriyānvayināmeva kārakatvena dhātorvyāpārarūpakriyāvācitvābhāve kriyānvayāsaṃbhavena kārakatvāsaṃbhavaḥ, tadasaṃbhave ca `kārake' ityadhikṛtya vihitānāṃ karmādisaṃjñānāmapyasaṃbhavātkarmādyarthe'santo'saṃbhāvitā ityarthaḥ| tadvācyatāmiti|
analyzed: kriyā anvayinām eva kāraka tvena dhātoḥ vyāpāra rūpa kriyā vāci tva abhāve kriyā anvaya asaṃbhavena kāraka tva asaṃbhavaḥ tad asaṃbhave ca kārake iti adhikṛtya vihitānām karma ādi saṃjñānām api asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ tat vācyatām iti

original: tathā ca karmādyarthe ṇyadādīnāṃ vidhānānyathāsaṃbhava eva bhāvanāyā dhātuvācyatāṃ pīnatvānyathāsaṃbhavo rātribhojanamiva bodayatisūcayatītyarthaḥ| etadanusaṃdhāyaidā''havinā kriyāmityādi| kārakatvāsaṃbhaveneti| kriyānvayitvasyaiva kārakatvātkriyāmantareṇa kārakatvāsaṃbhava ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca karma ādi arthe vidhāna anyathāsaṃbhavaḥ eva bhāvanāyāḥ dhātu vācya tām pīna tva anyathāsaṃbhavaḥ rātribhojanam iva bodayati sūcayati iti arthaḥ etat anusaṃdhāya edāha vinā kriyām ityādi kāraka tva asaṃbhavena iti kriyā anvayi tvasya eva kāraka tvāt kriyām antareṇa kāraka tva asaṃbhavaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu nedaṃ karmādyarthakaṇyadādividhānaṃ dhātārvyāpārarūpakriyāvācakatve mānaṃ ṇyadādīnāṃ karmādyarthakatvasya prakārāntareṇāpyupapattisaṃbhavādanyathānupapannasyaiva mānatvādityāśaṅkya samādhatte na ceti| bhāṭṭarītiriti|
analyzed: nanu na idam karma ādi arthaka ṇyad ādi vidhānam dhātār vyāpāra rūpa kriyā vācakatve mānam ṇyad ādīnām karma ādi arthaka tvasya prakāra antareṇa api upapatti saṃbhavāt anyathā anupapannasya eva mānatvāt iti āśaṅkya samādhatte na ca iti bhāṭṭa rītiḥ iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥpācako devadattaḥ, pakvastaṇḍula ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavānurodhātkṛtāṃ kartṛkarmādyarthakatvamuktvā dhātoḥ phalamātravācakatvena kriyāvācakābhāvātkṛdantasthale kriyāpratītirna syāt, tatpratītyabhāve ca kārakatvādi ca na syāditi kṛtāṃ kartṛkarmādyarthakatvamanupapannamityāśaṅkya kriyāṃ vinā kārakatvāsaibhavāttatra
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ pācakaḥ devadattaḥ pakvaḥ taṇḍulaḥ ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇya anubhava anurodhāt kṛtām kartṛ karma ādi arthaka tvam uktvā dhātoḥ phala mātra vācaka tvena kriyā vācaka abhāvāt kṛt anta sthale kriyā pratītiḥ na syāt tad pratīti abhāve ca kāraka tva ādi ca na syāt iti kṛtām kartṛ karma ādi arthaka tvam anupapannam iti āśaṅkya kriyām vinā kāraka tva asaibhavāt tatra

original: kartṛkarmādikārakaireva svasvarūpalābhāya kriyā''kṣipyate, ākṣiptāṃ tāmādāya tatsaṃbandhādeva kārakatvaṃ kārakārthakaḥ pratyayaścopapadyata ityevaṃ bhāṭṭarītirna yuktetyarthaḥ| niruktabhāṭṭarīteranyatra klṛptarītiviruddhatvādayuktvaṃ pratipādayannāhaākhyāte'pīti| tiṅantasthale vyāpārarūpabhāvanā na dhātuvācyā|
analyzed: kartṛ karma ādi kārakaiḥ eva sva svarūpa lābhāya kriyā ākṣipyate ākṣiptām tām ādāya tad saṃbandhāt eva kāraka tvam kāraka arthakaḥ pratyayaḥ ca upapadyate iti evam bhāṭṭa rītiḥ na yuktā iti arthaḥ nirukta bhāṭṭa rīteḥ anyatra klṛpta rīti viruddha tvāt ayuktvam pratipādayan āha ākhyāte pi iti tiṅ anta sthale vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanā na dhātu vācyā

original: tathā sati tasyāḥ prādhānyena pratitirna syāt| kiṃtu tiṅsaṃjñakākhyātavācyaiva sā| vākyārthabodhe sarvataḥ prādhānyena tasyāḥ pratīyamānatvāt| prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthaprādhānyasya pāṭhaka aupagava ityādau klṛptatvāt| tadāgame hīti nyāyena tasyā ākhyātapratyayavācyatvaniścayācca| taduktam`pratyayārthaṃ saha brūtaḥ prakṛtipratyayau sadā|
analyzed: tathā sati tasyāḥ prādhānyena pratitiḥ na syāt kiṃtu tiṅ saṃjñaka ākhyāta vācyā eva sā vākya artha bodhe sarvatas prādhānyena tasyāḥ pratīyamāna tvāt prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya artha prādhānyasya pāṭhakaḥ aupagavaḥ ityādau klṛpta tvāt tad āgame hi iti nyāyena tasyāḥ ākhyāta pratyaya vācya tva niścayāt ca tat uktam pratyaya artham saha brūtaḥ prakṛti pratyayau sadā

original: prādhānyādbhāvanā tena pratyayārtho'vadhārte' iti| na ca tatra kartṛkarmapratītirna syāttadvācakābhāvāditi vācyam‌| bhāvanāvyāpāraḥ| vyāpāraśca nityaṃ sāśraya eva| nirāśrayasya vyāpārasyāsaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: prādhānyāt bhāvanā tena iti na ca tatra kartṛ karma pratītiḥ na syāt tad vācaka abhāvāt iti vācyam bhāvanā vyāpāraḥ vyāpāraḥ ca nityam sa āśrayaḥ eva nirāśrayasya vyāpārasya asaṃbhavāt

original: tathā ca yadyāśraya eva na syāccedbhāvanā'stitāmeva na pratipadyata iti bhāvanā''tmasvasvarūpalābhāya kartāramākṣipatyākṣepādeva kartṛkarmaṇoḥ pratipattisaṃbhave kimiti tadvācakatvamākhyātasya kalpanīyamityevaṃrītyā mīmāsakaiḥ prādhānyādbhāvanāyā ākhyātavācyatvaṃ siddhāntitam|
analyzed: tathā ca yadi āśrayaḥ eva na syāt ced bhāvanā astitām eva na pratipadyate iti bhāvanā ātma sva svarūpa lābhāya kartāram ākṣipati ākṣepāt eva kartṛ karmaṇoḥ pratipatti saṃbhave kim iti tad vācaka tvam ākhyātasya kalpanīyam iti evaṃrītyā mīmāsakaiḥ prādhānyāt bhāvanāyāḥ ākhyāta vācya tvam siddhāntitam

original: evaṃ sati yadi uparyuktā bhāṭṭarītirāśrīyeta tadāākhyāte'pitiṅsaṃjñakākhyāte'pītyarthaḥ| tathātvāpattāviti| kṛtsaṃjñakapratyayavattiṅsaṃjñakākhyātapratyayānāmapi kartṛkarmavācitvaṃ svīkṛtya tābhyāṃ kartṛkarmabhyāṃ svasvarūpalābhāyā''kṣiptāṃ kriyāmādāya tiṅāṃ kartṛkarmavācitvopapattau satyāmityarthaḥ| tatrāpīti|
analyzed: evam sati yadi upari uktā bhāṭṭa rītiḥ āśrīyeta tadā ākhyāta ipi tiṅ saṃjñaka ākhyāte ipi iti arthaḥ tathātva āpattau iti kṛt saṃjñaka pratyaya vat tiṅ saṃjñaka ākhyāta pratyayānām api kartṛ karma vāci tvam svīkṛtya tābhyām kartṛ karmabhyām sva svarūpa lābhāya ākṣiptām kriyām ādāya tiṅām kartṛ karma vāci tva upapattau satyām iti arthaḥ tatra api iti

original: tiṅ‌saṃjñakākhyāte'pi, bhāvanāyāḥvyāṣārasya, vācyatvaṃ tiṅ‌vācyatvaṃ naiva sidhyedityarthaḥ| tathā cānyatra klṛptasvasiddhāntaviruddhatvānniruktā bhāṭṭarītiḥ kāryamityādau nā''śrayituṃ yujyata iti bhāvaḥ| liṅgasakhyānvayeti|
analyzed: tiṅ saṃjñaka ākhyāte api bhāvanāyāḥ vyāṣārasya vācyatvam tiṅ vācya tvam na eva sidhyet iti arthaḥ tathā ca anyatra klṛpta sva siddhānta viruddha tvāt niruktā bhāṭṭa rītiḥ kāryam ityādau na āśrayitum yujyate iti bhāvaḥ liṅga sakhya anvaya iti

original: pakvavān pakvavatī, pakvastaṇḍula ityādau viklittyanukūlavyāpāravadabhinnaḥ puṃstvaikatvaviśiṣṭaścaitra ityādirītyā śābdabodhodayātpuṃstvādiliṅgaikatvādisaṃkhyānvayāya kṛtsu kartṛkarmādivācyatvamavaśyamāśrayaṇīyamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pakvavān pakvavatī pakvaḥ taṇḍulaḥ ityādau viklitti anukūla vyāpāra vat abhinnaḥ puṃstva ekatva viśiṣṭaḥ caitraḥ ityādi rītyā śābda bodha udayāt puṃstva ādi liṅga ekatva ādi saṃkhyā anvayāya kṛtsu kartṛ karma ādi vācyatvam avaśyam āśrayaṇīyam iti arthaḥ

original: tenakartṛkarmādinā, svasvarūpanirūpakatvena vyāpārasyā''kṣepāttatpratītiḥ syādityevaṃ manyate cedākhyāte'pi ekatvādiviśiṣṭo vyāpārāśraya iti bodhādekatvādi saṃkhyānvayāya kartṛkarmaṇī vācye syātām, pakvavānityādau bhūtakāliko devadattakartṛko vyāpāra iti bodhānurodhena vyāpāre viśeṣaṇatayā kālasya kārakasya cānvayadānārthaṃ bhāvanāyā api
analyzed: tena kartṛ karma ādinā sva svarūpa nirūpaka tvena vyāpārasya ākṣepāt tad pratītiḥ syāt iti evam manyate ced ākhyāte pi ekatva ādi viśiṣṭaḥ vyāpāra āśrayaḥ iti bodhāt ekatva ādi saṃkhyā anvayāya kartṛ karmaṇī vācye syātām pakvavān ityādau bhūta kālikaḥ devadatta kartṛkaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodha anurodhena vyāpāre viśeṣaṇatayā kālasya kārakasya ca anvaya dāna artham bhāvanāyāḥ api

original: vācyatvamavaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kṛtsvapītyapinā dhātorvyāpāravācakatvāvaśyakatve samuccitaṃ hetvantaraṃ pradarśayatitathā hītyādinā| nakhaurbhinna iti| vyāpārajanyadvidhābhavanaṃ bhididhātvarthaḥ| karmaṇi ktapratyayaḥ| nakhairiti karaṇe tṛtīyā| tathā ca nakhakaraṇakavyāpārajanyavidāraṇāśrayo hiraṇyakaśipuriti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: vācyatvam avaśyam aṅgīkaraṇīyam syāt iti arthaḥ kṛtsu api iti apinā dhātoḥ vyāpāra vācakatva āvaśyakatve samuccitam hetvantaram pradarśayati tathā hi ityādinā bhinnaḥ iti vyāpāra janya dvidhā bhavanam bhidi dhātvarthaḥ karmaṇi kta pratyayaḥ nakhaiḥ iti karaṇe tṛtīyā tathā ca nakha karaṇaka vyāpāra janya vidāraṇa āśrayaḥ hiraṇyakaśipuḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: tatra karoti kriyāṃ janayatīti vyutpattyā kriyājanakasya kārakattrapratīteḥ kriyāyāśca janyakriyāsākāṅkṣatvācca parasparamanvayena sāmarthyādvaiyākaraṇamate nakhabhinna iti samāso bhavati| evaṃ haritrāta ityatrāpi samāsa upapādyaḥ|
analyzed: tatra karoti kriyām janayati iti vyutpattyā kriyā janakasya kāraka ttra pratīteḥ kriyāyāḥ ca janya kriyā sākāṅkṣa tvāt ca parasparam anvayena sāmarthyāt vaiyākaraṇa mate nakha bhinnaḥ iti samāsaḥ bhavati evam haritrātaḥ iti atra api samāsaḥ upapādyaḥ

original: mīmāṃsakamate tu tiṅāmeva bhāvanārūpavyāpāravācakatvādatra tiṅabhāvena vyāpārarūpakriyāyā abhāvādaruṇādhikaraṇanyāyena kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvayātparasparaṃ tadananvayenāsāmarthyānnakhabhinnayoḥ karaṇakarmakārakayoḥ samāso na syādityarthaḥ| samāsābhāve sahetukaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ pradarśayannāhapuruṣo rājña ityādi|
analyzed: mīmāṃsaka mate tu tiṅām eva bhāvanā rūpa vyāpāra vācaka tvāt atra tiṅ abhāvena vyāpāra rūpa kriyāyāḥ abhāvāt aruṇa adhikaraṇa nyāyena kārakāṇām kriyayā eva anvayāt parasparam tad ananvayena asāmarthyāt nakha bhinnayoḥ karaṇa karma kārakayoḥ samāsaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ samāsa abhāve sa hetukam dṛṣṭāntam pradarśayan āha puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ ityādi

original: rājasaṃbandhī puruṣaḥ, devadattasaṃbandhinī bhāryetyevamanvaye vivakṣite rājño bhāryā ityanena yathā samāso na bhavati tayoḥ parasparamananvayenāsāmarthyāttadvannakhairbhinna ityādau samāso na syāditi bhāvaḥ| sāmarthyamupapādayituṃ śaṅkatena cādhyāhṛteti|
analyzed: rāja saṃbandhī puruṣaḥ devadatta saṃbandhinī bhāryā iti evam anvaye vivakṣite rājñaḥ bhāryā iti anena yathā samāsaḥ na bhavati tayoḥ parasparam ananvayena asāmarthyāt tadvat nakhaiḥ bhinnaḥ ityādau samāsaḥ na syāt iti bhāvaḥ sāmarthyam upapādayitum śaṅkatena ca adhyāhṛtā iti

original: yena vinā yadanupapannaṃ tattenā''kṣipyate iti nyāyena nakhairityasya karaṇakārakatvena kārakatvasya ca kriyājanakatvarūpatvena janakatvasya ca janyatvamantarā'nupapannatvāttena karaṇakārakeṇa svasvarūpanirūpakatayā''kṣipyamāṇāṃ karotikriyāṃ gṛhītvetyarthaḥ| sāmarthyamiti| anvayayogyatvarūpamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yena vinā yat anupapannam tat tena ākṣipyate iti nyāyena nakhaiḥ ityasya karaṇa kāraka tvena kāraka tvasya ca kriyā janaka tva rūpa tvena janaka tvasya ca janya tvam antarā anupapanna tvāt tena karaṇa kārakeṇa sva svarūpa nirūpaka tayā ākṣipyamāṇām karoti kriyām gṛhītvā iti arthaḥ sāmarthyam iti anvaya yogya tva rūpam iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca nakhakaraṇakavyāpārajanyabhedāśrayaḥ= nakhaiḥ kṛtvā bhinna iti śābdabodhajananādadhyāhṛtakriyāmādāya sāmarthyamupapādanīyamityartha| evamadhyāhṛtakriyāmādāya sāmarthyopapādane dṛṣṭāntaṃ pradarśayannāhadadhyodanao ityādivaditi| dadhnā odanaḥ, dadhyodanaḥ| annena vyañjanamiti tṛtīyātatpuruṣaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca nakha karaṇaka vyāpāra janya bheda āśrayaḥ nakhaiḥ kṛtvā bhinnaḥ iti śābda bodha jananāt adhyāhṛta kriyām ādāya sāmarthyam upapādanīyam iti arthaḥ evam adhyāhṛta kriyām ādāya sāmarthya upapādane dṛṣṭāntam pradarśayan āha ityādi vat iti dadhnā odanaḥ dadhyodanaḥ annena vyañjanam iti tṛtīyā tatpuruṣaḥ

original: saṃskārakadravyavācakaṃ tṛtīyāntamannena samasyata iti hi tatsūtrasyārthaḥ| atra dadhneti karaṇatṛtīyāntasya viśeṣaṇatayā odane'nvayasya bādhādvibhaktyarthakārakasya kriyopasarjananvena pratītiniyamādvibhaktyarthakārakeṇa vinā kriyāmanupapadyamānenā''kṣipyamāṇopasekakriyādvārā sāmarthyamaṅgīkṛtya samāsa upapāditaḥ|
analyzed: saṃskāraka dravya vācakam tṛtīyā antam annena samasyate iti hi tad sūtrasya arthaḥ atra dadhnā iti karaṇa tṛtīyā antasya viśeṣaṇa tayā odanena vayasya bādhāt vibhakti artha kārakasya kriyā upasarjana nvena pratīti niyamāt vibhakti artha kārakeṇa vinā kriyām anupapadyamānena ākṣipyamāṇa upaseka kriyā dvārā sāmarthyam aṅgīkṛtya samāsaḥ upapāditaḥ

original: evaṃ cātrānupapattyā''kṣepa evādhyāhārapadārthaḥ| yadi cātrādhyāhṛtakriyādvārā sāmarthyopapādanaṃ nāṅgīkriyeta cedasāmarthyātsamāso na syāditi spaṣṭameva| etadvannakhabhinna ityādāvapi adhyāhṛtakriyādvārā sāmarthyopapādanamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca atra anupapatti ākṣepaḥ eva adhyāhāra padārthaḥ yadi ca atra adhyāhṛta kriyā dvārā sāmarthya upapādanam na aṅgīkriyeta ced asāmarthyāt samāsaḥ na syāt iti spaṣṭam eva etadvat nakha bhinnaḥ ityādau api adhyāhṛta kriyā dvārā sāmarthya upapādanam āvaśyakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: anayā rītyā nakhabhinna ityādau yadadhyāhṛtakriyādvārā sāmarthyopapādanaṃ tanna yuktisahamiti nirācaṣṭetatra vidhyānarthakyādityādinā|
analyzed: anayā rītyā nakha bhinnaḥ ityādau yat adhyāhṛta kriyā dvārā sāmarthya upapādanam tat na yukti saham iti nirācaṣṭe tatra vidhi ānarthakyāt ityādinā

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥannena vyañjanamityāderanuśāsanasya padavidhitvātsamarthaḥ padavidhiritiparibhāṣopasthityā'dhyāhṛtakriyāntarbhāvamantarā kevalaṃ svarūpeṇa sāmarthyarahitapadānāṃ dadhyādīnāṃ niruktasūtreṇa samāsavidhānānupapatteragatyā dadhyodanādāvadhyāhṛtakriyādvārā sāmarthyopapādanena samāsāṅgīkāre'pi hariṇā kṛtaṃ harikṛtamityatra mīmāṃsakamate'pi
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ annena vyañjanam ityādeḥ anuśāsanasya pada vidhi tvāt samarthaḥ pada vidhiḥ iti paribhāṣā upasthityā adhyāhṛta kriyā antarbhāvam antarā kevalam sva rūpeṇa sāmarthya rahita padānām dadhi ādīnām nirukta sūtreṇa samāsa vidhāna anupapatteḥ agatyāḥ dadhyodana ādau adhyāhṛta kriyā dvārā sāmarthya upapādanena samāsa aṅgīkāre api hariṇā kṛtam hari kṛtam iti atra mīmāṃsaka mate pi

original: kṛdhātorvyāpāravācakatvāttanirūpitakartṛtvaṃ harau sākṣādidyate| tathā ca pratyāsattyā kṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātūpasthāpyakriyānirūpitakartṛkaraṇavācakatṛtīyāntaṃ kṛdantena samasyata iti kartṛkaraṇe kṛtetyasyārthāṃtkriyāmanaṣyāhṛtyaiva sākṣāddhātvarthānvayena śāstrasya caritārthatvena
analyzed: kṛ dhātoḥ vyāpāra vācaka tvāt tad nirūpita kartṛ tvam harau sākṣāt idyate tathā ca pratyāsattyā kṛt pratyaya prakṛti bhūta dhātu upasthāpya kriyā nirūpita kartṛ karaṇa vācaka tṛtīyā antam kṛt antena samasyate iti kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā iti asya arthān kriyām anaṣyāhṛtya eva sākṣāt dhātvartha anvayena śāstrasya caritārtha tvena

original: kartṛtvādyanyathānupapattyā''kṣipyamāṇasvakartṛkādikriyājanyatvaparamparāsaṃbandhamādāya haritrāta ityādau tatpravṛtterayogāt, mukhyābhāva eva gauṇagrahaṇaṃ yujyate nānyathetyarthāditi bhāvaḥ| nakhaminna ityādau mīmāṃsakarītyā sāmarthyopapādanagāśaṅkatena caikasyāmiti|

original: utpalaśabdastūtpalatvaviśiṣṭadravyaparaḥ| athavā so'pyākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenotpalatvajātiparo'stu| ubhayathā'pi nīlotpalaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena parasparamanvayasya bādhenāsāmarthyātsamāso na prāpnoti| utpalamasti ityutpalasya kartṛtvenāstikriyāyāmanvayaḥ, tādṛśotpalaniṣṭhaṃ ca nīlarūpamityāśrayadvārā nīlasyāpi tathā'stikriyāyāmanvayaḥ|

original: tathā ca prakṛte'pi noktaparamparāsaṃbandhena tayoranvayaḥ, kiṃtu ekakriyānvayitvarūpameva sāmarthyaṃ tacca nakhairityasya karaṇatvena karotikriyāyāmanvayādbhinna ityasya ca tasyāmeva karmatve(svaniṣṭhavidāraṇajanakatve)nānvayādastīti na samāsānupapattirityāśayaḥ śaṅkituriti bhāvaḥ| tadetad‌dūṣayatiasūryaṃpaśyā ityādinā|
analyzed: tathā ca prakṛte api na ukta paramparā saṃbandhena tayoḥ anvayaḥ kiṃtu eka kriyā anvayi tva rūpam eva sāmarthyam tat ca nakhaiḥ ityasya karaṇa tvena karoti kriyāyām anvayāt bhinnaḥ iti asya ca tasyām eva karma tve sva niṣṭha vidāraṇa janakatvena anvayāt asti iti na samāsa anupapattiḥ iti āśayaḥ śaṅkituḥ iti bhāvaḥ tat etat dūṣayati a sūryam paśyāḥ ityādinā

original: as‌rpalalāṭayordṛśitapoḥ, ityasyāyamarthaḥasūrye lalāṭe ca karmaṇyupapade dṛṇestapeśca khaś syāditi| tathā cāsūryaśabde upapade dṛśeḥ khaśi śittvātpāghrādhyepi paśyādeśe, arurdviṣadajantasyeti pūrvapadasya mumāgame asūryaṃpaśyetyasya siddhiḥ| sūryakarmakadarśanābāvavanta iti bodhaḥ|
