original: asūryaṃpaśyā rājadārā ityatra darśanakriyāyā evābhāvabodhena sūryaśabdārdena nañarthasyānvayavirahādasamarthasamāsatvenābhimato bhāṣyakārāderityarthaḥ| anāpatteriti| tava mate tadasamarthasamāsatvaṃ bhajyeta|
analyzed: a sūryaṃpaśyāḥ rāja dārāḥ iti atra darśana kriyāyāḥ eva abhāva bodhena sūrya śabda ardena nañ arthasya anvaya virahāt asamartha samāsa tvena abhimataḥ bhāṣyakāra ādeḥ iti arthaḥ anāpatteḥ iti tava mate tad asamartha samāsa tvam bhajyeta

original: sūryaṃ na paśyantītyarthe nañarthaprasajyapratiṣedhasya darśatakriyāyāmanvayātsūryasyāpi tasyāmeva karmatayā'nvayādekakriyānvayatitvarūpasāmarathyasattvādityarthaḥ| ityāderityādinā aśrāddhabhojītyādirgrāhyaḥ| śrāddhaṃ na bhuṅkte ityarthena tasyāpyasamarthasamāsatvāt|
analyzed: sūryam na paśyanti iti arthe nañ artha prasajya pratiṣedhasya darśata kriyāyām anvayāt sūryasya api tasyām eva karmatayā anvayāt eka kriyā anvayati tva rūpa sāmarathya sattvāt iti arthaḥ ityādeḥ ityādinā aśrāddha bhojī ityādiḥ grāhyaḥ śrāddham na bhuṅkte iti arthena tasya api asamartha samāsa tvāt

original: nanu darśanakriyāyāmevobhayoranvayād bhavatvasūryaṃpaśyetyādeḥ samarthasamāsatvaṃ kā hāniriti cedāhaiṣṭāpattāvatti| kṛtaḥ sarvo mṛttikayā ityarthe kṛtaḥ `sarvamṛttikaḥ' iti sarvamṛttikayoḥ samāsāpattiḥ| mṛttikāyāḥ karaṇatvena, sarvaśabdārthasya ca karmatvena kṛdhātvarthe'nvayenaikakriyānvayitvarūpasāmarthyasattvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu darśana kriyāyām eva ubhayoḥ anvayāt bhavatu a sūryam paśya ityādeḥ samartha samāsa tvam kā hāniḥ iti ced āha eṣṭāpattau atti kṛtaḥ sarvaḥ mṛttikayā iti arthe kṛtaḥ sarva mṛttikaḥ iti sarva mṛttikayoḥ samāsa āpattiḥ mṛttikāyāḥ karaṇa tvena sarva śabda arthasya ca karma tvena eka kriyā anvayi tva rūpa sāmarthya sattvāt iti arthaḥ

original: asmanmate tu mṛttikāyāḥ karaṇakārakatvena kārakasya ca kriyayaivānvayaniyamātsarvaśabdasya kriyāśabdatvābhāvenānvayāyogyatayā'sa marthyānnaiva samāso bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|sāmartaayābhāvādeva ca sarvaścarmaṇā kṛta ityarthe `sarvacarmaṇaḥ' iti nipātanātsamāsa ityuktaṃ sarvacarmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ khakhañāviti sūtre|
analyzed: asmad mate tu mṛttikāyāḥ karaṇa kāraka tvena kārakasya ca kriyayā eva anvaya niyamāt sarva śabdasya kriyā śabda tva abhāvena anvaya ayogyatayā a samarthyāt na eva samāsaḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ sāmartaayā abhāvāt eva ca sarvaḥ carmaṇā kṛtaḥ iti arthe sarva carmaṇaḥ iti nipātanāt samāsaḥ iti uktam sarva carmaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ kha khañau iti sūtre

original: nanvekakriyānvayitvena sarvamṛttikayoḥ sāmarthyasattve'pi kartṛkaraṇe kṛtetyanena karaṇatṛtīyāntasya kṛdantena samāsavidhānena sarvaśabdasya kṛdantatvābhāvātsamāsavidhāyakāprāptyā samāso na syādityāśaṅkyā''hana cātreti| sarvamṛttika ityatra samāsavidhāyakābhāvo naivamantavyaḥ|
analyzed: nanu eka kriyā anvayi tvena sarva mṛttikayoḥ sāmarthya sattve pi kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā iti anena karaṇa tṛtīyā antasya kṛt antena samāsa vidhānena sarva śabdasya kṛt anta tva abhāvāt samāsa vidhāyaka aprāptyā samāsaḥ na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha na ca atra iti sarva mṛttikaḥ iti atra samāsa vidhāyaka abhāvaḥ na eva mantavyaḥ

original: sarvaśabdasya kṛdantatvābhāvena kartṛkaraṇe kṛtetyasyāprāptāvapi `sahasupā' ityasyaiva vidhāyakasya sattvādityarthaḥ| nanu saha supetyasya samāsavidhāyakatvābhāve kā hāniriti cettatrā''haanyatheti na syāditi| tathā cāsamarthasamāsa ityuktirbhāṣyakṛdāderna saṃgaccheteti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sarva śabdasya kṛt anta tva abhāvena kartṛ karaṇe kṛtā iti asya aprāptau api saha supā ityasya eva vidhāyakasya sattvāt iti arthaḥ nanu saha supā ityasya samāsa vidhāyaka tva abhāve kā hāniḥ iti ced tatra āha anyathā iti na syāt iti tathā ca asamartha samāsaḥ iti uktiḥ bhāṣyakṛt ādeḥ na saṃgaccheta iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu siddhānte saha supetyagatikagatitvātsamarthaparibhāṣāviṣayatvācca nātrā''śrīyate| anyathā dvitīyā śritetyādisūtraistattatsamāsavidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| saha supetyatra samarthaparibhāṣānupasthitiśca kalpanīyā syāt| asamarthasamāsa ityuktistu nipātanātsamāsa ityevaṃparatayā nirvāhyā|
analyzed: nanu siddhānte saha supā iti agatika gati tvāt samartha paribhāṣā viṣaya tvāt ca na atra āśrīyate anyathā dvitīyā śritā ityādi sūtraiḥ tat tat samāsa vidhānam vyartham syāt saha supā iti atra samartha paribhāṣā anupasthitiḥ ca kalpanīyā syāt asamartha samāsaḥ iti uktiḥ tu nipātanāt samāsaḥ iti evaṃpara tayā nirvāhyā

original: tathā ca vidhāyakābhāvadanābhidhānādvā sarvamṛttika iti samāso na syādityāśayavānāhakiṃ ceti| bhāvayati ghaṭamiti| bhāvanāyāstiṅvācyatve phalamātre dhātorarthaḥ| tathā ca bhūdhātorutpattirarthaḥ| ṇijarthaśca vyāpāraḥ| tasya cānukūlatāsaṃsargeṇotpattāvanvayaḥ| utpattyanukūlo vyāpāra ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca sarva mṛttikaḥ iti samāsaḥ na syāt iti āśayavān āha kim ca iti bhāvayati ghaṭam iti bhāvanāyāḥ tiṅ vācya tve phala mātre dhātoḥ arthaḥ tathā ca bhū dhātoḥ utpattiḥ arthaḥ ṇic arthaḥ ca vyāpāraḥ tasya ca anukūlatā saṃsargeṇa utpattau anvayaḥ utpatti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca bhāvayati ghaṭamityatra ṇijarthavyāpārajanyotpattyāśrayatvād‌ghaṭaraya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ karmaṇi dvitīyā yathā bhavati tathā bhavati ghaṭaḥ ityatrāpi bhūdhātorutpattirarthaḥ| tiṅaśca vyāpāro'rthaḥ| anakūlatāsaṃsargeṇānvaye utpattyanukūlo vyāpāra ityarthaḥ saṃpannaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca bhāvayati ghaṭam iti atra karma saṃjñāyām karmaṇi dvitīyā yathā bhavati tathā bhavati ghaṭaḥ iti atra api bhū dhātoḥ utpattiḥ arthaḥ tiṅaḥ ca vyāpāra arthaḥ anakūla tā saṃsargeṇa anvaye utpatti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti arthaḥ saṃpannaḥ

original: tathā ca tiṅarthavyāpārajanyotpattyāśrayatvād‌ghaṭaraya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ dvitīyotpattau bhavati ghaṭaḥ ityasya sthāne bhavati ghaṭamiti syāt| dhātvarthaphaleti| ubhayatrāpi ghaṭasya bhūdhātvarthotpattirūpaphalāśrayatvena karmasaṃjñāyāḥ dūṣaṇamuddhartumāśaṅkatena cā''khyāteti|
analyzed: tathā ca tiṅ artha vyāpāra janya utpatti āśraya tvāt ghaṭa raya karma saṃjñāyām dvitīya utpattau bhavati ghaṭaḥ iti asya sthāne bhavati ghaṭam iti syāt dhātvartha phala iti ubhayatra api ghaṭasya bhū dhātvartha utpatti rūpa phala āśraya tvena karma saṃjñāyāḥ dūṣaṇam uddhartum āśaṅkatena ca ākhyātā iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥṇijante prayojakavyāpāro ṇijarthaḥ, sa eva ṇijantottaratiṅ‌pratyayenānūdyate na tu prayojyavyāpāra ucyate| aṇijante tu tiṅ‌pratyayena prayojyavyāpāra ākhyāyate| evaṃ ca dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyam| tathā ca ghaṭaṃ bhāvayatītyatra ghaṭasya kartṛtvābhāve sati ṇijarthavyāpāranirūpitaṃ karmatvaṃ nirapavādamiti dvitīyā bhavati|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ ṇij ante prayojaka vyāpāraḥ ṇij arthaḥ saḥ eva ṇij anta uttara tiṅpratyayena anūdyate na tu prayojya vyāpāraḥ ucyate a ṇij ante tu tiṅpratyayena prayojya vyāpāraḥ ākhyāyate evam ca dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ vaiṣamyam tathā ca ghaṭam bhāvayati iti atra ghaṭasya kartṛ tva abhāve sati ṇij artha vyāpāra nirūpitam karmatvam nirapavādam iti dvitīyā bhavati

original: ghaṭo bhavatītyatra tvākhyātārthavyapārāśrayatayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhitatvānna ghaṭasya karmatvamityartha iti| vaiyākaraṇastadetad‌dūṣayatiākhyātārthavyāpāreti| aṇyanta(śuddha)dhātusamabhivyāhṛtākhyātārthavyāpārāśrayasya kartṛtva ityarthaḥ| pācayati devadatta iti| pacayati viṣṇumitra ityaṇyantāvasthā| pācayati devadatto viṣṇumitreṇeti ṇyantāvasthā|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ bhavati iti atra tu ākhyāta artha vyapāra āśrayatayā kartṛ saṃjñayā bādhita tvāt na ghaṭasya karma tvam iti arthaḥ iti vaiyākaraṇaḥ tat etat dūṣayati ākhyāta artha vyāpāra iti aṇi anta śuddha dhātu samabhivyāhṛta ākhyāta artha vyāpāra āśrayasya kartṛ tve iti arthaḥ pācayati devadattaḥ iti pacayati viṣṇumitraḥ iti aṇi antā avasthā pācayati devadattaḥ viṣṇumitreṇa iti ṇi antā avasthā

original: tatra ṇyantāvasthāyāmākhyātārthavyāpārāśrayatvena viṣṇumitrasya kartṛtve'pi ṇyantasthale ṇij‌vācyaprayojakavyāpārasyaivā''khyātapratyayenābhidānāttādvaśākhyātārthavyāpārāśrayatvena prayojakadevadattasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ syānna tu prayojyasya viṣṇumitrasya ṇyantadhaātusamamivyāhṛtākhaayātārthavyāpārāśrayatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: tatra ṇic anta avasthāyām ākhyāta artha vyāpāra āśraya tvena viṣṇumitrasya kartṛ tve api ṇic anta sthale ṇic vācya prayojaka vyāpārasya eva ākhyāta pratyayena abhidānāt tādvaśa ākhyāta artha vyāpāra āśraya tvena prayojaka devadattasya eva kartṛ tvam syāt na tu prayojyasya viṣṇumitrasya

original: tathā ca viṣṇumitrasya kartṛsaṃjñāyā abhāvena kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyeti tṛtīyā na syādityaniṣṭāpattirityarthaḥ| manmate tu na doṣaḥ| viklittyanukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāraḥ pācayaterarthaḥ| tatra ṇic‌prakṛtibhūtapac‌dhātuvācyavyāpārāśrayatvena viṣṇumitrasya kartṛtvāttṛtīyopapatteḥ suvacatvāt| grāmaṃ gamayatīti|
analyzed: tathā ca viṣṇumitrasya kartṛ saṃjñāyāḥ abhāvena kartṛ karaṇayoḥ tṛtīyā iti tṛtīyā na syāt iti aniṣṭa āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ mad mate tu na doṣaḥ viklitti anukūla vyāpāra anukūla vyāpāraḥ pācayateḥ arthaḥ tatra ṇic prakṛti bhūta pac dhātu vācya vyāpāra āśraya tvena viṣṇumitrasya kartṛ tvāt tṛtīyā upapatteḥ suvaca tvāt grāmam gamayati iti

original: ṇijantasthale pūrvoktarītyā prayojyasya viṣṇumitrasya kartṛtvābhāvena kartṛniṣṭhavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayasya karturīptitatamamityanena vihitā karmasaṃjñā viṣṇumitraniṣṭhavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayasyāpi grāmasya na syāt|
analyzed: ṇic anta sthale pūrvokta rītyā prayojyasya viṣṇumitrasya kartṛ tva abhāvena kartṛ niṣṭha vyāpāra janya phala āśrayasya kartuḥ īptitatamam iti anena vihitā karma saṃjñā viṣṇumitra niṣṭha vyāpāra janya phala āśrayasya api grāmasya na syāt

original: grāmaṃ gacchati viṣṇumitra śyaṇyantasthale mīmāṃsakamate viṣṇumitrasyā''khyātārthavyāpārāśrayatayā kartṛsaṃjñāyāṃ tādṛśakartṛniṣṭhavyāpārajanyadātvarthasaṃyogaphalāśrayasya grāmasya karmasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ yathā gamikarmatā bhavati tadviṇṇijantasthale vidhṇumitraniṣṭhavyāpārajanyadhātvarthasaṃyogaphalāśrayasyāpi grāmasya
analyzed: grāmam gacchati viṣṇumitra śyaṇi anta sthale mīmāṃsaka mate viṣṇumitrasya ākhyāta artha vyāpāra āśraya tayā kartṛ saṃjñāyām tādṛśa kartṛ niṣṭha vyāpāra janya dātvartha saṃyoga phala āśrayasya grāmasya karma saṃjñāyām satyām yathā gami karmatā bhavati tad viṣṇij anta sthale vidhṇumitra niṣṭha vyāpāra janya dhātvartha saṃyoga phala āśrayasya api grāmasya

original: ākhyātatadarthavyāpārāśrayayorekavākyasthatve satyevā''khyātārthavyāpāpāśrayasya kartṛtvamityavaśyaṃ vaktavyam, anyathā ghaṭo vidyate ityatratyaṃ tādṛśavyāpārāśrayatvamādāya ghaṭaṃ karotītyatra ghaṭapadottaraṃ prathamāpattiḥ syāt|

original: vyāpārarūpakriyāvācakatvamantarā bhūvādaya ityetadvākyārthabodhāsaṃbhavena dhātupadārthajñānāsaṃbhavāttadanyatamatvarūpadhātutvasya suraguruṇā'pi jñātumaśakyatvāt| ata evābhiprāyādāhaastu yathākaramiti| vyāpārasaṃtāna iti| yathā cullyadhiśrayaṇamārabya cullydhaḥśrayaṇaparyanto vyāpārasamūhaḥ kriyetipadavācya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: vyāpāra rūpa kriyā vācaka tvam antarā bhū ādayaḥ iti etad vākya artha bodha asaṃbhavena dhātu padārtha jñāna asaṃbhavāt tad anyatama tva rūpa dhātu tvasya suraguruṇā api jñātum aśakya tvāt atas eva abhiprāyāt āha astu yathā ākaram iti vyāpāra saṃtānaḥ iti yathā cullī adhiśrayaṇam ārabya cullī dhas śrayaṇa paryantaḥ vyāpāra samūhaḥ kriyā iti pada vācyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ bhvādiṣu sarvatra dhātuṣu kriyāpadavācyo vyāpārasamūha ūhyaḥ| phalavyāpārayordhāturityuktatvāt| tādṛśakriyāvācakatve sati bhvaudigaṇapaṭhitatvamityeva bhāṣyānasāri dhātutvalakṣaṇamastitvatyarthaḥ| bhūvādaya iti sūtrārthaviṣaye śaṅkatenanu sattādīniti| sattāviklittyādayo ye phalāṃśāstadanyatamavācakatve sati gaṇapaṭhitatvaṃ dhātutvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam bhū ādiṣu sarvatra dhātuṣu kriyā pada vācyaḥ vyāpāra samūhaḥ ūhyaḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātuḥ iti ukta tvāt tādṛśa kriyā vācaka tve sati bhvaudi gaṇa paṭhita tvam iti eva bhāṣyā anasāri dhātu tva lakṣaṇam astitva iti arthaḥ bhū ādayaḥ iti sūtra artha viṣaye śaṅkate nanu sattā ādīn iti sattā viklitti ādayaḥ ye phala aṃśāḥ tad anyatama vācaka tve sati gaṇa paṭhita tvam dhātu tvam iti arthaḥ

original: lakṣaṇamiti| bhūvādaya iti sūtrajavākyārthaṃrūpamityarthaḥ| sattādiphalavācakatvena vāśabdasādṛśyaṃ gṛhyate, na kriyāvācakatveneti tātparyam| phalāṃśānyatamavācakatvetyupādāne sūtravaiyarthyaśaṅkā'pi nodetīti bhāvaḥ| nanu kriyāvacano dhāturiti bhāṣyavyavahāraḥ kathaṃ saṃgamanīyaḥ? phalāṃśasya kriyātvābhāvādata āhadhātvarthatvāditi|
analyzed: lakṣaṇam iti bhū ādayaḥ iti sūtra ja vākyārthaṃrūpam iti arthaḥ sattā ādi phala vācaka tvena vāśabda sādṛśyam gṛhyate na kriyā vācaka tvena iti tātparyam phala aṃśa anyatama vācaka tva iti upādāne sūtra vaiyarthya śaṅkā api na udeti iti bhāvaḥ nanu kriyā vacanaḥ dhātuḥ iti bhāṣya vyavahāraḥ katham saṃgamanīyaḥ phala aṃśasya kriyā tva abhāvāt atas āha dhātvartha tvāt iti

original: yatkiṃcinniṣṭhavyāpārātmakakriyājanyaphalavācitvāddhātvarthaphalasyāpi gauṇaḥ kriyātvavyavahāra iti cennaitadbhadramityāhaanyatamamadhya ityādinā|
analyzed: yat kiṃcid niṣṭha vyāpāra ātmaka kriyā janya phala vāci tvāt dhātvartha phalasya api gauṇaḥ kriyā tva vyavahāraḥ iti ced na etat bhadram iti āha anyatama madhye ityādinā

original: vikalpārthakasya vikalpayatīti prayogasya darśanādvikalpasyāpyanya tamamadhye praveśāvaśyakatvena gaṇapaṭhitavāśabdasādṛśyādvikalpārthakavetyavyavasyāpi bhvādigaṇe praveśāvaśyakatvena tatra dhātutvātivyāpterduruddharatvāditi bhāvaḥ|| 11 ||
analyzed: vikalpa arthakasya vikalpayati iti prayogasya darśanāt vikalpasya api anya tama madhye praveśa āvaśyaka tvena gaṇa paṭhita vā śabda sādṛśyāt vikalpa arthaka vetya vyavasyā api bhvādi gaṇe praveśa āvaśyaka tvena tatra dhātu tva ativyāpteḥ duruddhara tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: śaṅkatenanviti asyaiveti| bhvādigaṇapaṭhitatve sati kriyāvācakatvasyaiva dhātutve ityarthaḥ| evakāreṇa phalamātravācakatvasya vyāvṛttiḥ| kriyāpratītyabhāvāditi| asti bhavati vidyate ityāditaḥ sattārūpaphalasyaiva pratītirjāyate, na tu tadatiriktāyā vyāpārarūpakriyāyāḥ|
analyzed: śaṅkate nanu iti asya eva iti bhvādi gaṇa paṭhita tve sati kriyā vācaka tvasya eva dhātu tve iti arthaḥ evakāreṇa phala mātra vācaka tvasya vyāvṛttiḥ kriyā pratīti abhāvāt iti asti bhavati vidyate iti āditas sattā rūpa phalasya eva pratītiḥ jāyate na tu tad atiriktāyāḥ vyāpāra rūpa kriyāyāḥ

original: ata eva kiṃ karotīti kriyāpraśne pacatītyuttaravadastītyuttaraṃ na, astītyataḥ kriyāpratītyabhāvādityarthaḥ| adhātutvaprasaṅga iti| astyādīnāṃ kriyāvācakatvābhāvāddhātutvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ| tataśca laḍādirna syādata āhaastyādāviti| dharmibhāgesattādirūpe dharmiṇo bhāga ityarthaḥ| sattādiphalarūpadharmaghaṭito'rtho dharmī|
analyzed: atas eva kim karoti iti kriyā praśne pacati iti uttara vat asti iti uttaram na asti iti atas kriyā pratīti abhāvāt iti arthaḥ adhātu tva prasaṅgaḥ iti asti ādīnām kriyā vācaka tva abhāvāt dhātu tvam na syāt iti arthaḥ tatas ca laḍ ādiḥ na syāt atas āha asti ādau iti dharmi bhāge sattā ādi rūpe dharmiṇaḥ bhāgaḥ iti arthaḥ sattā ādi phala rūpa dharma ghaṭitaḥ ūrthaḥ dharmī

original: dharmī ca sakarmakasthale karmapadārthastaṇḍulādiḥ| akarmakasthale tu phalasya kartṛniṣṭhatvātkartṛpadārtho devadattādireva dharmī bodhyaḥ| vastusad bhāvyaṃ bhāvanāpratītijanakaṃ na bhavatītyata āhabhāvyatveneti| bhāvanārūpavyāpāraniṣpadyatvenetyarthaḥ| vivakṣita iti| vaktumiṣṭatva ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: dharmī ca sakarmaka sthale karma padārthaḥ taṇḍula ādiḥ akarmaka sthale tu phalasya kartṛ niṣṭhatvāt kartṛ padārthaḥ devadatta ādiḥ eva dharmī bodhyaḥ vastu sat bhāvyam bhāvanā pratīti janakam na bhavati iti atas āha bhāvyatvena iti bhāvanā rūpa vyāpāra niṣpadyatvena iti arthaḥ vivakṣitaḥ iti vaktum iṣṭatve iti arthaḥ

original: phalaniṣpādakavyāpārasya jijñāsitatva iti phalito'rthaḥ| tadeva jijñāsāsthalaṃ pradarśayitumāhasa tato gato na veti gamidātorgatyarthākarmaketi kartari ktaḥ| vibhāgānukūlo vyāpāro'tra gamidhātvarthatatpradeśāvidhikavibāgānukūlavyāpāravānna veti saṃpratyayāt|
analyzed: phala niṣpādaka vyāpārasya jijñāsita tve iti phalitaḥ ṛthaḥ tat eva jijñāsā sthalam pradarśayitum āha sa tatas gataḥ na vā iti gami dātoḥ gati artha akarmakā iti kartari ktaḥ vibhāga anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ utra gami dhātvartha tad pradeśa avidhika vibāga anukūla vyāpāravān na vā iti saṃpratyayāt

original: tathā cātra praśne patīyamānāṃ vyāpāraviṣayakajijñāsāṃ sattānukūlavyāpārakathanadvārā nivartayitumuttaramāhamahatā yatnenāstīti| pratīyata eveti| atra yatnapadopādānādyatnajanyā satteti kathanādas dhātoḥ sattānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ pratīyata evetyarthaḥ| na ga ityarthaparyavasānājjijñāsānivṛttirbhavatītyastītyasya praśrottaratvaṃ ca| sutarāmiti|
analyzed: tathā ca atra praśne vyāpāra viṣayaka jijñāsām sattā anukūla vyāpāra kathana dvārā nivartayitum uttaram āha mahatā yatnena asti iti pratīyate eva iti atra yatna pada upādānāt yatna janyā sattā iti dhātoḥ sattā anukūlaḥ vyāpāra ūrthaḥ pratīyate eva iti arthaḥ na gaḥ iti artha paryavasānāt jijñāsā nivṛttiḥ bhavati iti asti ityasya ca sutarām iti

original: utpattyādyarthavivakṣāyāmastyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatvadhrauvyamiti śeṣaḥ| utpattyanukūlavyāpārapratītestatra sarvānubhavasiddhatvāt| sattārthakatve kvacideva vyāpārapratītiḥ, utpattyādyarthakatve tu sarvatraiva vyāpārapratītiriti bodhanāya sutarāmiti ratabantoktiḥ| utpattyādītyādipadena parābhavatītyatra parābhavasya saṃgrahaḥ|
analyzed: utpatti ādi artha vivakṣāyām asti ādīnām vyāpāra vācakatva dhrauvyam iti śeṣaḥ utpatti anukūla vyāpāra pratīteḥ tatra sarva anubhava siddha tvāt sattā arthaka tve kvacid eva vyāpāra pratītiḥ utpatti ādi arthaka tve tu sarvatra eva vyāpāra pratītiḥ iti bodhanāya sutarām iti rata banta uktiḥ utpatti ādi ityādi padena parābhavati iti atra parābhavasya saṃgrahaḥ

original: astyāderutpattyarthakatve rāmāyaṇaprayogaṃ pramāmayatirohitaoo iti| āsīt, abhavat, ityanayorudapadyatetyarthaḥ| sattārthakatve'nubhavavirodhaḥ| vaṃśāvalyāmutpattyarthasyaivānubhavasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| astyādeḥ sattāsamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatve pramāṇāntaramapyāhakiṃ ceti| laḍādivyavasthā na syāditi|
analyzed: asti ādeḥ utpatti arthaka tve rāmāyaṇa prayogam iti āsīt abhavat iti anayoḥ udapadyata iti arthaḥ sattā arthaka tva inubhava virodhaḥ vaṃśāvalyām utpatti arthasya eva anubhava siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ asti ādeḥ sattā samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tve pramāṇa antaram api āha kim ca iti laḍ ādi vyavasthā na syāt iti

original: astyādervyāpārāvācakatve vartamāne laṭ, bhūte luṅ, bhaviṣyati lṛṅ, ityevaṃ laḍādervyavasthā na syādityarthaḥ| vartamānādikālavṛttitvena vivakṣāyāṃ vartamāne laḍityādinā laḍādividhānādityarthaḥ| vartamānatvādīnāṃ kālagatatvena sarvānubhavasiddhatvādvartamānādiśabdāḥ kālaviśeṣabodhakāḥ| tasyā evetyevakāreṇa phalaṃ vyāvartyate|
analyzed: asti ādeḥ vyāpāra a vācaka tve vartamāne laṭ bhūte luṅ bhaviṣyati lṛṅ iti evam laṭ ādeḥ vyavasthā na syāt iti arthaḥ vartamāna ādi kāla vṛtti tvena vivakṣāyām vartamāne laṭ ityādinā laṭ ādi vidhānāt iti arthaḥ vartamāna tva ādīnām kāla gata tvena sarva anubhava siddha tvāt vartamāna ādi śabdāḥ kāla viśeṣa bodhakāḥ tasyāḥ eva iti evakāreṇa phalam vyāvartyate

original: phale vartamānatvādyananvayasya prāgupapādanīditi bhāvaḥ| tatraiva mānamāhakriyābhedāyetyādi| bhedāyeti caturthī tādarthye, tumarthāditi vā bodhyā| vartamānatvādiviśiṣṭakriyāyā itarakriyāto vyāvartanāya laḍādibodhyaḥ kāla ityarthaḥ| kriyābhedāyetyasya sarvaṃ vākyamiti nyāyena sāvadhāraṇatvāllaḍādibodhyaḥ kālaḥ kriyāyā eva bhedakaḥ|
analyzed: phale vartamāna tva ādi ananvayasya prāk upapādanīt iti bhāvaḥ tatra eva mānam āha kriyā bhedāya ityādi bhedāya iti caturthī tādarthye tumun arthāt iti vā bodhyā vartamāna tva ādi viśiṣṭa kriyāyāḥ itara kriyātaḥ vyāvartanāya laḍ ādi bodhyaḥ kālaḥ iti arthaḥ kriyā bhedāya iti asya sarvam vākyam iti nyāyena sāvadhāraṇa tvāt laḍ ādi bodhyaḥ kālaḥ kriyāyāḥ eva bhedakaḥ

original: ataḥ kriyāyāmeva kālānvayaḥ| saptiṅarthasaṃkhyā tu sarvasya = ākhyātapratipadikārthasya bhediketi vākyapadīyārthaḥ| bhūvādisūtre bhāṣye'pyuktaṃnāntareṇa kriyāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānāḥ kālā vyajyante| astyādibhiścāpi bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānakālā vyajyante' iti| asti, abhūt, bhaviṣyatīti kālaviśeṣāvagamāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atas kriyāyām eva kāla anvayaḥ sap tiṅ artha saṃkhyā tu sarvasya ākhyāta pratipadikā arthasya bhedikā iti vākyapadīya arthaḥ bhūvādi sūtre bhāṣye pi uktam na antareṇa kriyām bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamānāḥ kālāḥ vyajyante asti ādibhiḥ ca api bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamāna kālāḥ vyajyante iti asti abhūt bhaviṣyati iti kāla viśeṣa avagamāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasmādyadyatra kriyā na syāttarhi laḍādikamapi na syāditi bodhyam| tathā ca bhāṣyakārādyanubhava evāstyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatve pramāṇamityāśayaḥ| anyatrāśeṣabhāvādityuttarārdhamavatārayituṃ śaṅkatenanviti| evamiti| dhātorvyāpāravācakatve satītyarthaḥ aśeṣabhāvāditi| śeṣabhāvaḥpṛthagbhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt yadi atra kriyā na syāt tarhi laḍ ādikam api na syāt iti bodhyam tathā ca bhāṣyakāra ādi anubhavaḥ eva asti ādīnām vyāpāra vācaka tve pramāṇam iti āśayaḥ anyatra aśeṣa bhāvāt iti uttara ardham avatārayitum śaṅkate nanu iti evam iti dhātoḥ vyāpāra vācaka tve sati iti arthaḥ aśeṣa bhāvāt iti śeṣa bhāvaḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ

original: bhinnādikaraṇaniṣṭhatvaṃ, tadabhāva ekādhikaraṇaniṣṭatvaṃ tasmāt, bhāvanāphalayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyādityarthaḥ| sā vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā| tathāspaṣṭaṃ na prakāśate| tatspaṣṭatva iti| bhāvanāyāḥ spaṣṭaṃ pratibhāna ityarthaḥ| doṣa iti| tathā ca dūratvādikamiva phalabhāvanayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ svaṣṭapratītā pratibandhakamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhinna ādi karaṇa niṣṭha tvam tad abhāvaḥ eka adhikaraṇa niṣṭa tvam tasmāt bhāvanā phalayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt iti arthaḥ sā vyāpāra rūpā bhāvanā tathā aspaṣṭam na prakāśate tad spaṣṭa tve iti bhāvanāyāḥ spaṣṭam pratibhāne iti arthaḥ doṣaḥ iti tathā ca dūra tva ādikam iva phala bhāvanayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ pratibandhakam iti arthaḥ

original: praśna iti| vyāpāraviśeṣaviṣayakapraśna ityarthaḥ| pacatītyuttaravaditi| pacidhātorvyāpāraviśeṣavācitvasya suprasiddhatvāttasya praśnottaratvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ| uttaramapi syāditi| astyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācitve'pi astītyasyottaratvaṃ neṣyate, vyāpārasāmānyavācitvāttasya, kimuta vyāpārāvācakatva iti śaṅkakāśayaḥ|
analyzed: praśnaḥ iti vyāpāra viśeṣa viṣayaka praśnaḥ iti arthaḥ pacati iti uttara vat iti paci dhātoḥ vyāpāra viśeṣa vāci tvasya su prasiddha tvāt tasya praśna uttaratvam yujyate iti arthaḥ uttaram api syāt iti asti ādīnām vyāpāra vāci tve api asti iti asya uttaratvam na iṣyate vyāpāra sāmānya vāci tvāt tasya kim uta vyāpāra avācaka tve iti śaṅkaka āśayaḥ

original: siddhāntī vyāpārasāmānyavācitve'pi tasyotaratvamiṣṭamevetyāhaiṣṭāpatteriti| tadeveṣṭāpattisthalaṃ darśayatiāsannavināśamityārabhyottarasya sarvasamatatvādityantena| tathā cāstyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatvamavaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ| itaratraāsannavināśabhinne| susthatayā niścita iti|
analyzed: siddhāntī vyāpāra sāmānya vācitve api tasya utaratvam iṣṭam eva iti āha eṣṭāpatteḥ iti tat eva iṣṭāpatti sthalam darśayati āsanna vināśam iti ārabhya uttarasya sarva samata tvāt ityantena tathā ca asti ādīnām vyāpāra vācaka tvam avaśyakam iti bhāvaḥ itaratra āsanna vināśa bhinne sustha tayā niścite iti

original: sattānukūlavyāpāraniścaye sati kiṃ karotīti praśno'nyāviṣayaka evetyavadhāraṇāttatrāstītyuttaraṃ netyarthaḥ|| 12 ||
analyzed: sattā anukūla vyāpāra niścaye sati kim karoti iti praśnaḥ nyā viṣayakaḥ eva iti avadhāraṇāt tatra asti iti uttaram na iti arthaḥ

original: śaṅkatenanviti| evamiti| asyādyakarmakāṇāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāvācakatve, ityarthaḥ| phalaniyatatvāditi| phalānukūlavyāpārasyaika bhāvanāśabdavācyatvāphalasya bhāvanāśabdārthakukṣipraviṣṭatvena bhāvanāyāḥ phalaniyatatvagityarthaḥ| karmatvāditi| prakṛtadhātūpāttapradhānabhūtavyāpāraprayojyaphalāśrayasyetyarthaḥ| kriyāvācakatva iti|
analyzed: śaṅkate nanu iti evam iti asya ādi akarmakāṇām vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanā vācaka tve iti arthaḥ phala niyata tvāt iti phala anukūla vyāpārasya eka bhāvanā śabda vācya tva aphalasya bhāvanā śabda artha kukṣi praviṣṭa tvena bhāvanāyāḥ phala niyata tvac iti arthaḥ karma tvāt iti prakṛta dhātu upātta pradhāna bhūta vyāpāra prayojya phala āśrayasya iti arthaḥ kriyā vācaka tve iti

original: akarpakāṇāmapi phalānukūlavyāpāravācakatva ityarthaḥ| sarveṣāṃsakarmakākarmakobhayeṣāṃ phalānukūlavyāpāravācakapacyādivatsakarmakatvāpattirityāśaṅkāṃ manasikṛtyā''haphalavyāpārayoriti|
analyzed: akarpakāṇām api phala anukūla vyāpāra vācaka tve iti arthaḥ sarveṣām sakarmaka akarmaka ubhayeṣām phala anukūla vyāpāra vācaka paci ādi vat sakarmaka tva āpattiḥ iti āśaṅkām manasikṛtya āha phala vyāpārayoḥ iti

original: nanu phalavyāpārayorekavṛttitvasyākarmakatāniyāmakatve grāmaṃ gacchati, vṛkṣaṃ tyajītyatra vyāpāravattajjanyasaṃyogavibhāgarūpaphalasyāpi kartṛvṛttitvena phalavyāpārayorakaniṣṭhatvād‌gamyādīnāmapyakarmakatvāpattirityanusaṃdhāyā''haekamātraniṣṭhātāyāmti| eketarāvṛttitve sati ekavṛttitvamekamātraniṣṭhatvamityarthaḥ|

original: antarātmāantaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaḥ kartā vyāpārāśraya ityarthaḥ| śarīrātmāśarīrāvacchinnaḥ karmaphalāśraya ityarthaḥ| evaṃ caupādhikabhedamādāya phalavyāpārayorbhinnādhikaraṇaniṣṭhatvākṣaterna sakarmakatvānupapattirnāpyakarmakatvāpattiśceti bodhyam|

original: dhāraṇasya prāṇaniṣṭhatvādvikṣepasya gātraniṣṭhatvāvdyāpārasya ca tadbhinnadevadattaniṣṭhatvātphalasya vyāpāravyadhikaraṇatvādityarthaḥ| tasmātphalāśrayāvācakatve sati phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvamityevaṃ sakarmakatvalakṣaṇaṃ vācyam|

original: tataśca jīvatyādeḥ phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatve'pi `jīvaprāṇadhāraṇe' nṛtī gātravikṣepe' sraṃsu dhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane' ityanuśāsanātphalāśrayāṇāṃ prāṇagātrādhaḥpradeśānāmapi vācakatvena phalāśrayāvācakatvābhāvānna sakarmakatvamiti| ata evāsteḥ svadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārārthakatve'pi svarūpaphalāśrayavācakatvānna sakarmakatvamiti jñaiyam|| 13 ||
analyzed: tatas ca jīvati ādeḥ phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tve api jīva prāṇadhāraṇe nṛtī gātra vikṣepe sraṃsu dhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane iti anuśāsanāt phala āśrayāṇām prāṇa gātra adhas pradeśānām api vācaka tvena phala āśraya avācaka tva abhāvāt na sakarmaka tvam iti atas eva āsteḥ sva dhāraṇa anukūla vyāpāra arthaka tve api svarūpa phala āśraya vācaka tvāt na sakarmaka tvam iti jñaiyam

original: vyāpārasya dhātuvācyatve śaṅkatenanviti| asattvabhūteti| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakavaijātyarūpasādhyatvena vyāpārarūpakriyāyā dhātuta upasthitau satyāmityarthaḥ| pāka iti| ityādighañantasthale'pītyarthaḥ| tatpratyayeti| tena sādhyatvarūpeṇa pratītyāpattirityarthaḥ| nanu ghañante tathā pratītiriṣṭaiveti cedāhana ceṣṭāpattiriti|
analyzed: vyāpārasya dhātu vācya tve śaṅkate nanu iti asattva bhūta iti kriyāntara ākāṅkṣā anutthāpaka tā avacchedaka vaijātya rūpa sādhyatvena vyāpāra rūpa kriyāyāḥ dhātutaḥ upasthitau satyām iti arthaḥ pākaḥ iti ityādi ghañ anta sthale pi iti arthaḥ tad pratyaya iti tena sādhyatva rūpeṇa pratīti āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu ghañ ante tathā pratītiḥ iṣṭā eva iti ced āha na ca iṣṭāpattiḥ iti

original: aniṣṭhāpattau hetumāhakṛdabhihiteti| kṛtpratyayavācyo bhāvodhātvartho, dravyavatdravyadharmeṇa kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthāpakatāvacchedakavaijātyarūpasiddhatvarūpeṇa tulyaṃ prakāśate bhāsate, ityarthaḥ| bhāṣyavirodhāditi| niruktabhāṣyādbhāvārthakakṛdantālliṅgasaṃkhaayādyanvayitvarūpasiddhatvenaiva kriyāyāḥ pratīterlābhādityāśaṅkyā''ākhyātaśabda iti|
analyzed: aniṣṭhā āpattau hetum āha kṛt abhihita iti kṛt pratyaya vācyaḥ bhāvaḥ dhātvarthaḥ dravyavat dravya dharmeṇa kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā utthāpakatā avacchedaka vaijātya rūpa siddhatva rūpeṇa tulyam prakāśate bhāsate iti arthaḥ bhāṣya virodhāt iti nirukta bhāṣyāt bhāva arthaka kṛt antāt liṅga saṃkha aya ādi anvayi tva rūpa siddhatvena eva kriyāyāḥ pratīteḥ lābhāt iti āśaṅkya ā ākhyāta śabdaḥ iti

original: ākhyātaśabda ityasya vivaraṇamāhapaśya mṛga ityādi| tathā cā''khyātaśabda iti bahuvrīhiḥ| sa cāpi ākhyātarūpau śabdau yasminnityākhyātaśabdayordvivacanāntayorbodhyaḥ| bhāgāmyāmityasya tiṅantābhyāmiti vivaraṇadarśanāt| vākyaṃ cānyapadārthaḥ| tatraiva tiṅantadvayasaṃbhavāt| ata eva lāghave'pi na karmadhāraya iti sūcitam|
analyzed: ākhyāta śabdaḥ iti asya vivaraṇam āha paśya mṛgaḥ ityādi tathā ca ākhyāta śabdaḥ iti bahuvrīhiḥ sa ca api ākhyāta rūpau śabdau yasmin iti ākhyāta śabdayoḥ dvivacana antayoḥ bodhyaḥ bhāga āmyām ityasya tiṅ antābhyām iti vivaraṇa darśanāt vākyam ca anya padārthaḥ tatra eva tiṅ anta dvaya saṃbhavāt atas eva lāghave api na karmadhārayaḥ iti sūcitam

original: evaṃ cā''khyātaśabde ityasyatiṅantasamudāye ityarthaḥ| apavyākhyānamiti| ākhyātaśabde karmadhārayaṃ svīkṛtya bhāgābhyāmityasya prakṛtipratyayarūpabhāgābhyāmiti vyākhyānamaśuddham| bhāgadvayasattvāditi| pacatītyatrāpi prakṛtipratyayarūpabhāgadvayasattvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca ākhyāta śabde iti asya tiṅ anta samudāye iti arthaḥ apavyākhyānam iti ākhyāta śabde karmadhārayam svīkṛtya bhāgābhyām ityasya prakṛti pratyaya rūpa bhāgābhyām iti vyākhyānam aśuddham bhāga dvaya sattvāt iti pacati iti atra api prakṛti pratyaya rūpa bhāga dvaya sattvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca pāka ityatreva pacatītyatra siddhāvasthāpannatvena kriyāpratītyāpatterbhāgadvayasya kriyāvācakatvābhāvena dṛṣṭāntāsaṃgatyāpatteśceti bhāvaḥ| anye tu sādhyatvasādhanatvābhyāṃ pratītimātre'yaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca pākaḥ ityatra iva pacati ityatra siddha avasthā āpanna tvena kriyā pratīti āpatteḥ bhāga dvayasya kriyā vācaka tva abhāvena dṛṣṭānta asaṃgati āpatteḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ anye tu sādhya tva sādhana tvābhyām pratīti mātrā iyam dṛṣṭāntaḥ

original: yathā pacatītyatra tiṅante dhāturūpaprakṛtya sādhyatvena svārtho bodhyate, sādhanatvarūpasvārthastiṅā, tathā pāka ityatra dhātunā sādhyatvena kriyā pratyāyyate, pratyayena siddhatvarūpeṇetyarthaḥ| idameva vyākhyānaṃ helārājīye dṛśyata ityāhuḥ| sādhyasādhanarūpateti|

original: yathākramaṃ paśyabhāgena sādhyarūpatā, dhāvatibhāgena sādhanarūpatā yathā śāstre prakalpitetyarthaḥ| tatra sādhyatvamāhakriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpaketyādi| sādhanatvaṃ tukārakatvenānvayitvamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥpaśyetyatra kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvaṃ svasmin kārakāṇāmanvayaḥ svasya vā kārakatvenānyatrānvayitvābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yathākramam paśya bhāgena sādhya rūpatā dhāvati bhāgena sādhana rūpatā yathā śāstre prakalpitā iti arthaḥ tatra sādhya tvam āha kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā anutthāpaka ityādi sādhana tvam tu kāraka tvena anvayi tvam iti ayam bhāvaḥ paśya iti atra kriyāyāḥ sādhya tvam sve kārakāṇām anvayaḥ svasya vā kāraka tvena anyatra anvayi tva abhāvaḥ

original: dhāvatītyasyāḥ sādhanatvaṃ tu kārakatvenānyasminsvasyānvayaḥ| itthaṃ pacati bhavatītyatrāpyekakartṛkā vartamānā yā pacikriyā ekatatkartṛkā vartamānā bhavanakriyetibodāttatrāpyūhyam| evaṃ ca paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādau ekamṛgābhinnāśrayikā yā vartamānā dhāvanakriyā tadviṣayakaṃ yadiṣṭasādhanībhūtaṃ darśanaṃ tadanukūlā bhāvaneti bodha iti|
analyzed: dhāvati iti asyāḥ sādhanatvam tu kāraka tvena anyasmin svasya anvayaḥ ittham pacati bhavati iti atra api eka kartṛkā vartamānā yā paci kriyā eka tad kartṛkā vartamānā bhavana kriyā iti bodāt tatra api ūhyam evam ca paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati ityādau eka mṛga abhinna āśrayikā yā vartamānā dhāvana kriyā tad viṣayakam yat iṣṭa sādhanībhūtam darśanam tad anukūlā bhāvanā iti bodhaḥ iti

original: nanu ākhyātavācyakriyāyāḥ kartṛtvakarmatvasvīkāre kārakatvenānyatrānanvayitvarūpaṃ tasyā asattvarūpatvaṃ bhajyeteticenna| `kriyā na yujyate liṅgakriyānādhārakārakaiḥ| asattvarūpatā tasyā iyamevāvadhāryatām||
analyzed: nanu ākhyāta vācya kriyāyāḥ kartṛ tva karma tva svīkāre kāraka tvena anyatra ananvayi tva rūpam tasyāḥ asattva rūpa tvam bhajyeta iti ced na kriyā na yujyate liṅga kriyā anādhāra kārakaiḥ asattva rūpa tā tasyāḥ iyam eva avadhāryatām

original: liṅgaṃ ca kriyānādhārakāṇi ca taiḥ kriyā na yujyate, iti haryukteḥ kartṛtvakarmatvetarakārakatvavyāpyarūpeṇānanvayitvamasattvarūpatvamityarthasya lābhena tiṅantopasthitakriyāyāḥ kartṛtvakarmatvasvīkāre'pi asattvarūpatvabhaṅgābhāvādityarthaḥ| sa ghañādiṣviti|
analyzed: liṅgam ca kriyā anādhārakāṇi ca taiḥ kriyā na yujyate iti hari ukteḥ kartṛ tva karmatva itara kārakatva vyāpya rūpeṇa ananvayitvam asattva rūpatvam iti arthasya lābhena tiṅanta upasthita kriyāyāḥ kartṛ tva karmatva svīkāre pi asattva rūpatva bhaṅga abhāvāt iti arthaḥ sa ghañ ādiṣu iti

original: pāka ityādau prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāpannā pratyayena tu sādhanāvasthāpannā kriyā pratīyata ityarthaḥ| nanu dhāvatī paśyetyatra kriyayorliṅgasaṃkhyānanvayitvena ṣāka ityatra ca liṅgasaṃkhyānvayitvenobhayatra sāmyābhāvātkathaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikatvamityata āhaiyān paramiti| ghañādyupasthāpyeti| kriyetyarthaḥ| naivamiti|
analyzed: pākaḥ ityādau prakṛtyā sādhya avasthā āpannā pratyayena tu sādhana avasthā āpannā kriyā pratīyate iti arthaḥ nanu dhāvatī paśya iti atra kriyayoḥ liṅga saṃkhyā ananvayi tvena ṣākaḥ ityatra ca liṅga saṃkhyā anvayi tvena ubhayatra sāmya abhāvāt katham dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika tvam iti atas āha eyān param iti ghaña ādi upasthāpyā iti kriyā iti arthaḥ na evam iti

original: yādṛśī ghañādyupasthāpyā kriyā tādṛśī tiṅantopasthāpyā kriyā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā ca vaiṣamyād‌dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāve hi sarvāṃśena sābhyamapekṣitamityevaṃ naiva niyamaḥ| anyathā candramukhādyorapi sarvāṃśena sāmyābhāvātsana syāt| kiṃ ca sarvāṃśena sāmye dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvavilaya eva|
analyzed: yādṛśī ghañ ādi upasthāpyā kriyā tādṛśī tiṅ anta upasthāpyā kriyā na bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā ca vaiṣamyāt dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika bhāvaḥ na upapadyate iti bhāvaḥ dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika bhāve hi sarva aṃśena sābhyam apekṣitam iti evam na eva niyamaḥ anyathā syāt kim ca sarva aṃśena sāmye dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika bhāva vilayaḥ eva

original: na hi bhavati ghaṭa iva ghaṭaḥ paṭa iva paṭa iti| api tu kiṃcidaṃśanaiva sāmyamapekṣyate, tacca prakṛtasthale'pyastītyāhatathā'pīti| tiṅantopasthāpyā kriyā yathā kārakatvenānyatrānveti tathā ghañādyupasthāpyā'pyanyatra kārakatvenānvetīti kārakatvenānvayitvadharmeṇa dṛṣṭhāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo'vadheyaḥ|
analyzed: na hi bhavati ghaṭaḥ iva ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ iva paṭaḥ iti api tu kiṃcid aṃśanā eva sāmyam apekṣyate tat ca prakṛta sthale pi asti iti āha tathā api iti tiṅ anta upasthāpyā kriyā yathā kāraka tvena anyatra anveti tathā ghañ ādi upasthāpya api anyatra kāraka tvena anveti iti kāraka tvena anvayi tva dharmeṇa dṛṣṭhānta dārṣṭāntika bhāvaḥ vadheyaḥ

original: nanu pāka ityādau prakṛtibhūtadhātutaḥ sādhyatvarūpeṇa kriyāpratītau kiṃ pramāṇamata āhaodanasya pāka itīti| karmaṣaṣṭhyā mānatvāditi|
analyzed: nanu pākaḥ ityādau prakṛti bhūta dhātutaḥ sādhya tva rūpeṇa kriyā pratītau kim pramāṇam atas āha odanasya pākaḥ iti iti karma ṣaṣṭhyāḥ mānatvāt iti

original: ghañ‌prakṛtidhātunā ghañeva siddhāvasthāyā eva kriyāyā abhidhāne kārakāṇāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānārtha evānvayaniyamādodanasyākārakatvena tavdyāpyakarmasaṃjñāyā asaṃbhavātkartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhyanupapattereva ghañ‌prakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāvācakatve pramāṇatvādityāśayaḥ| ṣaṣṭhīmupapādayitumāśaṅkatena cādhyāhṛtoti|
analyzed: ghañ prakṛti dhātunā ghañ eva siddha avasthāyāḥ eva kriyāyāḥ abhidhāne kārakāṇām sādhya tvena pratīyamāna arthe eva anvaya niyamāt odanasya akāraka tvena tad dyāpya karma saṃjñāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī anupapatteḥ eva ghañ prakṛti bhūta dhātoḥ sādhya avasthā āpanna kriyā vācaka tve pramāṇa tvāt iti āśayaḥ ṣaṣṭhīm upapādayitum āśaṅkatena ca adhyāhṛta iti

original: adhyāhatāstīti tiṅantopasthāpyasādhyāvasthakriyāyāḥ pākena pākasya caudaneneti paramparayā'nvayātṣaṣṭhī syādityarthaḥ| tathā ca ghañante dhātutaḥ sādhyāvasthākriyāyā apratītāvapyupapadyamānayā ṣaṣṭhyā tādṛśadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthakriyāvācakatvaṃ kalpayituṃ na yujyata iti cennetyāhakṛdantena yoga eveti|
analyzed: adhyāhatā asti iti tiṅ anta upasthāpya sādhya avasthakriyāyāḥ pākena pākasya ca odanena iti paramparayā anvayāt ṣaṣṭhī syāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca ghañ ante dhātutaḥ sādhya avasthā kriyāyāḥ apratītau api upapadyamānayā ṣaṣṭhyā tādṛśa dhātoḥ sādhya avasthakriyā vācaka tvam kalpayitum na yujyate iti ced na ityāha kṛt antena yogaḥ eva iti

original: kṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātūpasthāpyākreyānirūpitakartṛkarmavācakādeva kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtītyanena ṣaṣṭhīvidhānādityarthaḥ| tathā ca kṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvastakriyāvācakatvamantarā sā karmaṣaṣṭhī durlabheti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kṛt pratyaya prakṛti bhūta dhātu upasthāpya ākreya a nirūpita kartṛ karma vācakāt eva kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti iti anena ṣaṣṭhī vidhānāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca kṛt pratyaya prakṛti bhūta dhātoḥ sādhya avasta kriyā vācaka tvam antarā sā karmaṣaṣṭhī durlabhā iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvadhyāhṛtatiṅantopasthitasādhyāvasthakriyayā kṛdantasya yogo'stīti tādṛśakriyādvārakaḥ kṛdantayogo'pyastīti na karmaṣaṣṭhyanupapattirityāśayenā''hana lokāvyayeti| niṣedhācceti| adhyāhṛtalādeśaprakṛtibhūtadātūpastāpyakriyānvaye ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāccetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu adhyāhṛta tiṅ anta upasthita sādhya avastha kriyayā kṛt antasya yogaḥ usti iti tādṛśa kriyā dvārakaḥ kṛt anta yogaḥ upi asti iti na karma ṣaṣṭhī anupapattiḥ iti āśayena āha na loka avyaya iti niṣedhāt ca iti adhyāhṛta la ādeśa prakṛti bhūta dātu upastāpya kriyā anvaye ṣaṣṭhī niṣedhāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' iti vacanavihita odanapāka iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyasaṃbhavānna syātpaṣṭhyantasyottarapadārthe'nanvayena sāmarthyābhāvāccetyapi bodhyam| na ca śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyaiva vākyaṃ samāsaścāstviti śaṅkyam| nalapākaḥ śuṇṭhīpāka ityādau nalādikartṛtvādiprakārakabodhasya savānubhavasiddhasya vilayāpattoḥ|
analyzed: kṛt yogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate iti vacana vihitaḥ odana pākaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī samāsaḥ api kṛt yoga ṣaṣṭhī asaṃbhavāt na syāt paṣṭhī antasya uttara padārthena anvayena sāmarthya abhāvāt ca iti api bodhyam na ca śeṣa lakṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhyā eva vākyam samāsaḥ ca astu iti śaṅkyam nala pākaḥ śuṇṭhī pākaḥ ityādau nala ādi kartṛ tva ādi prakāraka bodhasya vilaya āpattoḥ

original: tasmātkarmaṣaṣṭhyanupapattireva kṛdantasthale dhātoḥ sādhyāvastāpannakriyārthakatve pramāṇamiti yāvat| nanu bhāvārthakakṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāvācakatve tannirūpitakarmatvasyeva karaṇatvasyāpi saṃbhavātkāṣṭhaiḥ pāka ityapi syādityāśaṅkyeṣṭamevaitaditi pariharannāhaevaṃ rītyetyādīṣṭamevetyantam|
analyzed: tasmāt karma ṣaṣṭhī anupapattiḥ eva kṛt anta sthale dhātoḥ pramāṇam iti yāvat nanu bhāva arthaka kṛtpratyaya prakṛti bhūta dhātoḥ sādhya avasthā āpanna kriyā vācaka tve tad nirūpita karmatvasya iva karaṇatvasya api saṃbhavāt kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ iti api syāt iti āśaṅkya iṣṭam eva etat iti pariharan āha evam rītyā ityādi iṣṭam eva ityantam

original: tiṅ‌pratyayenaiva sādhyāvasthaāpannatvena vyāpārarūpabhāvanā'bidhīyate, iti manvānā mīmāṃsakāḥ `kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' iti prayogamaneṣṭamāmananti| evamiti| yathaidanasya karmatāsiddhyarthaṃ pāka ityatra sādhyāvasthāpannavyāpāpāro dhātunocyate tathā phalāṃśo'pi dhātunā sādhyāvasthāpanna evocyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tiṅpratyayena eva sādhya avasthā āpanna tvena vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanā abidhīyate iti manvānāḥ mīmāṃsakāḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ iti prayogam aneṣṭam āmananti evam iti yathā aidanasya karmatā siddhi artham pākaḥ iti atra sādhya avasthā āpanna vyāpā pāraḥ dhātunā ucyate tathā phala aṃśaḥ api dhātunā sādhya avasthā āpannaḥ eva ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: sādhyāvasthaivāsattvāvasthetyucyate vaiyākaraṇaiḥ| ata eveti| phalasmāpi asattvāvasthāpannatayā dhātunocyamānatvādevetyarthaḥ| stokaṃ pacatītivaditi|
analyzed: sādhya avasthā eva asattva avasthā iti ucyate vaiyākaraṇaiḥ atas eva iti asattva avasthā āpannatayā dhātunā ucyamāna tvāt eva iti arthaḥ stokam pacati iti vat iti

original: viklittarūpaphalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvātphalāśrayatvena karmatvāttatsamānādhikaraṇastokādiśabdebhyo yathā dvitīyā bhavati tathā stokaṃ pāka ityatrāpi dhātvarthaphale sādhyatvenopasthite sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayātstokamiti dvitīyā bhavatītyarthaḥ| upapadyata iti|
analyzed: viklitta rūpa phalasya api vyapadeśi vat bhāvāt phala āśraya tvena karma tvāt tad samāna adhikaraṇa stoka ādi śabdebhyaḥ yathā dvitīyā bhavati tathā stokam pākaḥ iti atra api dhātvartha phale sādhya tvena upasthite sāmānādhikaraṇyena anvayāt stokam iti dvitīyā bhavati iti arthaḥ upapadyate iti

original: phalāṃśasya sattvāvasthāpannatvenopasthitau tu kārakāṇāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānārtha evānvayaniyamātsāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye'pi sādhyatvenopasthitārthe'nvayābhāvātstokaṃ pāka iti nopadyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanvekasyaiva dhātvarthasya vuruddhasādhyatvasiddhatvābhyāṃ kathaṃ bhānamiti cenna|
analyzed: phala aṃśasya sattva avasthā āpannatvena upasthitau tu kārakāṇām sādhya tvena pratīyamāna arthaḥ eva anvaya niyamāt sāmānādhikaraṇyena anvaye pi sādhya tvena upasthita artha anvaya abhāvāt stokam pākaḥ iti na upadyeta iti bhāvaḥ nanu ekasya eva dhātvarthasya katham bhānam iti ced na

original: yathā saṃbandhibhedādekasyaiva pitṛtvaṃ putratvaṃ ca tathā ekatraiva kārakaliṅgādirūpasaṃbavdhibhedādubhayoḥ saṃbhavena tayorvirodhābhāvādityarthaḥ| vyāpārānvaye tu stokaḥ pāka ityeva| vyāpārasyākarmatayā tadviśeṣaṇe dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ| phalānvaye dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā kartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhī tu na śaṅkyā|
analyzed: yathā saṃbandhi bhedāt ekasya eva pitṛ tvam putra tvam ca tathā ekatra eva kāraka liṅga ādi rūpa saṃbavdhi bhedāt ubhayoḥ saṃbhavena tayoḥ virodha abhāvāt iti arthaḥ vyāpāra anvaye tu stokaḥ pākaḥ iti eva vyāpārasya akarmatayā tad viśeṣaṇe dvitīyāyāḥ aprāpteḥ phala anvaye dvitīyām bādhitvā kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī tu na śaṅkyā

original: kartṛsāhacaryeṇa dhātvarthe bhedainānvayikarmaṇa eva tatra grahaṇāditi laghuñjūṣāyāṃ nirūpitatvādityarthaḥ|| 14 ||
analyzed: kartṛ sāhacaryeṇa dhātvarthe bheda ena anvayi karmaṇaḥ eva tatra grahaṇāt iti laghuñjūṣāyām nirūpita tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: etadeveti| ekasyā eva kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvasiddhatvābhṣāṃ bhānamevetyarthaḥ| sādhyatvena kriyeti| tatradhañādyante| pratīyata iti śeṣaḥ| sādhyatvena kriyāpratītau bodakamāhadhāturūpeti| dhāturūpaṃ nibandhanaṃ nimittaṃ yasyā ityarthaḥ| śabdaśaktisvābāvyāddhātuvācyā kriyā(phalavyāpārau)sādhyatvena pratīyata iti yāvat|
analyzed: etat eva iti ekasyāḥ eva kriyāyāḥ bhānam eva iti arthaḥ sādhya tvena kriyā iti tatra dhañ ādi ante pratīyate iti śeṣaḥ sādhya tvena kriyā pratītau bodakam āha dhātu rūpa iti dhātu rūpam nibandhanam nimittam yasyāḥ iti arthaḥ śabda śakti svābāvyāt dhātu vācyā kriyā phala vyāpārau sādhya tvena pratīyate iti yāvat

original: phalavyāpārobhayoḥ sādhyatvena pratītibodhanāya kriyeti sādhāraṇaśabdena nirdeśaḥ| tāntrikaiḥ phalavyāpārayoḥ kriyāśabdena vyavahriyamāṇatvāt| siddhabhāvastviti| siddhatvena pratītistvityarthaḥ| ghañādīti| ghañādirnivandhanaṃ nimittaṃ yasyetyarthaḥ| ghañādivācyā kriyā(phalavyāpārau)siddhatvena pratīyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: phala vyāpāra ubhayoḥ sādhya tvena pratīti bodhanāya kriyā iti sādhāraṇa śabdena nirdeśaḥ tāntrikaiḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ kriyā śabdena vyavahriyamāṇa tvāt siddha bhāvaḥ tu iti siddha tvena pratītiḥ tu iti arthaḥ ghañ ādi iti ghañ ādiḥ nivandhanam nimittam yasya iti arthaḥ ghañ ādi vācyā kriyā phala vyāpārau siddha tvena pratīyate iti arthaḥ

original: ādiśabdena ktvātumun‌ktinnādayo grāhyāḥ| ghañādibhirvyāpāraphalayoḥ siddhatvena bodhane pramāṇābhāvamāśaṅ‌vaya pariharatina cetyādinā mānatvādityantena| pāka ityukta iti|
analyzed: ādi śabdena grāhyāḥ ghañ ādibhiḥ vyāpāra phalayoḥ siddhatvena bodhane pramāṇa abhāvam āśaṅvaya pariharati na ca ityādinā māna tvāt iti antena pākaḥ iti uktaḥ iti

original: pāka ityādiśravaṇe dhātvarthaghañarthakriyayorabhedānvaye satyapi kartavyo vā nāśanīyo vā tiṣṭhati vā jāyate vā raśyati vetyādijāyamānapākasādhyakriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā eva mānatvādityarthaḥ| dhātūpasthāpyāyāmiti| pacatītyādisthala ityarthaḥ| tadasaṃbhavasyoktatvāditi|
analyzed: pākaḥ ityādi śravaṇe dhātvartha ghañartha kriyayoḥ abheda anvaye sati api kartavyaḥ vā nāśanīyaḥ vā tiṣṭhati vā jāyate vā raśyati vā ityādi jāyamāna pāka sādhya kriyā antara ākāṅkṣāyāḥ eva māna tvāt iti arthaḥ dhātu upasthāpyāyām iti pacati ityādi sthale iti arthaḥ tad asaṃbhavasya ukta tvāt iti

original: pacatītyukte kriyāvagatau punaḥ kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā ajāyamānatvena kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā asaṃbhavasyoktatvādityarthaḥ| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpavattvaṃ sādhyatvamityādineti śeṣaḥ| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpeṇopasthite'rthe kriyānvayāsaṃbhavātkriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā asaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ| anāpatteriti|
analyzed: pacati iti ukte kriyā avagatau punar kriyā antara ākāṅkṣāyāḥ ajāyamāna tvena kriyāntara ākāṅkṣāyāḥ asaṃbhavasya ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ kriyāntara ākāṅkṣā anutthāpaka tā avacchedaka rūpavat tvam sādhya tvam ityādinā iti śeṣaḥ kriyāntara ākāṅkṣā anutthāpaka tā avacchedaka rūpeṇa upasthita īrthe kriyā anvaya asaṃbhavāt kriyāntara ākāṅkṣāyāḥ asaṃbhavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ anāpatteḥ iti

original: ghañ‌pratyayena sādhyāvasthāpannāyā eva kriyāprā abhidhāne tasyā liṅgānavayitayā tādṛśadhātvarthaviśeṣaṇavācakastokādiśabdasyāpi puṃstvānupapattyā sāmānye napuṃsakagityasyaivāpatteriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: ghañpratyayena sādhya avasthā āpannāyāḥ eva abhidhāne tasyāḥ liṅga anavayitayā tādṛśa dhātvartha viśeṣaṇa vācaka stoka ādi śabdasya api puṃstva anupapattyā sāmānye napuṃsaka gityasya eva āpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: siddhāvasthāpannakriyāyā bodhane tu tādṛśakriyāyā liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayitayā tatsamānādhikaraṇastokādiśabdasyāpi liṅgasaṃkhyānvayātstokaḥ pākaḥ, ityekatvaṃ puṃstvaṃ copapadyate| etadeva viśadayatitasmāditi| dhātvarthānvaya iti| dhātvarthaphalānvayestokādiśabdebhyo dvitīyā napuṃsakaliṅgatā ca|
analyzed: siddha avasthā āpanna kriyāyāḥ bodhane tu tādṛśa kriyāyāḥ liṅga saṃkhyā ādi anvayitayā tad samāna adhikaraṇa stoka ādi śabdasya api liṅga saṃkhyā anvayāt stokaḥ pākaḥ iti ekatvam puṃstvam ca upapadyate etat eva viśadayati tasmāt iti dhātvartha anvaye iti dhātvartha phala anvaye stoka ādi śabdebhyaḥ dvitīyā napuṃsaka liṅgatā ca

original: dhātvarthavyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmanvaye jyotiṣṭomena bhaktipūrvaṃ yajetetivatprathamāsaṃbhave'pi napuṃsakaliṅgamātram| ghañarthavyāpārānvaye tu vyāpārasya karmatvābhāvena dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ prātipadikārtheti prathamā puṃliṅgatā ca| ghañarthaphalasya padārthaikadeśatvānna tatra stokādyanvayaḥ|
analyzed: dhātvartha vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyām anvaye jyotiṣṭomena bhakti pūrvam yajeta iti vat prathamā saṃbhave pi napuṃsaka liṅga mātram ghañ artha vyāpāra anvaye tu vyāpārasya karma tva abhāvena dvitīyāyāḥ aprāpteḥ prātipadika arthā iti prathamā pum liṅga tā ca ghañ artha phalasya padārtha eka deśa tvāt na tatra stoka ādi anvayaḥ

original: dhātvarthaphalasya padārthaikadeśatve'pi tatretarapadārthānvayo bhavatyeva| anyathā taṇḍulaṃ pacati stokaṃ pacati stokaṃ pāka ityanāpattorityāśayaḥ| ghañādeḥ śaktiriti| liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayivyāpārārtha, ityarthaḥ| eteneti| ghañādīnāṃ siddhāvasthāpannavyāpāravācakatvāṅgīkāreṇetyarthaḥ| sādhutāmātramiti|

original: `saṃbodhanapadaṃ yacca tatkriyāya viśeṣaṇam, vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathā sati' iti vākyapadīyāt| saṃbodhanasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatve hetumāhanighātānurodhāditi| ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamiti vākyalakṣaṇe saviśeṣaṇamityasya sākṣātparamparayā ca yadvadviśeṣaṇaṃ tatsahitamityarthaḥ|

original: na ca jānīhītyadhyāhāre tiṅantadvayaghaṭitavākyasyaikatiṅa vākyamiti daribhāṣitaṃ yannighātopayogyekavākyatvaṃ tadabhāvena nighātāsiddhiriti vācyam| vrajāni devadatta jānīhīti samudāyasya yo'rthastasmin vrajāni devadattetyasya vṛttirvākyaikadeśanyāyena|

original: bahuṣu tiṅanteṣvekavākyatāsattvādeva tiṅantebhyaḥ parasya tiṅantasya nighātaniṣedhaḥ| sārthaka ityarthakenoparyuktavākyapadīyena kauṇḍabhaṭṭairuktatvādityarthaḥ| tanmate'pi bhavatyeveti| pacati bhavati devadatta jānīhīti samudāyasya mukhyaviśeṣyabhūtārthabodhakaikatiṅantaghaṭitatvādvārtikamate'pi devadattetyasya nighāto bhavatyevetyarthaḥ|

original: pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte, ityudāharaṇe nivṛttabhedāyā ekasyā eva bhujikriyāyā āvṛttyā janitā utpattayaḥ pañcasaṃkhyayā gaṇyante| āvṛttikṛtaṃ galabilādhaḥsaṃyogarūpaphalānekatvamicchan bhujikriyāyāḥ pañca utpattyāvṛttīḥ karoti, yathā viklittirūpaṃ phalamicchaṃstadanukūlaṃ phūtkārādivyāpāraṃ karoti tadvadityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pañca kṛtvas bhuṅkte iti udāharaṇe nivṛtta bhedāyāḥ ekasyāḥ eva bhuji kriyāyāḥ āvṛttyā janitāḥ utpattayaḥ pañca saṃkhyayā gaṇyante āvṛtti kṛtam gala bila adhas saṃyoga rūpa phala anekatvam icchan bhuji kriyāyāḥ pañca utpatti āvṛttīḥ karoti yathā viklitti rūpam phalam icchan tad anukūlam phūtkāra ādi vyāpāram karoti tadvat iti arthaḥ

original: galabilādhaḥsaṃyogānukūlavyāpāro bhujikriyeti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca pañcaśabdasya pañcasaṃkhyotpattiparatvaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇana ityuktisvārasyāt, pratyayastu tad‌doyatakaḥ, pañcasaṃkhyotpatteśca svasamabhivyāhṛtakribāyāmevānvayasyaucityātkriyāyoga eva kṛtvasujādeḥ sādhutvaṃ labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ|

analyzed: evam ca pañca saṃkhyā utpattikā vartamāna kālikā eka kartṛkā bhuji kriyā iti bodhaḥ evam sakṛt pacati dvis pacati ityādau api ūhyam kriyā yoge eva sādhu tvāt eva ghaṭau ityādi vat dvis ghaṭaḥ iti ādikam na bhavati kriyā gaṇanā bhāvāt iti bodhyam

original: kārakāmiti| kartā karma cetyādi kārakaṣaṭ‌kamityarthaḥ| kārakaśabdasya kriyāparatvaṃ darśayituṃ tadyaugikārthamāhakaroti kartṛkarmādibyapadeśāniti| asyāḥ kriyāyā ayaṃ kartā, idaṃ karma, idaṃ karaṇamityevaṃ kriyānirūpitā eva hi kartukarmādisaṃjñā ityarthaḥ| kriyānvayināmeva saṃjñeti|
analyzed: kārakām iti kartā karma ca ityādi kāraka ṣaṭkam iti arthaḥ kāraka śabdasya kriyā paratvam darśayitum tad yaugika artham āha karoti kartṛ karma ādi byapadeśān iti asyāḥ kriyāyāḥ ayam kartā idam karma idam karaṇam iti evam kriyā nirūpitāḥ eva hi kartu karma ādi saṃjñāḥ iti arthaḥ kriyā anvayinām eva saṃjñā iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ dhruvamapāyeityādyuttarasūtre `kriyāyāṃ' ityasyānuvṛttau satyāṃ kriyāyā janakākāṅkṣatayā tatra janakatvena yadapāye dhruvamityasya saṃbandhe kriyamāṇe kriyājanakamityarthasaṃpattyā janakasya janyākāṅkṣatayā janya eva janakasyānvaya ucita iti kriyānvayināmevāpādānādisaṃjñā ityartha iti|

original: anyathā uttarapadārthānvaye'pyabrāhmaṇa ityādau samāsavikalpena pakṣe'samastatvātkriyānvayaniyamasya vyabhicārāpattirityāśayavānāhayathāśrutagrahaṇāyogāditi| evaṃ ca vyabhicāravāraṇāyāsamastanañityasya tiṅantopasthāpyakriyānvayītyevārtho vivakṣitavya ityabhiprāyaḥ|

analyzed: yuṣmad ādi artha abhinna laṭ artha kartṛ niṣṭha vartamāna kālika paci kriyā bhāvaḥ iti bodhāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca tādṛśa bodhaḥ eva asamasta nañ arthasya kriyā anvaye mānam iti bhāvaḥ nañ artha abhāvasya pratiyogitayā kriyā anvayāt eva yuṣmad ādeḥ tiṅ vācya kāraka vāci tva rūpa sāmānādhikaraṇya sattvāt prathama madhyama puruṣa ādi upapadyate upapadyate ca ekavacana dvivacana ādi

analyzed: ghaṭa katṛka sattāyāḥ eva abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ evakāreṇa ghaṭa abhāvaḥ vyāvartitaḥ nanu ghaṭaḥ na jāyate ityādi pūrvokta sthalena anupapattyā kriyā pratiyogika abhāva pratīti svīkāre api ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādau ghaṭa abhāva patītiḥ eva svīkriyatām bādhaka abhāvāt tathā ca tatra eva nañaḥ kriyā anvaya niyama bhaṅgaḥ iti āśaṅkya ghaṭa abhāva pratīti svīkāre bādhakam pradarśayati na hi ghaṭaḥ abhāvaḥ iti pratīti svīkāre bādhakam

original: na jāyate| ityādinā| ekatrotpattayanukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ, aparatra sattānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| anayormadhye dhātvarthabheda eva viśeṣaḥ, etadatiriktaḥ kaścidapi kiyānapi viśeṣo nāsti| yo'pi viśeṣo'sti so'pi nañarthābhāvapratiyogibhedakalpane'kiṃcitkara ityarthaḥ| tathā cobhayatrāpi kriyāpratiyogikābhāva ityevamekarūpa eva śābdabodhaḥ|

original: adhyāhāre bījamāhaprakāratāsaṃbandheneti| nañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsaṃbandhena śābdabodhatvāvacchinnaṃ prati dhātujanyabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya klṛptatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: adhyāhāre bījam āha prakāratā saṃbandhena iti nañartha abhāva niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā saṃbandhena śābdabodha tva avacchinnam prati dhātu janya bhāvanā upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya klṛpta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: atra yatkiṃcinnaṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitanañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākaśābdabodhajananaṃ kāryaṃ, tādṛśābhāvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitanañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākaśābdabodhajananaṃ kāryaṃ, tādṛśābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsaṃbandhāvacchinnadhātujanyavyāpārarūpabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamiti bodhyam| klṛptatvāditi| āvaśyakatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atra yat kiṃcid naṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita nañartha abhāva niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka śābdabodha jananam kāryam tādṛśa abhāva niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita nañartha abhāva niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka śābdabodha jananam kāryam tādṛśa abhāva niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita prakāratā saṃbandha avacchinna dhātu janya vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanā upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti bodhyam klṛpta tvāt iti āvaśyaka tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā nañarthābhāvasya kriyānvayaniyamo nopapadyeteti bhāvaḥ| śeṣamiti| āropitatvaṃ nañ‌dyotyamanekamityatraikavacananiyamena dvivacanabahuvacanābhāvaścetyādītyarthaḥ|| 16 ||
analyzed: anyathā nañ artha abhāvasya kriyā anvaya niyamaḥ na upapadyeta iti bhāvaḥ śeṣam iti āropita tvam nañ dyotyam anekam iti atra ekavacana niyamena dvivacana bahuvacana abhāvaḥ ca ityādi iti arthaḥ

original: tathā yasya ca bhāveneti| yasya ca bhāvenetyanenaitādṛśapadatrayaghaṭitaṃ, ṣaṣṭhī cetyanenaitādṛśapadadvayaghaṭitaṃ ca sūtraṃ lakṣyate ityāśayavānāhayasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇamityatreti, ṣaṣṭhī cānādare, itīti ca| atra bhāvaśabdau dhātuvācyakiyāparau| yanniṣṭhakriyayā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate tataḥ saptamīti tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā yasya ca bhāvena iti yasya ca bhāvena iti anena etādṛśa pada traya ghaṭitam ṣaṣṭhī ca iti anena etādṛśa pada dvaya ghaṭitam ca sūtram lakṣyate iti āśayavān āha yasya ca bhāvena bhāva lakṣaṇam iti atra iti ṣaṣṭhī ca anādare iti iti ca atra bhāva śabdau dhātu vācya kiyā parau yad niṣṭha kriyayā kriyā antaram lakṣyate tatas saptamī iti tad arthaḥ

original: tata ityasya jñāpakakriyāśrayavācakādityarthaḥ| tacca gopadaduhyamānapadayorapyastīti ubhābhyāmapi saptamī bhavati| jñāpakatvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ, tasya ca bhāvalakṣaṇamityukteḥ kriyāyāmevānvaya iti satisaptamyāḥ kriyāyoga eva sādhutvaṃ labhyate| yathā goṣuduhyamānāsu gata iti|
analyzed: tatas iti asya jñāpaka kriyā āśraya vācakāt iti arthaḥ tat ca go pada duhyamāna padayoḥ api asti iti ubhābhyām api saptamī bhavati jñāpaka tvam saptamī arthaḥ tasya ca bhāva lakṣaṇam iti ukteḥ kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ iti sati saptamyāḥ kriyā yogaḥ eva sādhu tvam labhyate yathā goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ iti

original: duhyamānānāṃ gavāṃ jñāpakatvaṃ jñāpyatvaṃ ca gamanakriyāyāṃ śabdataḥ pratīyate tathā'pi gogatadohanakriyāyāḥ sākṣājjñāpakatā gavāṃ tu tadāśrayatayā| nirjñātakālakriyāyā anirjñātakālakriyāyāṃ svādhikaraṇakālavṛttitvajñāpakatvāt| vartamānadohanaviśiṣṭābhirgobhirjñāpyagamanavāniti śābdabodhe godohanakāle gata iti phalito'rthaḥ|
analyzed: duhyamānānām gavām jñāpaka tvam jñāpya tvam ca gamana kriyāyām śabdataḥ pratīyate tathā api go gata dohana kriyāyāḥ sākṣāt jñāpaka tā gavām tu tad āśraya tayā nirjñāta kāla kriyāyāḥ anirjñāta kāla kriyāyām sva adhikaraṇa kāla vṛtti tva jñāpaka tvāt vartamāna dohana viśiṣṭābhiḥ gobhiḥ jñāpya gamanavān iti śābda bodhe godohana kāle gate iti phalita ūrthaḥ
