original: evamuttarasūtre'pīti rudati rudato vetyādau putrādiviṣayako'nādaro'dhikā bhāsata iti jñeyam| tatsvarūpaṃsādhutvasvarūpam| vakṣyateasādhuranumānenetyetavdyākhyānāvasara iti śeṣaḥ| kriyayaivetīti| evakāro'yogavyavacchedārthaḥ| ayogaḥ saṃbandhābhāvaḥ, tasya vyavacchedo nivṛttiḥ| tathā ca niruktāṣṭakasya kriyāyoga eva sādhutvaṃ nānyathetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam uttara sūtre api iti rudati rudataḥ vā ityādau putra ādi viṣayakaḥ ūnāda rodhikā bhāsate iti jñeyam tad svarūpam sādhutva svarūpam vakṣyate asādhuḥ anumānena iti etad dyākhyāna avasare iti śeṣaḥ kriyayā eva iti iti eva kāraḥ yoga vyavaccheda arthaḥ ayogaḥ saṃbandha abhāvaḥ tasya vyavacchedaḥ nivṛttiḥ tathā ca nirukta aṣṭakasya kriyā yogaḥ eva sādhutvam na anyathā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kriyāśabdasya dhātvarthamātre prasiddheḥ phalānvayenaivoktāṣṭakasya sādhutve sati na bhāvanānvayaniyamaḥ sidhyatīti na tadanurodhena bhāvanāyāḥ pāka ityādau dātuvācyatvaṃ labhyata ityāśaṅkyā''haayaṃ bhāva iti| bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ, ityādisūtreṣu bāhulyena vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ kriyāśabdena vyavahārasya kṛtatvādbhāvanāyāṃ kriyāśabdo rūḍhaḥ|
analyzed: nanu kriyā śabdasya dhātvartha mātre prasiddheḥ phala anvayena eva ukta aṣṭakasya sādhu tve sati na bhāvanā anvaya niyamaḥ sidhyati iti na tad anurodhena bhāvanāyāḥ pākaḥ ityādau dātu vācyatvam labhyate iti āśaṅkya āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti bhū ādayaḥ dhātavaḥ ityādi sūtreṣu bāhulyena vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ kriyā śabdena vyavahārasya kṛta tvāt bhāvanāyām kriyā śabdaḥ rūḍhaḥ

original: kriyetyākārakaḥ śabdo rūḍhyā bhāvanāṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| bhāvanāyāṃ kriyāśabdasya rūḍhisattve tathāprayogaprācuryadarśanameva pramāṇamityaśayena `prāyaśaḥ kriyāśabdenetyuktam| nanu phale'pi kriyāśabdaḥ prayukto dṛśyate, tatkathaṃ bhāvanāyāmeva kriyāśabdasya sāṃketikī śaktirityucyate, ityāśaṅkyā''haphalāṃśe kvācitka iti|
analyzed: kriyā iti ākārakaḥ śabdaḥ rūḍhyā bhāvanām pratipādayati iti arthaḥ bhāvanāyām kriyā śabdasya rūḍhi sattve tathā prayoga prācurya darśanam eva pramāṇam iti aśayena prāyaśas kriyā śabdena iti uktam nanu phale api kriyā śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ dṛśyate tat katham bhāvanāyām eva kriyā śabdasya sāṃketikī śaktiḥ iti ucyate iti āśaṅkya āha phala aṃśe kvācitke iti

original: kriyāśabde kṛñaḥ śa ceti sūtreṇa karmaṇi śapratyayaḥ| tathā ca kriyate bhāvanārūpavyāpāreṇotpādyate iti vyutpattyā phale yaugiko'yaṃ kriyāśabdaḥ, sa cāpi phaleṃ kvacideva prayuktaḥ| kvācitka ityanena prayogabāhulyābhāva uktaḥ| tena phalāṃśe kriyāśabdasya rūḍhyabhāva ityuktaṃ bhavati| yogāt prakṛtipratyayārthasaṃbandhādāgato yaugikaḥ|
analyzed: kriyā śabde kṛñaḥ śa ca iti sūtreṇa karmaṇi śa pratyayaḥ tathā ca kriyate bhāvanā rūpa vyāpāreṇa utpādyate iti vyutpattyā phale yaugikaḥ yam kriyā śabdaḥ sa ca api kvacid eva prayuktaḥ kvācitkaḥ iti anena prayoga bāhulya abhāvaḥ uktaḥ tena phala aṃśe kriyā śabdasya rūḍhi abhāvaḥ iti uktam bhavati yogāt prakṛti pratyaya artha saṃbandhāt āgataḥ yaugikaḥ

original: avayavaśaktyasahakṛtasamudāyaśaktimātreṇārthapratipādikā rūḍhiḥ, samudāyaśaktinirapekṣāvayavaśaktyā'rthapratipādikā yogaśaktiḥ|
analyzed: avayava śakti a sahakṛta samudāya śakti mātreṇa artha pratipādikā rūḍhiḥ samudāya śakti nirapekṣā avayava śaktyā artha pratipādikā yoga śaktiḥ

original: avayavārthānusaṃdhānasāpekṣatvena yogārthasya vilambopasthitikatvādvahiraṅgatvaṃ, avayavārthānusaṃdhānānapekṣatvena tuḥrūḍhyarthasya śīghropasthitikatvādantaraṅgatvamityantaraṅgatvaṃhiraṅgabhāvamūlakena yogādrūḍhirbaṃlīyasītinyāyena kriyāśabdena vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyā eva grahaṇāvaśyakatvena bhāvanārūpakriyānvaya evāṣṭakasya sādhutvaṃ pratipādyate
analyzed: avayava artha anusaṃdhāna sāpekṣa tvena yoga arthasya vilamba upasthitika tvāt vahiraṅga tvam avayava artha anusaṃdhāna anapekṣa tvena tuḥ rūḍhi arthasya śīghra upasthitika tvāt antaraṅga tvam iti antaraṅga tvam hiraṅga bhāva mūlakena yogāt rūḍhiḥ baṃlīyasī iti nyāyena kriyā śabdena vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ eva grahaṇa āvaśyaka tvena bhāvanā rūpa kriyā anvayaḥ eva aṣṭakasya sādhu tvam pratipādyate

original: na tu phalānvayeneti bhāva iti| saṃjñāśabdasyeti| rūḍhasyetyarthaḥ| anapekṣyeti| prakṛtipratyayātmakāvayavārthamananusaṃdhāyetyarthaḥ| saṃjñāśabdasya prakṛtipratyayārthānanusaṃdhānapravṛttikatvena balīyastve mīmāṃsādhikaraṇaṃ pramāṇīkarotiata eveti| saṃjñāśabdaprābalyāditi|
analyzed: na tu phala anvayena iti bhāvaḥ iti saṃjñā śabdasya iti rūḍhasya iti arthaḥ an apekṣya iti prakṛti pratyaya ātmaka avayava artham an anusaṃdhāya iti arthaḥ saṃjñā śabdasya prakṛti pratyaya artha an anusaṃdhāna pravṛttika tvena balīyas tve mīmāṃsā adhikaraṇam pramāṇīkaroti atas eva iti saṃjñā śabda prābalyāt iti

original: sāpekṣapravṛttikaśabdāpekṣayā nirapekṣapravṛttikaśabdasya balīyastvādityarthaḥ| navame nirṇītamiti| navamādhyāye dvitīyapāde pañcame'dhikaraṇe rathaṃtaramuttarāgranthapaṭhitayoravercorgeyamiti nirṇītamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sāpekṣa pravṛttika śabda apekṣayā nirapekṣa pravṛttika śabdasya balīyaḥ tvāt iti arthaḥ navame nirṇītam iti navama adhyāye dvitīya pāde pañcame adhikaraṇe rathaṃtaram uttarā grantha paṭhitayoḥ aveḥ ṛcoḥ geyam iti nirṇītam iti arthaḥ

original: taddhi `yadyonyāṃ gāyati taduttarayorgāyati' iti vacane padāntarasāpekṣatvapadāntaranirapekṣatvābhyāmarthapratipādakayordvayoruttarāśabdayormadhye padāntaranirapekṣārthaṃpratipādakottarāśabdagrahaṇanirṇayāya pravṛttam| chandaḥ, uttarā ceti dvau granthau samāgānāmṛkpāṭhārthaṃ staḥ|
analyzed: tat hi yat yonyām gāyati tat uttarayoḥ gāyati iti vacane pada antara sāpekṣa tva pada antara nirapekṣa tvābhyām artha pratipādakayoḥ dvayoḥ uttarā śabdayoḥ madhye pada antara nirapekṣa artham pratipādaka uttarā śabda grahaṇa nirṇayāya pravṛttam chandaḥ uttarā ca iti dvau granthau samāgānām ṛk pāṭha artham staḥ

original: tatra cchandonāmake granthe nānāvidhānāṃ sābhnāṃ yonibhūtā evarcaḥ paṭhitāḥ| uttarāgranthe tu tṛcātmakāni sūktāni paṭhitāni| ekasmiṃstṛce chandogatā yonyṛk‌prathamā, itare dve uttare| evaṃ sthite `taduttarayorgāyati' rathaṃtarayonyuttarayorṛcorgāyatītyatra dvividhe uttare saṃbhavataḥ|
analyzed: tatra chandaḥ nāmake granthe nānāvidhānām sābhnām yoni bhūtāḥ eva ṛcaḥ paṭhitāḥ uttarā granthe tu tṛca ātmakāni sūktāni paṭhitāni ekasmin tṛce chandaḥ gatā yoni ṛc prathamā itare dve uttare evam sthite tad uttarayoḥ gāyati rathaṃtara yoni uttarayoḥ ṛcoḥ gāyati iti atra dvividhe uttare saṃbhavataḥ

original: chandogranthe `abhitvā śūra' itīyamṛk rathaṃtarayonitvena paṭhitā| tasyā upari `tvāmiddhi havāmahe' ityādayo bṛhadādisāmnāṃ yonayaḥ paṭhitāḥ| uttarāgrante tu `abhi tvā śūra' iti sūkte tasyā ṛca ūrdhvaṃ `na tvā vām̐ anye' ityeṣā sāmnaḥ kasyāpyayonibhūtā paṭhitā|
analyzed: chandaḥ granthe abhi tvā śūraḥ iti iyam ṛc rathaṃtara yoni tvena paṭhitā tasyāḥ upari tvām id hi havāmahe ityādayaḥ bṛhat ādi sāmnām yonayaḥ paṭhitāḥ uttara agra ante tu abhi tvā śūraḥ iti sūkte tasyāḥ ṛcaḥ ūrdhvam na tvā vām anye iti eṣā sāmnaḥ kasya api a yoni bhūtā paṭhitā

original: tatra cchandogranthānusāreṇa bṛhadādisāmāntarayoryānī dve ṛcau rathaṃtarasya svayonyuttare bhavataḥ| uttarāgranthānusāreṇa tṛcagate dvitīyatṛtīye ṛcau svayonyuttare bhavataḥ|
analyzed: tatra chandaḥ grantha anusāreṇa bṛhat ādi sāma antarayoḥ yānī dve ṛcau rathaṃtarasya sva yoni uttare bhavataḥ uttarā grantha anusāreṇa tṛca gate dvitīya tṛtīye ṛcau sva yoni uttare bhavataḥ

original: tatra taduttarayorityatratyottarāśabdena kiṃ chandogranthānusāreṇa rathaṃtarayonyuttarabhūte bṛhadādisāmāntarayoryonī `tvāmiddhi havāmahe' ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye, uta uttarāgranthānusāreṇa rathaṃtarayonyuttare tṛcagate kasyāpi sāmno'nonibhūte dvitīyatṛtīye `na tvā vām̐ anye' ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye, ityevaṃ saṃdehe prāpte satidvividho
analyzed: tatra tad uttarayoḥ iti atratya uttarāśabdena kim chandaḥ grantha anusāreṇa rathaṃtara yoni uttara bhūte bṛhat ādi sāma antarayoḥ yonī tvām id hi havāmahe ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye uta uttarā grantha anusāreṇa rathaṃtara yoni uttare tṛca gate kasya api dvitīya tṛtīye na tvā vām anye ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye iti evam saṃdehe prāpte sati dvividhaḥ anyaḥ ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye iti evam saṃdehe prāpte sati dvividhaḥ anuṣṭhānaḥ anuṣṭhānaḥ anu

original: hyatrottarāśabdaḥ| tatraiko vyavasthāvācī, aparaśca granthaviśeṣavācī| yaśca vyavasthāvācī so'vadhyaṃśe nityasākāṅūkṣaḥ| uttarayorityukte tatra kasmādityevamavadhaayākāṅkṣāyā niyamena jāyamānatvāt| tasmādavadhivācakapadāntarasāpekṣatvenaivāyaṃ svārthapratipādakaḥ| padāntarānapekṣāyāṃ tvanarthaka eva bhavet|
analyzed: hi atra uttarā śabdaḥ tatra ekaḥ vyavasthā vācī aparaḥ ca grantha viśeṣa vācī yaḥ ca vyavasthā vācī saḥ vadhi aṃśe uttarayoḥ iti ukte tatra kasmāt iti evam avadha aya ākāṅkṣāyāḥ niyamena jāyamāna tvāt tasmāt avadhi vācaka pada antara sāpekṣa tvena eva ayam svārtha pratipādakaḥ pada antara anapekṣāyām tu anarthakaḥ eva bhavet

original: taduktaṃ śābarabhāṣye'sminnevādhikaraṇe`sarve hi saṃbandhiśabdāḥ padāntaramanapekṣamāṇā na kaṃcidapyarthamāhuḥ| tasmādapekṣitaṃ padāntaram| itarathā'paripūrṇārthaṃ vākyamanabhidhāyakameva syātkasyācidapyarthasya'| saṃbandhiśabdāḥnityaṃ saṃbandhyantarasāpekṣāḥ|
analyzed: tat uktam śābara bhāṣye smin eva adhikaraṇe sarve hi saṃbandhi śabdāḥ pada antaram anapekṣamāṇāḥ na kaṃcid api artham āhuḥ tasmāt apekṣitam pada antaram itarathā aparipūrṇa artham vākyam anabhidhāyakam eva syāt kasyācid api arthasya saṃbandhi śabdāḥ nityam saṃbandhi antara sāpekṣāḥ

original: uttarāśabdasya vaidikaprayogād‌granthaviśeṣe saṃjñātvena vinuyuktasya grahaṇe tu tasya padāntaranirapekṣatvātkevalaṃ śravaṇamātreṇaiva paripūrmasvārthabodhakatvam| tadapyuktaṃ tatraiva`saṃjñāsaṃjñigrahaṇe na punaḥ padāntaramapekṣate, śrutyaiva paripūrṇārtho gṛhyamāṇāsu padāntarāntaryamapekṣitavyaṃ bhavati' iti|
analyzed: uttarā śabdasya vaidika prayogāt grantha viśeṣe saṃjñā tvena vinu yuktasya grahaṇe tu tasya pada antara nirapekṣa tvāt kevalam śravaṇa mātreṇa eva tat api uktam tatra eva saṃjñā saṃjñi grahaṇe na punar pada antaram apekṣate śrutyā eva paripūrṇa arthaḥ gṛhyamāṇāsu pada antara āntaryam apekṣitavyam bhavati iti

original: evaṃ ca bṛhadādiyonyoruttarāśabdasya pūrvaṛksāpekṣatvādyaugikī pravṛttiriti tayorbilambenopasthitiḥ| uttarāgranthe tu tasya rūḍhyaparaparyāyasaṃjñātvena pravṛttiriti granthasya jhaṭityupasthitiḥ| tataścottarāśabdenātrottarāgranthe paṭhitayoreva śīghramupastitiḥ kṛteti tatraiva rathaṃtaraṃ geyaṃ, na bṛhadādiyonāviti siddhāntitam|
analyzed: evam ca bṛhat ādi yonyoḥ uttarā śabdasya pūrva ṛc sāpekṣa tvāt yaugikī pravṛttiḥ iti tayoḥ bilambena upasthitiḥ uttarā granthe tu tasya rūḍhi apara paryāya saṃjñā tvena pravṛttiḥ iti granthasya jhaṭiti upasthitiḥ tatas ca uttarā śabdena atra uttarā granthe paṭhitayoḥ eva śīghram upastitiḥ kṛtā iti tatra eva rathaṃtaram geyam na bṛhat ādi yonau iti siddhāntitam

original: evaṃ ca tatra yathā saṃbandhiśabdasya tattatsaṃbandhipratītisāpekṣapravṛttikatvena vilambopasthitikatvāddaurbalyaṃ, saṃjñāśabdasya tu nirapekṣapravṛttikatvena śīghropasthitikatvātprābalyaṃ tathā prakṛte yogārthapratītisāpekṣapravṛttikayaugikāpekṣayā saṃjñāśabdasya yogārthapratītinirapekṣapravṛttikatvātprābalyamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca tatra yathā saṃbandhi śabdasya tad tad saṃbandhi pratīti sāpekṣa pravṛttika tvena vilamba upasthitika tvāt daurbalyam saṃjñā śabdasya tu nirapekṣa pravṛttika tvena śīghra upasthitika tvāt prābalyam tathā prakṛte yoga artha pratīti sāpekṣa pravṛttika yaugika apekṣayā saṃjñā śabdasya yoga artha pratīti nirapekṣa pravṛttika tvāt prābalyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu phalasyāpi `karmavatkarmaṇā' iti sūtre kriyāśabdena vyavahārādastibhavatividyatiṣu sādhyatvena pratīyamānatvātsattādereva kriyātvopapādanācca palasyāpi kriyāśabdena grahaṇe bādhakābhāva ityāśaṅkayā''hakiṃ ca phalāṃśo'pīti| vyāpāraviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| `phale pradhānaṃ vyāpāraḥ' ityuktvāditi bhāvaḥ| kvacittathābhūtānīti|
analyzed: nanu phalasya api karma vat karmaṇā iti sūtre kriyā śabdena vyavahārāt asti bhavati vidyatiṣu sādhya tvena pratīyamāna tvāt sattā ādeḥ eva kriyā tva upapādanāt ca palasya api kriyā śabdena grahaṇe bādhaka abhāvaḥ iti āśaṅkayā āha kim ca phala aṃśaḥ upi iti vyāpāra viśeṣaṇam iti arthaḥ phale pradhānam vyāpāraḥ iti uktvāt iti bhāvaḥ kvacid tathābhūtāni iti

original: vyāpāraviśeṣaṇānītyarthaḥ| caitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau kartṛtiṅante kārakāṇāṃ vyāpāraviśeṣaṇatvena dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ| paktetyādau kṛdante kārakāṇāṃ vyāpāraṃ prati viśeṣyatvākvacidityuktam| guṇānāṃ ceti|
analyzed: vyāpāra viśeṣaṇāni iti arthaḥ caitraḥ taṇḍulam pacati ityādau kartṛ tiṅ ante kārakāṇām vyāpāra viśeṣaṇa tvena dṛṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ paktā ityādau kṛt ante kārakāṇām vyāpāram prati guṇānām ca iti

original: `guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvātsyāt'asyārthaḥguṇānāṃviśeṣaṇānāṃ, parārthatvātviśeṣyopakāritvāt, samatvātviśeṣyopakāritvarūpasamānadharmatvāt, teṣāṃ parasparaṃ saṃbandho guṇapradhānabhāvenānvayo nasyāditi|
analyzed: guṇānām ca parārtha tvāt asaṃbandhaḥ sama tvāt syāt tasya arthaḥ guṇānām viśeṣaṇānām parārtha tvāt viśeṣya upakāri tvāt sama tvāt viśeṣya upakāri tva rūpa samāna dharma tvāt teṣām parasparam saṃbandhaḥ guṇa pradhāna bhāvena anvayaḥ na syāt iti

original: tathā ca yathā phalasya viśeṣyopakāritvādviśeṣyabhūte vyāpāra evānvayastathā kārakāṇāmapi viśeṣyopakāritvātsākṣātparamparayā vā vyāpāra evānvayo, na tu kvacidapi phale, viśeṣaṇatvāviśeśānnirākāṅkṣātvācca| kārakatvasya kriyājanakatvarūpatvena janyakriyāṃśa eva teṣāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ| etannyāyānuguṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ svayamevā''hasarve sevakā iti|
analyzed: tathā ca yathā phalasya viśeṣya upakāri tvāt viśeṣya bhūte vyāpāre eva anvayaḥ tathā kārakāṇām api viśeṣya upakāri tvāt sākṣāt paramparayā vā vyāpāre eva anvayaḥ na tu kvacid api phale viśeṣaṇa tva aviśeśāt nirākāṅkṣā tvāt ca kāraka tvasya kriyā janaka tva rūpa tvena janya kriyā aṃśaḥ eva teṣām sākāṅkṣa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ etad nyāya anuguṇam dṛṣṭāntam svayam eva āha sarve sevakāḥ iti

original: parasparaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvamanāpannāḥ sevakāḥ prādhānyena yathā rājānameva sevante tathā kārakāṇyapi parasparanirapekṣāṇī vyāpārameva viśeṣyatvenāṅgīkurvate, na guṇabhūtaṃ phalāṃśamiti na tatrānvaya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: parasparam guṇa pradhāna bhāvam anāpannāḥ sevakāḥ prādhānyena yathā rājānam eva sevante tathā kārakāṇi api paraspara nirapekṣāṇī vyāpāram eva viśeṣya tvena aṅgīkurvate na guṇa bhūtam phala aṃśam iti na tatra anvayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ ca kārakāṇāṃ nityaparatantrāṇāṃ viśeṣyākāṅkṣāyāṃ dhātvarthaphalāṃśasya tathānvayayogyatāyāmapi tasyāpi paratantrasya viśeṣyākāṅkṣāpūraṇasamarthāyāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmevānvayāṅgīkāre laukikanyāyaṃ pradarśayatinahi bhikṣuka iti|
analyzed: kim ca kārakāṇām nitya paratantrāṇām viśeṣya ākāṅkṣāyām dhātvartha phala aṃśasya tathā anvaya yogyatāyām api tasya api paratantrasya viśeṣya ākāṅkṣā pūraṇa samarthāyām vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyām eva anvaya aṅgīkāre laukika nyāyam pradarśayati na hi bhikṣukaḥ iti

original: yathā hi lokavyavahāre bhikṣuko bhikṣukāntaraṃ na yācate sati bhikṣukādanyasmindātarītyevaṃ dṛśyate tathā kārakāṇyapi guṇabhūtāni guṇabhūtaṃ phalāṃśaṃ viśeṣyatayā nāṅgīkurvate, satyāmaguṇabhūtāyāṃ viśeṣyatayā'ṅgīkārayogyāyāṃ vyāpārātprakabhāvanāyāmityarthaḥ| manvata iti|
analyzed: yathā hi lokavyavahāre bhikṣukaḥ bhikṣuka antaram na yācate sati bhikṣukāt anyasmin dātari iti evam dṛśyate tathā kārakāṇi api guṇa bhūtāni guṇa bhūtam phala aṃśam viśeṣyatayā na aṅgīkurvate satyām aguṇa bhūtāyām viśeṣyatayā aṅgīkāra yogyāyām vyāpārāt praka bhāvanāyām iti arthaḥ manvate iti

original: anena nyāyena kārakāṇāṃ phalānvayaṃ vihāya bhāvanānvayameva mīmāṃsakā api manvata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ceti| kāraṇāṇāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmevānvaya ityevaṃ niyame cetyarthaḥ| yādṛśaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitastaṃ darśayativiśeṣyatayetyādi| kārakādīti| kālaphalayorādipadena grahaḥ|
analyzed: anena nyāyena kārakāṇām phala anvayam vihāya bhāvanā anvayam eva mīmāṃsakāḥ api manvate iti arthaḥ evam ca iti kāraṇāṇām vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyām eva anvayaḥ iti evam niyame ca iti arthaḥ yādṛśaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ phalitaḥ tam darśayati viśeṣya tayā ityādi kāraka ādi iti kāla phalayoḥ ādi padena grahaḥ

original: kārakādi, prakāroviśeṣaṇaṃ yatretyevamīdṛśe śābdabodhe jananīye, viśeṣyatayākārakādiniṣṭhaviśeṣaṇatānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyā yā bhāvanopasthitiḥ sā kāraṇamityarthaḥ| caitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatra lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥcaitrasyābhedasaṃbandhena laḍarthakartaryanvayaḥ|
analyzed: kāraka ādi prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇam yatra iti evam īdṛśe śābda bodhe jananīye viśeṣyatayā akāraka ādi niṣṭha viśeṣaṇatā nirūpita viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena dhātu janyā yā bhāvanā upasthitiḥ sā kāraṇam iti arthaḥ caitraḥ taṇḍulam pacati iti atra lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ caitrasya abheda saṃbandhena laṭ artha kartari anvayaḥ

original: laḍarthakartuśca niṣṭhatvasaṃbandhena bhāvanāyāṃvyāpāre'nvayaḥ, laḍarthakālasyāpi kālikasaṃbandhena vyāpāra evānvayaḥ| tathā taṇḍularūpasya karmaṇo niṣṭhatvasaṃbandhena viklittirūpe phale'nvayaḥ, phalasya cānukūlatāsaṃbandhena vyāpāre'nvayaḥ| caitraṃ prati laḍarthakartā viśeṣyaḥ, vyāpāraṃ prati ca viśeṣaṇam|
analyzed: laṭ artha kartuḥ ca niṣṭha tva saṃbandhena bhāvanāyām vyāpāra invayaḥ laṭ artha kālasya api kālika saṃbandhena vyāpāre eva anvayaḥ tathā taṇḍula rūpasya karmaṇaḥ niṣṭha tva saṃbandhena viklitti rūpe phala invayaḥ phalasya ca anukūla tā saṃbandhena vyāpāra invayaḥ caitram prati laṭ artha kartā viśeṣyaḥ vyāpāram prati ca viśeṣaṇam

original: tathā taṇḍulaṃ prati phalaṃ viśeṣyaṃ vyāpāraṃ prati ca viśeṣaṇam| tathā ca caitrābhinnalaḍarthakartṛniṣṭhaḥ, taṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklittyanukūlo vartamānakāliko vyāpāra iti vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodha ityarthaḥ| atra kartṛkārakasya vyāpāre sākṣādanvayaḥ, karmakārakasya tu phale, phalasya ca sākṣāvdyāpāra iti paramparayā vyāpāre karmānvayaḥ|
analyzed: tathā taṇḍulam prati phalam viśeṣyam vyāpāram prati ca viśeṣaṇam tathā ca caitra abhinna laṭ artha kartṛ niṣṭhaḥ taṇḍula niṣṭha viklitti anukūlaḥ vartamāna kālikaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti vyāpāra mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ śābda bodhaḥ iti arthaḥ atra kartṛ kārakasya vyāpāre sākṣāt anvayaḥ karma kārakasya tu phale phalasya ca sākṣāt dyāpāraḥ iti paramparayā vyāpāre karma anvayaḥ

original: yathā'dhikaraṇakārakasya kartṛkarmadvārā kriyānvayastathā karmaṇo'pi phaladvārā kriyāyāmevānvayo na tu phala iti bodhyam|
analyzed: yathā adhikaraṇa kārakasya kartṛ karma dvārā kriyā anvayaḥ tathā karmaṇaḥ api phala dvārā kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ na tu phale iti bodhyam

original: nanu yatra vyāpārasya prādhānyeva pratītiḥ, yathā pacatītyādau tiṅante| tatroktanyāyena kārakāṇi vyāpārameva viśeṣyatayā'ṅgīkurvantu nāma, kiṃtu yatra vyāpāro guṇabhūtastatra kathaṃ kārakāṇi viśeṣyatayā vyāpāramahgīkuryurata āhayatrāpi paktetyādi|
analyzed: nanu yatra vyāpārasya prādhānya eva pratītiḥ yathā pacati ityādau tiṅ ante tatra ukta nyāyena kārakāṇi vyāpāram eva viśeṣyatayā aṅgīkurvantu nāma kiṃtu yatra vyāpāraḥ guṇa bhūtaḥ tatra katham kārakāṇi viśeṣyatayā vyāpāram ahgīkuryuḥ atas āha yatra api paktā ityādi

original: yatra paktetyādikartrarthakatṛjādyantasthale prakṛtipratyayārtharyoriti nyāyena kartuḥ prādhānyāttadviśeṣaṇībhūtā vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā tatrāpi| niruktakāryakāraṇabhāvānusāreṇa viśeṣaṇībhūtabhāvanāyāmeva kārakānvayaḥ| yathā odanasya paktetyatra odanarūpasya karmaṇo vyāpāra evānvayo na tu phale|
analyzed: yatra paktā ityādi kartṛ artha katṛ ja ādi anta sthale prakṛti pratyaya artha ryoḥ iti nyāyena kartuḥ prādhānyāt tad viśeṣaṇībhūtā vyāpāra rūpā bhāvanā tatra api nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva anusāreṇa viśeṣaṇībhūta bhāvanāyām eva kāraka anvayaḥ yathā odanasya paktā ityatra odana rūpasya karmaṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ eva anvayaḥ na tu phale

original: tasyāmevetyekāreṇa phalānvayasya vyāvartitatvādityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca dhātvarthaphale kārakānvaye vājapeyādhikaraṇamasaṃgataṃ syāt| taddhi prathamādhyāyasya caturthapāde ṣaṣṭhamadhikaraṇam| phalaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, bhāvanā ākhyātārthaḥ, dhātvarthasya ca karaṇatvena bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ|
analyzed: tasyām eva iti ekāreṇa phala anvayasya vyāvartita tvāt iti arthaḥ kim ca dhātvartha phale kāraka anvaye vājapeya adhikaraṇam asaṃgatam syāt tat hi prathama adhyāyasya caturtha pāde ṣaṣṭham adhikaraṇam phalam dhātvarthaḥ bhāvanā ākhyāta arthaḥ dhātvarthasya ca karaṇa tvena bhāvanāyām anvayaḥ

original: evaṃ sthite tatretthaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ`vājapeyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' ityatra vājapepaॉyaśabdena guṇo vidhīyate| vājasyānnasya peyaṃ dravībhūto rasa iti vyutpattyā bājapeyaśabdo yavāgūparaḥ| tathā ca somena yajetetyatra somarūpaguṇa ivātra yavāgūrūpo guṇo vidhīyate|
analyzed: evam sthite tatra ittham pūrvapakṣaḥ vājapeyena svārājya kāmaḥ yajeta iti atra guṇaḥ vidhīyate vājasya annasya peyam dravībhūtaḥ rasaḥ iti vyutpattyā bājapeya śabdaḥ yavāgū paraḥ tathā ca somena yajeta iti atra soma rūpa guṇaḥ iva atra yavāgū rūpaḥ guṇaḥ vidhīyate

original: na ca vājapeyarūpaguṇavatā yāgena svarājyaṃ bhāvayedityarthalābhāya vājapeyaśabde matvarthalakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāryeti vācyam| vājapeyaguṇe svārājyaphale ca yajestantreṇa saṃbandhe sati vājapeyadravyeṇa svārājyāya yatetetyevamarthalābhāt| nanu yāgasya guṇasaṃbandhe sati vājapeyaguṇena yāgaṃ kuryādityevaṃ yāgasya karmakārakatvaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: na ca vājapeya rūpa guṇavatā yāgena svarājyam bhāvayet iti artha lābhāya vājapeya śabde matu artha lakṣaṇā aṅgīkāryā iti vācyam vājapeya guṇe svārājya phale ca yajeḥ tantreṇa saṃbandhe sati vājapeya dravyeṇa svārājyāya yateta iti evam artha lābhāt nanu yāgasya guṇa saṃbandhe sati vājapeya guṇena yāgam kuryāt iti evam yāgasya karma kāraka tvam bhavati

original: tathā yāgena svārājyaṃ bhāvayodityevaṃ yāgasya phalasaṃbandhe karaṇakārakatvaṃ bhavati| tatkathamubhayasaṃbandha iti cenna| yajeḥ sādhāraṇatvenobhayarūpatvasaṃbhavāt| yajetetyatra yajadhātunā yāga uktaḥ| pratyayena bhāvanoktā| tayostu samabhivyāhārātsaṃbandhamātraṃ gamyate| tacca karmatvakaraṇatvayoḥ sādhāraṇam|
analyzed: tathā yāgena svārājyam bhāvayot iti evam yāgasya phala saṃbandhe karaṇa kāraka tvam bhavati tat katham ubhaya saṃbandhe iti ced na yajeḥ sādhāraṇa tvena ubhaya rūpa tva saṃbhavāt yajeta iti atra yaja dhātunā yāgaḥ uktaḥ pratyayena bhāvanā uktā tayoḥ tu samabhivyāhārāt saṃbandha mātram gamyate tat ca karmatva karaṇa tvayoḥ sādhāraṇam

original: na tatra karmatvavācinī karaṇatvavācīnī vā kācidasādhāraṇī vibhaktiḥ śrūyate| ataḥ sādhāraṇasya yajerubhābhyāṃ yugapatsaṃbandhe sati yathocitasaṃbandhaviśeṣastatra tatra paryavasyati| evaṃ tantreṇa saṃbandhāṅgīkāre vājapeyadravyena yāgaṃ kuryādityarthasya labhyamānatvādguṇavidhitve'pi nāsti matvarthalakṣaṇeti|
analyzed: na tatra karma tva vācinī karaṇa tva vācīnī vā kācid asādhāraṇī vibhaktiḥ śrūyate atas sādhāraṇasya yajeḥ ubhābhyām yugapad saṃbandhe sati yathā ucita saṃbandha viśeṣaḥ tatra tatra paryavasyati evam tantreṇa saṃbandha aṅgīkāre vājapeya dravyena yāgam kuryāt iti arthasya labhyamāna tvāt guṇa vidhi tve api na asti matu artha lakṣaṇā iti

original: siddhāntastuyajestantreṇobhayasaṃbandhāṅgīkāre yāge viruddhatrikadbayāpattiḥ syāt| tathā hiuddeśyatvamanuvādyatvaṃ mukhyatvaṃ ceti trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇāmekaṃ trikam| upādeyatvaṃ vidheyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ ceti trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇāmaparaṃtrikam| etattrikadvayaṃ mithaḥ krameṇa viruddham| yajetetyatra prtayayavācyamāvanāyāḥ sādhyaṃ svārājyaphalam| sādhanaṃ yāgaḥ|
analyzed: siddhāntaḥ tu yajeḥ tantreṇa ubhaya saṃbandha aṅgīkāre yāge viruddha trika dbaya āpattiḥ syāt tathā hi uddeśya tvam anuvādya tvam mukhya tvam ca iti trayāṇām dharmāṇām ekam trikam upādeya tvam vidheya tvam guṇa tvam ca iti trayāṇām dharmāṇām aparam trikam etat trika dvayam mithas krameṇa viruddham yajeta iti atra sādhyam svārājya phalam sādhanam yāgaḥ

original: tatrā''dyamuddeśyatvāditrikaṃ sādhyabhūtasvārājyaphalaniṣṭham| dvitīyamupādeyatvāditrikaṃ sādhanabhūtayāganiṣṭham| phalamuddiśya yāga upādīyate| phalamanūdya yāgo vidhīyate| phalaṃ pradhānaṃmukhyaṃ, yāga upasarjanaṃ guṇaḥ| phalasyoddeśyatvaṃ nāma mānasāpekṣāviṣayatvam| yāgasyopādeyatvaṃ nāmānuṣṭhīyamānattram| tāvumau manaḥśarīropādhiko dharmau|
analyzed: tatra ādyam uddeśya tva ādi trikam sādhya bhūta svārājya phala niṣṭham dvitīyam upādeya tva ādi trikam sādhana bhūta yāga niṣṭham phalam uddiśya yāgaḥ upādīyate phalam anūdya yāgaḥ vidhīyate phalam pradhānam mukhyam yāgaḥ upasarjanam guṇaḥ phalasya uddeśya tvam nāma mānasa apekṣā viṣaya tvam yāgasya upādeya tvam nāma anuṣṭhīyamāna ttram tau umau manaḥ śarīra upādhikaḥ dharmau

original: anuvādyatvavidheyatvadharmau tu śabdopādhikau| jñātasya kathanamanuvādaḥ| ajñātasyānuṣṭheyatvakathanaṃ vidhiḥ| phalayāgayoḥ sādhyasādhanatvarūpatayā pradhānatvopasarjanatve| evaṃ sati phalatatsādhanayoḥ svārājyayāgayoḥ svabāvaparyālocanāyāṃ yathā phalasyoddeśyatvāditrīkaṃ, yāgasyopādeyavatvāditrikaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: anuvādya tva vidheya tva dharmau tu śabda upādhikau jñātasya kathanam anuvādaḥ ajñātasya anuṣṭheya tva kathanam vidhiḥ phala yāgayoḥ sādhya sādhana tva rūpatayā pradhāna tva upasarjana tve evam sati phala tad sādhanayoḥ svārājya yāgayoḥ svabāva paryālocanāyām yathā phalasya uddeśya tva ādi trīkam yāgasya upādeyava tva ādi trikam bhavati

original: tathā yāgasya vājapeyasya ca sādhyasādhanabhāvaparyālocanāyāṃ yāgasyoddeśyatvāditrikaṃ, vājapeyasyopādepatvāditrikaṃ ca paryavasyati| tataḥ prakṛte yāgasya sādhanatvena sādhyatvena ceti prakāradvayena pratyayavācyabhāvanāyāṃ yugapattantreṇa saṃbandhāṅgīkāre sādhanatvamūlakā upādeyatvādayastrayo dharmā yāge'ṅgīkartavyāḥ|
analyzed: tathā yāgasya vājapeyasya ca sādhya sādhana bhāva paryālocanāyām yāgasya uddeśya tva ādi trikam vājapeyasya upādepa tva ādi trikam ca paryavasyati tatas prakṛte yāgasya sādhana tvena sādhya tvena ca iti prakāra dvayena pratyaya vācya bhāvanāyām yugapad tantreṇa saṃbandha aṅgīkāre sādhana tva mūlakāḥ upādeya tva ādayaḥ trayaḥ dharmāḥ yāga iṅgīkartavyāḥ

original: sādhyatvācca tadānīmeva tatraiva yāge uddeśyatvādayastrayo dharmāḥ prāpnuvanti| kiṃ tūpādeyatvādibhiḥ sākaṃ virodhāduddeśyatvādayastrayo dharmāstatra tadānīmeva nāṅgīkartuṃ śakyante| ato'tra yāgasya sādhanatvena sādhyatvena ceti prakāradvayena bhāvanāyāṃ yugapattantreṇa saṃbandho durvaca iti|
analyzed: sādhya tvāt ca tadānīm eva tatra eva yāge uddeśya tva ādayaḥ trayaḥ dharmāḥ prāpnuvanti kim tu upādeya tva ādibhiḥ sākam virodhāt uddeśya tva ādayaḥ trayaḥ dharmāḥ tatra tadānīm eva na aṅgīkartum śakyante atas utra yāgasya sādhana tvena sādhya tvena ca iti prakāra dvayena bhāvanāyām yugapad tantreṇa saṃbandhaḥ durvacaḥ iti

original: asminnadhikaraṇe dhātvarthaphalasya yāgasya karaṇatvena bhāvanāyāmanvaye kṛte tatraiva yāge punaḥ kārakāntarānvaye viruddhatrikadvayāpattirdoṣatvenoktā| yadi viśeṣaṇībhūte ghātvarthaphale kārakāntarānvayaḥ syāttarhi trikadvayāpāttirūpadoṣadānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: asmin adhikaraṇe dhātvartha phalasya yāgasya karaṇa tvena bhāvanāyām anvaye kṛte tatra eva yāge punar kāraka antara anvaye viruddha trika dvaya āpattiḥ doṣa tvena uktā yadi viśeṣaṇībhūte ghātvartha phale kāraka antara anvayaḥ syāt tarhi trika dvaya āpātti rūpa doṣa dānam asaṃgatam syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasmādviśeṣaṇībhūte dhātvarthaphale kārakāṇāmanvayo naiva bhavati kiṃtu viśeṣyabhūte vyāpāra eva kārakānvaya ityavaśyamaṅgīkāryamityāśayenā''habhūṣaṇe prapañcitamiti| evaṃ ca pāka ityādāvodanasyetyādikārakānvayasiddhaye vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyā ghañante dhātuvācyatvamāvaśyakamiti siddham|
analyzed: tasmāt viśeṣaṇībhūte dhātvartha phale kārakāṇām anvayaḥ nā eva bhavati kiṃtu viśeṣya bhūte vyāpāre eva kāraka anvayaḥ iti avaśyam aṅgīkāryam iti āśayena āha bhūṣaṇe prapañcitam iti evam ca pākaḥ ityādau odanasya ityādi kāraka anvaya siddhaye vyāpāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ ghañ ante dhātu vācya tvam āvaśyakam iti siddham

original: prakārāntareṇa kārakāṇāṃ vyāpārānvayaniyamaṃ sādhayatāmanyeṣāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ matamupapādayannāhakecittvityādi| anvayabodhākāṅkṣānivṛttyoriti| anvayabodhasyā''kāṅkṣānivṛtteścetyarthaḥ| adarśanāditi|
analyzed: prakāra antareṇa kārakāṇām vyāpāra anvaya niyamam sādhayatām anyeṣām vaiyākaraṇānām matam upapādayan āha kecid tu ityādi anvaya bodha ākāṅkṣā nivṛttyoḥ iti anvaya bodhasya ākāṅkṣā nivṛtteḥ ca iti arthaḥ adarśanāt iti

original: bhūtale dhaṭa ityatra bhūtalābhinnamadhikaraṇamekatvaviśiṣṭo ghaṭaścetyanvayabodhasya, devadatto ghaṭamityatra ghaṭābhinnaṃ karmetyādyanvayabodhasya ca saṃbhave'pi `sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ kriyayā parisamāpyate' iti nyāyena vākyadvaye krameṇāstipaśyatītyādikriyāmantareṇa vākyaghaṭakayāvatpadārthānāṃ
analyzed: bhū tale dhaṭaḥ iti atra bhū tala abhinnam adhikaraṇam ekatva viśiṣṭaḥ ghaṭaḥ ca iti anvaya bodhasya devadattaḥ ghaṭam iti atra ghaṭa abhinnam karma ityādi anvaya bodhasya ca saṃbhave pi sarvam hi vākyam kriyayā parisamāpyate iti nyāyena vākya dvaye krameṇa asti paśyati ityādi kriyām antareṇa vākya ghaṭaka yāvat padārthānām

original: parasparamanvayabodhājananādākāṅkṣānivṛtterapyadarśanādityarthaḥ| tavadyatirekeṇeti| sattādarśanādikriyādhyāhāreṇa vinā niruktavākyadvayasya sādhutvaṃ na labhyata ityarthaḥ| āhuriti| anena taduktāvasvarasaḥ sūcitaḥ| sa cāpyasādhutvāṃśe|
analyzed: parasparam anvaya bodha ajananāt ākāṅkṣā nivṛtteḥ api adarśanāt iti arthaḥ tavat yatirekeṇa iti sattā darśana ādi kriyā adhyāhāreṇa vinā nirukta vākya dvayasya sādhu tvam na labhyate iti arthaḥ āhuḥ iti anena tad uktau asvarasaḥ sūcitaḥ sa ca api asādhutva aṃśe

original: yadi tu kriyāsākāṅkṣāvākye sādhutvaṃ neṣyeta tarhi `gāmityukte kartā kriyā cānirdiṣṭe' ityādibhāṣyokterasādhutāpatteḥ| vākyaghaṭakayāvatpadārthānāṃ mitho'nvayabodha ākāṅkṣānivṛttiśca yogyakriyādhyāhārema nirvāhye ityāśayaḥ| etāvatā kārakāṇāṃ bhāvanānvayaniyamaḥ kathaṃ sidhyatīti cintyamiti bhāvaḥ|| 17 ||
analyzed: yadi tu kriyā sākāṅkṣā vākye sādhu tvam neṣyeta tarhi gām iti ukte kartā kriyā ca anirdiṣṭe ityādi bhāṣya ukteḥ asādhu tā āpatteḥ vākya ghaṭaka yāvat padārthānām mithas nvaya bodhaḥ ākāṅkṣā nivṛttiḥ ca nirvāhye iti āśayaḥ etāvatā kārakāṇām bhāvanā anvaya niyamaḥ katham sidhyati iti cintyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: svayamityādi| niruktāṣṭakasya kriyānvaya eva sādhutve yuktimuktvedānīṃ kriyānanvaye pratibandīrūpāṃ tāṃ vaktiyadi pakṣe'pi vatyartha iti| yadi pakṣesaṃdigdhasādhyavati parvatādau, vatyarthaḥsādṛśyamanveti, kārakaṃadhikaraṇādi, nañādiṣunañarthābhāve, taditaranāmārthe ca, anvetītīṣyeta naiyāyikairityarthaḥ|
analyzed: svayam ityādi nirukta aṣṭakasya kriyā anvaye eva sādhutve yuktim uktvā idānīm kriyā ananvaye pratibandī rūpām tām vakti yadi pakṣe api vati arthaḥ iti yadi pakṣe saṃdigdha sādhyavati parvata ādau vati arthaḥ sādṛśyam anveti kārakam adhikaraṇa ādi nañ ādiṣu nañartha abhāve tad itara nāma arthe ca anveti iti iṣyeta naiyāyikaiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tarhi puṣpebhya ityatra taditarānāmārthe ca, anvetītīṣyeta naiyāyikairityarthaḥ| tarhi puṣpebhya ityatra kārakacaturthīsiddhaye bhavadbhiryā spṛhadhātuprayogakalpanā kṛtā sā parityaktavyā bhavatīti saṃkṣipto'rthaḥ| parvato vahnimāniti| tena tulyamityanena kriyāsādṛśye vihitavateḥ kriyāyāmevānvaya ityevaṃ na niyamaḥ|
analyzed: tarhi puṣpebhyaḥ iti atra tad itara anāma arthe ca anveti iti iṣyeta naiyāyikaiḥ iti arthaḥ tarhi puṣpebhyaḥ iti atra kāraka caturthī siddhaye bhavadbhiḥ yā spṛha dhātu prayoga kalpanā kṛtā sā parityaktavyā bhavati iti saṃkṣiptaḥ ūrthaḥ parvataḥ vahnimān iti tena tulyam iti anena kriyā sādṛśye vihita vateḥ kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ iti evam na niyamaḥ

original: mahānasavaditi dṛṣṭānte niruktasūtreṇa vihatavatarerthasya sādṛśyasya parvata evānvayo, na kriyāyām| yathā mahānaso vanhimāṃstathā parvato'pīti vivaraṇena mahānasasadṛśaḥ parvata ityarthapratītervatyarthasādṛśyasya parvata evānvayasya dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: mahānasa vat iti dṛṣṭānte nirukta sūtreṇa sādṛśyasya parvate eva anvayaḥ na kriyāyām yathā mahānasaḥ vanhimān tathā parvataḥ api iti vivaraṇena mahānasa sadṛśaḥ parvataḥ iti artha pratīteḥ vati artha sādṛśyasya parvate eva anvayasya dṛṣṭa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā saptamyadhikaraṇe cetyādinā vihitasaptamyāderarthasyādhikaraṇādikārakasya kriyāyāmevānvaya ityayamapi niyamo na dṛśaayate|
analyzed: tathā saptamī adhikaraṇe ca ityādinā vihita saptamī ādeḥ arthasya adhikaraṇa ādi   kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ iti ayam api niyamaḥ na

original: `bhūtale na ghaṭaḥ' ityatra bhūtalavṛttitvābhāvavān ghaṭaḥ, athavā bhūtavṛttirghaṭābhāva ityarthabodhātkārakādhikāravihitādhikaraṇasya nañarthābhāva evānvayapratīteḥ, bhūtale ghaṭa ityatra bhūtalādheyatvavān, bhūtalavṛttirvā ghaṭa ityarthabodhādadhikaraṇakārakasya nāmārtha evānvayaparyavasānādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhū tale na ghaṭaḥ iti atra bhū tala vṛtti tva abhāvavān ghaṭaḥ athavā bhūta vṛttiḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti artha bodhāt kāraka adhikāra vihita adhikaraṇasya nañ artha abhāvaḥ eva anvaya pratīteḥ bhū tale ghaṭaḥ iti atra bhū tala ādheya tvavān bhū tala vṛttiḥ vā ghaṭaḥ iti artha bodhāt adhikaraṇa kārakasya nāma arthe eva anvaya paryavasānāt iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ vatyarthasādṛśyasya saptamyarthasyādhikaraṇakārakasya cānuśāsanamanādṛtya nāmārthānvayāṅgīkāreṇa tayoḥ sādhutvaṃ svīkurudhve cettadatyantāyuktamityāhatyajyatāmiti| caturthyāḥ spṛhīti|
analyzed: evam vati artha sādṛśyasya saptamī arthasya adhikaraṇa kārakasya ca anuśāsanam an ādṛtya nāma artha anvaya aṅgīkāreṇa tayoḥ sādhutvam svīkurudhve ced tat atyanta ayuktam iti āha tyajyatām iti caturthyāḥ spṛhi iti

original: puṣpebhya iti caturthyantamātraprayoge spṛhayatītiśabdādhyāhāra eva spṛherīpsita iti vihitacaturthyāḥ sādhutvārthamanusriyate, na tu tatsamānārthakaghātvantaraghaṭitapadādhyāhāro, nāpyarthādhyāhāro naiyāyikaistattyajyatām| anuśāsanavirodhasya taulyādityarthaḥ| ardhajaratīyamiti| ardhaṃ jaratyā ardhajaratī, tatsadṛśamardhajaratīyam|
analyzed: puṣpebhyaḥ iti caturthī anta mātra prayoge spṛhayati iti śabda adhyāhāraḥ eva spṛheḥ īpsitaḥ iti vihita caturthyāḥ sādhutva artham anusriyate na tu tad samāna arthaka ghātu antara ghaṭita pada adhyāhāraḥ na api artha adhyāhāraḥ naiyāyikaiḥ tat tyajyatām anuśāsana virodhasya taulyāt iti arthaḥ ardhajaratī iyam iti ardham jaratyāḥ ardhajaratī tad sadṛśam ardhajaratīyam

original: samāsācca tadviṣayāditīvārthe chapratyayaiti vyācakṣate| kiṃtvatrārdhajaratītyekadeśisamāsasyevārthaviṣayatvaṃ kathamiti cintyam|
analyzed: samāsāt ca tad viṣayāt iti iva arthe chapratyayāḥ eti vyācakṣate kiṃtu atra ardha jarati iti ekadeśi samāsasya iva artha viṣaya tvam katham iti cintyam

original: ekadeśisamāsottaraṃ gahāditvādidamarthe cha iti vyākhyāne'pi ekadeśisamāsasya pūrvapadārthapradhānatvājjaratyā ardhasyedamityarthaḥ syātsa tu neṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tu jaratyā ardhamidamityardhasyedaṃśabdasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇyamabhīṣṭaṃ na syādataḥ śivabhāgavata ityatreva yugapad‌vṛttiḥ karaṇīyā|
analyzed: eka deśi samāsa uttaram gaha ādi tvāt idam arthe chaḥ iti vyākhyāne api eka deśi samāsasya pūrva padārtha pradhāna tvāt jaratyāḥ ardhasya idam iti arthaḥ syāt sa tu na iṣṭaḥ kim tu jaratyāḥ ardham idam iti ardhasya idam śabdasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇyam abhīṣṭam na syāt atas śiva bhāgavataḥ iti atra eva yugapad vṛttiḥ karaṇīyā

original: atra śivabhagavacchabdayoḥ pūrvaṃ karmadhāraye kṛte tatastaddhitavṛttau śaivabhagavata iti syāt| ādau taddhitavṛttyā bhāgavataṃ saṃsādhya paścācchivena samāsavivakṣāyāṃ śivasya bhagavatyanvayo na syāt| ntargatatvena bhagavacchabdārthasyaikadeśatvātpadārthaḥ padārtheneti nyāyāt|
analyzed: atra śiva bhagavat śabdayoḥ pūrvam karmadhāraye kṛte tatas taddhita vṛttau śaiva bhagavataḥ iti syāt ādau taddhita vṛttyā bhāgavatam saṃsādhya paścāt śivena samāsa vivakṣāyām śivasya bhagavati anvayaḥ na syāt ntargata tvena bhagavat śabda arthasya eka deśa tvāt padārthaḥ padārthena iti nyāyāt

original: atastatra śivabhagavacchabdayorbhagavadapatyārthayośca yugapad‌vṛttidvaye kṛte śivasya bhagavato'patyamiti vṛttyarthāvabodhakaṃ vākyaṃ bhavati| tadvajjaratyā ardhenedamarthena ca saṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ yugapad‌vṛttidvaye kṛte jaratyā idamardhamiti vṛttyarthāvabodhakavākye idamardhaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sidhyati|
analyzed: atas tatra śiva bhagavat śabdayoḥ bhagavat apatya arthayoḥ ca yugapad vṛtti dvaye kṛte śivasya bhagavatā upatyam iti vṛtti artha avabodhakam vākyam bhavati tadvat jaratyāḥ ardhena idam arthena ca saṃbandha vivakṣāyām yugapad vṛtti dvaye kṛte jaratyāḥ idam ardham iti vṛtti artha avabodhaka vākye idam ardha śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam sidhyati

original: jaratyā idamiti jaratīyaṃ, ardhaṃ ca tajjaratīyaṃ ceti karmadhāraye kṛta idaṃtvena vivakṣitaṃ yajjaratīsaṃbandhi, tadardhamityarthabodhānniruktarītyā'pi ardhedaṃśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nirvoḍhuṃ śakyam|
analyzed: jaratyāḥ idam iti jaratī iyam ardham ca tat jaratīyam ca iti karmadhāraye kṛte idaṃtvena vivakṣitam yat jaratī saṃbandhi tat ardham iti artha bodhāt nirukta rītyā api ardha idam śabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam nirvoḍhum śakyam

original: tataśca yathā jaratyā idamardhaṃ kāmayate, idaṃ netyayuktaṃ tathā kvacitpāṇinyanuśāsanamanustrayate, kvacittyajyate cetyetadapyardhajaratīyasādṛśyādatyantāyuktamiti bhāvaḥ|| 18 ||
analyzed: tatas ca yathā jaratyāḥ idam ardham kāmayate idam na iti ayuktam tathā kvacid pāṇini anuśāsanam anustrayate kvacid tyajyate ca iti etat api ardhajaratīya sādṛśyāt atyanta ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ 18

original: evamiti| yathā niruktāṣ‍ṭakasya kriyayauvānvayastatetyarthaḥ| atrā''diśabdena ktvātumunādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ| bhāvārthagrahaṇam| inyādīnāmiti| atrā''diśabdena ktvātumunādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ| kriyayaiveti| guṇabhūtayā'pi kriyayaivetyarthaḥ| evakāraṇaṃ liṅgasaṃkhaayādyanvayidravyavyavacchedaḥ| anvayaḥ saṃbandha ityarthaḥ| tadāhaavigrahā gatādisthā iti|
analyzed: evam iti yathā nirukta aṣṭakasya atra ādi śabdena ktvā tumunā ādīnām saṃgrahaḥ bhāva artha grahaṇam inī ādīnām iti atra ādi śabdena ktvā tumunā ādīnām saṃgrahaḥ kriyayā eva iti guṇa bhūtayā api kriyayā eva iti arthaḥ eva kāraṇam anvayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti arthaḥ tat āha avigrahāḥ gata ādi sthāḥ iti

original: vivicyeti| viśeṣaṇatāmanāpadyetyarthaḥ| diśeṣyatayeti yāvat| na grahaṇaṃ yasyā ityarthaḥ| etatphalitamāhaguṇībhūteti itaraviśeṣaṇatāpannetyarthaḥ| grāmaṃ gata iti| gam‌dhātorgatyarthākarmaketi kartariktaḥ| prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti ktapratyayārthaḥ kartā viśeṣyaḥ| tadviśeṣaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ purodeśasaṃyogānukalo vyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: vivicya iti viśeṣaṇatām anāpadyā iti arthaḥ diśā iṣyatayā iti yāvat na grahaṇam yasyāḥ iti arthaḥ etad phalitam āha guṇībhūtā iti itara viśeṣaṇatā āpannā iti arthaḥ grāmam gataḥ iti gam dhātoḥ gati artha akarmakā iti kartā riktaḥ prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti kta pratyaya arthaḥ kartā viśeṣyaḥ tad viśeṣaṇam prakṛti arthaḥ puras deśa saṃyoga anukalaḥ vyāpāraḥ

original: saṃyogānukūlavyāpārāśraya ityarthaḥ| tatra ktapratyayārthakartṛviśeṣaṇībhūtavyāpārajanyasaṃyogāśrayatvena karmatvād grāmarūpasya karmaṇo viśeṣaṇībhūtavyāpāreṇaivānvayaḥ, kārakādiprakārakabodhe jananīye viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyabhāvanopasthiterhetutvasya klṛptatvāt| tathā ca grāmaniṣṭhasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārāśrayaścaitra iti bodhaḥ| tatheti|
analyzed: saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra ktapratyaya artha kartṛ viśeṣaṇībhūta vyāpāra janya saṃyoga āśraya tvena karma tvāt grāma rūpasya karmaṇaḥ viśeṣaṇībhūta vyāpāreṇa eva anvayaḥ kāraka ādi prakāraka bodhe jananīye viśeṣya tā saṃbandhena dhātu janya bhāvanā upasthiteḥ hetu tvasya klṛpta tvāt tathā ca grāma niṣṭha saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra āśrayaḥ caitraḥ iti bodhaḥ tathā iti

original: yathā grāmaṃ gata ityatra ktapratyayārthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā gamanakriyā grāmarūpakarmaṇā saṃbadhyate tathā kṛtapūrvītyatrenyarthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā kṛdhātvarthakriyā kaṭarūpakarmaṇā saṃbadhyata ityarthaḥ| kṛtapūrvīti| kaṭaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛto'neneti laukikavigrahaḥ| tatra pūrvamiti kriyāviśeṣamaṇam|
analyzed: yathā grāmam gataḥ iti atra kta pratyaya artha kartāram prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā gamana kriyā grāma rūpa karmaṇā saṃbadhyate tathā kṛtapūrvī iti atra ini artha kartāram prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā kṛ dhātvartha kriyā kaṭa rūpa karmaṇā saṃbadhyate iti arthaḥ kṛtapūrvī iti kaṭaḥ pūrvam kṛta ūnena iti laukika vigrahaḥ tatra pūrvam iti kriyā viśeṣa maṇam

original: kṛtapūrvaśabdayoḥ supsupeti samāsaḥ| anenatyanuvṛttau kṛtapūrvaśabdāt `pūrvādiniḥ, sapūrvācca' iti kartarīnipratbayaḥ| tatra karotikrayāpekṣayā kaṭasya karmatvātkaṭamiti dvitīyā| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamaneneti vigrahe kṛtaśabdasya pūrvaśabdena samāso na saṃbhavati| kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatvena sāmarthyavirahāt| samāsābhāvādeva cenarapyasaṃbhavaḥ|
analyzed: kṛta pūrva śabdayoḥ sup supā iti samāsaḥ tatra kṛta pūrva śabdāt pūrvāt iniḥ sa pūrvāt ca iti tatra karoti kraya apekṣayā kaṭasya karma tvāt kaṭam iti dvitīyā nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvam anena iti vigrahe kṛta śabdasya pūrva śabdena samāsaḥ na saṃbhavati kṛta śabdasya kaṭa sāpekṣa tvena sāmarthya virahāt samāsa abhāvāt eva ca inaḥ api asaṃbhavaḥ

original: kiṃ ca kṛta iti ktapratyayena kaṭasya karmaṇo'bhihatatvāttato dvitīyā na prāpnotīti cenna| kṛtaam pūrvaam ityalaukikavigrahavākye kaṭasyāsaṃnihitatayā karmatvenānvayāsaṃbhavena kṛñ‌dhātostadānīmakarmakatayā karmaṇi ktapratyayasyāsaṃbhave sati `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' iti bhāve ktapratyaye sati kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatvābhāvātsamāsa iniśca
analyzed: kim ca kṛtaḥ iti ktapratyayena kaṭasya karmaṇā ubhihata tvāt tatas dvitīyā na prāpnoti iti ced na pūrvam iti alaukika vigraha vākye kaṭasya asaṃnihita tayā karma tvena anvaya asaṃbhavena kṛñ dhātoḥ tadānīm akarmaka tayā karmaṇi ktapratyayasya asaṃbhave sati napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ iti bhāve ktapratyaye sati kṛta śabdasya kaṭa sāpekṣa tva abhāvāt samāsaḥ iniḥ ca

original: nirbādhau| karmaṇo'bhihitatvābhāvāśca| tataśca kṛtapūrvīti innantasya pūrvakālikakriyākartā `pūrvaṃ kṛtavān' ityarthaḥ paryavasyati| tataḥ karmatvavivakṣayā kiṃ kṛtavān? iti karmajijñāsāyāṃ kaṭasya karotikriyāpekṣayā karmatvāttato dvitīyā| kaṭaniṣṭhakarmatvaṃ ca na ktapratyayenābhihitaṃ, tasya bhāve vidhānāt| nāpīninā, tasya kartari vidhānāt|
analyzed: nirbādhau karmaṇaḥ ubhihita tva abhāvāḥ ca tatas ca kṛtapūrvī iti in nantasya pūrva kālika kriyā kartā pūrvam kṛtavān iti arthaḥ paryavasyati tatas karmatva vivakṣayā kim kṛtavān iti karma jijñāsāyām kaṭasya karoti kriyā apekṣayā karma tvāt tatas dvitīyā kaṭa niṣṭha karma tvam ca na ktapratyayena abhihitam tasya bhāve vidhānāt tasya kartari vidhānāt

original: nanu kaṭamityatra dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā kartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhī syātkaॉdyogasattvāditi śaṅkyam| na ca niṣṭhāyoge niṣedhādeva ṣaṣṭhī na bhavediti vācyam| `napuṃsake bhāve ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃkhaayānam' iti vārtikavacanena niṣṭhāyoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasyātrāprasakteriti cenna|
analyzed: nanu kaṭam iti atra dvitīyām bādhitvā kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī syāt kad yoga sattvāt iti śaṅkyam na ca niṣṭhā yoge niṣedhāt eva ṣaṣṭhī na bhavet iti vācyam napuṃsake bhāve ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhyāḥ iti vārtika vacanena niṣṭhā yoge ṣaṣṭhī niṣedhasya atra aprasakteḥ iti ced na

original: tatra kṛd‌grahaṇasāmarthyād vṛttyantarbhāvānāpannakṛdyogasya ṣaṣṭhīprayojakatvāṅgīkārāt| prakṛte ca kṛtetyasya taddhitakvṛttyantarbhūtatvānna tadyogaḥ ṣaṣṭhīprayojakaḥ| tathā ca ṣaṣṭhyabhāve uktarītyā karmaṇo'nabhihitatvād‌dvitīyā sulabhaiva|
analyzed: tatra kṛt grahaṇa sāmarthyāt vṛtti antarbhāva anāpanna kṛt yogasya ṣaṣṭhī prayojaka tva aṅgīkārāt prakṛte ca kṛtā ityasya taddhita k vṛtti antarbhūta tvāt na tad yogaḥ ṣaṣṭhī prayojakaḥ tathā ca ṣaṣṭhī abhāve ukta rītyā karmaṇaḥ ūnabhihitatvāt dvitīyā sulabhā eva

original: evaṃ ca kaṭaṃ kṛtavānityatreva kaṭamiti karmaṇa ityarthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtayaiva karotikriyayā'nvayaḥ| kārakaprakārakabodhaṃ pratītyādiniruktakāryakāraṇabhāvānusārādityarthaḥ| kaṭaniṣṭhotpattyanukūlapūrvakālikakriyākarteti, ekakaṭābhinnāśrayikā yotpattistadanukūlavyāpāravāniti kṛtapūrvīkaṭamityasmādbodhaḥ| inyādibhiriti|
analyzed: evam ca kaṭam kṛtavān ityatra eva kaṭam iti karmaṇaḥ iti artha kartāram prati viśeṣaṇībhūtayā eva karoti kriyayā anvayaḥ kāraka prakāraka bodham prati ityādi nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva anusārāt iti arthaḥ kaṭa niṣṭha utpatti anukūla pūrva kālika kriyā kartā iti eka kaṭa abhinna āśrayikā yā utpattiḥ tad anukūla vyāpāravān iti kṛta pūrvī kaṭam iti asmāt bodhaḥ ini ādibhiḥ iti

original: inyādyarthakartrādibhirguṇabhūteti yojanā| inyathaṃkartāraṃ prati guṇabhūtā karotikriyā kaṭakarmaṇā saṃbadhyata ddati yāvat| athavā svavācakaprakṛtikaktapratyayārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇabhūtā karotikriyā inyarthakartrā saṃbadhyate, iti vyākhyeyam|
analyzed: ini ādi artha kartṛ ādibhiḥ guṇa bhūtā iti yojanā ini athaṃkartāram prati guṇa bhūtā karoti kriyā kaṭa karmaṇā yāvat athavā sva vācaka prakṛtika kta pratyaya artham prati viśeṣaṇa bhūtā karoti kriyā ini artha kartrā saṃbadhyate iti vyākhyeyam

original: svaṃkriyā, tadvācakaḥ kṛghātuḥ, tatprakṛtikaḥ ktapratyayaḥ, tadartho bhāvaḥ, sa ca liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvitastaṃ prati guṇabhūtā karotikriyeti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ| ktapratyayārthabhāvanirūpitaviśeṣaṇabūtakarotikriyānirūpitamityarthasya kartṛtvamiti yāvat| tena `kartrādau vihitānāminyādīnāṃ kriyayaivānvayaḥ' ityavataraṇagranthānuguṇyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: svaṃkriyā tad vācakaḥ kṛ ghātuḥ tad prakṛtikaḥ ktapratyayaḥ tad arthaḥ bhāvaḥ sa ca liṅga saṃkhyā ādi anvitaḥ tam prati guṇa bhūtā karoti kriyā iti lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ ktapratyaya artha bhāva nirūpita viśeṣaṇa būta karoti kriyā nirūpitam iti arthasya kartṛ tvam iti yāvat tena kartṛ ādau vihitānām inyādīnām kriyayā eva anvayaḥ iti avataraṇa grantha ānuguṇyam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu gata ityādau kṛd‌vṛttisattvena vṛttau caikārthībhāvarūpasamudāyaśaktyaṅgīkāreṇa gatapadārthaikadeśagamanakriyāyāṃ grāmādikarmaṇāmanvayo durvacaḥ, tatra gamanakriyāyāḥ padārthaikadeśatvādityāśaṅkatena cetyādi| vṛttimātra iti| mātraṃ kārtsnye'vadhāraṇa iti kośānmātraśabdo'tra kṛtsnārthakaḥ| kṛtsnavṛttiṣvityarthaḥ| vakṣyamāṇatvāditi|
analyzed: nanu gataḥ ityādau kṛt vṛtti sattvena vṛttau ca ekārthībhāva rūpa samudāya śakti aṅgīkāreṇa gata padārtha eka deśa gamana kriyāyām grāma ādi karmaṇām anvayaḥ durvacaḥ tatra gamana kriyāyāḥ padārtha eka deśa tvāt iti āśaṅkatena ca ityādi vṛtti mātre iti mātram kārtsnya eva dhāraṇe iti kośāt mātra śabdaḥ utra kṛtsna arthakaḥ kṛtsna vṛttiṣu iti arthaḥ vakṣyamāṇatvāt iti

original: samāse khalu bhinnaiva śaktiḥityanena vṛttimātropalakṣakasamāsagrahaṇātkṛttaddhitasamāsaikaśeṣasanādyantadhaāturūpāsu pañcasvapi vṛttiṣvekāryobhāvarūpāyāḥ samudāyaśaktervakṣyamāṇatvādityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tatrānvaya iti| padārthaḥ padārthenānveti na tu padārthaiṃkadeśeneti niyamātpadārthaikadeśavyāpāre grāmakarmaṇo'nvayaḥ kathamityākṣepa ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: samāse khalu bhinnā eva śaktiḥ iti anena vṛtti mātra upalakṣaka samāsa grahaṇāt kṛt taddhita samāsa eka śeṣa san ādi anta dha ātu rūpāsu pañcasu api vṛttiṣu ekāryaḥ bhāva rūpāyāḥ samudāya śakteḥ vakṣyamāṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ katham tatra anvayaḥ iti padārthaḥ padārthena anveti na tu padārtha eka deśena iti niyamāt padārtha eka deśa vyāpāre grāma karmaṇaḥ anvayaḥ katham iti ākṣepaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tathā cāsaṃgatamidaṃ dṛṣṭāntopanyasanamiti bhāvaḥ| samādhattenityasāpekṣeṣvityādi| nityaṃ saṃbandhyantarasāpekṣeṣu śabdeṣu upasarjanatayā vṛttighaṭakeṣu satsvapi teṣu vṛttyekadeśabhūteṣveva tannirūpitaviśeṣaṇasya devadattāderanvayo bhavati| ekadeśānvaye'pi devadattasya yogurustatkulamityarthabodhajanakatvāt|
analyzed: tathā ca asaṃgatam idam dṛṣṭānta upanyasanam iti bhāvaḥ samādhatte nitya sāpekṣeṣu ityādi nityam saṃbandhi antara sāpekṣeṣu śabdeṣu upasarjanatayā vṛtti ghaṭakeṣu satsu api teṣu vṛtti eka deśa bhūteṣu eva tad nirūpita viśeṣaṇasya devadatta ādeḥ anvayaḥ bhavati eka deśa anvaye pi devadattasya yaḥ guruḥ tat kulam iti artha bodha janakatvāt

original: evaṃ caikadeśānvayapratibandhakaṃ tasya tādṛśārthabodhājanakatvaṃ, yathā ṛddhasya rājapuruṣa ityatra ṛddhasya rājñyanvaye'pi ṛddho yorājā, ṛddhasya yo rājeti vetyarthabodhājananam| rājño yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa ṛddhasaṃbandhītyeva tatra bodhāt| tacca pratibandhakaṃ nityasāpekṣeṣu nāstītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca eka deśa anvaya pratibandhakam tasya tādṛśa artha bodha ajanaka tvam yathā ṛddhasya rāja puruṣaḥ iti atra ṛddhasya rājñi anvaye pi ṛddhaḥ yaḥ rājā ṛddhasya yaḥ rājā iti vā iti artha bodha ājananam rājñaḥ yaḥ puruṣaḥ saḥ ṛddha saṃbandhi iti eva tatra bodhāt tat ca pratibandhakam nitya sāpekṣeṣu na asti iti arthaḥ

original: taduktaṃ vākyapadīyesaṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo nityaṃ sarvaḥ samasyate| vākyavatsā vyapekṣā hi vṛttāvapi na hīyate|| iti|
analyzed: tat uktam vākyapadīye saṃbandhi śabdaḥ sāpekṣaḥ nityam sarvaḥ samasyate vākya vat sā vyapekṣā hi vṛttau api na hīyate iti

original: hi yato devadattasya guroḥ kulamiti vākye yā vyapekṣāākāṅkṣā sā vṛttāvapi na hīnā bhavati, na nivartate, ato nityasāpekṣaḥ śabdaḥ samasyate, samāsaghaṭake ca tasminviśeṣaṇānvayo bhavati, bhavati ca devadattasya yo gururityādyarthaboghaḥ, tādṛśārthabodhānantaramevā''kāṅkṣānivṛtteriti tadarthaḥ| etatsarvamanusaṃdhāyā''hadevadattasya gurukulamiti|
analyzed: hi yatas devadattasya guroḥ kulam iti vākye yā vyapekṣā ākāṅkṣā sā vṛttau api na hīnā bhavati na nivartate atas nitya sāpekṣaḥ śabdaḥ samasyate samāsa ghaṭake ca tasmin viśeṣaṇa anvayaḥ bhavati bhavati ca devadattasya yaḥ guruḥ ityādi artha boghaḥ tādṛśa artha bodha anantaram eva ākāṅkṣā nivṛtteḥ iti tad arthaḥ etat sarvam anusaṃdhāya āha devadattasya guru kulam iti

original: gurutvasya śiṣyamantarā'nupapadyamānatvād guruḥ śiṣyāṃśe nityasāpekṣaḥ| śiṣyaścātra devadattaḥ| tasya ca padārthaikadeśe gurāvanvaye bhavati tato'pekṣitārthabodha iti padārthaḥ padārtheneti niyamo nityasāpekṣavyatiriktaviṣaya ityāśayaḥ| kecijjarannaiyāyikā na samāse śakti, nāpi samāse pūrvapade lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkurvate|
analyzed: guru tvasya śiṣyam antarā anupapadyamāna tvāt guruḥ śiṣya aṃśe nitya sāpekṣaḥ śiṣyaḥ ca atra devadattaḥ tasya ca padārtha eka deśe gurau anvaye bhavati tata upekṣita artha bodhaḥ iti padārthaḥ padārthena iti niyamaḥ nitya sāpekṣa vyatirikta viṣayaḥ iti āśayaḥ kecid jarat naiyāyikāḥ na samāse na api samāse pūrva pade lakṣaṇām aṅgīkurvate

original: kiṃtu rājapuruṣa ityatra puruṣapadaṃ rājasaṃbandhipuruṣaparaṃ rājapadaṃ tātparyagrāhakamityevamuttarapadalakṣaṇāṃ vadanti| tadrītyā'tra gururna padārthaikadeśa iti tatra viśeṣaṇānvayasya sāhajikatvānnāyaṃ dṛṣṭānta ityato dṛṣṭāntāntaraṃ darśayaticaitrasya napteti| janyaśarīrajanyaśarīraṃ naptṛpadārthaḥ|
analyzed: kiṃtu rāja puruṣaḥ iti atra puruṣa padam rāja saṃbandhi puruṣa param rāja padam tātparya grāhakam iti evam uttara pada lakṣaṇām vadanti tad rītyā atra guruḥ na padārtha eka deśaḥ iti tatra viśeṣaṇa anvayasya sāhajika tvāt na ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti atas dṛṣṭānta antaram darśayati caitrasya naptā iti janya śarīra janya śarīram naptṛ padārthaḥ

original: caitraḥ pitāmahaḥ, tatputro vaiśākhaḥ, tatputro jyeṣṭhaḥ| tatra caivājanyaśarīraṃ vaiśākhasya, vaiśākhajanyaśarīraṃ ca jyeṣṭhasyeti jyeṣṭhaścaitrasya naptā pautra ityarthaḥ| tatra janyaśarīrajanyaśarīrarūpanaptṛpadārthaikadeśe janyatve caitrasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantārthasya svanirūpitatvādisaṃbandhenānvayaḥ|
analyzed: caitraḥ pitāmahaḥ tad putraḥ vaiśākhaḥ tad putraḥ jyeṣṭhaḥ tatra ca eva ajanya śarīram vaiśākhasya vaiśākha janya śarīram ca jyeṣṭhasya iti jyeṣṭhaḥ caitrasya naptā pautraḥ iti arthaḥ tatra janya śarīra janya śarīra rūpa naptṛ padārtha eka deśe janya tve caitrasya iti ṣaṣṭhī anta arthasya sva nirūpita tva ādi saṃbandhena anvayaḥ

original: caitranirūpitajanyatvavaccharīrajanyaśarīramityarthaḥ| nanvatrāpi caitrasyeti ṣaṣṭhyantārthasya na naptṛpadārthaikadeśe janyatve'nvayaḥ, kiṃ tu svajanyajanyatvasaṃbandhena naptṛpadārthaviśeṣyabhūte śarīra evānvayaḥ| janyajanyatvasaṃbandhārthikā ṣaṣṭhītyarthaḥ| tathā ca caitrajanyajanyatvavacchaśarīramiti bodhaḥ| ata āhaityādāviti|
analyzed: caitra nirūpita janya tva vat śarīra janya śarīram iti arthaḥ nanu atra api caitrasya iti ṣaṣṭhī anta arthasya na naptṛ padārtha eka deśe janyatve anvayaḥ kim tu sva janya janya tva saṃbandhena naptṛ padārtha viśeṣya bhūte śarīre eva anvayaḥ janya janya tva saṃbandha arthikā ṣaṣṭhī iti arthaḥ tathā ca caitra janya janya tva vat śa śarīram iti bodhaḥ atas āha etyādau iti

original: ādipadād ghaṭādanyaḥ, ghaṭātpṛthagityādiparigrahaḥ| anyapadārthaikadeśe bhede pañcamyantārthaghaṭapratiyogitvasyānvayaḥ| ghaṭapratiyogikabhedavānityarthaḥ| tathā pṛthak‌padārthaikadeśe pṛthaktve pañcamyantārthaghaṭāvadhitvasyānvayaḥ| ghaṭāvadhikapārthakyavāniti bodhaḥ| yadyapi sarvatraivaikadeśaghaṭitaparamparāsaṃbandhenānvaya iti bhāṣya uktam|
analyzed: ādi padāt ghaṭāt anyaḥ ghaṭāt pṛthak ityādi parigrahaḥ anya padārtha eka deśe bhede pañcamī anta artha ghaṭa pratiyogitvasya anvayaḥ ghaṭa pratiyogika bhedavān iti arthaḥ tathā pṛthak padārtha eka deśe pṛthaktve pañcamī anta artha ghaṭa avadhi tvasya anvayaḥ ghaṭa avadhika pārthakyavān iti bodhaḥ yadi api sarvatra eva eka deśa ghaṭita paramparā saṃbandhena anvayaḥ iti bhāṣye uktam

original: taduktaṃ hariṇāsamudāyena saṃbandho yeṣāṃ gurukulādinā| saṃspṛśyāvayavāṃste tu yujyante tadvatā saha|| iti| yeṣāmarthānāṃ gurukulādirūpasamudāyena saṃbandhaḥ,(etena ekadeśaghaṭitatvarūpaparamparāsaṃbandho'rtho devadattādyuttaraṣaṣṭhyā iti sūcitam)te'pyarthā avayavān gurvādīn saṃspṛśya saṃbadhya tadbatāavayavavatā samudāyena gurukulādinā yujyanta
analyzed: tat uktam hariṇā samudāyena saṃbandhaḥ yeṣām guru kula ādinā saṃspṛśya avayavān te tu yujyante tadvatā saha iti yeṣām arthānām guru kula ādi rūpa samudāyena saṃbandhaḥ etena eka deśa ghaṭita tva rūpa paramparā saṃbandha ūrthaḥ devadatta ādi uttara ṣaṣṭhyā iti sūcitam te api arthāḥ avayavān guru ādīn saṃspṛśya saṃbadhya tadbatā a avayavavatā samudāyena guru kula ādinā yujyanta

original: iti tadarthāt| avayavān saṃspṛśyeti vadatā'trāpi pakṣe'vayavānāṃ viśeṣamasaṃbandhalābhaḥ sūcitaḥ| tathā'pyuktasthale ekadeśa evā''kāṅkṣāsattvādanubhavānurodhāccaikadeśānvayapakṣa evāṅgīkṛtaḥ|
analyzed: iti tad arthāt avayavān saṃspṛśya iti vadatā atra api pakṣa ivayavānām viśeṣam asaṃbandha lābhaḥ sūcitaḥ tathā api ukta sthale eka deśe eva ākāṅkṣā sattvāt anubhava anurodhāt ca eka deśa anvaya pakṣaḥ eva aṅgīkṛtaḥ

original: ata eva devadattasya gurukulamityādivākyajanyaśābdabodhottaraṃ gururdevadattīyo na vā, janyatvaṃ caitrīyaṃ na vetyādisaṃśayānutpattiścā''ñjasyena saṃgacchate|
analyzed: atas eva devadattasya guru kulam ityādi vākya janya śābda bodha uttaram guruḥ devadattīyaḥ na vā janya tvam caitrīyam na vā ityādi saṃśaya anutpattiḥ ca āñjasyena saṃgacchate

original: evaṃ ca niruktodāharaṇeṣu yathā padārthaikadeśe'pi gurvādau viśeṣaṇasya devadattāderanvayo'bhyupagatastathā padāthaiṃkadeśe guṇabhūtabhāvanāyāmeva grāmādikarmaṇāmanvayābhyupagame bādhakābhāva ityāśayaḥ| uktamarthamanyatrāpyatidiśatievamiti|
analyzed: evam ca nirukta udāharaṇeṣu yathā padārtha eka deśe api guru ādau viśeṣaṇasya devadatta ādeḥ anvayaḥ abhyupagataḥ tathā padātha eka deśe guṇa bhūta bhāvanāyām eva grāma ādi karmaṇām anvaya abhyupagame bādhaka abhāvaḥ iti āśayaḥ uktam artham anyatra api atidiśati evam iti

original: yathā gatapadārthaikadeśaguṇabhūtakriyāyāṃ grāmādikarmaṇāmanvayastathā bhoktuṃ pāka ityādāvapi pāka ityatra kṛd‌vṛttisattvena pākapadārthaikadeśāsattvabhūtaguṇakriyāyāṃ tumuno'nvaya ityarthaḥ| bhoktuṃ pāka iti| tumunṇvulau kriyāyāmiti sūtreṇa vihitasya tumunaḥ| kriyāyoga eva vidhānādasattvabhūtadhātūpasthāpyakriyāyāmanvayātsādhutvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā gata padārtha eka deśa guṇa bhūta kriyāyām grāma ādi karmaṇām anvayaḥ tathā bhoktum pākaḥ ityādau api pākaḥ iti atra kṛt vṛtti sattvena pāka padārtha eka deśa asattva bhūta guṇa kriyāyām tumunaḥ anvayaḥ iti arthaḥ bhoktum pākaḥ iti tumun ṇvulau kriyāyām iti sūtreṇa vihitasya tumunaḥ kriyā yoge eva vidhānāt asattva bhūta dhātu upasthāpya kriyāyām anvayāt sādhu tvam iti arthaḥ

original: bhuktvā pāka iti| samānakartṛkayoḥ kriyayormadhye pūrvakālasaṃbandhikriyāvācakātktvetyarthakasamānakartṛkayoriti sūtreṇa vidhutvaṃ bodhyam| atra dhātusaṃbandhādhikārātkripayoriti labdham| `avyayakṛto māve' iti vārtikād‌bhāva evārthastumunādeḥ|
analyzed: bhuktvā pākaḥ iti samāna kartṛkayoḥ kriyayoḥ madhye pūrva kāla saṃbandhi kriyā vācakāt ktvā iti arthaka samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti sūtreṇa vidhu tvam bodhyam atra dhātu saṃbandha adhikārāt kripayoḥ iti labdham avyaya kṛtaḥ iti vārtikāt bhāvaḥ eva arthaḥ tumuna ādeḥ

original: avedaṃ bodhyampāka ityādighañante prakṛtipratyayabhāgābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannāsattvasattavasvabhāve dve kriye pratipādyete|
analyzed: ava idam bodhyampākaḥ ityādi ghañ ante prakṛti pratyaya bhāgābhyām viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva āpanna asattva sattava svabhāve dve kriye pratipādyete

original: prakṛtibhāgenāsattvasvabhāvā kriyā, pratyayabhāgena ca sattvasvabhāvā kriyopasthāpyabhoktuṃ, bhuktvā, ityatra prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ kriyayorvaśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ samānaḥ, kiṃ tu pāka ityatra pratyayārthakriyāyāṃ yathā liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayitvarūpaṃ sattvasvabhāvātmakaṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ pratīyate, tādṛśaṃ vailakṣaṇyaṃ bhoktuṃ, bhuktvā ityatra
analyzed: prakṛti bhāgena asattva svabhāvā kriyā pratyaya bhāgena ca sattva svabhāvā kriyā upasthāpya bhoktum bhuktvā iti atra prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ kriyayoḥ samānaḥ kim tu pākaḥ iti atra pratyaya artha kriyāyām yathā liṅga saṃkhyā ādi anvayi tva rūpam sattva svabhāva ātmakam vailakṣaṇyam pratīyate tādṛśam vailakṣaṇyam bhoktum bhuktvā iti atra

original: pratyayārthakriyāyāṃ na pratīyata iti viśeṣaḥ| evaṃ cāsattvasvabhāva eva bhāvastumunāderartha iti| tasmātpāka ityādau dhātvaṃśakriyāṃ vyāpārarūpāmādāya karmakaraṇādivibhaktivatkṛtapūrvo kaṭamityādāvapi kartrādyarthakāḥ pratyayā iti bodhyam|
analyzed: pratyaya artha kriyāyām na pratīyate iti viśeṣaḥ evam ca asattva svabhāvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ tumuna ādeḥ arthaḥ iti tasmāt pākaḥ ityādau dhātu aṃśa kriyām vyāpāra rūpām ādāya karma karaṇa ādi vibhakti vat kṛta pūrvaḥ kaṭam ityādau api kartṛ ādi arthakāḥ pratyayāḥ iti bodhyam

original: pare tu bhoktuṃ pākaḥ, bhoktuṃ gata ityādyasādhveva| yatra kārye kriyāvācakaśabdaśya grahaṇaṃ tatra prādhānyena sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāvācino grahaṇāt| yatra tu kriyārūpārthasya grahaṇaṃ tatra guṇabhūtakriyāvācino'pi grahaṇam| ata eva gatapākādiyoge kārakavibhaktikṛtvasuc‌ktvādīnāṃ sādhutvamityāhuḥ|
analyzed: pare tu bhoktum pākaḥ bhoktum gataḥ ityādi asādhu eva yatra kārye grahaṇam tatra prādhānyena sādhya mātra avastha kriyā vācinaḥ grahaṇāt yatra tu kriyā rūpa arthasya grahaṇam tatra guṇa bhūta kriyā vācinaḥ api grahaṇam atas eva gata pāka ādi yoge sādhu tvam iti āhuḥ

original: tasyāyamāśayaḥtumunṇvulāviti sūtre kriyārthāyāmiti strīliṅganirdeśena kriyārthāyāḥ kriyāyā eva lābhe siddhe punaḥ kriyāgrahaṇena prādhānyena sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāpratipādake sati dhātostumunṇvalāvityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tasya ayam āśayaḥ tumun ṇvulau iti sūtre kriyā arthāyām iti strī liṅga nirdeśena kriyā arthāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ eva lābhe siddhe punar kriyā grahaṇena prādhānyena sādhya mātra avastha kriyā pratipādake sati dhātoḥ tumun ṇvalau iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca gatyartheti kartari ktapratyayāntatayā kṛdante pratyayārthasya prādhānyena gataśabdasya dravyavācitayā kriyāvācakatvābhāvena tumuna eva tatrāprāpteḥ| evaṃ pāka ityatra ghaño bhāvārthakatve'pi `kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate' iti bhāṣyokterliṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayitvarūpadravyadharmagrāhitayā pākaśabdasyāpi dravyavācitvaṃ bodhyam|
analyzed: tathā ca gati arthā iti kartari ktapratyaya anta tayā kṛt ante pratyaya arthasya prādhānyena gata śabdasya dravya vāci tayā kriyā vācaka tva abhāvena tumunaḥ eva tatra aprāpteḥ evam pākaḥ iti atra ghañaḥ bhāva arthaka tve pi kṛt abhihitaḥ bhāvaḥ dravya vat prakāśate iti bhāṣya ukteḥ liṅga saṃkhyā ādi anvayi tva rūpa dravya dharma grāhi tayā pāka śabdasya api dravya vāci tvam bodhyam

original: nanu gataśabdādau dhātoḥ sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāvācitayā tannibandhanastatra tumun syāditi ced‌bhrānto'si| tumun‌vidhau kriyārthopapadasyetyarthamupapadasaṃjñāyā āvaśyakatvenopapadamiti mahāsaṃjñayā kriyāphalakakriyāvācakapravṛtike pade sati tumunṇvulāvityarthasyā''vaśyakatvāt|
analyzed: nanu gata śabda ādau dhātoḥ sādhya mātra avastha kriyā vāci tayā tad nibandhanaḥ tatra tumun syāt iti ced bhrāntaḥ asi tumun vidhau kriyā artha upapadasya iti artham upapada saṃjñāyāḥ āvaśyaka tvena upapadam iti mahā saṃjñayā kriyā phalaka kriyā vācaka pravṛtike pade sati tumun ṇvulau iti arthasya āvaśyaka tvāt

original: tathā ca sādhyamātrasvabhāvakriyāvācakapadanikndhanastumun, sādhyamātrasvabhāvakriyāvācakatve'pi dhātoḥ padatvābhāvānna prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ| tādṛśaṃ ca padaṃ tiṅantameva| ata evātra sūtre na kriyārūpārthagrahaṇaṃ, kiṃ tu kriyāvācakaśabdagrahaṇam| upapadasaṃjñāyā padasaṃjñakaśabdaniṣṭhatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca sādhya mātra svabhāva kriyā vācaka pada nikndhanaḥ tumun sādhya mātra svabhāva kriyā vācaka tve pi dhātoḥ pada tva abhāvāt na prāpnoti iti bhāvaḥ tādṛśam ca padam tiṅ antam eva atas eva atra sūtre na kriyā rūpa artha grahaṇam kim tu kriyā vācaka śabda grahaṇam upapada saṃjñāyā pada saṃjñaka śabda niṣṭha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yattūcyatetapuṃsake bhāve ktasya dhātvarthānuvādakatvena sādhyamātravasthakriyāvācakatvād‌tadyoge bhoktuṃ gatamityatra tumun dūrvāra iti| tatra sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāvācakaprakṛtibhāgamādāya tumunāśaṅakyate cetprakṛtibhāgasya padatvābhāvattadarthasya viśeṣaṇatvenāpradhānyācca tadāśaṅkāyā asaṃbhava eva|
analyzed: yat tu ucyate tapuṃsake bhāve ktasya dhātvartha anuvādaka tvena sādhya mātra avastha kriyā vācaka tvāt tad yoge bhoktum gatam iti atra dūrvāraḥ iti tatra sādhya mātra avastha kriyā vācaka prakṛti bhāgam ādāya tumunā āśaṅakyate ced prakṛti bhāgasya pada tva abhāvat tad arthasya viśeṣaṇa tvena apradhānyāt ca tad āśaṅkāyāḥ asaṃbhavaḥ eva

original: kṛti pratyayārthasya prādhānyena ktapratyayasya prādhānyena sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāvācitbāttadantasya padatvācca tadyoge tumunāśaṅkyate cettadapi na| kṛdabhihito bhāvo dravyavatprakāśate, iti bhāṣyoktegaṃtaṃśabdo'pi na kriyāvācī, hana hi vacirantīti|
analyzed: kṛti pratyaya arthasya prādhānyena ktapratyayasya prādhānyena sādhya mātra avastha kriyā vāci tvāt tad antasya pada tvāt ca tad yoge ced tat api na kṛt abhihitaḥ bhāvaḥ dravya vat prakāśate iti na kriyā vācī hi na kriyā vācī

original: antiparakādvaceḥ `vadanti' ityatreva vacanārthāpratīteryathā tādṛśo vacirna prayujyate śābdikaiḥ prāmāṇikaistadvatkriyājanmagaṇanarūpārthāpratītestriḥ pāka ityādi na prayoktavyamityarthaḥ| nanvabhyāvṛttigaṇana ityatropasargabalena vṛnudhāttorupattau śakterniyamitatvādabhyāvṛttiśabdasya punaḥ punarbhavanamarthaḥ| janmeti yāvat|
analyzed: anti parakāt vaceḥ vadanti iti atra iva vacana artha apratīteḥ yathā tādṛśaḥ vaciḥ na prayujyate śābdikaiḥ prāmāṇikaiḥ tadvat kriyā janma gaṇana rūpa artha apratīteḥ tris pākaḥ ityādi na prayoktavyam iti arthaḥ nanu abhyāvṛtti gaṇane iti atra upasarga balena śakteḥ niyamita tvāt abhyāvṛtti śabdasya punar punar bhavanam arthaḥ janma iti yāvat

original: tacca janma naikaṃ, ekasya gaṇanāyogyatvāt| kiṃ tvanekaṃ, anekasyaiva gaṇanārhatvāt| tathā ca punaḥ punarjanmano gaṇanaṃ saṃkhaayānamabhyāvṛttigaṇanam, tatra dravyaguṇayoḥ svabhāvasiddhayorna gaṇanayogyaṃ punaḥ punarjanma, yata ekaivateṣāmutpattiḥ| kriyāyāstu dhātuto nivṛttabhedāyā eva pratīterbhavati punaḥ punarutpattirnāpyāvṛttiḥ|
analyzed: tat ca janma na ekam ekasya gaṇanā yogya tvāt kim tu anekam anekasya eva gaṇanā arha tvāt tathā ca punar punar janmanaḥ gaṇanam tatra dravya guṇayoḥ svabhāva siddhayoḥ na gaṇana yogyam punar punar janma yatas ekā eva teṣām utpattiḥ kriyāyāḥ tu dhātutaḥ nivṛtta bhedāyāḥ eva pratīteḥ bhavati punar punar utpattiḥ na api āvṛttiḥ

original: punaḥ punarjanmayogyasyaiva janma cābhyāvṛttipadenocyate, abhyetyupasargadvayasvārasyāt| punaḥ punarjanmayogyā ca kriyaiva, na dravyādītyabhyāvṛttigrahaṇādeva kriyāyā lābhe sati punaḥ kriyāgrahaṇādatra sādhyamātrāvasthaiva kriyā gṛhyate|
analyzed: punar punar janma yogyasya eva janma ca abhyāvṛtti padena ucyate abhyeti upasarga dvaya svārasyāt punar punar janma yogyā ca kriyā eva na dravya ādi iti abhyāvṛtti grahaṇāt eva kriyāyāḥ lābhe sati punar kriyā grahaṇāt atra sādhya mātra avasthā eva kriyā gṛhyate

original: pāka ityādau ca ghañupasthāpyā tu noktasvarūpeti na dvistriḥ pāka ityādau suc‌prayoga ityāśayavānāhakecittvityādi| pāka ityādau tādṛśīti| pākaśabde ghañupasthāpyā kriyā sādhyamātrasvabhāvā naivetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: pākaḥ ityādau ca ghañ upasthāpyā tu na ukta svarūpā iti na dvis tris pākaḥ ityādau suc prayogaḥ iti āśayavān āha kecid tu ityādi pākaḥ ityādau tādṛśī iti pāka śabde ghañ upasthāpyā kriyā sādhya mātra svabhāvā na eva iti arthaḥ

original: na ca gha़upasthāpyāyāstathātvābhāve'pi tatprakṛtibhūtapac‌dhātūpasthāpyakriyāyāḥ sādhyamātrasvabhāvatvākṣatestannimittakaḥ suc durvāra iti vācyam| kṛdante pratyayārthasya prāyaḥ prādhānyadarśanātprādhānabhūtayā ghañarthakriyayā ātmaneva svaprakṛtyarthaviśeṣaṇībhūtakriyāgatasādhyagātrasvabhāvatvaprayuktakāryasyābhibhavādityāśayāt|
analyzed: na ca ghaॅ upasthāpyāyāḥ tathātva abhāve pi tad prakṛti bhūta pac dhātu upasthāpya kriyāyāḥ sādhya mātra svabhāva tva akṣateḥ tad nimittakaḥ suc durvāraḥ iti vācyam kṛt ante pratyaya arthasya prāyas prādhānya darśanāt prādhāna bhūtayā ghañ artha kriyayā ātmanā iva sva prakṛti artha viśeṣaṇībhūta kriyā gata sādhya gātra svabhāva tva prayukta kāryasya abhibhavāt iti āśayāt

original: nanvevaṃ rītyā dvirvacanaṃ, dviḥ prayogaḥ, ityādyapi na syāditi tādṛśaprayogāṇāṃ kā gatirata āhadvirvacanamiti cetyādi| bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ tādṛśaprayogakaraṇād‌dvirvacane'cīti nirdeśācca bhāvārthakapratyayaprakṛtibhūtatādṛśaprayogaghaṭakadhātūpasthāpyakriyāmādāya dviśabde sujbhavatīti jñāpyata ityarthaḥ|

original: nanu dhātāvivā''khyāte'pi bhāvanābodhakatārūpā śaktiskṣataiva, mīmāṃmasakānāṃ tiṅ‌pratyayādbhāvanābodhasya jāyamānatvāt| tathā ca kathaṃ dhātoreva vācyā bhāvanā, na tiṅ‌pratyayasyeti nirṇīyate, ityāśaṅkatenanu siddhānta iti| ākhyātaśaktigraheti| ākhyāte tibādipratyaye bhāvanābodhakatāśaktirastīti grahavatāṃ mīmāṃsakādīnāmityarthaḥ| bodhāditi|

original: viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvasaṃbandhanimittakaṃ sādhutvamityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥyasminviśeṣye yādṛśaviśeṣamānvite yādṛgānupūrvyā sūtravārtikabhāṣyakārādyanyatamena sādhutvamuktaṃ sa śabdastatra sādhuranyatrāsādhureva| ata eva dantyasakāramadhyo'svaśabdo'śvo sādhurna, kiṃ tu nirghane sādhuḥ| evaṃ tālavyaśakāramadhyo'śva śabdo'śve sādhuḥ, na daridre|

original: evamākhyātasya karturanabhidhāyakatve dhātośca bhāvanānabhidhāyakatve'sādhutvameva syāt| vyākaraṇena tathaiva sādhutvabodhanāditi| nanu vyākaraṇaṃ sādhutvānvākhyāyakameva, na tu śaktigrāhakam| ata eva `atha śabdānuśāsanam' ityeva mahābhāṣya uktam|

original: ` sādhutvajñānaviṣayā saiṣā vyākaraṇasmṛtiḥ' itivākyapadīye'pi `sādhutvajñānaviṣayā' ityevoktaṃ, na tvarthabodhiketyāśaṅkāṃ dūrīkurvannāhaayamartha ityādi| vyākaraṇaśāstraṃ, ac‌parakeguccāraṇaprasaṅge yaṇuccāraṇīyaḥ, yaṇ‌ghaṭitaṃ ca tatsādhvityevaṃ śabdasādhutvapratipādakamityarthaḥ| tatraiṃveti| sādhuśabdeṣvevetyarthaḥ| avacchedakatayeti|

original: arthabodhajanakatāvacchedatayā kalpyamāno yo dharmaḥ saiva śaktirityevaṃ manvānānāṃ mīmāṃsakānāṃ mata ityarthaḥ| ekameveti| janakatāyā avacchinnatvaniyamena janakatāvacchedakatayā dharmakalpanā''vaśyakīti sādhutvasyaiva śaktatvaṃ yuktamiti śaktatvaṃ sādhutvamityekameva nārthāntaramityarthaḥ|

original: śaktigrahaṃ vyākaraṇopamānetyādyabhiyuktoktau śaktigrāhakeṣu prathamato vyākaraṇasya nirdeśād vyākaraṇasya tattadarthapuraskārema teṣāṃ teṣāṃ padānāṃ sādhutvabodhanārthaṃ pravṛttatvena vyākaraṇaśāstrasya śaktinirṇāyakatvasya niṣpratibandhaṃ siddhatvena laḥ karmaṇītyādibyākaraṇaśāstravirodhād bhāvanābhiprāyeṇa tiṅ‌prayogo'sādhureveti bhāvaḥ|

original: sādhutvamanapabhraṣṭatvādirūpaṃ, śaktistvicchāviśeṣaḥ padārthāntaraṃ veti sādhutvāpekṣayā'tiriktā śaktirityevaṃvāde'pītyarthaḥ| `nitye śabdārthasaṃbandhe' ityatra samānāyāmarthāvagatau śabdena cāpaśabdena ceti dharmaniyamaḥ kriyate sādhubhirbhāṣitanyaṃ nāsādhubhirgamyāgabhyotivadityuktaṃ, atra sādhutvāpekṣayā''tiriktā śaktiriti spaṣṭam| syādeveti|

original: sūtrakārādibhirākhyātasya bhāvanāyāmananuśāsanātkartrādyartha eva tadvidhānāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu jaiminimahāmunisūtraviruddhatvātpāṇinismṛtistyajyatāṃ durbalatvāditi cenna| sādhutvaviṣaye pāṇinismṛtereva balīyastvāt| sādhutvoddeśenaiva pāṇinivyākaraṇasya pravṛttatvādityaśayaḥ|

original: vastuto jaiminīyasūtravyākhyātṛvacanavirodhe'pi sūtrākṣaravirodhaleśo'pi pāṇinismṛtau nā''patati| tathā hi`bhāvārthāḥ karmaśabdāstebhyaḥ kriyā pratīyetaiṣa hyartho vidhīyate' iti hi jaiminimunisūtraṃ bhāvārthādhikaraṇe|

original: dadyājjuhuyadityādayaḥ karmaśabdā bhāvārthaḥ = prādhānyena kriyārthakāḥ, `bhāvapradhānamākhyātaṃ' iti niruktāt' atastebhyaḥ kriyā pratīyeta = prādhānyena pratīyeta| hiyataḥ prādānyāddhetoḥ, eṣa eva = kriyārūpa evārtho vidhīyate, na tu dravyarūpaḥ|
analyzed: dadyāt juhuyat ityādayaḥ karma śabdāḥ bhāva arthaḥ prādhānyena kriyā arthakāḥ bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti niruktāt atas tebhyaḥ kriyā pratīyeta prādhānyena pratīyeta hiyataḥ prādānyāt hetoḥ eṣaḥ eva kriyā rūpaḥ eva arthaḥ vidhīyate na tu dravya rūpaḥ

original: kriyāyāścā''śutaravināśitvātkālāntarabhāviphalajanakatā na saṃbhavatīti dvāramapūrvaṃ kalpanīyamiti tadarthaḥ| etatsūtrākṣarārthād‌bhāvanā ākhyātārthaḥ, na kartetyādikaṃ kathamapi na labhyata iti vibhāvyatāṃ sudhībhiḥ|
