original: vyākhyātṛbhirvṛttikārādibhistajjaiminisūtramevaṃ vyākhyātambhāvārthāḥbhāvanārūpo ya ākhyātārthaḥ, tasya paricchedo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ yeṣāmetādṛśāḥ| ākhyātena bhāvanāsāmānye upasthite itaradānādibhāvanāto vyāvartayan yāgarūpo dhātvartho'vacchedako bhavatyeveti bhāvaḥ| evamavacchedakībhūtā ye karmaśabdā dhātvarthā iti yāvat|
analyzed: vyākhyātṛbhiḥ vṛtti kāra ādibhiḥ tat jaimini sūtram evam vyākhyātam bhāva arthāḥ bhāvanā rūpaḥ yaḥ ākhyāta arthaḥ tasya paricchedaḥ ūrthaḥ prayojanam yeṣām etādṛśāḥ ākhyātena bhāvanā sāmānye upasthite itara dāna ādi bhāvanātaḥ vyāvartayan yāga rūpaḥ dhātvarthaḥ vacchedakaḥ bhavati eva iti bhāvaḥ evam avacchedakībhūtāḥ ye karma śabdāḥ dhātvarthāḥ iti yāvat

original: tebhyaḥ kriyā apūrvaṃ pratīyeta jñāyeta| hi yata eṣo'rtho vidhīyate| ekapadaśrutyā tasyaiva vidhānāt| yo vidhīyate sa tatkaraṇatvena saṃbadhyata iti vyaptirita| tathā ca vyākhyātṛvacanavirodhaḥ, na sūtrākṣaravirodha ityākalanīyaṃ yaiminirahasyavedibhiḥ|
analyzed: tebhyaḥ kriyā apūrvam pratīyeta jñāyeta hi yatas eṣaḥ ṛthaḥ vidhīyate eka pada śrutyā tasya eva vidhānāt yaḥ vidhīyate sa tad karaṇa tvena saṃbadhyate iti tathā ca vyākhyātṛ vacana virodhaḥ na sūtra akṣara virodhaḥ iti ākalanīyam yaimini rahasya vedibhiḥ

original: nanṛ darśapūrṇamāsaprakāraṇe `nānṛtaṃ vadet' iti yo'yamanṛtavadananiṣedha uktaḥ sa kiṃ puruṣamuddiśya vihito'thavā darsapūrṇamāsāvuddiśyeti saṃdihyobhayākāṅkṣārūpaprakaraṇapramāṇena darśapūrṇamāsayorayaṃ niṣedhaḥ|
analyzed: darśa pūrṇamāsa prakāraṇe na anṛtam vadet iti yaḥ yam anṛta vadana niṣedhaḥ uktaḥ sa kim puruṣam uddiśya vihitaḥ uthavā darsa pūrṇamāsau uddiśya iti saṃdihya ubhaya ākāṅkṣā rūpa prakaraṇa pramāṇena darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ ayam niṣedhaḥ

original: tathā hianṛtavadananiṣedhasyābhāvātmakatvena kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣayā grahaṇāsaṃbhavāttitsiddhyarthaṃ tatra kriyāṃ parikalpyānṛtavadananiṣedhaparipālanena bhāvayodityarthe phalaviśeṣasyānirdeśādasti atra kiṃ bhāvayedityupakāryākāṅkṣā| darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargaṃ bhāvayedityatrāpi kathaṃ bhāvayedityastyupakārakākāṅkṣā|
analyzed: tathā hi anṛta vadana niṣedhasya abhāva ātmaka tvena kathaṃbhāva ākāṅkṣayā grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt tid siddhi artham tatra kriyām parikalpya anṛta vadana niṣedha paripālanena bhāvayot iti arthe phala viśeṣasya anirdeśāt asti atra kim bhāvayet iti upakārya ākāṅkṣā darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām svargam bhāvayet iti atra api katham bhāvayet iti asti upakāraka ākāṅkṣā

original: ata ubhayākāṅkṣayā parasparasaṃbandhenakavākyatayā darśapūrṇamāsayoranṛtavadananiṣedhaparipālanenopakāraṃ saṃpādya svargaṃ bhāvayedityarthādṛrśapūrṇamāsayorayaṃ niṣedho vidhīyate| tataśca darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe sarvatrānṛtavadanaṃ varjanīyam|
analyzed: atas ubhaya ākāṅkṣayā paraspara saṃbandhena kavākyatayā darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ anṛta vadana niṣedha paripālanena upakāram saṃpādya svargam bhāvayet iti arthāt dṛrśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ ayam niṣedhaḥ vidhīyate tatas ca darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇe sarvatra anṛta vadanam varjanīyam

original: tatra yadā vrīhimayaḥ puroḍāśaḥ kartavya ityevamādavadhvaryumuktvā odanārtha me vrīhayo bhaviṣyantīti yavamayaḥ kriyatāmityucyate tadā niṣedhaparipālanaṃ naiva bhavati| pūrvavadanāpekṣayottaravadanasya bhinnatvenānṛtavadanāt| yo hi pūrvabhāṣaṇaviruddhamuttaraṃ bhāṣate so'nṛnatavādīti loke prasiddham|
analyzed: tatra yadā vrīhi mayaḥ puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti evam ādava dhvaryum uktvā odana artha me vrīhayaḥ bhaviṣyanti iti yava mayaḥ kriyatām iti ucyate tadā niṣedha paripālanam na eva bhavati pūrva vadana apekṣayā uttara vadanasya bhinna tvena anṛta vadanāt yaḥ hi pūrva bhāṣaṇa viruddham uttaram bhāṣate loke prasiddham

original: kiṃ tvanuṣṭhānakāle pūrvoktiviruddhānuṣṭhānena pūrvokteranṛtvamiti `vrīhimayaḥ puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ' ityākārakapūrvasaṃkalpasyānṛtavadanatvameva bhavati| yavamayapuroḍāśānuṣṭhānasya saṃkalpavisaṃvāditvāt| tathā ca kratorvairguṇyaṃ niṣedhollaṅghanaṃ ca syāt| tasmādvisaṃvādi na vaditavyam|
analyzed: kim tu anuṣṭhāna kāle pūrva ukti viruddha anuṣṭhānena pūrva ukteḥ anṛtvam iti vrīhi mayaḥ puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti ākāraka pūrva saṃkalpasya anṛta vadana tvam eva bhavati yava maya puroḍāśa anuṣṭhānasya saṃkalpa visaṃvādi tvāt tathā ca kratoḥ vairguṇyam niṣedha ullaṅghanam ca syāt tasmāt visaṃvādi na vaditavyam

original: evaṃ ṣojaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇarūpavaikalpikaprayogārambhe'dhvaryvādinā'nyatarapakṣaṃ saṃkalpya punaḥ pakṣāntaragrahaṇenaṃ nānṛtaṃ vaditavyam| anṛtavadanena kratuvaiguṇyānniṣedhollaṅghanācca prāyaścittāpatteḥ| yadā tu yo'tuṣṭhānavelāyāṃ pūrvasaṃkalpānusāreṇaivānutiṣṭhati tadā so'nṛtavadaniṣedhaṃ paripālayati|
analyzed: evam ṣojaśi grahaṇa agrahaṇa rūpa vaikalpika prayoga ārambha idhvaryu ādinā anyatara pakṣam saṃkalpya punar na anṛtam vaditavyam anṛta vadanena kratu vaiguṇyāt niṣedha ullaṅghanāt ca prāyaścitta āpatteḥ yadā tu yotu sthāna velāyām pūrva saṃkalpa anusāreṇa eva anutiṣṭhati tadā saḥ unṛta vada niṣedham paripālayati

original: yathaā yavamaṃya saṃkalpya yavamaya eva puroḍāśaḥ kriyate, atraiva samyaṅniṣedhasya paripālarnaḥ bhavati| yavamayapuroḍāśānuṣṭhānasya pūrvasaṃkalpasaṃvāditvāt| nātra katorvaigumyaṃ nāpi niṣedhollaṅghanamiti sutarāṃ prāyaścittābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yathaā saṃkalpya yava mayaḥ eva puroḍāśaḥ kriyate atra eva samyak niṣedhasya bhavati yava maya puroḍāśa anuṣṭhānasya pūrva saṃkalpa saṃvādi tvāt na atra katoḥ vaigumyam na api niṣedha ullaṅghanam iti sutarām prāyaścitta abhāvaḥ

original: tathā caivamanṛtavadananiṣedhaparipālanena darśapūrmamāsopakāre saṃpādite'ṅgibhyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yatphala svargarūpaṃ jananīyaṃ tadevāṅgasyānṛtavadananiṣedhasya phalamiti pratipāditaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tathā ca evam anṛta vadana niṣedha paripālanena darśa pūrma māsa upakāre saṃpādita iṅgibhyām darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām yat phala svarga rūpam jananīyam tat eva aṅgasya anṛta vadana niṣedhasya phalam iti pratipāditam bhavati

original: evaṃ rityā'nṛtavadananidhedhasya darsapūrṇamāsāṅgatvaṃ kartradhikaraṇesiddhāntitaṃ, tadākhyātena karturabhidhānaṃ vadato vaiyākaraṇasya mate virudhyetetyāśayena mīmāṃsakaḥ śaṅkatenanvityādi| tvanmata iti| ākhyātena(tiṅā)karturabhighānīmatyevaṃvādivaiyākaraṇamata ityarthaḥ| kratvartha eveti|
analyzed: evam darsa pūrṇamāsa aṅgatvam tat ākhyātena kartuḥ abhidhānam vadataḥ vaiyākaraṇasya mate virudhyeta iti āśayena mīmāṃsakaḥ śaṅkate nanu ityādi tvad mate iti ākhyātena tiṅā kartuḥ abhidhānīm ati evaṃvādi vaiyākaraṇa mate iti arthaḥ kratu arthe eva iti

original: nānṛtaṃ vadediti niṣedhasya darśapūrmamāsarūpakratvaṅgatvameva na sidhyedityarthaḥ| nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya kratvaṅgatvāsiddhau hetumāhaākhyātenetyādinā bādhyata ityantena| ayaṃ bhāvaḥvaiyākaraṇamate laḥ karmaṇītyādisūtraprāmāṇyādākhyātasya (tibādeḥ pratyayasyaḥ kartṛkarmādyarthaḥ| dhātośca phalānukūlā bhāvanā'rthaḥ|
analyzed: na anṛtam vadet iti niṣedhasya darśa pūrma māsa rūpa kratu aṅga tvam eva na sidhyet iti arthaḥ na anṛtam iti niṣedhasya kratu aṅga tva asiddhau hetum āha ākhyātena ityādinā bādhyate iti antena ayam bhāvaḥ vaiyākaraṇa mate laḥ karmaṇi ityādi sūtra prāmāṇyāt ākhyātasya tip ādeḥ pratyayasya kartṛ karma ādi arthaḥ dhātoḥ ca phala anukūlā bhāvanā arthaḥ

original: pratyayārthatvena kartuḥ prādhānyamityabhimānaḥ śaṅkituḥ| tathā ca vadodityākhyātaśrutyā kartā puruṣa uktaḥ| dhātunā ca vadanamuktam|
analyzed: pratyaya artha tvena kartuḥ prādhānyam iti abhimānaḥ śaṅkituḥ tathā ca vada ud iti ākhyāta śrutyā kartā puruṣaḥ uktaḥ dhātunā ca vadanam uktam

original: evaṃ satyekapadarūpayā viniyoktryā śrutyā svadhaṭakaprakṛtipratyayarūpabhāgadvayapratipādyayorarthayormitho'ṅgāṅgibhāvasaṃbandhabodhanādākhyātasya puruṣavācakatve sati prakṛtyarthasya vadanasya puruṣasaṃbandhitvena puruṣārthatvaṃ puruṣadharmatvaṃ pratīyate|
analyzed: evam sati eka pada rūpayā viniyoktryā śrutyā sva dhaṭaka prakṛti pratyaya rūpa bhāga dvaya pratipādyayoḥ arthayoḥ mithā uṅgāṅgibhāva saṃbandha bodhanāt ākhyātasya puruṣa vācaka tve sati prakṛti arthasya vadanasya puruṣa saṃbandhi tvena puruṣa artha tvam puruṣa dharma tvam pratīyate

original: tataśca pratiyogino'nṛtavadanasya puruṣadharmatayā tanniṣodhasyāpi puruṣadharmatvenaiva vidhātavyatvātpuruṣārthatvaṃ bhavati| evaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ vadediti niṣedhasyobhayākāṅkṣārūpaprakaraṇapramāṇena kratūpakārakatvarūpaṃ kratvarthatvaṃ prāpnoti, śrutipramāṇena ca puruṣopakārakatvarūpaṃ puruṣārthatvaṃ prāpnoti|
analyzed: tatas ca pratiyoginā unṛta vadanasya puruṣa dharmatayā tad niṣodhasya api puruṣa dharma tvena eva vidhātavya tvāt puruṣa artha tvam bhavati evam ca na anṛtam vadet iti niṣedhasya ubhaya ākāṅkṣā rūpa prakaraṇa pramāṇena kratu upakāraka tva rūpam kratu artha tvam prāpnoti śruti pramāṇena ca puruṣa upakāraka tva rūpam puruṣa artha tvam prāpnoti

original: tatra prakaraṇāpekṣayā śruterbalavattvātprakaraṇāprāptaṃ kratvarthatvaṃ bādhitvā nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya puruṣopakārakatvātmakaṃ puruṣārthatvameva syāt|
analyzed: tatra prakaraṇa apekṣayā śruteḥ balavat tvāt prakaraṇa aprāptam kratu artha tvam bādhitvā na anṛtam iti niṣedhasya puruṣa upakāraka tva ātmakam puruṣa artha tvam eva syāt

original: tathā ca yadā rāgadveṣādinā anṛtavadane puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavettadā'nṛtavadananiṣedheṃna tatrāpravṛttau satyāṃ nānṛtavadanajanyapātakotpattiriti na pātakajanyanarakapātādyanarthānubhavo nāpi satyavadanarūpapuṇyakaṃrmajanyaphalānubhavapratibandhaśca bhavati|
analyzed: tathā ca yadā rāga dveṣa ādinā anṛta vadane puruṣasya pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavet tadā anṛta vadana niṣedhena tatra apravṛttau satyām na anṛta vadana janya pātaka utpattiḥ iti na pātaka janya naraka pāta ādi anartha anubhavaḥ nā api satya vadana rūpa puṇya kaṃrma janya phala anubhava pratibandhaḥ ca bhavati

original: avānṛtavadane'pravṛttiḥ puruṣe upakārastad‌dvārotpatsyamānanarakādyaniṣṭapratibandha eva phalamityevaṃrītyā'nṛtavadananiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvameva sidhyenna kratvarthatvam|
analyzed: puruṣe upakāraḥ tad dvārā utpatsyamāna naraka ādi aniṣṭa pratibandhaḥ eva phalam iti evaṃrītyā anṛta vadana niṣedhasya puruṣa artha tvam eva sidhyet na kratu artha tvam

original: tathā ca puruṣakartṛkānṛtavadane sati puruṣasyaiva pratyavāyaḥ, na kratoriti kratāvanṛtavadane katubhreṣaprāyaścittānuṣṭhānarūpasakalayājñikamīmāṃsakācāravirodha āpatedityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca puruṣa kartṛka anṛta vadane sati puruṣasya eva pratyavāyaḥ na kratoḥ iti kratau anṛta vadane katu bhreṣa prāyaścitta anuṣṭhāna rūpa sakala yājñika mīmāṃsaka ācāra virodhaḥ āpatet iti arthaḥ

original: nanu nānṛtamiti niṣedhe prakaraṇaprāptasya kratvarthatvasya śrutivirodhe sati bādhyatve kiṃ pramāṇamiti ceducyateaṅgapradhānasaṃbandhabodhakaviniyogavidheḥ sahakāribhūtāni śrutyādīni ṣaṭ pramāṇāni|
analyzed: nanu na anṛtam iti niṣedhe prakaraṇa prāptasya kratu artha tvasya śruti virodhe sati bādhya tve kim pramāṇam iti ced ucyate aṅga pradhāna saṃbandha bodhaka viniyoga vidheḥ sahakāri bhūtāni śruti ādīni ṣaḍ pramāṇāni

original: tatra parasparaviruddhayoḥ pramāṇayorekatropastitau mitho virodhātsamuccayāsaṃbhavenakena dvitīyasya bādho vaktavyaḥ, sa ca valīyaptā durbalasyeti lokaprasiddhamiti śrutyādiṣaṇṇāṃ gadhye kasya balīyastvaṃ kasya ca durbalatvamiti jijñāsāyāṃ `śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣāt' iti sūtrayāṃbabhūva
analyzed: tatra paraspara viruddhayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ ekatra upastitau mithas virodhāt samuccaya asaṃbhavenakena dvitīyasya bādhaḥ vaktavyaḥ sa ca valīyaptā durbalasya iti loka prasiddham iti śruti ādi ṣaṇṇām kasya balīyaḥ tvam kasya ca durbala tvam iti jijñāsāyām śruti liṅga vākya prakaraṇa sthāna samākhyānām samavāye pāra daurbalyam artha viprakarṣāt iti sūtrayāṃbabhūva

original: bhagavāñjaiminimaharṣiḥ| śrutyādīnāṃ viniyojakānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pramāṇānāṃ madhye viruddhayordvayorekatra saṃnipāte pāradaurbalyaṃ paraṃ paraṃ pūrvapūrvād durvaṃlaṃ pūrveṇottarasya bādhaḥ| tatra hetuḥarthaviprakarṣāt, uttarapramāṇasya pūrvapramāṇakalpakatvādarthasya viniyogasyāṅgāṅgitvanirṇayasya viprakarṣādvilambāditi tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhagavān jaimini mahā ṛṣiḥ śruti ādīnām viniyojakānām ṣaṇṇām pramāṇānām madhye viruddhayoḥ dvayoḥ ekatra saṃnipāte pāra daurbalyam param param pūrva pūrvāt pūrveṇa uttarasya bādhaḥ tatra hetuḥ artha viprakarṣāt uttara pramāṇasya pūrva pramāṇa kalpaka tvāt arthasya viniyogasya aṅga aṅgi tva nirṇayasya viprakarṣāt vilambāt iti tad arthaḥ

original: atrottarottarasya durbalatvoktyā pūrvapūrvasya balīyastvaṃ sūcitam| tatra nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ| ravaḥ śabdaḥ| kasyacitkvicidviniyoge kartavye yaḥ śabdo viniyojakaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ nāpekṣate sa śabdaḥ śrutirityucyate| sā hi kasyacitkvacidviniyoge kartavye svottaravartiliṅgadipramāṇapañcakamadhye kimapi nāpekṣate|
analyzed: atra uttara uttarasya durbala tva uktyā pūrva pūrvasya balīyaḥ tvam sūcitam tatra nirapekṣaḥ ravaḥ śrutiḥ ravaḥ śabdaḥ kasyacid kvicid viniyoge kartavye yaḥ śabdaḥ viniyojakam pramāṇa antaram na apekṣate sa śabdaḥ śrutiḥ iti ucyate sā hi kasyacid kvacid viniyoge kartavye sva uttara varti liṅga ādi pramāṇa pañcaka madhye kim api nā apekṣate

original: liṅgādīni pañca viniyojakapramāṇāni tu svasvapūrvavartiyāvatpramāṇāpekṣayaiva viniyogaṃ kurvanti| atasteṣu liṅgādiṣvativyāptivāraṇāya śrutilakṣaṇe nirapekṣa ityuktam| tatra śrutiliṅgayorvirodhe śrutiprābalyodāharaṇaṃ pradarśyate`aindhryā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti śrūyate|
analyzed: liṅga ādīni pañca viniyojaka pramāṇāni tu sva sva pūrva varti yāvat pramāṇa apekṣayā eva viniyogam kurvanti atas teṣu liṅga ādiṣu ativyāpti vāraṇāya śruti lakṣaṇe nirapekṣaḥ iti uktam tatra śruti liṅgayoḥ virodhe śruti prābalya udāharaṇam pradarśyate aindhryā gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate iti śrūyate

original: kadācana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśupe bho indra, kadācidapi ghātako na bhavasi| kiṃ tvāhutiṃ dattavate yajamānāya prīyase, iti tadarthaḥ| ayamaindrī ṛk| indro devatā'syā ityaindrī| asyāḥ śruterindrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyaṃ dṛśyate|
analyzed: kadācana starīḥ asi na indra saścasi dāśupe bho indra kadācid api ghātakaḥ na bhavasi kim tu āhutim dattavate yajamānāya prīyase iti tad arthaḥ ayam aindrī ṛc indraḥ devatā asyāḥ iti aindrī asyāḥ śruteḥ indra rūpa artha prakāśana sāmarthyam dṛśyate

original: tena ca liṅgenaindryendramupatiṣṭhate iti śrutimanumāya tādṛśānumitaśrutyā'syāṛca indropasthāne niviyogo liṅgapramāṇena saṃbhavati| paraṃ tu aindryā gārhapatyamiti niruktapratyaśrutyā'smā ṛco gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogasya kṛtatvātpratyakṣaśruteścānumitaśrutyapekṣayā balavattvād‌gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogo bhavati|
analyzed: tena ca liṅgena aindryā indram upatiṣṭhate iti śrutim anumāya tādṛśa anumita śrutyā asyāḥ ṛcaḥ indra upasthāne liṅga pramāṇena saṃbhavati param tu aindryā gārhapatyam iti nirukta pratyaśrutyā asmai ṛcaḥ gārhapatya upasthāne viniyogasya kṛta tvāt pratyakṣa śruteḥ ca anumita śruti apekṣayā balavat tvāt gārhapatya upasthāne viniyogaḥ bhavati

original: kadācana starīrasīti mantre indraśabdaḥ `idi paramaisvarye' iti dhātvarthānusārātparamaiśvaryaguṇayogena yajñasādhanatvena vā gārhapatyābhidāyako mantavyaḥ| atraindrīśabdo gārhapatyaśabda upasargaviśiṣṭaḥ sthādhātuścābhidhāyako mantavyaḥ| atraindrīśabdo gārhapatyaśabda upasargaviśiṣṭaḥ sthādhātuścābhidhātrī śrutiḥ|
analyzed: kadācana starīḥ asi iti mantre indra śabdaḥ idi parama aisvarye iti dhātvartha anusārāt parama aiśvarya guṇa yogena yajña sādhana tvena vā gārhapatya abhidāyakaḥ mantavyaḥ atra aindrī śabdaḥ gārhapatya śabdaḥ upasarga viśiṣṭaḥ sthā dhātuḥ ca abhidhāyakaḥ mantavyaḥ atra aindrī śabdaḥ gārhapatya śabdaḥ upasarga viśiṣṭaḥ sthā dhātuḥ ca abhidhātrī śrutiḥ

original: aindryeti tṛtīyā gārhapatyamiti dvitīyā ca viniyokvī śrutiḥ| tatra tṛtīyayā aindryā ṛca upasthānāṅgatvaṃ pratipādyate| dvitīyayā ca gārhapatyasyopasthānāṅgitvaṃ bodhyate| gṛhapatinā saṃyukto gārhapatyo'gniḥ| `gṛhapatinā saṃyukte ñyaḥ'iti sūtreṇa gṛhapatiśabdāt ñyapratyayaḥ|
analyzed: aindryā iti tṛtīyā gārhapatyam iti dvitīyā ca viniyokvī śrutiḥ tatra tṛtīyayā aindryāḥ ṛcaḥ upasthāna aṅga tvam pratipādyate dvitīyayā ca gārhapatyasya upasthāna aṅgi tvam bodhyate gṛhapatinā saṃyuktaḥ gārhapatya ogniḥ gṛhapatinā saṃyukte ñyaḥ iti sūtreṇa gṛhapati śabdāt ñya pratyayaḥ

original: evaṃ sthite yadatra śrutipramāṇena liṅgapramāṇaṃ bādhyate tatrevaṃ yuktirdṛśyateviniyojakeṣu paṭ‌su pramāṇeṣu sākṣādviniyojikā śrutireva| ataḥ śrutiḥ pramāṇamūrdhanyabhūteti sarvairvyavahriyate| liṅgādīni pañca pramāṇāni tu na sākṣādviniyojakāni| arthaprakāśanasāmarthaayaṃ liṅgamityucyate|
analyzed: evam sthite yat atra śruti pramāṇena liṅga pramāṇam bādhyate tatra evam yuktiḥ dṛśyate viniyojakeṣu paṭsu pramāṇeṣu sākṣāt viniyojikā śrutiḥ eva atas śrutiḥ pramāṇa mūrdhanya bhūtā iti sarvaiḥ vyavahriyate liṅga ādīni pañca pramāṇāni tu na sākṣāt viniyojakāni artha prakāśana sāmartha ayam liṅgam iti ucyate

original: yathā kadācana starīrasīti mantrasyendrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyam| paraṃ tu tādṛśasāmarthyānusāriṇī `aindryendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyojikā śrutiryāvanna jñāyate tāvalliṅgamakiṃcitkarameva|
analyzed: yathā kadācana starīḥ asi iti mantrasya indra rūpa artha prakāśana sāmarthyam param tu tādṛśa sāmarthya anusāriṇī aindryā indram upatiṣṭhate iti evam viniyojikā śrutiḥ yāvat na jñāyate tāvat liṅgam akiṃcitkaram eva

original: ataḥ kadācana starīriti mantrasya kva viniyoga ityevamutpannākāṅkṣā, aindramantrasya kvacitkarmaṇi viniyogasādhanāya svapuraskṛte liṅgapramāṇe svabhāvato vidyamānāṃ prakalpakatvaśaktimuttejayati| tatastalliṅgaṃ svānuguṇāṃ `aindryendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyojikāṃ śrutiṃ kalpayati|
analyzed: atas kadācana starīḥ iti mantrasya kva viniyogaḥ iti evam utpanna ākāṅkṣā aindra mantrasya kvacid karmaṇi viniyoga sādhanāya sva puraskṛte liṅga pramāṇe svabhāvataḥ vidyamānām prakalpaka tva śaktim uttejayati tatas tat liṅgam sva anuguṇām aindryā indram upatiṣṭhate iti evam viniyojikām śrutim kalpayati

original: tayā ca śrutyā tatra viniyoga iti liṅgapramāṇaṃ śrutidvārā paramparayā viniyojakam| evaṃ ca śrutiḥ svābhidheyaṃ pratipādya dbitīyakṣaṇa eva viniyuṅkte| liṅgaṃ tu mantrapadānyādau svābhidheyamarthaṃ pratipādayanti| tata ūrdhvaṃ mantrasya sāmarthyaṃ nirūpyate|
analyzed: tayā ca śrutyā tatra viniyogaḥ iti liṅga pramāṇam śruti dvārā paramparayā viniyojakam evam ca śrutiḥ sva abhidheyam pratipādya dbitīya kṣaṇe eva viniyuṅkte liṅgam tu mantra padāni ādau sva abhidheyam artham pratipādayanti tatas ūrdhvam mantrasya sāmarthyam nirūpyate

original: (nāmamantrasyendraviṣayakakriyāsādhanatvamavagamyate)paścātsāmarthyāvaśātsādhanatvavācinī(aibdramantreṇetyevaṃ tṛtīyā vibhaktiḥ)sādhyatvavācinī(indramityevaṃ dvitīyāvibhaktiḥ) ca śrutiḥ(vibhaktirūpā)kalpyate| sā ca śrutiḥ `aindramantreṇendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyuṅkta iti caturthakṣaṇaparyantaṃ vilambate|
analyzed: nāma mantrasya indra viṣayaka kriyā sādhanatvam avagamyate paścāt sāmarthya avaśāt sādhana tva vācinī aibdra mantreṇa iti evam tṛtīyā vibhaktiḥ sādhya tva vācinī indram iti evam dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ ca śrutiḥ vibhakti rūpā kalpyate sā ca śrutiḥ aindra mantreṇa indram upatiṣṭhate iti evam viniyuṅkte iti caturtha kṣaṇa paryantam vilambate

original: tathā sati pratyakṣaśrutau svāmidheyapratipādanaviniyogayormadhyavartinau sāmarthyanirūpaṇakṣutikalpanavyāpārau na staḥ| evaṃ ca śrutipramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogaḥ sākṣādeva jāyata ityavyavahitaḥ| liṅgapramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogastu śrutiṃ kalpayitvā tad‌dvārā jāyata ityekāntaritaḥ|
analyzed: tathā sati pratyakṣa śrutau svāmidheya pratipādana viniyogayoḥ madhya vartinau sāmarthya nirūpaṇa kṣuti kalpana vyāpārau na staḥ evam ca śruti pramāṇena jāyamānaḥ viniyogaḥ sākṣāt eva jāyate iti avyavahitaḥ liṅga pramāṇena jāyamānaḥ viniyogaḥ tu śrutim kalpayitvā tad dvārā jāyate iti eka antaritaḥ

original: evaṃ vākyādipramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogo liṅgādi ca śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā jāyata iti dvitryādyantariti atyūhyam| yathā yathā ca pramāṇasya viniyoge vyavadhānādhikyaṃ tathā tathā tasya durbalatvam| vilambena viniyojakaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ tadapekṣayā śaighryeṇa viniyojakasya pramāṇasya prāḥ balyaṃ yuktyaiva siddhaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: evam vākya ādi pramāṇena jāyamānaḥ viniyogaḥ liṅga ādi ca śrutim ca kalpayitvā jāyate iti dvi tri ādi antar iti atyūhyam yathā yathā ca pramāṇasya viniyoge vyavadhāna ādhikyam tathā tathā tasya durbala tvam vilambena viniyojakam yat pramāṇam tad apekṣayā śaighryeṇa viniyojakasya pramāṇasya balyam yuktyā eva siddham bhavati

original: liṅgādyuttarapramāṃ hi svāpekṣayā yāvanti pūrvapramāṇāni tāvanti krameṇa parikalpya tad‌dvārā viniyogaṃ bodhayati| tena caikatrānekapramāṇasaṃvanipāta uttarasya pūrvaṃ bādhakaṃ bhavati| uttarapramāmasya bodho nāma tatrāpravṛttireva|
analyzed: liṅga ādi uttara pramām hi sva apekṣayā yāvanti pūrva pramāṇāni tāvanti krameṇa parikalpya tad dvārā viniyogam bodhayati tena ca ekatra aneka pramāṇa saṃvani pāte uttarasya pūrvam bādhakam bhavati uttara pramām asya bodhaḥ nāma tatra apravṛttiḥ eva

original: yata uttarapramāṇena vākyena svāpekṣayā pūrvavṛttipramāṇajātaṃ (liṅgaśruti) parikalpya kiṃcidarthaṃ kutracidviniyoktaṃ yadā pravartitavya tadā pūrvavṛttipramāṇajātasya (liṅgaśrutyorya) ātmasvarūpalābhastasmātprāgeva pūrvapramāṇena (liṅgena śrutyā vāḥ so'rthaḥ kutracidviniyojyate|
analyzed: yatas uttara pramāṇena vākyena sva apekṣayā pūrva vṛtti pramāṇa jātam liṅga śruti parikalpya kiṃcid artham kutracid viniyoktam yadā tadā pūrva vṛtti pramāṇa jātasya liṅga śrutyoḥ yaḥ ātma svarūpa lābhaḥ tasmāt prāk eva pūrva pramāṇena liṅgena śrutyā vār saḥ ṛthaḥ kutracid viniyojyate

original: jāte ca viniyoge kva viniyogaḥ, ityākāṅkṣāyā nivṛttatvāduttarapramāṇa(vākya)gatā liṅgādiprakalpakatvaśaktireva vyāhatā jāyata iti sarvathā vyāpāroparamāttatra tasyāpravṛttiriti|
analyzed: jāte ca viniyoge kva viniyogaḥ iti ākāṅkṣāyāḥ nivṛtta tvāt uttara pramāṇa vākya gatā liṅga ādi prakalpaka tva śaktiḥ eva vyāhatā jāyate iti sarvathā vyāpāra uparamāt tatra tasya apravṛttiḥ iti

original: evaṃ ca indrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyarūpeṇa liṅgapramāṇena śrutikalpanadvārā yāvadaindramantrasyendropasthāne viniyogaḥ kartavyasyāvat `aindryā gārhapatyamiti pratyakṣayā tṛtīyāśrutyā, aindramantreṇendramitiśrutikalpanātprāgeva aindryā ṛco gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogasya kṛtatvālliṅgapramāṇagatā kalpakatvaśaktireva vyāhanyata iti
analyzed: evam ca indra rūpa artha prakāśana sāmarthya rūpeṇa liṅga pramāṇena śruti kalpana dvārā yāvat aindra mantrasya indra upasthāne viniyogaḥ aindryā gārhapatyam iti pratyakṣayā tṛtīyā śrutyā aindra mantreṇa indram iti śruti kalpanāt prāk eva aindryāḥ ṛcaḥ gārhapatya upasthāne viniyogasya kṛta tvāt liṅga pramāṇa gatā kalpaka tva śaktiḥ eva vyāhanyate iti

original: pratyakṣaśruterbalavattvāttayā liṅgaṃ bādhyate| evaṃ prakṛte nānṛtaṃ vadedityatrā''khyātaśrutyā karturabhidhāne sati, ubhayākāṅkṣārūpaprakaraṇapramāṇena vākyaliṅgaśrutīḥ kalpiyitvā nānṛtamityasya yāvaddarśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyastāvad vadedityekapadarūpayā śrutyā nānṛtamityasya kartari puruṣe viniyogasya kṛtatvāt kva viniyogaḥ,
analyzed: pratyakṣa śruteḥ balavat tvāt tayā liṅgam bādhyate evam prakṛte na anṛtam vadet iti atra ākhyāta śrutyā kartuḥ abhidhāne sati ubhaya ākāṅkṣā rūpa prakaraṇa pramāṇena vākya liṅga śrutīḥ na anṛtam iti asya yāvat darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyaḥ tāvat vadet iti eka pada rūpayā śrutyā na anṛtam iti asya kartari puruṣe viniyogasya kṛta tvāt kva viniyogaḥ

original: ityākāṅkṣāyā nivṛttatvāt prakaraṇapramāṇaniṣṭhā vākyaliṅgādiprakalpatvaśaktirvyāhanyata iti śruterbalavattvāttayā prakaraṇapramāṇaṃ bādhyate| tathā cānṛtavadanakriyāniṣedhāśrayaḥ kartetibodhānnānṛtaṃ vadoditi niṣedhasya puruṣārthatvameva syānna kratvarthatvayityāśaṅkya samādhātumāhaiti cenneti|
analyzed: iti ākāṅkṣāyāḥ nivṛtta tvāt prakaraṇa pramāṇa niṣṭhā vākya liṅga ādi prakalpa tva śaktiḥ vyāhanyate iti śruteḥ balavat tvāt tayā prakaraṇa pramāṇam bādhyate tathā ca anṛta vadana kriyā niṣedha āśrayaḥ kartā iti bodhāt na anṛtam vadot iti niṣedhasya puruṣa artha tvam eva syāt na kratu artha tvayi iti āśaṅkya samādhātum āha eti ced na iti

original: mīmāṃsakamatenā''khyātena bhāvanāyā abhidhānācchrutyā kartuḥ puruṣasyāpratīyamānatvācchrutivirodhābhāve sati kevalaprakaraṇapramāṇena nānṛtayiti nipedhasya kratvarthatvameva bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| idānīṃ vaiyākaraṇamate ākhyātena (tiṅā) kartuḥ puruṣasyābhidhīyamānatve'pi nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya na puruṣārthatvaṃ saṃbhavatītyāhatiṅarthastvityādi|
analyzed: mīmāṃsaka matena ākhyātena bhāvanāyāḥ abhidhānāt śrutyā kartuḥ puruṣasya apratīyamāna tvāt śruti virodha abhāve sati kevala prakaraṇa pramāṇena na anṛtay iti nipedhasya kratu artha tvam eva bhavati iti bhāvaḥ idānīm vaiyākaraṇa mate ākhyātena tiṅā kartuḥ puruṣasya abhidhīyamāna tve pi na anṛtam iti niṣedhasya na puruṣa artha tvam saṃbhavati iti āha tiṅ arthaḥ tu ityādi

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥlaḥ karmaṇītyādiśāstraprāmāṇyādākhyātena(tibādipratyayena karturabhidhāne'pi na tasya prādhānyam| bhāvodhātvarthaḥphalavyāpārānyatarūpaḥ, pradhānaṃ yatreti bahuvrīhiḥ| tiṅantaṃ cānyapadārthaḥ|
analyzed: ayam karmaṇi ityādi śāstra prāmāṇyāt ākhyātena tip ādi pratyayena kartuḥ abhidhāne api na tasya prādhānyam bhāvaḥ dhātvarthaḥ phala vyāpāra anyatarūpaḥ pradhānam yatra iti bahuvrīhiḥ tiṅ antam ca anya padārthaḥ

original: tathā ca tiṅantaṃ bhāvapradhānakaṃtiṅarthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitadhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāśālibodhajanakamityarthakād `bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti niruktavacanād‌vyapārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyasya, tiṅarthakartrāderviśeṣaṇatvasya cāvagamāt| tataśca prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti nyāyasya saṃkoco'vaśyaṃ svīkāryaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca tiṅ antam bhāva pradhānakam tiṅ artha niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita dhātvartha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā śāli bodha janakam iti arthakāt bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti nirukta vacanāt vyapāra rūpa bhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyasya tiṅ artha kartṛ ādeḥ viśeṣaṇa tvasya ca avagamāt tatas ca prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti nyāyasya saṃkocaḥ uvaśyam svīkāryaḥ

original: tathā ca prakṛtītiṅ‌bhinnapratyayārthayormadhye pratyayārthasya prādhānyamityarthattiṅante'yaṃ nyāyo na pravartate| evaṃ cā''khyātavācyakarturdhātvarthavyāpārātmakabhāvanāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvādviśeṣaṇasya ca viśeṣyaparatantratvānmama viśeṣaṇaṃ kimiti viśeṣaṇākāṅkṣānudayād' guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvātsyāt' iti nyāyena nānṛtamiti
analyzed: tathā ca nyāyaḥ na pravartate evam ca ākhyāta vācya kartuḥ dhātvartha vyāpāra ātmaka bhāvanām prati viśeṣaṇa tvāt viśeṣaṇasya ca viśeṣya paratantra tvāt mama viśeṣaṇam kim iti viśeṣaṇa ākāṅkṣā anudayāt guṇānām ca parārtha tvāt asaṃbandhaḥ sama tvāt syāt iti nyāyena na anṛtam iti

original: niṣedhasyāṅgatve(viśeṣaṇatve)na saṃbandho viśeṣaṇabhūte kartari na saṃbhavatītyāhana hi guṇabhūta iti| viśeṣya evāṅgitvasya nyāyyatvādviśeṣaṇe(kartari)nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya viseṣaṇatvena saṃbandhe kṛte viśeṣaṇe(kartari)pradhānyamaprādhānyaṃ cetyekasminviruddhaddhayamāpadyeteti na viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇatvena padārthāntarasaṃbandhaḥ kartuṃ yujyate|
analyzed: niṣedhasya aṅga tve viśeṣaṇa tvena saṃbandhaḥ viśeṣaṇa bhūte kartari na saṃbhavati iti āha na hi guṇa bhūtaḥ iti viśeṣye eva aṅgi tvasya nyāyya tvāt viśeṣaṇe kartari na anṛtam iti niṣedhasya viseṣaṇa tvena saṃbandhe kṛte viśeṣaṇe kartari pradhānyam aprādhānyam ca iti ekasmin viruddha ddhayam āpadyeta iti na viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇa tvena padārtha antara saṃbandhaḥ kartum yujyate

original: tadāhaguṇabhūtaḥ kartā niṣedhaṃ svāṅgatvena grahītuṃ nālaṃ na samartha iti| itaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthite viśeṣaṇatvena padārthāntarānvayasya viruddhatvādeva somena yajetatyatra yāgena bhāvayedityevamākhyātārthabhāvanāyāṃ yāgasya viśeṣaṇatvenānvaye kṛte tādṛśe tatraiva punaḥ somena yāgaṃ bhāvayadityevaṃ somasya viśeṣyatvenānvayo nirākṛto mīmāṃsakaiḥ|
analyzed: tat āha guṇa bhūtaḥ kartā niṣedham sva aṅgatvena grahītum na alam na samarthaḥ iti itara viśeṣaṇa tvena upasthite viśeṣaṇa tvena padārtha antara anvayasya viruddha tvāt eva somena yajeta iti atra yāgena bhāvayet iti evam ākhyāta artha bhāvanāyām yāgasya viśeṣaṇa tvena anvaye kṛte tādṛśe tatra eva punar somena yāgam bhāvayat iti evam somasya viśeṣya tvena anvayaḥ nirākṛtaḥ mīmāṃsakaiḥ

original: nanu dhātvarthabhāvanā'pi kathaṃ niṣedaṃ gṛh‌ṇīyāttasyā api ākhyātārthakartṛsaṃbandhitvādityata āhabhāvanā tviti| pradhānamiti| yato bhāvanā tiṅarthakartāraṃ prati praghānaṃviśeṣyabhūtā'tastasyā viśeṣaṇatvena nañarthaniṣedhe'nvaye bādhakābhāvātsā niṣedhaṃ grahītuṃ samarthaiva|
analyzed: nanu dhātvartha bhāvanā api katham niṣedam gṛhṇīyāt tasyāḥ api ākhyāta artha kartṛ saṃbandhi tvāt iti atas āha bhāvanā tu iti pradhānam iti yatas bhāvanā tiṅ artha kartāram prati praghānam viśeṣya bhūtā atas tasyāḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena bādhaka abhāvāt sā niṣedham grahītum samarthā eva

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥvadedityatra dhātvarthavadanakriyāṃ prati tiṅarthaḥ kartā viśeṣaṇaṃ vadanakriyā ca viśeṣyaṃ, kartṛniṣṭhā vadanakriyeti bodhaḥ| anṛtamiti vadanasya viśeṣaṇaṃanṛtavadanakriyetyarthaḥ| tādṛśānṛtavadanakriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyā nañarthe viśeṣaṇatayā'nvayaḥ|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ vadet iti atra dhātvartha vadana kriyām prati tiṅ arthaḥ kartā viśeṣaṇam vadana kriyā ca viśeṣyam kartṛ niṣṭhā vadana kriyā iti bodhaḥ anṛtam iti vadanasya viśeṣaṇam anṛta vadana kriyā iti arthaḥ tādṛśa anṛta vadana kriyāyāḥ pradhāna bhūtāyāḥ nañ arthe viśeṣaṇatayā anvayaḥ

original: tathāca kartṛniṣṭhānṛtavadanākriyāniṣedha ityarthe saṃpanne kimartho'yaṃ niṣedha iti niṣedhasya kaimarthyākāṅkṣāyāṃ prakaraṇapramāṇādvākyaliṅgaśrutiḥ kalpayitvā tad‌dvārā niṣedhasya darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe viniyogātkratvarthataiva sidhyatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca kartṛ niṣṭha anṛta vadana akriyā niṣedhaḥ iti arthe saṃpanne kimarthaḥ ayam niṣedhaḥ iti niṣedhasya kaimarthya ākāṅkṣāyām prakaraṇa pramāṇāt vākya liṅga śrutiḥ kalpayitvā tad dvārā niṣedhasya darśa pūrṇamāsa prakaraṇe viniyogāt kratu artha tā eva sidhyati iti arthaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ rītyā na hiṃsyātsarvā bhūtāni, na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayedityādiniṣedhānāmapi śrutyā puruṣārthatvaṃ na syāt, śrutyupasthitasya kartuḥ kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvāt|
analyzed: nanu evam rītyā na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni na kalañjam bhakṣayet ityādi niṣedhānām api śrutyā puruṣa artha tvam na syāt śruti upasthitasya kartuḥ kriyām prati viśeṣaṇa tvāt

original: yadi tu na kalañjamityādiniṣedhasthale'nyasyāṅgino'saṃbhavādviśeṣaṇabhūtakarturapi niṣedho'ṅgaṃ bhavatītyucyate tarhi, itaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthite'rthe viśeṣaṇatvenetarārthānanvaya iti pūrvoktaniyamasya vyabhicārema nānṛtaṃ vedadityatrāpi niṣedhaḥ karturaṅgaṃ syādata āhaastu vedyādi| kratuyuktapuruṣadharma iti|
analyzed: yadi tu na kalañjam ityādi niṣedha sthale nyasya aṅginoḥ saṃbhavāt viśeṣaṇa bhūta kartuḥ api niṣedha uṅgam bhavati iti ucyate tarhi itara viśeṣaṇa tvena upasthita irthe viśeṣaṇa tvena itara artha ananvayaḥ iti pūrva ukta niyamasya na anṛtam vedat iti atra api niṣedhaḥ kartuḥ aṅgam syāt atas āha astu vedi ādi kratu yukta puruṣa dharmaḥ iti

original: ākhyātasya kartṛvācakatve padaśrutyā nānṛtaṃ vadediti niṣedhasya puruṣārthatvaṃ prāpnoti, prakaraṇena ca kratvarthatvam| tatraikasyaiva kasyacitkvacidviniyogārthaṃ prāptayordviyoḥ pramāṇayoryadyavirodhaḥ saṃbhavati tarhi tatra virodhakalpanamanyāyyam| virodhe hi balābalavicāreṇa prabalena durbalasya bādhaḥ kartavyo bhavatīti māhagauravam|
analyzed: ākhyātasya kartṛ vācaka tve pada śrutyā na anṛtam vadet iti niṣedhasya puruṣa artha tvam prāpnoti prakaraṇena ca kratu artha tvam tatra ekasya eva kasyacid kvacid viniyoga artham prāptayoḥ dviyoḥ pramāṇayoḥ yadi avirodhaḥ saṃbhavati tarhi tatra virodha kalpanam anyāyyam virodhe hi bala abala vicāreṇa prabalena durbalasya bādhaḥ kartavyaḥ bhavati iti māha gauravam

original: avirodha tu kasyāpyabādhenobhayoḥ samāveśaiti lāghavam| prakṛte nānṛtamiti niṣedhaṃ viniyoktaṃ prasaktayoḥ śrutiprakaraṇayormadhye śrutistaṃ puruṣe viniyuṅkte, prakaraṇaṃ tu kratāviti virodho bhāsate tathā'pi sa ābhāsa eva|
analyzed: tu kasya api abādhena ubhayoḥ samāveśaḥ eti lāghavam prakṛte na anṛtam iti niṣedham viniyoktam prasaktayoḥ śruti prakaraṇayoḥ madhye śrutiḥ tam puruṣe viniyuṅkte prakaraṇam tu kratau iti virodhaḥ bhāsate tathā api saḥ ābhāsaḥ eva

original: yataḥ kratāvapi puruṣasaṃbhavena śrutiprakaraṇayoravirodhe sati ubhābhyāṃ kratuyuktapuruṣadharmatvaṃ niṣedhasyetyavagamyate, śrutiprakaraṇābhyāmekavākyatayā niṣedhe kratuyuktaḥ puruṣo'ṅ‌gitvena samarpyata iti yāvat| tathā ca kratusaṃyuktapuruṣakartṛkānṛtavadananiṣedha iti bodhānniṣedhaḥ sākṣātpuruṣasyāṅūge, kratostu paramparayā niṣedho'ṅgamiti|
analyzed: yatas kratau api puruṣa saṃbhavena śruti prakaraṇayoḥ avirodhe sati ubhābhyām kratu yukta puruṣa dharma tvam niṣedhasya iti avagamyate śruti prakaraṇābhyām ekavākyatayā niṣedhe kratu yuktaḥ puruṣa uṅgi tvena samarpyate iti yāvat tathā ca kratu saṃyukta puruṣa kartṛka anṛta vadana niṣedhaḥ iti bodhāt niṣedhaḥ sākṣāt puruṣasya aṅūge kratoḥ tu paramparayā niṣedha uṅgam iti

original: yathā svayaṃ guṇabhūtaḥ sevako rājānaṃ pradhānaṃ manyate, tasyāpi rājño yadguṇabhūtaṃ putrakalatrādi tadapyasau svapradhānamiti manyate tadvadityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā svayam guṇa bhūtaḥ sevakaḥ rājānam pradhānam manyate tasya api rājñaḥ yat guṇa bhūtam putra kalatra ādi tat api asau sva pradhānam iti manyate tadvat iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yadyayaṃ niṣedhaḥ kratuyuktapuruṣārthaḥ syāttārhi kratau karturyajamānasya mukhaayatvāttenaivānṛtavadananiṣedhaḥ saṃlagno bhavediti yajamānenavānṛtavadaniṣedhaḥ paripālatīyo bhavennartvigādibhirityanuṣṭhāne vaiṣamyaṃ syādityanusaṃdhāyā''haanuṣṭhāne viśeṣābhāvāditi|
analyzed: nanu yadi ayam niṣedhaḥ kratu yukta puruṣa arthaḥ syāt tārhi kratau kartuḥ yajamānasya mukha aya tvāt tena eva anṛta vadana niṣedhaḥ saṃlagnaḥ bhavet iti yajamānena vā anṛta vada niṣedhaḥ bhavet na ṛtvij ādibhiḥ iti anuṣṭhāne vaiṣamyam syāt iti anusaṃdhāya āha anuṣṭhāne viśeṣa abhāvāt iti

original: puruṣasya kratuyuktatvena viśeṣaṇātkratuyuktaḥ kratusaṃbaddho yaḥ puruṣastatkartṛkaṃ yadanṛtavadanaṃ tasya niṣedha ityarthādyathā yajamānaḥ kratunā saṃvaddhastathartvigādirapi kratunā saṃbaddha iti kratusaṃbaddhatvāviśeṣādyajamānavaṭṭatvigādibhirapyanṛtavadanaṃ varjanīyamityanuṣṭhāne viśeṣābhāva ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: puruṣasya kratu yukta tvena viśeṣaṇāt kratu yuktaḥ kratu saṃbaddhaḥ yaḥ puruṣaḥ tad kartṛkam yat anṛta vadanam tasya niṣedhaḥ iti arthāt yathā yajamānaḥ kratunā saṃvaddhaḥ tathā ṛtvij ādiḥ api kratunā saṃbaddhaḥ iti kratu saṃbaddha tva aviśeṣāt yajamāna vaṭ ṭatvij ādibhiḥ api anṛta vadanam varjanīyam iti anuṣṭhāne viśeṣa abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yadi tu yuktaśabdasthāne kartṛpadaṃ prakṣipya kratukartṛpuruṣakartṛkānṛtavadanaviṣedhaḥkratoryaḥ kartā puruṣo yajamānastatkartṛkānṛtavadananiṣedha ityucyeta tadā yajamānavyatiriktartvigadināmanṛtavadananiṣedhāprasaktyā yajamānenānṛtavadanaṃ varjyaṃ na tadanyairṛtvigbirityanuṣṭhāne viśeṣaḥ saṃjāyeta, tathā viśeṣo mā bhūdityākalayyaiva
analyzed: yadi tu yukta śabda sthāne kartṛ padam prakṣipya kratu kartṛ puruṣa kartṛka anṛta vadana viṣedhaḥ kratoḥ yaḥ kartā puruṣaḥ yajamānaḥ tad kartṛka anṛta vadana niṣedhaḥ iti ucyeta tadā yajamāna vyatirikta ṛtvij adinām anṛta vadana niṣedha aprasaktyā yajamānena anṛta vadanam varjyam na tad anyaiḥ ṛtvigbiḥ iti anuṣṭhāne viśeṣaḥ saṃjāyeta tathā viśeṣaḥ mā bhūt iti ākalayya eva

original: kratuyuktapuruṣetyuktaṃ mūla iti bhūṣaṇasārakarturabhiprāyo bodhyaḥ|
analyzed: kratu yukta puruṣa iti uktam mūle iti bhūṣaṇa sāra kartuḥ abhiprāyaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: ekasyaiva niviyoge prasaktayordvayorviruddhapramāṇayoravirodhasaṃpādanena kratuyuktapuruṣadharmatvasamarthane mīmāṃsakābhimataṃ dṛṣṭāntamāhajañjabhyamāno'nubrūyāditi| jañjabhyamāno'nubrūyānmayi dakṣakratū iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrutam| jañjabhyamāna ityatra jabhadhātorbhāvagarhāyāṃ yaṅ, tataḥ kartari śānac|
analyzed: ekasya eva prasaktayoḥ dvayoḥ viruddha pramāṇayoḥ avirodha saṃpādanena kratu yukta puruṣa dharma tva samarthane mīmāṃsaka abhimatam dṛṣṭāntam āha jañjabhyamānaḥ nubrūyāt iti jañjabhyamānaḥ nubrūyāt mayi dakṣa kratū iti darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ śrutam jañjabhyamānaḥ iti atra jabha dhātoḥ bhāva garhāyām yaṅ tatas kartari śānac

original: `jabhī jṛbhi gātravināme' iti pāṇinismṛtergātravināmena vidāritamukha iti tadarthaḥ| tatra kimayaṃ mantrapāṭhaḥ puruṣamuddiśya vidhīyate'thavā kratumuddiśyeti saṃdihya vākyapramāṇena tāvajjajjabhyamānapuruṣadharmatvenāyaṃ pratīyate, śānacā kṛtpratyayena kartuḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyamānatvāt|
analyzed: gātra vināme iti pāṇini smṛteḥ gātra vināmena vidārita mukhaḥ iti tad arthaḥ tatra kim ayam mantra pāṭhaḥ puruṣam uddiśya vidhīyate thavā kratum uddiśya iti saṃdihya vākya pramāṇena tāvat jajjabhyamāna puruṣa dharma tvena ayam pratīyate kṛt pratyayena kartuḥ prādhānyena abhidhīyamāna tvāt

original: prakaraṇapramāṇena tu kratvaṅ‌gatvena pratīyate, vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇād‌balīyaḥ, tasmātpuruṣadharmo'yamiti pūrvapakṣayitvāvākyaprakaraṇābyāmaviruddhābhyāṃ kratuyuktapuruṣasaṃkāradvārā kratvartho'yamiti siddhāntitaṃ jaiminīye tṛtīyādhyāye caturthapāde pañcame jañjabhyamānādhikaraṇe|
analyzed: prakaraṇa pramāṇena tu kratu aṅga tvena pratīyate vākyam ca prakaraṇāt balīyaḥ tasmāt puruṣa dharmaḥ yam iti pūrvapakṣayitvā a vākya prakaraṇābyām aviruddhābhyām kratu yukta puruṣa saṃkāra dvārā kratu arthaḥ yam iti siddhāntitam jaiminīye tṛtīya adhyāye caturtha pāde pañcame jañjabhyamāna adhikaraṇe

original: na ca prakaraṇādvākyaliṅge śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā caturthakṣaṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyaḥ, tataḥ prāgeva vākyālliṅgaṃ śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā tṛtīyakṣaṇa eva viniyogasya kṛtvātpuruṣārthatvanirṇayena kva viniyoga ityākāṅkṣāyā virahānna kratāvapyanvayaḥ sidhyatīti vācyam| tathā sati pramāmayorvirodhaḥ syāt|
analyzed: na ca prakaraṇāt vākya liṅge śrutim ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā caturtha kṣaṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyaḥ tatas prāk eva vākyāt liṅgam śrutim ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā tṛtīya kṣaṇe eva viniyogasya kṛtvāt puruṣa artha tva nirṇayena kva viniyogaḥ iti ākāṅkṣāyāḥ virahāt na kratau api anvayaḥ sidhyati iti vācyam tathā sati pramā mayoḥ virodhaḥ syāt

original: virodhe ca balavatā durbalaṃ bādhanīyam| tacca na nyāyyam| avādhenopapattau bādhasyānyāyyatvāditi nyāyāt| tasmādvākyapramāṇena yadetanmantrānuvacanaṃ jañjabhyamānapuruṣāṅgatvena vihitaṃ tatra so'ṅgī jañjabhyamānapuruṣo nāsaṃbaddhaḥ, kiṃ tu kratusaṃbaddho grāhya ityetatprakaraṇapramāṇasāhāyyena pratipādyate|
analyzed: virodhe ca balavatā durbalam bādhanīyam tat ca na nyāyyam a vādhena upapattau bādhasya anyāyya tvāt iti nyāyāt tasmāt vākya pramāṇena yat etat mantra anuvacanam jañjabhyamāna puruṣa aṅga tvena vihitam tatra sa ūṅgī jañjabhyamāna puruṣaḥ na asaṃbaddhaḥ kim tu kratu saṃbaddhaḥ grāhyaḥ iti etat prakaraṇa pramāṇa sāhāyyena pratipādyate

original: tena virodhābhāvena bādhābhāvād‌dvayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ samāveśaḥ sādhitaḥ| tathā ca kratusaṃyuktajañjabhyamānapuruṣakartṛkaṃ mantrānuvacanamiti bodānmatrānuvacanasya puruṣārthatvaṃ puruṣadvārā ca kratvarthaṃ ca samarthitamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tena virodha abhāvena bādhā abhāvāt dvayoḥ pramāṇayoḥ samāveśaḥ sādhitaḥ tathā ca kratu saṃyukta jañjabhyamāna puruṣa kartṛkam mantra anuvacanam iti bodāt matra anuvacanasya puruṣa artha tvam puruṣa dvārā ca kratu artham ca samarthitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca balābalavicārasva virodha evāvasarādaviruddhābhyāṃ vākyaprakaraṇābhyāṃ jañjabyamānavākye mantrānuvacanasya kratuyuktapuruṣārthatvavatprakṛte'pyanṛtavadananiṣedhasyāviruddhābhyāṃ śrutiprakaraṇābhyāṃ kratuyuktapuruṣārthatvameva yuktamityāśayaḥ| taduktaṃ bhaṭṭapādaiḥstryupāyamāṃsabhakṣādi puruṣārthamapi śritaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca balābala vicāra sva virodhaḥ eva avasarāt aviruddhābhyām vākya prakaraṇābhyām jañjabyamāna vākye mantra anuvacanasya kratu yukta puruṣa artha tva vat prakṛte pi anṛta vadana niṣedhasya aviruddhābhyām śruti prakaraṇābhyām kratu yukta puruṣa artha tvam eva yuktam iti āśayaḥ tat uktam bhaṭṭa pādaiḥ strī upāya māṃsa bhakṣa ādi puruṣa artham api śritaḥ

original: pratiṣedhaḥ kratoraṅ‌gamiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇāśrayāt|| bhakṣādīti napuṃsakadvitīyāntam| stryupāyamāṃsabhakṣādīn viṣayīkṛtya yaḥ pratiṣedha uktaḥ sa puruṣārthaṃ śrito'pi prakaraṇāśrayātkratoraṅgamiṣṭa iti tadartha iti| anayā bhaṭṭoktyā viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇatvenetarānanvaya ityevaṃrūpo niyamo na sārvatrika iti jñeyam|
analyzed: pratiṣedhaḥ kratoḥ aṅgam iṣṭaḥ prakaraṇa āśrayāt bhakṣa ādi iti napuṃsaka dvitīyā antam strī upāya māṃsa bhakṣa ādīn viṣayīkṛtya yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ sa puruṣa artham śritaḥ api prakaraṇa āśrayāt kratoḥ aṅgam iṣṭaḥ iti tad arthaḥ iti anayā bhaṭṭa uktyā viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇa tvena itara ananvayaḥ iti evaṃrūpaḥ niyamaḥ na sārvatrikaḥ iti jñeyam

original: kratusaṃbandhī yaḥ puruṣaḥ, tatkartṛkānṛtavadanābhāva iti bodhātpuruṣaṃ prati kratorviśeṣaṇatvātpuruṣasya vadanakriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvācceti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kratu saṃbandhī yaḥ puruṣaḥ tad kartṛka anṛta vadana abhāvaḥ iti bodhāt puruṣam prati kratoḥ viśeṣaṇa tvāt puruṣasya vadana kriyām prati viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: nankākhyātasya bhāvanārthakatvābhiprāyeṇa prayoge tasya (ākhyātasya) tatra (bhāvanāyāṃ) asādhutvenā''khyātādbhāvanāyā bodho na syāt, sādhutvajñānasya śābdabodhaṃ prati kāraṇatvādata āhatadabhāve'pītyādi| ākhyātasya bhāvanāyāmasādhutve'pyākhyātādbhāvānābodho bhavatyevetyarthaḥ| apabhraṃśavaditi|
analyzed: nanu kākhyātasya bhāvanā arthaka tva abhiprāyeṇa prayoge tasya ākhyātasya tatra bhāvanāyām asādhu tvena ākhyātāt bhāvanāyāḥ bodhaḥ na syāt sādhu tva jñānasya śābda bodham prati kāraṇatvāt atas āha tad abhāve pi ityādi ākhyātasya bhāvanāyām asādhu tve pi ākhyātāt bhāvānām abodhaḥ bhavati eva iti arthaḥ apabhraṃśa vat iti

original: yathā'pabhraṃśānāṃ sādhutvabhramādbodhakatve'pyasādhutvaṃ tathā sādhutvabhramādbhāvanābodakatve'pi tasyāṃ tibāderasādhutvaṃ syādevetyarthaḥ| nanu pāṇin‌yādyanuśāsanasya niṣpramāṇatvāttiboderbhāvanābodhakatve'pi sādhutvaṃ niṣpratibandhameveti cenna|
analyzed: yathā apabhraṃśānām sādhu tva bhramāt bodhaka tve ipi asādhu tvam tathā sādhu tva bhramāt bhāvanā bodaka tve pi tasyām tip ādeḥ asādhu tvam syāt eva iti arthaḥ nanu pāṇini ādi anuśāsanasya niṣpramāṇa tvāt tip odeḥ bhāvanā bodhaka tve pi sādhu tvam niṣpratibandham eva iti ced na

original: `vrāhnaṇena niṣkāraṇaṃ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyo jñeyaśca' iti mahābhāṣyakārod‌dhṛtaśruteḥ, pāṇinīyaṃ mahāśāsraṃ padasādhutvalakṣaṇam| sarvopakārakaṃ grāhyaṃ kṛtsnaṃ, tyājyaṃ na kiṃcana|| iti parāśaropapurāṇādeścāpi pramāṇatvāt|
analyzed: niṣkāraṇam ṣaṣ aṅgaḥ veda udhyeyaḥ jñeyaḥ ca iti mahābhāṣya kāra uddhṛta śruteḥ pāṇinīyam mahā śāsram pada sādhu tva lakṣaṇam sarva upakārakam grāhyam kṛtsnam tyājyam na kiṃcana iti parāśara upapurāṇa ādeḥ ca api pramāṇa tvāt

original: nanu sādhutvajñānamantarā'pi śābdabodhodayadarśanātsādhutvajñānasya śābdabodhakāraṇatvābhāve'pi asādhutvajñānasattve śābdabodhodayādarśanādasādhutvajñānasya śābdabodhaṃ prati pratibandhakatvaṃ vaktavyameva| tathā ca bhāvanāyāmasādhustibādirityevaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ jñānasattvātkathaṃ tibāderbhāvanābodhakatvamityāśaṅkāṃ samādhātumāhavastuta ityādi|
analyzed: nanu sādhu tva jñānam antarā api śābdabodha udaya darśanāt sādhu tva jñānasya śābdabodha kāraṇatva abhāve pi asādhu tva jñāna sattve śābdabodha udaya adarśanāt asādhu tva jñānasya śābdabodham prati pratibandhaka tvam vaktavyam eva tathā ca bhāvanāyām asādhuḥ tip ādiḥ iti evam vaiyākaraṇānām jñāna sattvāt katham tip ādeḥ bhāvanā bodhaka tvam iti āśaṅkām samādhātum āha vastutas ityādi

original: tavdyatireketi| sādhutvasya vyatireko'bhāvaḥ, tannirṇayo'pītyarthaḥ| asādhutvajñānamiti yāvat| na pratibandhakamiti śeṣo'styeva| vakṣyāma iti|
analyzed: tad vyatireka iti sādhutvasya vyatirekaḥ bhāvaḥ tad nirṇayaḥ api iti arthaḥ asādhutva jñānam iti yāvat na pratibandhakam iti śeṣaḥ asti eva vakṣyāmaḥ iti

original: sādhutvajñānarahitānāmasādhutvajñānavatāmapi gagaryādiśabdebhyo bodhodayasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvātsādhutvajñānaṃ na heturnāpyasādhutvajñānaṃ tatpratibandhakamityagre'sādhuranumānenaityatra śaktinirṇaye vakṣyata iti sarvaṃ śivam|| 21 ||
analyzed: sādhu tva jñāna rahitānām asādhu tva jñānavatām api gagarī ādi śabdebhyaḥ bodha udayasya sarva anubhava siddha tvāt sādhu tva jñānam na hetuḥ na api asādhu tva jñānam tad pratibandhakam iti agre sādhuḥ anumānena eti atra śakti nirṇaye vakṣyate iti sarvam śivam 21

original: iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāravyākhyāyāṃ śāṃkaryaṃ dhātvākhyātayoḥ sāmānyārthasya nirupaṇam|| 1 ||
analyzed: iti vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇa sāra vyākhyāyām śāṃkaryam dhātu ākhyātayoḥ sāmānya arthasya nirupaṇam

original: raṅgabhaṭṭatanūjasya śaṃkarasya vinirmitau| pūrṇaḥ sārīyaṭīkāyāṃ dhātvākhyātārthanirṇayaḥ|| 1 ||
atha lakāraviśeṣārthanirūpaṇam||
analyzed: atha lakāra viśeṣa artha nirūpaṇam

original: viśeṣārthajijñāsāyāḥ sāmānyārthajñānapūrvakatvaniyamādākhyātasāmānyārthe nirūpite'vasarasaṃgatya lakāraviśeṣārthanirūpaṇamarabhata ityāha-pratyekamiti| ekaikasyetyarthaḥ| ekamekaṃ pratīti vīpsāyāmavyayībhāve ṣaṣṭhyā ambhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| daśalakārāṇāmiti| daśānāṃ lakārāṇāmityarthaḥ| diksaṃkhye saṃjñāyāmiti samāsaḥ|
analyzed: viśeṣa artha jijñāsāyāḥ sāmānya artha jñāna pūrvakatva niyamāt ākhyāta sāmānya arthe lakāra viśeṣa artha nirūpaṇam arabhata iti āha pratyekam iti ekaikasya iti arthaḥ ekam ekam prati iti vīpsāyām avyayībhāve ṣaṣṭhyāḥ am bhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ daśa lakārāṇām iti daśānām lakārāṇām iti arthaḥ diś saṃkhye saṃjñāyām iti samāsaḥ

original: saptarṣivadiyaṃ laḍādīnāṃ saṃjñeti bhāvaḥ| lakārāṇāmiti saṃbandha sāmānye ṣaṣṭhī| pratyekamityatrānvayaḥ| daśalakārāṇāṃ madhye ekaikasyetyarthaḥ| arthamiti| jātyekavacanam| nirūpayati-pratipādayati-vartamāne parokṣa iti| kārikāyā golārthamāha-laḍādaya ityādinā| vartamānatvasya laḍarthatve pramāṇamāha-vartamāne laḍitīti|
analyzed: saptarṣi vat iyam laḍ ādīnām saṃjñā iti bhāvaḥ lakārāṇām iti saṃbandha sāmānye ṣaṣṭhī pratyekam iti atra anvayaḥ daśa lakārāṇām madhye ekaikasya iti arthaḥ artham iti jāti ekavacanam nirūpayati pratipādayati vartamāne parokṣaḥ iti kārikāyāḥ gola artham āha laḍ ādayaḥ ityādinā vartamāna tvasya laṭ artha tve pramāṇam āha vartamāne laṭ iti iti

original: vartamānatvaṃ lakṣayati prārabdhāparīti| prārabdhāparisamāptakriyopalakṣitakālatvamityarthaḥ| vartamānatvasya kālagatatvena sarvānubhavasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| prārabdhā ca aparisamāptā ca yā kriyā tādṛśākriyāśrayakālatvamiti akṣarārthaḥ|
analyzed: vartamāna tvam lakṣayati prārabdha apari iti prārabdha aparisamāpta kriyā upalakṣita kālatvam iti arthaḥ vartamāna tvasya kāla gata tvena sarva anubhava siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ prārabdhā ca aparisamāptā ca yā kriyā tādṛśa akriyā āśraya kālatvam iti akṣara arthaḥ

original: bhāṣye `nyāyyā tveṣā vartamānakālatā''rambhānapavargādavaśyaṃ bhuñjāno hasati jalpati, pibati, nimiṣati ca' ityuktam| nāntarīyakatvāttāsāṃ na vicchedakatvamiti hasanādidaśāyāmapi `bhuṅkte' iti prayogopapattiḥ| anekadinādisādhyagranthādhyayanasamaye bhojanagamanādinānāvidhakriyāṇāmapi na vicchedakatvam|
analyzed: bhāṣye nyāyyā tu eṣā vartamāna kāla tā ārambha anapavargāt avaśyam bhuñjānaḥ hasati jalpati pibati nimiṣati ca iti uktam nāntarīyaka tvāt tāsām na vicchedaka tvam iti hasana ādi daśāyām api bhuṅkte iti prayoga upapattiḥ aneka dina ādi sādhya grantha adhyayana samaye bhojana gamana ādi nānāvidha kriyāṇām api na vicchedaka tvam

original: ata eva saṃhitādyadhyayanasamāptiparyantaṃ devadattaḥ saṃhitāṃ paṭhatīti prayoga upapadyate| ito'pi laghu lakṣaṇamāha-bhūteti| tathā ca bhūtabhaviṣyadbhinnakālatvaṃ vartamānatvamityarthaḥ| tatra bhūtatvaṃ-vartamānadvaṃsapratiyogikriyāśrayakālatvaṃ, bhaviṣyattvaṃ tu-vartamānaprāgabhāvapratiyogikriyāśrayakālatvaṃ jñeyam|
analyzed: atas eva saṃhitā ādi adhyayana samāpti paryantam devadattaḥ saṃhitām paṭhati iti prayogaḥ upapadyate itas api laghu lakṣaṇam āha bhūta iti tathā ca bhūta bhaviṣyat bhinna kālatvam vartamāna tvam iti arthaḥ tatra bhūta tvam vartamāna dvaṃsa pratiyogi kriyā āśraya kālatvam bhaviṣyat tvam tu vartamāna prāgabhāva pratiyogi kriyā āśraya kālatvam jñeyam

original: vartamānatvaṃ ca dhvaṃse prakṛtaprayogādhikaraṇakālavṛttitvaṃ, evameva prāgabhāve'pi vartamānatvaṃ bodhyam| prakṛtaprayogādhikaraṇakālaśca praharīdanādyātmako buddhisthastatra tatra viśiṣya niveśyaḥ| lakṣye lakṣaṇaṃ saṃgamayati-pacatītyādāviti| adhiśrayaṇāditi|
analyzed: vartamāna tvam ca dhvaṃse prakṛta prayoga adhikaraṇa kāla vṛtti tvam evam eva prāgabhāve pi vartamāna tvam bodhyam prakṛta prayoga adhikaraṇa kālaḥ ca praharīt anādi ātmakaḥ buddhi sthaḥ tatra tatra viśiṣya niveśyaḥ lakṣye lakṣaṇam saṃgamayati pacati ityādau iti adhiśrayaṇāt iti

original: adhiśrayaṇaṃ-cullyupari sthālīsthāpanaṃ, ādiryasya, adhaḥśrayaṇaṃ-cullyā, sakāśātsthālyavatāraṇaṃ, anto yasyeti bahuvrīhidvaye kṛte sati karmadhārayaḥ| kriyāsamūho'nyapadārthaḥ| karmadhāraye'pi sa samūha eva viśeṣyaḥ| tādṛśasamūhāntargatamadhye ityarthaḥ| tattatphalānukūlavyāpārārambhakṣaṇasamāptikṣaṇayorantarāle iti yāvat|
analyzed: adhiśrayaṇam cullī upari sthālī sthāpanam ādiḥ yasya adhas śrayaṇam cullyā sakāśāt sthālī avatāraṇam antaḥ yasya iti bahuvrīhi dvaye kṛte sati karmadhārayaḥ kriyā samūhaḥ nya padārthaḥ karmadhāraye api sa samūhaḥ eva viśeṣyaḥ tādṛśa samūha antargata madhye iti arthaḥ tad tad phala anukūla vyāpāra ārambha kṣaṇa samāpti kṣaṇayoḥ antarāle iti yāvat

original: tat-uktarūpaṃ vartamānatvamastīti laṭh‌prayogo bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanvātmā'sti parvatāḥ santītyādau laṭ‌prayogānupapattiḥ| tatrā''tmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārasya nityatayā prārabdhatvābhāvātprarābdhāparisamāptatvarūpavartamānatvasyāsaṃbhavādityāśaṅkya samādhatte-ātmetyādinā|
analyzed: tat ukta rūpam vartamānatvam asti iti laṭh prayogaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ nanu ātmā asti parvatāḥ santi ityādau laṭ prayoga anupapattiḥ tatra ātma dhāraṇa anukūla vyāpārasya nitya tayā prārabdha tva abhāvāt prarābdha aparisamāpta tva rūpa vartamānatvasya asaṃbhavāt iti āśaṅkya samādhatte ātmā ityādinā

original: tattatkālikānāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānānāṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ sthityādirūpāstāsāmanityatayā-utpattidhvaṃsaśālitayā tadviśiṣṭasya-anityarājakriyāviśiṣṭātmadhāraṇānukūvyāpārasyotpattyādikaṃ-utpattisamāptabhūtādikālabhedamādāya-ātmādiniṣṭhātmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpāre tattatkālaviśiṣṭarājakriyāgatotpattyādimattvamāropya prārabdhāparisamāptatvarūpaṃ
analyzed: tad tad kālikānām bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamānānām rājñām yāḥ kriyāḥ sthiti ādi rūpāḥ tāsām anitya tayā utpatti dhvaṃsa śāli tayā tad viśiṣṭasya anitya rāja kriyā viśiṣṭa ātma dhāraṇa anukū vyāpārasya utpatti ādikam utpatti samāpta bhūta ādi kāla bhedam ādāya ātma ādi niṣṭha ātma dhāraṇa anukūla vyāpāre tad tad kāla viśiṣṭa rāja kriyā gata utpatti ādimattvam āropya prārabdha aparisamāpta tva rūpam

original: vartamānatvamātmadhārānukūlavyāpārasya nirvāhyam| ayamarthaḥ-parvatādikartṛkrātmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārasya nityatayotpattyādirahitatve'pi bhūtabhaviṣyadādikālikarājakriyāviśiṣṭasya niruktavyāpārasyotpattyādimattvena prārabdhāparisamāptatvarūpavartamānatvaṃ sūpapādamiti|
analyzed: vartamāna tvam ātma dhārā anukūla vyāpārasya nirvāhyam ayam arthaḥ parvata ādi kartṛ kra ātma dhāraṇa anukūla vyāpārasya nitya tayā utpatti ādi rahita tve pi bhūta bhaviṣyat ādi kālika rāja kriyā viśiṣṭasya nirukta vyāpārasya utpatti ādimat tvena prārabdha aparisamāpta tva rūpa vartamāna tvam sūpapādam iti

original: ātmāstītyatrā''tmano nityatayotpattyādiśūnyatve'pi śarīrasyotpattyādimattayā tādṛśaśarīraviśiṣṭasyā''tmana utpattyādikaṃ kalpayitvā vartamānatvādibodakapratyayānāṃ prayoga upapādanīyaḥ| tathā ca kevale ātmadhāraṇānūkūlavyāpārarūpārthe utpattyādyasattve'pi uktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭe tasmin viśeṣaṇadvārotpattyādisattvaṃ naivānupapannīmatyāśayaḥ|
analyzed: ātmā asti iti atra ātmanaḥ nitya tayā utpatti ādi śūnyatve pi śarīrasya utpatti ādimattayā tādṛśa śarīra viśiṣṭasya ātmanaḥ utpatti ādikam kalpayitvā vartamāna tva ādi bodaka pratyayānām prayogaḥ upapādanīyaḥ tathā ca kevale ātma dhāraṇa anūkūla vyāpāra rūpa arthe utpatti ādi asattve pi ukta viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭe tasmin viśeṣaṇa dvāra utpatti ādi sattvam na eva anupapannīm ati āśayaḥ

original: athavā tadviśiṣṭasyetyatratyatacchabdenāvyavahitapūrvatvādanityatvasya parāmarśaḥ| tathā ca tādṛśānityakriyāgataṃ vartamānatvādikamāropya tadarthako laṭ pratyaya ityarthaḥ| atrārthe pramātvena vartamānelaṭ‌sūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyaṃ nirdiśati--uktaṃ hīti tiṣṭhateradhikaraṇamiti|
analyzed: athavā tad viśiṣṭasya iti atratya tad śabdena avyavahita pūrvatvāt anitya tvasya parāmarśaḥ tathā ca tādṛśa anitya kriyā gatam vartamāna tva ādikam āropya tad arthakaḥ laṭ pratyayaḥ iti arthaḥ atra arthe pramā tvena vartamānelaṭ sūtra stham bhāṣyam nirdiśati uktam hi iti tiṣṭhateḥ adhikaraṇam iti

original: rājakriyāṇāmādheyatāsaṃbandhena kālaviśiṣṭatvāttādṛśakriyādhāraḥ kālastiṣṭhateḥ parvatādigatasthitikriyāyā adhikaraṇamityarthaḥ| rājādikriyādhārakālasya parvatādigatasthitāvādheyatāsaṃbandhenā''ropa iti yāvat|
analyzed: rāja kriyāṇām ādheya tā saṃbandhena kāla viśiṣṭa tvāt tādṛśa kriyā ādhāraḥ kālaḥ tiṣṭhateḥ parvata ādi gata sthiti kriyāyāḥ adhikaraṇam iti arthaḥ rāja ādi kriyā ādhāra kālasya parvata ādi gata sthitau ādheya tā saṃbandhena āropaḥ iti yāvat

original: tatra kaiyaṭo'pathiṃ vyācaṣṭa-`rājñāṃ sthitirbhūtādibhedena bhinnā parvatādisthityāderbhodiketi kriyārūpatvaṃ kālatrayayogaścopapadyate, iti, kriyārūpatvaṃ kālatrayayogaśca parvatādisthityāderupapadyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra kaiyaṭa upathim vyācaṣṭa rājñām sthitiḥ bhūta ādi bhedena bhinnā parvata ādi sthiti ādeḥ bhodikā iti kriyā rūpa tvam kāla traya yogaḥ ca upapadyate iti kriyā rūpa tvam kāla traya yogaḥ ca parvata ādi sthiti ādeḥ upapadyate iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā parvatādisthitīnāṃ sadṛśāvayavatvātpūrvāparībhūtāvayavakasamūhatvarūpakriyātvānupapattiḥ, evaṃ tāsāṃ duravadhārabhedatayā kālabhedānupapattiśca syāditi bhāvaḥ| parato bhidyata iti| sarvaṃ ātmasattādikaṃ, pacyādidhātvarthasāmānyamiti yāvat| parato bhidyate-parata eva bhidyate, svāpekṣayā pareṇānyena vartamānatvādinā bhidyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā parvata ādi sthitīnām sadṛśa avayava tvāt pūrvāparībhūta avayavaka samūha tva rūpa kriyā tva anupapattiḥ evam tāsām duravadhāra bheda tayā kāla bheda anupapattiḥ ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ paratas bhidyate iti sarvam ātma sattā ādikam paci ādi dhātvartha sāmānyam iti yāvat paratas bhidyate paratas eva bhidyate sva apekṣayā pareṇa anyena vartamāna tva ādinā bhidyate iti arthaḥ

original: ātmā tu-ātmasattādikaṃ tu na vikalpate na svato bhedakaṃ bhavati, bhedasādhakaṃ svātiriktameva ātmasattādeḥ sadṛśāvayavatvena tadbhedasya duravadhāratvādivisadṛśasvabhāvāvayakastatraikasapāptyanantaraṃ dvitīyasyā''rambhāttatastṛtīyasyetyevamavadhṛtabhedatayā kālatrayabhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ-ātmasattādau tu naivamityāśayaḥ|
analyzed: ātmā tu ātma sattā ādikam tu na vikalpate na svatas bhedakam bhavati bheda sādhakam sva atiriktam eva ātma sattā ādeḥ sadṛśa avayavatvena tad bhedasya duravadhāra tva ādi visadṛśa svabhāva avayakaḥ tatra eka sapāpti anantaram dvitīyasya ārambhāt tatas tṛtīyasya iti evam avadhṛta bhedatayā kāla traya bhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ ātma sattā ādau tu na evam iti āśayaḥ

original: tasmāt-ātmasattādeḥ svato bhedasādhakatvāsāṃbhavādevetyarthaḥ| parvatādīti| ādiśabdenā''tmādergrahaṇam| pararūpeṇetisvāpekṣayā parasya rājādiniṣṭhakriyārūpārthasya rūpeṇa-taddharmeṇotpattyādimattvena bhi, dyate ityarthaḥ| iti vākyapadīye coktamityanena saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt ātma sattā ādeḥ svatas bheda sādhakatva asāṃbhavāt eva iti arthaḥ parvata ādi iti ādi śabdena ātma ādeḥ grahaṇam para rūpeṇa iti sva apekṣayā parasya rāja ādi niṣṭha kriyā rūpa arthasya rūpeṇa tad dharmeṇa utpatti ādimattvena bhidyate iti arthaḥ iti vākyapadīye ca uktam iti anena saṃbandhaḥ

original: nanu tama āsīt, tucchenābhvapihitaṃ yadāsīt, eko ha vai nārāyaṇa āsīt, ahamekaḥ, prathamamāsaṃ vartāmi ca bhaviṣyami ca, ityādiśrutiṣu tamaādipadārthānāṃ sadā sattvena vartamānadhvaṃsapratiyogikriyāśrayatvarūpabhūtatvābhāvādbhūtakālārthakapratyayo'nupapanna ityāśaṅkya samādhatte-evamiti|
analyzed: nanu tamaḥ āsīt tucchena abhu apihitam yat āsīt ekaḥ ha vai nārāyaṇaḥ āsīt aham ekaḥ prathamam āsam vartāmi ca ca ityādi śrutiṣu tamaḥ ādi padārthānām sadā sattvena vartamāna dhvaṃsa pratiyogi kriyā āśraya tva rūpa bhūta tva abhāvāt bhūta kāla arthaka pratyayaḥ anupapannaḥ iti āśaṅkya samādhatte evam iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-adhiśrayaṇādaradhaḥśrayaṇaparyanta odanaphalāvacchinnaḥ saṃtānarūpo vyāpāranicayaḥ kriyā pacerarthaḥ| evaṃ sarvatra| sa ca yāvatā kālena nivartate tāvānkālo vartamānaḥ| tadyogādvartamāno dhātvarthaḥ|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ adhiśrayaṇa ādara dhas śrayaṇa paryantaḥ odana phala avacchinnaḥ saṃtāna rūpaḥ vyāpāra nicayaḥ kriyā paceḥ arthaḥ evam sarvatra sa ca yāvatā kālena nivartate tāvān kālaḥ vartamānaḥ tad yogāt vartamānaḥ dhātvarthaḥ

original: tena niṣpannasyārthasya bhūtatvādaniṣpannasya ca bhāvitvānniṣpannāniṣpannavyatirekeṇa rāśyantarasyābhāvādvartamānābhāva iti śaṅkā nirastā|
analyzed: tena niṣpannasya arthasya bhūta tvāt aniṣpannasya ca bhāvi tvāt niṣpanna aniṣpanna vyatirekeṇa rāśi antarasya abhāvāt vartamāna abhāvaḥ iti śaṅkā nirastā

original: tataḥ parvatāstiṣṭhanti, ātma'sti, sravanti sindhava ityādau parvatādisthityādeḥ sarvadā vidyamānatvādbhūtabhaviṣyadabhāvāttatpratidvaṃdvirūpasya vartamānasyāpyabhāva iti laṇna prāpnotītyāśaṅkya kālatravartināṃ rājñāṃ yāḥ kriyāḥ paripālanādirūpā bhūtādibhedena bhinnāstāḥ parvatādisthityāderbhedikāḥ|
analyzed: tatas parvatāḥ tiṣṭhanti sravanti sindhavaḥ ityādau parvata ādi sthiti ādeḥ sarvadā vidyamāna tvāt bhūta bhaviṣyat abhāvāt tad pratidvaṃdvi rūpasya vartamānasya api abhāvaḥ iti laṇ na prāpnoti iti āśaṅkya kālatra vartinām rājñām yāḥ kriyāḥ paripālana ādi rūpāḥ bhūta ādi bhedena bhinnāḥ tāḥ parvata ādi sthiti ādeḥ bhedikāḥ

original: tataśca saṃprati ye rājānastatkriyābhedena bhinnāyāḥ parvatādisthitervartamānatvaṃ, evaṃ ca kṛtvā bhṛtabhaviṣyatkālo'pyupapadyate-tasthuḥ parvatā naladuṣyantādikāle, sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kalkiviṣṇukāle, ityevaṃrītyā yathā parvatādisthityādau bhūtatvādikaṃ sādhitaṃ tadvattamaādisattāyāṃ bhūtatvaṃ sādhanīyamiti|
analyzed: tatas ca saṃprati ye rājānaḥ tad kriyā bhedena bhinnāyāḥ parvata ādi sthiteḥ vartamāna tvam evam ca kṛtvā bhṛta bhaviṣyat kālaḥ upi upapadyate tasthuḥ parvatāḥ nala duṣyanta ādi kāle sthāsyanti parvatāḥ kalki viṣṇu kāle iti evaṃrītyā yathā parvata ādi sthiti ādau bhūta tva ādikam sādhitam tadvat tamaḥ ādi sattāyām bhūta tvam sādhanīyam iti

original: nanu vartamānatvādīnāṃ laḍādipratyayadyotyatvamathavā tadvācyatvam? tatra na dvitīyaḥ| vartamānatvādīnāṃ laḍādipratyayavācyatve hi sati kartrādīnāmarthānāṃ lakārāntare (loṭ‌liṅādau)caritārthānāṃ vartamānatvādayo'rthā bādhakā bhaveyuḥ| viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bādhāt| tataśca laḍādīnāṃ kartrādyabhidhāyakatvaṃ na syāt| viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bādhāt|
analyzed: nanu vartamāna tva ādīnām laṭ ādi pratyaya dyotya tvam athavā tad vācya tvam tatra na dvitīyaḥ vartamāna tva ādīnām laḍ ādi pratyaya vācya tve hi sati kartṛ ādīnām arthānām lakāra antare loṭ liṅ ādau caritārthānām vartamāna tva ādayaḥ ṛthāḥ bādhakāḥ bhaveyuḥ viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bādhāt tatas ca laḍ ādīnām kartṛ ādi abhidhāyaka tvam na syāt viśeṣeṇa sāmānyasya bādhāt

original: tataśca laḍādīnāṃ kartrādyabhidhāyakatvaṃ na syāt| tathā ca caitramaitrau pacataḥ, maitrāḥ pacantītyādau karturabhānāttadgatadvitvādyapratītau dvivacanabahuvacane na syātām| śabādayaśca na syuḥ| laḍādervartamānatvādyabhidāyakatvena kartrādyabhidhāyakatvābhāvādyuṣmādādestatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvātpuruṣavyavasthā na syāt|
analyzed: tatas ca laṭ ādīnām kartṛ ādi abhidhāyaka tvam na syāt tathā ca caitra maitrau pacataḥ maitrāḥ pacanti ityādau kartuḥ abhānāt tad gata dvi tva ādi apratītau dvivacana bahuvacane na syātām śap ādayaḥ ca na syuḥ laḍ ādeḥ vartamāna tva ādi abhidāyaka tvena kartṛ ādi abhidhāyaka tva abhāvāt yuṣmāt ādeḥ tad sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāvāt puruṣa vyavasthā na syāt

original: caitraḥ pacatītyatra laṭā karturanabhidhānenānabhihitatvaprayuktā kartari tṛtīyāpattiśca syāditi vartamānatvādīnāṃ laḍādipratyayadyotyatvameva yuktam| dyotakatvaṃ ca svasamabhivyāhṛtapadagataśaktyunnāyakatvama| vartamānatvādīnāṃ laḍādipratyayavācyatve tvitthamupapattiḥ-vartamānatvādibhirarthaiḥ kartrādayo'rthā na bādhyante, parasparaṣirodhābhāvāt|
analyzed: caitraḥ pacati iti atra laṭā kartuḥ anabhidhānena anabhihita tva prayuktā kartari tṛtīyā āpattiḥ ca syāt iti vartamāna tva ādīnām laṭ ādi pratyaya dyotya tvam eva yuktam dyotaka tvam ca sva samabhivyāhṛta pada gata śakti unnāyaka tvam a vartamāna tva ādīnām laḍ ādi pratyaya vācya tve tu ittham upapattiḥ vartamāna tva ādibhiḥ arthaiḥ kartṛ ādayaḥ arthāḥ na bādhyante paraspara virodha abhāvāt

original: śaktatāvacchedakabhedenārthadvayasaṃbhavāt| tathā hi-laḥ karmaṇītyatra `laḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśena sarvalakārāṇāṃ saṃgrahāllaḍādīnāmapi kartrādayo'pyarthā bhaveyuḥ| tathā ca kartrādyarthe śaktatāvacchedakaṃ lakāratvaṃ, vartamānatvādyarthe tu laṭ‌tvādikamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: śakta tā avacchedaka bhedena artha dvaya saṃbhavāt tathā hi laḥ karmaṇi iti atra laḥ iti bahuvacana nirdeśena sarva lakārāṇām saṃgrahāt laṭ ādīnām api kartṛ ādayaḥ api arthāḥ bhaveyuḥ tathā ca kartṛ ādi arthe śakta tā avacchedakam lakāra tvam vartamāna tva ādi arthe tu laṭ tva ādikam iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiṃ ca kartrādyarthe śaktatāvacchedakaṃ lakāratvaṃ, vartamānatvādyarthe tu laṭ‌tvādikamiti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca kartrādayo'pi niravakāśāḥ| na ca liṅādayo'vakāśāḥ| vartamānatvādivadvidhyāderapi liṅagādivācyatvāditi| tadevaṃ pakṣadvayasya bhāṣyārūpaḍhatve'pi vācakatāpakṣe pratyayārthatayā vartamānatvādīnāṃ prādhānyāpattiḥ|
analyzed: kim ca kartṛ ādi arthe śakta tā avacchedakam lakāra tvam vartamāna tva ādi arthe tu laṭ tva ādikam iti bhāvaḥ kim ca kartṛ ādayaḥ api niravakāśāḥ na ca liṅ ādayaḥ upakāśāḥ vartamāna tva ādi vat vidhi ādeḥ api liṅaga ādi vācya tvāt iti tat evam pakṣa dvayasya vācakatā pakṣe pratyaya artha tayā vartamāna tva ādīnām prādhānya āpattiḥ

original: tadarthaṃ prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ' iti nyāyasya tiṅantātiriktatvena saṃkocaḥ kalpanīyaḥ| dyotakatāpakṣe tu dyotyārthasya viśeṣaṇatvaniyamātpratyayavācyaviṣayasya `pratyayārthaḥ pradhānaṃ' iti niyamasya nātrāvatāra iti na niyamasaṃkocaprasaṅga iti lāghavād‌dyotakatāpakṣa eva sādhīyānityāśayenā''ha-taccetyādi| vartamānatvādītyarthaḥ| dyotyata iti|
analyzed: tad artham prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti nyāyasya tiṅanta atirikta tvena saṃkocaḥ kalpanīyaḥ dyotaka tā pakṣe tu dyotya arthasya viśeṣaṇa tva niyamāt pratyaya vācya viṣayasya pratyaya arthaḥ pradhānam iti niyamasya na atra avatāraḥ iti na niyama saṃkoca prasaṅgaḥ iti lāghavāt dyotaka tā pakṣaḥ eva sādhīyān iti āśayena āha tat ca ityādi vartamāna tva ādi iti arthaḥ dyotyate iti

original: laḍādirdyotakaḥ| dyotakatvaṃ ca laḍādisamābhivyāhṛtadhātugataśaktyudbodhakatvam| tacca dhātorvartamānatvādau śaktiṃ vinā na saṃbhavati| evaṃ ca bahūnāṃ dhātūnāṃ tatra śaktikalpanāyāṃ gauravāpātādalpatarapratyayānāmeva vācakatvameva syānna dyotakatvamityāśaṅ‌kyā''ha-kriyāsāmānyeti|
analyzed: laḍ ādiḥ dyotakaḥ dyotaka tvam ca laḍ ādi sama abhivyāhṛta dhātu gata śakti udbodhaka tvam tat ca dhātoḥ vartamāna tva ādau śaktim vinā na saṃbhavati evam ca bahūnām dhātūnām tatra śakti kalpanāyām gaurava āpātāt alpatara pratyayānām eva vācaka tvam eva syāt na dyotaka tvam iti āśaṅkya āha kriyā sāmānya iti

original: kālasya sarvādhāratvātkālasāmānyavṛttikriyāvācakasya dhātorvartamānādikālaviseṣaviśiṣṭe vyāpāre lakṣaṇetyarthaḥ| vaiśiṣṭyaṃ ca vyāpāre, vartamānādikālaniṣṭhādhikaraṇatānirūpitādheyatāsaṃbandhena bodhyam| tātparyagrāhakatveneti| viśiṣṭalakṣaṇāyāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvameva prakṛte laḍāderdyotakatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kālasya sarva ādhāra tvāt kāla sāmānya vṛtti kriyā vācakasya dhātoḥ vartamāna ādi kāla viseṣa viśiṣṭe vyāpāre lakṣaṇā iti arthaḥ vaiśiṣṭyam ca vyāpāre vartamāna ādi kāla niṣṭha adhikaraṇatā nirūpita ādheyatā saṃbandhena bodhyam tātparya grāhaka tvena iti viśiṣṭa lakṣaṇāyām tātparya grāhaka tvam eva prakṛte laṭ ādeḥ dyotakatvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca laḍādyādeśatvena tibādīnaṃ vartamānakālādidyotakatvātpacati, apākṣīdityādau na bhūtakriyāvartamānakriyayoḥ pratītiḥ| vācakatāpakṣamabhyupetyā''ha-anvayeti| yatsattve yatsattvamanvayaḥ| yadabhāve yadabhāvo vyatirekaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca laṭ ādi ādeśa tvena vartamāna kāla ādi dyotaka tvāt pacati apākṣīt ityādau na bhūta kriyā vartamāna kriyayoḥ pratītiḥ vācakatā pakṣam abhyupetya āha anvaya iti yad sattve yat sattvam anvayaḥ yad abhāve yad abhāvaḥ vyatirekaḥ

original: yathā daṇḍasattve ghaṭaniṣpattirdṛśyate, daṇḍābhāve ghaṭaniṣpattirna dṛśyata ityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ ghaṭaṃ prati daṇḍakāraṇatā, evaṃ laḍādisattve vartamānatvādeḥ pratītirjāyate, yathā-pacati, pakṣyati, apākṣīditi| evamanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadrūpaṃ-vartamānatvādirūpaṃ, laḍādivācyamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā daṇḍa sattve ghaṭa niṣpattiḥ dṛśyate daṇḍa abhāve ghaṭa niṣpattiḥ na dṛśyate iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām ghaṭam prati daṇḍa kāraṇatā evam laḍa ādi sattve vartamāna tva ādeḥ pratītiḥ jāyate yathā apacati pakṣyati apākṣīt iti evam anvaya vyatirekābhyām tad rūpam vartamāna tva ādi rūpam laḍa ādi vācyam iti arthaḥ

original: anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vācyavācakabhāvo nirdhāryata iti yāvat| vācako laḍādiḥ| vācakatāvacchedakaṃ laṭ‌tva-liṭ‌vādikaṃ tadapi laḍādyādeśe tibādāvanubhavasiddhameva| anubhavabalādeva ca tallaṭ‌tvādikaṃ tibādyādeśeṣvāropitaṃ bodhyam| ata eva yajetetyatra pratyaye'pyasti aṃśadvayam| ākhyātatvaṃ liṅtvaṃ ca|
analyzed: anvaya vyatirekābhyām vācya vācaka bhāvaḥ nirdhāryate iti yāvat vācakaḥ laṭ ādiḥ vācakatā avacchedakam tat api laṭ ādi ādeśe tip ādau anubhava siddham eva anubhava balāt eva ca tat laṭ tva ādikam tip ādi ādeśeṣu āropitam bodhyam atas eva yajeta iti atra pratyaye pi asti aṃśa dvayam ākhyāta tvam liṅ tvam ca

original: tatra liṅ‌tvāṃśena śābdībāvanocyata iti mīmāṃsāgranthaḥ saṃgacchate| aṃśadvayaṃ śaktatāvacchedakadvayamityarthaḥ| vaiyākaraṇā api-pacyādiṣvasti vācakatāvacchedakadvayam| pacyāditvaṃ dhātutvaṃ ca| tatra dhātutvena sāmānyarūpeṇa pacyādaya utpattyanukūlavyāpārātmikāṃ kriyāmāhuḥ|
analyzed: tatra liṅ tva aṃśena śābdī bāvanā ucyate iti mīmāṃsā granthaḥ saṃgacchate aṃśa dvayam śakta tā avacchedaka dvayam iti arthaḥ vaiyākaraṇāḥ apipaci ādiṣu asti vācakatā avacchedaka dvayam paci ādi tvam dhātu tvam ca tatra dhātu tvena sāmānya rūpeṇa paci ādayaḥ utpatti anukūla vyāpāra ātmikām kriyām āhuḥ

original: pacyāditvaviśeṣarūpeṇa tu viklittyāditattatphalaviśeṣānukalaphūtkārāditattadvyāpāraviśeṣātmikāṃ kriyāmāhuriti vadanti| anyayā-anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vācyavācakabāvānirdhāraṇe vilopāpattiriti| paktetyādāvapi pacertvayāpārāśraye lakṣaṇā| na ca kartari kṛdityādīnāṃ vaiyarathyam|
analyzed: paci ādi tva viśeṣa rūpeṇa tu viklitti ādi tad tad phala viśeṣa anukala phūtkāra ādi tad tad vyāpāra viśeṣa ātmikām kriyām āhuḥ iti vadanti anyayā anvaya vyatirekābhyām vācya vācaka bāva anirdhāraṇe vilopa āpattiḥ iti paktā ityādau api lakṣaṇā na ca kartari kṛt ityādīnām vaiyarathyam

original: dhātostādṛśe'rthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ kartari kṛdityādisūtrāṇāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvenopayogasaṃbhavāt| evaṃ sarvatrāpīti pratyayānāṃ vācakatvaṃ kvāpi na sidhyediti tādṛśokteruccheda eva syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: dhātoḥ tādṛśa ṛthe lakṣaṇāyām kartari kṛt ityādi sūtrāṇām tātparya grāhaka tvena upayoga saṃbhavāt evam sarvatra api iti pratyayānām vācaka tvam kvāpi na sidhyet iti tādṛśa ukteḥ ucchedaḥ eva syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: parokṣe liḍiti sūtrāditi| anadyatane laṅityato'nadyatana iti anuvartate, bhūta ityadhikṛtam| parokṣatvaṃ ca dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇam| parokṣaśabdo'yamatīndriyavācī prasiddhaḥ| vyutpattistu-akṣṇaḥ paraṃ parokṣaṃ, mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| akṣṇo'rśanādityac samāsāntaḥ|
analyzed: parokṣe liṭ iti sūtrāt iti anadyatane laṅ iti atas na adyatanaḥ iti anuvartate bhūtaḥ iti adhikṛtam parokṣa tvam ca dhātvartha viśeṣaṇam parokṣa śabdaḥ yam atīndriya vācī prasiddhaḥ vyutpattiḥ tu akṣṇaḥ param parokṣam mayūra vyaṃsaka ādi tvāt samāsaḥ samāsa antaḥ

original: vṛttiviṣaye cākṣiśabdaḥ sarvendriyavacano, na cakṣuḥparyāyaḥ, anyathendriyāntaravijñātaṃ vastu parokṣamāpadyetetyarthaḥ| tathā ca-adya bhavo'dyatanastadbhinnabūtakālavṛttiryā parokṣā kriyā tadvācakāddhātorliḍiti sūtrārthaḥ| evaṃ caitanmate bhūtānadyatanakāladyotako liṭ| pakṣāntare tu laḍ‌vattadvācakaḥ|
analyzed: vṛtti viṣaye ca akṣi śabdaḥ sarva indriya vacanaḥ na cakṣuḥ paryāyaḥ anyathā indriya antara vijñātam vastu parokṣam āpadyeta iti arthaḥ tathā ca adya bhava udyatanaḥ tad bhinna būta kāla vṛttiḥ yā parokṣā kriyā tad vācakāt dhātoḥ liṭ iti sūtra arthaḥ evam ca etad mate bhūta anadyatana kāla dyotakaḥ liṭ pakṣa antare tu laṭ vat tad vācakaḥ

original: evaṃ sarvalakāreṣu dyotakatvaṃ vācakatvaṃ ca bodhyam| kālaśūnyeṣu liṅādiṣu tu dyotakatvaṃ vācakatvaṃ ca mūla eva spaṣṭam| adyatanānadyatanavibhāgastu-atītāyā rātreḥ paścārdhenā''gāminyāḥ pūrvārdhena ca sahito divaso'dyatanastadbhinnonadyatana ityekaḥ prakāraḥ|
analyzed: evam sarva lakāreṣu dyotaka tvam vācaka tvam ca bodhyam kāla śūnyeṣu liṅ ādiṣu tu dyotaka tvam vācaka tvam ca mūle eva spaṣṭam adyatana anadyatana vibhāgaḥ tu atītāyāḥ rātreḥ paśca ardhena āgāminyāḥ pūrva ardhena ca sahitaḥ divasa udyatanaḥ tad bhinnaḥ ūnadyatanaḥ iti ekaḥ prakāraḥ

original: atītāyā rātrerantyatṛtīyabhāgenā''gāminyā ādyatṛtīyabhāgadvayena ca sahito divaso'dyatanastadbhinno'nadyatana iti dvitīyaḥ| udayādudayaṃ yāvadadyatanastādbhinno'nadyatana iti tṛtīyaḥ| eṣvanyatamāṅgīkāre deśācārādvyavasthā| parokṣatvaṃ tu varṣaśatavṛttatvamityeke| varṣasahasravṛttatvamityapare| dvyahavṛttatvaṃ tryahavṛttatvaṃ cetyanye|
analyzed: atītāyāḥ rātreḥ antya tṛtīya bhāgena āgāminyāḥ ādya tṛtīya bhāga dvayena ca sahitaḥ divasa udyatanaḥ tad bhinnaḥ ūna adyatanaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ udayāt udayam yāvat adyatanaḥ tād bhinnaḥ ūna adyatanaḥ iti tṛtīyaḥ eṣu anyatama aṅgīkāre deśa ācārāt vyavasthā parokṣa tvam tu varṣa śata vṛtta tvam iti eke varṣa sahasra vṛtta tvam iti apare dvi aha vṛtta tvam tri aha vṛtta tvam ca iti anye

original: kuḍyakaṭādyantaritatvamitītare| ete pakṣā bhāṣye sthitāḥ| tatra prayokturindriyāgocaratvaṃ parokṣatvamityeva sarvasaṃmataṃ, sarvatrendriyāgocaratvasyāvyabhicaritvāditi bodyam| anadyatane, bhūte, parokṣe, iti viśeṣaṇatrayasya krameṇa vyāvartyamāha-tenādyatana ityādinā| adya prātareva jagāmeti na bhavati|
analyzed: kuḍya kaṭa ādi antarita tvam iti itare ete pakṣāḥ bhāṣye sthitāḥ tatra prayoktuḥ indriya agocara tvam parokṣa tvam iti eva sarva saṃmatam sarvatra indriya agocara tvasya avyabhicari tvāt iti bodyam anadyatane bhūte parokṣe iti viśeṣaṇa trayasya krameṇa vyāvartyam āha tena adyatanaḥ ityādinā adya prātar eva jagāma iti na bhavati

original: atra gamanakriyāyā bhūtakālavṛttitve'pi prayokturindriyāgocaratve'pi ca bhūtakālasyādyatanatvāt| śvo jagāmeti na liṭ| atra gamanakriyāyā anadyatanatve'pi bhaviṣyatkālavṛttitvena bhūtakālavṛttitvābhāvāt| adrākṣamahaṃ gate'hriḥ pātareva sa jagameti liṇna prayujyate| atra gamanakriyāyā anadyatanabhūtakālavṛttitve'pi pratyakṣatvena parokṣatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: atra gamana kriyāyāḥ bhūta kāla vṛtti tve pi prayoktuḥ indriya agocara tve pi ca bhūta kālasya adyatana tvāt śvas jagāma iti na liṭ atra gamana kriyāyāḥ anadyatana tve pi bhaviṣyat kāla vṛtti tvena bhūta kāla vṛtti tva abhāvāt adrākṣam aham gata ihriḥ pātar eva sa jagama iti liṭ na prayujyate atra gamana kriyāyāḥ anadyatana bhūta kāla vṛtti tve pi pratyakṣa tvena parokṣa tva abhāvāt

original: parokṣatvaṃ lakṣayati-sākṣātkaromītyādi| sākṣātkaromītyetādṛśaśabdābhilapyamānaviṣayatāśāli yajjñānaṃ tādṛśajñānaviṣayatvābhāvavattvam| jñānaṃ ca prayoktṛniṣṭhatvena vivakṣitam| tataśca prayokturindriyāgocaratvaṃ parokṣatvamityeva phalitam| parokṣa iti dhātvarthaviśeṣaṇamityuktaṃ tatra śaṅkate-na cetyādi| kriyā nāmeti|
analyzed: parokṣatvam lakṣayati sākṣātkaromi ityādi sākṣātkaromi iti etādṛśa śabda abhilapyamāna viṣayatā śāli yat jñānam tādṛśa jñāna viṣayatva abhāvavat tvam jñānam ca prayoktṛ niṣṭhatvena vivakṣitam tatas ca prayoktuḥ indriya agocara tvam parokṣatvam iti eva phalitam parokṣaḥ iti dhātvartha viśeṣaṇam iti uktam tatra śaṅkatena ca ityādi kriyā nāma iti

original: sādhyatvenābhidhīyamāno guṇabhūtāvayavaḥ pūrvāparībhūtānekavyāpārāṇāmekaphalajanakatvaviṣayaikabuddhyā viṣayīkṛtaḥ samūhaḥ kriyetyucyate tāntrikaiḥ| iyamiti| sā ceyaṃ kriyā yataḥ pūrvāparībhūtanekavyāpārasamūharūpā'to'tyantāparadṛṣṭā-pareṇa pratyakṣapramāṇenātyantamadṛṣṭā pratyakṣapramāmajanyajñānāviṣayetyarthaḥ| piṇḍībhūteti|
