original: avayavānāmāśutaravināśitvena piṇḍībhāvasyaivābhāvena nidarśayituṃ na śakyeti bhāṣyeṇa tasyā indriyāgocaratvābhidhānātparokṣa iti tadviseṣaṇaṃ vyarthamiti śaṅkāśayaḥ| avyāvartakamiti| yadi tu kasyāścitkriyāyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ syāttārhi tādṛśapratyakṣaviṣayakriyāyāṃ liḍvāraṇāya parokṣa iti viśeṣamaṃ sārthakaṃ syāt|
analyzed: avayavānām āśutara vināśi tvena piṇḍībhāvasya eva abhāvena nidarśayitum na śakyā iti bhāṣyeṇa tasyāḥ indriya agocara tva abhidhānāt parokṣaḥ iti tat viseṣaṇam vyartham iti śaṅkā āśayaḥ avyāvartakam iti yadi tu kasyāścid kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣam syāt tārhi tādṛśa pratyakṣa viṣaya kriyāyām liṭ vāraṇāya parokṣaḥ iti sārthakam syāt

original: sarvasyā api kriyāyāḥ parokṣatve tu vyāvartyābhāvāttadakiṃcitkaramiti bhāvaḥ| samādhatte-piṇḍībhūtāyā ityādinā| avayavānāṃ kṣaṇikatvena tanmelanātyantāsaṃbhavātpiṇḍasyaivābhāvātpiṇḍībhūtāyā nidarśayitumaśakyatve'pi avayaśaḥ ekaikāvayavasya sākṣātkaromītyatādṛśalaukikapratītiviṣayatvasaṃbhavādavayavadvārā vaktuḥ pratyakṣaviṣayakriyāyāṃ liḍvāraṇāya
analyzed: sarvasyāḥ api kriyāyāḥ parokṣa tve tu vyāvartya abhāvāt tat akiṃcitkaram iti bhāvaḥ samādhatte piṇḍībhūtāyāḥ ityādinā avayavānām kṣaṇikatvena tad melana atyanta asaṃbhavāt piṇḍasya eva abhāvāt piṇḍībhūtāyāḥ nidarśayitum aśakyatve pi ekaika avayavasya sākṣātkaromi iti atādṛśa laukika pratīti viṣayatva saṃbhavāt avayava dvārā vaktuḥ pratyakṣa viṣaya kriyāyām liṭ vāraṇāya

original: tatsārthakamiti bhāvaḥ| avayavānāṃ pratyakṣatve sādhakamāha-anyatheti| uktavaiparītye, avayavānāmapi pratyakṣatvābhāva ityarthaḥ| paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra mṛgakartṛkadhāvanakriyāyā darśanākriyānirūpitakarmatvaṃ na syāt| tathā ca tādṛśaprayoge bhāṣyasaṃmataikavākyatvānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu kṣaṇāvacchinnā avayavā api apratyakṣā eva|
analyzed: tat sārthakam iti bhāvaḥ avayavānām pratyakṣa tve sādhakam āha anyathā iti ukta vaiparītye avayavānām api pratyakṣa tva abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra mṛga kartṛka dhāvana kriyāyāḥ darśana akriyā nirūpita karmatvam na syāt tathā ca tādṛśa prayoge bhāṣya saṃmata ekavākyatva anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu kṣaṇa avacchinnāḥ avayavāḥ api apratyakṣāḥ eva

original: vastusaukṣmyavatsūkṣmakālāvacchinnatvasyāpi pratyakṣe pratibandhakatvāvaśyakatvena pratyakṣāsaṃbhavāt| atyantāparadṛṣṭeti bhāṣyasyāpi samūharūpeṇāvayavarūpeṇa ca pratyakṣapramāṇenātyantamadṛṣṭetyevārthaḥ| tasmādādityagativaduttaradeśasaṃyogādirūpaphalānumaiyaiva sarvā kriyā|
analyzed: vastu saukṣmya vat sūkṣma kāla avacchinna tvasya api pratyakṣe pratibandhaka tva āvaśyaka tvena pratyakṣa asaṃbhavāt atyanta apara dṛṣṭā iti bhāṣyasya api samūha rūpeṇa avayava rūpeṇa ca pratyakṣa pramāṇena atyantam adṛṣṭā iti eva arthaḥ tasmāt āditya gati vat uttara deśa saṃyoga ādi rūpa phala anumaiyā eva sarvā kriyā

original: paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra dṛśerjñānasāmānyārthakratvāṅgīkāreṇa kṣipraṃ kṣipraṃ deśāntarasaṃyogadarśanena ca dhāvanamanumīyata ityanumitiviṣayatvameva tatra dhāvanasyeti laghumañjūṣāyāṃ nāgeśabhaṭṭairuktatvāttadanusāreṇa parokṣapadasārthakyaṃ pradarśayati-vyāpārāviṣṭānāmiti|
analyzed: paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra dṛśeḥ jñāna sāmānya artha kratu āṅgīkāreṇa kṣipram kṣipram deśa antara saṃyoga darśanena ca dhāvanam anumīyate iti anumiti viṣaya tvam eva tatra dhāvanasya iti laghumañjūṣāyām nāgeśa bhaṭṭaiḥ ukta tvāt tad anusāreṇa parokṣa pada sārthakyam pradarśayati vyāpāra āviṣṭānām iti

original: vyāpāraviśiṣṭānāṃ kriyānukūlasādhanānāmevātra pārokṣyaṃ vivikṣitamityasya vyāpāraviśiṣṭe kārake parokṣa iti viśeṣaṇaṃ, na tu dhātvarthakriyāyāṃ, tasyā atīndriyatvena paramāṇoriva bahirindriyajanyapratyakṣāyogyatvāt|
analyzed: vyāpāra viśiṣṭānām kriyā anukūla sādhanānām eva atra pārokṣyam vivikṣitam iti asya vyāpāra viśiṣṭe kārake parokṣaḥ iti viśeṣaṇam na tu dhātvartha kriyāyām tasyāḥ atīndriya tvena paramāṇoḥ iva bahis indriya janya pratyakṣa ayogya tvāt

original: tataśca anadyatanabhūtakāliko yo vyāpārastādṛśavyāpāraviśiṣṭaḥ parokṣaśca yo devadattādistanniṣṭhakriyāvācakād‌dhātorliḍiti parokṣe liḍiti sūtrārthaḥ| tena pacanādikriyānāviṣṭasya caitrasya pratyakṣatve'pi caitraḥ papāceti prayonasya nānupapattiḥ| pacanādivyāpāraviṣṭasya parokṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ| noktadoṣa iti|
analyzed: tatas ca anadyatana bhūta kālikaḥ yaḥ vyāpāraḥ tādṛśa vyāpāra viśiṣṭaḥ parokṣaḥ ca yaḥ devadatta ādiḥ tad niṣṭha kriyā vācakāt dhātoḥ liṭ iti parokṣe liṭ iti sūtra arthaḥ tena pacana ādi kriyā anāviṣṭasya caitrasya pratyakṣa tve api caitraḥ papāca iti na anupapattiḥ pacana ādi vyāpāra viṣṭasya parokṣa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ na ukta doṣaḥ iti

original: prayokturvyāpārāviṣṭasādhanasya devadattādeḥ pratyakṣatvadāśāyāṃ `ayaṃ papāca' iti prayogavāraṇārthatayā parokṣapadasārthakye satiḥ avyāvartakatvarūpo doṣo netyarthaḥ| vyāpārāviṣṭānāmityasya prayojanamāha-ayaṃ papāceti| vyāpārāviṣṭasya pratyakṣatva eva liṇneṣyate, na tu vyāpārānāviṣṭasya pratyakṣatva iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: prayoktuḥ vyāpāra āviṣṭa sādhanasya devadatta ādeḥ pratyakṣa tva dāśāyām ayam papāca iti prayoga vāraṇa arthatayā parokṣa pada sārthakye satiḥ avyāvartaka tva rūpaḥ doṣaḥ na iti arthaḥ vyāpāra āviṣṭānām iti asya prayojanam āha ayam papāca iti vyāpāra āviṣṭasya pratyakṣa tve eva liṅ na iṣyate na tu vyāpāra anāviṣṭasya pratyakṣa tve iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca prayoktuḥ pratyakṣāviṣayakartṛkasthala eva caitraḥ papāceti liṭ‌prayogo bhavati| yadā hi prayoktā'nadyatanabhūtakālikagamanādikriyākartāraṃ sajjīkṛtāśvādikaṃ baddhaparikaraṃ gamanodyataṃ sākṣātkṛtavāṃstadā'yaṃ jagāmeti| prayogo na bhavati vyāpārāviṣṭasya dhaddhaparikarādikasya gantuḥ parokṣatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: evam ca prayoktuḥ pratyakṣa aviṣaya kartṛka sthale eva caitraḥ papāca iti liṭ prayogaḥ bhavati yadā hi prayoktā anadyatana bhūta kālika gamana ādi kriyā kartāram sajjīkṛta aśva ādikam baddha parikaram gamana udyatam sākṣātkṛtavān tadā ayam jagāma iti prayogaḥ na bhavati vyāpāra āviṣṭasya gantuḥ parokṣa tva abhāvāt

original: yadā tu tādṛśagamanādikriyākartāraṃ kriyānāviṣṭatvena sākṣātkaroti tadā'yaṃ jagāmeti liḍ bhavati| kriyāviṣṭasya gantuḥ parokṣatvāditi tātparyam|
analyzed: yadā tu tādṛśa gamana ādi kriyā kartāram kriyā anāviṣṭa tvena sākṣātkaroti tadā ayam jagāma iti liṭ bhavati kriyā āviṣṭasya gantuḥ parokṣa tvāt iti tātparyam

original: yadyapi kriyāya apratyayatve, viśiṣṭajñāne viśeṣaṇajñānasya kāraṇatvena tatra viśeṣaṇabhūtakriyāyāḥ pratyakṣatvābhāvena tādṛśakriyāviśiṣṭasādhanapratyakṣaṃ durupapādameva, tathā ca tadvaiyarthyaṃ tadavasthameva tathā'pi phūtkārasītkārādikriyāvaiśiṣṭyasamaye sādhanasamaye sādhanaparokṣatvasya vivakṣitatvānnoktadoṣa iti dhyeyam|
analyzed: yadi api apratyaya tve viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣaṇa jñānasya kāraṇa tvena tatra viśeṣaṇa bhūta kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣa tva abhāvena tādṛśa kriyā viśiṣṭa sādhana pratyakṣam durupapādam eva tathā ca tad vaiyarthyam tad avastham eva tathā api phūtkāra sītkāra ādi kriyā vaiśiṣṭya samaye sādhana samaye sādhana parokṣa tvasya vivakṣita tvāt na ukta doṣaḥ iti dhyeyam

original: yatra sādhanaśaktayāśrayabhūtaṃ phūtkārasītkārādiviśiṣṭaṃ saṃrabdharūpaṃ dravyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatra dhātvartha eva pratyakṣābhimāno laukikānāṃ, abhimāno mithyājñānaṃ tadvya vṛttaye parokṣagrahaṇamiti yāvat| avedaṃ bodhyam-prācīnamate parokṣatvaṃ dhātvarthe viśeṣaṇaṃ, navīnamate tu dhātvarthasādhane tadviśeṣaṇam| tatra prathamamatamevocitam|
analyzed: yatra sādhana śaktayā āśraya bhūtam phūtkāra sītkāra ādi viśiṣṭam saṃrabdha rūpam dravyam pratyakṣam tatra dhātvarthe eva pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ laukikānām abhimānaḥ mithyājñānam tad vya vṛttaye parokṣa grahaṇam iti yāvat bodhyam prācīna mate parokṣa tvam dhātvarthe viśeṣaṇam navīna mate tu dhātvartha sādhane tat viśeṣaṇam tatra prathama matam eva ucitam

original: yato dhātorityadhikārasya dhātvarthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ sva(dhātu)vācyatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, sādhanalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu sva(dhātu)vācyasādhanatvaṃ saṃbandha iti gauravāt| na ca sarvā kriyā parokṣetyavyāvartakaṃ tat| samudāyasya parokṣatve'pi pratyekamavayavasyāparokṣatvāt|
analyzed: yatas dhātoḥ iti adhikārasya dhātvarthe lakṣaṇāyām sva dhātu vācya tvam saṃbandhaḥ sādhana lakṣaṇāyām tu sva dhātu vācya sādhana tvam saṃbandhaḥ iti gauravāt na ca sarvā kriyā parokṣā iti avyāvartakam tat samudāyasya parokṣa tve pi pratyekam avayavasya aparokṣa tvāt

original: ata eva `piṇḍībhūtā na nidarśayituṃ śakyā iti bhāṣye viśiṣya piṇḍībhūtāyā eva nirdarśayitumaśaktyatvaṃ pradarśitam| ataeva paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra dhāvanākriyāyā eva paśyetyatra karmatvaṃ sarvasiddhameva| na ca pratyekaṃ na kriyātvamiti vācyam| tāvatā'pi ghātvarthatvākṣateḥ kiṃ ca phalasyāpi svajanakavyāpāragatapaurvāparyāropeṇa kriyātvam|
analyzed: atas eva piṇḍībhūtā na nidarśayitum śakyāḥ iti bhāṣye viśiṣya piṇḍībhūtāyāḥ eva nirdarśayitum aśakti atvam pradarśitam ataeva paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra dhāvanā kriyāyāḥ eva paśya iti atra karmatvam sarva siddham eva na ca pratyekam na kriyā tvam iti vācyam tāvatā api ghātvartha tva akṣateḥ kim ca phalasya api sva janaka vyāpāra gata paurvāparya āropeṇa kriyā tvam

original: ata eva cyate taṇḍulaḥ svayamevetyādau phalamātravācakatve tasya dhātusaṃjñāsiddhiḥ| parokṣatvamapi bhāpyoktaṃ kriyāyāṃ saṃgacchata iti pratibhāti iti| nanvevaṃ kriyāyāḥ kriyāviṣṭasādhanasya vā pratyakṣatve liḍanupapanna ityāśaṅkate-kathaṃ tarhīti| udayanaḥ kiraṇāvalīṃ vyātene ityatretyarthaḥ| vitastare ityarthaḥ| tanu vistāra iti smaraṇāt|
analyzed: atas eva cyate taṇḍulaḥ svayam eva ityādau phala mātra vācaka tve tasya dhātu saṃjñā siddhiḥ parokṣatvam api bhāpya uktam kriyāyām saṃgacchate iti pratibhāti iti nanu evam kriyāyāḥ kriyā viṣṭa sādhanasya vā pratyakṣa tve liṭ anupapannaḥ iti āśaṅkate katham tarhi iti udayanaḥ kiraṇāvalīm vyātene iti atra iti arthaḥ vitastare iti arthaḥ tanu vistāre iti smaraṇāt

original: kathaṃtve hetumāha-svakriyāyā iti| udayanakartṛkakriyāyaḥ prayokturudayanasyāvaśyaṃ pratyakṣatvena vistārakriyāyāḥ pārokṣyābhāvālliḍanupapanna ityarthaḥ| sādhanapārokṣyapakṣe kriyāviṣṭasādhanasya svapratyakṣatvāditi heturvodhyaḥ|
analyzed: kathaṃtve hetum āha sva kriyāyāḥ iti prayoktuḥ udayanasya avaśyam pratyakṣa tvena vistāra kriyāyāḥ pārokṣya abhāvāt liṭ anupapannaḥ iti arthaḥ sādhana pārokṣya pakṣe kriyā āviṣṭa sādhanasya sva pratyakṣa tvāt iti hetuḥ vodhyaḥ

original: nanu svavyāpārasyāpi vartamānadaśāyāṃ viṣayāntarāsaktirūpavyāsaṅgādinā svayamapratisaṃdhāne'pi tataḥ karyeṇānumitau bhavatyeva liṭ| yathā-bahu jagada purastāttasya mattā kilāham' iti|

original: atra yathā harṣātirekādinā manaso'saṃnihitatvātkriyāpārokṣyaṃ tadvatprakṛte'pi viṣayāntarasaṃcārarūpavyāsahgādinā udayanakartṛkavyāpārasya vyāpāraviśiṣṭasādhanasya codayanapratyakṣaviṣayatvābhāvarūpaparokṣatvasaṃbhavānna liṭo'saṃgatiriti cenna|

original: nuruktodāharaṇe'bhihatatvaprayuktatṛtīyādivirahaśca na sidhyediti vidhyādīnāṃ liṅ‌dyotyatvameva yuktam| vācyatve tvitthamupapattiḥ-vidhyādibhiḥ kartrādayo na bādhyante| parasparavirodhābhāvāt| śaktatāvacchedakabhedenārthadvayasyāpi saṃbhavāt|
analyzed: nurukta udāharaṇa ibhi hata tva prayukta tṛtīya ādi virahaḥ ca na sidhyet iti vidhi ādīnām liṅ dyotya tvam eva yuktam vācyatve tu ittham upapattiḥ vidhi ādibhiḥ kartṛ ādayaḥ na bādhyante paraspara virodha abhāvāt śakta tā avacchedaka bhedena artha dvayasya api saṃbhavāt

original: tathā hi-laḥ karmaṇītyatra `laḥ' iti bahuvacananirdeśena sarvalakārāṇāṃ saṃgrahālliṅo'pi kartrādayo'pyarthāḥ syureva| tathā ca kartrādyarthe śaktatāvacchedakaṃ lakāratvaṃ, vidhyādyarthe tu liṅ‌tvamiti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca kartrādayo'pi niravakāśā eva| na ca laḍādayo'vakāśāḥ| vidhyādivadvartamānatvāderapi laḍādivācyatvāditi jñeyam|
analyzed: tathā hi laḥ karmaṇi iti atra laḥ iti bahuvacana nirdeśena sarva lakārāṇām saṃgrahān liṅaḥ upi kartṛ ādayaḥ api arthāḥ syuḥ eva tathā ca kartṛ ādi arthe śakta tā avacchedakam lakāra tvam vidhi ādi arthe tu liṅ tvam iti bhāvaḥ kim ca kartṛ ādayaḥ api niravakāśāḥ eva na ca vidhi ādi vat vartamānatva ādeḥ api laḍ ādi vācyatvāt iti jñeyam

original: athāpi bhavedityādau dhātvarthaṃ prati vidhyādeḥ pratyayārthatayā viśeṣyatvaṃ syāt| tathā caikacaitrābhinnāśrayakaṃ vidhiviṣayo bhavanamiti dhātvarthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhavarmanamayuktaṃ syāt| pratyayārthatayā viśeṣyatvāpādanasya kartrādāvapi tulyatvāt|
analyzed: atha api bhavet ityādau dhātvartham prati vidhi ādeḥ pratyaya artha tayā viśeṣya tvam syāt tathā ca eka caitra abhinna āśrayakam vidhi viṣayaḥ bhavanam iti dhātvartha mukhya viśeṣyaka śābdabodha varmanam ayuktam syāt pratyaya artha tayā viśeṣya tva āpādanasya kartṛ ādau api tulya tvāt

original: pratyayārthaḥ pradhānaṃ, prakṛtyartho viśeṣaṇamitpautsargikamākhyāte tyajyate, bāvapradhānamākhyātamiti bhāṣyānurodhāditi cettarhi tata eva na doṣa ityavadheyam| vidhyādiśabdārthānnirvakti-tatreti| teṣāṃ vidhyādīnāṃ madhyaityarthaḥ| preraṇamiti| pravartanamityarthaḥ| pravartataṃ ca pravṛttyanukūlo vyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: pratyaya arthaḥ pradhānam prakṛti arthaḥ viśeṣaṇam iti autsargikam ākhyāte tyajyate bāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti bhāṣya anurodhāt iti ced tarhi tatas eva na doṣaḥ iti avadheyam vidhi ādi śabda arthān nirvakti tatra iti teṣām vidhi ādīnām madhyā eti arthaḥ preraṇam iti pravartanam iti arthaḥ ca pravṛtti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ

original: yathā nikṛṣṭasya bhṛtyādeḥ prabhuṇā svābhilaṣite pravartanam| ithamevā''jñā| apravṛttaprayojyasya tadabhilaṣitājñātopāyapravartanamupadeśaḥ| yathā svargakāmo yajetetyādiḥ| yathā vā'nena pathā yāhītyāptavacaḥ| so'pi vidhireva| ādye svargo'bhilaṣitaḥ|
analyzed: yathā nikṛṣṭasya bhṛtya ādeḥ prabhuṇā sva abhilaṣite pravartanam itham eva ājñā apravṛtta prayojyasya tad abhilaṣita ajñāta upāya pravartanam upadeśaḥ yathā svarga kāmaḥ yajeta ityādiḥ yathā vā anena pathā yāhi iti āpta vacaḥ saḥ api vidhiḥ eva ādye svargaḥ abhilaṣitaḥ

original: atrāpravṛttasya prayojyasya devadattāderyadabhilaṣitaṃ svargaḥ, tatprātiviṣaye yo'jñātopāyaḥ-yāgaḥ, tādṛśe svargaprāptyupāyabhūte yāge pravartanaṃ devadattāderanena vākyena kriyata ityayamapi vidhirityarthaḥ| antye kāśyādiprāptirabilaṣitamityādyūhyam| bhṛtyādernikṛṣṭasyeti| svasamānottamayoḥ pravartanāyāmativyāptivāraṇāya nikṛṣṭatvoktiḥ|
analyzed: atra apravṛttasya prayojyasya devadatta ādeḥ yat abhilaṣitam svargaḥ tad prātiviṣaye yaḥ jñāta upāyaḥ yāgaḥ tādṛśe svarga prāpti upāya bhūte yāge pravartanam devadatta ādeḥ anena vākyena kriyate iti ayam api vidhiḥ iti arthaḥ antye kāśi ādi prāptiḥ abilaṣitam ityādi ūhyam bhṛtya ādeḥ nikṛṣṭasya iti sva samāna uttamayoḥ pravartanāyām ativyāpti vāraṇāya nikṛṣṭa tva uktiḥ

original: evaṃ ca na tatra vidhitvamiti bhāvaḥ| ājñāpyatvena nikṛṣṭatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bodayituṃ-bhṛtyāderiti| tena svāpekṣayā'dhikavayaskabhṛtyapreraṇāyā vidhitvameva| niyogakaraṇamiti| āvaśyake śrāddhabhojanādau svabhilaṣite dauhitrādeḥ pravartanamityarthaḥ| āmantraṇamiti| svāmilaṣite kāmacāreṇa pravadauhitrādeḥ pravartanamityarthaḥ| āmantraṇamiti|
analyzed: evam ca na tatra vidhi tvam iti bhāvaḥ ājñāpya tvena nikṛṣṭa tvam vivakṣitam iti bodayitum bhṛtya ādeḥ iti tena sva apekṣayā adhika vayaska bhṛtya preraṇāyāḥ vidhi tvam eva niyoga karaṇam iti āvaśyake śrāddha bhojana ādau su abhilaṣite dauhitra ādeḥ pravartanam iti arthaḥ āmantraṇam iti svāmi laṣite kāmacāreṇa pravartanam iti arthaḥ āmantraṇam iti

original: svāmilaṣite kāmacārema pravartyapravartanamityarthaḥ| kāmacāraśca pravartyasyaiva| eṣaiva ca kāmacārānujñā| pravṛttasya prayojyasya nivṛttipratibandhena taddhite pravartikoktiranujñā| ārabdhaṃ kurvevetyevaṃrūpā| tathā kuruṣva yathāhitamityapyanujñaiva| etatsarvopalakṣaṇamāmantraṇam| adhīṣṭa iti| satkārapūrvaka iti|
analyzed: svāmi laṣite pravartya pravartanam iti arthaḥ kāmacāraḥ ca pravartyasya eva eṣā eva ca kāmacāra anujñā pravṛttasya prayojyasya nivṛtti pratibandhena taddhite pravartikā uktiḥ anujñā ārabdham kuru eva iti evaṃrūpā tathā kuruṣva yathāhitam iti api anujñā eva etat sarva upalakṣaṇam āmantraṇam adhīṣṭaḥ iti satkāra pūrvakaḥ iti

original: satkṛtya kvacanocite mahati karmaṇi pravartanamityarthaḥ| yathā-pāṇavakamadhyapayeti| eṣaivābhyarthanā| prārthanā tu svābhilaṣitavastudānādipravartikoktiḥ| saṃpraśnaḥ-saṃpradhāraṇamiti| ekatarakoṭikanirṇayecchā| yathā-kiṃ bho vedayadhīyīyota tarkamiti| etaccatuṣṭayeti|
analyzed: satkṛtya kvacana ucite mahati karmaṇi pravartanam iti arthaḥ yathā pāṇavakam adhyapayā iti eṣā eva abhyarthanā prārthanā tu sva abhilaṣita vastu dāna ādi pravartikā uktiḥ saṃpraśnaḥ saṃpradhāraṇam iti ekatara koṭika nirṇaya icchā yathā kim bho tarkam iti etad catuṣṭaya iti

original: vidhyādyadhīṣṭānteṣu caturṣvanusyūtamanugataṃ yatpravartanātvaṃ pravartanāgataṃ sāmānyaṃ tadrūpeṇava caturṇāṃ vācyatā svīkartavyā śakyatāvacchedakatve lāghavāt, na tu vidhitvāditattadviśeṣarūpeṇa, śakyatāvacchedakatve gauravāt|
analyzed: vidhi ādi adhīṣṭa anteṣu caturṣu anusyūtam anugatam yat pravartanā tvam pravartanā gatam sāmānyam caturṇām vācya tā svīkartavyā śakya tā avacchedaka tve lāghavāt na tu vidhi tva ādi tad tad viśeṣa rūpeṇa śakya tā avacchedaka tve gauravāt

original: yajetetyādividhivākyādvidhyādīnāṃ bodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatve'pi tattadviśeṣarūpeṇa vācyatāyāṃ tattadrūpasyanekatvena śakyatāvacchedakānekatvasya durvāratayā gauravātpravartanātvena vācyatāyāṃ pravartanātvasyaikatvena tasya śakyatāvacchedakatvakalpane lāghavaṃ bhavatīti pravartanātvenaiva vidhyādīnāṃ vācyatociteti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yajeta ityādi vidhi vākyāt vidhi ādīnām bodhasya sarva anubhava siddha tve pi tad tad viśeṣa rūpeṇa vācyatāyām tad tad rūpasi aneka tvena śakyatā avacchedaka aneka tvasya durvāra tayā gauravāt pravartanā tvena vācyatāyām pravartanā tvasya eka tvena tasya śakyatā avacchedaka tva kalpane lāghavam bhavati iti pravartanā tvena eva vidhi ādīnām vācyatā ucitā iti bhāvaḥ

original: avārthe vākyapadīyānukūlyaṃ darśayitumāha-uktaṃ ceti| harikārikāyāmityarthaḥ| pravartanārūpamiti| pravartanāyā rūpaṃ pravartanātvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: vākyapadīya ānukūlyam darśayitum āha uktam ca iti harikārikāyām iti arthaḥ pravartanā rūpam iti pravartanāyāḥ rūpam pravartanā tvam iti arthaḥ

original: tatpravartanātvaṃ vidhyādiṣu caturṣu anugatamastītyatastatraiva pravartanātvavatyeva liṅ vidhātavyaḥ, ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena dharmamātre śaktiriti mate pravartanātva eva liṅa vidhātavya iti yathāśrutameva sādhu| kiṃ bhedasyeti| tattadviśeṣarūpeṇa pārthakyādbhedavivakṣayā kiṃ prayojanaṃ na kimapītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tad pravartanā tvam vidhi ādiṣu caturṣu anugatam asti iti atas tatra eva pravartanā tvavati eva liṅ vidhātavyaḥ ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāyena dharma mātre śaktiḥ iti mate pravartanā tve eva liṅ vidhātavyaḥ iti yathāśrutam eva sādhu kim bhedasya iti tat tat viśeṣa rūpeṇa pārthakyāt bheda vivakṣayā kim prayojanam na kim api iti arthaḥ

original: pratyuta bhedavivakṣā gauravagrasteti bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ tarhi sūtrakṛtā caturṇāṃ pṛthagupādānaṃ kimati kṛtaṃ tadāśayamāha-nyāyavyutpādaneti| nyāyaḥ-vidhyāditattatpadapravṛttinimittaviśeṣaḥ, tadavagamārthamityarthaḥ| pravartanāyā bhedabodhanāyeti yāvat| nanu lokavyutpattyaiva tadavagamo bhavedityata āha-prapañcārthamiti|
analyzed: pratyuta bheda vivakṣā gaurava grastā iti bhāvaḥ nanu evam tarhi sūtrakṛtā caturṇām pṛthak upādānam kim ati kṛtam tad āśayam āha nyāya vyutpādanā iti nyāyaḥ vidhi ādi tad tad pada pravṛtti nimitta viśeṣaḥ tad avagama artham iti arthaḥ pravartanāyāḥ bheda bodhanāya iti yāvat nanu loka vyutpattyā eva tad avagamaḥ bhavet iti atas āha prapañca artham iti

original: lokavyavahāreṇa pravartanābedāvagama uttamādhikāriṇāṃ suśakaḥ, madhyamādyadhikāriṇāṃ tu duravagama iti teṣāṃ spaṣṭapratipattaye sūtre caturṇāmupādānamiti bhāvaḥ| pravartanātvaṃ ceti| propasṛṣṭād‌vṛtudhātorṇyantāṇṇyāsaśrantho yujiti yuci niṣpannasya pravartanāśabdasya pravṛttyanukūlo vyāpāraviśeṣo'rthaḥ|
analyzed: loka vyavahāreṇa pravartanā beda avagamaḥ uttama adhikāriṇām su śakaḥ madhyama ādi adhikāriṇām tu duravagamaḥ iti teṣām spaṣṭa pratipattaye sūtre caturṇām upādānam iti bhāvaḥ pravartanā tvam ca iti pra upasṛṣṭāt vṛtu dhātoḥ ṇi antāt ṇyāsa śranthaḥ yuj iti yuci niṣpannasya pravartanā śabdasya pravṛtti anukūlaḥ vyāpāra viśeṣaḥ ṛthaḥ

original: tasya vyāpāraviśeṣasya svarūpataḥ pravṛttijanakatvādarśanātpravṛttiviṣayasyeṣṭasādhanatvajñānatvajñānadvāraiva tasya pravṛttijanakatvaṃ vācyam| anyathā pravṛttiviṣayasyeṣṭasādhanatvājñāne pravṛttyanupapattiḥ syāt| ataḥ pravṛtitajanakaṃ yajjñānaṃ, tādṛśajñānīyaviṣayatāyāṃ yavacchedakaṃ tattvamavacchedakatvaṃtad‌rūpameva pravartanātvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tasya vyāpāra viśeṣasya svarūpataḥ pravṛtti janaka tva adarśanāt pravṛtti viṣayasya iṣṭasādhanatva jñānatva jñāna dvārā eva tasya pravṛtti janaka tvam vācyam anyathā pravṛtti viṣayasya iṣṭasādhanatva ajñāne pravṛtti anupapattiḥ syāt atas pravṛtita janakam yat jñānam tādṛśa jñānīya viṣayatāyām ya avacchedakam tattvam avacchedaka tvam tad rūpam eva pravartanā tvam iti arthaḥ

original: tacceti| pravṛttijanakajñānīyaviṣayatāvacchedhakatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| tadeveti| iṣṭasādhanatvamevetyarthaḥ| evakārema kṛtisādhyatvādervyāvṛttiḥ| vidhyartho jñeya iti śeṣaḥ| nanviṣṭasādhanatvajñānasyeva kṛtisādhyatājñānasyāpi pravṛttihetutvamavaśyamaṅgīkartavyam| ata eva kṛtyasādhyasumervānayanādāvapravṛttirupapadyata iti cedāha-yadyapītyādi| etaditi|
analyzed: tat ca iti pravṛtti janaka jñānīya viṣayatā avacchedhaka tvam ca iti arthaḥ tat eva iti iṣṭasādhanatvam eva iti arthaḥ eva kārema kṛti sādhya tva ādeḥ vyāvṛttiḥ vidhi arthaḥ jñeyaḥ iti śeṣaḥ nanu iṣṭa sādhana tva jñānasya iva kṛti sādhya tā jñānasya api pravṛtti hetutvam avaśyam aṅgīkartavyam atas eva kṛtya sādhya sumeru ānayana ādau apravṛttiḥ upapadyate iti ced āha yadi api ityādi etat iti

original: pravṛttijanakājñānaviṣayatāvacchedakatvabhityartha-| kṛtisādhyatvasyāpīti| astīti śeṣaḥ| tatsattve hetumāha-tajjñānasyeti| kṛtisādhyatvajñānādapi pravṛttidarśanādityarthaḥ| kṛtisādhyatvajñānasya pravṛttihetutvaṃ nirasyati-tathā'pīti| lokata eveti|
analyzed: pravṛtti janaka ajñāna viṣayatā avacchedaka tvam iti artha kṛti sādhya tvasya api iti asti iti śeṣaḥ tad sattve hetum āha tad jñānasya iti kṛti sādhya tva jñānāt api pravṛtti darśanāt iti arthaḥ kṛti sādhya tva jñānasya pravṛtti hetutvam nirasyati tathā api iti lokataḥ eva iti

original: yāgo matkṛtisādhyaḥ, matkṛtisādhyatvavirodhidharmānākrāntatvādityādyanumānākhyalaukikapramāṇādevetyarthaḥ| gamyata iti| yāgādau sarvatra kṛtisādhyatvamanumānenāvagamyata ityarthaḥ| yāgādau svargādiṣṭasādhanatvaṃ tu na laukikapramāṇato'vagantu śakyaṃ kiṃtu vedenaiva tadavagantuṃ śaktata iti tava śaktikalpanamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yāgaḥ mad kṛti sādhyaḥ mad kṛti sādhya tva virodhi dharma anākrāntatvāt ityādi anumāna ākhya laukika pramāṇāt eva iti arthaḥ gamyate iti yāga ādau sarvatra kṛti sādhya tvam anumānena avagamyate iti arthaḥ yāga ādau svarga ādi iṣṭa sādhanatvam tu na laukika pramāṇataḥ uvagantu śakyam kiṃtu vedena eva tat avagantum śaktataḥ iti tava śakti kalpanam āvaśyakam iti bhāvaḥ

original: anyetu kṛtisādhyatājñānaṃ na pravartakaṃ, kṛtyasādhyatvena niścite pravṛttistu na, tata iṣṭābhāvena vṛthāśramajanakatvena dveṣāditi vadanti| evaṃ ca kṛtisādhyatvasyānyalabhyatvādananyalabhyo hi śabdārtha iti nyāyānna talliṅśakyamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anye tu kṛti sādhya tā jñānam na pravartakam kṛtya sādhya tvena niścite pravṛttiḥ tu na tatas iṣṭa abhāvena vṛthā śrama janaka tvena dveṣāt iti vadanti evam ca kṛti sādhya tvasya anya labhya tvāt ananya labhyaḥ hi śabda arthaḥ iti nyāyāt na tat liṅ śakyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu madhuviṣasaṃpṛktānnabhojanādau pravṛttivāraṇāya balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānasyāpi pravṛttihetutvaṃ kalpanīyaṃ, tathā ca tatrāpi liṅaḥ śaktirāvasyakīti cedāha-balavadaniṣṭetyādi| balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānaṃ cetyarthaḥ| na heturiti| na pravṛttiheturityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu madhu viṣa saṃpṛkta anna bhojana ādau pravṛtti vāraṇāya balavat aniṣṭa ajanaka tva jñānasya api pravṛtti hetutvam kalpanīyam tathā ca tatra api liṅaḥ śaktiḥ āvasyakī iti ced āha balavat aniṣṭa ityādi balavat aniṣṭa ajanaka tva jñānam ca iti arthaḥ na hetuḥ iti na pravṛtti hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yāgapākaderapi nāntarīyakāniṣṭaduḥkhajanakatvena kathaṃ tatra pravṛttiḥ syādata uktaṃ balavaditi| tathā ca yāgapākādau yatkiṃcid‌duḥkhādisvalpāniṣṭajanaktave'pi sukhādhikaduḥkhābhāvādbalavadaniṣṭājanakatvena pravṛttirbhavatyeva| balavadaniṣṭaṃ ca sukhādhikaduḥkhamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: tatra dveṣābhāvasya bhramarūpatvāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca vastuto balavadaniṣṭajanakatvajñānasattvena balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānarūpakāraṇābhāve'pi āstikasya parakīyasundarīgamane pravṛttidarśanād‌dṛḍho vyatirekavyabhicāra ityāśayaḥ|

original: tathā ca kṛtisādhyatvasyānumānena gamyatvāt, balavadaniṣṭājanakatvasya pravṛttyanupayogitvācceṣṭasādhanatvameva liṅ‌śakyārtha ityāha-tasmādityādi| pravartaneti| liṅādyartha ityarthaḥ| iṣṭasādhanatvamave liṅādiśakyamityatra maṇḍanamiśroktiṃ pramāmayati-uktaṃ ceti| puṃsāṃ neṣṭetyādi|

original: iṣṭābhyupāyatvaṃ-iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ, tasmādanyaḥ-balavadaniṣṭājanakatvādiḥ, puṃsāṃ yāgādikriyāsu pravartako na-pravṛttijanakajñānaviṣayo na bhavati, api tu iṣṭasādhanatvameva pravṛttijanakajñānaviṣaya ityarthaḥ| caśabdo hatau| yataḥ| pravṛtitihetuṃ dharmaṃ-pravṛttijanakajñānaviṣayatāvacchedakaṃ dharmaṃ pravartanāśabdārthaṃ vadantītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: iṣṭa abhyupāya tvam iṣṭa sādhana tvam tasmāt anyaḥ balavat aniṣṭa ajanaka tva ādiḥ puṃsām yāga ādi kriyāsu pravartakaḥ na pravṛtti janaka jñāna viṣayaḥ na bhavati api tu iṣṭa sādhana tvam eva pravṛtti janaka jñāna viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ caśabdaḥ hatau yatas dharmam pravṛtti janaka jñāna viṣaya tā avacchedakam dharmam pravartanā śabda artham vadanti iti arthaḥ

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-propasargaviśiṣṭavṛtudhātorṇijantādyuci niṣpannaḥ pravartanāśabdaḥ pravṛttyanukūlavyāpāramāha| tādṛśavyāpāraśca yāgādigateṣṭasādhanatvajñānameva| yajetetyādyukte'pi yadā hyasau yāgādi madiṣṭasādhanamityevaṃ jānāti tadaivāyaṃ yāgādau pravartate nānyatheti dṛṣṭatvāt|

original: brāhmaṇāyeti kriyayā yamabhiṣaitītivārtikātpatye śete itivatsaṃpradānatvāccaturthī, tathā ca yo-yatkartṛkaḥ, brāhmaṇāya-brāhmaṇoddeśyakaḥ, avaguret-daṇḍādyudyamanādivyāpāraḥ, tādṛśavyāpārahetukāḥ, taṃ-tādṛśapuruṣakarmikāḥ, śatena yātayet-śatasaṃvatsaraparyantaṃ yamadūtakartṛkā yātanāḥ, iti śābdabodhaḥ|

original: tādṛśasaṃbandhenānvayabodhe tātparyagrahakatvena sūtrasārthakye sati punastatra liṅaḥ śakti kalpanasya gauravaparāhatatvāt| luṅarthamāha-bhūtamātra iti| mātraśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaka ityāśayavānāha-bhūtasāmānya iti| bhūtatvarūpasāmānyadharmāvacchinne, na tu viśeṣadharmāvacchinna ityarthaḥ| tatra pramāṇamāha-mūte luṅiti sūtrāditi|

original: bhūtatvarūpasāmānyadharmāvacchinnaṃ `bhūte' iti padamadhidhikṛtya dhāṃtorluṅvidhānādityarthaḥ| tatra bhūte iti dhātvarthakriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇam| bhūtakālikakriyāvācakāddhātorluṅiti tadarthaḥ| atreti| `bhūte' ityadhikārasūtra ityardhaḥ| bhūtatvamāha-vartamāneti|

original: vartamāne, vartamāno vā dhvaṃsa iti dvividhasamāsasaṃbhave'pi arthaikyasaṃbhavādvartamānakāliko yo dhvaṃsa-atītakriyādhvaṃsaḥ, tādṛśadhvaṃsapratiyoginī yā atītakriyā tasyāṃ pratiyogatvasattvādvartamānadhvaṃsapratiyogikriyāśrayakālatvaṃ bhūtatvamityarthaḥ phalatītyāśayenā''ha-tacca kriyāyāṃ nirbādhamiti|
analyzed: vartamāne vartamānaḥ vā dhvaṃsaḥ iti dvividha samāsa saṃbhave api artha aikya saṃbhavāt vartamāna kālikaḥ yaḥ dhvaṃsa atīta kriyā dhvaṃsaḥ tādṛśa dhvaṃsa pratiyoginī yā atīta kriyā tasyām pratiyoga tva sattvāt vartamāna dhvaṃsa pratiyogi kriyā āśraya kāla tvam bhūta tvam iti arthaḥ phalati iti āśayena āha tat ca kriyāyām nirbādham iti

original: ayaṃ-buddhisthatvena saṃnihito vakṣyamāmaḥ| saṃgraha ityasya draṣṭavya ityanena saṃbandhaḥ| ādya iti| adyabhavo'dyatana ityarthaḥ| bhedāditi| tathācā''dye pacati, pakṣyati, apākṣīditi trividho'pi prayogo dṛśyate| antya iti| adyatanabhinno'nadyatana ityarthaḥ| bhūto bhaviṣyaṃśceti|

original: āśrayaśabdena cā''śrayatvaśaktimānucyate| nanu yadīpsitatvānīpsitatvayoḥ śābdabodhe bhānābhāvastathā'nanubhavāt, tarhi `kriyājanyaphalāśrayaḥ karma' ityeva sūtramastu, tāvataiva taṇḍulaṃ pacati, grāmaṃ gacchaṃstṛṇaṃ spṛśati, viṣaṃ bhuṅkte, ityādisarvalakṣyāṇāṃ saṃgraho bhavatīti karturīpsitatamaṃkarma, tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam, iti

original: viśiṣṭaśaktau viśeṣaṇaśakterarthasiddhatvena gotve'pi śaktisattvāt| tatra gotvaviśiṣṭavyaktau yā śaktiḥ sā gotvācchinnaiveti nirvivādam| gotve tu sā śaktiḥ sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā vā? sāvacchinnatve gotvatvamavacchedakaṃ vācyam|
analyzed: viśiṣṭa śaktau viśeṣaṇa śakteḥ arthasiddhatvena gotve api śakti sattvāt tatra go tva viśiṣṭa vyaktau yā śaktiḥ sā go tvāt chinnā eva iti nirvivādam go tve tu sā śaktiḥ sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā vā sāvacchinna tve go tva tvam avacchedakam vācyam

original: śakyatāvacchedakasya śakyāntargatatvaniyamād‌gotvatvasyāpi sāvacchinnatve'vacchedakāntaramityanavasthā prasajyeta, tadvāraṇārthaṃ gotve śaktirniravacchinnaivetyaṅgīkāryam| tathaā ca govyaktijñānātpūrvaṃ yad‌gotvasya jñānaṃ jāyate| tanniṣprakāratvānniravacchinnaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ bhavatīti niravācchinnajñānaṃ saṃgacchate|
analyzed: śakyatā avacchedakasya śakya antargata tva niyamāt go tva tvasya api sāvacchinna tva ivacchedaka antaram iti anavasthā prasajyeta tad vāraṇa artham go tve śaktiḥ niravacchinnā eva iti aṅgīkāryam tathaā ca go vyakti jñānāt pūrvam yat go tvasya jñānam jāyate tat niṣprakāra tvāt niravacchinnam nirvikalpakam bhavati iti niravācchinna jñānam saṃgacchate

original: gotvasyāpi saviśeṣaṇatve nirvikalpakajñānasya vilaya eva syāt| evaṃ ca gotvamakhaṇḍaṃ nāmāvacchedakadharmāghaṭitaṃ yathā, tadvadāśrayatvamapyakhaṇḍaṃ, avacchedakadharmāghaṭitamiti bhāvaḥ| jalaṃ jalamityanugatabuddhyā jalapadaśakyatāvacchedakatayā ca jalatvavadāśrayatvasiddhirjñeyā|
analyzed: go tvasya api sa viśeṣaṇa tve nirvikalpaka jñānasya vilayaḥ eva syāt evam ca go tvam akhaṇḍam nāma avacchedaka dharma aghaṭitam yathā tadvat āśraya tvam api akhaṇḍam avacchedaka dharma aghaṭitam iti bhāvaḥ jalam jalam iti anugata buddhyā jala pada śakyatā avacchedaka tayā ca jalatva vat āśraya tva siddhiḥ jñeyā

original: udāharaṇeṣu karmatvalakṣaṇasya samanvayaṃ darśayati-odanaṃ pacatītyatreti| viklittyāśrayatvādityanena kartṛniṣṭaprakṛtadhātūpāttavyāpāraprayojyatve sati tādṛśavyāpāravyadhikaraṇataddhātvarthaphalāśrayatvaṃ karmatvamityuktam| naiyāyikaiḥ kṛño yatnamātrārthakatvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ tadayuktamiti sūcayannāha-ghaṭaṃ karotīti| utpatterdhātvarthatvāditi|
analyzed: udāharaṇeṣu karmatva lakṣaṇasya samanvayam darśayati odanam pacati iti atra iti viklitti āśraya tvāt iti anena kartṛ niṣṭa prakṛta dhātu upātta vyāpāra prayojya tve sati tādṛśa vyāpāra vyadhikaraṇa tad dhātvartha phala āśraya tvam karmatvam iti uktam naiyāyikaiḥ kṛñaḥ yatna mātra arthaka tvam aṅgīkṛtam tat ayuktam iti sūcayan āha ghaṭam karoti iti utpatteḥ dhātvartha tvāt iti

original: kiṃ tūtpādanamevāta ityatra yatnārthakatvanirasanapūrvakaṃ kṛña utpattyarthakatvasya sādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ghaṭaṃ jānātīcchatītyādisaviṣayārthakadhātuṣu jñānecchādyayatvābhāvātkarmatvānupapatterityāśaṅkya parihartumāha-jānātītyatreti| kṣavaraṇabhaṅgeti| āvaraṇabhaṅgānukūlavyāpāro jānātyarthaḥ|
analyzed: kim tu utpādanam eva atas iti atra yatna arthaka tva nirasana pūrvakam kṛñaḥ utpatti arthaka tvasya sādhita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ ghaṭam jānāti icchati ityādi sa viṣaya arthaka dhātuṣu jñāna icchā ādi aya tva abhāvāt karmatva anupapatteḥ iti āśaṅkya parihartum āha jānāti iti atra iti āvaraṇa bhaṅga iti āvaraṇa bhaṅga anukūla vyāpāraḥ jānāti arthaḥ

original: ghaṭaṃ jānātītyatra kriyājanyāvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphalāśrayatvād‌baṭasya karmatvamityarthaḥ| āvaraṇabhaṅgānukūlavyāpāraśca ghaṭādyākārā buddhivṛttireva| taduktaṃ-vuddhitatsthacidābhāsau dvāvetau vyāpnuto ghaṭam| tatrājñānaṃ dhiyā naśyedābhāsena ghaṭaḥ sphuret|| iti| dhīvṛttyā'jñānanāśa āvaraṇabhaṅga iti tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭam jānāti iti atra kriyā janya āvaraṇa bhaṅga rūpa phala āśraya tvāt baṭasya karma tvam iti arthaḥ āvaraṇa bhaṅga anukūla vyāpāraḥ ca ghaṭa ādi ākārā buddhi vṛttiḥ eva tat uktam vuddhi tad stha cit ābhāsau dvau etau vyāpnutaḥ ghaṭam tatra ajñānam dhiyā naśyet ābhāsena ghaṭaḥ sphuret iti dhī vṛttyā ajñāna nāśaḥ āvaraṇa bhaṅgaḥ iti tad arthaḥ

original: nanu vidyamāne ghaṭe dhīvṛttijanyāvaraṇabhaṅgāśrayatvasaṃbhave'pi vinaṣṭe'nutpanne vā ghaṭe tadāśrayatvāsaṃbhavātkathaṃ tasya karmatvamata āha-atītānāgateti| parokṣasthale'pīti| pratyakṣasthala iva parokṣasthale'pītyarthaḥ| jñānajanyasya-dhīvṛttijanyasya, tasya-āvaraṇabhaṅgasya, āvaśyakatvāt-avaśyāṅgīkartavyatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu vidyamāne ghaṭe dhī vṛtti janya āvaraṇa bhaṅga āśraya tva saṃbhave pi vinaṣṭa inutpanne vā ghaṭe tad āśraya tva asaṃbhavāt katham tasya karmatvam atas āha atīta anāgata iti parokṣa sthale ipi iti pratyakṣa sthale iva parokṣa sthale ipi iti arthaḥ jñāna janyasya dhī vṛtti janyasya tasya āvaraṇa bhaṅgasya āvaśyaka tvāt avaśya aṅgīkartavya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: parokṣaghaṭe tadā āvaraṇabhaṅgāśrayatvāṅgīkāre yuktiṃ darśayati-anyatheti| vinaṣṭādighaṭe āvaraṇabhaṅgānaṅgīkāre| yathā pūrvamiti| pūrvaṃ ghaṭasya vidyamānatvāttadānīṃtanadhīvṛtterāvaraṇabhaṅgajanakatve'pi idānīṃ ghaṭasyāvidyamānatvādidānīṃtanadhīvṛtterāvaraṇabhaṅgajanakatvāsaṃbhavāt `ghaṭaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ jānāmi' iti prayogo na syādītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: parokṣa ghaṭe tadā āvaraṇa bhaṅga āśraya tva aṅgīkāre yuktim darśayati anyathā iti vinaṣṭa ādi ghaṭe āvaraṇa bhaṅga anaṅgīkāre yathā pūrvam iti pūrvam ghaṭasya vidyamāna tvāt tadānīṃtana dhī vṛtteḥ āvaraṇa bhaṅga janaka tve pi idānīm ghaṭasya avidyamāna tvāt idānīṃtana dhī vṛtteḥ āvaraṇa bhaṅga janaka tva asaṃbhavāt ghaṭam yathāpūrvam jānāmi iti prayogaḥ na syādi iti arthaḥ

original: atra yathāpūrvamiti padārthānatikrame'avyayībhāvaḥ| jānātikriyāviśeṣaṇametat| pūrvaṃ pūrvajñānamanatikramyeti yathāpūrvam| pūrvajñānasyānatikramo yasmiṃstathābhūtaṃ jñānaṃ na syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atra yathāpūrvam iti padārtha anatikrame avyayībhāvaḥ jānāti kriyā viśeṣaṇam etat pūrvam pūrva jñānam an atikramya iti yathāpūrvam pūrva jñānasya anatikramaḥ yasmin tathābhūtam jñānam na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-ghaṭasya vidyamānatādaśāyāṃ tātkālikadhīvṛttyā vidyamānaghaṭagataṃ yadāvaraṇamācchādanamajñānarūpaṃ tadbhaṅgasya(āvaraṇanāśasya)kṛtatvādyathā suvyaktaṃ ghaṭajñānaṃ jāyate tadvadghaṭasyāvidyamānatādaśāyāṃ tātkālikadhīvṛttyā'vidyamānaghaṭagatāvaraṇabhaṅgasyākṛtatvādāvaraṇasya sattvātsuvyaktaṃ ghaṭajñānaṃ na jāyata iti
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ ghaṭasya vidyamāna tā daśāyām tātkālika dhī vṛttyā vidyamāna ghaṭa gatam yat āvaraṇam ācchādanam ajñāna rūpam tad bhaṅgasya āvaraṇa nāśasya kṛta tvāt yathā su vyaktam ghaṭa jñānam jāyate tadvat ghaṭasya avidyamāna tā daśāyām tātkālika dhī vṛttyā avidyamāna ghaṭa gata āvaraṇa bhaṅgasya akṛta tvāt āvaraṇasya sattvāt su vyaktam ghaṭa jñānam na jāyate iti

original: pūrvajñānasyātikramasattvādyathāpūrvaṃ jānāmīti prayogo na bhavet| paraṃ tu vidyamānaghaṭasya yathā suvyaktaṃ jñānaṃ jāyate tathā'vidyamānaghaṭasyāpi suvyaktaṃ jñānaṃ jāyata ityanubhavasiddham| tādṛśānubhavopapattaye'vidyamānaghaṭe'pi āvaraṇabhaṅgo'stītyavaśyamaṅgīkāryam| suvyaktajñānaṃ prati āvaraṇabhaṅgasya kāraṇatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pūrva jñānasya atikrama sattvāt yathāpūrvam jānāmi iti prayogaḥ na bhavet param tu vidyamāna ghaṭasya yathā su vyaktam jñānam jāyate tathā a vidyamāna ghaṭasya api su vyaktam jñānam jāyate iti anubhava siddham tādṛśa anubhava upapattaye vidyamāna ghaṭe pi āvaraṇa bhaṅgo sti iti avaśyam aṅgīkāryam su vyakta jñānam prati āvaraṇa bhaṅgasya kāraṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: anyathā vidyamānaghaṭa ivāvidyamānaghaṭe suvyaktaṃ jñānaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu vinaṣṭe bhāvini vā ghaṭe āvaraṇabhaṅgāśrayatā kathaṃ ghaṭeta, āśrayasyāvidyamānatvāt, vidyamāna eva hi sā vaktuṃ yujyata ityata āha--atītāderāśrayatā ceti| naiyāyikānāmiveti|
analyzed: anyathā vidyamāna ghaṭe iva avidyamāna ghaṭe su vyaktam jñānam na syāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu vinaṣṭe bhāvini vā ghaṭe āvaraṇa bhaṅga āśraya tā katham ghaṭeta āśrayasya avidyamāna tvāt vidyamāne eva hi sā vaktum yujyate iti atas āha atīta ādeḥ āśraya tā ca iti naiyāyikānām iva iti

original: naiyāyikairhi anubhavāgusārema yathā'tītādighaṭāderviṣayatayā jñānāśrayatā'ṅgīkṛtā tathā'smābhirapi atītādighaṭe viṣayatayā''varaṇabhaṅgāśrayatā'nubhavānurodhena svīkriyata iti bhāvaḥ| nanvatītādighaṭe viṣayatāsattve'pi viṣayatayā jñānāśrayatve vipratipattidarśanād‌dṛṣṭāntāsaṃgatirata āha--satkāryavādeti|
analyzed: naiyāyikaiḥ hi yathā atīta ādi ghaṭa ādeḥ viṣayatayā jñāna āśraya tā aṅgīkṛtā tathā asmābhiḥ api atīta ādi ghaṭe viṣayatayā āvaraṇa bhaṅga āśraya tā anubhava anurodhena svīkriyate iti bhāvaḥ nanu atīta ādi ghaṭe viṣayatā sattve pi viṣayatayā jñāna āśraya tve vipratipatti darśanāt dṛṣṭānta asaṃgatiḥ atas āha satkārya vāda iti

original: `sadeva somyedamagra āsīt' iti śruterghaṭādikaṃ sarvaṃ kāryajātaṃ kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇa pūrvamasthitameva| yadyapi ghaṭa utpanno ghaṭo naṣṭa iti vyāvahāro dṛśyate tathā'pi utpanna ityasya daṇḍacakrādivyāpāreṇa vyaktībhūta ityarthaḥ| naṣṭa ityasya cāvyakto jāta ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: sat eva somya idam agre āsīt iti śruteḥ ghaṭa ādikam sarvam kārya jātam kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa pūrvam asthitam eva yadi api ghaṭaḥ utpannaḥ ghaṭaḥ naṣṭaḥ iti vyāvahāraḥ dṛśyate tathā api utpannaḥ iti asya daṇḍa cakra ādi vyāpāreṇa vyaktībhūtaḥ iti arthaḥ naṣṭaḥ iti asya ca avyaktaḥ jātaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ghaṭastu vyaktībhāvātpūrvaṃ mṛttikārūpeṇāstyeva tathā nāśottaramapi mṛttikāyāmavyaktarūpeṇa ghaṭo'styeva| na hi asataḥ sattvaṃ, sato vā nāśaḥ saṃbhavati? sikatāsu vyāpārasahasreṇāpi tailādarśanāt|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ tu vyaktībhāvāt pūrvam mṛttikā rūpeṇa asti eva tathā nāśa uttaram api mṛttikāyām avyakta rūpeṇa ghaṭaḥ usti eva na hi asataḥ sattvam sataḥ vā nāśaḥ saṃbhavati sikatāsu vyāpāra sahasreṇa api taila adarśanāt

original: kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvastānameva tatprāgabhāvaḥ kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthānādeva yathā ghaṭo jāyata ityatra ghaṭasya kārakatvaṃ kartṛtvaṃ copapadyate tadvadāvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphalāśrayatvamapyupapadyata ityarthaḥ| kāryaṃ sadā sadeva vidyamānameva na tu kadāpyavidyamānagityevaṃ yo vādaḥ sa satkāryavāda iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avastānam eva tad prāgabhāvaḥ kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avasthānāt eva yathā ghaṭaḥ jāyate iti atra ghaṭasya kāraka tvam kartṛ tvam ca upapadyate tadvat āvaraṇa bhaṅga rūpa phala āśraya tvam api upapadyate iti arthaḥ kāryam sadā sat eva vidyamānam eva na tu kadāpi avidyamāna giti evam yaḥ vādaḥ sa satkārya vādaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu kāryasya sarvadā sattve nāsti naśyatīti vyavahārānupapattirata āha-tirobhāvābhyupeti tirobhāvasaṃpādakakāraṇasāmagrayā tirobhāve kṛte saiva virobhāvāvasthaiva bhāvānāṃ nāstitā naṣṭatetyarthaḥ| labdhaḥ kramo yena tādṛśe tirobhāve satītyarthaḥ| tirobhāvotpattigatavartamānatvanimittako naśyatīti vyavahāra ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu kāryasya sarvadā sattve na asti naśyati iti vyavahāra anupapattiḥ atas āha tirobhāva abhyupeti tirobhāva saṃpādaka kāraṇa sāmagrayā tirobhāve kṛte sā eva virobhāva avasthā eva bhāvānām nāstitā naṣṭatā iti arthaḥ labdhaḥ kramaḥ yena tādṛśe tirobhāve sati iti arthaḥ tirobhāva utpatti gata vartamāna tva nimittakaḥ naśyati iti vyavahāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: labdhakrama ityanena tasya vyāpārarūpatā''veditā| pratīyata ityanena pratītiḥ pramāṇatvenoktā| tirobhāvo nāma kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ, tathā ca ghaṭasya tirobhāve'pi kāraṇe sūkṣmarūpeṇāvasthānāttatrā''varaṇabhaṅgāśrayatvasya nānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ
analyzed: labdha kramaḥ iti anena tasya vyāpāra rūpa tā veditā pratīyate iti anena pratītiḥ pramāṇa tvena uktā tirobhāvaḥ nāma kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avasthānam tathā ca ghaṭasya tirobhāve api kāraṇe sūkṣma rūpeṇa avasthānāt tatra āvaraṇa bhaṅga āśraya tvasya na anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: niruktakarmatvalakṣaṇasya niṣkṛṣṭārtha spaṣṭayitumāśaṅkate-nanviti| caitraścaitramiti| prakṛtadhātūpāttavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayaḥ karma, ityevaṃ karmalakṣaṇamuktam| caitro grāmaṃ gacchatītyatra gamidhātvarthaḥ-saṃyogānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| sa ca pādaprakṣeparūpaścaitre kartari vartate|
analyzed: nirukta karmatva lakṣaṇasya spaṣṭayitum āśaṅkate nanu iti caitraḥ caitram iti prakṛta dhātu upātta vyāpāra janya phala āśrayaḥ karma iti evam karma lakṣaṇam uktam caitraḥ grāmam gacchati iti atra gami dhātvarthaḥ saṃyoga anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ sa ca pāda prakṣepa rūpaḥ caitre kartari vartate

original: tathā ca gamadhātūpāttapādaprakṣeparūpavyāpārajanyaṃ yatphalaṃ saṃyogaḥ tadāśrayatvād‌grāmasya yathā karmasaṃjñā bhavati tadvatsaṃyogasya dviṣṭhatvena tādṛśasaṃyogasya caitra'pi sattvāccaitrasyāpi prakṛtadhātūpāttavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvātkarmatvāpattau caitraścaitraṃ gacchatīti prayoga āpadyate|
analyzed: tathā ca gama dhātu upātta pāda prakṣepa rūpa vyāpāra janyam yat phalam saṃyogaḥ tad āśraya tvāt grāmasya yathā karma saṃjñā bhavati tadvat saṃyogasya dviṣṭha tvena tādṛśa saṃyogasya sattvāt caitrasya api prakṛta dhātu upātta vyāpāra janya phala āśraya tvāt karma tva āpattau caitraḥ caitram gacchati iti prayogaḥ āpadyate

original: caitrapadārthasya kartṛtvakarmatvaitadubhayalakṣaṇākrāntatvenaikasyaiva caitraśabdasya prathamāntatā dvitīyāntatā ca syāditi yāvat|
analyzed: caitra padārthasya kartṛ tva karma tva etad ubhaya lakṣaṇa ākrānta tvena ekasya eva caitra śabdasya prathama anta tā dvitīya anta tā ca syāt iti yāvat

original: tathā prayāgato niḥsṛtya kāśīṃ gacchati caitra ityatra gamadhātūpāttapādaprakṣeparūpavyāpārajanyaphalaṃ yathā saṃyogaḥ sa ca kāśyāṃ vartate tathā tādṛśavyāpārajanyatvādvibhāgo'pi phalamiti kṛtvā vibhāgarūpaphalāśrayatvātprayāgasyāpi karmatvāpattau prayāgaṃ gacchati iti ca prayoga āpadyata iti bhāvaḥ| etāmāśaṅkāṃ nirākaroti-neti|
analyzed: tathā prayāgataḥ niḥsṛtya kāśīm gacchati caitraḥ iti atra gama dhātu upātta pāda prakṣepa rūpa vyāpāra janya phalam yathā saṃyogaḥ sa ca kāśyām vartate tathā tādṛśa vyāpāra janya tvāt vibhāgaḥ api phalam iti kṛtvā vibhāga rūpa phala āśraya tvāt prayāgasya api karma tva āpattau prayāgam gacchati iti ca prayogaḥ āpadyate iti bhāvaḥ etām āśaṅkām nirākaroti na iti

original: tatra prathamāmāpattiṃ nirasyati-grāmasyevetyādi| grāmo yathā gamadhātvarthavyāpārajanyasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayastathā caitro'pi kartā yadyapi tādṛśasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayo bhavati tathā'pi vyāpārāśrayatvena tajjanyaphalāśrayatvena ca caivasya kartṛkarmasaṃjñayoḥ prāptau paratvātkartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñāyā bādhānna caitraścaitramiti prayoga āpadyata

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-sa kratuṃ kurvītetyanenopāsanaṃ vidhāya tādṛśopāsanavidhiviṣayatayā `manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīraḥ' ityuktam| tatra manaḥprāṇādisaṃbandhasya jīvātmanyāñjasyena saṃbhavādihopāsyatvena manomayādiśabdavācyo jīvo nirdiṣṭa ityāśaṅkya, yadi manomayādiśabdapratipādyasya jīvatvaṃ syāttadā vākyaśeṣe-`etamitaḥ pretyābhisaṃbhavitāsmi' ityatra
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ sa kratum kurvīta iti anena upāsanam vidhāya tādṛśa upāsana vidhi viṣaya tayā manaḥ mayaḥ prāṇa śarīraḥ iti uktam tatra manaḥ prāṇa ādi saṃbandhasya jīvātmani āñjasyena saṃbhavāt iha upāsya tvena manaḥ maya ādi śabda vācyaḥ jīvaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ iti āśaṅkya yadi manaḥ maya ādi śabda pratipādyasya jīva tvam syāt tadā vākya śeṣe etam itas pretya abhisaṃbhavitāsmi iti atra

original: manomayādiśabdapratipādyasya jīvasyaikasya prāptikarmatvena prāptikartṛtvena ca kṛtaḥ kartṛkarmobhayavyapadeśo viruddhaḥ, itaḥ-asmāccharīrāt, pretya-niḥsṛtya, etaccharīraṃ parityajyetyarthaḥ, etaṃ-manomayādiśabdapratipādyaṃ prakṛtaṃ jīvātmānaṃ, abhisaṃbhavitāsmi-prāptāsmi, iti tadarthāditi|
analyzed: manaḥ maya ādi śabda pratipādyasya jīvasya ekasya prāpti karma tvena prāpti kartṛ tvena ca kṛtaḥ kartṛ karma ubhaya vyapadeśaḥ viruddhaḥ itas asmāt śarīrāt pretya niḥsṛtya etat śarīram parityajya iti arthaḥ etam manaḥ maya ādi śabda pratipādyam prakṛtam jīvātmānam abhisaṃbhavitāsmi prāptāsmi iti tad arthāt iti

original: atra etamityanena prakṛtamanomayo jīvātmā prāptikarmatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ, abhisaṃbhavitāsmi-prāptāsmīti luḍutamena puruṣeṇa upāsakaḥ śārīraḥ prāptikartṛtvena vyapadiṣṭaḥ| samupasṛṣṭādādhṛṣīyād‌bhū prāptāvityātmanepadino vyatyayena luṭaḥ sthāne parasmaipadam|
analyzed: atra etam iti anena prakṛta manaḥ mayaḥ jīvātmā prāpti karma tvena nirdiṣṭaḥ abhisaṃbhavitāsmi prāptā asmi iti luḍutamena puruṣeṇa upāsakaḥ śārīraḥ prāpti kartṛ tvena vyapadiṣṭaḥ samupasṛṣṭāt ādhṛṣīyāt bhū prāptau iti ātmanepadinaḥ vyatyayena luṭaḥ sthāne parasmaipadam

original: atha vā ṇic‌saṃniyogenaivā''tmanepadamityekīyapakṣe ṇijabhāve vyatyayantaraivotsargata eva parasmaipadamiti jñeyam| atra śāṃkarabhāṣyam-`na ca satyāṃ gatāvekasya kartṛkarmavyāpadeśo yuktaḥ' iti|
analyzed: atha vā ṇic saṃniyogena eva ātmanepadam iti ekīya pakṣe ṇic abhāve vyatyaya ntarā evā utsargataḥ eva parasmaipadam iti jñeyam atra śāṃkara bhāṣyam na ca satyām gatau ekasya yuktaḥ iti

original: atra satyāṃ gatāvityuktyā ātmānamātmanā hantītyādivadaupādhikabedakalpanā'gatikagatirūpā na yukteti sūcitam tatra kālabedenaikasya saṃjñādvayasaṃbhave'pi, na yugapadekasya saṃjñādvayaṃ yuktam| prakṛtaśrutau tu yugapadeva saṃjñādvayakāryopalambho viruddha ityāśayena samādhatte-ucyata iti| evamiti| ekasya kartṛtvakarmatvobhayāṅgīkāre, ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atra satyām gatau iti uktyā ātmānam ātmanā hanti ityādi vat aupādhika beda kalpanā gatika gati rūpā na yuktā iti sūcitam tatra kāla bedena ekasya saṃjñā dvaya saṃbhave api na yugapad ekasya saṃjñā dvayam yuktam prakṛta śrutau tu yugapad eva saṃjñā dvaya kārya upalambhaḥ viruddhaḥ iti āśayena samādhatte ucyate iti evam iti ekasya kartṛ tva karma tva ubhaya aṅgīkāre iti arthaḥ

original: bhanomayasyeti| manomayaśabdabodyasyetyarthaḥ| jībatva iti| brahmabhinnatve, ityarthaḥ| vākyaśeṣa iti| etamitaḥ pretyetyādivākyaśeṣa ityarthaḥ| tasyeti| manomayaśabdabodhyajīvātmana ityarthaḥ| iti mūlasthaśabdārthavivaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam| samādhānaprakāramāha-jīvasyaibeti|
analyzed: manaḥ mayasya iti manaḥ maya śabda bodyasya iti arthaḥ jīva tve iti brahma bhinna tve iti arthaḥ vākyaśeṣaḥ iti etam itas pretya ityādi vākyaśeṣaḥ iti arthaḥ tasya iti manaḥ maya śabda bodhya jīva ātmanaḥ iti arthaḥ iti mūla stha śabda artha vivaraṇam draṣṭavyam samādhāna prakāram āha jīvasya eva iti

original: manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīraḥ, ityādinā jīvasyaivopāsyatvena bodhane sati prāptikarpatvamapi tasyaiva vācyam| etamityetacabdhasya pūrvaprakrāntārthaparāmarśitvāt| tasyeti| jīvātmana ityartha| abhisaṃbhavitāsmi, iti-kriyāpadaghaṭakākhyātena tiṅā kartṛtvamuktam| laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve cetyanena luṭaḥ kartari vidhānādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: manaḥ mayaḥ prāṇa śarīraḥ ityādinā jīvasya eva upāsya tvena bodhane sati prāpti karpatvam api tasya eva vācyam etam pūrva prakrānta artha parāmarśi tvāt tasya iti jīvātmanaḥ iti artha abhisaṃbhavitāsmi iti kriyāpada ghaṭaka ākhyātena tiṅā kartṛ tvam uktam karmaṇi ca bhāve ca iti anena luṭaḥ kartari vidhānāt iti arthaḥ

original: tatraikasya yugapatkartṛkarmasaṃjñādvayaṃ na yujyate-na saṃbhavati| ākaḍārīyatayā parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñāyā bādhāt| tathā ca etamiti dvitīyā na prāpnuyāt|
analyzed: tatra ekasya yugapad kartṛ karma saṃjñā dvayam na saṃbhavati ākaḍārīyatayā parayā kartṛ saṃjñayā karma saṃjñāyāḥ bādhāt tathā ca etam iti dvitīyā na prāpnuyāt

original: atha abhisaṃbhavitāsmīti na śuddhe kartari luṭ, api tu karmakartarīti yadyucyeta-etamiti pūrvavākye karmatayā nirdiṣṭasya kartṛtvaṃ yathā taṇḍulaṃ pacatīti vākye karmasaṃjñakasya taṇḍulasya taṇḍulaḥ pacyate svayameveti vākye kartatvamiti na yugapatsaṃjñādvayamityucyate cettannetyāha-yagādyāpattiriti|
analyzed: atha abhisaṃbhavitāsmi iti na śuddhe kartari luṭ api tu karma kartari iti yadi ucyeta etam iti pūrva vākye karmatayā nirdiṣṭasya kartṛ tvam yathā taṇḍulam pacati iti vākye karma saṃjñakasya taṇḍulasya taṇḍulaḥ pacyate svayam eva iti vākye kartṛ tvam iti na yugapad saṃjñā dvayam iti ucyate ced tat na ityāha yak ādi āpattiḥ iti

original: nanu luṭaḥ karmakartṛtve'pi tāsaḥ sārvadhātukatvābhāvānna yagāpattirata āha-yagādīti| ādipadācciṇvadbhāvātmanepadādergrahaṇam| tathā ca ciṇvadbhād‌vṛddhirātmanepadaṃ cā''padyeteti bhāvaḥ| śabdavirodhadvāreti| ekasya yugapatsaṃjñādvayakāryāsaṃbhavātmakavirodadvāretyarthaḥ| saḥ yugapadekasya saṃjñādvayāsaṃbhavarūpo virodha ityarthaḥ| bhedaheturiti|
analyzed: nanu luṭaḥ karma kartṛ tve api tāsaḥ sārvadhātuka tva abhāvāt na yak āpattiḥ atas āha yak ādi iti ādi padāt ciṇvat bhāva ātmanepada ādeḥ grahaṇam tathā ca ciṇvat bhāt vṛddhiḥ ātmanepadam ca āpadyeta iti bhāvaḥ śabda virodha dvārā iti ekasya yugapad saṃjñā dvaya kārya asaṃbhava ātmaka viroda dvārā iti arthaḥ saḥ yugapad ekasya saṃjñā dvaya asaṃbhava rūpaḥ virodhaḥ iti arthaḥ bheda hetuḥ iti

original: upāsyopāsakayoḥ paramātmajīvātmanorbhedaheturbhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā ca manomayādiśabdena paramātmaiva nirdiṣṭaḥ, na jīvātmeti sidhyatīti na pūrvoktabhagavadvyāsanirṇayavirodha ityāśayaḥ|
analyzed: upāsya upāsakayoḥ paramātma jīvātmanoḥ bheda hetuḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ tathā ca manaḥ maya ādi śabdena paramātmā eva nirdiṣṭaḥ na jīvātmā iti sidhyati iti na pūrva ukta bhagavat vyāsa nirṇaya virodhaḥ iti āśayaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ kartṛtṛtīyāyā api karaṇatṛtatīyāvad‌vyāpāraviśiṣṭāśrayavācakatvaṃ prāpnoti, nā''śrayamātravācakatvamityata āha-evaṃ ceti| dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvasya kartṛtve cetyarthaḥ| vyāpārāṃśasyeti| kartṛtvalakṣaṇaghaṭakasya vyāpārāṃśasyetyarthaḥ| dhātulabhyatvāditi| dhātunā pratipādyamānatvādityarthaḥ| āśrayamātramiti|
analyzed: nanu evam kartṛ tṛtīyāyāḥ api karaṇa tṛtatīyā vat vyāpāra viśiṣṭa āśraya vācakatvam prāpnoti na āśraya mātra vācakatvam iti atas āha evam ca iti dhātu upātta vyāpāra āśraya tvasya kartṛ tve ca iti arthaḥ vyāpāra aṃśasya iti kartṛ tva lakṣaṇa ghaṭakasya vyāpāra aṃśasya iti arthaḥ dhātu labhya tvāt iti dhātunā pratipādyamāna tvāt iti arthaḥ āśraya mātram iti

original: ananyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvāditi nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ| mātrapadena vyāpāraghyavacchedaḥ| mīmāṃsakoktaṃ kartṛtvaṃ dūṣayitumanuvadati-kārakacakraprayoktṛtvamiti| prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyānvayayogyakārakasamudāyapravartakatvamityarthaḥ| uktāpekṣayā'pi lāghavānurodhena naiyāyikasaṃmataṃ kartṛtvamanuvadati-kārakacakraprayoktṛtvamiti|
analyzed: ananya labhyasya eva śabda artha tvāt iti nyāyāt iti bhāvaḥ mātra padena mīmāṃsaka uktam kartṛ tvam dūṣayitum anuvadati kāraka cakra prayoktṛ tvam iti prakṛta dhātu upātta kriyā anvaya yogya kāraka samudāya pravartaka tvam iti arthaḥ ukta apekṣayā api lāghava anurodhena naiyāyika saṃmatam kartṛ tvam anuvadati kāraka cakra prayoktṛ tvam iti

original: prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyānvayayogyakārakasamudāyapravartakatvamityarthaḥ| uktāpekṣayā'pi lāghavānurodhena naiyāyikasaṃmataṃ kartṛtvamanuvadati-kṛtyāśrayatvaṃ veti| prakṛtadhātvarthavyāpārānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvamityarthaḥ| āśrayatvaṃ ca samavāyasaṃbandhena grāhyam|
analyzed: prakṛta dhātu upātta kriyā anvaya yogya kāraka samudāya pravartaka tvam iti arthaḥ ukta apekṣayā api lāghava anurodhena naiyāyika saṃmatam kartṛ tvam anuvadati kṛti āśraya tvam vā iti prakṛta dhātvartha vyāpāra anukūla kṛti āśraya tvam kartṛ tvam iti arthaḥ āśraya tvam ca samavāya saṃbandhena grāhyam

original: tena pākānukūlakṛteḥ kālikasaṃbandhenā''śrayatvasya ghaṭe sattve'pi na ghaṭaḥ pacati, ghaṭena pacyata ityāderāpattiḥ| tadetad‌dvividhamapi kartṛtvamavyāptidoṣagrastamityāha-avyāptamiti| daṇḍaḥ karoti, sthālī pacatītyādau daṇḍāderacetanatvena kārakacakraprayoktṛtvābhāvātkṛtyāśrayatvābhāvācca kartṛtvaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ| karturvibhāgamāha-ayaṃ ceti|
analyzed: tena pāka anukūla kṛteḥ kālika saṃbandhena āśraya tvasya ghaṭe sattve pi na ghaṭaḥ pacati ghaṭena pacyate iti ādeḥ āpattiḥ tat etat dvividham api kartṛ tvam avyāpti doṣa grastam iti āha avyāptam iti daṇḍaḥ karoti sthālī pacati ityādau daṇḍa ādeḥ acetana tvena kāraka cakra prayoktṛ tva abhāvāt kṛtya āśraya tva abhāvāt ca kartṛ tvam na syāt iti bhāvaḥ kartuḥ vibhāgam āha ayam ca iti

original: tṛtīyārthatvenoktaḥ kartetyarthaḥ| vibhāgaśca kartṛtvavyāpyadharmapuraskārema kathanam| trividhatvaṃ pradarśayati-śuddha ityādinā| hetukartṛ-karmakartṛbhyāṃ bhinnaḥ kartā śuddha ityarthaḥ| ṇijarthavyāpārāśrayaḥ kartā prayojakakartetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tṛtīyā artha tvena uktaḥ kartā iti arthaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca kartṛ tva vyāpya dharma puraskārema kathanam trividha tvam pradarśayati śuddhaḥ ityādinā hetu kartṛ karma kartṛbhyām bhinnaḥ kartā śuddhaḥ iti arthaḥ ṇijartha vyāpāra āśrayaḥ kartā prayojaka kartā iti arthaḥ

original: karmakartā tu ṇic‌prakṛtibhūtadhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatve sati ṇijarthavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayaḥ, prayojyakarteti bhāvaḥ| yo hyaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartṛsaṃjñaḥ saṇṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmasaṃjñako bhavati sa karmakarteti yāvat| na tu phalāśrayamātravṛttivyāpārāśrayatvarūpakarmakartṛtvamiha vivakṣitamityāśayaḥ|
analyzed: karma kartā tu ṇic prakṛti bhūta dhātu upātta vyāpāra āśraya tve sati ṇijartha vyāpāra janya phala āśrayaḥ prayojya kartā iti bhāvaḥ yaḥ hi a ṇi anta avasthāyām kartṛ saṃjñaḥ sat ṇi anta avasthāyām karma saṃjñakaḥ bhavati sa karma kartā iti yāvat na tu phala āśraya mātra vṛtti vyāpāra āśraya tva rūpa karma kartṛ tvam iha vivakṣitam iti āśayaḥ

original: śuddhādīnāṃ kartṝṇāṃ krameṇodāharaṇānyāha-mayā hariḥo, kāryateo, gamayati kṛṣṇaṃo iti| udāharaṇakrameṇaiva tacchābdabodhān pradarśayati-madabhinnāśrayaka----vyāpāraḥ, haryabhinnāśrayaka----vyāpāraḥ, gokulakarmakagamanā---vyāpāraḥ, ityevaṃ krameṇa teṣāṃ śābdabodhā jñeyāḥ, prathamodāharaṇe mayeti
analyzed: śuddha ādīnām kartṝṇām krameṇa udāharaṇāni āha mayā hariḥ gamayati iti udāharaṇa krameṇa eva tad śābda bodhān pradarśayati mad abhinna āśrayaka vyāpāraḥ hari abhinna āśrayaka vyāpāraḥ gokula karmaka gamana vyāpāraḥ iti evam krameṇa teṣām śābda bodhāḥ jñeyāḥ prathama udāharaṇe mayā iti

original: prayojakatvakarmatvavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravattvācchuddhaḥ kartā| dvitīyodāharaṇe karoterṇijantātkarmaṇi laṭ, yak| atra hariḥ prayojakakartā| tṛtīyodāharaṇe kṛṣṇasyāṇau karturṇyante gatibuddhītisūtreṇa karmasaṃjñāvidhānātkṛṣṇaḥ karmakartā|
analyzed: prayojaka tva karmatva vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāravat tvāt śuddhaḥ kartā dvitīya udāharaṇe karoteḥ ṇic antāt karmaṇi laṭ yak atra hariḥ prayojaka kartā tṛtīya udāharaṇe kṛṣṇasya aṇau kartuḥ ṇi ante gati buddhi iti sūtreṇa karma saṃjñā vidhānāt kṛṣṇaḥ karma kartā

original: tathā ca karma cāsau kartā ceti karmadhārayaḥ, karmasaṃjñayā kartṛsaṃjñāyā vādhāttadabhāve'pi prakṛtadhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvarūpavāstavakartṛtvasattvānna kācitkṣatiḥ| sevanānukūla iti| sevā-pādasaṃvāhanādikaṃ, prītirvā| navīnamate tu-madabhinnāśrayavyāpārajanyā harikarmikā sevetyādiḥ śābdabodho jñeyaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca karma ca asau kartā ca iti karmadhārayaḥ karma saṃjñayā kartṛ saṃjñāyāḥ vādhāt tad abhāve pi prakṛta dhātu upātta vyāpāra āśraya tva rūpa vāstava kartṛ tva sattvāt na kācid kṣatiḥ sevana anukūlaḥ iti sevā pāda saṃvāhana ādikam prītiḥ vā navīna mate tumat abhinna āśraya vyāpāra janyā hari karmikā sevā ityādiḥ śābda bodhaḥ jñeyaḥ

original: tairhi karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāre phalamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhāṅgīkārāt| evaṃ kāryate hariṇetyatrāpi haryabhinnāśrayakavyāpārajanyotpādaneti bodho'vaseyaḥ|
analyzed: taiḥ hi karma pratyaya samabhivyāhāre phala mukhya viśeṣyaka śābda bodha aṅgīkārāt evam kāryate hariṇā iti atra api hari abhinna āśrayaka vyāpāra janya utpādanā iti bodhaḥ vaseyaḥ

original: karamatṛtīyāyā vyāpāraviśiṣṭaśrayo vācya ityāha-karaṇatṛtīyāyāstviti| nanvāśrayavyāpārayoḥ karṇatṛtīyāvācyatve na mānaṃ, sādhakatamasyaiva karaṇasaṃjñāvidhānādata āha-tathā hīti| sādhakatamaṃ hi karaṇaṃ, tatra tamabarthaḥ prakarṣaḥ| sa cāvyavadhānena phalajanako yo vyāpārastadvattā|
analyzed: karama tṛtīyāyāḥ vyāpāra viśiṣṭa śrayaḥ vācyaḥ iti āha karaṇa tṛtīyāyāḥ tu iti nanu āśraya vyāpārayoḥ karṇa tṛtīyā vācya tve na mānam sādhakatamasya eva karaṇa saṃjñā vidhānāt atas āha tathā hi iti sādhakatamam hi karaṇam tatra tamap arthaḥ prakarṣaḥ sa ca avyavadhānena phala janakaḥ yaḥ vyāpāraḥ tadvat tā

original: tādṛśaprakarṣaśca kārakāntarāpekṣo grāhyaḥ, na tu karaṇāntarāpekṣaḥ| kārakasāmānyavācinaḥ sādhakaśabdādvihitena tamap‌pratyayena kārakāvadhikaprakarṣasyaiva bodhanāt| karaṇāntarāpekṣaprakarṣasya karaṇāntare'bhāvācca| tena, rayena dīpikayā pathā vrajatīti prayogasya nānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśa prakarṣaḥ ca kāraka antara apekṣaḥ grāhyaḥ na tu karaṇa antara apekṣaḥ kāraka sāmānya vācinaḥ sādhaka śabdāt vihitena tamappratyayena kāraka avadhika prakarṣasya eva bodhanāt karaṇa antara apekṣa prakarṣasya karaṇa antare bhāvāt ca tena rayena dīpikayā pathā vrajati iti prayogasya nā anupapattiḥ

original: nahyatra rathāpekṣayā dīpikāyāṃ dīpikāpekṣayā vā rathe kiyānapi prakarṣaḥ pratīyate?| tādṛśavyāpāreti| phalaniṣpattyavyavahitapūrvavartī yo vyāpārastadviśiṣṭaṃ yatkāraṇaṃ tadeva karaṇamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca vyāpārāśrayayoḥ karaṇatṛtīyāśakyatve sādhakatamamiti sūtrameva pramāmamityāśayaḥ|

original: yadyapi taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau dhātvarthaphalarūpakarmadvārā kriyāśrayatvaṃ taṇḍula derasti tathā'pi vyāpārajanyaphalāśrayatvasattvena parayā karmasaṃjñayā bādhānna doṣa iti bodhyam| pare tvadhikaraṇakārakasya kartrādāvevānvayaḥ kaṭe śete ityādau kaṭādhikaraṇakacaitrakartṛkaśayanamityādirītyā bodhāt| tad‌dvārakamevāsya kriyānvayitvam|

original: udāsīnamityanena dhruvapadārtha uktaḥ| audāsīnyaṃ kriyānāśrayatvamityāha-anāśraya iti| pratyāsattyā prakṛtadhātūpattiviśleṣahetukriyānāśraya ityarthaḥ| taccodāsīnaṃ calaṃ vā'calaṃ vā kathamapyastutad‌dhruvamevocyate| nanu niruktamudāsīnaṃ yadyacalaṃ tadā ghruvamucyatāṃ, paraṃtu yadi calaṃ tadā kathaṃ dhruvamucyata ityāśaṅkyā''ha-atadāveśāditi|

original: viśleṣasya dviṣṭhatvena viśleṣāśrayayordvayormadhye yadviśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayastadapādānamityukte tādṛśakriyānāśrayasya saṃjñino'rthādviśleṣāśrayatvaṃ labhyata ityāśayenā''ha-evaṃ ceti| apāye dhruvamityanena viśleṣajanakakriyāśūnyatvavivakṣaṇe cetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: viśleṣasya dviṣṭha tvena viśleṣa āśrayayoḥ dvayoḥ madhye yat viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśrayaḥ tat apādānam iti ukte tādṛśa kriyā anāśrayasya saṃjñinā ūrthāt viśleṣa āśraya tvam labhyate iti āśayena āha evam ca iti apāye dhruvam iti anena viśleṣa janaka kriyā śūnyatva vivakṣaṇe ca iti arthaḥ

original: viśleṣetyādi satītyantaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ yadi nocyeta tarhi prayāgātkāśīṃ gacchati caitra ityatra gantari caitre'pādānasaṃjñāyā ativyāptiḥ syāt| gacchaterviśleṣajanakakriyāvācitvena viśleṣasya ca dviṣṭhatvena prayāga iva caitre'pi sattvāviśeṣāt| tathā ca kartṛsaṃjñāṃ bādhitvā'pādānasaṃjñaiva syāt|
analyzed: viśleṣa ityādi sati ityantam viśeṣaṇam yadi nā ucyeta tarhi prayāgāt kāśīm gacchati caitraḥ iti atra gantari ativyāptiḥ syāt gacchateḥ viśleṣa janaka kriyā vāci tvena viśleṣasya ca dviṣṭha tvena prayāge iva caitre pi sattva aviśeṣāt tathā ca kartṛ saṃjñām bādhitvā apādāna saṃjñā eva syāt

original: kartṛsaṃjñāyāstu taṇḍulaṃ pacati caitra ityādāvavakāśa iti bhāvaḥ| satyantaviśeṣaṇoktau tu caitrasya viśleṣāśrayatve'pi viśleṣajanakakriyāśrayatvena noktātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| atha yadi viśleṣāśrayatvamiti viśeṣyaṃ nocyeta tarhi pūrvokta eva prayoge kāśyāṃ karmaṇyativyāptiḥ syāt| prayāgasyeva kāśyā api viśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayatvāt|
analyzed: kartṛ saṃjñāyāḥ tu taṇḍulam pacati caitraḥ ityādau avakāśaḥ iti bhāvaḥ sati anta viśeṣaṇa uktau tu caitrasya viśleṣa āśraya tve pi viśleṣa janaka kriyā āśraya tvena na ukta ativyāptiḥ iti bhāvaḥ atha yadi viśleṣa āśraya tvam iti viśeṣyam na ucyeta tarhi pūrva ukte eva prayoge kāśyām karmaṇi ativyāptiḥ syāt prayāgasya iva kāśyāḥ api viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśraya tvāt

original: viśeṣyoktau tu prayāgasyeva kāśyā viśleṣāśrayatvābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ| tathā ca kartari karmaṇi cetyubhayatrātivyāptivāraṇāya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyobhayamupāttam| avedaṃ bodyam-gacchati, yāti, iyarti, atati, ityādau tattaddhātorvibhāgajanakakriyāvācitve'pi vibhāgasya tattaddhātuvācyatvābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: viśeṣya uktau tu prayāgasya iva kāśyāḥ viśleṣa āśraya tva abhāvāt na ativyāptiḥ tathā ca kartari karmaṇi ca iti ubhayatra ativyāpti vāraṇāya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya ubhayam upāttam bodyam gacchati yāti iyarti atati ityādau tad tad dhātoḥ vibhāga janaka kriyā vāci tve api vibhāgasya tad tad dhātu vācyatva abhāvaḥ

original: ata eva tādṛśavibhāgasya dhātuvācyavyāpārajanyatve'pi phalatvābhāvaḥ| phalatvasya tad‌dhātuvācyavyāpārajanyatve sati taddhātujanyopasthitiviṣayatvāt| yatra ca vibhāgasya dhātuvācyatvābhāvastādṛśavibhāgāśrayasyāpādānatvam| yathā vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatītyādau patadhātvartho vibhāgajanakaḥ saṃyogānukūlavyāpāraḥ|
analyzed: atas eva tādṛśa vibhāgasya dhātu vācya vyāpāra janya tve pi phalatva abhāvaḥ phalatvasya tad dhātu vācya vyāpāra janya tve sati tad dhātu janya upasthiti viṣayatvāt yatra ca vibhāgasya dhātu vācya tva abhāvaḥ tādṛśa vibhāga āśrayasya apādānatvam yathā vṛkṣāt parṇam patati ityādau pata dhātu arthaḥ vibhāga janakaḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ

original: tatra saṃyogasya dhātuvācyatve'pi vibhāgasya tadavācyatvena tādṛśavibhāgaśrayasya vṛkṣasyāpādānatvam| yatra ca vibhāgasya dhātuvācyatvaṃ tatra vibhāgasya phalatvāttādṛśavibhāgāśrayasyāpādānasaṃjñāṃ bādhitvā paratvātkarmasaṃjñaiva bhavati, nāpādānasaṃjñā| yathā vṛkṣaṃ tyajati khaga ityatra vibhāgānukūlo vyāpārastyajadhātvarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra saṃyogasya dhātu vācya tve api vibhāgasya tad avācya tvena tādṛśa vibhāga śrayasya vṛkṣasya apādāna tvam yatra ca vibhāgasya dhātu vācya tvam tatra vibhāgasya phala tvāt tādṛśa vibhāga āśrayasya apādāna saṃjñām bādhitvā paratvāt karma saṃjñā eva bhavati na apādāna saṃjñā yathā vṛkṣam tyajati khagaḥ iti atra vibhāga anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ tyaja dhātu arthaḥ

original: atra vibhāgasya dhātuvācyatvena phalatvāttādṛśavibhāgāśrayasya vṛkṣasya karmasaṃjñaiva bhavati, nāpādānasaṃjñā, vibhāgasya dhātuvācyatvāditi| navīnamate pūrvoktadhātuṣvapi vibhāgasyāpi dhātuvācyatvam| ata eva avadhitvaṃ ca `prakṛtadhātūpāttavibhāgajanakavyāpārānāśrayatve sati prakṛtadhātvarthavibhāgāśrayatvaṃ, iti vadanti|
analyzed: atra vibhāgasya dhātu vācya tvena phalatvāt tādṛśa vibhāga āśrayasya vṛkṣasya karma saṃjñā eva bhavati na apādāna saṃjñā vibhāgasya dhātu vācya tvāt iti navīna mate pūrvokta dhātuṣu api vibhāgasya api dhātu vācya tvam atas eva avadhi tvam ca prakṛta dhātu upātta vibhāga janaka vyāpāra anāśraya tve sati prakṛta dhātvartha vibhāga āśraya tvam iti vadanti

original: tatra grāmādāyāti, grāmādvibhajate, ityādau vibhāgasamānādhikaraṇavyāpārārthakadhātuyoge vibhāgasya phalatve'pi tādṛśavibhāgāśrayasyāpādānatvam| vṛkṣaṃ tyajatītyādau vibhāgavyadhikaraṇavyāpārārthakadhātuyoge vibhāgāśrayasya karmatvamiti vyavasthā|
analyzed: tatra grāmāt āyāti grāmāt vibhajate ityādau vibhāga samāna adhikaraṇa vyāpāra arthaka dhātu yoge vibhāgasya phala tve pi tādṛśa vibhāga āśrayasya apādāna tvam vṛkṣam tyajati ityādau vibhāga vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra arthaka dhātu yoge vibhāga āśrayasya karma tvam iti vyavasthā

original: evaṃ ca prayāgātkāśīṃ gacchatītyādau vibhāgasya dhātvarthatve'pi vyāpārasamānādhikaraṇavibhāgasya pratītyā tādṛśavibhāgāśrayasya prayāgasya na karmatvam| vyāpāravyadhikaraṇavibhāgāśrayasyaiva karmatvāditi bodhyam| apādānatvalakṣaṇaghaṭakasatyantaviśeṣaṇasya vyāvartyamāha-vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatīti|
analyzed: evam ca prayāgāt kāśīm gacchati ityādau vibhāgasya dhātvartha tve pi vyāpāra samāna adhikaraṇa vibhāgasya pratītyā tādṛśa vibhāga āśrayasya prayāgasya na karmatvam vyāpāra vyadhikaraṇa vibhāga āśrayasya eva karma tvāt iti bodhyam apādānatva lakṣaṇa ghaṭaka sati anta viśeṣaṇasya vyāvartyam āha vṛkṣāt parṇam patati iti

original: atra vibhāgajanyasaṃyogānukūlavyāpāraḥ patadhātvarthaḥ| atra parṇavṛttiryaḥ saṃyogānukūlavyāpāraḥ sa vṛkṣaparṇayorvibhāgajanakaḥ, vibhāgaśca saṃyogavad‌dviṣṭhatvena vṛkṣaparṇaitadubhayaniṣṭhaḥ|
analyzed: atra vibhāga janya saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ pata dhātvarthaḥ atra parṇa vṛttiḥ yaḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ sa vṛkṣa parṇayoḥ vibhāga janakaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca saṃyoga vat dviṣṭha tvena vṛkṣa parṇa etad ubhaya niṣṭhaḥ

original: evaṃ sthite yadi viśleṣāśrayatvamapādānatvamityevocyeta tadā vṛkṣasyeva parṇasyāpi viśleṣāśrayatvādapādānasaṃjñā prasajyeta, tadvāraṇāya satyantaṃ viśeṣaṇamuktam| tataśca parṇasya viśleṣāśrayatve'pi viśleṣajanakavyāpārāśrayatvenāpādānasaṃjñāyā vyāvṛttiḥ sidhyati|
analyzed: evam sthite yadi viśleṣa āśraya tvam apādāna tvam iti eva ucyeta tadā vṛkṣasya iva parṇasya api viśleṣa āśraya tvāt apādāna saṃjñā prasajyeta tad vāraṇāya satī antam viśeṣaṇam uktam tatas ca parṇasya viśleṣa āśraya tve pi viśleṣa janaka vyāpāra āśraya tvena apādāna saṃjñāyāḥ vyāvṛttiḥ sidhyati

original: nanu viśleṣāśrayatve sati prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyānāśrayatvamityetāvataiva parṇe'tiprasaṅgavāraṇe sati viśleṣahetviti kriyāviśeṣaṇaniveśanasya kiṃ prayojanamityāśaṅkyā''ha-dhāvato'śvāditi| atrāpi patadhātvarthaḥ pūrvavadeva|
analyzed: nanu viśleṣa āśraya tve sati prakṛta dhātu upātta kriyā anāśraya tvam iti etāvatā eva parṇa iti prasaṅga vāraṇe sati viśleṣa hetu iti kriyā viśeṣaṇa niveśanasya kim prayojanam iti āśaṅkya āha dhāvatā ūśvāt iti atra api pata dhātu arthaḥ pūrvavat eva

original: aśvārūḍhapuruṣaniṣṭho yaḥ saṃyogānukūlavyāpāraḥ, so'śvapuruṣayorvibhāgajanaka ityaśvasya vibhāgāśrayatve'pi dhāvata iti viśeṣaṇātprakṛtadhātūpāttadhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭatvātprakṛtaṛdhātūpāttakriyānāśrayatvābhāvenāśvasyāpādānatvaṃ na syādato viśleṣahetviti kriyāyā viśeṣaṇaṃ dattam|
analyzed: aśva ārūḍha puruṣa niṣṭhaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ saḥ ūśva puruṣayoḥ vibhāga janakaḥ iti aśvasya vibhāga āśraya tve api dhāvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇāt prakṛta dhātu upātta dhāvana kriyā viśiṣṭa tvāt prakṛta ṛ dhātu upātta kriyā nāśraya tva abhāvena aśvasya apādāna tvam na syāt atas viśleṣa hetu iti kriyāyāḥ viśeṣaṇam dattam

original: tena cāśvasya ṛdhātūpāttadhāvanakriyāyuktatve'pi viśleṣahetupatadhātūpāttasaṃyogānukūlakriyānāśrayatvādapādānasaṃjñā pravartate, viśleṣahetukriyāyā aśvārūḍhapuruṣamātraniṣṭhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| etenāśvasya calatve'pi yasmādaśvādasau patati tasya patatastādṛśo'pyaśvo dhruva eveti spaṣṭīkṛtam|
analyzed: tena ca aśvasya ṛ dhātu upātta dhāvana kriyā yukta tve pi viśleṣa hetu pata dhātu upātta saṃyoga anukūla kriyā anāśraya tvāt apādāna saṃjñā pravartate viśleṣa hetu kriyāyāḥ aśva ārūḍha puruṣa mātra niṣṭha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ etena aśvasya cala tve pi yasmāt aśvāt asau patati tasya patataḥ tādṛśaḥ upi aśvaḥ dhruvaḥ eva iti spaṣṭīkṛtam

original: vṛkṣāvadhikavibhāgajanakaḥ parṇaniṣṭhaḥ saṃyogānukūlavyāpāra iti bodhaḥ vṛkṣātparṇaṃ patatītyatra bodhyaḥ| aśvātpatatītyukte yatkiṃcidatarakriyānāśrayatvadaśāyāmevāśvasyāpādānatvaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkā syādatastannivṛttaye dhāvata ityaśvaviśeṣaṇamupāttam| aśvāvadhikavibhāgajanakaḥ saṃyogānūkūlavyāpāro'śvavāraniṣṭha iti rītyā bodhaḥ|
analyzed: vṛkṣa avadhika vibhāga janakaḥ parṇa niṣṭhaḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ vṛkṣāt parṇam patati iti atra bodhyaḥ aśvāt patati iti ukte yat kiṃcid atara kriyā anāśraya tva daśāyām eva aśvasya apādāna tvam bhavati iti āśaṅkā syāt atas tad nivṛttaye dhāvataḥ iti aśva viśeṣaṇam upāttam aśva avadhika vibhāga janakaḥ saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra ūśvavāra niṣṭhaḥ iti rītyā bodhaḥ

original: nanu kuḍ‌yātpatato'svātpatatītyatra patata iti viśeṣaṇādviśleṣajanakakriyāśrayatvapratīteraśvasyāpādānatvaṃ na syādityāśaṅkyā''ha-yasmādaśvāditi| yasmādaśvādasau patati so'śvo yatkiṃcidavādhikavibhāgajanakakriyāśrayo'pi patatastasya dhruva eva viśleṣajanakakriyānaśraya evetyartha| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-atra prayoge viśleṣajanike dve kriye vartete|
analyzed: nanu kuḍyāt patataḥ ūsvāt patati iti atra patataḥ iti viśeṣaṇāt viśleṣa janaka kriyā āśraya tva pratīteḥ aśvasya apādāna tvam na syāt iti āśaṅkya āha yasmāt aśvāt iti yasmāt aśvāt asau patati saḥ ūśvaḥ patataḥ tasya dhruvaḥ eva viśleṣa janaka kriyā anaśrayaḥ eva iti artha ayam bhāvaḥ atra prayoge viśleṣa janike dve kriye vartete

original: tatraikā kuḍyāvadhikaviśleṣajanikā, sā'śvaniṣṭhā, dvitīyā tvaśvāvadhikaviśleṣajanikā, sā puruṣaniṣṭhā| tathā''śrayabhedādviśleṣo'pi dvividhaḥ kuḍyāśvayorviśleṣaḥ, sa ca kuḍyāvadhiko'śvaniṣṭhaḥ| aśvāśvārohayorviśleṣaśca dvitīyaḥ, sa cāśvāvadhiko'śvārohaniṣṭhaḥ|
analyzed: tatra ekā kuḍya avadhika viśleṣa janikā sā aśva niṣṭhā dvitīyā tu aśva avadhika viśleṣa janikā sā puruṣa niṣṭhā tathā āśraya bhedāt viśleṣaḥ api dvividhaḥ kuḍya aśvayoḥ viśleṣaḥ sa ca kuḍya avadhika ūśva niṣṭhaḥ aśva aśva ārohayoḥ viśleṣaḥ ca dvitīyaḥ sa ca aśva avadhika ūśva āroha niṣṭhaḥ

original: evaṃ sthite viśleṣahetukriyānāśrayetyatra viśleṣasāmānyopādānena niruktasthale'svasyāpādānatvānupapattiśaṅkā, yanniṣṭhaviśleṣāvadhitvaṃ tadviśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayatvamityevaṃ viśleṣaviśeṣopādāne noktānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: evam sthite viśleṣa hetu kriyā anāśrayā iti atra viśleṣa sāmānya upādānena nirukta sthale svasya apādānatva anupapatti śaṅkā yat niṣṭha viśleṣa avadhi tvam tad viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśraya tvam iti evam viśleṣa viśeṣa upādāne na ukta anupapattiḥ

original: kuḍ‌yātpatato'śvātpatatītyatrāśvasyāsvāśvārohaniṣṭhaviśleṣāvadhitvaṃ, tādṛśa(aśvāśvārohaniṣṭha)viśleṣajanakakriyāyā aśvārohamātraniṣṭhāyā aśve'sattvenāśvasya tadviśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayatvādapādānatvamupapadyate|
analyzed: kuḍyāt patataḥ uśvāt patati iti atra aśvasya asva aśva āroha niṣṭha viśleṣa avadhi tvam tādṛśa aśva aśva āroha niṣṭha viśleṣa janaka kriyāyāḥ aśva āroha mātra niṣṭhāyāḥ aśve sattvena aśvasya tad viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśraya tvāt apādāna tvam upapadyate

original: yadyapyaśvasya kuḍyāśvaviśleṣajanakakriyāśrayatvaṃ vidyate tathā'pi sā kriyā aśvāśvārohaviśleṣajanikā na bhavatītyaśvasya tad‌viśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayatvaṃ nirbādhamityāśayenā''ha-tadviśleṣahetukriyetyādi viśeṣaṇīyamityantam|
analyzed: yadi api aśvasya kuḍya aśva viśleṣa janaka kriyā āśraya tvam vidyate tathā api sā kriyā aśva aśva āroha viśleṣa janikā na bhavati iti aśvasya tad viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśraya tvam nirbādham iti āśayena āha tad viśleṣa hetu kriyā ityādi viśeṣaṇīyam ityantam

original: tacchabdārthasya yacchabdārthasāpekṣatvāt-yadviśleṣāvadhitvaṃ tadviśleṣahetukriyānāśrayatve satītyevaṃ yattaccabdābhyāṃ nirvṛtto viśleṣavyāktiviśeṣo'vadhilakṣaṇe praveśanīya ityāśayaḥ| tathā cāśvasyāśvārohaniṣṭhaviśleṣajanakakriyānāśrayatvamaviruddhamita bhāvaḥ| evaṃ kuḍyāderapi dhruvatvaṃ sidhyatītyāha-tasyāpīti|
analyzed: tad śabda arthasya yad śabda artha sāpekṣa tvāt yad viśleṣa avadhi tvam tad viśleṣa hetu kriyā anāśraya tve sati iti evam yat tad cabdābhyām nirvṛttaḥ viśleṣa vyākti viśeṣaḥ uvadhi lakṣaṇe praveśanīyaḥ iti āśayaḥ tathā ca aśvasya aśva āroha niṣṭha viśleṣa janaka kriyā anāśraya tvam aviruddham ita bhāvaḥ evam kuḍya ādeḥ api dhruva tvam sidhyati iti āha tasya api iti

original: yasmādaśvādayaṃ patati tasyāpyaśvasya patane kuḍyādidhruvaṃ bhavati| kuḍyāśvaniṣṭhaviśleṣajanakakriyāyā aśvamātraniṣṭhāyāḥ kuḍyādāvasattvena kuḍyādestadviśleṣa(kuḍyāśvaviśleṣa) janakakriyānāśrayatvādityarthaḥ|

original: rajakāyetyādiprayogasya ca mukhyatvopagamāt| evaṃ na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyādityapyata eva saṃgacchate| tatra dadātirbodhanārthaḥ| matiśabdastajjanakavedādiparaḥ| śūdrasaṃpradānakaṃ jñānajanakavadādikarmakaṃ yadbodhanaṃ tanna kuryādityartho jñeḥ| saṃpradānasaṃjñāyā anvarthatvaṃ manyamānānāṃ vṛttikārāṇāṃ mataṃ varṇayati-vṛttikārāstviti|

original: samyak pradīyate yasmāyiti| anvarthasaṃjñayeti| tathā ca svasvatvanivṛttipūrvaka parasvatvottyanukūlo vyāpāro dādhātvartha iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca rajakāya vastraṃ dadātītyādau niruktadādhātvarthābhāvādrajakasya vastraṃ dadātītyevaṃ saṃbandhasāmānye ṣaṣṭhyeveti vadanti| vipāya gāṃ dadātī yatra dānakriyākarmībhūtagosaṃbandhāya vipro dānakriyoddeśyaḥ|

original: goviprayoḥ svasvāmibhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| tathā ca viproddeśyakaḥ, gokarmakaḥ, parasvatvotpattyanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| maitrāya vārtāḥ kathayatītyatra kathanākriyākarmībhūtavārtāsabandhāya maitraḥ kathanakriyoddeśyaḥ| maitravārtayorjñātṛjñeyabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ| tathā ca maitrābhinnasaṃpradānakaṃ vārtākarmakaṃ kathanamiti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: go viprayoḥ sva svāmi bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tathā ca vipra uddeśyakaḥ go karmakaḥ para sva tva utpatti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ maitrāya vārtāḥ kathayati iti atra kathanā kriyā karmībhūta vārtā sabandhāya maitraḥ kathana kriyā uddeśyaḥ maitra vārtayoḥ jñātṛ jñeya bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tathā ca maitra abhinna saṃpradānakam vārtā karmakam kathanam iti bodhaḥ

original: tadvibhajate-idaṃ ceti| karmaṇā yamabhipraitītyanenoktaṃ saṃpradānaṃ cetyarthaḥ| asya trividhamityanenānvayaḥ| vibhāgaśca saṃpradānatvāvāntaradharmapuraskāreṇa kathanam| anirākaraṇāditi| tyāgāṅgamiti| tyāgo-dānaṃ, tasyāṅgaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ, samabhivyāhṛtadhātvarthe tyāge viśeṣaṇatayā pratīyamānatvaṃ tyāgāṅgatvamityarthaḥ| karmaṇepsitamiti|
analyzed: tat vibhajate idam ca iti karmaṇā yam abhipraiti iti anena uktam saṃpradānam ca iti arthaḥ asya trividham iti anena anvayaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca saṃpradāna tva avāntara dharma puraskāreṇa kathanam anirākaraṇāt iti tyāga aṅgam iti tyāgaḥ udānam tasya aṅgam viśeṣaṇam samabhivyāhṛta dhātvarthe tyāge viśeṣaṇatayā pratīyamāna tvam tyāga aṅga tvam iti arthaḥ karmaṇā īpsitam iti

original: samabhivyāhṛtadhātvarthatyāgajanyaphalāśrayarūpakarmaṇā saṃbandhumabhipreyamāṇamityarthaḥ| tathā ca tyāgāṅgaṃ sat yatkarpaṇā saṃbandhumabhipreyamāṇaṃ tatkārakaṃ, karturanirākaraṇāt, tathā kartuḥ preraṇayā, karturanumatipradānena ca saṃpradānatāṃ labhate ityarthaḥ| tatrānirākaraṇahetukaṃ saṃpradānaṃ pradarśayati-sūryāyeti|
analyzed: samabhivyāhṛta dhātvartha tyāga janya phala āśraya rūpa karmaṇā saṃbandhum abhipreyamāṇam iti arthaḥ tathā ca tyāga aṅgam sat yat karpaṇā saṃbandhum abhipreyamāṇam tat kārakam kartuḥ anirākaraṇāt tathā kartuḥ preraṇayā kartuḥ anumati pradānena ca saṃpradāna tām labhate iti arthaḥ tatra anirākaraṇa hetukam saṃpradānam pradarśayati sūryāya iti

analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ loke karma ādi padānām karmatva viśiṣṭe śaktatvena dharmi paratvena pratīteḥ śāstre pi dharmi paratva āvaśyakatvāt anyathā karma tve dvitīya ityādi eva vadet na tu karmaṇi karaṇe ityādi iti tathā ca karma ādi padānām karmatva ādi dharma vācakatve sūtra svarasa bhaṅgaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: niruktasthale karmavācakakṛdādipratyayānāṃ dharmivācakatāyā dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca tayorevetyādisūtravihitaktādīnāṃ dharmivācakatvavatkarmaṇi dvitīyetyādāvapi dharmivācakatvameva yuktamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu karmaṇi dvitīyetyādeḥ karmaṇi śaktigrahakasūtrasya, phalasya dhātulabhyatayā āśrayamātre śaktigrāhakatvakalpanayā bhavanmate'pi sūtrasvarasabhaṅgāpattiḥ| lāghavānurodhena āśrayamātre tatkalpanamiticenmamāpi mate lāghavāddharme tatkalpanamiti tulyamevetyata āha-dvitīyādyarthaketi| prāptodaka iti| dharmivācakatveti|

analyzed: prāpta udakaḥ iti atas udadaka kartṛka prāpti karma iti ākāraka samāsa arthasya grāmasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇya viṣayaka bodhasya anubhava siddhasya nirvāhāya dvitīyāyāḥ karmaṇi śaktiḥ āvaśyakī anyathā dvitīyā arthaka bahuvrīheḥ api karmatva bodhaka tva āpattyā sāmānādhikaraṇī anupapatteḥ karma di padānām dharmi vācakatāyām bhāṣyam api pramāṇam iti āha supām karma ādayaḥ iti

original: yadi dvitīyādisub‌vibhaktīnāṃ karmatvādidharmo'rtho vācyatvenābhipretaḥ syāttarhi supāṃ karmatvādayo'pyarthā ityeva vadet| yasamācca tathā noktaṃ tasmātkarmatvādidharmāṇāṃ dvitīyādivibhaktivācyatvaṃ munitrayāsaṃmatatvādaprāmāṇikamiti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu karmaṇi dvitīyetyādau karmādipade lakṣaṇāpattāvapi dvitīyādīnāṃ dharmamātravācakatvamucitaṃ lāghavāt, astu ca bahuvrīherapi dharmayātravācakatvaṃ, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca lakṣaṇayopapādyamityata āha-iti digiti| digarthastu evaṃ sati kṛtastaddhitasyāpi tavyāderdharmivācakatvaṃ na sidhyet|
analyzed: nanu karmaṇi dvitīyā ityādau karma ādi pade lakṣaṇā āpattau api dvitīya ādīnām dharma mātra vācakatvam ucitam lāghavāt astu ca bahuvrīheḥ api sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca lakṣaṇayā upapādyam iti atas āha eti diś iti diś arthaḥ tu evam sati kṛtaḥ taddhitasya api tavya ādeḥ dharmi vācakatvam na sidhyet

original: `ektavyāstaṇḍulāḥ' ityādau taṇḍulādisāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavānurodhātteṣāṃ dharmivācakatvamiti cenna| lakṣaṇayaiva sāmānādhikaraṇyopapatteḥ| paktavya ityāditaḥ karmatvamātrabodho'nubhavaviruddha iti cetprāptodakādāvapi sa tulya iti bhāvaḥ|

analyzed: nanu dvitīya ādīnām āśraye pi na śaktiḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātu labhya tva vat āśrayasya api prakṛti bhūta prātipadikena labhya tvāt api tu āśraya tva mātre ananya labhya tvāt dharma dharmiṇoḥ ca amedāt karmaṇi ityādi nirdeśaḥ na anupapannaḥ atas eva dvitīya ādeḥ karmatva ādi śakti vācaka tvam iti siddhānte prāpta udaka ādi bahuvrīheḥ dharmi bodhaka tā nirvāhaḥ

original: evaṃ kārakavibhaktyarthaṃ pratipādya prasaṅgasaṃgatyā ṣaṣṭhyarthaṃ pratipādayati kārikāyāṃ-saṃbandha iti| śeṣa ṣaṣṭhī iti| kārakaprātipadikārthavyatirekaḥ svasvābhibhāvādisaṃbandhaḥ śeṣapadārthastatra ṣaṣṭhīvidhānāttasyāḥ saṃbandho'rtha ityarthaḥ| tatretaravibhaktīnāmekīyamate dharmivācakatvavadasyā api tathā bhramaḥ|

original: syāttaṃ nirākurvannāha sāre-saṃbandhamātramiti| mātrapadena saṃbandhivyavacchedaḥ| sa ca saṃbandhaḥ kvacitsaṃbandhatvasāmānyarūpeṇa vācyaḥ| yathā mātuḥ smaratītyādau| kvacittu viśeṣarūpeṇa vācyaḥ| yathā-rājapuruṣa ityādau| kārakaṣaṣṭhyā iti| kartṛkarpaṇoḥ kṛtītyādisūtravihitaṣaṣṭhyāstu tatkārakatvaśaktirarthaḥ| śaktiḥ kārakamitīti|

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-saptamīpañcamyau-atra kārakaśabdaḥ kartṛtvādiśaktiparaḥ, na tu kartrādiparaḥ, vyākhyānāt| madhyasya pūrvaparāvadhidvayasāpekṣatvākārakayormadhyamiti vigrahaḥ| kālādhvanorityanuvartate| tathā ca śaktidvayamadhye yau kālādhvānau tadvācakātsaptamīpañcamyau sta iti tadarthaḥ| udāo-adya bhuktvā'yaṃ dvyahe dvyahādvā bhokteti|

original: kartṛtvaśaktistu adhikaraṇakālabhedena bhujikriyābhedādbhidyata eveti| ityādi bhāṣye dṛśyate ityarthaḥ| anantarakālavṛttitvaṃ saptamīpañcamīvibhaktyarthaḥ|

original: evaṃ caitaddivusādhikaraṇakabhojanottarakālikaṃ tathāvidhabhojanasamānakartṛkamataddivasānantaravdyahānantarakālavṛtti yadbhojanaṃ tadāśraya ityarthaḥ| ihastho'yaṃ krośe krośādvā lakṣyaṃ vidhyedityatrānantaradeśavṛttitvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ| ihaśabdapratipādyasyaitaddeśādhikaraṇakatvasya sthitāvanvayaḥ|

original: gaṅgāyāmityadhikaraṇam| hasteneti karaṇam| mayeti kartṛkārakam| dīyata iti karmaṇi kriyāpadam| etatsarvamanusaṃdhāya vākyārthabodhaṃ nirdiśati-devadattasaṃbandhinītyādinā manniṣṭho vyāpāra ityantena| kārikāsthaṃ yathāyathamiti padaṃ vivṛṇoti-uktaprakāreṇeti| yathāsve yatāyathamiti nipātanam|

analyzed: ghaṭam janāti iti atas ghaṭa viṣayakam jñānam iti boda anubhavāt dvitīyā vibhakteḥ tādṛśa sthale viṣayatāyām lakṣaṇā iti vadataḥ naiyāyika prācīnān pratyāha supām karma iti iti iti etad artham viśadayati ayam bhāvaḥ ityādinā supām karma ādayaḥ api arthāḥ saṃkhyā ca iti karma ādayaḥ iti ādi padena karaṇa ādi kāraka antara grahaḥ

analyzed: api śabdena śaktiḥ kārakam iti saptamī pañcamyau iti sūtra bhāṣya ukta karma tva ādi śaktayaḥ gṛhyante tathā tiṅām iti tadvat tiṅām api kartṛ karmaṇī saṃkhyā ca arthaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra iti supsu ca iti arthaḥ niyamaḥ iti niyamaḥ hi dvividhaḥ pratyaya niyama ūrtha niyamaḥ ca iti tatra pratyaya niyamaḥ api dvividhaḥ sāmānya apekṣaḥ prakṛta artha apekṣaḥ ca iti

analyzed: liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka tvānām abhāvāt avyayānām karma ādi yogya tva abhāvāt avyayebhyaḥ vibhaktiḥ na prāpnoti iti āha niyamaḥ iti artha niyamaḥ prasiddhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatra karmādyarthayogyaprātipadikāccetkarmaṇi vibhaktistadā dvitīyaṃva, karmādirahite tadyogyaprātipadikārthe prātipadikāccedvibhaktistadā prathamaiva, ityarthaniyamapakṣe karmaṇi dvitīyaiva, prātipadikārthe prathamaiveti niyamena hi yatra karmādyarthasaṃbhavastatraivānyāsāṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃpādyata iti pratyāsattyā karmādyarthayogyetyasya lābhaḥ|
analyzed: tatra karma ādi artha yogya prātipadikāt ced karmaṇi vibhaktiḥ tadā karma ādi rahite tad yogya prātipadika arthe prātipadikāt ced vibhaktiḥ tadā prathamā eva iti artha niyama pakṣe karmaṇi dvitīyā eva prātipadika arthe prathamā eva iti niyamena hi yatra karma ādi artha saṃbhavaḥ tatra eva anyāsām nivṛttiḥ saṃpādyate iti pratyāsattyā karma ādi artha yogyā iti asya lābhaḥ

original: tathā ca karmādyarthaśūnyārthakāvyayādapi vibhaktiḥ sidhyati| karmādyarthayogyāccedvibhaktiḥ karaṇīyā tadā amukārthe prathamā, amukārthe dvitīyā kartavyeti niyamākāraḥ saṃpannaḥ| tataścāvyayānāṃ karmādyarthayogyatvābhāvena niyamākāre praveśābāvānniyamāpravṛttau sāmānyasūpeṇāvyayātsaptāpi vibhaktayo bhavantīti bhāvaḥ|
