original: `liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśātsamānavidhāneṣvaprāptā sārasvatī strītvāt'ityūhalakṣaṇādhikaraṇe paśūnāṃ samānavidhānatve'pi puṃliṅganirdeśānna tatra mantra ityukteḥ| na ca sāmānye napuṃsapamityanuśiṣṭamasmai iti napuṃsakameva meṣīsādhāraṇamastviti vācyam| anvenaṃ mātā manyatāmanu pitetyanvādeśena puṃstvanirṇayāt|
analyzed: liṅga viśeṣa nirdeśāt samāna vidhāneṣu aprāptā sārasvatī strī tva atityūha lakṣaṇa adhikaraṇe paśūnām samāna vidhāna tve pi pum liṅga nirdeśāt na tatra mantraḥ iti ukteḥ na ca sāmānye napuṃsapam iti anuśiṣṭam asmai iti napuṃsakam eva meṣī sādhāraṇam astu iti vācyam anu enam mātā manyatām anu pitā iti anvādeśena puṃstva nirṇayāt

original: anvādeśe napuṃsake enadvaktavya iti vārtikādenadityāpatteriti ceducyate-pūrvopasthitatattadrūpeṇopasthāpakāt, asmai, enamityādipadācchāgatvādiviśiṣṭānāmiva puṃstvādiviśiṣṭānameva paśūnāmupasthityāmeṣyāmapravṛtteḥ saṃbhavādityādirvistaro bṛhadbhūṣaṇe'nusaṃdheya ityāśayavānāha-vistarema prapañcitaṃ bhūṣaṇa iti| catuṣkamiti|
analyzed: anvādeśe napuṃsake enat vaktavyaḥ iti vārtikāt enat iti āpatteḥ iti ced ucyate pūrva upasthita tad tad rūpeṇa upasthāpakāt asmai enam iti ādi padāt chāga tva ādi viśiṣṭānām iva puṃstva ādi viśiṣṭa ānam eva paśūnām upasthityām eṣyāma pravṛtteḥ saṃbhavāt ityādiḥ vistaraḥ bṛhat bhūṣaṇena anusaṃdheyaḥ iti āśayavān āha vistarema prapañcitam bhūṣaṇe iti catuṣkam iti

original: ekatvādisaṃkhyāsahitaṃ svārthadravyaliṅgatrikamityarthaḥ| caturṇāṃ samūhaścatuṣkam| pañcakamiti| pañcānāṃ samūha ityarthaḥ| kartrādikārakasāhitaṃ svārthadravyaliṅgasaṃkhyācatuṣkamityarthaḥ| liṅgasaṃkhyākārakāṇāṃ nāmārthatvaṃ sādhayituṃ śaṅkate-nanviti|

original: anvayavyatirekābhyāmiti ṭābādisamabhivyāhāre'jāśvādipadātstrītvapratīteṣṭābādyabhāve ca strītvāpratīterityevaṃ pratītyapratītirūpābhyāmityarthaḥ| evaṃ saṃkhyākārakaviṣaye'pi ghaṭamiti dvitīyaikavacanaśravaṇādekatvakarmatvayoravagamāttadaśravaṇe ca tayoranavagamālliṅgāditrayasya pratyayārthatvamucitamiti bhāvaḥ| tata eveti| pratyayādevatyarthaḥ|
analyzed: anvaya vyatirekābhyām iti ṭāp ādi samabhivyāhāra ijāśu ādi padāt strītva pratīteḥ ṭāp ādi abhāve ca strītva apratīteḥ iti evam pratīti apratīti rūpābhyām iti arthaḥ evam saṃkhyā kāraka viṣaye api ghaṭam iti dvitīya ekavacana śravaṇāt ekatva karma tvayoḥ avagamāt tad aśravaṇe ca tayoḥ anavagamān liṅga ādi trayasya pratyaya artha tvam ucitam iti bhāvaḥ tatas eva iti pratyayāt eva iti arthaḥ

original: upasthitau-liṅgādīnāmupasthitau jāyāmānāyāṃ satyāṃ pratyayārthatvaniścayānna teṣāṃ nāmārthatvamāśrayituṃ yuktamityāha-satyamiti| satyamiti yāthārthye, tvaduktiryathārthetyarthaḥ| liṅgāditrikasya pratyayārthatvasādhakayuktivattasya nāmārthatvasādhikā'pi yuktirastītyāha-pratyayavarjita iti| dadhi paśyatīti|
analyzed: upasthitau liṅga ādīnām upasthitau jāyāmānāyām satyām pratyaya artha tva niścayāt na teṣām nāma artha tvam āśrayitum yuktam iti āha satyam iti satyam iti yāthārthye tvad uktiḥ yathārthā iti arthaḥ liṅga ādi trikasya pratyaya artha tva sādhaka yukti vat tasya nāma artha tva sādhikā api yuktiḥ asti iti āha pratyaya varjitaḥ iti dadhi paśyati iti

original: svamornapuṃsakāditiśāstrānusāreṇa vaiyākaraṇānāmatra napuṃsakaprakṛtikadvitīyaikavacanāmapratyayajñānam| itareṣāṃ tvam‌pratyayāśravaṇānnāsti pratyayajñānam| pratyayajñānābhāve'pi ca klībatvaikatvobhayaviśiṣṭadādhikarmakaṃ darśanamiti bodhodayasya tadvākyādanubhavasiddhatvena liṅgāditrikasya prakṛtyarthatvaṃ sidhyati|
analyzed: su amoḥ napuṃsakāt iti śāstra anusāreṇa vaiyākaraṇānām atra napuṃsaka prakṛtika dvitīya eka vaca nāma pratyaya jñānam itareṣām tvampratyaya aśravaṇāt na asti pratyaya jñānam pratyaya jñāna abhāve pi ca klība tva eka tva ubhaya viśiṣṭa da adhikarmakam darśanam iti bodha udayasya tad vākyāt anubhava siddha tvena liṅga ādi trikasya prakṛti artha tvam sidhyati

original: anyathā'nubhavavirodhaḥ spaṣṭaeva| paśyatītyādāvityādipadena rājā'miyaṃ gacchatītyādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ| kiṃca śāstreṇa prakṛtereva liṅgamanuśiṣṭaṃ dṛśyata iti liṅgasya nāmārthatvamevocitamityāha-liṅgānuśāsanasyeti| ata eveti| liṅgādivayasya pratyayavācyatve prakṛtivācyatve cetyubhayatrāpi yukteḥ sattvādevetyarthaḥ| na nirbandha iti|
analyzed: anyathā anubhava virodhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva paśyati ityādau iti ādi padena rājām iyam gacchati ityādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ kiṃca śāstreṇa prakṛteḥ eva liṅgam anuśiṣṭam dṛśyate iti liṅgasya nāma artha tvam eva ucitam iti āha liṅga anuśāsanasya iti atas eva iti liṅga ādi vayasya pratyaya vācya tve prakṛti vācya tve ca iti ubhayatra api yukteḥ sattvāt eva iti arthaḥ na nirbandhaḥ iti

original: pratyayavācyatvameva samīcīnamathavā prakṛtivācyatvameva samīcīnamityevaṃvidha āgraho na dhartavya ityarthaḥ| ubhayatra yuktisattve'pi lāghavānurodhena liṅgāditrayasya pratyayavācyatvaṃ yuktamityāha-vācakatāyā yuktatvāditi| anantaprakṛtīnāṃ vācakatvakalpane gauravāttadapekṣayā svalpataraṭābādisvādipratyayānāṃ vācakatvakalpane lāghavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pratyaya vācya tvam eva samīcīnam athavā prakṛti vācya tvam eva samīcīnam iti evaṃvidhaḥ āgrahaḥ na dhartavyaḥ iti arthaḥ ubhayatra yukti sattve api lāghava anurodhena liṅga ādi trayasya pratyaya vācya tvam yuktam iti āha vācakatāyāḥ yukta tvāt iti ananta prakṛtīnām vācaka tva kalpane gauravāt tad apekṣayā svalpatara ṭāba ādi sva ādi pratyayānām vācaka tva kalpane lāghavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ṭāvādistrīpratyayaṃ vinā'pi vāk‌śaradādiśabdebhyaḥ strītvabodhasya sarvajanānubhavasiddhatvena kāraṇābhāve'pi kāryasattvarūpavyatirekavyabhicārātprakṛtipratyayayoritinyāyena pratyayārthatvālliṅgasya prādhānyāpatteśca liṅgasya nāmārthatvameva| saṃkhyākārakayostu nāmārthatvaṃ pratyayārthatvaṃ vetyāha-dyotikā vācikā veti|
analyzed: nanu ṭāva ādi strī pratyayam vinā api vāc śarad ādi śabdebhyaḥ strī tva bodhasya sarva jana anubhava siddha tvena kāraṇa abhāve pi kārya sattva rūpa vyatireka vyabhicārāt prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti nyāyena pratyaya artha tvāt liṅgasya prādhānya āpatteḥ ca liṅgasya nāma artha tvam eva saṃkhyā kārakayoḥ tu nāma artha tvam pratyaya artha tvam vā iti āha dyotikāḥ vācikāḥ vā iti

original: vibhaktīnāṃ dvitvādidyotakatāpakṣe saṃkhyākārakayornāmārthatvaṃ, tāsāṃ tadvācakatāpakṣe saṃkhyākārakayoḥ pratyayārthatvamityevaṃ vākyapadīye hariṇā saṃkhyākārakaviṣaye nāmārthatvaṃ pratyayārthatvaṃ veti pakṣadvayasya varṇanāditi bhāvaḥ| kecittu saṃkhyākārakayorapi nāgārthatvameva|
analyzed: vibhaktīnām dvi tva ādi dyotaka tā pakṣe saṃkhyā kārakayoḥ nāma artha tvam tāsām tad vācaka tā pakṣe saṃkhyā kārakayoḥ pratyaya artha tvam iti evam vākyapadīye hariṇā saṃkhyā kāraka viṣaye nāma artha tvam pratyaya artha tvam vā iti pakṣa dvayasya varṇanāt iti bhāvaḥ kecid tu saṃkhyā kārakayoḥ api nāga artha tvam eva

original: na cānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vibhaktīnāmeva tadvācakatvakalpanamucitamiti vācyam| dadhi paśya, madhu ānayetyādau vibhaktiṃ vinā'pi saṃkhaayākārakapratītyā vyatirekavyabhicārāt| tadevaṃ pañkaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣaḥ śreyān prātipadikājjatiliṅgasaṃkhyākārakaprakārakadravyaviśeṣyakabodhasyaiva sarvānubhavasiddhatvāditi prāhuḥ|
analyzed: na ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām vibhaktīnām eva tad vācaka tva kalpanam ucitam iti vācyam dadhi paśya madhu ānaya ityādau vibhaktim vinā api vyatireka vyabhicārāt tat evam pañkam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣaḥ śreyān prātipadikāt jati liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka prakāraka dravya viśeṣyaka bodhasya eva sarva anubhava siddha tvāt iti prāhuḥ

original: tattatsūtranirdeśaṃ vinā śāstre nirūpitāḥ, iti sāmānyataḥ śāstrapadopādānasya tātparyaṃ vakti-bahuṣu sthaleṣviti| bhāṣyādyākaragrantheṣu tatra tatra sūtre'mīṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ nirūpaṇamastīti sūcayituṃ sāmānyataḥ śāstrapadopādānamityarthaḥ| prādhānyeneti| sarūpasūtre sarveṣāmeva pakṣāṇāṃ bhāṣyakārairnirūpitatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tad tad sūtra nirdeśam vinā śāstre nirūpitāḥ iti sāmānyatas śāstra pada upādānasya tātparyam vakti bahuṣu sthaleṣu iti bhāṣya ādi ākara grantheṣu tatra tatra sūtra imīṣām pakṣāṇām nirūpaṇam asti iti sūcayitum sāmānyatas śāstra pada upādānam iti arthaḥ prādhānyena iti sarūpa sūtre sarveṣām eva pakṣāṇām bhāṣyakāraiḥ nirūpita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: sarūpasūtrādāvityādipadenānabhihitasūtra--tatropapadamitisūtrasthakaiyaṭayoḥ saṃgraho| bodhyaḥ| atredaṃ bodhyam-ekaṃ dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ pañcakaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ, iti pañca pakṣāḥ śāstre tatra tatra nirūpitāḥ santi|
analyzed: sarūpa sūtra ādau iti ādi padena anabhihita sūtra tatra upapadam iti sūtra stha kaiyaṭayoḥ saṃgrahaḥ bodhyaḥ atra idam bodhyam ekam dvikam trikam catuṣkam pañcakam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pañca pakṣāḥ śāstre tatra tatra nirūpitāḥ santi

original: tatra ekaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣo mīmāṃsakamātrasaṃmatatvena nirālambanāyā jāteḥ pratītyananubhavādasaṃbhavaduktikatvena cehopekṣitaḥ| tathā ca āditaḥ dvikaṃ, āditastrikāṃāditaścatuṣkaṃ, saṃkhyātiriktaṃ catuṣkaṃ, āditaḥ pañkaṃ ca prātipadikārtha iti pañca pakṣāḥ|
analyzed: tatra ekam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣaḥ mīmāṃsaka mātra saṃmata tvena nirālambanāyāḥ jāteḥ pratīti ananubhavāt asaṃbhavat uktika tvena ca iha upekṣitaḥ tathā ca āditas dvikam āditas trikām āditas catuṣkam saṃkhyā atiriktam catuṣkam āditas pañkam ca prātipadika arthaḥ iti pañca pakṣāḥ

original: tatra kasmin‌pakṣe'nabhihitasūtramāvaśyakaṃ kasmiṃśca vyarthamiti bhāṣyānusāreṇocyate-āditaḥ-dvikaṃ trikaṃ iti pakṣe saṃkhyā kārakaṃ ca vibhaktyarthaḥ| āditaścatuṣkamiti pakṣe kārakamātraṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ| saṃkhyātiriktaṃ catuṣkamiti pakṣe saṃkhyāmātraṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra kasmin pakṣena abhihita sūtram āvaśyakam kasmin ca vyartham iti bhāṣya anusāreṇa ucyate āditas dvikam trikam iti pakṣe saṃkhyā kārakam ca vibhakti arthaḥ āditas catuṣkam iti pakṣe kāraka mātram vibhakti arthaḥ saṃkhyā atiriktam catuṣkam iti pakṣe saṃkhyā mātram vibhakti arthaḥ

original: pañcakamiti pakṣe saṃkhyākārakayorvibhaktyarthatvaṃ nāstīti tatpakṣe tayorvibhaktidyotyatvameva| dyotyatvenaiva caiṣāṃ, supāṃ karmādayo'pyarthāḥ saṃkhyā caiva tathā tiṅāmityatra bhāṣye vibhaktyarthatvamiti vyavahāraḥ evaṃ ca āditaḥ dikaṃ, trikaṃ, saṃkhyātiriktaṃ catuṣkaṃ ceti pakṣatraye saṃkhyā vibhaktyarthaḥ saṃpadyate|
analyzed: pañcakam iti pakṣe saṃkhyā kārakayoḥ vibhakti artha tvam na asti iti tad pakṣe tayoḥ vibhakti dyotya tvam eva dyotya tvena eva ca eṣām supām karma ādayaḥ api arthāḥ saṃkhyā ca eva tathā tiṅām iti atra bhāṣye vibhakti artha tvam iti vyavahāraḥ evam ca āditaḥ dikam trikam saṃkhyā atiriktam catuṣkam ca iti pakṣa traye saṃkhyā vibhakti arthaḥ saṃpadyate

original: tathā āditaḥ dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ ceti pakṣatraye kārakaṃ vibhaktyartho bhavati| tatra svaujas, karmaṇi dvitīyā, dvyekayoḥ, ityādīnāmekavākyatā| sā cettham‌-svaujas‌ityatra padadvayaṃ-prātipadikāt, am, iti ca| karmaṇi ityatra ca padadvayaṃ-karmaṇi, dvitīyā, iti ca tathā dvyekayorityatrāpi padadvayaṃ-dvyekayoḥ, dvivacanaikavacane, iti ca|
analyzed: tathā āditas dvikam trikam catuṣkam ca iti pakṣa traye kārakam vibhakti arthaḥ bhavati tatra su ojaḥ karmaṇi dvitīyā dvi ekayoḥ ityādīnām ekavākyatā sā ca ittham su ojaḥ iti atra pada dvayam prātipadikāt am iti ca karmaṇi iti atra ca pada dvayam karmaṇi dvitīyā iti ca tathā dvi ekayoḥ iti atra api pada dvayam dvi ekayoḥ dvivacana ekavacane iti ca

original: evaṃ ca ṣaṭ padāni jāyante tatra prāyo vyākaraṇaśāstre kārakapañcamyasaṃbhavena digyogalakṣaṇapañcagī bodhyā| pañcamyartho'vadhiḥ| tathā ca prātipadikāt ityasya pañcamyantasyāvadhibhāvena vidheye am‌pratyaye'nvayaḥ| prātipadikāvadhikaparatvavān am pratyayo bhavatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca ṣaḍ padāni jāyante tatra prāyas vyākaraṇa śāstre kāraka pañcamī asaṃbhavena diś yoga lakṣaṇa pañcagī bodhyā pañcamī arthaḥ uvadhiḥ tathā ca prātipadikāt ityasya pañcamī antasya avadhi bhāvena vidheye am pratyaya invayaḥ prātipadika avadhika paratvavān am pratyayaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: karmāṇīti saptamyantasya niṣṭhatvasaṃbandhena dvyekayorityatrānvayaḥ-karmagate dvitve ekatve ceti| vdyekayorityasya ca vācakatvasaṃbandhenām‌pratyaye'nvayaḥ-ekatvavācako'm bhavatīti| dvitīyā, dvivacanaikavacane ityanayostvabedasaṃbandhenāmyevānvayaḥ-dvitīyaikavacanābhinno'mityarthaḥ|
analyzed: karmāṇi iti saptamī antasya niṣṭhatva saṃbandhena dvi ekayoḥ iti atra anvayaḥ karma gate dvitve ekatve ca iti vdi ekayoḥ iti asya ca vācaka tva saṃbandhena am pratyaya invayaḥ eka tva vācaka ūm bhavati iti dvitīyā dvivacana ekavacane iti anayoḥ tu a beda saṃbandhena ami eva anvayaḥ dvitīya ekavacana abhinna ūm iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca mahāvākyārthaḥ-pātipadikāt karmagataikatvavācako'm pratyayo bhavatīti| ayaṃ ca saṃkhyāvibhaktyarthakapakṣatraye vākyārthaḥ| atra sūtrajabodhe saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyam| kārakavibhaktyarthakapakṣatraye tvityam-saṃkhyāyāḥ sarvatra viśeṣaṇatayaiva bhānaniyamāt vdyekayorityasya ādheyatārsabandhena karmaṇītyatrānvayaḥ| ekatve yatkarmetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca mahā vākya arthaḥ pātipadikāt karma gata ekatva vācaka ūm pratyayaḥ bhavati iti ayam ca saṃkhyā vibhakti arthaka pakṣa traye vākya arthaḥ atra sūtra ja bodhe saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyam kāraka vibhakti arthaka pakṣa traye tu ityam saṃkhyāyāḥ sarvatra viśeṣaṇa tayā eva bhāna niyamāt karmaṇi iti atra anvayaḥ ekatve yat karma iti arthaḥ

original: vṛkṣe śākhetivadekatva iti saptamī ādheyasyā''dhāratvavivakṣayā| evaṃca vākyārthaḥ-prātipadikāt ekatvaviśiṣṭe karmaṇi nāma ekatvaviśiṣṭakarmavācako dvitīyaikavacanamamiti| asmin‌pakṣe sūtrajabodhe karmādeḥ prādhānyam|
analyzed: vṛkṣe śākhā iti vat ekatve iti saptamī ādheyasya ādhāra tva vivakṣayā evam ca vākya arthaḥ prātipadikāt ekatva viśiṣṭe karmaṇi nāma ekatva viśiṣṭa karma vācakaḥ asmin pakṣe sūtra ja bodhe karma ādeḥ prādhānyam

original: pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe tvevaṃ vākyārthaḥ-prātipadikāt tadarthakarmagataikatve dyotye dvitīyaikavacanamam‌pratyayo bhavatīti| ityeko'rthaḥ| āraśca-prātipadikāt tadarthagataikatvaviśiṣṭe karmaṇi dyotye dvitīyaikavacanamam pratyayo bhavatīti| tatra prathamavākyārthe karmagataikatve, ityanvayena sūtrajabodhe saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyam|
analyzed: pañcakam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣe tu evam vākya arthaḥ prātipadikāt tad artha karma gata ekatve dyotye dvitīya eka vacana mam pratyayaḥ bhavati iti iti ekaḥ arthaḥ āraḥ ca prātipadikāt tad artha gata ekatva viśiṣṭe karmaṇi dyotye dvitīya eka vacana mam pratyayaḥ bhavati iti tatra prathama vākya arthe karma gata ekatve iti anvayena sūtra ja bodhe saṃkhyāyāḥ prādhānyam

original: dvitīye tu ekatvaviśiṣṭe karmaṇītyanvayena sūtrajabodhe karmādeḥ prādhānyam| pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣe saṃkhyāyāḥ kārakasya va vibhaktyarthatvaṃ dyotyatvenaiveti prāguktameva|
analyzed: dvitīye tu eka tva viśiṣṭe karmaṇi iti anvayena sūtra ja bodhe karma ādeḥ prādhānyam pañcakam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣe saṃkhyāyāḥ kārakasya vibhakti artha tvam dyotya tvena eva iti prāguktam eva

original: evaṃ sati yadyanabhihita iti sūtraṃ na kriyeta tarhi kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityatra ktena karmamātroktāvapi tadekatvasyānuktatayā, karmagataikatve dyotye dvitīyaikavacanamamiti pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣīyaprathamavākyārthenām durvāraḥ syāt| ato'pradhānakarmādiviśeṣaṇārthamanabhihitādhikāra āvaśyakaḥ|
analyzed: evam sati yadi anabhihitaḥ iti sūtram na kriyeta tarhi kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ iti atra ktena karma mātra uktau api tad ekatvasya anuktatayā karma gata ekatve dyotye dvitīya ekavacanam am iti pañcakam prātipadika arthaḥ iti durvāraḥ syāt durvāraḥ syāt āvaśyakaḥ

original: tathā cānabhihitakarmagataikatve dyotye'm‌pratyaya ityarthena ktena karmaṇa uktatvātkṛtaḥ kaṭa ityatra nām‌pratyayaḥ prāpnotītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca saṃkhyāvibhaktyartha ithi pakṣe'nabhihitādhikāra āvaśyaka iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca anabhihita karma gata ekatve dyotya īṃpratyayaḥ iti arthena ktena karmaṇaḥ ukta tvāt kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ iti atra nāmpratyayaḥ prāpnoti iti arthaḥ evam ca saṃkhyā vibhakti arthaḥ pakṣenabhihita adhikāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca āditaḥ dvikaṃ, trikaṃ, saṃkhyātiriktaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca prātipadikārtha iti pakṣeṣvapi saṃkhyāyā vibhaktyarthatvādanabhihitasūtramāvaśyakamiti bodhyam|
analyzed: tathā ca āditas dvikam trikam saṃkhyā atiriktam catuṣkam ca prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣeṣu api saṃkhyāyāḥ vibhakti artha tvāt anabhihita sūtram āvaśyakam iti bodhyam

original: pañcakaṃ prātipadikārtha iti pakṣīyadvitīyavākyārthe tu ekatvaviśiṣṭe karmaṇītyanvayena sūtrajabodhe karmādeḥ prādhānyātsūtrajabodhaviṣayapradhānaviṣayeṇoktārthānāmitinyāyena kṛtaḥ kaṭa ityādau dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ siddhatvādanabhihatādhikāro'nāvaśyakaḥ| tathā ca kārakaṃ vibhaktyartha iti pakṣe'nabhihitasūtraṃ vyarthamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pañcakam prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣīya dvitīya vākya arthe tu ekatva viśiṣṭe karmaṇi iti anvayena sūtra ja bodhe karma ādeḥ prādhānyāt sūtra ja bodha viṣaya pradhāna viṣayeṇa ukta arthānām iti nyāyena kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ ityādau dvitīyāyāḥ aprāpteḥ siddhatvāt anabhihata adhikāraḥ na āvaśyakaḥ tathā ca kārakam vibhakti arthe iti pakṣena abhihita sūtram vyartham iti bhāvaḥ

original: evamāditaḥ dvikaṃ, trikaṃ, catuṣkaṃ ca prātipadikārtha iti pakṣeṣvapi kārakasya vibhaktyarthatvādanabhihitasūtraṃ vyarthamiti bodhyamiti|| 25 ||
analyzed: evam āditaḥ dvikam trikam catuṣkam ca prātipadika arthaḥ iti pakṣeṣu api kārakasya vibhakti artha tvāt anabhihita sūtram vyartham iti bodhyam iti

original: nanu ghaṭamānayetyādivākyajanyaśābdabodhe ghaṭādiśabdabhānasyānanubhavāttasya prātipadikārthatvasādhanamayuktamityāśaṅkāyāmāha-śabdastāvaditi| śabdo'pītyarthaḥ| bhāsata iti| svārthadravyādivacchabdasyāpi śābdabodhe bhānaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| ātrārthe haryuktiṃ pramāṇayati-na so'stīti|
analyzed: nanu ghaṭam ānaya ityādi vākya janya śābdabodhe ghaṭa ādi śabda bhānasya ananubhavāt tasya prātipadika artha tva sādhanam ayuktam iti āśaṅkāyām āha śabdaḥ tāvat iti śabda upi iti arthaḥ bhāsate iti svārtha dravya ādi vat śabdasya api śābdabodhe bhānam bhavati iti arthaḥ haryuktim pramāṇayati na saḥ asti iti

original: loke-vidvadanubhave tādṛśaḥ śābdabodhātmakaḥ pratyayo nāstyeva, yatra(śābdabodātmakapratyaye) śabdarūpaviśeṣaṇabhānaṃ na bhavatītyetādṛśa ityarthaḥ| yataḥ sarvaṃ jñānaṃ śābdabodātmakaṃ śabdena-śabdarūpaviśeṣaṇenānuviddhaṃ nityasaṃbaddhameva bhāsate pratīyata iti tattacchāstrīyasakalatattvaviṣayakabodānubhavavattamaharyukteriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśaḥ śābdabodha ātmakaḥ pratyayaḥ na asti eva yatra śābdabodha ātmaka pratyaye śabda rūpa viśeṣaṇa bhānam na bhavati iti etādṛśaḥ iti arthaḥ yatas sarvam jñānam śābdaboda ātmakam śabdena śabda rūpa viśeṣaṇena anuviddham nitya saṃbaddham eva bhāsate pratīyate iti tad tad śāstrīya sakala tattva viṣayaka boda anubhava vat tam aharyukteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: yatra pratyakṣajñānaṃ tatrāpi śabdārthayostādātmyādāropitaṃ śabdabhānamastyeveti sūcayitumanukddhimivetīvaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ| pratyakṣādirūpakalajñāne śabdabhānaṃ śabdārthayostādātmyādupapadyata iti yāvat| śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ ca arthaṃ śṛṇoti arthaṃ vadati ityādiprayogānusāreṇānubhavasiddhatvādanapalapanīyam|
analyzed: yatra pratyakṣa jñānam tatra api śabda arthayoḥ tādātmyāt āropitam śabda bhānam asti eva iti sūcayitum anukddhim iva iti iva śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ pratyakṣa ādi rūpa kala jñāne śabda bhānam śabda arthayoḥ tādātmyāt upapadyate iti yāvat śabda arthayoḥ tādātmyam ca artham śṛṇoti artham vadati ityādi prayoga anusāreṇa anubhava siddha tvāt anapalapanīyam

original: nahyarthasya kambugrīvādimataḥ śravaṇaṃ vadanaṃ vā saṃbhavati? kadāpi naiva saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ| kiṃtu tadvācakaśabdasyaiva śravaṇamuccāraṇaṃ vā saṃbhavati| ato'rthaṃ śṛṇotītyādiprayogānupapattiḥ| śabdārthayostādātmyāṅgīkāre tu tattādātmghāpannaṃ śabdaṃ śṛṇotītyarthabodāttādṛśaprayogopapattiḥ|
analyzed: nahi arthasya kambu grīvā ādimataḥ śravaṇam vadanam vā saṃbhavati kadāpi nā eva saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ kiṃtu tad vācaka śabdasya eva śravaṇam uccāraṇam vā saṃbhavati atas ṛtham śṛṇoti ityādi prayoga anupapattiḥ śabda arthayoḥ tādātmya aṅgīkāre tu śabdam śṛṇoti iti artha bodāt tādṛśa prayoga upapattiḥ

original: evaṃ cārthaśravaṇoccāraṇānyathānupapattyā śabdārthayostādātmyamanicchatā'pyaṅgīkāryam| ata eva omityekākṣaraṃ brahma, rāmetidvyakṣaraṃ nāma mānabhaṅgaḥ pinākinaḥ, vṛddhirādaic, ityevamādau śaktigrāhakaśrutismṛtiviṣaye sāmānādhikaraṇyena prayogaśca saṃgacchate|
analyzed: evam ca artha śravaṇa uccāraṇa anyathā anupapattyā śabda arthayoḥ tādātmyam an icchatā api aṅgīkāryam atas eva om iti ekākṣaram brahma rāma iti dvi akṣaram nāma māna bhaṅgaḥ pinākinaḥ vṛddhiḥ āt ai c iti evamādau śakti grāhaka śruti smṛti viṣaye sāmānādhikaraṇyena prayogaḥ ca saṃgacchate

original: yattu śabdārthayostādātbhye'gniśabdoccāraṇe mukhe dāhāpattirityādid‌vaṇaṃ, tattu tādātmyasya tadbhinnatve sati tadabhedena pratīyamānatvena bhedābhedaghaṭitatvānnirākṛtaṃ mañjūvāyām| śabdārthayorbheda eva vāstavo'bhedastvāropitaḥ| vāstavabhedādeva nāgniśabdoccāraṇena mukhe dāhāpattisaṃbhavaḥ| nāpi āropitābhedāttatsaṃbhavaḥ|
analyzed: yat tu śabda arthayoḥ tādātbhya igni śabda uccāraṇe mukhe dāha āpattiḥ ityādi dvaṇam tat tu tādātmyasya tad bhinnatve sati tad abhedena pratīyamāna tvena bheda abheda ghaṭita tvāt nirākṛtam mañjūvāyām śabda arthayoḥ bhedaḥ eva vāstavaḥ bhedaḥ tu āropitaḥ vāstava bhedāt eva na agni śabda uccāraṇena mukhe dāha āpatti saṃbhavaḥ na api āropita abhedāt tad saṃbhavaḥ

original: na hyāropitāgnitvaviśiṣṭaguñjāphalebhyo'gnikāryaṃ dāhādi loke dṛśyate? naiva dṛśyata ityarthaḥ| ato'rthaśabdayostādātmyāṅgīkāre'pi na niruktadūṣaṇāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| nanvevaṃ bhavatu śabdabhānaṃ tathāpi śabdasya nāmārthatvaṃ kathamityata āha-viṣṇumuccārayeti|
analyzed: na hi āropita agni tva viśiṣṭa guñjā phalebhyaḥ agni kāryam dāha ādi loke dṛśyate na eva dṛśyate iti arthaḥ atas ṛtha śabdayoḥ tādātmya aṅgīkāre api na nirukta dūṣaṇa āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu evam bhavatu śabda bhānam tathā api śabdasya nāma artha tvam katham iti atas āha viṣṇum uccāraya iti

original: yadyatra viṣṇupadātsvārthadravyāliṅgādyarthavadviṣṇuśabdasyāpyupasthitirna syāttārhi arthoccāraṇāsaṃbhavena viṣṇumuccārayeti vākyārthabodhānupapattiḥ syāt| ataḥ śabdādarthavatsvavācakaśabdasyāpyupasthitirbhavati| upasthitiścoccaritasamānānupūrvīkasyaiva śabdasya, na nārāyaṇādeḥ paryāyasya|
analyzed: yadi atra viṣṇu padāt svārtha dravya aliṅga ādi arthavat viṣṇu śabdasya api upasthitiḥ na syāt tārhi artha uccāraṇa asaṃbhavena viṣṇum uccāraya iti vākya artha bodha anupapattiḥ syāt atas śabdāt arthavat sva vācaka śabdasya api upasthitiḥ bhavati upasthitiḥ ca uccarita samāna ānupūrvīkasya eva śabdasya na nārāyaṇa ādeḥ paryāyasya

original: tathā ca viṣṇuśabdasyopasthitau satyāṃ tatra vācakatāsaṃbandhenārthasyānvayāccaturbhujarūpārthavācakaṃ viṣṇuśabdamuccārayetyarthabodhodayācchabdo'pi prātipadikārtha iti bhāvaḥ| lakṣaṇayeti| svaśakyasaṃbandharūpayetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca viṣṇu śabdasya upasthitau satyām tatra vācakatā saṃbandhena arthasya anvayāt caturbhuja rūpa artha vācakam viṣṇu śabdam uccāraya iti artha bodha udayāt śabdaḥ api prātipadika arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ lakṣaṇayā iti sva śakya saṃbandha rūpayā iti arthaḥ

original: svaṃ-viṣṇuśabdaḥ, svaśakyaḥ-lakṣmīpatirūpo'rthaḥ, tatsaṃbandho vācyatayā viṣṇuśabde iti svavācyavācakatvasaṃbandhena lakṣaṇayā vākyārthabodhanirvāha iti cenna| tāvatā'pi śabdasya prātipadikārthatvā(prātipadikavācyatvā)siddheḥ| kiṃ ca dvividhā hi lakṣaṇā prayojanavatī nirūḍhā ceti|
analyzed: svam viṣṇu śabdaḥ sva śakyaḥ lakṣmīpati rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ tad saṃbandhaḥ vācyatayā viṣṇu śabde iti sva vācya vācaka tva saṃbandhena lakṣaṇayā vākya artha bodha nirvāhaḥ iti ced na tāvatā api śabdasya prātipadika artha tva aprātipadika vācya tva asiddheḥ kim ca dvividhā hi lakṣaṇā prayojanavatī nirūḍhā ca iti

original: prayojanavatī cet-yathā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra ghoṣe śaityapāvanatvādipratītiḥ prayojanaṃ tadvadatra lakṣaṇāyāḥ prayojanaṃ vaktavyaṃ syāt| prayojanādarśanānnirūḍheti cedāha-śaktyanatirekāditi| nirūḍhalakṣaṇāyāḥ śaktyatiriktatvābhāvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: prayojanavatī ca iti athā gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra ghoṣe śaitya pāvana tva ādi pratītiḥ prayojanam tadvat atra lakṣaṇāyāḥ prayojanam vaktavyam syāt prayojana adarśanāt nirūḍhā iti ced āha śakti anatirekāt iti nirūḍha lakṣaṇāyāḥ śakti atirikta tva abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: yathā'sya śabdasyaitasminnarthe śaktirityanāditātparyagrahavaśābdudhyate tathā nirūḍhalakṣaṇā'pi anāditātparyagrahādhīnetyarthaḥ| anāditātparyaṃ ca yathā viṣṇupadasya lakṣmīpatau prasiddhaṃ, tathā viṣṇuśabde'pīti nirūḍhalakṣaṇāśrayaṇaṃ nāma śaktyāśrayaṇameveti bhāvaḥ| kiṃ ca lakṣaṇāyā na sarvatra saṃbhava ityāha-jabagaḍadaśamuccārayeti|
analyzed: yathā asya śabdasya etasmin arthe śaktiḥ iti anādi tātparya graha vaśāt dudhyate tathā nirūḍha lakṣaṇā api anādi tātparya graha adhīnā iti arthaḥ anādi tātparyam ca yathā viṣṇu padasya lakṣmīpatau prasiddham tathā viṣṇu śabde api iti nirūḍha lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇam nāma śakti āśrayaṇam eva iti bhāvaḥ kim ca lakṣaṇāyāḥ na sarvatra saṃbhavaḥ iti āha ja bagaḍa daśam uccāraya iti

original: niruktasamudāsya kutrāpi śaktatvābhāvādekākṣarakosādiprāmāṇyātpratyekavarṇasya śakyārthasattve'pi jabagaḍadaśetisamudāyāttatpratītyabhāvācca śakyārthāgraheṇa samudāyasya śakyārthābhāvācchakyasaṃbandhātmakalakṣaṇāyā api tatrāsaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: nirukta samudāsya kutra api śakta tva abhāvāt eka akṣara kosa ādi prāmāṇyāt pratyeka varṇasya śakya artha sattve pi ja bagaḍa daśa iti samudāyāt tad pratīti abhāvāt ca śakya artha agraheṇa samudāyasya śakya artha abhāvāt śakya saṃbandha ātmaka lakṣaṇāyāḥ api tatra asaṃbhavāt

original: yatra śakyārtha eva na gṛhyate tatra śakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā vārtā'pi dūrotsāriteti svārthadravyādivacchabdasya svasvarūpe'pi śaktirāśrayaṇīyeti bhāvaḥ| śabdādarthasyeva śabdasyāpyupasthitau tu tādṛśasamudāyasyaiva tādṛśapadaśakyatvena na jabagaḍadaśamaccārayeti vākyārthabodānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: yatra śakya arthaḥ eva na gṛhyate tatra śakya saṃbandha rūpa lakṣaṇāyāḥ vārtā api dūra utsāritā iti svārtha dravya ādi vat śabdasya sva svarūpe api śaktiḥ āśrayaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥ śabdāt arthasya iva śabdasya api upasthitau tu tādṛśa samudāyasya eva tādṛśa pada śakya tvena na vākya artha boda anupapattiḥ

original: nanu tatra śakyārthājñānāllakṣaṇāyā ajñātatve'pi jabagetitattadavayavaśakyārthavācakatvarūpalakṣaṇāyā vastutaḥ sattvādvākyārthatrodho'stvityata āha-ajñātāyā iti|
analyzed: nanu tatra śakyārtha ajñānāt lakṣaṇāyāḥ ajñāta tve pi vastutas sattvāt vākya artha trodhaḥ ustu iti atas āha ajñātāyāḥ iti

original: gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra gaṅgāpadasya vastutaḥ sato'pi svaśakyapravāhasāmīpyasaṃbabhdhasyājñāne lakṣyatīrarūpārthabodhājananena jñātāyā eva vṛtterarthopasthitau prayojakatvamityasyā''vaśyakatvātprakṛte lakṣaṇāyā agrahānna vākyārthabodha udetīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra gaṅgā padasya vastutas sataḥ api sva śakya pravāha sāmīpya saṃbabhdhasya ajñāne lakṣya tīra rūpa artha bodha ajananena jñātāyāḥ eva vṛtteḥ artha upasthitau prayojaka tvam iti asya āvaśyaka tvāt prakṛte lakṣaṇāyāḥ agrahāt na vākya artha bodhaḥ udeti iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu niruktasthale yadākadācijjātavṛttijñānavaśādvākyārthabodho'stvityāgrahe tvāha-gāvamuccārayeti| gāveti bhāṣāsthaḥ śabdaḥ kaścidanarthakaḥ|
analyzed: nanu nirukta sthale yadā kadācid jāta vṛtti jñāna vaśāt vākya artha bodhaḥ ustu iti āgrahe tu āha gāvam uccāraya iti gāvā iti bhāṣā sthaḥ śabdaḥ kaścid anarthakaḥ

original: gāvetibhāṣāśabdānukaraṇai'pi tādṛśānukaraṇaśabdānāṃ sādhutvasya sarvairapyaṅgīkārādanukāraṇānāṃ kvāpi śaktāvasatyāṃ śakyāgrahācchakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā apinaiyāyikasaṃmatāyā agrahādarthabodho na syāt, vṛttyā'rthabodhajanakatvārūpārthavattvābhāvena prātipadikasaṃjñā'pi na syāt, sādhutvaṃ cāpi na syāditi anukaraṇānāṃ śabde śaktiḥ

original: athaṃbodhānukūlatvena prathamapratītatvarūpakāraṇatvāduccaritasyaiva śabdasya bhānenādoṣāt| tathā ca-tasmādarthanivṛttirityasya-arthavācakaśabdāntaranivṛttirityartha ukta udyota iti bodhyam| loke tu yatra śabde itarapadārthānvayarūpakāryāsaṃbhavastatra śabdasya viśeṣaṇatā'rthasya ca viśeṣyateti śabdopasthite'rthe kāryaṃ kartavyam|
analyzed: athaṃbodha anukūla tvena prathama pratīta tva rūpa kāraṇatvāt uccaritasya eva śabdasya bhānena adoṣāt tathā ca tasmāt artha nivṛttiḥ iti asya artha vācaka śabda antara nivṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ uktaḥ udyote iti bodhyam loke tu yatra śabde itara padārtha anvaya rūpa kārya asaṃbhavaḥ tatra śabdasya viśeṣaṇa tā arthasya ca viśeṣya tā iti śabda upasthita īrthe kāryam kartavyam

original: yathā nīlo bhramaraḥ, ityukte nahi nīlimā śabde'nveti, bhramaraśabde nīlimno'saṃbhavāt| kiṃtu bhramaraśabdavācye ṣaṭ‌pade kīṭe'nveti, tatraiva tatsaṃbhavāt| yatra cārthe kāryāsaṃbhavastatrārthasya viśeṣaṇatā, śabdasya ca viśeṣyateti tadarthavācake śabde kāryaṃ karaṇīyam|
analyzed: yathā nīlaḥ bhramaraḥ iti ukte nahi nīlimā śabdena vā iti bhramara śabde nīlimnaḥ saṃbhavāt kiṃtu bhramara śabda vācye ṣaṭpade kīṭena vā iti tatra eva tad saṃbhavāt yatra ca arthe kārya asaṃbhavaḥ tatra arthasya viśeṣaṇa tā śabdasya ca viśeṣya tā iti tad artha vācake śabde kāryam karaṇīyam

original: yathā viṣṇumuccārayetyatra viṣṇupadārthe caturbhuje uccāraṇakriyānvayāsaṃbhavāttadarthavācake viṣṇuśabde samabhivyāhṛtakriyānvaya iti bodhyam| nanu sāmānyataḥ padajanyopasthitiviṣayasya śābdabodhe bhānāṅgīkāre samavāyasaṃbandhena ghaṭādiśabdajanyopasthitiviṣayasyā''kāśasya ghaṭo'stītyādivākyajanyaśābdabodhaviṣayatvāpattirata āha--atiprasaṅgeti|
analyzed: yathā viṣṇum uccāraya iti atra viṣṇu padārthe caturbhuje uccāraṇa kriyā anvaya asaṃbhavāt tad artha   viṣṇu śabde samabhivyāhṛta kriyā anvayaḥ iti bodhyam nanu sāmānyatas pada janya upasthiti viṣayasya śābdabodhe bhāna aṅgīkāre samavāya saṃbandhena ghaṭa ādi śabda janya upasthiti viṣayasya ākāśasya ghaṭaḥ asti ityādi vākya janya śābdabodha viṣaya tva āpattiḥ atas āha atiprasaṅga iti

original: vāraṇāyeti| niruktāpattirūpātiprasaṅganirasanāyetyarthaḥ| padopasthitireveti| padārthopasthitirevetyarthaḥ| anukāryaśabdaprasaṅgāttu padopasthitirityuktam| sā padārthopasthitiśca vṛttijanyeti viśeṣaṇād‌vṛttijñānajanyā'pekṣitetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: vāraṇāya iti nirukta āpatti rūpa atiprasaṅga nirasanāya iti arthaḥ pada upasthitiḥ eva iti padārtha upasthitiḥ eva iti arthaḥ anukārya śabda prasaṅgāt tu pada upasthitiḥ iti uktam sā padārtha upasthitiḥ ca vṛtti janyā iti viśeṣaṇāt vṛtti jñāna janya apekṣitā iti arthaḥ

original: tathā cā''kāśasya ghaṭapadatsamavāyasaṃbandhonopasthitāvapi vṛttyā ghaṭapadādupasthityabhāvena ghaṭo'stītyādivākyajanyabodhe na tasya bhānamityarthaḥ| evaṃ gavityayamāhetyādāvabhedapakṣe'nukāryābhinnānukaraṇasya padādupasthitāvapi vṛttyā padādupasthityabhāvenānukāryasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti tātparyam| āśrayatayā vṛttimattvasyeti|
analyzed: tathā ca ākāśasya vṛttyā ghaṭa padāt upasthitau api vṛttyā ghaṭa padāt upasthiti abhāvena ghaṭaḥ asti ityādi vākya janya bodhe na tasya bhānam iti arthaḥ evam gavi iti ayam āha ityādau abheda pakṣenukārya abhinna anukaraṇasya padāt upasthitau api vṛttyā padāt upasthiti abhāvena anukāryasya śābda bodha viṣayatvam na saṃbhavati iti tātparyam āśrayatayā vṛttimat tvasya iti

original: anukāryānukaraṇayaurabhedapakṣe'nukāryasya yatkiṃcidarthavācakatvād‌vācakatārūpā vṛttiranukārye'sti| sā ca vṛttirarthanirūpitatvādāśrayatāsaṃbandheneti vṛttimattvasyānukārye sattvānnānukāryasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvānupapattiḥ| āśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimato'rthasya śābde bhānāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anukārya anukaraṇa yauḥ abheda pakṣe nukāryasya yat kiṃcid artha vācaka tvāt vācaka tā rūpā vṛttiḥ anukārye sti sā ca vṛttiḥ artha nirūpita tvāt āśraya tā saṃbandhena iti vṛttimat tvasya anukārye sattvāt na anukāryasya śābda bodha viṣaya tva anupapattiḥ āśraya tā saṃbandhena vṛttimataḥ ṛthasya śābde bhāna aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvasyaiva śābdabodhaviṣayatvaniyāmakatve nirūpakatāsaṃsargeṇa vṛttimato'rthasya śābdayodhe bhānaṃ na syādata āha-nirūpakatāśrayatānyatareti| nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenā''śrayatāsaṃbandhena vā vṛttimato'rthasya śābde bhānaṃ svīkriyate| na tabhayorekenaiva saṃbandhena vṛttimata ityāgraha iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu āśrayatā saṃbandhena vṛttimat tvasya eva śābda bodha viṣayatva niyāmaka tve nirūpakatā saṃsargeṇa vṛttimataḥ ṛthasya śābda yodhe bhānam na syāt atas āha nirūpakatā āśrayatā anyatara iti nirūpakatā saṃbandhena āśrayatā saṃbandhena vā vṛttimataḥ ṛthasya śābde bhānam svīkriyate na ekena eva saṃbandhena vṛttimataḥ iti āgrahaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: śaktirūpāyā vṛtternirūpako'rthaḥ, tatra nirūpakatā, āśrayastu śabdaḥ, tatra āśrayatā| tathā ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena śaktirūpavṛttimān arthaḥ| āśrayatāsaṃbandhena ca tādṛśavṛttimāñ śabdaḥ|
analyzed: śakti rūpāyāḥ vṛtteḥ nirūpakaḥ ṛthaḥ tatra nirūpaka tā āśrayaḥ tu śabdaḥ tatra āśraya tā tathā ca nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena śakti rūpa vṛttimān arthaḥ āśraya tā saṃbandhena ca tādṛśa vṛttimān śabdaḥ

original: satyevaṃ ghaṭamānayetyādau vākyārthabodhe nirūpakatayā vṛttimataḥ kambugrīvādiviśiṣṭārthasyaiva bhānaṃ pāmarajanairanubhūyate, tathā'pi na so'sti pratyayo loke, viṣayatvamanādṛtyeti cābhiyuktatamavākyapadīyakṛddharyanubhavabalādāśrayatayā vṛttimataḥ śabdasyāpi bodhe bhānaṃ svīkriyata ityāśayenoktamanyatarasaṃbandheneti|
analyzed: sati evam ghaṭam ānaya ityādau vākya artha bodhe nirūpakatayā vṛttimataḥ kambu grīva ādi viśiṣṭa arthasya eva bhānam pāmara janaiḥ anubhūyate tathā api na saḥ asti pratyayaḥ loke viṣayatvam an ādṛtya iti ca abhiyuktatama vākya padīya kṛt hari anubhava balāt āśrayatayā vṛttimataḥ śabdasya api bodhe bhānam svīkriyate iti āśayena uktam anyatara saṃbandhena iti

original: ata eva gāmānayetyatra gotvastrītvaikatvaviśiṣṭa-gośabdavācyagokarmakamānayanamiti sarvatraivopasthāpakaśabdaghaṭitaṃ śābdabodhavarmanaṃ saṃgacchate| evaṃ cānukaraṇasthale bhedābhedobhayapakṣe'nukāryasya śabde bhānasattve'pi bhedāpakṣe'nukaraṇasyānukārye śaktiḥ|
analyzed: atas eva gām ānaya iti atra go tva strī tva eka tva viśiṣṭa go śabda vācya go karmakam ānayanam iti sarvatra eva upasthāpaka śabda ghaṭitam śābdabodha varmanam saṃgacchate evam ca anukaraṇa sthale bheda abheda ubhaya pakṣenukāryasya śabde bhāna sattve pi bheda apakṣenukaraṇasya anukārye śaktiḥ

original: sā ca śaktiranukārye nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenānukaraṇe tvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vartata iti kṛtvā śaktirūpavṛttinirūpakār‌thapratipādakatvādanukakaraṇasya prātipadikasaṃjñā, nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śabdasya śābdabodhe bhānaṃ ca sidhyati| arthavatsūtrasya vṛttinirūpakārthapratipādakaśabdasya prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: sā ca śaktiḥ anukārye nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena anukaraṇe tu āśraya tā saṃbandhena vartate iti kṛtvā śakti rūpa vṛtti nirūpaka artha pratipādaka tvāt anuka karaṇasya prātipadika saṃjñā nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena vṛttimat tvāt anukāryasya śabdasya śābda bodhe bhānam ca sidhyati arthavat sūtrasya vṛtti nirūpaka artha pratipādaka śabdasya prātipadika saṃjñā bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: vṛttyā'rthapratipādakasya saṃjñeti yāvat| ata evānukāryānukaraṇayorabhedapakṣe bhedamūlikāyā vācyavācakabhāvāparaparyāyakavṛtterasaṃbhavenānukāryāṃnukaraṇayorvṛttimattvasya vaktumaśakyatvādanukaraṇasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvena prātipadikasaṃjñā na bhavati, tataśca subutpattyabhāvātpadasaṃjñāyā abhāvena
analyzed: vṛttyā artha pratipādakasya saṃjñā iti yāvat atas eva anukārya anukaraṇayoḥ abheda pakṣe bheda mūlikāyāḥ vācya vācaka bhāva apara paryāyaka vṛtteḥ asaṃbhavena anukārya annukaraṇayoḥ vṛttimat tvasya vaktum aśakya tvāt anukaraṇasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpa arthavat tva abhāvena prātipadika saṃjñā na bhavati tatas ca sup utpatti abhāvāt pada saṃjñāyāḥ abhāvena

original: gavityayamāhetyatrāpadāntatvādvakārasya lopaḥ śākalyasyeti lopo na| prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhāvādeva ca bhuvo vugityatreva bhū sattāyāmityatra vibhaktirna kṛtā|
analyzed: gau iti ayam āha iti atra a pada anta tvāt vakārasya lopaḥ śākalyasya iti lopaḥ na prātipadika saṃjñāyāḥ abhāvāt eva ca bhuvaḥ vuk iti atra iva bhū sattāyām iti atra vibhaktiḥ na kṛtā

original: nanvevamabhedapakṣe'nukāryānukaraṇayorvṛttimattvābhāve satyanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ na syāt, śābde śabdabhāne vṛttimattvasya niyāmakatvāditi ceducyate-abhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃcidarthavācakatvācchabdatadarthayorvṛttirasti| tatrārtho vṛtternirūpakaḥ, anukāryaśabdastvāśrayaḥ|
analyzed: nanu evam abheda pakṣenukārya anukaraṇayoḥ vṛttimat tva abhāve sati anukāryasya śābde bhānam na syāt śābde śabda bhāne vṛttimat tvasya niyāmaka tvāt iti ced ucyate abheda pakṣenukāryasya kiṃcid artha vācaka tvāt śabda tad arthayoḥ vṛttiḥ asti tatra arthaḥ vṛtteḥ nirūpakaḥ anukārya śabdaḥ tu āśrayaḥ

original: tathā ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenārtho vṛttimān, anukāryaśabdastvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimān| tatrānukāryeṇābhedamāpannasyānukaraṇasyāpyāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ bhavati| anukaraṇasya prātipadisaṃjñā tu na bhavati| vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvāt|
analyzed: tathā ca nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena arthaḥ vṛttimān anukārya śabdaḥ tu āśraya tā saṃbandhena vṛttimān tatra anukāryeṇa abhedam āpannasya anukaraṇasya api āśraya tā saṃbandhena vṛttimat tvāt anukāryasya śābde bhānam bhavati anukaraṇasya prātipadi saṃjñā tu na bhavati vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpa arthavat tva abhāvāt

original: na cānukāryasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvasattvāttadabhedamāpannasyānukaraṇasyāpi tādṛśārthavattvasya durvāratayā prātipadikasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam| abhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃ cidarthavācakatve'pyanukaraṇasya tadarthavācakatvābhāvāt, anukaraṇādanukāryārthāpratiteranubhavasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: na ca anukāryasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpa arthavat tva sattvāt tad abhedam āpannasya anukaraṇasya api tādṛśa arthavat tvasya durvāra tayā prātipadika saṃjñā syāt iti vācyam abheda pakṣe nukāryasya kim cit artha vācaka tve pi anukaraṇasya tad artha vācaka tva abhāvāt anukaraṇāt anukārya artha apratiteḥ anubhava siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: abhedapakṣe'anukāryasya kiṃcidarthasattve mānaṃ tu `bhūsattāyām' ityādyarthanirdeśa eva| nahi tatra sattādyartho'nukaraṇasyetyevaṃ ko'pyavagacchati? kiṃ tvanukāryasya bhūdhātoreveti sarvānubhavaḥ| bhedapakṣe tvanukaraṇānna kasyacidapyarthasya pratītirbhavati kiṃ tvanukaraṇācchaktirūpavṛttyā'nukāryaśabdarūpasyārthasya pratītirjāyate|
analyzed: abheda pakṣe anukāryasya kiṃcid artha sattve mānam tu bhū sattāyām ityādi artha nirdeśaḥ eva nahi tatra sattā ādi arthaḥ nukaraṇasya iti evam kaḥ api avagacchati kim tu anukāryasya bhū dhātoḥ eva iti sarva anubhavaḥ bheda pakṣe tu anukaraṇāt na kasyacid api arthasya pratītiḥ bhavati kim tu anukaraṇāt śakti rūpa vṛttyā anukārya śabda rūpasya arthasya pratītiḥ jāyate

original: tatra nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ, anukaraṇasya tu anukāryaśabdarūpatādṛśavṛttimadarthapratipādakatvātprātipadikasaṃjñā ca sidhyatīti bodhyam|
analyzed: tatra nirūpakatā saṃbandhena vṛttimat tvāt anukāryasya śābde bhānam anukaraṇasya tu anukārya śabda rūpa tādṛśa vṛttimat artha pratipādaka tvāt prātipadika saṃjñā ca sidhyati iti bodhyam

original: nanvanukaraṇasya kathaṃvṛttyāśrayatā? anukāryanirūpitā vṛttyāśrayatā'nukaraṇasyeti cet-nirūpyanirūpakabhāvasya bhedamūlakatvenānukāryānukaraṇayorabhede tadasaṃbhavādanukaraṇasyānukāryanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatā vaktumaśakyā|
analyzed: nanu anukaraṇasya katham vṛtti āśraya tā anukārya nirūpitā vṛtti āśraya tā anukaraṇasya iti ced nirūpya nirūpaka bhāvasya bheda mūlaka tvena anukārya anukaraṇayoḥ abhede tad asaṃbhavāt anukaraṇasya anukārya nirūpita vṛtti āśraya tā vaktum aśakyā

original: na cābhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃcidarthavācakatvād‌govyaktyāditattadarthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatā'nukārye yā'sti saiva vṛttyāśrayatā tadabhedapanne'nukaraṇe'pyastīti vācyam| anukaraṇādanukāryārthagovyaktyādipratīteḥ kathamapyanubhavābhāvāttādṛśārthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatāyā apyanukāryābhedamāpanne'pyanukaraṇe vaktumaśaktyatvādata āha-saṃbandhasyobhayeti|
analyzed: na ca abheda pakṣenukāryasya kiṃcid artha vācaka tvāt go vyakti ādi tad tad artha nirūpita vṛtti āśraya tā anukārye yā asti sā eva vṛtti āśraya tā tad abheda panna inukaraṇe pi asti iti vācyam anukaraṇāt anukārya artha go vyakti ādi pratīteḥ katham api anubhava abhāvāt tādṛśa artha nirūpita vṛtti āśraya tāyāḥ api anukārya abhedam āpanne ipi anukaraṇe vaktum aśakti atvāt atas āha saṃbandhasya ubhaya iti

original: saṃbandhasya saṃbandhinau dvau, tau ca saṃbandhanirūpakau, saṃbandhaśca saṃbandhidvayanirūpyaḥ, ataḥ saṃbandhibhyāṃ bhinno dviṣṭhaśca saṃbandha ityucyate| ghaṭaśabdatadarthayoryaḥ saṃbandhastasya nirūpakau saṃbandhinau ghaṭaśabdastadarthaśceti dvau| saṃbandhasya sarvatrobhayanirūpyatvameva loke prasiddhaṃ, na kvāpyekanirūpyatvaṃ dṛśyate|
analyzed: saṃbandhasya saṃbandhinau dvau tau ca saṃbandha nirūpakau saṃbandhaḥ ca saṃbandhi dvaya nirūpyaḥ atas saṃbandhibhyām bhinnaḥ dviṣṭhaḥ ca saṃbandhaḥ iti ucyate ghaṭa śabda tad arthayoḥ yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tasya nirūpakau saṃbandhinau ghaṭa śabdaḥ tad arthaḥ ca iti dvau saṃbandhasya sarvatra ubhaya nirūpya tvam eva loke prasiddham na kvāpi eka nirūpya tvam dṛśyate

original: śabdārthayostādṛśasaṃbandhaśca bodhyabodhakabāvarūpaḥ| etenāsau saṃbandha eva śaktiriti sūcitam| tatra bodhakatārūpā śaktiḥ śabdaniṣṭhā, bodyatārūpā tu śabdārthaniṣṭhā| tathā ca śabdatadarthau dvāvapi vṛttyāśrayau|
analyzed: śabda arthayoḥ tādṛśa saṃbandhaḥ ca bodhya bodhaka bāva rūpaḥ etena asau saṃbandhaḥ eva śaktiḥ iti sūcitam tatra bodhaka tā rūpā śaktiḥ śabda niṣṭhā bodya tā rūpā tu śabda artha niṣṭhā tathā ca śabda tad arthau dvau api vṛtti āśrayau

original: evaṃ ca bodhyatārūpavṛttyāśrayatvādyathā śabdārthasya śābde bhānaṃ jāyate tadvad‌bodhakatārūpavṛttyāśrayatvācchabdasyāpi sābdabodhe bhānaṃ saṃbhavet| anayā rītyā sarvatraiva śābde śavdabhānamupapādanīyam|
analyzed: evam ca bodhya tā rūpa vṛtti āśraya tvāt yathā śabda arthasya śābde bhānam jāyate tadvat bodhaka tā rūpa vṛtti āśraya tvāt śabdasya api sābda bodhe bhānam saṃbhavet anayā rītyā sarvatra eva śābde śavda bhānam upapādanīyam

original: anukaraṇasthale'bedapakṣe'nukāryasya govyaktyāditattadarthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatvāttadabhedamāpannasyānukakaraṇasyāpi tādṛśavṛttyāśrayatvaṃ, śābde jāyamānānukāryarūpaśabdabhānānubhavabalādevāṅgīkāryam| tathā cānukaraṇasyāpi vṛttyāśrayatvād vṛttijanyapadopasthiteḥ satvānnānukāryasya śābde bhānānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ|

original: yathā śṛṅgitvaṃ gorlakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cellakṣyabhūtāyāṃ gavi śṛṅgitvasya vidyamānatve'pi mahiṣyādāvattivyāptistatrāpi śṛṅgitvasya vidyamānatvāt| lakṣyamātrāvṛttitvamasaṃbhavaḥ| yathā gorekaśaphavattvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ cedyāvadgovyaktīnāṃ dviśaphavattvenaikaśaphavattvasya kutrāpyasattvāt| tallakṣaṇasyeti| avyayībhāvādisamāsalakṣaṇasyetyarthaḥ|

analyzed: bāla bodha artham udāharaṇam rājā devadattaḥ tad svāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ viṣṇumitraḥ rāja bhinnaḥ caitraḥ tad svāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ maitraḥ tādṛśa maitra apekṣayā viṣṇumitraḥ bhinnaḥ iti tādṛśa maitra niṣṭha pratiyogitāka bhedaḥ viṣṇumitre iti arthaḥ viṣṇumitre rāja bhinnasya caitrasya saṃbandhaḥ na asti iti yāvat

original: loke kaścitpuruṣovaisākhaḥ, jyeṣṭhanāmānaṃ puruṣamarājakīyaṃ-rājasaṃbandhibhinnaṃ matvā rājānaṃ nindituṃ pravṛttaḥ, atrāntare āṣāḍhanāmakapuruṣeṇa vaiśākhaṃ prati kathitaṃ-ayaṃ jyeṣṭhanāmārājapuruṣa iti| tacchrutvā rājanindanādvirato vaiśākhaḥ| etāvatā rājapuruṣapadādarājakīyabhinna ityarthaḥ spaṣṭa eva pratīyate|

original: rājapuruṣa iti samudāyasya rājabhinnasaṃbandhibhinne, śaktiriti bhāvaḥ| śratredaṃ bodhyam-yathā rājapuruṣe viṣṇumitre rājabhinnasya caitrasya saṃbandho vyāvartyate tathā devadattasaṃjñake rājñyapi rājapuruṣābhinnaviṣṇumitrabhinnasya maitrasya saṃbandho vyāvartyata ityanyonyābhāvarūpo bhedaḥ|

original: vṛtti ghaṭake puruṣe yathā sundara iti viśeṣaṇānvayo bhavati tatā devadattasyeti viśeṣaṇasyāpyanvayaḥ syāt| yo rājasvāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ sa sundara iti bodhodayavadyo rājasaṃbandhī puruṣaḥ| sa devadattasaṃbandhīti yo rājasvāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ sa devadattasvāmiko'pīti bodhodayāt| tataśca rājapuruṣo devadattasya ceti prayoga āpadyetetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: vṛtti ghaṭake puruṣe yathā sundaraḥ iti viśeṣaṇa anvayaḥ bhavati devadattasya iti viśeṣaṇasya api anvayaḥ syāt yaḥ rāja svāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ sa sundaraḥ iti bodha udaya vat yaḥ rāja saṃbandhī puruṣaḥ sa devadatta saṃbandhī iti yaḥ rāja svāmikaḥ puruṣaḥ sa devadatta svāmikaḥ api iti bodha udayāt tatas ca rāja puruṣaḥ devadattasya ca iti prayogaḥ āpadyeta iti arthaḥ

original: devadatto'tra rājabhinnaḥ kaścinnāgarikaḥ| nanu vṛttasya vā viśeṣaṇayogo neti vārtikena vṛttighaṭakasya viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhaniṣedhātkathaṃ vṛttighaṭake puruṣe sundara iti viśeṣaṇānvaya iti cenna| vṛttighaṭakasyāpradhānasyaiva viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhaniṣedho, na tu pradhānasya, pradhānasya tu viśeṣaṇasaṃbandho bhavatyeveti tadarthāt|
analyzed: devadattaḥ utra rāja bhinnaḥ kaścid nāgarikaḥ nanu vṛttasya vā viśeṣaṇa yogaḥ na iti vārtikena vṛtti ghaṭakasya viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha niṣedhāt katham vṛtti ghaṭake puruṣe sundaraḥ iti viśeṣaṇa anvayaḥ iti ced na vṛtti ghaṭakasya apradhānasya eva viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha niṣedhaḥ na tu pradhānasya pradhānasya tu viśeṣaṇa saṃbandhaḥ bhavati eva iti tad arthāt

original: ata eva puruṣo vyāghra iva śūra ityatra pradhānapuruṣanirūpitaviśeṣaṇatvasya śūrapadārthe sattve'pi `upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ' iti samāsapravṛttiḥ syāditi tanniṣedhārthaṃ `sāmānyāprayoge' iti caritārtham| tathā cātra śauryasyopamānopameyasādhāraṇadharmasya prayogānna samātaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva puruṣaḥ vyāghraḥ iva śūraḥ iti atra pradhāna puruṣa nirūpita viśeṣaṇa tvasya śūra padārthe sattve api upamitam vyāghra ādibhiḥ iti samāsa pravṛttiḥ syāt iti tad niṣedha artham sāmānya aprayoge iti caritārtham tathā ca atra śauryasya upamāna upameya sādhāraṇa dharmasya prayogāt na samātaḥ

original: anyathā vṛttighaṭakasya viśeṣaṇasaṃbandhaniṣedhādviseṣaṇayoge sati samāsapravṛttireva na syāditi samāsaniṣedhārthaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ `sāmānyāprayoge' itivacanaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt| evaṃ ca `sāmānyāprayoge' iti vacanameva jñāpayati-bhavati hi vṛttighaṭakasyāpi pradhānasya upāttaviśeṣaṇavijātīyaviśeṣaṇayoga iti jñāpyata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā vṛtti ghaṭakasya viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha niṣedhāt viśeṣaṇa yoge sati samāsa pravṛttiḥ eva na syāt iti samāsa niṣedha artham kriyamāṇam sāmānya aprayoge iti vacanam vyartham syāt evam ca sāmānya aprayoge iti vacanam eva jñāpayati bhavati hi vṛtti ghaṭakasya api pradhānasya upātta viśeṣaṇa vijātīya viśeṣaṇa yogaḥ iti jñāpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhaṅgameva viśadayati--atrāyamāśaya ityādinā| svāmyādipratītiranubhavasiddhoti| citrā gāvo yasyeti vigrahavākyādyasya citrā gāva ityevaṃ gopadārthamukhyaviśeṣyako bodhaḥ, samāsāttu citragosaṃbandhī citragosvāmītyevaṃ citragoviśeṣaṇakānyapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyakabodhodayātsvāmyādipratītiranubhavasiddhetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhaṅgam eva viśadayati atra ayam āśayaḥ ityādinā svāmi ādi pratītiḥ anubhava siddhā uti citrāḥ gāvaḥ yasya iti vigraha vākyāt yasya citrāḥ gāvaḥ iti evam go padārtha mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ bodhaḥ samāsāt tu citra go saṃbandhī citra go svāmī iti evam citra go viśeṣaṇaka anya padārtha mukhya viśeṣyaka bodha udayāt svāmi ādi pratītiḥ anubhava siddhā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu citraguriti samāsasya citragosvāmini lakṣaṇayeṣṭārthabodhaḥ syādityāśaṅkate--na ceti| samādhatte--tadasaṃbhavāditi| lakṣaṇayeṣṭārthalābhāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu citraguḥ iti samāsasya citrago svāmini lakṣaṇayā iṣṭārtha bodhaḥ syāt iti āśaṅkatena ca iti samādhatte tad asaṃbhavāt iti lakṣaṇayā iṣṭārtha lābha asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: citragurityatra lakṣaṇayā yathākathaṃcitsvāmyādilābhasaṃbhave'pi prāptodaka ityādau lakṣaṇayeṣṭārthalābhāsaṃbhavena na sarvatra lakṣaṇayā nirvāho bhavatīti citragurityatra lakṣaṇāśrayaṇamayuktamiti bhāvaḥ| prāptamudakaṃ yamiti vākyādyatkarmakaprāptikartrudakamiti bodhaḥ, samāsāttūdakakartṛkamāptikarma grāma iti|
analyzed: citraguḥ iti atra lakṣaṇayā yathā kathaṃcid svāmi ādi lābha saṃbhave pi prāpta udakaḥ ityādau lakṣaṇayā iṣṭārtha lābha asaṃbhavena na sarvatra lakṣaṇayā nirvāhaḥ bhavati iti citraguḥ iti atra lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇam ayuktam iti bhāvaḥ prāptam udakam yam iti vākyāt yad karmaka prāpti kartṛ udakam iti bodhaḥ samāsāt tu udaka kartṛkam āpti karma grāmaḥ iti

original: tatra prathamata evodakapade udakasaṃbandhilakṣaṇāyāmudakasya padārthaikadeśatayā tatra prāptapadārthaprāptikarturanvayo na syādata āha-prāptikartrabhinnamiti| prapūrvakāp‌dhātorgatyartheti kartari ktaḥ, prāptikriyākartrityarthaḥ, ktapratyayārthakartuścābhedenodake'nvaya ityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇāyāmapīti|
analyzed: tatra prathamatas eva udaka pade udaka saṃbandhi lakṣaṇāyām udakasya padārtha eka deśa tayā tatra prāpta padārtha prāpti kartuḥ anvayaḥ na syāt atas āha prāpti kartṛ abhinnam iti pra pūrvaka āp dhātoḥ gati artha iti kartari ktaḥ prāpti kriyā kartā iti arthaḥ ktapratyaya artha kartuḥ ca abhedena udaka anvayaḥ iti arthaḥ lakṣaṇāyām api iti

original: prāptikartrabhinnodakamiti bodottaraṃ tātparvānupāpattipratisaṃdhānena tādṛśodakasaṃbandhī grāma ityevaṃ lakṣaṇāyāmapītyarthaḥ| ityarthālābhāditi| saṃbandhilakṣaṇayā prāptikartrabhinnodakasaṃbandhī grāma iti bodhasyaiva saṃbhavenodakakartṛkaprāptikargetyabhīpsitārthālābādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: prāpti kartṛ abhinna udakam iti boda uttaram tātparva anupāpatti pratisaṃdhānena tādṛśa udaka saṃbandhī grāmaḥ iti evam lakṣaṇāyām api iti arthaḥ iti artha alābhāt iti saṃbandhi lakṣaṇayā prāpti kartṛ abhinna udaka saṃbandhī grāmaḥ iti bodhasya eva saṃbhavena udaka kartṛka prāpti kargā iti abhīpsita artha alābāt iti arthaḥ

original: grāmasya tādṛśodakasaṃbandhitvena bodhe'pi karmatvena bodho na syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu kartrarthakasya ktapratyayasyaiva karmaṇi lakṣaṇā'stu, udakasya praptau kartṛtayā'nvaya, tathā codakaniṣṭhaprāptikarmatyabhīṣṭārthalābhaḥ saṃbhavatītyāśaṅkya samādhatte-tarhītyādinā|
analyzed: grāmasya tādṛśa udaka saṃbandhi tvena bodhe api karmatvena bodhaḥ na syāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu kartṛ arthakasya ktapratyayasya eva karmaṇi lakṣaṇā astu udakasya praptau kartṛtayā anvaya tathā ca udaka niṣṭha prāpti karmati abhīṣṭa artha lābhaḥ saṃbhavati iti āśaṅkya samādhatte tarhi ityādinā

original: ktapratyayasya karmaṇi lakṣaṇāyāṃ prāptodakapadayoḥ samānādhikaraṇatvātsamānādhikaraṇayośca prātipadikārthayorabhedanaivānvaya iti niyamādudakābhinna prāptikarmetyevamarthaḥ syānna tu udakaniṣṭhaprāptikarmeti bhāvaḥ| prāptikarmeti syāditi| prāptikarmabhinnamudakamiti bodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ktapratyayasya karmaṇi lakṣaṇāyām prāpta udaka padayoḥ samāna adhikaraṇa tvāt samāna adhikaraṇayoḥ ca prātipadika arthayoḥ abhedanā eva anvayaḥ iti niyamāt udaka abhinna prāpti karma iti evam arthaḥ syāt na tu udaka niṣṭha prāpti karma iti bhāvaḥ prāpti karma iti syāt iti prāpti karma bhinnam udakam iti bodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: prāptaśabdasya kriyāśabdatvenodakaśabdasya ca jātiśabdatvenodakasyaiva viśeṣyatāyā yuktatvāt| udakasya prāptau kartṛtveneṣṭo'nvayo na syādityatra tātparyamiti bodhyam| anyatheti| uktavaiparītye| udakasya prāptau kartṛtvasaṃbandhenānvayābhyupagama ityarthaḥ| samānādhikaraṇeti| samānavibhaktikaprātipadikārthayorityarthaḥ| bhaṅgāpatteriti|
analyzed: prāpta śabdasya kriyā śabda tvena udaka śabdasya ca jāti śabda tvena udakasya eva viśeṣya tāyāḥ yuktatvāt udakasya prāptau kartṛ tvena iṣṭaḥ anvayaḥ na syāt iti atra tātparyam iti bodhyam anyathā iti ukta vaiparītye udakasya prāptau kartṛ tva saṃbandhena anvaya abhyupagamaḥ iti arthaḥ samāna adhikaraṇa iti samāna vibhaktika prātipadika arthayoḥ iti arthaḥ bhaṅga āpatteḥ iti

original: nāmārthadhātvarthayoḥ sākṣādbhedenānvayasya vyutpattiviruddhatvādudakasya prāptau kartṛtvenānvayaḥ kartumaśakya ityāha--prāpterdhātvarthatayetyādi| tathā codakakartṛkaprāptikarma grāma ityabhīpsitārthalābho naiva syāditi bhāvaḥ| anyatheti| nāmārthadhātvarthetyādiniyamānaṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| nāmārthasya dhātvarthe bhedenānvayāṅgīkāra iti yāvat|
analyzed: nāma artha dhātvarthayoḥ sākṣāt bhedena anvayasya vyutpatti viruddha tvāt udakasya prāptau kartṛ tvena anvayaḥ kartum aśakyaḥ iti āha prāpteḥ dhātvartha tayā ityādi tathā ca udaka kartṛka prāpti karma grāmaḥ iti abhīpsita artha lābhaḥ na eva syāt iti bhāvaḥ anyathā iti nāma artha dhātvartha ityādi niyama anaṅgīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ nāma arthasya dhātvarthe bhedena anvaya aṅgīkāraḥ iti yāvat

original: devadattaḥ pacyata iti| devadatte taṇḍulaḥ pacyata ityarthe devadattaḥ pacyata iti prayogaḥ siddhānte neṣyate| devadattaśabdottaraṃ tṛtīyāyā abhāvena kartṛtvāpratīterdevadattasya kriyāyāmanvayasya vaktumaśakyatvāttādṛśe'rthe tādṛśaḥ prayogo na bhavati| tādṛśaprayogasaṃbhavastvevam-devadattasya kartṛtvenāvivakṣitatvāttṛtīyābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: devadattaḥ pacyate iti devadatte taṇḍulaḥ pacyate iti arthe devadattaḥ pacyate iti prayogaḥ siddhānte na iṣyate devadatta śabda uttaram tṛtīyāyāḥ abhāvena kartṛ tva apratīteḥ devadattasya kriyāyām anvayasya vaktum aśakya tvāt tādṛśa irthe tādṛśaḥ prayogaḥ na bhavati tādṛśa prayoga saṃbhavaḥ tu evam devadattasya kartṛ tvena avivakṣita tvāt tṛtīyā bhāvaḥ

original: na ca ṣaṣṭhī syāditi vācyam| kevalaprātipadikārthavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyaprasaṅgāt| ata eva prathamā bhavatīti| evaṃ ca devadattaḥ pacyata ityevamananvitārthakaḥ prayoga iti jñeyam| kartrarthakatṛtīyādivibhaktiviśeṣasaṃnidhānāttiṅkṛtsaṃnidhānācca nāmārthasya kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvenānvayadarśanāt| ananvayānāpatteriti|
analyzed: na ca ṣaṣṭhī syāt iti vācyam kevala prātipadika artha vivakṣāyām ṣaṣṭhī aprasaṅgāt atas eva prathamā bhavati iti evam ca devadattaḥ pacyate iti evam ananvita arthakaḥ prayogaḥ iti jñeyam kartṛ arthaka tṛtīyā ādi vibhakti viśeṣa saṃnidhānāt tiṅkṛt saṃnidhānāt ca nāma arthasya kriyāyām kartṛ tvena anvaya darśanāt ananvaya anāpatteḥ iti

original: yadi ca tṛtīyādisaṃnidhānābhāve'pi kartṛtvena kriyāyāmanvayaḥ syāttarhi niruktaprayoge devadattasya pākakriyāyāṃ kartṛtvasaṃbandhenānvayasaṃbhavāddevadattaḥ pacyata iti vākye'nanvitārthakatvasyeṣṭasyānupapatterityarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadi ca tṛtīyādi saṃnidhāna abhāve pi kartṛ tvena kriyāyām anvayaḥ syāt tarhi nirukta prayoge devadattasya pāka kriyāyām kartṛ tva saṃbandhena anvaya saṃbhavāt devadattaḥ pacyate iti vākyena anvita arthakatvasya iṣṭasya anupapatteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pacatītyādī bhāvapradhānamākhyātamiti vacanabalatklṛptatyāgasya pratyayārthaprādhānyasya prāptapadādirūpavṛttau tyāgena viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavaiparītyasya siddhatayodakasya prakārībhūtaktārthakartaryabhedenānvayena ktārthakartuśca kriyāyāyāyanvayenodakābhinnakartṛkā prāptiriti bodhottaraṃ tādṛśaprāptikriyāsaṃbandhigrāmalakṣaṇāyāṃ
analyzed: nanu pacati ityādī bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti vacana bala t klṛpta tyāgasya pratyaya artha prādhānyasya prāpta pada ādi rūpa vṛttau tyāgena viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāva vaiparītyasya siddhatayā udakasya prakārībhūta kta artha kartari abhedena anvayena kta artha kartuḥ ca prāptiḥ iti bodha uttaram tādṛśa prāpti kriyā saṃbandhi grāma lakṣaṇāyām

original: nābhīṣṭārthāsaṃbhavo nāpi nāmārthadhātvarthayoriti niyamabhaṅgo'pītyāśaṅkate-athodakābhinnetyādinā| tatsaṃbandhīti| prāptikriyākarmetyarthaḥ| samādhatte-iti cenneti| udakābhinnakartṛkā prāptirityevaṃ bodhasaṃbhave, tato lakṣaṇā'pi kathaṃcitsaṃbhavet, kiṃtu niruktākārako bodha evā''dau na saṃbhavatītyāha-prāpterdhātvarthatayetyādi| viśeṣyatāyā iti|
analyzed: na abhīṣṭa artha asaṃbhavaḥ nā api nāmārtha dhātvarthayoḥ iti niyama bhaṅgā upi iti āśaṅkate atha udaka abhinna ityādinā tat saṃbandhi iti prāpti kriyā karma iti arthaḥ samādhatte iti ced na iti udaka abhinna kartṛkā prāptiḥ iti evam bodha saṃbhave tatas lakṣaṇā api kathaṃcid saṃbhavet kiṃtu nirukta ākārakaḥ bodhaḥ eva ādau na saṃbhavati iti āha prāpteḥ dhātvartha tayā ityādi viśeṣya tāyāḥ iti

original: ktārthakartṛniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaprāptiniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāyā ityarthaḥ| asaṃbhavāditi| vaktumaśakyatvādityarthaḥ| asaṃbhavamevopapādayituṃ hetumāha--prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti| pratyayārthasyava prādhānyamiti| pācakaḥ, aupagava ityādau pratyayārthaprādhānyasyānubhavādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ktārtha kartṛ niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita prāpti niṣṭha viśeṣyatāyāḥ iti arthaḥ asaṃbhavāt iti vaktum aśakya tvāt iti arthaḥ asaṃbhavam eva upapādayitum hetum āha prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti pratyaya arthasya vai prādhānyam iti pācakaḥ aupagavaḥ ityādau pratyaya artha prādhānyasya anubhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: ata evaupagavamānayetyādāvupagvapatyasyaivā''nayanaṃ dṛśyate, na tūpagorapīti bodhyam| sattvapradhānāni nāmānīti vacanavirodho'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| tathā ca sarvathā prāptau viśeṣyatā vaktumaśakyā| tiṅante pratyayārthaprādhānyatyāge pramāṇasattve'pyatra tattyāge mānābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva aupagavam ānaya ityādau upagu apatyasya eva ānayanam dṛśyate na tu upagoḥ api iti bodhyam sattva pradhānāni nāmāni iti vacana virodhaḥ upi atra draṣṭavyaḥ tathā ca sarvathā prāptau viśeṣya tā vaktum aśakyā tiṅ ante pratyaya artha prādhānya tyāge pramāṇa sattve api atra tad tyāge māna abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu gāmānayetyādāvekatvaviśiṣṭāṃ gāmiti pratīteḥ pratyayārthatve'pi saṃkhaayāyā viśeṣaṇatayā'nvayadarśanātpratyayārthaprādhānyasya vyabhicāramāśaṅkyā''hṛ-prāptapada iti| nanu apekṣitabodhānyathānupapattyā pratyayārthaprādhānyasya vṛttau tyāgo'stu tathā sattvapradhānānītyarayāpi vṛttyapraviṣṭanāmaparatvamastvityāśaṅkyā''ha-nāmārthatveneti|
analyzed: nanu gām ānaya ityādau ekatva viśiṣṭām gām iti pratīteḥ pratyaya artha tve api viśeṣaṇatayā anvaya darśanāt pratyaya artha prādhānyasya vyabhicāram āśaṅkya āhṛ prāpta padaḥ iti nanu apekṣita bodha anyathā anupapattyā pratyaya artha prādhānyasya vṛttau tyāgoḥ tu tathā sattva pradhānāni iti arayā api vṛtti apraviṣṭa nāma paratvam astu iti āśaṅkya āha nāma artha tvena iti

original: nāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyatvenotyarthaḥ nāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyayorevānvayaḥ, sa cābhedanaiveti nāmārthayorityasyārthāditi bhāvaḥ| abhedānvayāpatteśceti| prāpternāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyatve tathaiva sahanāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyasyodakasyābhedānvayena bhāvyaṃ, sa ca dravyakriyayoratyantabhedena bādhitatvānna bhavatītyanyat|
analyzed: nāma janya pratīti viśeṣya tvena uti arthaḥ nāma janya pratīti viśeṣyayoḥ eva anvayaḥ sa ca abhedanā eva iti nāma arthayoḥ iti asya arthāt iti bhāvaḥ abheda anvaya āpatteḥ ca iti prāpteḥ nāma janya pratīti viśeṣya tve tathā eva saha nāma janya pratīti viśeṣyasya udakasya abheda anvayena bhāvyam sa ca dravya kriyayoḥ atyanta bhedena bādhita tvāt na bhavati iti anyat

original: kiṃtu nāmajanyapratītiviśeṣaṇabhūtena kartrā tādṛśodakasyābhedānvayaḥ sarvathā'saṃbhavīti abhedānvayāpatterityasya viśeṣaṇībhūtakartrā sahodakasyābhedānvayabodānapatterityarthaḥ| na kevalaṃ dvitīyārthakabahuvrīhāveva lakṣaṇayeṣṭārthabodhalābhāsaṃbhavaḥ, kiṃtu tṛtīyādyarthakabahuvrīhāvapītyāha-evamūḍharatha iti|
analyzed: kiṃtu nāma janya pratīti viśeṣaṇa bhūtena kartrā tādṛśa udakasya abheda anvayaḥ sarvathā asaṃbhavi iti abheda anvaya āpatteḥ iti asya viśeṣaṇībhūta kartrā saha udakasya abheda anvaya boda anapatteḥ iti arthaḥ na kevalam dvitīya arthaka bahuvrīhau eva lakṣaṇayā iṣṭārtha bodha lābha asaṃbhavaḥ kiṃtu tṛtīya ādi arthaka bahuvrīhau api iti āha evam ūḍha rathaḥ iti

original: ūḍho ratho yeneti vigrahavākyādyatkartṛkavahanakriyākarmabhūto rathaḥ, upahṛtaḥ paśuryasmā ityato yaduddesyakopahāraṇakriyākarmabhūtaḥ paśuḥ, udṛdhṛta odano yasyā ityasmādyadavadhikoddharaṇakriyākarmabhūta odanaḥ vahavaḥ, pācakā yasyāmiti vākyādyadadhikaraṇakabah‌vabhinnāḥ pacanakartāra ityevaṃ rathādyuttarapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyako bodho, na
analyzed: ūḍhaḥ rathaḥ yena iti vigraha vākyāt yad kartṛka vahana kriyā karma bhūtaḥ rathaḥ upahṛtaḥ paśuḥ yasmai iti atas yad uddesyaka upahāraṇa kriyā karma bhūtaḥ paśuḥ udṛdhṛtaḥ odanaḥ yasyāḥ iti asmāt yad avadhika uddharaṇa kriyā karma bhūtaḥ odanaḥ vahavaḥ pācakāḥ yasyām iti vākyāt yad adhikaraṇaka bahu abhinnāḥ pacana kartāraḥ iti evam ratha ādi uttara padārtha mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ bodhaḥ na bhavati iti

original: tvanyapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ| samāsāttvanyapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyakabodha iṣyate, sa ca samāsaśaktisvīkāramantarā'nupapanna ityāśayena samāsātpratīyamānaṃ tādṛśabodhaṃ pradarśayati-atra hītyādinā| rathakarmakavahanakriyākartetyaveṃprakāreṇānyapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodho'bhyugataḥ|

original: tasyā''śrayatvasaṃbandhonottarapadārthe'nvayaḥ| samāse tu nīlādipadenaiva lakṣaṇayā nīlādyabhedaḥ pratipādyate| tathā ca lakṣaṇayā tādṛśārtha(nīlābhinnamutpalamityartha)vivakṣāyāṃ samāsaḥ, vibhaktyā tadvivakṣāyāṃ vākyamiti vyavasthāyāḥ saṃbhava ityūcūḥ| evamaupagavādāvapi upagvadiśabdasyopagvādisaṃbandhe lakṣaṇeti bodhyam|
analyzed: tasya āśraya tva saṃbandhaḥ ūna uttara padārtha invayaḥ samāse tu nīla ādi padena eva lakṣaṇayā nīla ādi abhedaḥ pratipādyate tathā ca lakṣaṇayā tādṛśa artha nīla abhinnam utpalam iti artha vivakṣāyām samāsaḥ vibhaktyā tad vivakṣāyām vākyam iti vyavasthāyāḥ saṃbhavaḥ iti ūcūḥ evam aupagava ādau api upagvadi śabdasya upagva ādi saṃbandhe lakṣaṇā iti bodhyam

original: yaduktaṃ samudāyaśaktivādibhiryadi samāse viśiṣṭaśaktirna svīkriyate tarhi paṅkajaśabde'vayavaśaktyaiva paṅkajanikardṛtvarūpeṇa padamasyāpyupasthitau satyāṃ tatrāpi samudāyaśaktirna sidhyedityevaṃrūpā yā pratibandī koṭiḥ sā'pi samudāyaśaktisādhikā na bhavatītyāha-nāpi paṅkajapadapratibandīti| śaktisādhiketyasya vṛttimātre śaktisādhiketyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yat uktam samudāya śakti vādibhiḥ yadi samāse viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ na svīkriyate tarhi paṅkaja śabda evayava śaktyā eva paṅkaja nikardṛ tva rūpeṇa padam asya api upasthitau satyām tatra api samudāya śaktiḥ na sidhyet iti evaṃrūpā yā pratibandī koṭiḥ sā api samudāya śakti sādhikā na bhavati iti āha nā api paṅkaja pada pratibandī iti śakti sādhikā iti asya vṛtti mātre śakti sādhikā iti arthaḥ

original: na bhavatīti śeṣo'styeva| paṅkajapadapratibandī yāvad‌vṛttau śaktiṃ sādhayituṃ na prabhavatītyatra hetumāha-avayavaśaktimajānato'pīti| paṅkādhikaraṇakotpattyāśrayamityādyavayavaśaktijñānābhāvavato'pītyarthaḥ| bodhāditi| pad‌matvena pad‌mabobonna paṅkajaśabdo lākṣaṇika iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: na bhavati iti śeṣaḥ usti eva paṅkaja pada pratibandī yāvat vṛttau śaktim sādhayitum na prabhavati iti atra hetum āha avayava śaktim ajānatā api iti paṅka adhikaraṇaka utpatti āśrayam ityādi avayava śakti jñāna abhāvavatā api iti arthaḥ bodhāt iti padma tvena paṅkaja śabdaḥ lākṣaṇikaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvavayavaśaktijñānābhāve'pi lakṣaṇākaraṇe kiṃ pratibandhakamityāśaṅkya samādhatte--naceti| nahītyarthaḥ| śaktyagraha iti|
analyzed: nanu avayava śakti jñāna abhāve pi lakṣaṇa akaraṇe kim pratibandhakam iti āśaṅkya samādhattena ca iti nahi iti arthaḥ śakti agrahe iti

original: avayavaśaktijñānābhāve satyavayavaśakyārthopasthityasaṃbhavena śakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyāḥ sutarāmasaṃbhavāttebhyaḥ-paṅkajādiśabdaghaṭakāvayavebhyo viśiṣṭārthapratyayaḥ--pad‌matvaviśiṣṭapad‌mārthabodho na saṃbhavatīti saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: avayava śakti jñāna abhāve sati avayava śakya artha upasthiti asaṃbhavena śakya saṃbandha rūpa lakṣaṇāyāḥ sutarām asaṃbhavāt tebhyaḥ paṅkaja ādi śabda ghaṭaka avayavebhyaḥ viśiṣṭa artha pratyayaḥ padma tva viśiṣṭa padma artha bodhaḥ na saṃbhavati iti saṃbandhaḥ

original: tathā cāvayavaśaktijñānābhāvāvastāyāmapi paṅkajaśabdātpad‌matvaprakārakabodhasyānubhavasiddhasyopapattaye samudāyaśaktirāvasyakītyarthaḥ| rājapuruṣa ityādau ca samāsaghaṭakāvayavayo rājapuruṣayoḥ śaktijñānasattvāllakṣaṇaiva|
analyzed: tathā ca avayava śakti jñāna abhāvau astāyām api paṅkaja śabdāt padma tva prakāraka bodhasya anubhava siddhasya upapattaye samudāya śaktiḥ āvasyakī iti arthaḥ rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau ca samāsa ghaṭaka avayavayoḥ rāja puruṣayoḥ śakti jñāna sattvāt lakṣaṇā eva

original: evaṃ cānubhavasiddhapad‌matvādiviśiṣṭabodānyathānupapattiravayavaśaktijñānaśūnyasthale paṅ‌kajādipada eva samudāyaśaktiṃ kalpayati na tvavayavaśaktijñānasattve rājapuruṣādau sarvatra vṛttāviti tātparyārthaḥ| evaṃ rathaḥ, kāraśabde'pi samudāyaśaktiraṅgīkāryaiveti na pūrvoktādhikaraṇavirodha iti bodhyam|
analyzed: evam ca anubhava siddha padma tva ādi viśiṣṭa boda anyathā anupapattiḥ avayava śakti jñāna śūnya sthale paṅkaja ādi padaḥ eva samudāya śaktim kalpayati na tu avayava śakti jñāna sattve rāja puruṣa ādau sarvatra vṛttau iti tātparyārthaḥ evam rathaḥ kāra śabde pi samudāya śaktiḥ aṅgīkāryā eva iti na pūrvokta adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ iti bodhyam

original: nanvevaṃ rājādyavayavaśaktijñānavirahadaśāyāṃ rājasaṃbandhī puruṣa ityevaṃ bodho na syāditi kṛtvā tatrāpi samudāyaśaktiḥ svīkartavyetyāśaṅkyeṣṭāpattireva tadā bodhānudayasyeti samādhatte--ata eveti| avayavaśaktijñānasya lakṣaṇāyāṃ kāraṇatvādevetyarthaḥ| na bodha iti|
analyzed: nanu evam rāja ādi avayava śakti jñāna viraha daśāyām rāja saṃbandhī puruṣaḥ iti evam bodhaḥ na syāt iti kṛtvā tatra api samudāya śaktiḥ svīkartavyā iti āśaṅkya iṣṭa āpattiḥ eva tadā bodha anudayasya iti samādhatte atas eva iti avayava śakti jñānasya lakṣaṇāyām kāraṇa tvāt eva iti arthaḥ na bodhaḥ iti

original: yadi rājapuruṣapadayoḥ śakyārtha evājñātastarhi tatsaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā asaṃbhavādviśiṣṭārthābodhasyānubhavasiddhatvādityarthaḥ| tathā cāvayavaśaktijñānavirahasamaye bodānudaya iṣṭa eveti bhāvaḥ| aṣaṣṭhyarthabahuvrīhau lakṣaṇāyā asaṃbhava iti| bahuvyutpattibhañjanamiti mūla eva prāgatadvyākhyātam|
analyzed: yadi rāja puruṣa padayoḥ śakyārthaḥ eva ajñātaḥ tarhi tad saṃbandha rūpa lakṣaṇāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt viśiṣṭa artha ābodhasya anubhava siddha tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca avayava śakti jñāna viraha samaye boda anudayaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ a ṣaṣṭhī artha bahuvrīhau lakṣaṇāyāḥ asaṃbhavaḥ iti bahu vyutpatti bhañjanam iti mūle eva prāk atat vyākhyātam

original: bahuvrīhāvuttaramada eva lakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamakamāha-pūrvapadasyeti| yaugikatveneti| prakṛtipratyayayoryogena niṣpannatvādityarthaḥ| tallabhaṇāyā iti| pūrvapadalakṣaṇāyā jñānasyetyarthaḥ| dhātupratyayatadartheti| dhātupratyayayostadarthayośca yajjñānaṃ tajjanyatayetyarthaḥ| ayaṃ vilambitatve hetuḥ|
analyzed: bahuvrīhau uttara made eva lakṣaṇāyām vinigamakam āha pūrva padasya iti yaugika tvena iti prakṛti pratyayayoḥ yogena niṣpanna tvāt iti arthaḥ tad labhaṇāyāḥ iti pūrva pada lakṣaṇāyāḥ jñānasya iti arthaḥ dhātu pratyaya tad artha iti dhātu pratyayayoḥ tad arthayoḥ ca yat jñānam tad janyatayā iti arthaḥ ayam vilambita tve hetuḥ

original: svaśakyasaṃbandhātmakalakṣaṇāyā jñāne'vayavaśaktijñānasya kāraṇatvādavayavaśaktijñāne cāvayavajñānasya kāraṇatvātprakṛtipratyayajñānasyāpi lakṣaṇāhetutvena pūrvapadalakṣaṇāyā vilambitatvamityarthaḥ| etenottarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ śīghropasthitikatvarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ sūcitamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sva śakya saṃbandha ātmaka lakṣaṇāyāḥ jñāna ivayava śakti jñānasya kāraṇa tvāt avayava śakti jñāne ca avayava jñānasya kāraṇa tvāt prakṛti pratyaya jñānasya api lakṣaṇā hetu tvena pūrva pada lakṣaṇāyāḥ vilambita tvam iti arthaḥ etena uttara pada lakṣaṇāyām śīghra upasthitika tva rūpam pramāṇam sūcitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu undī kledane' iti dhātoḥ `vkun‌śilpisaṃjñayoḥ'iti kvun‌pratyaye nalope codakaśabdasya niṣpannatvena yaugikatvādudakakartṛkaprāptikarmetyarthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ prāptapadasya tātparyagrāhakatvenopayogāccottarapadalakṣaṇāyāmapi dhātupratyayayostadarthayośca jñānasyā''vaśyakatvena sāmyamevetyāśaṅkyottarapada eva lakṣaṇāyāṃ mānāntaraṃ
analyzed: nanu undī kledane iti dhātoḥ vkun śilpi saṃjñayoḥ iti kvun pratyaye na lope ca udaka śabdasya niṣpanna tvena yaugika tvāt udaka kartṛka prāpti karma iti arthe lakṣaṇāyām prāpta padasya tātparya grāhaka tvena upayogāt ca uttara pada lakṣaṇāyām api dhātu pratyayayoḥ tad arthayoḥ ca jñānasya āvaśyaka tvena sāmyam eva iti āśaṅkya uttara pade eva lakṣaṇāyām māna antaram

original: vakti-pratyayānāmityādi| saṃnihitapadeti| svasaṃnihitaṃ satpūrvavarti ca yatpadaṃ tadarthagato yaḥ svārthaḥ saṃkhyākarmatvādistadbodhakatvaṃ pratyayānāmityanvayaniyāmakānurodāccottarapada eva lakṣaṇā samucitetyarthaḥ| rājapuruṣamānayetyatra rājñi pratyayārthakarmatvādyanvayo na, rājñaḥ pratyayapūrvavartitve'pi saṃnihitatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: vakti pratyayānām ityādi saṃnihita pada iti sva saṃnihitam sat pūrva varti ca yat padam tad artha gataḥ yaḥ svārthaḥ saṃkhyā karma tva ādiḥ tad bodhaka tvam pratyayānām iti anvaya niyāmaka anurodāt ca uttara pade eva lakṣaṇā samucitā iti arthaḥ rāja puruṣam ānaya iti atra rājñi pratyaya artha karma tva ādi anvayaḥ na rājñaḥ pratyaya pūrva varti tve api saṃnihita tva abhāvāt

original: anyathā dvivacanāpatteḥ, puruṣavadrājānayanāpatteśceti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ phasyetyādau vyavahite kuṇḍalādau karmatvādyanvayāpattinirāso jñeyaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā dvivacana āpatteḥ puruṣa vat rāja ānayana āpatteḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ evam kuṇḍalinam phasya ityādau vyavahite kuṇḍala ādau karma tva ādi anvaya āpatti nirāsaḥ jñeyaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ ghaṭādipadeṣvapi caramavarṇasyaiva vācakatā syāt, pratyayāvyavahitapūrvavartitvātpūrvapūrvavarṇānāṃ ca vācakatāyāṃ tātparyagrāhakatvenopayogādityevaṃ vaiyākaraṇoktāṃ pratibandīṃ nirāsayitumāha-ghaṭādipade ceti| atirikteti| ghaṭādipadaghaṭakadhātvādiśakyapekṣayā'tiriktā vācakatā śaktirityartha| viśiṣṭe kalpyate-viśiṣṭa eva kalpyate|
analyzed: nanu evam ghaṭa ādi padeṣu api carama varṇasya eva vācakatā syāt pratyaya avyavahita pūrva varti tvāt pūrva pūrva varṇānām ca vācakatāyām tātparya grāhaka tvena upayogāt iti evam vaiyākaraṇa uktām pratibandīm nirāsayitum āha ghaṭa ādi pade ca iti atiriktā iti ghaṭa ādi pada ghaṭaka dhātu ādi śaki apekṣayā atiriktā vācakatā śaktiḥ iti artha viśiṣṭe kalpyate viśiṣṭe eva kalpyate

original: evakārāntarbhāveṇa vyākhyāne hetumāha--saṃketitatvāditi| kośādinā'bhiyuktavyavahāreṇa ca ghaṭetyevamānūpūrvīkasamudāyasyaiva kambugrīvādimatyarthe saṃketitatvena bodhanādityarthaḥ| evaṃ paṭādiśabdeṣvapi jñeyam| nanu vyavahārādinā vācakatvasya viśiṣṭe nirdhāraṇe'pi bodhakatvaṃ caramavarṇasyaiva syādityāśaṅkyā''ha-bodhakatvasyāpīti|
analyzed: eva kāra antarbhāveṇa vyākhyāne hetum āha saṃketita tvāt iti kośa ādinā abhiyukta vyavahāreṇa ca ghaṭa iti evam ānūpūrvīka samudāyasya eva kambugrīva ādimati arthe saṃketita tvena bodhanāt iti arthaḥ evam paṭa ādi śabdeṣu api jñeyam nanu vyavahāra ādinā vācaka tvasya viśiṣṭe nirdhāraṇe api bodhaka tvam carama varṇasya eva syāt iti āśaṅkya āha bodhaka tvasya api iti

original: paryāptisaṃbandhena bodajanakatvādhikaraṇatvasyāpītyarthaḥ| apiśabdena vācakatvasya saṃgrahaḥ| sa ca dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ| tathaā ca yathā vācakatvasya paryāptisaṃbandhena pratyekavarṇe'sattvamevaṃ bodhakatvasyāpi paryāptisaṃbandhena pratyekasminvarṇe'sattvādityarthaḥ| tenādhikaraṇatvasaṃbandhena bodhakatvasya prativarṇe sattve'pi na kṣatiriti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: paryāpti saṃbandhena boda janakatva adhikaraṇa tvasya api iti arthaḥ apiśabdena vācakatvasya saṃgrahaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭānta arthaḥ tathaā ca yathā vācakatvasya paryāpti saṃbandhena pratyeka varṇe sattvam evam bodhakatvasya api paryāpti saṃbandhena pratyekasmin varṇe sattvāt iti arthaḥ tena adhikaraṇa tva saṃbandhena bodhakatvasya prativarṇe sattve api na kṣatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu citragurityatra citragosvāmīti bodhānyathānupapattyā kalpyamānā lakṣaṇottarapadavatpūrvapade'pi kalpyā syādaviśeṣādityanusaṃdhāya brūte--prakṛte ceti| atyantasaṃnidhāneneti| pratyayāvyavahitatvarūpātyantasaṃnidhānenetyarthaḥ| uttarapada eveti| pratyayārthānvayasaukaryamapi tatraiva lakṣaṇākaraṇe bījamiti bhāvaḥ| viśeṣa iti|
analyzed: nanu citraguḥ iti atra citrago svāmī iti bodha anyathā anupapattyā kalpyamānā lakṣaṇa uttara pada vat pūrva pade api kalpyā syāt aviśeṣāt iti anusaṃdhāya brūte prakṛte ca iti atyanta saṃnidhānena iti pratyaya avyavahita tva rūpa atyanta saṃnidhānena iti arthaḥ uttara pade eva iti pratyaya artha anvaya saukaryam api tatra eva lakṣaṇa ākaraṇe bījam iti bhāvaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti
