original: pratyayaṃ prati pūrvapadāpekṣayottarapadasyātyantasaṃnidānameva viśeṣa iti uttarapada eva lakṣaṇeti bhāvaḥ athavā ghaṭapaṭādipadāpekṣayā samāsottarapadalakṣaṇāyā anvayasaukaryādikaṃ viśeṣa ityarthaḥ| tathā ca ghaṭapaṭādipadeṣu caramavarṇasyātyantaṃ pratyayasaṃnidhāne'pi tasyārthabodhakatvānanubhavātsamudāyasyaiva vācakatvaṃ kalpyata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: pratyayam prati pūrva pada apekṣayā uttara padasya atyanta saṃnidānam eva viśeṣaḥ iti uttara pade eva lakṣaṇā iti bhāvaḥ athavā ghaṭa paṭa ādi pada apekṣayā samāsa uttara pada lakṣaṇāyāḥ anvaya saukarya ādikam viśeṣaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca ghaṭa paṭa ādi padeṣu carama varṇasya atyantam pratyaya saṃnidhāne api tasya artha bodhaka tva ananubhavāt samudāyasya eva vācaka tvam kalpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiṃ ca pratyayātyantasaṃnidhānena caramavarṇasyaiva vācakatvamastu, tacceṣṭameva nāniṣṭamityatra mīmāṃsakasaṃmataṃ darśayati--svīkṛtaṃ cetyādinā| caramavarmasyaiveti| pūrvapūrvavarṇagatatātparyagrāhakatvaviśiṣṭacaramavarṇasyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: kim ca pratyaya atyanta saṃnidhānena carama varṇasya eva vācakatvam astu tat ca iṣṭam eva na aniṣṭam iti atra mīmāṃsaka saṃmatam darśayati svīkṛtam ca ityādinā carama varmasya eva iti pūrva pūrva varṇa gata tātparya grāhakatva viśiṣṭa carama varṇasya iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvavarṇagatatātparyagrāhakatvaṃ ca pūrvapūrvavarṇānāṃ yaḥ śrautaḥ sākṣātkarastajjanitasaṃskāravattvaṃ, tādṛśasaṃskāravattvasahitacaramavarmasyaiveti| yāvat| tena kevalacaramavarṇānnārthapratyayo, nāpi pūrvapūrvavarṇānarthakyamiti bodhyam|
analyzed: pūrva varṇa gata tātparya grāhaka tvam ca pūrva pūrva varṇānām yaḥ śrautaḥ sākṣātkaraḥ tad janita saṃskāravat tvam tādṛśa saṃskāravat tva sahita carama varmasya eva iti yāvat tena kevala carama varṇāt na artha pratyayaḥ na api pūrva pūrva varṇa ānarthakyam iti bodhyam

original: evaṃ parasparānvayayogyatvarūpavyapekṣālaṇasāmarthyavādināṃ naiyāyikamīmāṃsakādīnāṃ matamupapādya tadayuktatve pratipādayannāha--atrocyate iti| samāse'pi vyapekṣaivetimataviṣaye dūṣaṇamucyata ityarthaḥ| śakyasvīkāra iti| samāse samudāyaśaktyanaṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| tasya--samāsasyetyarthaḥ| prātipadikasaṃjñādikamiti|
analyzed: evam paraspara anvaya yogya tva rūpa vyapekṣā laṇa sāmarthya vādinām naiyāyika mīmāṃsaka ādīnām matam upapādya tad ayukta tve pratipādayan āha atra ucyate iti samāse api vyapekṣā eva iti mata viṣaye dūṣaṇam ucyate iti arthaḥ śakya svīkāre iti samāse samudāya śakti anaṅgīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ tasya samāsasya iti arthaḥ prātipadika saṃjñā ādikam iti

original: ādinā subluk, samudāyātpunaḥ subutpattiḥ, anudāttaṃ padamekavarjamityasya pravṛttiśca gṛhyate| saṃjñāderabhāvamupapādayannāha-arthavattvābhāvenoti| arthavatsūtre'rthavadityatra praśaṃsāyāṃ matup| prāśastyaṃ ba vṛttyā'rthabodhajanakatvamśabdaśāstraprastāvācchabdasvarūpamiti viśeṣyasyādhyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: ādinā sup luk samudāyāt punar sup utpattiḥ anudāttam padam eka varjam iti asya pravṛttiḥ ca gṛhyate saṃjñā ādeḥ abhāvam upapādayan āha arthavat tva abhāvena uti arthavat sūtra īrthavat iti atra praśaṃsāyām matup prāśastyam vṛttyā artha bodha janaka tvam śabda śāstra prastāvāt śabda svarūpam iti viśeṣyasya adhyāhāraḥ

original: tathā ca vṛttyā'rthapratipādakaṃ yacchabdasvarūpaṃ tatprātipadikasaṃjñakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| na tu saṃbandhamātraimatupaṃ svīkṛtya yathākathaṃcidarthavattvam|
analyzed: tathā ca vṛttyā artha pratipādakam yat śabda svarūpam tat prātipadika saṃjñakam bhavati iti arthaḥ na tu saṃbandha mātraiḥ matupam svīkṛtya yathā kathaṃcid arthavattvam

original: tathā sati anukāryānukaraṇayorabhedapakṣe'nukaraṇasya vṛttyā'nukāryārthapratipādakatvābhāve'pi sādṛśyādinā'nukāryārthasmārakatvena yathākathaṃcidarthavattvasattvātprātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ subutpattyā `bhūḥ sattāyām| ityādi savibhaktikamaiva nideṃṣṭavyaṃ syāt, na tu-bhū sattāyāmiti vibhaktiśūnyamiti tadasaṃgatameva syāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā sati anukārya anukaraṇayoḥ abheda pakṣe nukaraṇasya vṛttyā anukārya artha pratipādaka tva abhāve pi sādṛśya ādinā anukārya artha smāraka tvena yathā kathaṃcid arthavat tva sattvāt prātipadika saṃjñāyām sup utpattyā bhūḥ sattāyām ityādi savibhaktikam a eva nideṃṣṭavyam syāt na sattāyām iti vibhakti śūnyam iti tat asaṃgatam eva syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca samāsaghaṭakapadayoḥ pratyekaṃ vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatve'pi samudāye śaktyanaṅgīkāreṇa rājapuruṣetyādisamāsasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvābhāvena prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt| tataścālaukikaprakriyāvākyasthasubaluṅna syāt, anudāttaṃ padamiti śeṣanighātaśca na syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca samāsa ghaṭaka padayoḥ pratyekam vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tve api samudāye śakti anaṅgīkāreṇa rāja puruṣa ityādi samāsasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva abhāvena prātipadika saṃjñā na syāt tatas ca alaukika prakriyā vākya stha sup a luk na syāt anudāttam padam iti śeṣa nighātaḥ ca na syāt iti arthaḥ

original: na cā''kāṅkṣādivaśātsvasvāvayavānyataravṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpamarthavattvamarthavatsūtre grāhyamiti vācyam| gauravāt| citragurityādau tadasaṃbhavācca| gośabdasyaiva lakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭārthapratipādakatvāt| na cārthabodhajanakatvaviśiṣṭajñānaviṣayaśabdatvamevārthavattvaṃ tatra grāhyam|
analyzed: na ca ākāṅkṣā ādi vaśāt sva sva avayava anyatara vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpam arthavattvam arthavat sūtre grāhyam iti vācyam gauravāt citraguḥ ityādau tad asaṃbhavāt ca go śabdasya eva lakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭa artha pratipādaka tvāt na ca artha bodha janakatva viśiṣṭa jñāna viṣaya śabdatvam eva arthavattvam tatra grāhyam

original: taccekasya padasya lakṣaṇayā, aparasya padasya tatra tātparyagrāhakatayā cetyevaṃ samāsarūpasamudāyasyākṣatameveti na citragurityādau prātipadikasaṃjñādyanupapattiriti vācyam| tathā sati pratyekamapi prātipadikasaṃjñāsaṃbhavena pratyekasmācchabdādvibhaktyutpattyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: tat ca ekasya padasya lakṣaṇayā aparasya padasya tatra tātparya grāhaka tayā ca iti evam samāsa rūpa samudāyasya akṣatam eva iti na citraguḥ ityādau prātipadika saṃjñā ādi anupapattiḥ iti vācyam tathā sati pratyekam api prātipadika saṃjñā saṃbhavena pratyekasmāt śabdāt vibhakti utpatti āpatteḥ

original: na caikāc‌dvirvacananyāyena samudāyādeva vibhaktirutpatsyate, na pratyekasmāditi vācyam| yatra samudāyakāryeṇa tadavayavā api tatkāryabhājo jāyante tatraiva tannyāyapravṛttisvīkārāt| yathā pacū iti samudāye dvirukte a, ac, pa, ityevamanye'pi tadavayavā dviruktā bhavanti|
analyzed: na ca eka a c dvirvacana nyāyena samudāyāt eva vibhaktiḥ utpatsyate na pratyekasmāt iti vācyam yatra samudāya kāryeṇa tad avayavāḥ api tad kārya bhājaḥ jāyante tatra eva tad nyāya pravṛtti svīkārāt yathā iti samudāye dvis ukte a a c pa iti evam anye api tad avayavāḥ dvis uktāḥ bhavanti

original: yathā vā mūlapradeśe vṛkṣe pracālite'nye'pi tadavayavāḥ śākhādayaḥ pracālitā bhavanti tadvadityarthaḥ| ekāco dve prathamasyetyādinirdeśena pratyekasmādvibhaktivāraṇe tu mahad‌gauravamiti spaṣṭameveti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yathā vā mūla pradeśe vṛkṣe tad avayavāḥ śākhā ādayaḥ pracālitāḥ bhavanti tadvat iti arthaḥ eka a caḥ dve prathamasya ityādi nirdeśena pratyekasmāt vibhakti vāraṇe tu mahat gauravam iti spaṣṭam eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ rājapuruṣādisamāse'rthavatsūtrāprāptāvapi kṛttaddhitetyuttarasūtre samāsagrahaṇādeva samāsasya prātipadikasaṃjñā syāditi śaṅkate-na ca kṛttaddhiteti| samāsagrahaṇāditi| sā-prātipadikasaṃjñā| tathā ca samāsagrahaṇaṃ vidhyarthamityabhimānaḥ śaṅkituḥ| niyamārthatāyā bhāṣyasiddhāyā iti|
analyzed: nanu evam rāja puruṣa ādi samāsa īrthavat sūtra aprāptau api kṛt taddhita iti uttara sūtre samāsa grahaṇāt eva samāsasya prātipadika saṃjñā syāt iti śaṅkatena ca kṛt taddhita iti samāsa grahaṇāt iti sā a prātipadika saṃjñā tathā ca samāsa grahaṇam vidhi artham iti abhimānaḥ śaṅkituḥ niyama artha tāyāḥ bhāṣya siddhāyāḥ iti

original: siddhe satyārambho niyamārtha iti nyāyena samāsasya prātipadikasaṃjñāsiddhiṃ vinā niyamārthatvāsiddhiḥ saṃjñāsiddhiśca pūrvasūtreṇaiva vaktavyeti taduddeśyārthavatpadārthajñānaṃ vinā saṃjñāsiddhervaktumaśakyatvādarthavatsūtre yādṛśamarthavattvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ taducyate-arthaśabdānmatup, arthaśabpaścābhidheyavacanaḥ, evaṃ ca vṛttyā'rthabodhakaṃ
analyzed: siddhe sati ārambhaḥ niyama arthaḥ iti nyāyena samāsasya prātipadika saṃjñā siddhim vinā niyama artha tva asiddhiḥ saṃjñā siddhiḥ ca pūrva sūtreṇa eva vaktavyā iti tad uddeśya arthavat padārtha jñānam vinā saṃjñā siddheḥ vaktum aśakya tvāt arthavat sūtre yādṛśam arthavat tvam vivakṣitam tat ucyate artha śabdāt matup artha śabpaḥ ca abhidheya vacanaḥ evam ca vṛttyā artha bodhakam evam ca vṛttyā artha bodhakam evam ca vṛttyā artha bodhakam evam ca

original: yattatprātipadikasaṃjñamityarthād‌vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvamarthavattvamityarthaḥ| vṛttiśabdena ca laukikālaukikasādāraṇyena vṛttisāmānyamabhipreyate|
analyzed: yat tat prātipadika saṃjñam iti arthāt vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tvam arthavat tvam iti arthaḥ vṛtti śabdena ca laukika alaukika sādāraṇyena vṛtti sāmānyam abhipreyate

original: tatra yasya śabdasyānvaye yo'rthaḥ pratiyate, vyatireke ca vyatiricyate sa tasyārtha ityanvayavyatirekasiddhā vṛttirlaukikī iyamevābhidhā, vācyavācakabhāvaḥ śaktiriti śabdairvyavahriyate `kartari kṛt, tayoreva kṛtyakta, dvyekathordvi, tasyāpatyam, ityādiralaukikī|
analyzed: tatra yasya śabdasya anvaye yaḥ ṛthaḥ pratiyate vyatireke ca vyatiricyate sa tasya arthaḥ iti anvaya vyatireka siddhā vṛttiḥ laukikī iyam eva abhidhā vācya vācaka bhāvaḥ śaktiḥ iti śabdaiḥ vyavahriyate kartari kṛt tayoḥ eva tasya apatyam iti ādiḥ alaukikī

original: etadanusaṃdhāyevoktaṃ vṛhadvaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe pṛṣṭhearthavatsūtre'rthavattvamarthapratītyanukūlavṛttimattvamātramiti| śaktilakṣaṇādyotanānyatamasaṃbandhonārthabodhajanakatvamityarthaḥ| laghumañjūṣāyāṃvṛttyā'rthabodhakatvabheveti| śabdaratnaṭīkāyāṃ bhairavyāmapi-pūrvasūtre'rthavattvaṃ vṛttimattvasāmānyamabhipretamiti|
analyzed: etat anusaṃdhāya iva uktam vṛhat vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe pṛṣṭhe arthavat sūtra īrthavattvam artha pratīti anukūla vṛttimattva mātram iti śakti lakṣaṇā dyotana anyatama saṃbandhaḥ na artha bodha janakatvam iti arthaḥ laghumañjūṣāyām vṛttyā artha bodhakatva bhevā iti śabdaratna ṭīkāyām bhairavyām api pūrva sūtra īrthavattvam vṛttimattva sāmānyam abhipretam iti

original: tathā cārthavatsūtreṇa prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvātsamāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthameva, na vidhyartham| rājapuruṣādisamudāye siddhānte viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkārāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca arthavat sūtreṇa prātipadika saṃjñāyāḥ siddha tvāt samāsa grahaṇam niyama artham eva na vidhi artham rāja puruṣa ādi samudāye siddhānte viśiṣṭa śakti svīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu siddhānte'pi asūryaṃpaśyāḥ, aśrāddhabhojītyādāvasūryamiti aśrāddhamiti cāsamarthasamāsaḥ, atra nañarthasya sūryakarmikayā dṛśikriyayā saṃbandho, na sūryeṇa, sūryaṃ na paśyantītyarthāvagamāt, tathā'śrāddhamityatratyaño bhujikriyayā saṃbandho na śrāddhena, śrāddhabhojananiṣedhāvagamāt|
analyzed: nanu siddhānte api a sūryaṃpaśyāḥ aśrāddha bhojī ityādau a sūryam iti aśrāddham iti ca asamartha samāsaḥ atra nañ arthasya sūrya karmikayā dṛśi kriyayā saṃbandhaḥ na sūryeṇa sūryam na paśyanti iti artha avagamāt tathā aśrāddham iti atratyañaḥ bhuji kriyayā saṃbandhaḥ na śrāddhena śrāddha bhojana niṣedha avagamāt

original: tathā cāsamarthasamāse vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvāttatra saṃjñāvidhānārthamāvaśyakaṃ samāsagrahaṇamiti tadevedānīṃ samudāyaśaktyanaṅgīkartṛmate vṛttyā'rtābhidhāyakatvābhāve'pi samāse saṃjñāvidhāyakaṃ syāditi cenmaivam|
analyzed: tathā ca asamartha samāse vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpa arthavat tva abhāvāt tatra saṃjñā vidhāna artham āvaśyakam samāsa grahaṇam iti tat eva idānīm samudāya śakti anaṅgīkartṛ mate vṛtti ārta abhidhāyaka tva abhāve pi samāse saṃjñā vidhāyakam syāt iti ced mā evam

original: asūryamityādāvapi asūryamityādeḥ sūryakarmakadarśanābhāvavati, śrāddhakarmakabhojanābhāvavati ca śaktikalpanenārthavatsūtreṇāva siddhatvāt| na ca śaśaśṛṅgamityādau śaśīyaśṛṅgasyātyantāprasiddherarthābhāvenānarthakasya saṃjñārthaṃ tadāvaśyakaṃ, anyathā prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāditi vācyam|
analyzed: a sūryam ityādau api a sūryam ityādeḥ sūrya karmaka darśana abhāvavati śrāddha karmaka bhojana abhāvavati ca śakti kalpanena arthavat sūtreṇa ava siddha tvāt na ca śaśa śṛṅgam ityādau śaśīya śṛṅgasya atyanta aprasiddheḥ artha abhāvena anarthakasya saṃjñā artham tat āvaśyakam anyathā prātipadika saṃjñā na syāt iti vācyam

original: tatrāpi viśakalitaprasiddhaṃ śṛṅgādikamāropitasaṃbandhe śakyaṃ, nāma-gavādiṣvanubhūtaṃ śṛṅgaṃ śaśamastakavartitayā buddhyotprekṣitaṃ śaśaśṛṅgapadāvācyamato'rthavatsūtrasya prāptisattvāt| kiṃ ca samāsarūpadharmigrāhakāt, asūryalalāṭayoriti mānādasūryetyasya prātipadikasaṃjñā sidhyati|
analyzed: tatra api viśakalita prasiddham śṛṅga ādikam āropita saṃbandhe śakyam nāma go ādiṣu anubhūtam śṛṅgam śaśa mastaka vartitayā buddhyā utprekṣitam śaśa śṛṅga pada avācyam atas ṛthavat sūtrasya prāpti sattvāt kim ca samāsa rūpa dharmi grāhakāt asūrya lalāṭayoḥ iti mānāt asūrya iti asya prātipadika saṃjñā sidhyati

original: nahi prātipadikatvaṃ subutpattiṃ ca vinā samīpoccāritapadatvarūpamupapadatvaṃ nirvahati| svāpnapadārthānubhavānurodhena bauddhapadarthasyā''vaśyakatvena śaśaśṛṅgādau bauddhaḥ śaśaśṛṅgādirartho vācya iti spaṣṭaṃ nibandheṣviti bodhyam| tathā ca siddhānte samāsagrahaṇasyaniyamārthatvameva|
analyzed: nahi prātipadika tvam sup utpattim ca vinā samīpa uccārita pada tva rūpam upapada tvam nirvahati svāpna padārtha anubhava anurodhena bauddha padarthasya āvaśyaka tvena śaśa śṛṅga ādau bauddhaḥ śaśa śṛṅga ādiḥ arthaḥ vācyaḥ iti spaṣṭam nibandheṣu iti bodhyam tathā ca siddhānte samāsa grahaṇasya aniyama artha tvam eva

original: nanu viśiṣṭaśaktyasvīkāre rājapuruṣādisamāse pratyekamavayavasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatve'pi samudāyasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābāvātprātipadikasaṃjñā na prāpnoti tadvidhyarthamevāstu, niyamavyāvartyasya gāmānayetyādervṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvābhāvādeva prātipadikasaṃjñāyā aprāpterdoṣābhāvena tasya niyamārthatvābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ|
analyzed: nanu viśiṣṭa śakti asvīkāre rāja puruṣa ādi samāse pratyekam avayavasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tve api samudāyasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpa arthavat tva abāvāt prātipadika saṃjñā na prāpnoti tad vidhi artham eva astu niyama vyāvartyasya gām ānaya ityādeḥ vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva abhāvāt eva prātipadika saṃjñāyāḥ aprāpteḥ doṣa abhāvena tasya niyama artha tva abhāve api na kṣatiḥ

original: nacāpratyayasyeti niṣedhājjanmavān kartetyādau prātipadikasaṃjñāna syāditi vācyam| kṛttaddhi tyuttarasūtreṇa tatsaṃbhavāt| na ca saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇe tadantagrahaṇaṃ nāstīti niṣedhāttadantavidherasaṃbhava iti vācyam| kevalayoḥ kṛttaddhitayoḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojanābhāvena tadantavidheranivāryatvāditi cenna|
analyzed: na ca apratyayasya iti niṣedhāt janmavān kartā ityādau syāt iti vācyam kṛt taddhi tyuttara sūtreṇa tad saṃbhavāt na ca saṃjñā vidhau pratyaya grahaṇe tad anta grahaṇam na asti iti niṣedhāt tad anta vidheḥ asaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam kevalayoḥ kṛt taddhitayoḥ saṃjñāyāḥ prayojana abhāvena tad anta vidheḥ anivārya tvāt iti ced na

original: kevalakṛttaddhitayoḥ prātipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ phiṣo'nta udātta iti phiṭ‌svarapravṛttereva prayojanatvāt| na ca matyayasvareṇa bādhānna phiṭ‌svarapravṛttisaṃbhava iti vācyam| yena nāprāptinyāyena pratyayasvarāpekṣayā prātipadikasvarasya subdhātau dhātusvarasyeva balīyastvāt|
analyzed: kevala kṛt taddhitayoḥ prātipadika saṃjñāyām phiṣaḥ antaḥ udāttaḥ iti phiṭ svara pravṛtteḥ eva prayojana tvāt na ca matyaya svareṇa bādhāt na phiṭ svara pravṛtti saṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam yena na aprāpti nyāyena pratyaya svara apekṣayā prātipadika svarasya sup dhātau dhātu svarasya iva balīyaḥ tvāt

original: tathā ca tadantavidherabhāvājjanmavānityādau prātipadikasaṃjñā na syāditi cenna| uttarasūtre tadantagrahaṇāyārthavadityanuvṛtterāvaśyakatvena kṛttaddhitā|
analyzed: tathā ca tad anta vidheḥ abhāvāt janmavān ityādau prātipadika saṃjñā na syāt iti ced na uttara sūtre tad anta grahaṇāya arthavat iti anuvṛtteḥ āvaśyaka tvena kṛt taddhitā

original: nāmanarthakānāmaprasiddhervṛttyā'rthabodhajanakatvarūpārthavattvagrahaṇe'rthavad‌grahaṇānuvṛttivaiyarthyena tatsāmarthyātsamudāyaśaktyā viśiṣṭārthabodajanakatvarūpaviśiṣṭārthavattvamuttarasūtre gṛhyate| tādṛśaviśiṣṭārthavattvaṃ ca na kevalakṛttāddhitānāṃ saṃbhavati, tatra pāribhāṣikārthavattvābhāvāt|

original: tataśca tādṛśaviśiṣṭārthavantau yau kṛttaddhitāvityabhedena viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānupapattiriti tadupapattaye kṛttaddhitāṃśe tadantavidhiḥ sidhyatikṛttaddhitānteṣveva pāribhāṣikārthavattvasya sattvāt| tathā ca janmavānityādau na saṃjñāyā anupapattiḥ|

analyzed: na ca anuvṛtta arthavat padasya tad anta vidhi siddhi artham kṛt taddhitayoḥ ava anvayoḥ tu na samāse pi prayojana abhāvāt tathā ca viśiṣṭa śakti anaṅgīkāre pi samāsasya kṛt taddhita iti sūtre samāsa grahaṇāt eva saṃjñā sidhyet iti vācyam tathā sati kṛt taddhita samāsāḥ iti dvaṃdvasya asādhu tā āpatteḥ śranyatarasya pāṇḍitye maitra caitraḥ paṇḍitau iti prayoga abhāvāt

original: parasparasāpekṣatvasūcanāyaiva caitraśca maitraśceti vākye pratyekaṃ caśabdaprayogaḥ| tayoḥ parasparāpekṣitvaṃ ca pratyāsattyā svasamabhivyāhṛtapāṇḍitya eveti parasparopakṣitvalakṣaṇasāmarthyasattvāditaretarapogadvaṃdvaḥ samāso bhavati| ekatarasyāpāṇḍitye parasparāpekṣitvasāmarthyābhāvād‌dvaṃdva eva na prāpnotīti tatra dvaṃdvasyāsādhutvamucyate|

original: evaṃ ca dvaṃdvaghaṭakayāvatpadārthe, itara(dvaṃdbāghaṭaka)padārthānvaya eva dvaṃdvasya sādhutvaṃ, na dvaṃdvaghaṭakayatkiṃcitpadārthe, dvaṃdvāghaṭakapadārthānvaye, iti niyamo labhyate| itaretyasya dvaṃdvaghaṭakībhūtapadārthātiriktetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca dvaṃdva ghaṭaka yāvat padārthe itara dvaṃdba aghaṭaka padārtha anvaye eva dvaṃdvasya sādhu tvam na dvaṃdva ghaṭaka yat kiṃcid padārthe dvaṃdva aghaṭaka padārtha anvaye iti niyamaḥ labhyate itarā iti asya dvaṃdva ghaṭakībhūta padārtha atiriktā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ sati vṛttighaṭakapadārtathātiriktasya viśiṣṭārthabodhajanakatvarūpānuvṛttārthavatpadārthasya yadi kṛttaddhitayorevānvayaḥ syānnasamāse, tarhi kṛttaddhitasamāseti padatrasya viśiṣṭārthabodhajanakatvarūpe'rthavattve parasparānapekṣitvena parasparasāpekṣatvalakṣaṇasāmarthyābhāvātsamāso na syāt, kiṃ tu `kṛttaddhitau samāsaśca' ityeva nirdeṣṭavyaṃ
analyzed: evam sati vṛtti ghaṭaka padārtha thā atiriktasya viśiṣṭa artha bodha janakatva rūpa anuvṛtta arthavat padārthasya yadi kṛt taddhitayoḥ eva anvayaḥ syāt na samāse tarhi kṛt taddhita samāsa iti paraspara anapekṣi tvena paraspara sāpekṣa tva lakṣaṇa sāmarthya abhāvāt samāsaḥ na syāt kim tu kṛt taddhitau samāsaḥ ca iti eva nirdeṣṭavyam

original: syāt| yasmācca tatā'kṛtvā padatrayasyetaretarayoge dvaṃdvaḥ kṛtastasmādanuvṛttārthavatpadasya samāsapade'pyanvayaḥ kārya eva| tathaā ca samāsādau viśiṣṭaśaktyanaṅgīkāre'rthavattvābhāvātsamāsasya saṃjñā na bhavati|
analyzed: syāt yasmāt ca tatā kṛtvā pada trayasya itaretara yoge dvaṃdvaḥ kṛtaḥ tasmāt anuvṛtta arthavat padasya samāsa pade pi anvayaḥ kāryaḥ eva tathaā ca samāsa ādau viśiṣṭa śakti anaṅgīkāra īrthavat tva abhāvāt samāsasya saṃjñā na bhavati

original: na caivaṃ samāsādau viśiṣṭaśaktnaṅgīkartṛmate samāsagrahaṇaṃ vyarthameva syāditi tadvidhāyakamevāstu samāsaśca sautratvādupapādanīya iti vācyam| tathā sati bahupaṭaca ityatra jasantātpūrvaṃ bahuci kṛte tasya taddhitāntatvābhāvānnottarasūtreṇa saṃjñā prāpnoti|
analyzed: na ca evam samāsa ādau viśiṣṭa śakti aṅgīkartṛ mate samāsa grahaṇam vyartham eva syāt iti tad vidhāyakam eva astu samāsaḥ ca sautra tvāt upapādanīyaḥ iti vācyam tathā sati bahu paṭa caḥ iti atra jas antāt pūrvam bahu ci kṛte tasya taddhita anta tva abhāvāt na uttara sūtreṇa saṃjñā prāpnoti

original: nāpi pūrvasūtreṇa, prakṛtiprtayayayoḥ pratyekaṃ vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatve'pi samudāyasya vṛttyārthapratipādakatvābhāvāt| tathā ca citaḥ saprakṛteriti vacanena cittvaprayuktāntodāttatvaṃ vakārottaravartino'kārasya syāt, bahupaṭavaḥ iti, iṣyate tu ṭakārottaravartino'kārasya bahupaṭavaḥ, iti|
analyzed: na api pūrva sūtreṇa prakṛti prtayayayoḥ pratyekam vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tve api samudāyasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva abhāvāt tathā ca citaḥ sa prakṛteḥ iti vacanena cit tva prayukta anta udātta tvam vakāra uttara vartinā ukārasya syāt bahu paṭavaḥ iti iṣyate tu ṭakāra uttara vartinā ukārasya bahu paṭavaḥ iti

original: pratipadikasaṃjñāyāṃ satyāṃ tu antaraṅgānapi vighīn bahiraṅgo lugbādhate, iti nyāyena prathamajaso luguttaramave pravartate svara itīṣṭasiddhiḥ| na ca taddhitaśabdasya tadviśiṣṭaparatayā kṛttaddhitetisūtreṇaivātra prātipadikasaṃjñeti vācyam| pacatakītyādāvatiprasaṅgāt| avyayasarvanāmnāmityatra tiṅaścetyanuvartanātpacatīti tiṅantasyākac|
analyzed: pratipadika saṃjñāyām satyām tu antaraṅgān api vighīn bahiraṅgaḥ luc bādhate iti nyāyena prathama jasaḥ luc uttara mave pravartate svaraḥ iti iṣṭa siddhiḥ na ca taddhita śabdasya tad viśiṣṭa para tayā kṛt taddhita iti sūtreṇa eva atra prātipadika saṃjñā iti vācyam pacatakī ityādau atiprasaṅgāt avyaya sarvanāmnām iti atra tiṅaḥ ca iti anuvartanāt pacati iti tiṅ antasya akac

original: bahupaṭavastiṣṭhantīti vākyasya taddhitaviśiṣṭatvāttatrātiprasaṅgācca| evaṃ ca bahupaṭava ityatrāvasyameṣṭavyā saṃjñā na syādityeko doṣaḥ| aparaśca mūlakenopadaṃśamityatra tṛtīyāprabhṛtinyanyatarasyāmiti samāsābhāvapakṣe kṛdantatvātprātipadikasaṃjñāpattiḥ syāt| na ca samudāyottaraṃ kṛdvihita iti na tatkṛdantamiti vācyam|
analyzed: bahu paṭavaḥ tiṣṭhanti iti vākyasya taddhita viśiṣṭa tvāt tatra atiprasaṅgāt ca evam ca bahu paṭavaḥ iti atra avasyam eṣṭavyā saṃjñā na syāt iti ekaḥ doṣaḥ aparaḥ ca mūlakena upadaṃśam iti atra tṛtīyā prabhṛtini anyatarasyām iti samāsa abhāva pakṣe kṛt anta tvāt prātipadika saṃjñā āpattiḥ syāt na ca samudāya uttaram kṛt vihitaḥ iti na tat kṛt antam iti vācyam

original: kṛd‌grahaṇe gatikārakapūrvasyāpi grahaṇamiti paribhāṣayā viśiṣṭagrahaṇasaṃbhavāt| mūlakasyopadaṃśanakarmatvaṃ bhujau karaṇatvaṃ cāsti, vibhaktistu pradhānakriyāṃ prati karaṇatvaprayuktā tṛtīyaiva kṛteti mūlakasyopadaṃśanakārakatvākṣateḥ| tathā ca mūlakeneti vibhakterluk syāt| na ca samāsatadabhāvayoraikarūpye samāsavikalpe phalābhāva iti vācyam|
analyzed: kṛt grahaṇe gati kāraka pūrvasya api grahaṇam iti paribhāṣayā viśiṣṭa grahaṇa saṃbhavāt mūlakasya upadaṃśana karma tvam bhujau karaṇa tvam ca asti vibhaktiḥ tu pradhāna kriyām prati karaṇa tva prayuktā tṛtīyā eva kṛtā iti mūlakasya upadaṃśana kāraka tva akṣateḥ tathā ca mūlakena iti vibhakteḥ luk syāt na ca samāsa tad abhāvayoḥ aikarūpye samāsa vikalpe phala abhāvaḥ iti vācyam

original: samāse uttarapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ asamāse tūdāttadvayamiti svaraviśeṣasya tatphalatvasaṃbhavāt| tathā cātrāpi doṣa eva|

original: kiṃ ca vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvamarthavattvamarthavatsūtre gṛhyate cedviśiṣṭaśaktimasvīkurvatāṃ prācīnavaiyākaraṇānāṃ mate hariṣu karoṣītyādau prakṛtipratyayoḥ pratyekaṃ vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatve'pi samudāyasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvābhāvātsaṃjñā na prāpnotīti pratyayāntaparyudāso viphalaḥ, tatsārthakyāya prakṛti tyayasamudāyasya
analyzed: kim ca vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tvam arthavat tvam arthavat sūtre gṛhyate ced viśiṣṭa śaktim asvīkurvatām prācīna vaiyākaraṇānām mate hariṣu karoṣi ityādau prakṛti pratyayoḥ pratyekam vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tve api samudāyasya vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva abhāvāt saṃjñā na prāpnoti iti pratyaya anta paryudāsaḥ viphalaḥ tad sārthakyāya prakṛti tyaya samudāyasya

original: prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatīti kalpyate| kṛttaddhitāntayoḥ pratyayāntatvānniṣedhe prāpte vidhyartha(pratiprasavārtha)muttarasūtre kṛttaddhitagrahaṇam| bahupaṭava ityatra prakṛtipratyayasamudāyatvātprātipadikasaṃjñāyaṃ satyāṃ siddha iṣṭaḥ svaraḥ|
analyzed: prātipadika saṃjñā bhavati iti kalpyate kṛt taddhita antayoḥ pratyaya anta tvāt niṣedhe prāpte vidhi artha pratiprasava artham uttara sūtre kṛt taddhita grahaṇam bahu paṭavaḥ iti atra prakṛti pratyaya samudāya tvāt prātipadika saṃjñā ayam satyām siddhaḥ iṣṭaḥ svaraḥ

original: tathā'pi bahupaṭava ityatreṣṭasvarasiddhyarthaṃ pratyayāntaparyudāso'vaśyaṃ vaktavya iti gauravameva doṣaḥ| viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkāre kṛttaddhitāntayorvṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvenārthavatsūtreṇaiva saṃjñāyāḥ siddhatvāddhāttoḥ pratyayāntasya ca cedbhavati saṃjñā tarhi kṛttaddhitāntayoreveti niyamena dhātuparyadāsaḥ pratyayāntaparyuda saśca pratyākhyāto
analyzed: tathā api bahu paṭavaḥ iti atra iṣṭa svara siddhi artham pratyaya anta paryudāsaḥ uvaśyam vaktavyaḥ iti gauravam eva doṣaḥ viśiṣṭa śakti svīkāre kṛt taddhita antayoḥ vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tvena arthavat sūtreṇa eva saṃjñāyāḥ siddha tvāt dhāttoḥ pratyaya antasya ca ced bhavati saṃjñā tarhi kṛt taddhita antayoḥ eva iti niyamena dhātu paryadāsaḥ pratyaya anta paryudasaḥ ca pratyākhyātaḥ

original: bhāṣye| na cottarasūtre saṃjñāvidhau pratyayagrahaṇa iti niṣedhāttadantagrahaṇaṃ na syāt| kṛttaddhitāntayorviśiṣṭārthapratipādakatvābhāvenārthavadityanuvṛttisāmarthyādapi na tadantavidheḥ saṃbhavaḥ| kiṃ tu pratyayaparyupadāsānniṣedhe prāpte kevalapratyayoreva saṃjñāvidhānārthaṃ kṛttaddhitagrahaṇamiti vācyamiti cenna|
analyzed: bhāṣye na ca uttara sūtre saṃjñā vidhau pratyaya grahaṇe iti niṣedhāt tad anta grahaṇam na syāt kṛt taddhita antayoḥ viśiṣṭa artha pratipādaka tva abhāvena arthavat iti anuvṛtti sāmarthyāt api na tad anta vidheḥ saṃbhavaḥ kim tu pratyaya paryupadāsāt niṣedhe prāpte kevala pratyayoḥ eva saṃjñā vidhāna artham kṛt taddhita grahaṇam iti vācyam iti ced na

original: bhāṣye pratyayaparyudāsānuktervṛttvā'rthapratipādakatvātpratyayasyārthavatsūtreṇaiva siddheḥ punastad‌grahaṇaṃ tadantārthamevetyanumīyate| naca siddhe satyārambho niyamārtha iti nyāyena pratyayasya cedbhavati saṃjñā tarhi kṛttaddhitayoreveti niyamārthaṃ tad‌grahaṇamiti vācyam| pratyayaparyudāsānuktiparabhāṣyaviruddhatvāt|

original: pratyayaparyudāsānuktibhāṣyātpratyayasya saṃjñāyāmapi phalābhāvadoṣābhāvayoravagamāt| phaladoṣayoḥ saṃbhave'vaśyaṃ sa paryudāsa uktaḥ syāt| tathā ca tadantasaṃjñārthameveti bahupaṭava ityatra prātipadikasaṃjñārthaṃ pratyayāntaparyudāsaḥ kartavya iti gauravameko doṣaḥ|

original: aparaśca mūlakenopadaṃśamityādau kṛd‌grahaṇaparibhāṣayā kṛdantatvātsaṃjñā prāpnotīti doṣaḥ| evaṃ ca na prācīnavaiyākaraṇoktarītyā klṝptaśaktyopapattirbhavatīti sarvatra samāsādau viśiṣṭaśaktiḥ svīkāryetyabhiprāyaḥ| sā ca viśiṣṭaśaktiḥ kṛttaddhitādipañcavṛttiṣviva vākye'pyāśrayaṇīyā|
analyzed: aparaḥ ca mūlakena upadaṃśam ityādau kṛt grahaṇa paribhāṣayā kṛt anta tvāt saṃjñā prāpnoti iti doṣaḥ evam ca na prācīna vaiyākaraṇa ukta rītyā klṝpta śaktyā upapattiḥ bhavati iti sarvatra samāsa ādau viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ svīkāryā iti abhiprāyaḥ sā ca viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ kṛt taddhita ādi pañca vṛttiṣu iva vākye pi āśrayaṇīyā

original: iyān paraṃ viśeṣaḥ-kṛttaddhitādipañcavṛttiṣu vartamānā viśiṣṭaśaktirekārthībhāvaśabdena vyavahriyate, na vākye vartamāneti| vākye viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkārādeva `vākyapratiṣedho'rthavattvāt' vākyasya prātipadikasaṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kartapyaḥ, kutaḥ? arthavattvāt, vākyasya viśiṣṭārthavattvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: iyān param viśeṣaḥ kṛt taddhita ādi pañca vṛttiṣu vartamānā viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ ekārthībhāva śabdena vyavahriyate na vākye vartamānā iti vākye viśiṣṭa śakti svīkārāt eva vākya pratiṣedha ūrthavat tvāt vākyasya prātipadika saṃjñāyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kartapyaḥ kutas arthavat tvāt vākyasya viśiṣṭa arthavat tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: ityuktvā `na vai padārthādanyasyārthasyopalabdhirbhavati vākye' padāni svasvamarthaṃ pratipādayanti vākyam| padārthā eva tvākāṅkṣāyogyatāsaṃbidhivaśātparasparasaṃsṛṣṭā vākyārthaḥ| na tu vākyaṃ vākyārtho vā pṛthagastīti|
analyzed: iti uktvā na vai padārthāt anyasya arthasya upalabdhiḥ bhavati vākye padāni sva svam artham pratipādayanti vākyam padārthāḥ eva tu ākāṅkṣā yogyatā saṃbidhi vaśāt paraspara saṃsṛṣṭāḥ vākya arthaḥ na tu vākyam vākya arthaḥ vā pṛthak asti iti

original: evaṃ ca padārthairavā''kāṅkṣādibhiḥ saṃsargasya gamyamānatvānna tatra vākyaśaktikvākyasyātiriktasyābhāvāccetyāśaṅkya tadupari siddhānta uktaḥ-`padārthādanyasyānupalabdhiriti cetpadārthābhisaṃbandhasyopalabdhiḥ,' devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāmiti vākyasthapadānāṃ sāmānye vartamānānāṃ yadviśeṣe'vasthānaṃ sa vākyārthaḥ, tasmātpratiṣedho vaktavya
analyzed: evam ca padārthaiḥ ava ākāṅkṣā ādibhiḥ saṃsargasya gamyamāna tvāt na tatra vākya śakti kvākyasya atiriktasya abhāvāt ca iti āśaṅkya tad upari siddhāntaḥ uktaḥ padārthāt anyasya anupalabdhiḥ iti ced padārtha abhisaṃbandhasya upalabdhiḥ devadatta gām abhyāja śuklām iti vākya stha padānām sāmānye vartamānānām yat viśeṣa ivasthānam sa vākya arthaḥ tasmāt pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ

original: ityarthavatsūtre bhāṣya uktam| atra keyaṭaḥ-dhvanivyaṅgyaṃ nityaṃ vākyaṃ viśiṣṭārthasya=viśeṣaṇatvādiviśiṣṭasyārthasya, padārthasaṃsargarūpasya vācakam| anyathā hyaśābdo vākyārthaḥ syāditi| sāmānye vartamānānāṃ--viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatvarahitasvasvārthe vartamānānāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: iti arthavat sūtre bhāṣye uktam atra keyaṭaḥ dhvani vyaṅgyam nityam vākyam viśiṣṭa arthasya viśeṣaṇa tva ādi viśiṣṭasya arthasya padārtha saṃsarga rūpasya vācakam anyathā hi aśābdaḥ vākya arthaḥ syāt iti sāmānye vartamānānām viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva rahita sva svārthe vartamānānām iti arthaḥ

original: viśeṣe'vasthānaṃ--viśeṣaṇatvādiviśiṣṭe padārthasaṃsargarūpe vākyārthe'vasthānamityarthaḥ| yadi ca padārthasaṃsargo vākyaśakyo na syāttarhi vākyārthasyāśābdatvenāprāmāṇyādanāśvāsena `jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' ityādiḥ śrautavyavahāro laukikavyavahāraśca sarva ucchinnaḥ syādityanena praghaṭṭakena padārthasaṃsargarūpe vākyārthe vākyasya śaktiḥ
analyzed: viśeṣa iva sthānam viśeṣaṇa tva ādi viśiṣṭe padārtha saṃsarga rūpe vākya artha ivasthānam iti arthaḥ yadi ca padārtha saṃsargaḥ vākya śakyaḥ na syāt tarhi vākya arthasya aśābda tvena aprāmāṇyāt anāśvāsena jyotiṣṭomena svarga kāmaḥ yajeta ityādiḥ śrauta vyavahāraḥ laukika vyavahāraḥ ca sarvaḥ ucchinnaḥ syāt iti anena praghaṭṭakena padārtha saṃsarga rūpe vākya arthe vākyasya śaktiḥ

original: samāśrayaṇīyaiveti sidhyati| evaṃ ca samāsasya śaktivṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvenārthavattvādarthavatsūtreṇaiva saṃjñāsiddheḥ samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ saṃpadyate| niyamākāraśca--yatra saṃdhāte pūrvo bhāgaḥ padaṃ, uttaraśca pratyayo netyevaṃrūpo manoramokto bodhyaḥ|
analyzed: samāśrayaṇīyā eva iti sidhyati evam ca samāsasya śakti vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tvena arthavat tvāt arthavat sūtreṇa eva saṃjñā siddheḥ samāsa grahaṇam niyama artham saṃpadyate niyama ākāraḥ ca yatra saṃdhāte pūrvaḥ bhāgaḥ padam uttaraḥ ca pratyayaḥ na iti evaṃrūpaḥ manorama uktaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: tena ca mūlakenopadaṃśamityatra kṛśaktyabhāvena śakyasaṃbandharūpasakṣaṇāyā apyasaṃbhavena lākṣaṇīkārthavattvasyāpyasaṃdantatvātprāptā, gāmānayetyādivākyasyāpratyayāntatvādarthavatsūtreṇa prāptā ca saṃjñā na bhavati| tataśca sublopādikaṃ na bhavatīti doṣābhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tena ca mūlakena upadaṃśam iti atra kṛ śakti abhāvena śakya saṃbandha rūpa sakṣaṇāyāḥ api asaṃbhavena lākṣaṇīkā arthavat tvasya api asaṃdanta tvāt prāptā gām ānaya ityādi vākyasya a pratyaya anta tvāt arthavat sūtreṇa prāptā ca saṃjñā na bhavati tatas ca sup lopa ādikam na bhavati iti doṣa abhāvaḥ

original: vahupaṭava ityasya niyamākārakukṣipraviṣṭatvābhāvādarthavatsūtreṇa saṃjñāsiddhiriti sarvaṃ sustham| yattūcyate yadyarthavatsūtre vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpamarthavattvaṃ gṛdyate tarhyekārthībhāvasya vṛttimātre sattvāttkṛttaddhitāntayoḥ samāsasya cārtavatsūtreṇaiva saṃgrahātsubantatiṅantayorekārthībhāvābhāvenāsaṃgrahādarthavatsūtre
analyzed: vahu paṭavaḥ iti asya niyama ākāra kukṣi praviṣṭa tva abhāvāt arthavat sūtreṇa saṃjñā siddhiḥ iti sarvam sustham yat tu ucyate yadi arthavat sūtre vṛttyā artha pratipādaka tva rūpam arthavat tvam gṛdyate tarhi ekārthībhāvasya vṛtti mātre sattvāt t kṛt taddhita antayoḥ samāsasya ca ārtavat sūtreṇa eva saṃgrahāt sup anta tiṅ antayoḥ ekārthībhāva abhāvena asaṃgrahāt arthavat sūtre

original: pratyayāntaparyudāsasya kṛttaddhiteti sūtrasya ca vaiyarthyāpattidurvāreti| tanna| kvibantadātunāṃ kviblope sati chid bhid, ityādāvadhaāturiti paryudāsāt, iyān iyadityādāvidam‌śabdātparasya vatupo vakārasya ghakārādeśe tasyeyādeśe ca idaṃkimorīś‌kī, itīdaṃśabdasyeśādeśe tasya yasyeti ceti lope, iyat, iti kevalaṃ pratyayarūpamavaśiṣṭaṃ,
analyzed: pratyaya anta paryudāsasya kṛt taddhita iti sūtrasya ca vaiyarthya āpatti durvārā iti tat na kvip anta dātunām kvip lope sati chid bhid ityādau adha ātuḥ iti paryudāsāt iyān iyat ityādau idam śabdāt parasya vatupaḥ vakārasya ghakāra ādeśe tasya iyādeśe ca iti idam śabdasya īśa ādeśe tasya yasya iti ca iti lope iyat iti kevalam pratyaya rūpam avaśiṣṭam

original: tatrāpratyaya iti paryudāsātsaṃjñānāpatteḥ| vidhāyakābhāvāt| tadarthaṃ kṛttaddhitagrahaṇasya vidhyarthatve prāgukteṣu mūlakenopadaṃśaṃ, daśa dāḍimānītyādiṣu doṣaprasaṅga iti samāsagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthamiti bodhyam|
analyzed: tatra apratyayaḥ iti paryudāsāt saṃjñāna āpatteḥ vidhāyaka abhāvāt tad artham kṛt taddhita grahaṇasya vidhi artha tve prāk ukteṣu mūlakena upadaṃśam daśa dāḍimāni ityādiṣu doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti samāsa grahaṇam niyama artham iti bodhyam

original: evaṃ prācīnavaiyākaraṇarītyā samāse śaktyasvīkāre klṛptaśaktyopapattirna bhavatīti pratipādyātha naiyāyikādirītyā lakṣaṇayā'pyupapattirna bhavatīti brūte-samāsavākye śaktyabhāvenetyādi|
analyzed: evam prācīna vaiyākaraṇa rītyā samāse śakti asvīkāre klṛpta śaktyā upapattiḥ na bhavati iti pratipādya atha naiyāyika ādi rītyā lakṣaṇayā api upapattiḥ na bhavati iti brūte samāsa vākye śakti abhāvena ityādi

original: samāseṃ viśiṣṭaśaktyasvīkāre samāsarūpavākyasya kasmiṃścidapyarthe śaktirnāstīti samāsasya śakyārthābhāvācchakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā api vaktumaśakyatvāllākṣaṇikārthavattvasyāpi samāse'sattvānna lakṣaṇayā naiyāyikādirītyā'pyupapattirbhavatīti sarvatra samāse viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkāra āvaśyakaḥ| avedaṃ bodhyam--nyāyavaiśeṣikādimate vākye lakṣaṇā nāsti|
analyzed: viśiṣṭa śakti asvīkāre samāsa rūpa vākyasya kasmiṃścid api arthe śaktiḥ na asti iti samāsasya śakyārtha abhāvāt śakya saṃbandha rūpa lakṣaṇāyāḥ api vaktum aśakya tvāt lākṣaṇika arthavattvasya api samāse sattvāt na lakṣaṇayā naiyāyika ādi rītyā api upapattiḥ bhavati iti sarvatra samāse viśiṣṭa śakti svīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ bodhyam nyāya vaiśeṣika ādi mate vākye lakṣaṇā na asti

original: svavācyasaṃbandho lakṣaṇā iti tallakṣaṇāt| svaṃ-gaṅgāpadaṃ, tacchakyo'rthaḥ jalapravāhaviśeṣaḥ, tasya sākṣātsaṃbandhaḥ saṃyogākhyastīre, so'rthaniṣṭhaḥ saṃbandha eva gaṅgāśabde āropito lakṣaṇeti samanvayaḥ| tena cā''ropitena śabdavyāpārema gaṅgāpadāllakṣyabhūtatīropasthityā gaṅgātīre ghoṣa iti śabdabodho bhavati| svaśakyasaṃbandho lakṣaṇetyukteḥ|
analyzed: sva vācya saṃbandhaḥ lakṣaṇā iti tad lakṣaṇāt svam gaṅgā padam tad śakyaḥ arthaḥ jala pravāha viśeṣaḥ tasya sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ saṃyoga ākhyaḥ tīre saḥ ṛtha niṣṭhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ eva gaṅgā śabde āropitaḥ lakṣaṇā iti samanvayaḥ tena ca āropitena śabda vyāpārema gaṅgā padāt lakṣya bhūta tīra upasthityā gaṅgā tīre ghoṣaḥ iti śabda bodhaḥ bhavati sva śakya saṃbandhaḥ lakṣaṇā iti ukteḥ

original: svasya-padasya, lakṣapārthena paramparāsaṃbandho yaḥ sa eva lakṣaṇetyabhipretamiti gamyate| yataḥ padasya sākṣātsaṃbandhaḥ śakyārtheneva, tasyaiva padasya lakṣyārthena paramparāsaṃbandho yaḥ saiva lakṣaṇā| sākṣātsaṃbandha eva śaktirvācyavācakabhāvo'bhidhāvṛttiriti vā bhaṇyate| paramparāsaṃbandhastu lakṣaṇā, jaghanyavṛttiriti cocyate|
analyzed: paramparā saṃbandhaḥ yaḥ saḥ eva lakṣaṇā iti abhipretam iti gamyate yatas padasya sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ śakya arthena iva tasya eva padasya lakṣya arthena paramparā saṃbandhaḥ yaḥ sā eva lakṣaṇā sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ eva śaktiḥ vācya vācaka bhāvaḥ abhidhā vṛttiḥ iti vā bhaṇyate paramparā saṃbandhaḥ tu lakṣaṇā jaghanya vṛttiḥ iti ca ucyate

original: evaṃ ca padasamudāyarūpasya vākyasya kasmiṃścidapyarthe śakyabhāvena vākyaśakyaprasiddheḥ kathaṃ tatra śakyasaṃbandhātmikā lakṣaṇā ghaṭeta| vākyaśakyāprasiddhyā tacchakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā api vākye'prasīddhiriti bhāvaḥ| mīmāṃsakāstvevaṃ manyante-yadi vākye lakṣaṇā na svīkriyate kathaṃ yadi tarhi gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra lakṣaṇā|
analyzed: evam ca pada samudāya rūpasya vākyasya kasmiṃścid api arthe śakya bhāvena vākya śakya prasiddheḥ katham tatra śakya saṃbandha ātmikā lakṣaṇā ghaṭeta vākya śakya aprasiddhyā tad śakya saṃbandha rūpa lakṣaṇāyāḥ api vākye prasīddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ mīmāṃsakāḥ tu evam manyante yadi vākye lakṣaṇā na svīkriyate katham yadi tarhi gabhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra lakṣaṇā

original: tatra pratyekaṃ padeṣu lakṣaṇā na saṃbhavati| yadi gabhīrapadaṃ tīralakṣakaṃ, tarhi nadyāmityanena sahānanvayāpatteḥ| nahi tīraṃ nadī| gadyāmityanenānanvayāpattereva nāpi nadīpadaṃ ca nadītīraparamiti padadvaye pratyekaṃ sā| tathā sati gambhīryeviśiṣṭā yā nadī, tādṛśanadītīrāprāptiprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: tatra pratyekam padeṣu lakṣaṇā na saṃbhavati yadi gabhīra padam tīra lakṣakam tarhi nadyām iti anena saha ananvaya āpatteḥ nahi tīram nadī gadyām iti anena ananvaya āpatteḥ eva nā api nadī padam ca nadī tīra param iti pada dvaye pratyekam sā tathā sati yā nadī tādṛśa nadī tīra aprāpti prasaṅgāt

original: tasmātpadalakṣaṇāyā vaktumaśakyatvena vākye'pi sā'vaśmabhyupeyā| paraṃ tu vākye śaktireva nāstīti ktha tatra śakyasaṃbandharūpā lakṣaṇeti cettarhi svabodhyasaṃbandha eva lakṣaṇālakṣaṇamastu| bodhyatvaṃ ca śābdabodhe bhāsamānatvam|
analyzed: tasmāt pada lakṣaṇāyāḥ vaktum aśakya tvena vākye api sā avaśmabhyupeyā param tu vākye śaktiḥ eva nā asti iti ktha tatra śakya saṃbandha rūpā lakṣaṇā iti ced tarhi sva bodhya saṃbandhaḥ eva lakṣaṇā lakṣaṇam astu bodhya tvam ca śābdabodhe bhāsamāna tvam

original: svaṃ-rājapuruṣetyādisamāsarūpaṃ vākyaṃ, tasya sākṣātsaṃbandho vākyāvayavarājapuruṣapadābhyāṃ, tayośca padārthasaṃsargarūpavākyārtheneti vākyasya paramparayā vākyārthena saṃbandhāllakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ|
analyzed: svam rāja puruṣa ityādi samāsa rūpam vākyam tasya sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ vākya avayava rāja puruṣa padābhyām tayoḥ ca padārtha saṃsarga rūpa vākya arthena iti vākyasya paramparayā vākya arthena saṃbandhāt lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ

original: padānupasthāpyasyāpilakṣyatāvacchedakatīratvādeḥ śābdabodhe bhānasattvādyathā bodhyatvaṃ tadvatpadānupasthitasyāpi padārthasaṃsargarūpavākyārthasya śābdabodhe bhānasattvādbodhyatvam| tatā ca yathā padīyaśakyatā śaktivṛttibodhyā, tathā paramparāsaṃbandhaviśiṣṭaḥ padārthasaṃsargarūpo vākyārthe'pi vākyabodhyo bhavati|
analyzed: pada anupasthāpyasya api lakṣya tā avacchedaka tīra tva ādeḥ śābdabodhe bhāna sattvāt yathā bodhyatvam tadvat pada anupasthitasya api padārtha saṃsarga rūpa vākya arthasya śābdabodhe bhāna sattvāt bodhyatvam ca yathā padīya śakyatā śakti vṛtti bodhyā tathā paramparā saṃbandha viśiṣṭaḥ padārtha saṃsarga rūpaḥ vākya arthe api vākya bodhyaḥ bhavati

original: tataśca bodhyasaṃbandharūpā lakṣaṇā padavadvākye'pyastīti vākyamapi lakṣakamiti| evaṃ ca rājapuruṣa ityādisamāsavākyena padārthasaṃsargarūpo vākyārtho gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra gaṅgāpadena tīramiva lakṣyata iti mīmāṃsakamatena vākye'pi lakṣaṇā sidhyati| taduktaṃ-`sarvatraiva hi vākyārtho lakṣya eveti ca sthitam' iti|
analyzed: tatas ca bodhya saṃbandha rūpā lakṣaṇā pada vat vākye api asti iti vākyam api lakṣakam iti evam ca rāja puruṣaḥ ityādi samāsa vākyena padārtha saṃsarga rūpaḥ vākya arthaḥ gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra gaṅgā padena tīram iva lakṣyate iti mīmāṃsaka matena vākye api lakṣaṇā sidhyati tat uktam sarvatra eva hi vākya arthaḥ lakṣyaḥ eva iti ca sthitam iti

original: vākye lakṣaṇāsvīkārādeva prābhākarā apyarthavādavākye prāśastyalakṣaṇāṃ menire| taduktaṃ nayavivekaṭīkāyāṃ varadarājena-yadyapyekaikapadasaṃbandhitā prāśastye nāsti, ekaikapadādapratītestathā'pi samudāyasaṃbandhitā'styeveti| ata eva grāhavatī nadī, iti vākyasyātra mā snāhītyarthe lakṣaṇetyughoṣaḥ saṃgacchate|
analyzed: vākye lakṣaṇā svīkārāt eva prābhākarāḥ api arthavāda vākye prāśastya lakṣaṇām menire tat uktam nayaviveka ṭīkāyām varadarājena yadi api ekaika pada saṃbandhi tā prāśastye na asti ekaika padāt apratīteḥ tathā api samudāya saṃbandhi tā asti eva iti atas eva grāhavatī nadī iti vākyasya atra mā snāhi iti arthe lakṣaṇā iti ughoṣaḥ saṃgacchate

original: tadetannaiyāyikā na sahante-yaduktaṃ gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra vākyalakṣaṇeti tadasāram| tatra tadīpadameva gabhīranadītīralakṣakaṃ, na tu vākyaṃ, gabhīrapadaṃ tu tādṛśalakṣaṇāyāṃ tātparyagrāhakamiti na tasya vaiyarthyaṃ nāpyananvayāpattidoṣaḥ| evaṃ ca padalakṣaṇayaiva nirvāhe vṛthaiva vākyalakṣaṇāyāṃ mīmāṃsakādara iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tat etat naiyāyikāḥ na sahante yat uktam gabhīrāyām nadyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra vākya lakṣaṇā iti tat asāram tatra tadī padam eva gabhīra nadī tīra lakṣakam na tu vākyam gabhīra padam tu tādṛśa lakṣaṇāyām tātparya grāhakam iti na tasya vaiyarthyam na api ananvaya āpatti doṣaḥ evam ca pada lakṣaṇayā eva nirvāhe vṛthā eva vākya lakṣaṇāyām mīmāṃsaka ādaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: kiṃ ca svabodhya svaniṣṭhabodhakatānirūpitabodhyatāvadarthasaṃbandha ityartho vācyaḥ| tatra bodhakatvaṃ kiṃ vṛttyā bodhajanakatvamathavā jñānajanakajñānaviṣayatvam| nā''dyaḥ| vākye lakṣaṇābhāvaprasaṅgāt| vākyārthasya vṛttyabodhyatvāt| nāntyaḥ|
analyzed: kim ca sva bodhya sva niṣṭha bodhakatā nirūpita bodhyatāvat artha saṃbandhaḥ iti arthaḥ vācyaḥ tatra bodhakatvam kim vṛttyā bodha janakatvam athavā jñāna janaka jñāna viṣayatvam na ādyaḥ vākye lakṣaṇa abhāva prasaṅgāt vākya arthasya vṛtti abodhya tvāt na antyaḥ

original: kabhbugrīvādimadarthajñānajanakajñānaviṣayatvaṃ ghaṭetisaṃghātasyeva tadavayavaghakārādīnāmapyastīti pratyekaṃ varṇānāmarthavattvāpattyā vibhaktyutpattyā nalopādibahūplavāpatteḥ| tasmātsvaśakyasaṃbandho lakṣaṇetyevamurarīkaraṇīyam|

original: tataśca prātipadikasaṃjñādirūpakāryeṇa dhūmena vahniriva samāsasyārthavattvamanumīyata iti bhāvaḥ| samāsagrahaṇasya vidhyarthatve tu mūlakenetyādipūrvoktadūṣaṇaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ|

original: nanu samāsagrahaṇasya vidhyarthatve'pi kṛd‌grahaṇa iti paribhāṣāyā jñāpakasiddhatayā sārvatrikatvābhāvātkṛttiddhetatyatrāpravṛttyā na mūlakenopadaṃśamityatrātiprasaṅga ityato dūvaṇāntaramāha-kiṃ caivamiti evaṃ-samāse viśiṣṭaśaktyanaṅgīkāre| ananvayāpattiriti| citragumityādau gavādipadārthe karmatvādyananvayāpattirityarthaḥ|

original: tatraiva hetumāha--pratyayānāmityādi| yasmātpratyamo vidhīyate sā prakṛtiḥ, datarthenānvito yaḥ svārthaḥ karmatvādirūpaḥ, tadbodhakatā pratyayānāmiti niyamaśarīram| pratyayāśca vibhaktikṛttaddhitākhyātā iti tasyārthaḥ| evaṃ ca prakṛtītvaṃ yatyayavidhānāvadhitvaṃ, na tu pratyayāvyavahitapūrvatvam|

original: tataśca samāsottarapadasya pratyayavidhānāvadhitvarūpaprakṛtitvābhāvena na karmatvādyanvayaḥ saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| yattu pratyayānāṃ tvasaṃnihitapadārthagatasvārthabodhakatvamityeva vyutpattiriti tannetyāha-ardhapippalītyādāviti| ādinā pūrvakāya ityāderitaretaradvaṃdvasya ca saṃgrahaḥ|
analyzed: tatas ca samāsa uttara padasya pratyaya vidhāna avadhi tva rūpa prakṛti tva abhāvena na karma tva ādi anvayaḥ saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ yat tu pratyayānām tu asaṃnihita padārtha gata sva artha bodhaka tvam iti eva vyutpattiḥ iti tat na ityāha ardhapippalī ityādau iti ādinā pūrva kāyaḥ ityādeḥ itaretara dvaṃdvasya ca saṃgrahaḥ

original: upakumbhamitiyatra kumbhanirūpitasāmīpyavamtaṃ, pippīsaṃbandhyardhaṃ cā''nayetibodādvibhaktyarthasga pūrvapadārthe'nvayena pratyayānāṃ svasaṃnihitapadārtheti| niyamasya vyabhicāraḥ| saṃnihitatvaṃ cāvyavahitapūrvatvenānusaṃdhīyamānatvat|
analyzed: upakumbham iti yatra pippī saṃbandhi ardham ca anayā iti bodāt vibhakti arthaḥ pratyayānām sva saṃnihita padārtha iti niyamasya vyabhicāraḥ saṃnihita tvam ca avyavahita pūrva tvena anusaṃdhīyamāna tvat

original: tataścopakumbhamityādāvupapadārthādeḥ pratyayapūrvatve'pi vyavahitatvenābyakhitatvarūpakāraṇābhāve'pi kāryasattvarūpo vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ| nanu saṃnihitatvaṃ nāvyavahitapūrvatvaṃ, dhavakhadirāvityādo dhavādipadārthe vibhaktyarthānvayāpatte| kiṃ tu saṃnihitatvenānuśāsanabodhitatvam|
analyzed: tatas ca upakumbham ityādau upapadārtha ādeḥ pratyaya pūrvatve pi vyavahita tvena abyakhita tva rūpa kāraṇa abhāve pi kārya sattva rūpaḥ vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu saṃnihita tvam na avyavahita pūrva tvam dhava khadirau ityādaḥ dhava ādi padārthe vibhakti artha anvaya āpatte kim tu saṃnihita tvena anuśāsana bodhita tvam

original: tacca dhavādipadārthānāmivopādipadārthānāmapyastītyāśaṅkate-na cetyādinā| tatrāpīti| upakumbhādisamāse'pītyarthaḥ| ānuśāsanikoti| saṃnihitatvenānuśāsanabodhitatvarūpānusāsanikasaṃnidhervivakṣitatve yādṛśo'rthaḥ saṃpannastamāha--yatpadottaraṃ yā'nuśiṣṭeti|

original: samāsottaramanuśāsanasattve'pi samasyāmānapūrvaparādipadottaraṃ kathamanuśāsanamata āha--samāse cetyādi samāsasyānekapadasamūharūpatvātsamūhasya ca tad‌ghaṭapratyekapadānatiriktatvātsamāsarūpaprātipadikādvihitavibhaktestattatpadasaṃnihitatvamityarthaḥ| yadvā samasyamānapadeti|

original: samasyamānaṃ padaṃ ca samāsaghaṭakībhūtaṃ padaṃ-pūrvaṃ paraṃ madhyamaṃ ca| tathā cāvyayībhāve'vyayaṃ, ekadeśisamāse ekadeśāvācipadaṃ, dvaṃdve sarvāṇyapi padāni samasyamānānīti tattadarthe vibhaktyarthānvayaḥ avyayībhāvādisamāse'vyayaṃ subantena samasya ityādinā'vyayādereva samasanakriyākarmatvaṃ trodhyate|

original: taṇḍulaḥ pacatītyādāviti| atra taṇḍulo na kartā, kiṃtu karmaiva| tathā'pi kargatvenāvivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyābhāvena prātipadikārthatvātprathamā| kartā tu caitrādiḥ pṛthageva| tathā ca taṇḍulaḥ pacatītyasādhuḥ prayogaḥ| atra kriyākārakabhāvasaṃbandhabodhakasya dvitīyāpratyayasyābhāvātkriyānvayābhāvena na tādṛśaḥ prayogaḥ|

original: yadi tu dvitīyābhāve'pi karmatvasaṃsargeṇa taṇḍulasya kriyāyāmanvayaḥ kriyate, tarhi taṇḍulakarmakaḥ pākaḥ sa ca caitraniṣṭha iti prasajyeta, sa cāniṣṭaḥ, sarvānubhavaviruddhatvāt|
analyzed: yadi tu dvitīya abhāve pi karmatva saṃsargeṇa taṇḍulasya kriyāyām anvayaḥ kriyate tarhi taṇḍula karmakaḥ pākaḥ sa ca caitra niṣṭhaḥ iti prasajyeta sa ca aniṣṭaḥ sarva anubhava viruddha tvāt

original: atastādṛśabodhavāraṇāyaivaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kalpanīya-pātipadikārthaḥ prakāro-viśeṣaṇaṃ yasminnityākārake bodhe jananīye viśeṣyatayā taduttaravībhaktijanyopasthitirheturityavaśyaṃ vaktavyam|
analyzed: atas tādṛśa bodha vāraṇāya evam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ kalpanīya pātipadika arthaḥ prakāraḥ viśeṣaṇam yasmin iti ākārake bodhe jananīye viśeṣya tayā tad uttara vībhakti janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ iti avaśyam vaktavyam

original: tathā ca taṇḍulasya pākakriyāyāṃ yādṛśasaṃsargeṇānvayaḥ karaṇīyastādṛśasaṃsargabodhikāyā vibhaktestaṇḍhulapadottaramasattvānna taṇḍulasya pākakribāyāmanvayaḥ| evaṃ ca niruktakāryakāraṇabhāvasyā''vaśyakatve sati lākṣaṇikasyāpi rājādipadārthasya puruṣādipadārthe'nvayo na syāt, tatraiva hetumāha--puruṣādestathātvābhāvāditi|
analyzed: tathā ca taṇḍulasya pāka kriyāyām yādṛśa saṃsargeṇa anvayaḥ karaṇīyaḥ tādṛśa saṃsarga bodhikāyāḥ vibhakteḥ taṇḍhula pada uttaram asattvāt na taṇḍulasya pāka kribāyām anvayaḥ evam ca nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya āvaśyaka tve sati lākṣaṇikasya api rāja ādi padārthasya puruṣa ādi padārthe anvayaḥ na syāt tatra eva hetum āha puruṣa ādeḥ tathātva abhāvāt iti

original: puruṣāderityādipadena svāmisāhityayorgrahaṇam| vibhaktijanyopasthitiviṣayatvābhāvādityarthaḥ| atra rājaprakārakaḥ puruṣaviśeṣyako bodhaḥ, ttitragavīprakārakaḥ svāmiviśeṣyakaḥ, nīlotpalaprakārakaḥ sāhityaviśeṣyako bodha iṣṭaḥ|
analyzed: puruṣa ādeḥ iti ādi padena svāmi sāhityayoḥ grahaṇam vibhakti janya upasthiti viṣaya tva abhāvāt iti arthaḥ atra rāja prakārakaḥ puruṣa viśeṣyakaḥ bodhaḥ ttitragavī prakārakaḥ svāmi viśeṣyakaḥ nīlotpala prakārakaḥ sāhitya viśeṣyakaḥ bodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ

original: padi tu viśeṣyatvenābhimatārthasya puruṣādervibhaktijanyopasthitiviṣayatvaṃ svāttarhyeva rājādeḥ prakāratayā puruṣādāvanvayaḥ sthānnānyathā, uktaniyamānurodhārdi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tu viśeṣya tvena abhimata arthasya puruṣa ādeḥ vibhakti janya upasthiti viṣayatvam svāt tarhi eva rāja ādeḥ prakāratayā puruṣa ādau anvayaḥ sthāt na anyathā ukta niyama anurodha ardi bhāvaḥ

original: nanu śubhrastaṇḍula ityādau śubhrādirūpanāmārthaprakārakaḥ śābdabodho viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena taṇḍulādau jāyate, na ca tatra viśeṣyatāsaṃbanyena vibhaktijanyopasthitirastīti vyabhicārānnoktakāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ saṃbhavati|
analyzed: nanu śubhraḥ taṇḍulaḥ ityādau śubhra ādi rūpa nāma artha prakārakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena taṇḍula ādau jāyate na ca tatra viśeṣyatā saṃbanyena vibhakti janya upasthitiḥ asti iti vyabhicārāt na ukta kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ saṃbhavati

original: taṇḍulaḥ pacatītyādau taṇḍulādeḥ karmatvasaṃbandhena kriyāyāmanvayo mā bhūdityetadartha prātipadikārthaprakārakaśābdabodhaṃ prati dhātubhinnajanyopasthitirhetuḥ| athavā viśaṣyatayā dhātujanyopasthitiḥ pratibandhiketyevaṃ kāraṇaṃ pratibandhakaṃ vā kalpanīyam|
analyzed: taṇḍulaḥ pacati ityādau taṇḍula ādeḥ karmatva saṃbandhena kriyāyām anvayaḥ mā bhūt iti etad artha prātipadika artha prakāraka śābdabodham prati dhātu bhinna janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ athavā viśaṣyatayā dhātu janya upasthitiḥ pratibandhikā iti evam kāraṇam pratibandhakam vā kalpanīyam

original: tathā ca rājapuruṣa ityādau prakāratāviśiṣṭasya prātipadikārtharūparājādeḥ viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena puruṣādāvanvaye bādhakābhāva ityāśayenā''ha--taṇḍhulaḥ śubhra ityādau ceti| prātipadikārthakaprathamārtha iti| prātipadikasyārtha ivārtho yasyā ityuṣṭramukhavatsamāsaḥ, prātipadikārthasadṛśārthavatī yā prathamāvibhaktistadarthe, ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau prakāratā viśiṣṭasya prātipadika artha rūpa rāja ādeḥ viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena puruṣa ādau anvaye bādhaka abhāvaḥ iti āśayena āha taṇḍhulaḥ śubhraḥ ityādau ca iti prātipadika arthaka prathamā arthaḥ iti prātipadikasya arthaḥ iva arthaḥ yasyāḥ iti uṣṭra mukha vat samāsaḥ prātipadika artha sadṛśa arthavatī yā prathamā vibhaktiḥ tad arthe iti arthaḥ

original: taṇḍularūpapratātipadikārthābhinno yo vibhaktyartha ityevaṃ taṇḍulāderabhedainānvayaḥ| tasya ceti| vibhaktyarthasya cetyarthaḥ| taṇḍularūpaprātipadikārthābhinnasya vibhaktyarthasyeti yāvat| taṇḍularūpavibhaktyarthābhinno yaḥ śubhrapadārtha ityaivaṃ śuklapadārthe'bhedenaivānvaya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: taṇḍula rūpa pratātipadikārtha abhinnaḥ yaḥ vibhakti arthaḥ iti evam taṇḍula ādeḥ abhedaina anvayaḥ tasya ca iti vibhakti arthasya ca iti arthaḥ taṇḍula rūpa prātipadikārtha abhinnasya vibhakti arthasya iti yāvat taṇḍula rūpa vibhakti artha abhinnaḥ yaḥ śubhra padārthaḥ śukla padārtha ibhedena eva anvayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: pāka ityādau pac‌dhātūpasthāpyavyāpārasyāsattvarūpeṇa bhānaṃ, ghañupasthāpyavyāpārasya tu sattvarūpeṇoti yathā vyāpārasya dvedhā bhānaṃ tadvatprātipadikārthasyāpi dvedhā bhānaṃ, śabdātprātipadikārthasya sattvarūpeṇa bhānaṃ, vibhaktyā tvasattvarūpeṇa prātipadikārthasya bhānamityabhedānvayasaṃbhavāttaṇḍulānvayavati asattvarūpe prātipadikārthe
analyzed: pākaḥ ityādau pac dhātu upasthāpya vyāpārasya asattva rūpeṇa bhānam ghañ upasthāpya vyāpārasya tu sattva rūpeṇa uti yathā vyāpārasya dvedhā bhānam tadvat prātipadika arthasya api dvedhā bhānam śabdāt prātipadika arthasya sattva rūpeṇa bhānam vibhaktyā tu asattva rūpeṇa prātipadika arthasya bhānam iti abheda anvaya saṃbhavāt taṇḍula anvayavati asattva rūpe prātipadika arthe

original: viśeṣyatayā vibhaktijanyopasthiteḥ sattvānnātra prātipadikārthaprakārakabodhaṃ prati vibhaktijanyopastitirheturityevaṃrūpasya kāryakāraṇabhāvasya vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: viśeṣya tayā vibhakti janya upasthiteḥ sattvāt na atra prātipadika artha prakāraka bodham prati vibhakti janya upastitiḥ hetuḥ iti evaṃrūpasya kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu taṇḍulaḥ śubhra itgatra vyabhicāranivāraṇe'pi śubhraṃ taṇḍulaṃ, śubhreṇa taṇḍulenetyādau vyabhicāro durnivāraḥ, dvitīyādivibhakteḥ prātipadikārthe vihitatvābhāvādityāśaṅkya samādhatte--śubhreṇetyādinā| abhedārthiketi| viśeṣaṇavācakādyā vibhaktistasyā abhedo'rthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu taṇḍulaḥ śubhraḥ iti atra vyabhicāra nivāraṇe api śubhram taṇḍulam śubhreṇa taṇḍulena ityādau vyabhicāraḥ durnivāraḥ dvitīyā ādi vibhakteḥ prātipadika arthe vihita tva abhāvāt iti āśaṅkya samādhatte śubhreṇa ityādinā abheda arthikā iti viśeṣaṇa vācaka ādyā vibhaktiḥ tasyāḥ

original: nīlamutpalaṃ paśyetyādau nīlābhinnaṃ yadutpalaṃ tatkarmakaṃ darśanāmiti bodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvādityarthaḥ| dhyāyennityaṃ maheśabhityatra dhyānakriyānirūpitaṃ karmatvaṃ maheśasya pratīyate, tacca maheśapadottaradvitīyayā spaṣṭamuktaṃ, tataśca maheśasamānādhikaraṇaṃ paccavaktraṃ trinetramityādi yadviśeṣaṇaṃ taduttaradvitīyāvibhakteḥ
analyzed: nīlam utpalam paśya ityādau nīla abhinnam yat utpalam tad karmakam bodhasya sarva anubhava siddha tvāt iti arthaḥ dhyāyet nityam maheśa iti atra dhyāna kriyā nirūpitam karmatvam maheśasya pratīyate tat ca maheśa pada uttara dvitīyayā spaṣṭam uktam tatas ca maheśa samāna adhikaraṇam paccavaktram trinetram ityādi yat viśeṣaṇam tad uttara dvitīyā vibhakteḥ

original: karmatvena karmārthakatvāpratītermaheśarūpakarmābhedabophakatvaṃ phalati| ata eva viśeṣaṇadhibhakterabhedārthakatvamityuddheṣaḥ| nanu karmaṇi dvitīyā vihitā, na tvabheda iti kathaṃ viśeṣaṇavibhakterabhedārthakatvamucyata iti cenna| karmābhedasya karmarūpatayā'bhedasya `karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityanuśāsanaviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: karma tvena karma arthaka tva apratīteḥ maheśa rūpakarma abheda bophaka tvam phalati atas eva nanu karmaṇi dvitīyā vihitā na tu abhede iti katham viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ abheda arthaka tvam ucyate iti ced na karma abhedasya karma rūpa tayā abhedasya karmaṇi dvitīyā iti anuśāsana viṣaya tvāt

original: evaṃ viśeṣaṇottaratṛtīyādivibhakterapyabhedārthakatvaṃ jñeyam| nanu viśeṣyavācakapadottaravibhaktyaima karmādyarthasyāvagamādviśeṣaṇottaravibhaktiḥ prayogasādhutvāyaiva, na tvathaṃsādhutvāya|
analyzed: evam viśeṣaṇa uttara tṛtīyā ādi vibhakteḥ api abheda arthaka tvam jñeyam nanu karma ādi arthasya avagamāt viśeṣaṇa uttara vibhaktiḥ prayoga sādhu tvāya eva na tu atham sādhu tvāya

original: tataśca śubhrapadārthasya taṇḍulenaivānvayo vaktavyaḥ, taṇḍulasya ca vibhaktijanyopasthitiviṣayatvābhāva iti tatra kāryakāraṇabāvavyabhicārastadavastha eveti manasyanusaṃdhāyā''ha--pārṣṇiko vā'nvaya iti|
analyzed: tatas ca śubhra padārthasya taṇḍulena eva anvayaḥ vaktavyaḥ taṇḍulasya ca vibhakti janya upasthiti viṣaya tva abhāvaḥ iti tatra kārya kāraṇa bāva vyabhicāraḥ tad avasthaḥ eva iti manasi anusaṃdhāya āha pārṣṇikaḥ vā anvayaḥ iti

original: ayamarthaḥ-karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyevaṃ pratyayaniyame sati dvitīpādayaḥ pratyayā viśiṣṭeṣvartheṣu karmādiṣu niyatā iti hetoḥ sādhutvarthe vibhaktiriti vacanaṃ na yuktaṃ, kiṃ tu karmādyarthikaiva, `kaṭo'pi karma bhīṣmādayo'pi karma' iti-bhāṣyādviśeṣaṇa'pi karmatvādisattvāt| evaṃ ca kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvaya iti niyamātkriyāyāmanvayaḥ|
analyzed: ayam arthaḥ karmaṇi eva dvitīyā iti evam pratyaya niyame sati dvitīpa ādayaḥ pratyayāḥ viśiṣṭeṣu artheṣu karma ādiṣu niyatāḥ iti hetoḥ sādhu tu arthe vibhaktiḥ iti vacanam na yuktam kim tu karma ādi arthikā eva kaṭaḥ api karma bhīṣma ādayaḥ api karma iti bhāṣyāt karma tva ādi sattvāt evam ca kārakāṇām kriyayā eva anvayaḥ iti niyamāt kriyāyām anvayaḥ

original: tataśaaca śubhreṇa taṇḍulenetyatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ parasparamanvayābhāvānna vyabhicāraḥ| nanu yadi kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvayaḥ kriyate tarhi tasyā vibhaktijanyopasthitiviṣayatvābhāvena niruktakāryakāraṇabhāvavyabhicāraḥ sustha eveti cenna| yadi vibhaktyarthasya dvārīkaraṇaṃ vinā'nvayaḥ kriyeta tarhi vyabhicāraḥ syāt|
analyzed: śubhreṇa taṇḍulena iti atra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ parasparam anvaya abhāvāt na vyabhicāraḥ nanu yadi kārakāṇām kriyayā eva anvayaḥ kriyate tarhi tasyāḥ vibhakti janya upasthiti viṣaya tva abhāvena nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva vyabhicāraḥ susthaḥ eva iti ced na yadi vibhakti arthasya dvārīkaraṇam vinā anvayaḥ kriyeta tarhi vyabhicāraḥ syāt

original: kiṃtu vibhaktyarthaṃ dvārīkṛtyaiva kārakāṇāṃ kriyānvayasvīkārāt| tataśca śubhreṇetyatra śubhrapadārthābhinnaṃ yatkaraṇaṃ tanniṣṭakaraṇatānirūpikā kriyetyarthaḥ| vibhaktyarthasya dvārīkaraṇādeva prātipadikārthadhātvarthayoḥ sākṣādbhedenānvayo'vyutpanna iti niyamavirodho neti bodhyam|
analyzed: kiṃtu vibhakti artham dvārīkṛtya eva kārakāṇām kriyā anvaya svīkārāt tatas ca śubhreṇa iti atra śubhra padārtha abhinnam yat karaṇam tad niṣṭa karaṇatā nirūpikā kriyā iti arthaḥ vibhakti arthasya dvārīkaraṇāt eva prātipadikārtha dhātvarthayoḥ sākṣāt bhedena anvayaḥ vyutpannaḥ iti niyama virodhaḥ na iti bodhyam

original: na ca śubhreṇa taṇḍulenetyatra yadi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ parasparamanvayābhāvastarhi śubhrapadārthataṇḍulapadārthayoḥ paricchedo na syāditi śubhreṇa taṇḍulena śivaṃ pūjayedityanuśāsane'pi śyāmalāditaṇḍulena, yena kenacicchubhrapadārthena ca śivapūjanaṃ prasajyeteti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca śubhreṇa taṇḍulena iti atra yadi viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ parasparam anvaya abhāvaḥ tarhi śubhra padārtha taṇḍula padārthayoḥ paricchedaḥ na syāt iti śubhreṇa taṇḍulena śivam pūjayet iti anuśāsane api śyāmala ādi taṇḍulena yena kenacid śubhra padārthena ca śiva pūjanam prasajyeta iti vācyam

original: viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavācakapadadvaye'pi tṛtīyābodhyakaraṇasya svātantryeṇa pūjanakriyāprāmanvayena śubhreṇa pūjayettaṇḍulena pūjayediti pārthakyena bodhottaraṃ tayoḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena mānaso'nvayaḥ svīkriyate| ayameva pārṣṇikaḥ pārṣṭhiko vā'nvaya ityucyate|
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya vācaka pada dvaye pi tṛtīyā bodhya karaṇasya svātantryeṇa śubhreṇa pūjayet taṇḍulena pūjayet iti pārthakyena bodha uttaram tayoḥ parasparam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvena mānasaḥ anvayaḥ svīkriyate ayam eva pārṣṇikaḥ pārṣṭhikaḥ vā anvayaḥ iti ucyate

original: tataśca pratyāsattivaśādyaḥ śubhraḥ sa taṇḍula eva, yaśca taṇḍulaḥ sa śubhra eveti parasparaṃ paricchedena śubhrābhinnataṇḍulakaraṇikā śivakarmikā pūjā vidhiviṣayeti bodhānna doṣa iti bhāvaḥ| paricchedo viśeṣarūpeṇārthāvadhāraṇamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatas ca pratyāsatti vaśāt yaḥ śubhraḥ sa taṇḍulaḥ eva yaḥ ca taṇḍulaḥ sa śubhraḥ eva iti parasparam paricchedena śubhra abhinna taṇḍula karaṇikā śiva karmikā pūjā vidhi viṣayā iti bodhāt na doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ paricchedaḥ viśeṣa rūpeṇa artha avadhāraṇam iti arthaḥ

original: ata evāruṇādhipharaṇe `aruṇayā ṣiṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti śrutau aruṇayetyādipadatrayai'pi tṛtīyopāttasya karaṇakarakasya svātantryeṇa krayaṇabhāvanāyāmanvayena āruṇyakaraṇikā piṅgākṣīkaraṇikā ekahāyanīkaraṇikā ca yā bhāvanā tatsādhyena krayeṇa somaṃ bhāvayet|
analyzed: atas eva aruṇādhipharaṇe aruṇayā siṅgākṣyā ekahāyanyā somam krīṇāti iti śrutau tṛtīya upāttasya karaṇa karakasya svātantryeṇa krayaṇa bhāvanāyām anvayena āruṇya karaṇikā piṅgākṣī karaṇikā ekahāyanī karaṇikā ca yā bhāvanā tad sādhyena krayeṇa somam bhāvayet

original: gavā te krīṇānīti mantraliṅgādyā cā''ruṇyaviśiṣṭā gauḥ saiva piṅgalākṣiyuktā saiva caikahāyanaviśiṣṭetyevamabhedavabodhastu pārṣṭhikaḥ pratyāsattinyāyānmīmāṃsakairaṅgīkṛtaḥ saṃgacchata iti jñeyam| tathā ceti| prātipadikārthaprakārakabodhaṃ prativiśeṣgratayā taduttaravibhaktijanyopasthiterehetutvāvaśyakatve cetyarthaḥ| anvayāsaṃbhavāditi|
analyzed: gavā te krīṇāni iti mantra liṅga ādyā ca aruṇya viśiṣṭā gauḥ sā eva piṅgala akṣi yuktā sā eva ca eka hāyana viśiṣṭā iti evam abheda avabodhaḥ tu pārṣṭhikaḥ pratyāsatti nyāyāt mīmāṃsakaiḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ saṃgacchate iti jñeyam tathā ca iti prātipadika artha prakāraka bodham ca iti arthaḥ anvaya asaṃbhavāt iti

original: tathā sati vyākaraṇamadhīte, pacati, ityādīnāṃ vaiyākaraṇaḥ pācaka ityāditaddhitakṛdantavigrahatvānāpatteḥ| kiṃ tu samāsajanyapratītiviṣayārthapratītijanakatvaṃ, tacca prakṛte'bhatameva, samāsajanyamatītiviṣayarājasaṃbandhaviṣayakapratītijanakatvādrājñaḥ puruṣasyetyata āha-anyatheti|

original: tathā ca yadyatra prathamabhakṣa iti samāsāntargatabhakṣapadārthamākṣamuddiśya prāthamyaṃ vitreyaṃ syāttarhi tadvācakayordvayoḥ padayārekesyāṃ vṛttau praveśa eva na syāt| vaṣaṭa़kartuḥ pramabhakṣaiti vākye tu samāsaḥ kṛta eveti tadanurodhena viśiṣṭārthasvaivātra śabdamaryādayā vidheyatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti pratīyate iti bodhyam|
analyzed: tathā ca yadi atra prathama bhakṣaḥ iti samāsa antargata bhakṣa padārtha ākṣam uddiśya prāthamyam vitreyam syāt tarhi tad vācakayoḥ dvayoḥ vṛttau praveśaḥ eva na syāt vaṣaṭa kartuḥ vākye tu samāsaḥ kṛtaḥ eva iti tad anurodhena viśiṣṭa artha svā eva atra śabda maryādayā vidheya tvam vivakṣitam iti pratīyate iti bodhyam

original: ayameva hyekaprasaratābhaṅgo nāma yadviśiṣṭaikopastitijanakatvarūpasāmarthyabhaṅgaḥ| uddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvaye pṛthagupasthiteḥ prayojakatvena tathā'nvaye tadbhaṅgāditi mīmāṃsāyāmuktamityāha-tṛtīya iti| tṛtīyādhyāyasya pañcame pāde daśamādhikaraṇe `vaṣaṭkārācca bhakṣayet'iti sūtra ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ayam eva hi eka prasara tā bhaṅgaḥ nāma yat viśiṣṭa eka upastiti janaka tva rūpa sāmarthya bhaṅgaḥ uddeśya vidheya bhāvena anvaye pṛthak upasthiteḥ prayojaka tvena tathā anvaye tad bhaṅgāt iti mīmāṃsāyām uktam iti āha tṛtīye iti tṛtīya adhyāyasya pañcame pāde daśama adhikaraṇe vaṣaṭkārāt ca bhakṣaya iti iti sūtre iti arthaḥ

original: ekaprasaratābhaṅgabhayādeva citrayā yajetetyatra citrayetyekena padena strīkārakamuddiśya citratvasya vidhānaṃ na yujyata ityuktam| tathā hi-vṛttirnāma padapadārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ śaktilakṣaṇānyatararūpaḥ| prakṛte ca citratvastrītvarūpadharmadvayaviśiṣṭe'rthe citrāśabdasya śaktiḥ| tādṛśaśaktirūpāyāmekasyāṃ vṛttau citratvastrītvayāḥ praveśaḥ|
analyzed: eka prasara tā bhaṅga bhayāt eva citrayā yajeta iti atra citrayā iti ekena padena strī kārakam uddiśya citra tvasya vidhānam na yujyate iti uktam tathā hi vṛttiḥ nāma pada padārthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ śakti lakṣaṇa anyatara rūpaḥ prakṛte ca citra tva strī tva rūpa dharma dvaya viśiṣṭa irthe citrā śabdasya śaktiḥ tādṛśa śakti rūpāyām ekasyām vṛttau citra tva strī tvayāḥ praveśaḥ

original: tasyātra bhaṅgaḥ syādyadi strīkārakānuvādena citratvamatra vihitaṃ syāt| uddeśyavidheyayorhi pṛthak pṛthak śaktyopasthitirāvaśyakī| atra caikasyāṃ śaktau strītvacitratvayoḥ praveśānna tayoruddeśyavidheyabhāvaḥ saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ| tryaṅgairiti| paśauśrutam-tryaṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajatīti|
analyzed: tasya atra bhaṅgaḥ syāt yadi strī kāraka anuvādena citra tvam atra vihitam syāt uddeśya vidheyayoḥ hi pṛthak pṛthak śaktyā upasthitiḥ āvaśyakī atra ca ekasyām śaktau strītva citra tvayoḥ praveśāt na tayoḥ uddeśya vidheya bhāvaḥ saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ tri aṅgaiḥ iti paśauśrutam tri aṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtam yajati iti

original: tatra hṛdayasyāgre'vadyatītyādinaikādaśāṅgānāṃ homasya vidhānena prakṛtivadvikṛtiriti nyāyenaikādaśabhiraṅgairhome prāpte-idaṃ vākyamārabhyate|
analyzed: tatra hṛdayasya agrevat yati ityādinā ekādaśa aṅgānām homasya vidhānena prakṛti vat vikṛtiḥ iti nyāyena ekādaśabhiḥ aṅgaiḥ home prāpte idam vākyam ārabhyate

original: tatrāṅgānuvādena tritvaṃ vidhīyate lāghavāt, na tu tritvaviśiṣṭāṅgāntaramiti viśiṣṭavirgauravāditi pūrvapakṣayitvā, yadyatra tryaṅgairiti vṛttyantargatāṅgapadārthamuddiśya tritvaṃ vidheyaṃ syāttarhi tadvācakayordvayoḥ padayorakasyāṃ vṛttau pradeśa eva na syāt, arthādekaprasaratābhaṅgaḥ syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra aṅga anuvādena tritvam vidhīyate lāghavāt na tu tritva viśiṣṭa aṅga antaram iti viśiṣṭa viḥ gauravāt iti pūrvapakṣayitvā yadi atra tri aṅgaiḥ iti vṛtti antargata aṅga padārtham uddiśya tritvam vidheyam syāt tarhi tad vācakayoḥ dvayoḥ padayoḥ akasyām vṛttau pradeśaḥ eva na syāt arthāt eka prasara tā bhaṅgaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: tryaṅgairiti tu samāsaḥ kṛta eveti tadanusāreṇātra tritvaviśiṣṭāṅgāntarasyaiva śabdamaryādayā vidheyatvamavagamyate| tatraviśeṣaṇavisiṣṭārthasyānyato'prāptau satyāṃ viśiṣṭavidhāveva paryavasānaṃ bhavati| tadekadeśasya kasyacidanyataḥ prāptatve sati prāptāprāptavivekanyāyenāprāptāṃśe viśiṣṭavidheḥ paryavasānaṃ bhavatītyanyadetatū|
analyzed: tri aṅgaiḥ iti tu samāsaḥ kṛtaḥ eva iti tad anusāreṇa atra tritva viśiṣṭa aṅga antarasya eva śabda maryādayā vidheya tvam avagamyate tatra viśeṣaṇa visiṣṭa arthasya anyatas prāptau satyām viśiṣṭa vidhau eva paryavasānam bhavati tad eka deśasya kasyacid anyatas prāpta tve sati prāpta aprāpta viveka nyāyena aprāpta aṃśe viśiṣṭa vidheḥ paryavasānam bhavati iti anyat etat tūṣṇīm

original: yathā rājapuruṣādisamāse ākāṅkṣāmūlakasamudāyaśaktivaśātpadārthabodha eva jāyamāno viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannaviśiṣṭayorbhavati tatra viśiṣṭaśaktigraha ittham-rājapuruṣādisamāsapadaṃ rājasaṃbandhavatpuruṣādau śaktamiti| tatra sā viśiṣṭaśaktiḥ prāptāprāptavivekanyāyena saṃbandhāṃśe viśeṣaṇādyaṃśe ca paryavasyati|
analyzed: yathā rāja puruṣa ādi samāse ākāṅkṣā mūlaka samudāya śakti vaśāt padārtha bodhaḥ eva jāyamānaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva āpanna viśiṣṭayoḥ bhavati tatra viśiṣṭa śakti grahaḥ ittham rāja puruṣa ādi samāsa padam rāja saṃbandhavat puruṣa ādau śaktam iti tatra sā viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ prāpta aprāpta viveka nyāyena saṃbandha aṃśe viśeṣaṇa ādi aṃśe ca paryavasyati

original: rājādeḥ klṝptāvayavaśaktyaivopasthitisaṃbhavādityuktaṃ mañjūṣāyāṃ tadviditi bhāvaḥ| śabdamaryādayā tu viśiṣṭavidhereva tādṛśasthale svīkartavyaḥ| tathā ca prakṛte tritvaviśiṣṭāṅgāntaravidhirūpaviśiṣṭavidhiraṅgīkṛtaḥ| aṅgāntarāṇi ca kalpasūtrakāreṇa darśitāni-dakṣiṇoṃ'saḥ, savyā śroṇiḥ, gudaṃ tṛtīyam, iti sauviṣṭakṛtānīti|
analyzed: rāja ādeḥ klṝpta avayava śaktyā eva upasthiti saṃbhavāt iti uktam mañjūṣāyām tad vid iti bhāvaḥ śabda maryādayā tu viśiṣṭa vidheḥ eva tādṛśa sthale svīkartavyaḥ tathā ca prakṛte tritva viśiṣṭa aṅga antara vidhi rūpa viśiṣṭa vidhiḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ aṅga antarāṇi ca kalpasūtra kāreṇa darśitāni dakṣiṇā ūṃsaḥ savyā śroṇiḥ gudam tṛtīyam iti sauviṣṭakṛtāni iti

original: tasmādanijyāśeṣaistribhiraṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛddhotavya ityuktaṃ tatsthalaṃ darśayati-daśame ceti| daśamādhyāye saptamapāde tṛtīye'dhikaraṇe `ijyāśeṣāt--tryaṅgairvāoityādisūtre siddhāntitamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt an ijyā śeṣaiḥ tribhiḥ aṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛt hotavyaḥ iti uktam tat sthalam darśayati daśame ca iti daśama adhyāye saptama pāde tṛtīya adhikaraṇe ijyā śeṣāt tri aṅgaiḥ vāo ityādi sūtre siddhāntitam iti arthaḥ

original: etacca viśiṣṭaśaktipakṣe ghaṭapadād ghaṭaghaṭatvayoriva viśiṣṭaśaktyaiva prāthamyaviśiṣṭabhakṣasya tritvaviśiṣṭāṅgānāṃ copasthityā vākyārtharūpoddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayāsaṃbhavātsaṃgacchate|
analyzed: etat ca viśiṣṭa śakti pakṣe ghaṭa padāt ghaṭa ghaṭa tvayoḥ iva viśiṣṭa śaktyā eva prāthamya viśiṣṭa bhakṣasya tritva viśiṣṭa aṅgānām ca upasthityā vākya artha rūpa uddeśya vidheya bhāvena anvaya asaṃbhavāt saṃgacchate

original: samudāyaśakteranaṅgīkāre tu prathamo bhakṣaḥ, tribhiraṅgaiḥ, ityādivākyavātsamāse'pi uddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayaḥ syāditi mīmāṃsādhikaraṇavirodhaḥ spaṣṭa eveti tātparyārthaḥ| samāse viśiṣṭaśaktisvīkārādevāruṇādhikaraṇārambha upapadyata ityāha-saṃgacchate cāruṇeti anyatheti|
analyzed: samudāya śakteḥ anaṅgīkāre tu prathamaḥ bhakṣaḥ tribhiḥ aṅgaiḥ ityādi vākyavāt samāse api uddeśya vidheya bhāvena anvayaḥ syāt iti mīmāṃsā adhikaraṇa virodhaḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva iti tātparyārthaḥ samāse viśiṣṭa śakti svīkārāt eva aruṇa adhikaraṇa ārambhaḥ upapadyate iti āha saṃgacchate ca aruṇā iti anyathā iti

original: samāse viśiṣṭaśaktyanaṅgīkāre pūrvapakṣasyaivāsaṃbhavenāruṇādhikaraṇāsaṃbhavāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| tathā hi-jyotiṣṭome krayasaṃnidhau śrūyate-`aruṇayā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti' iti|
analyzed: samāse viśiṣṭa śakti anaṅgīkāre pūrvapakṣasya eva asaṃbhavena aruṇa adhikaraṇa asaṃbhava āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ tathā hi jyotiṣṭome kraya saṃnidhau śrūyate aruṇayā piṅga akṣyā ekahāyanyā somam krīṇāti iti

original: atrāruṇayeti padaṃ krayeṇa saṃbandhyata uta vākyabhedena prākaraṇikagrahacamasādyakhiladravyeṇa saṃbandhyata iti saṃśaye-aruṇāpadaṃ rūpaviśeṣe guṇe śaktaṃ, rūpaviśeṣe ca krayarūpakriyākaraṇatvaṃ bādhitaṃ, rūpasyāmūrtatvāt|
analyzed: atra aruṇayā iti padam krayeṇa saṃbandhyate uta vākya bhedena prākaraṇika graha camasa ādi akhila dravyeṇa saṃbandhyate iti saṃśaye aruṇā padam rūpa viśeṣe guṇe śaktam rūpa viśeṣe ca kraya rūpa kriyā karaṇa tvam bādhitam rūpasya amūrta tvāt

original: ato vākyātpṛthakkṛtya tṛtīyāśrutyā prākaraṇikāni dravyāṇyanūdyā''ruṇyaguṇo vidhīyateāruṇyena guṇena jyotiṣṭomāpūrvasādhanadravyaṃ bhāvayediti pūrvapakṣayitvā yogyatājñānasya na śabdabodhe hetutvaṃ, kiṃ tvayogyatāmiścayasya bodhapratibandhakatvamātraṃ, yogyatā ca parasparānvayaprayojakadharmavattvaṃ, payasāḥ siñcitītyatra
analyzed: atas vākyāt pṛthakkṛtya tṛtīyā śrutyā prākaraṇikāni dravyāṇi anūdya āruṇya guṇaḥ vidhīyate āruṇyena guṇena jyotiṣṭoma apūrva sādhana dravyam bhāvayet iti pūrvapakṣayitvā yogyatā jñānasya na śabda bodhe hetutvam kim tu ayogyatā miścayasya bodha pratibandhaka tva mātram yogyatā ca paraspara anvaya prayojaka dharmavattvam payasā siñciti iti atra

original: sekānvayaprayojakadharmasya jalatvasya payasi, evaṃ payaḥkaraṇakānvayaprayojakadharmasya sekatvasya sekakriyāyāṃ sattvāllakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| vahninā siñcatītyatra tu vahnau sekānvayaprayojakadharmasya dravadravyatvasyāsattvādayogyatāniścayānna śābdabodhaḥ|
analyzed: seka anvaya prayojaka dharmasya jala tvasya payasi evam payaḥ karaṇaka anvaya prayojaka dharmasya seka tvasya seka kriyāyām sattvāt lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ vahninā siñcati iti atra tu vahnau seka anvaya prayojaka dharmasya drava dravya tvasya asattvāt ayogya tā niścayāt na śābda bodhaḥ

original: prakṛte ca kārakāṇāṃ kriyayaivānvaya iti niyamādayogyatāniścayābhāvasattvenā''ruṇyasyāpi krayaṇākriyāyāmanvaya upapadyate, pārṣṭhikastu dravyeṇānvaya iti na vākyavicchedaśaṅketyādi siddhāntitam| atra pūrvapakṣasya noktiḥ saṃbhavati|
analyzed: prakṛte ca kārakāṇām kriyayā eva anvayaḥ iti niyamāt ayogya tā niścaya abhāva sattvena aruṇyasya api krayaṇa akriyāyām anvayaḥ upapadyate pārṣṭhikaḥ tu dravyeṇa anvayaḥ iti na vākya viccheda śaṅkā ityādi siddhāntitam atra pūrvapakṣasya nā uktiḥ saṃbhavati

original: samāse viśiṣṭaśaktyasvīkāre piṅgākṣyekahāyanīśabdayorapi piṅgatvākṣitvaikatvahāyananvādervācyatayā teṣāmapyamūrtatvātkrayaṇakriyākaraṇatvāsaṃbhavena krīṇātikaraṇasyaitadvākyādalābhādāruṇyasya vākyabhedaśaṅkasāyā evāsaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: samāse viśiṣṭa śakti asvīkāre piṅgākṣī ekahāyanī śabdayoḥ api piṅgatva akṣi tva ekatva hāyananva ādeḥ vācyatayā teṣām api amūrta tvāt krayaṇa kriyā karaṇa tva asaṃbhavena krīṇāti karaṇasya etad vākyāt alābhāt āruṇyasya vākyabheda śaṅkasāyāḥ eva asaṃbhavāt

original: triṣvapi lakṣitadravyavidhyupapattau vākyabhedaśaṅkāyā nirbījatvācca bahuvrīhyogruṇaśabdasya ceti trayāṇāmapi lākṣaṇikadravyābhidhāyakatāyā aviśiṣṭatvena bahuvrīhyoreva dravyavidhāyakatvaṃ, nāruṇapadasyetyatra vinigamakāsaṃbhavāt| vākya bhedena prakaraṇe niveśasyāpyasaṃbhāvitatvācca|
analyzed: triṣu api lakṣita dravya vidhi upapattau vākya bheda śaṅkāyāḥ nirbīja tvāt ca ca iti trayāṇām api lākṣaṇika dravya abhidhāyaka tāyāḥ aviśiṣṭa tvena bahuvrīhyoḥ eva dravya vidhāyaka tvam na aruṇa padasya iti atra vinigamaka asaṃbhavāt vākya bhedena prakaraṇe niveśasya api asaṃbhāvita tvāt ca

original: tathā hi-prakaraṇe'pyamūrtatvātkriyābhiḥ, kārakatvācca dravyairapi saṃbandho'saṃbhavī| tasmātpūrvapakṣāsaṃbhavādaruṇādhikaraṇocchedāpatteḥ samāse viśiṣṭaśaktirāvaśaayakītyāśayenā''ha--prapañcita bhūṣaṇa iti| vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe vistaraśaḥ saṃgṛhītamityarthaḥ| āstāṃ vistara iti|
analyzed: tathā hi prakaraṇe pi amūrta tvāt kriyābhiḥ kāraka tvāt ca dravyaiḥ api saṃbandhaḥ usaṃbhavī tasmāt pūrvapakṣa asaṃbhavāt aruṇa adhikaraṇa uccheda āpatteḥ samāse viśiṣṭa śaktiḥ āvaśaayakī iti āśayena āha prapañcita bhūṣaṇe iti vaiyākaraṇa bhūṣaṇe vistaraśaḥ saṃgṛhītam iti arthaḥ āstām vistaraḥ iti

original: jaiminīyānāṃ jaiminīmasūtravirodho'tyantamanucita iti taiḥ samāse viśiṣṭaśaktivādo'vaśyamabhyupeya ityalaṃ vistareṇetyarthaḥ|| 34 ||
analyzed: jaiminīyānām jaiminī masūtra virodha utyantam anucitaḥ iti taiḥ samāse viśiṣṭa śakti vādaḥ vaśyam abhyupeyaḥ iti alam vistareṇa iti arthaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ mīmāṃsakādīn prati samudāyaśaktiṃ vyavasthāpya ākhyātaṃ taddhitakṛtorityādyuktaṃ tatpūrvagranthāsaṃgatamityāṅkānirāsārthaṃ tatsaṃgatiṃ pradarśayannāha--rājapuruṣa ityādinā| rājā cāsāviti| atra rājapadaṃ vigrahavākyāntargatamapi rājasaṃbandhiparameva, ata eva vigrahasya samāsasamānārthatvamakṣuṇṇamiti bhāvaḥ| ityeva vigraha iti|
analyzed: nanu evam mīmāṃsaka ādīn prati samudāya śaktim vyavasthāpya ākhyātam taddhita kṛtoḥ ityādi uktam tat pūrva grantha asaṃgatam iti āṅkā nirāsa artham tad saṃgatim pradarśayan āha rāja puruṣaḥ ityādinā rājā ca asau iti atra rāja padam vigraha vākya antargatam api rāja saṃbandhi param eva atas eva vigrahasya samāsa samānārtha tvam akṣuṇṇam iti bhāvaḥ iti eva vigrahaḥ iti

original: evakāreṇa prasiddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vigrahasya vyāvṛttiḥ| atha ṣaṣṭhyantena vigrahe'pi rājapadaṃ rājasaṃbandhini lākṣaṇikaṃ, ṣaṣṭhī tvabhedārthiketyaṅgīkāre nirvahatyeva samāsasamānārthakatvamiti cenna| rājasaṃbandhiranirūpito yo'bheda iti ṣaṣṭhyarthābhedasya vigrahe prādhānyena bhānātsamāse tu tathā bhānābhāvāt|

original: niṣādaḥ sthapatiḥ svāmī yasyeti puruṣāntarānyapadārthake bahuvrīhāvityarthaḥ| sthapatiśabdaḥ svāmiparyāya iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca niṣādasthapatisamāso nirukteṣu triṣvapyartheṣu śaktatvānnānārthakaḥ, sati tātparye niṣādasaṃbandhinaḥ, niṣādasvāmikasyāpi ca bodhotpatteriṣṭatvāttatrāpi śaktirāvaśyakīti bhāvaḥ| nānārthe iti|
analyzed: niṣādaḥ sthapatiḥ svāmī yasya iti puruṣa antara anya padārthake bahuvrīhau iti arthaḥ sthapati śabdaḥ svāmi paryāyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam ca niṣāda sthapati samāsaḥ nirukteṣu triṣu api artheṣu śakta tvāt nānārthakaḥ sati tātparye niṣāda saṃbandhinaḥ niṣāda svāmikasya api ca bodha utpatteḥ iṣṭa tvāt tatra api śaktiḥ āvaśyakī iti bhāvaḥ nānārthe iti

original: śaktyādivṛttyā'nekārthopasthitau satyāmityarthaḥ| tātparyāditi| nānārthavācake haryādau tātparyād vaktṛtātparyānurodhād viśeṣasya vivakṣitārthaviśeṣasyāvagatirniścaya iti tadarthaḥ| nyāyenetyasya kva tātparyamiti saṃśaye prāpte satīti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: śakti ādi vṛttyā aneka artha upasthitau satyām iti arthaḥ tātparyāt iti nānā artha vācake hari ādau tātparyāt vaktṛ tātparya anurodhāt viśeṣasya vivakṣita artha viśeṣasya avagatiḥ niścayaḥ iti tad arthaḥ nyāyena iti asya kva tātparyam iti saṃśaye prāpte sati iti śeṣaḥ

original: niṣādasthapatiśabde svaghaṭakapadaghaṭitavākyadṛṣṭārthamātraviṣayakabodhajanakatatpuruṣāpekṣayā, svaghaṭakapadaghaṭitavākyadṛṣṭārthāttiriktārthaviṣayakabodhajanakatvena bahuvrīherbahiraṅgatvam|
analyzed: niṣāda sthapati śabde sva ghaṭaka pada ghaṭita vākya dṛṣṭa artha mātra viṣayaka bodha janaka tatpuruṣa apekṣayā sva ghaṭaka pada ghaṭita vākya dṛṣṭa artha attirikta artha viṣayaka bodha janaka tvena bahuvrīheḥ bahis aṅga tvam

original: svaṃ niṣādasthapatiriti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ, tad‌ghaṭake ye dve pade, tādṛśapadadvayaghaṭitaṃ yadvākyaṃ-niṣādānāṃ sthapatirityākārakaṃ, tatra dṛṣṭo yo'rthaḥ-niṣādasaṃbandhisthapatirityevaṃrūpaḥ, tādavadarthaviṣayakabodhajanakatvāttatpuruṣasya bahuvrīhyapekṣayā'ntaraṅgatvam|
analyzed: svam niṣāda sthapatiḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ tad ghaṭake ye dve pade tādṛśa pada dvaya ghaṭitam yat vākyam niṣādānām sthapatiḥ iti ākārakam tatra dṛṣṭaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ niṣāda saṃbandhi sthapatiḥ iti evaṃrūpaḥ tādavat artha viṣayaka bodha janaka tvāt tatpuruṣasya bahuvrīhi apekṣayā antaraṅga tvam

original: bahuvrīhestu savghaṭakapadaghaṭitaṃ yadvākyaṃ citrā gāva iti, tatra dṛṣṭo yo'rthaḥ-citrābhinnā gāvaḥ, tadapekṣayā'tiriktaḥ svāmirūpo yo'nyapadārthaḥ, tāvadarthabodhajanakatvena bahuvrīhestatpuruṣāpekṣayā bahiraṅgatvam| vṛttighaṭakībhūtapadārthātiriktapadārthabodhajanakatvābhāvena bahuvrīhyapekṣayā tatpuruṣe lāghavam|
analyzed: bahuvrīheḥ tu yat vākyam citrāḥ gāvaḥ iti tatra dṛṣṭaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ citrā bhinnāḥ gāvaḥ tad apekṣayā atiriktaḥ svāmi rūpaḥ yonya padārthaḥ tāvat artha bodha janaka tvena bahuvrīheḥ tatpuruṣa apekṣayā bahiraṅga tvam vṛtti ghaṭakībhūta padārtha atirikta padārtha bodha janaka tva abhāvena bahuvrīhi apekṣayā tatpuruṣe lāghavam

original: bahuvrīhau tu vṛttighaṭakībhūtapadārthātiriktapadārthabodhajanakatvena tatpuruṣāpekṣayā gauravamiti bhāvaḥ| evameva ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣāpekṣayā karmadhārayasya laghutvaṃ bodhyam|
analyzed: bahuvrīhau tu vṛtti ghaṭakībhūta padārtha atirikta padārtha bodha janaka tvena tatpuruṣa apekṣayā gauravam iti bhāvaḥ evam eva ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣa apekṣayā karmadhārayasya laghu tvam bodhyam

original: vṛttighaṭakībhūtapadārthayorabhedenānvayādekārthaviṣayakabodhajanakatvena tatpuruṣāpekṣayā karmadhāraye lāghavaṃ, ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe tu vṛttighaṭakībhūtapadārthayorbhedenānvayātpadārthadvayaviṣayakabodhajanakatvena karmadhārayāpekṣayā gauravam, iti bhāvaḥ| tatkalpanāyāmiti| niṣādasthapatiśabde tātparyakalpanāyāṃ prāptāyāmiti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: vṛtti ghaṭakībhūta padārthayoḥ abhedena anvayāt eka artha viṣayaka bodha janaka tvena tatpuruṣa apekṣayā karmadhāraye lāghavam ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣe tu vṛtti ghaṭakībhūta padārthayoḥ bhedena anvayāt padārtha dvaya viṣayaka bodha janaka tvena karmadhāraya apekṣayā gauravam iti bhāvaḥ tad kalpanāyām iti niṣāda sthapati śabde tātparya kalpanāyām prāptāyām iti śeṣaḥ

original: pūrvopasthitārtha eveti| saṃbhavati sāmanādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānyāyyatvamiti nyāyena niṣādasaṃbandhisthapatyapekṣayā niṣādarūpe sthapatāvevopasthitiprayuktalāghavānurodha tattātparyaṃ kalpyate niścīyate|
analyzed: pūrva upasthita arthaḥ eva iti saṃbhavati sāmanādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasya anyāyya tvam iti nyāyena niṣāda saṃbandhi sthapati apekṣayā niṣāda rūpe sthapatau eva upasthiti prayukta lāghava anurodha tat tātparyam kalpyate niścīyate

original: abhedānvayenaikārthabodhajanakatvarūpasāmānādhikaraṇye saṃbhavati sati, bhedasaṃbandhenānvayabodhajanakatvarūpavaiyadhikaraṇyasya nyāyāpetatvaṃ, padadvayenābhedā vayādekasyaiva padārthasya bodhanena karmadhāraye lāghavāt, tatpuruṣe tu bhedenānvayātpadadvayena pārthakyenārthadvayasya bodhanena gauravāditi saṃkalito'rthaḥ|
analyzed: abheda anvayena ekārtha bodha janaka tva rūpa sāmānādhikaraṇye saṃbhavati sati bheda saṃbandhena anvaya bodha janaka tva rūpa vaiyadhikaraṇyasya nyāya apeta tvam pada dvayena abhedāḥ ekasya eva padārthasya bodhanena karmadhāraye lāghavāt tatpuruṣe tu bhedena anvayāt pada dvayena pārthakyena artha dvayasya bodhanena gauravāt iti saṃkalita ūrthaḥ

original: nanu mīmāṃsakamate samāse śakyabhāvātkathaṃ niṣādasthapatipadaṃ nānārthakamata āha-pareṣāmapīti| vyapekṣāphakṣavādināṃ naiyāyikādīnāmapītyarthaḥ| sati tātparye iti| ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādyarthe tātparye satītyarthaḥ| yaṣṭīḥ praveśayetivaditi|
analyzed: nanu mīmāṃsaka mate samāse śakya bhāvāt katham niṣāda sthapati padam nānārthakam atas āha pareṣām api iti vyapekṣā phakṣa vādinām naiyāyika ādīnām api iti arthaḥ sati tātparye iti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣa ādi arthe tātparye sati iti arthaḥ yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya iti vat iti

original: tatra yathā yaṣṭipravaśarūmamukhyārthānvayānupapattyabhāve'pi tātparyānupapattyā yaṣṭidhare lakṣaṇā kriyate evaṃ yakṛte niṣādasthapatiśabde'pyanvayānupapattyabhāve'pi tātparyānupapattyā ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādyarthe lakṣaṇā durvāretyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra yathā tātparya anupapattyā yaṣṭidhare lakṣaṇā kriyate evam niṣāda sthapati śabde api anvaya anupapatti abhāve pi tātparya anupapattyā ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣa ādi arthe lakṣaṇā durvārā iti arthaḥ

original: tataścānekārthakatve'pi yādṛśārthasyopasthitau lāghavaṃ bhavati tādṛśalāghavānusāreṇa karmadhārayārtha eva tātparyaṃ niścīyate iti tātparyam|| 36 ||
analyzed: tatas ca aneka arthaka tve pi yādṛśa arthasya upasthitau lāghavam bhavati tādṛśa lāghava anusāreṇa karmadhāraya arthe eva tātparyam niścīyate iti tātparyam

original: iti śrīvaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāravyākhyāyāṃ śāṃkaryāṃ samāsaśaktinirṇayaḥ|
analyzed: iti śrī vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāra vyākhyāyām śāṃkaryām samāsa śakti nirṇayaḥ

original: raṅgabhaṭṭatanūjena śaṃkareṇa vinirmite|
sārīye'bhūdvivaraṇe samāse śaktinirṇayaḥ|| 5 ||

original: || vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāraḥ ||
(tatra dvitīyo bhāgaḥ)
