original: || atha śaktinirṇayaḥ ||
analyzed: atha śakti nirṇayaḥ

original: prasaṅgasaṃgatyā yāvatpadeṣu śaktiṃ samarthayan bhūmikāmāracayati-śaktiprasaṅgaditi| samāsaśaktinirūpaṇaprasaṅgātsmṛtasyopekṣānarhatvādityarthaḥ| tasyā iti| śakterityarthaḥ| śaktirnāma padena saha padārthasya saṃbandhaḥ|
analyzed: prasaṅga saṃgatyā yāvat padeṣu śaktim samarthayan bhūmikām āracayati śakti prasaṅgāt iti samāsa śakti nirūpaṇa prasaṅgāt smṛtasya upekṣā anarha tvāt iti arthaḥ tasyāḥ iti śakteḥ iti arthaḥ śaktiḥ nāma padena saha padārthasya saṃbandhaḥ

original: sa cāsmātpadādayamartho boddhavya ityarthaviśeṣyakeśvarecchārūpo vā, idaṃ padamamumarthaṃ bodhayatviti padaviśeṣyakeśvarecchārūpo veti tārkikāḥ| amumeveśvarīyasaṃketa iti vyavaharanti te| navyatārkikairīśvarecchā, jñānaṃ vā kṛtirvā śaktirityucyate| tānnirākartumādau tatsvarūpaṃ darśamati-indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣaya iti|
analyzed: sa ca asmāt padāt ayam arthaḥ boddhavyaḥ iti artha viśeṣyaka īśvara icchā rūpaḥ vā idam padam amum artham bodhayatu iti pada viśeṣyaka īśvara icchā rūpaḥ vā iti tārkikāḥ amum eva īśvarīya saṃketaḥ iti vyavaharanti te navya tārkikaiḥ īśvara icchā jñānam vā kṛtiḥ vā śaktiḥ iti ucyate tān nirākartum ādau tad svarūpam darśa mati indriyāṇām sva viṣayaḥ iti

original: asyārthaḥ-yathā cakṣurādīnāṃ rūpādiviṣayakajñānajanane'nādiḥ puruṣaprayatnānapekṣā yogyatā, tajjanakatāvacchedakadharmavattvarūpā, tathā śabdānāmarthe'nādiḥ saṃbandha eva yogyatā, tadbodhajanakatāvacchedako dharma iti| pratipadārthamāha--indriyāṇāṃ--cakṣurādīnām, ityādinā| cākṣuṣapadaṃ rāsanādipratyakṣasyāpyupalakṣaṇam|
analyzed: asya arthaḥ yathā cakṣuḥ ādīnām rūpa ādi viṣayaka jñāna jananena ādiḥ puruṣa prayatna anapekṣā yogyatā tad janakatā avacchedaka dharmavattva rūpā tathā śabdānām arthena ādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ eva yogyatā tad bodha janakatā avacchedakaḥ dharmaḥ iti pratipadārtham āha aindriyāṇām cakṣuḥ ādīnām ityādinā cākṣuṣa padam rāsana ādi pratyakṣasya api upalakṣaṇam

original: anādiryogyatetyatra na ādirthasyāḥ setyartho bodhyaḥ| saiva śaktiriti| bodhakāraṇatārūpaiva śaktirityarthaḥ| pare tu arthāsaṃbaddhasya śabdasyārtaviṣayakabodhajanakatvānyathānupapattyā kalpyamānaśaktirūpasaṃbandhasya bodhajanakatvarūpatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, ātmāśrayāpatteḥ|
analyzed: anādiḥ yogyatā iti atra na ādiḥ thasyāḥ sā iti arthaḥ bodhyaḥ sā eva śaktiḥ iti bodha kāraṇatā rūpā eva śaktiḥ iti arthaḥ pare tu artha asaṃbaddhasya śabdasya ārta viṣayaka bodha janakatva anyathā anupapattyā kalpyamāna śakti rūpa saṃbandhasya bodha janakatva rūpatvam na saṃbhavati ātma āśraya āpatteḥ

original: kiṃ ca saṃbandhibhinnatve sati ubhayāśritatve sati viśiṣṭabuddhiniyamakatvaṃ saṃbandhatvam| yo hi ghaṭabhūtalayoḥ saṃyogavattadubhayasminnapi saṃbandhiti vartate sa evaṃ saṃbandho bhavati, icchāyā janakatvasya vā padamātravṛttitvenobhayavṛttitvābhāvānna saṃbandhatavam|
analyzed: kim ca saṃbandhi bhinna tve sati ubhaya āśrita tve sati viśiṣṭa buddhi niyamaka tvam saṃbandha tvam yaḥ hi ghaṭa bhū talayoḥ saṃyoga vat tat ubhayasmin api vartate saḥ evam saṃbandhaḥ bhavati icchāyāḥ janakatvasya vā pada mātra vṛttitvena ubhaya vṛttitva abhāvāt na saṃbandha tavam

original: nanu asmātpadādayamartho boddhavya itīcchāyāṃ bodhasyeva padatadarthayorapi icchāviṣayatvena pratīteḥ kathamicchāyā ubhayavṛttitvābhāva iti cenna| tatra hi na padaṃ nāpi padārtha icchāviṣayaḥ, kiṃ tu bodha eva tādṛśa iti bodhaniṣṭhaviṣayataivecchāśrayatāniyāmikā, na tu bodhaviṣayapadatadarthaniṣṭhaviṣayatā icchāśrayatāniyāmikā|
analyzed: nanu asmāt padāt ayam arthaḥ boddhavyaḥ iti icchāyām bodhasya iva pada tad arthayoḥ api icchā viṣaya tvena pratīteḥ katham icchāyāḥ ubhaya vṛtti tva abhāvaḥ iti ced na tatra hi na padam na api padārthaḥ icchā viṣayaḥ kim tu bodhaḥ eva tādṛśaḥ iti bodha niṣṭha viṣayatā eva icchā āśraya tā niyāmikā na tu bodha viṣaya pada tad artha niṣṭha viṣayatā icchā āśraya tā niyāmikā

original: ayaṃ śabdaḥ padārtho vā icchāvāniti pratītyabhāvāt| viṣayatāsaṃbandhena bodhasyaiva sākṣādicchāśrayatve saṃbhavati sati paramparāsaṃbandhena padatadarthayoricchāśrayatvābhvupagamemānāgāva ityāśayaḥ| nanu śabdavadarthasyāpi sābdabodhe nimittatvādastyubhayatrāpi bodhajanakatvamiti saṃyogavattasya saṃbandhatvaṃ durvāramiti cenna|
analyzed: ayam śabdaḥ padārthaḥ vā icchāvān iti pratīti abhāvāt viṣayatā saṃbandhena bodhasya eva sākṣāt icchā āśraya tve saṃbhavati sati paramparā saṃbandhena pada tad arthayoḥ icchā āśraya tva ābhu upagama imān āgāvaḥ iti āśayaḥ nanu śabda vat arthasya api sābda bodhe nimitta tvāt asti ubhayatra api bodha janaka tvam iti saṃyoga vat tasya saṃbandha tvam durvāram iti ced na

original: yathā daṇḍacakrayorubhayorghaṭajanakatve'pi tayoḥ parasparamasaṃbandho'nubhavasiddhastadvacchabdatadarthayorubhayorbodhajanakatve'pi tayoḥ parasparaṃ saṃbandhasya durupapādatvāt|
analyzed: yathā daṇḍa cakrayoḥ ubhayoḥ ghaṭa janaka tve pi tayoḥ parasparam asaṃbandhaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ tadvat śabda tad arthayoḥ ubhayoḥ bodha janaka tve pi tayoḥ parasparam saṃbandhasya durupapāda tvāt

original: api ca viśiṣṭapratītiniyāmakasyaiva saṃbandhatvaṃ, yathā-ghaṭapad‌bhūtalamityatra ghaṭanirūpitasaṃyogāśrayo bhūtalamiti viśiṣṭapratītiniyāmakatvātsaṃyogasya saṃbandhatvaṃ, tadvadicchāyā janakatvasya ca viśiṣṭapratītiniyāmakatvābhāvānna saṃbandhatvasaṃbhavaḥ| tasmātpadatadarthayoḥ saṃbandhāntarameva śaktiḥ, vācyavācakabhāvāparaparyāyeti prāhuḥ|
analyzed: api ca viśiṣṭa pratīti niyāmakasya eva saṃbandha tvam yathā ghaṭa pad bhū talam iti atra ghaṭa nirūpita saṃyoga āśrayaḥ bhū talam iti viśiṣṭa pratīti niyāmaka tvāt saṃyogasya saṃbandha tvam tadvat icchāyāḥ janaka tvasya ca viśiṣṭa pratīti niyāmaka tva abhāvāt na saṃbandha tva saṃbhavaḥ tasmāt pada tad arthayoḥ saṃbandha antaram eva śaktiḥ vācya vācaka bhāva apara paryāyā iti prāhuḥ

original: anādikāraṇatāyā vyabhicāragrastatvātsaṃketajñānaṃ vinā bodhānudayācca saṃketa eva-śaktirastviti naiyāyikaḥ śaṅkate-nanu neti| anādibhūtāyā bodhakāraṇatāyāḥ śaktitvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ| tasyā aśaktitve hetumāha-ādhuniketi| idānīṃtanapitrādisaṃketite caitramaitrādināmnītyarthaḥ| tadabhāvāditi| anāditvaviśiṣṭabodakāraṇatāyā asattvādityarthaḥ|

original: tathācā''dhrunikasaṃketasthale caitrādāvicchāyāṃ viśeṣaṇatayā bodhajanakatājñānasya sattve'pi svātantryeṇa bodhajanakatājñānaṃ nāstīti viśeṣaṇābhāvaprayuktaviśiṣṭābhāvācchābdabodhahetordhodhajacakatājñānasyā''dhunisaṃketasthale vyabhicāra eveti cennetyāha-nedaṃ taddhījanakamiti grahavata iti|

original: ghaṭapadaṃ paṭadhījanakaṃ neti jñānavato'bhrāntasyetyarthaḥ| ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvābhāvaniścayavataḥ puruṣasyeti yāvat| bādheneti| ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvajñānasyābhāvenetyarthaḥ| pade paragrahamiti| ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvamastītyākārakaṃ jñānaṃ madanyabhrāntapuruṣasaṃbandhītyevaṃ jānato'pītyarthaḥ| tad‌grahāsaṃbhavāditi|
analyzed: ghaṭa padam paṭa dhī janakam na iti jñānavataḥ bhrāntasya iti arthaḥ ghaṭa pade paṭa dhī janaka tva abhāva niścayavataḥ puruṣasya iti yāvat bādhena iti ghaṭa pade paṭa dhī janaka tva jñānasya abhāvena iti arthaḥ pade para graham iti ghaṭa pade paṭa dhī janaka tvam asti iti ākārakam jñānam mad anya bhrānta puruṣa saṃbandhi iti evam jānataḥ api iti arthaḥ tad graha asaṃbhavāt iti

original: ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvajñānasya sarvathā'nudayādityarthaḥ| yasya ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvaṃ nāstīti niścayātmakaṃ jñānamasti tādṛśe'bhrāntapuruṣe ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvamastītyevaṃ bhrāntapuruṣīyajñānasya yathākathaṃcid(abhāvapratiyogitvena)sattve'pi tāvatā'bhrāntapuruṣasya ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvamastītyevaṃ jñānaṃ kathamivodiyāt|

original: naivodiyādityarthaḥ| sarvatra kārye pratidhandhakābhāvasyāpi kāraṇatvenāvaśyāṅgīkāryatvāt kṛtasthale ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvaṃ nāstītyevamātmakasya niścayātmakajñānasya prabalapratibandhakasya sattvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ cābhrāntapuruṣasya ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvajñānābhāvānna ghaṭapadātpaṭavyaktijñānāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| anyatheti|

original: uktavaiparītye ca ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvābhāvaniścayasattve'pi tatra ghaṭapade paṭadhījanakatvajñānāṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| tadabhāvavati tatprakārakārakaṃ jñānaṃ bhrāntijñānaṃ mithyājñānamiti tādṛśabhrāntijñānaṃ rajatatvābhāvavatyāṃ śuktau idaṃ rajatamiti rajatvaprakārakaṃ jñānaṃ caitrasya jātam|

original: taccaitrāyibhrāntijñānaṃ-rajatatvābhāvavatī śuktī rajatatvena rūpeṇānena gṛhītetyevaṃ maitreṇa jñātam| ataścaitraniṣṭhabhrāntijño maitraḥ| sa cābhrānta eva| nedaṃ rajatamiti purovartini vastuni rajatvaprakārakatvasya bādhaniścayāt|
analyzed: tat caitrāyi bhrānti jñānam rajata tva abhāvavatī śuktī rajata tvena rūpeṇa anena gṛhītā iti evam maitreṇa jñātam atas caitra niṣṭha bhrānti jñaḥ maitraḥ sa ca abhrāntaḥ eva na idam rajatam iti purovartini vastuni rajatva prakāraka tvasya bādha niścayāt

original: satyemaṃ caitrīyabhrānterjñātṛtvena yadi maitrasyāpi rajatatvābhāvavadvastuviśeṣyakarajatatvaprakārakajñānasattvena bhnāntyāśrayatvaṃ svīkriyate, tarhi bhrāntijñasyapi bhrantatvamāpadyeteti nedaṃ rajatamiti bādhasthale idaṃ rajatamityevaṃ rajatatvaprakārakaṃ jñānameva nodetītyavagantavyamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: satyā imam caitrīya bhrānteḥ jñātṛ tvena yadi maitrasya api rajata tva abhāvavat vastu viśeṣyaka rajata tva prakāraka jñāna sattvena bhnānti āśraya tvam svīkriyate tarhi bhrānti jñasi api bhranta tvam āpadyeta iti na idam rajatam iti bādha sthale idam rajatam iti evam rajata tva prakārakam jñānam eva na udeti iti avagantavyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: arthadhījanakatvarūpāyāḥ śaktergrahakamāha-idaṃ ceti| śabde vidyamānamanādisiddhamarthadhījanakatvarūpaṃ sābharthyaṃ pitrādinā kṛto yaḥ saṃketastajjñānād gṛhyate| ghaṭapadaṃ kambugrīvādimadarthasya vācakamityupadeśaḥ saṃketaḥ| pitrādityādipadenā''pto grāhyaḥ| tathā ca saṃketajñānātpūrvaṃ na śābdabodha iti vyaktam|
analyzed: artha dhī janaka tva rūpāyāḥ śakteḥ grahakam āha edam ca iti śabde vidyamānam anādisiddham artha dhī janaka tva rūpam sābharthyam pitṛ ādinā kṛtaḥ yaḥ saṃketaḥ tad jñānāt gṛhyate ghaṭa padam kambu grīvā ādimat arthasya vācakam iti upadeśaḥ saṃketaḥ pitrāt ityādi padena āptaḥ grāhyaḥ tathā ca saṃketa jñānāt pūrvam na śābda bodhaḥ iti vyaktam

original: uktavaiparītye| apabhraṃśeṣvekarūpatvābhāve'pi śaktikalpana ityarthaḥ| paryāyatayeti| sādhuṣvivāpabhraṃśeṣvapi śaktitamattvasattvātsādhūnāṃ paryāyatvena yathā kośādau parigaṇanaṃ kṛtaṃ tadvadapabhraṃśānāmapi saṃskṛtataparyāyatvena kośādau parigaṇanakartavyatā''padyetetyarthaḥ| evaṃ ceti| apabhraṃśānāṃ sākṣādvācakatvābhāve cetyarthaḥ| matamiti|

original: śaktatvameva sādhutvamityevaṃ yannaiyāyikamīmāṃsakādināṃ mataṃ tad‌ `te sādhuṣvanumānena' ityādyuktavākyapadīyānusāreṇaiveti bodhyam| idānīmiti| apabhraṃśānāṃ sākṣādavācakatvavipaye mīmāṃsakādimatapratipādanānantaramityarthaḥ| svamatamiti| vaiyākaraṇamatamityarthaḥ| vācakatvāviśeṣa iti|
analyzed: śaktatvam eva sādhu tvam iti evam yat naiyāyika mīmāṃsaka ādinām matam tat te sādhuṣu anumānena ityādi ukta vākyapadīya anusāreṇa eva iti bodhyam idānīm iti apabhraṃśānām sākṣāt avācaka tva vipaye mīmāṃsaka ādi mata pratipādana anantaram iti arthaḥ sva matam iti vaiyākaraṇa matam iti arthaḥ vācakatva aviśeṣaḥ iti

original: japabhraṃśātmakabāṣāśabdānāṃ bodhakatvasya harisaṃmatyopapāditatvātteṣu śaktikalpanaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ durāgraha ityāśaṅkyetanaiyāyikādibhirityatastaduktarītyā'pabhraṃśānāṃ bodhakatvaṃ durvacamityāśayenā''ha--ayaṃ bhāva iti| aśaktatva iti|
analyzed: japa bhraṃśa ātmaka bāṣā śabdānām bodhaka tvasya hari saṃmatyā upapādita tvāt teṣu śakti kalpanam vaiyākaraṇānām durāgrahaḥ iti āśaṅkya ita naiyāyika ādibhiḥ iti atas tad ukta rītyā apabhraṃśānām bodhaka tvam durvacam iti āśayena āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti aśakta tve iti

original: yadyapabhraṃśeṣu śaktirbodhakatārūpā na kalpyeta tarhi tebhyo'rthabodho na syāt, sa tu jāyata iti sarvānubhavasiddhamityarthaḥ| śaktikalpanaṃ vinaivāpabhraṃśānāṃ bodhakatvaṃ prakārāntarema syādityāśaṅkate-na ceti| sādhusmaraṇāditi|
analyzed: yadi apabhraṃśeṣu śaktiḥ bodhaka tā rūpā na kalpyeta tarhi tebhyaḥ ṛtha bodhaḥ na syāt sa tu jāyate iti sarva anubhava siddham iti arthaḥ śakti kalpanam vinā eva apabhraṃśānām bodhaka tvam syāt iti āśaṅkatena ca iti sādhu smaraṇāt iti

original: apabhraṃśānāṃ sādhuśabdaprakṛtikatvena sādṛśyādapabhraṃśebhyaḥ prakṛtibhūtaḥ sādhuśabdaḥ smṛto bhavati, smṛtācca sādhuśabdādarthabodho jāyata iti paramparayā'pabhraṃśānāṃ bodhakatvaṃ, na tu sākṣāt| teṣu śaktyabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| iti cettannetyāha-tānaviduṣāmiti| tattadarthabodhakatvena sādhuśabdānajānatāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: apabhraṃśānām sādhu śabda prakṛtika tvena sādṛśyāt apabhraṃśebhyaḥ prakṛti bhūtaḥ sādhu śabdaḥ smṛtaḥ bhavati smṛtāt ca sādhu śabdāt artha bodhaḥ jāyate iti paramparayā apabhraṃśānām bodhaka tvam na tu sākṣāt teṣu śakti abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ iti ced tat na iti āha tān aviduṣām iti tad tad artha bodhaka tvena sādhu śabdān ajānatām iti arthaḥ

original: sādhuśabdājñāne kāraṇamāha-pāmarāṇāmiti| saṃskṛtānabhijñānāmityarthaḥ| apabhraṃśamātravyutpannāḥ pāmarā iti bhāvaḥ| bodhāditi| gagarītyādyapabhraṃśebhyo ghaṭādyarthabodhādityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ-pāmarāṇāṃ sādhorabodhācceti|
analyzed: sādhu śabda ajñāne kāraṇam āha pāmarāṇām iti saṃskṛta anabhijñānām iti arthaḥ apabhraṃśa mātra vyutpannāḥ pāmarāḥ iti bhāvaḥ bodhāt iti gagarī ityādi apabhraṃśebhyaḥ ghaṭa ādi artha bodhāt iti arthaḥ teṣām pāmarāṇām sādhoḥ abodhāt ca iti

original: apabhraṃśamātravyutpannatvena tattadathakatvena sādhuśabdajñānābhāvātsādhuśabdebhyaḥ pāmarāṇāṃ gavādyarthabodhātyantāsaṃbhavāccetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: apabhraṃśa mātra vyutpanna tvena tad tad athaka tvena sādhu śabda jñāna abhāvāt sādhu śabdebhyaḥ pāmarāṇām gavā ādi artha bodha atyanta asaṃbhavāt ca iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ ca yasmātsādhuśabdajñānābhāvavatāmapi gāvyādyapabhraṃśebhyo gāvādyarthapratītirjāyata iti loke'nubhūyate, tasmādapabhraṃśāḥ sākṣādvācakā ityeva yuktaṃ, na tu sādhuśabdānumānena paramparayā'rthabodhakā ityuktirupapadyata ityāśayaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca yasmāt sādhu śabda jñāna abhāvavatām api gāvī ādi apabhraṃśebhyaḥ gāvī ādi artha pratītiḥ jāyate iti loke nubhūyate tasmāt apabhraṃśāḥ sākṣāt vācakāḥ iti eva yuktam na tu sādhu śabda anumānena paramparayā artha bodhakāḥ iti uktiḥ upapadyate iti āśayaḥ

original: gavādyarthanirūpitāyāḥ sādhuśabdaniṣṭhavācakatāśakterapabhraṃśeṣu bhrāntyā sattvamādāya tebhyo bodhaḥ saṃbhavedityāśaṅkate-na ca śaktibhramāditi| apabhraṃśe ki bodhakatvaśakterbhrāntirabhipreyate utteśvarecchārūpāyā iti saṃdihya tatra nā''dya ityāha-bodhakatvasyeti| apabhraṃśe tattadarthabodhajanakatvasyetyarthaḥ| abādheneti|
analyzed: go ādi artha nirūpitāyāḥ sādhu śabda niṣṭha vācakatā śakteḥ apabhraṃśeṣu bhrāntyā sattvam ādāya tebhyaḥ bodhaḥ saṃbhavet iti āśaṅkate na ca śakti bhramāt iti apabhraṃśe ki bodhaka tva śakteḥ bhrāntiḥ abhipreyate utta īśvara icchā rūpāyāḥ iti saṃdihya tatra na ādyaḥ iti āha bodhaka tvasya iti apabhraṃśe tad tad artha bodha janakatvasya iti arthaḥ abādhena iti

original: nāyaṃ tadarthabodhaka ityākārakabādhajñānaniścayābhāvādapabhraṃśeṣu bodhajanakatvaśakterabādhenetyarthaḥ|9tad‌grahasyābhramatvāditi| apabhraṃśe bodhajanakatvagrahasya bhramatvāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: na ayam tad artha bodhakaḥ iti ākāraka bādha jñāna niścaya abhāvāt apabhraṃśeṣu bodha janaka tva śakteḥ abādhena iti arthaḥ tad grahasya abhrama tvāt iti apabhraṃśe bodha janaka tva grahasya bhrama tva asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ

original: yathā rajjau sarpajñānānantaraṃ samīpaṃ gatvā sūkṣmekṣikayā nāyaṃ sarpaḥ kiṃtu rajjuriti paścāttanena bādhajñānena pūrvajātasarpajñānasya bhramatvaṃ kalpyate tadvat gagarīśabdājjāyamānasya ghaṭarūpārthajñānasya paścāttanena kiṃcidviṣayakajñānena bādhābhāvādapabhraṃśe bodhakatvagrahasya bhramatvakalpanaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā rajjau sarpa jñāna anantaram samīpam gatvā sūkṣma īkṣikayā na ayam sarpaḥ kiṃtu rajjuḥ iti paścāttanena bādha jñānena pūrva jāta sarpa jñānasya bhrama tvam kalpyate tadvat gagarī śabdāt jāyamānasya ghaṭa rūpa artha jñānasya paścāttanena kiṃcid viṣayaka jñānena bādhā abhāvāt apabhraṃśe bodhaka tva grahasya bhrama tva kalpanam na saṃbhavati iti arthaḥ

original: jñānasya bhramatvakalpena tādṛśajñānaviṣayavastuno bādhasyaiva kāraṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ| dvitīyakalpe tvāha--īśvareccheti| sanmātraviṣayiṇyā iti| atra `mātraṃ kārtsnye'vadhāraṇe' iti kośānmātraśabdaḥ kṛtsnārthakaḥ| ghaṭaḥ san, paṭaḥ san iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāccetanācetaneṣu sarvatra sattvāvagamācchabdeṣvapi sattvaṃ pratīyate|
analyzed: jñānasya bhrama tva kalpena tādṛśa jñāna viṣaya vastunaḥ bādhasya eva kāraṇa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ dvitīya kalpe tu āha īśvara icchā iti sat mātra viṣayiṇyāḥ iti atra mātram kārtsnya iva dhāraṇe iti kośāt mātra śabdaḥ kṛtsna arthakaḥ ghaṭaḥ san paṭaḥ san iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt cetana acetaneṣu sarvatra sattva avagamāt śabdeṣu api sattvam pratīyate

original: tathā cāpabhraṃśānapabhraṃśātmakasarvaśabdaviṣayikāyā īśvarecchārūpaśakterityarthaḥ| bādābhāvāditi| yathā kambugrīvādimānartho ghaṭaśabdajanyabodhaviṣayo jāyatāmityanapabhraṣṭaśabdaviṣayīṇīśvarecchā vartate tathā ghaṭarūpo'rtho gagarīśabdajanyabodhaviṣayo bhavatvityapabhraṣṭaśabdāveṣayiṇyā api īśvarecchāyāḥ
analyzed: tathā ca apabhraṃśa anapabhraṃśa ātmaka sarva śabda viṣayikāyāḥ īśvara icchā rūpa śakteḥ iti arthaḥ bāda abhāvāt iti yathā kambu grīvā ādimān arthaḥ ghaṭa śabda janya bodha viṣayaḥ jāyatām iti anapabhraṣṭa śabda viṣayīṇi īśvara icchā vartate tathā ghaṭa rūpaḥ arthaḥ gagarī śabda janya bodha viṣayaḥ bhavatu iti apabhraṣṭa śabda āveṣayiṇyāḥ api īśvara icchāyāḥ

original: svīkārāvasyakatvenāpabhraṣṭeṣvapīśvarecchārūpaśakterbādhābhāvāt| anyatheśvarecchāyāḥ sarvaśabdaviṣayakatvaṃ nopapadyetetyarthaḥ| apabhraṃśātmakabhāṣāśabdād gagarīgāvītyādestattadarthabodhasya śiṣṭāśiṣṭasarvānubhavasiddhatvenāpabhraṣṭeṣvapīśvarecchayā bādhābhāvādīśvarecchā śaktiriti mate'pi śaktijñānasya bhramatvaṃ nopapadyate|
analyzed: svīkāra avasyaka tvena apabhraṣṭeṣu api īśvara icchā rūpa śakteḥ bādhā abhāvāt anyathā īśvara icchāyāḥ sarva śabda viṣayaka tvam na upapadyeta iti arthaḥ apabhraṃśa ātmaka bhāṣā śabdāt gagarī gāvī ityādeḥ tad tad artha bodhasya śiṣṭa aśiṣṭa sarva anubhava siddha tvena apabhraṣṭeṣu api īśvara icchayā bādhā abhāvāt īśvara icchā śaktiḥ iti mate pi śakti jñānasya bhrama tvam na upapadyate

original: jñānasya bhramatve viṣayabādhasyaiva niyāmakatvāt| sa ca viṣayabādhaḥ prakṛte nāstīti bhāvaḥ| svarūpataḥ sakterbhramatvaṃ sarvathā'saṃbhavītyāśayena śakteḥ svarūpamāha-padapadārthaviśeṣeti|
analyzed: jñānasya bhrama tve viṣaya bādhasya eva niyāmaka tvāt sa ca viṣaya bādhaḥ prakṛte nā asti iti bhāvaḥ svarūpataḥ sakteḥ bhrama tvam sarvathā asaṃbhavi iti āśayena śakteḥ svarūpam āha pada padārtha viśeṣa iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-idaṃ padamamumarthaṃ bodhayatu, ityevamarthanirūpitapadaśaktibodhakamidaṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ nirviseṣaṃ na sāmānyamiti ngrāyena, śṛṅgagrāhikayā(pratipadoktasvarūpeṇa)vā ghaṭapadaṃ ghaṭārthaṃ bodhayatu, paṭapadaṃ pararūpamarthaṃ bodhayatu, ityādiviśeṣavākyānāṃ(prātisvikavākyānāṃ)paricāyakam|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ idam padam amum artham bodhayatu iti evam artha nirūpita pada śakti bodhakam idam sāmānya vacanam nirviseṣam na sāmānyam iti śṛṅga grāhikayā pratipada ukta svarūpeṇa vā ghaṭa padam ghaṭa artham bodhayatu paṭa padam para rūpam artham bodhayatu iti ādi viśeṣa vākyānām prātisvika vākyānām paricāyakam

original: tathā ca ghaṭapadajanyabodhaviṣayatvaprakāratānirūpitaghaṭarūpārthaniṣṭhaviseṣyatākecchā śaktirityevaṃ padaviśeṣārthaviśeṣaghaṭitā śaktiriti vaktavyamiti gagarīśabdajanyabodhaviṣayatvaprakārikā ghaṭaviśeṣyikecchaiva śaktiḥ prakṛtasthale vācyā, sā cedyadyasti, na tarhi śaktibhramaḥ, yadi nāsti tarhi sutarāṃ na śaktibhramaḥ sidhyati|
analyzed: tathā ca ghaṭa pada janya bodha viṣaya tva prakāratā nirūpita ghaṭa rūpa artha niṣṭha viseṣya tāka icchā śaktiḥ iti evam pada viśeṣa artha viśeṣa ghaṭitā śaktiḥ iti vaktavyam iti gagarī śabda janya bodha viṣaya tva prakārikā ghaṭa viśeṣyikā icchā eva śaktiḥ prakṛta sthale vācyā sā ced yadi asti na tarhi śakti bhramaḥ yadi na asti tarhi sutarām na śakti bhramaḥ sidhyati

original: kvacitprasiddhasya svavirahiṇi jñānasyaiva bhramatvāt| yathā satyarajate prasiddhasya rajatatvasya rajatatvavirahiṇyāṃ śuktau yadrajatatvaprakārakaṃ jñānaṃ tasyaiva bhramaśabdavyavahāryatvāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kvacid prasiddhasya sva virahiṇi jñānasya eva bhrama tvāt yathā satya rajate prasiddhasya rajata tvasya rajata tva virahiṇyām śuktau yat rajata tva prakārakam jñānam tasya eva bhrama śabda vyavahārya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadyapi idaṃ padamamumarthaṃ bodhayatvityādisāmānyamukhapravṛttaśaktyāvedakavacanānusāreṇa sāmānyarūpeṇa padapadārthaghaṭitāyāḥ śakteḥ paṭapadaṃ ghaṭe śaktaṃ, ghaṭapadaṃ vāpaṭe saktamityevaṃ bhramatvaṃ saṃbhavet|
analyzed: yadi api idam padam amum artham bodhayatu ityādi sāmānya mukha pravṛtta śakti āvedaka vacana anusāreṇa sāmānya rūpeṇa pada padārtha ghaṭitāyāḥ śakteḥ paṭa padam ghaṭe śaktam ghaṭa padam vā a paṭe saktam iti evam bhrama tvam saṃbhavet

original: tathā'pi śṛṅgagrāhikayā ghaṭapadaṃ ghaṭe śaktaṃ, paṭapadaṃ ca paṭe śaktamityevaṃ prātipadikarūpeṇa śaktyāvedakavacanānusāreṇa padapadārthaviśeṣaghaṭitāyāḥ śaktebhramatvaṃ sutarāṃ durvacamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā api śṛṅga grāhikayā ghaṭa padam ghaṭe śaktam paṭa padam ca paṭe śaktam iti evam prātipadika rūpeṇa śakti āvedaka vacana anusāreṇa pada padārtha viśeṣa ghaṭitāyāḥ śakteḥ bhrama tvam sutarām durvacam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yacca pūrvamasminneva prakaraṇe `śaktibhramānurodhena' iti granthena śaktibhrama uktaḥ sa ca `idaṃ padamamumarthaṃ bodhayatu' ityevaṃ sāmānyarūpeṇa śaktyāvedakavacanānusāreṇa yojyaḥ, tadānīmeva śaktibhramasaṃbhavāt| na tu ghaṭapadaṃ ghaṭe śaktamityevaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa śaktyāvedakavacanānusāreṇa, tadānīṃ śaktibhramasaṃbhavasyāpyabhāvādeti| bodhyam|
analyzed: yat ca pūrvam asmin eva prakaraṇe śakti bhrama anurodhena iti granthena śakti bhramaḥ uktaḥ sa ca idam padam amum artham bodhayatu iti evam sāmānya rūpeṇa śakti āvedaka vacana anusāreṇa yojyaḥ tadānīm eva śakti bhrama saṃbhavāt na tu ghaṭa padam ghaṭe śaktam iti evam viśeṣa rūpeṇa śakti āvedaka vacana anusāreṇa tadānīm śakti bhrama saṃbhavasya api abhāvāt eti bodhyam

original: apabhraśānāṃ sākṣādvācakatvamiti vaiyākaraṇasaṃmatapakṣe'pi vākyapadīyānumatimāha-uktaṃ ceti| apabhraṃśarūpabhāṣāśabdā api śaktāḥ-nāma sākṣādvācakā eva, na tu sādhṛsmaraṇadvāretyuktamityarthaḥ| viguṇeṣviti|
analyzed: apabhraśānām sākṣāt vācaka tvam iti vaiyākaraṇa saṃmata pakṣe pi vākyapadīya anumatim āha uktam ca iti apabhraṃśa rūpa bhāṣā śabdāḥ api sākṣāt vācakāḥ eva na tu sādhṛ smaraṇa dvārā iti uktam iti arthaḥ viguṇeṣu iti

original: nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇā buddhirviśeṣya upajāyata iti nyāyena puruḥsphūrtimad‌vaktṛniṣṭhaṃ vaiguṇyamatrendriyāsāmarthyaṃ nāma jihavājāḍyādirūpaṃ bodhyam|
analyzed: na agṛhīta viśeṣaṇā buddhiḥ viśeṣye upajāyate iti nyāyena puruḥ sphūrtimat vaktṛ niṣṭham vaiguṇyam atra indriya asāmarthyam nāma jihava ajāḍya ādi rūpam bodhyam

original: tathā coccārayitṛjih‌vājāḍyādidoṣavaśādapabhraṃśā niṣpadyante iti abhidhātṛṣu-trayoktṛṣu viguṇeṣu-jih‌vājāḍyādidoṣayukteṣu satsu, pāramparyāt-paramparaiva pāramparyaṃ, caturvarṇāditvātsvārthe pyañ, paramparayā-vṛddhavyavahāraparamparayā yeṣvartheṣu, prasiddhiṃ-khyātimāgatāḥ-prāptāḥ, teṣāṃ-apabhraṃśānāṃ, sādhuḥ-śabdaḥ, avācakaḥ-abodhaka ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca uccārayitṛ jihvā jāḍya ādi doṣa vaśāt apabhraṃśāḥ niṣpadyante iti abhidhātṛ ṣu trayoktṛṣu viguṇeṣu jihvā jāḍya ādi doṣa yukteṣu satsu pāramparyāt paramparā eva pāramparyam catur varṇa ādi tvāt svārthe paramparayā vṛddha vyavahāra paramparayā yeṣu artheṣu prasiddhim khyātim āgatāḥ prāptāḥ teṣām apabhraṃśānām sādhuḥ śabdaḥ avācakaḥ abodhakaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sādhuravācaka ityayuktaṃ, yato yasminnarthe apabhraṃśāḥ prayujyate tadarthavācakatvaṃ sādhūnāmapīti sarvasaṃmatatvāt ityata evaṃ vyākhyeyam-apabhraṃśānāṃ prakṛtibhūtaḥ sādhurvyavahito na tatra bodhakaḥ, kiṃtu apabhraṃśānāṃ sādhuprakṛtikatvātkiṃcidvarmavyatyāse'pi ta eva ime iti pratyabhijñayā sādhutādātmyāpannāstattadānupūrvyavacchinnā
analyzed: nanu sādhuḥ avācakaḥ iti ayuktam yatas yasmin arthe apabhraṃśāḥ prayujyate tad artha vācaka tvam sādhūnām api iti sarva saṃmata tvāt iti atas evam vyākhyeyam apabhraṃśānām prakṛti bhūtaḥ sādhuḥ vyavahitaḥ na tatra bodhakaḥ kiṃtu apabhraṃśānām sādhu prakṛtika tvāt kiṃcid varma vyatyāse pi te eva ime iti pratyabhijñayā sādhu tādātmya āpannāḥ tad tad ānupūrvī avacchinnāḥ

original: asādhavaeva sākṣādācakā iti| daivī vāgiti| saṃskṛtabhāṣāmayī devānāṃ vāgityarthaḥ| aśakteriti| saṃskṛtaśabdoccāraṇāsamarthairjih‌vājāḍyādidoṣavaśādityarthaḥ| abhidhātṛbhiḥ-vaktṛbhiḥ, vyavakīrṇā-ucchinnānupūrvīkā kṛteti śeṣaḥ| anityatvadarśināmiti| sarve śabdā anityāḥ, sphoṭastu nāstyeveti vādināṃ naiyāyikānāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: asādhavaḥ eva iti daivī vāc iti saṃskṛta bhāṣā mayī devānām vāc iti arthaḥ aśakteḥ iti saṃskṛta śabda uccāraṇa asamarthaiḥ jihvā jāḍya ādi doṣa vaśāt iti arthaḥ abhidhātṛbhiḥ vaktṛbhiḥ vyavakīrṇā aucchinna ānupūrvīkā kṛtā iti śeṣaḥ anitya tva darśinām iti sarve śabdāḥ anityāḥ sphoṭaḥ tu na asti eva iti vādinām naiyāyikānām iti arthaḥ

original: asnin vādai-śaktivicārākhye, vuddhiviparyayaḥ-sādhava eva vāttakāḥ, na tvapabhraṃśā ityevaṃ viparyayo vaiparītyaṃ saṃjātamityarthaḥ| ayaṃ sārārthaḥ-apabhraṃśarūpā vāk,vaktṝṇāṃ vāgindriyādidoṣavaśāducchinnānupūrvīkā'pi viśiṣṭaṃ śuddhānnātaricyate, ekadeśavikṛtamananyavadityādinyāyānusaṃdhānena kiṃcidvarṇavyatyāse'pi daivī-saṃskṛtarūpaiva bhavati|
analyzed: vuddhi viparyayaḥ sādhavaḥ eva vāttakāḥ na tu apabhraṃśāḥ iti evam viparyayaḥ vaiparītyam saṃjātam iti arthaḥ ayam sāra arthaḥ apabhraṃśa rūpā vāc vaktṝṇām vāc indriya ādi doṣa vaśāt ucchinna ānupūrvīkā api viśiṣṭam śuddhāt na ataricyate eka deśa vikṛtam ananya vat ityādi nyāya anusaṃdhānena kiṃcid varṇa vyatyāse pi daivī saṃskṛta rūpā eva bhavati

original: tataścāpabhraṃśānāṃ saṃskṛtaprakṛtikatvātseyamiti pratyabhijñayā prakṛtivikṛtyostādātmyenābhedāt| apabhraṃśānāmeva sākṣādvācakatvasaṃbhave sati saṃskṛtāpabhraṃśayaurbhedaṃ pariklpya tatra saṃskṛtaiva vācikā, nābhraṃśarūpā vāgityevaṃ naiyāyikānāṃ ityuktaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tatas ca apabhraṃśānām saṃskṛta prakṛtika tvāt sā iyam iti pratyabhijñayā prakṛti vikṛtyoḥ tādātmyena abhedāt apabhraṃśānām eva sākṣāt vācaka tva saṃbhave sati saṃskṛta apabhraṃśa yauḥ bhedam pariklpya tatra saṃskṛtā eva vācikā na abhraṃśa rūpā vāc iti evam naiyāyikānām iti uktam bhavati

original: atha saṃskṛtā eva vācakāḥ, nāpabhraṃśā ityatra pramāṇābhāvenāpabhraṃśātmakabhāṣāśabdā api vācakā evetyāśayenā''ha--kiṃ ceti| vinigamanāvirahāditi| anyatarakoṭiniścāyakapramāṇābhāvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: atha saṃskṛtāḥ eva vācakāḥ na apabhraṃśāḥ iti atra pramāṇa abhāvena apabhraṃśa ātmaka bhāṣā śabdāḥ api vācakāḥ eva iti āśayena āha kim ca iti vinigamana avirahāt iti anyatara koṭi niścāyaka pramāṇa abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: yathā saṃskṛtā vāk himālayamārabhya rāmeśvaraparyantaṃ sarvadeśeṣu ekarūpā bhavati, yathā gaurityayaṃ saṃskṛtaḥ śabdaḥ mahārāṣṭradeśe prayujyate, tathā saurāṣṭramāgavādideśeṣvapi tādṛśānupūrvīka eva tādṛśārtha eva ca prayujyate saṃskṛtābhijñaiḥ, tathā'pabhraṃśarūpā gagarītyādirvāgapi, sarvadeśeṣu samānarūpatvābhāve'pi tattaddeśe
analyzed: yathā saṃskṛtā vāc himālayam ārabhya rāmeśvara paryantam sarva deśeṣu eka rūpā bhavati yathā gauḥ iti ayam saṃskṛtaḥ śabdaḥ mahārāṣṭra deśe prayujyate tathā saurāṣṭra māgava ādi deśeṣu api tādṛśa ānupūrvīkaḥ eva tādṛśa arthaḥ eva ca prayujyate saṃskṛta abhijñaiḥ tathā apabhraṃśa rūpā gagarī ityādiḥ vāc api sarva deśeṣu samāna rūpatva abhāve pi tad tad deśe

original: ekarūpaiva-samānarūpaiva bhavati, yathā mahārāṣṭrasaṃcārayogyadeśeṣu sarvatra gagarīśabdo `ghāgara' ityarthe prayujyamāno dṛśyate| yadyapi ārthasaṃcārānarhayāvanādideśeṣu gagarīśabdo na dṛśyate tathāpi yāvanādivyatiriktasarvadeśeṣu dṛśyata iti apabhraṃśarūpā vāgapi sarvadeśe ekarūpaivā''ste|
analyzed: eka rūpā eva samāna rūpā eva bhavati yathā mahārāṣṭra saṃcāra yogya deśeṣu sarvatra gagarī śabdaḥ ghāgaraḥ iti arthe prayujyamānaḥ dṛśyate yadi api ārtha saṃcāra anarha yāvana ādi deśeṣu gagarī śabdaḥ na dṛśyate tathā api yāvana ādi vyatirikta sarva deśeṣu dṛśyate iti apabhraṃśa rūpā vāc api sarva deśe eka rūpā eva āste

original: evaṃ ca sarvadeśetyatratyasarvaśabdo vivakṣitasarvadeśaparaḥ, na tu sākalyena(anavacchedena)sarvadeśaparaḥ| tathā sati yavanahūṇādimayadeśe saṃskṛtavāco'pyasattvena tasyā api anavacchinnasarvadeśeṣu ekarūpatānāpatteḥ|
analyzed: evam ca sarva deśa iti atratya sarva śabdaḥ vivakṣita sarva deśa paraḥ na tu sākalyena anavacchedena sarva deśa paraḥ tathā sati yavana hūṇa ādi maya deśe saṃskṛta vācopya sattvena tasyāḥ api anavacchinna sarva deśeṣu eka rūpatā anāpatteḥ

original: tataśca saṃskṛtāpabhraṃśarūpayordvayorapi vācorbahuṣu deśeṣu ekarūpatvāviśeṣāttatra saṃskṛtaiva vācikā, nāpabhraṃśarūpā vāgityatraikatarapakṣaniścāyakapramāṇābhāva iti bhāvaḥ| bhāṣāyāmapīti| apabhraṃśarūpāyāmapītyarthaḥ| śaktiriti| saṃskṛteṣvivāpabhraṃśeṣvapi vācyavācakabāvāparaparyāyā śaktiravaśyamāstheyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatas ca saṃskṛta apabhraṃśa rūpayoḥ dvayoḥ api vācoḥ bahuṣu deśeṣu eka rūpa tva aviśeṣāt tatra saṃskṛtā eva vācikā na apabhraṃśa rūpā vāc iti atra ekatara pakṣa niścāyaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhāṣāyām api iti apabhraṃśa rūpāyām api iti arthaḥ śaktiḥ iti saṃskṛteṣu iva apabhraṃśeṣu api vācya vācaka bāva apara paryāyā śaktiḥ avaśyam āstheyā iti arthaḥ

original: bhāṣāṇāṃ deśabhedena bhinnatvena nānārūpatvāttatra śaktikalpanaṃ gauravāpādakatvānna yuktamityāśayena śaṅkate-na ceti| tāsāṃ-bhāṣāṇām| doṣa iti| bhāṣāṇāṃ nānātvameva doṣaḥ-bhāṣāsu śaktikalpane pratibandhakamityarthaḥ| gauravānnānārūpāsu bhāṣāsu na śaktiḥ kalpyata iti bhāvaḥ| tadetanna yuktamityāha-saṃskṛtavadityādinā tādavasthyādityantena|
analyzed: bhāṣāṇām deśa bhedena bhinna tvena nānā rūpa tvāt tatra śakti kalpanam gaurava āpādaka tvāt na yuktam iti āśayena śaṅkatena ca iti tāsām bhāṣāṇām doṣaḥ iti bhāṣāṇām nānātvam eva doṣaḥ bhāṣāsu śakti kalpane pratibandhakam iti arthaḥ gauravāt nānā rūpāsu bhāṣāsu na śaktiḥ kalpyate iti bhāvaḥ tat etat na yuktam iti āha saṃskṛta vat ityādinā tādavasthyāt iti antena

original: saṃskṛtavaditi| yathā gaurityādiḥ saṃskṛtā vāk, saṃcārayogyeṣu mahārāṣṭādisarvadeśeṣu ekarūpaivāsti| yāvanādideśeṣu saṃskṛtavācaḥ sarvathā'sattvātsaṃcārayogyasarvadeśeṣviti sarvaśabdārthasaṃkocasyā''vaśyakatvena vivakṣitasarvadeśeṣu saṃskṛtā vāgyathaikarūpā vartate tathā'pabhraṃśarūpā vāgapi vivakṣitottarahindustānadeśe ekarūpaiva bhavati|
analyzed: saṃskṛta vat iti yathā gauḥ ityādiḥ saṃskṛtā vāc saṃcāra yogyeṣu mahārāṣṭa ādi sarva deśeṣu eka rūpā eva asti yāvan ādi deśeṣu saṃskṛta vācaḥ sarvathā sattvāt saṃcāra yogya sarva deśeṣu iti sarva śabda artha saṃkocasya āvaśyaka tvena vivakṣita sarva deśeṣu saṃskṛtā vāc yathā eka rūpā vartate tathā apabhraṃśa rūpā vāc api vivakṣita uttara hindu stāna deśe eka rūpā eva bhavati

original: yata uttarahindusthānadeśeṣu ghaṭī yarthe gagarī śabda evāpabhraṃśaḥ, na tu `ghāgara' ityādikaḥ| tathā mahārāṣṭadeśe puṃstvaviśiṣṭaghaṭārthe `ghaḍā' ityapabhraṃśaḥ, ghaṭītyarthe `ghāgara' ityapabhraṃśaḥ, kalaśītyarthe `kalaśī' ityapabhraṃśaḥ, na tu tatra gagarītyapabhraṃśaḥ|
analyzed: yatas uttara hindu sthāna deśeṣu ghaṭī yarthe gagarī śabdaḥ eva apabhraṃśaḥ na tu ghāgaraḥ iti ādikaḥ tathā mahārāṣṭa deśe puṃstva viśiṣṭa ghaṭa arthe ghaḍāḥ iti apabhraṃśaḥ ghaṭī iti arthe ghāgaraḥ iti apabhraṃśaḥ kalaśī iti arthe kalaśī iti apabhraṃśaḥ na tu tatra gagarī iti apabhraṃśaḥ

original: tataśca saṃskṛtavāgyathā vivakṣitasarvadeśe ekarūpā, tathā pratyekamapabhraṃśarūpā vāgapi vivakṣitatattadeśe ekarūpaivetyevaṃ sthitau satyāṃ saṃskṛtaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ, nāpabhraṃśaḥ śabda ityarthe vinigamanāvirahastadavastha eveti bhāvaḥ| sarvatraikatveneti|

original: mahārāṣṭrasaṃcārayogyeṣvekarūpatvenetyarthaḥ apabhraṃśānāṃ vācakatve śādhakāntaramāha-kiṃceti| avacchediketi| śaktaṃ padaṃ, pade śaktatā, śaktatā nāma arthabodhajanakatā, tasyā avacchedikā, ghaṭādipadaniṣṭhā ghakārottaravartyakārottaravartiṭakārottaravartyakāra ityevaṃ varṇānupūrvī arthabodhajanakata vacchediketyarthaḥ|
analyzed: mahārāṣṭra saṃcāra yogyeṣu eka rūpa tvena iti arthaḥ apabhraṃśānām vācaka tve śādhaka antaram āha kiṃca iti avacchedikā iti śaktam padam pade śakta tā śakta tā nāma artha bodha janaka tā tasyāḥ avacchedikā ghaṭa ādi pada niṣṭhā ghakāra uttara varti akāra uttara varti ṭakāra uttara varti akāraḥ iti evam varṇa ānupūrvī artha bodha janaka tā iti arthaḥ

original: sā ca ghaṭaḥ kumbhaḥ kalaśa ityādiparyāyeṣu yatā bhinnā bhinnā vartate tathā ghāgaragagarītyādyapabhraṃśeṣvapi śaktatāvacchedikā varṇānupūrvī bhinnā bhinnā vartata iti sādhvarabhraṃśayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ|

original: viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ityādinānāparyāyaniṣṭhā nānānupūrvyo yathā śaktatāvacchedikā aṅgīkriyante, tathā'pabhraṃśaniṣṭhā api tāḥ śaktatāvacchedakatvena svīkriyantāmaviśeṣāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca yathā saṃskṛtaśabdā arthaviśeṣasya sākṣādvācakāstathā'pabhraṃśaśabdā api sākṣādeva vācakāḥ, na tatra vaiṣamyaṃ kartuṃ yujyata iti tātparyam|
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ ityādi nānā paryāya niṣṭhāḥ nānā ānupūrvyaḥ yathā śakta tā avacchedikāḥ aṅgīkriyante tathā apabhraṃśa niṣṭhāḥ api tāḥ śakta tā avacchedaka tvena svīkriyantām aviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ evam ca yathā saṃskṛta śabdāḥ artha viśeṣasya sākṣāt vācakāḥ tathā apabhraṃśa śabdāḥ api sākṣāt eva vācakāḥ na tatra vaiṣamyam kartum yujyate iti tātparyam

original: etadāśayenopasaṃharati-tathā ca saṃskṛtavadityādi| nanu yadi saṃskṛtavad bhāṣāśabdā api śaktāścettarhi āpaḥ strī bhūmni vārvāri salilaṃ kamalaṃ jalamitivad gagarīgāvītyādayo bhāṣāśabdā api saṃskṛtaparyāyatvena kośādau parigaṇanīyāḥ syurityāśaṅkate-na ca paryāyatayeti| apabhraṃśānāṃ kośādāvaparigaṇane kāraṇayāha-sādhūnāmeveti|
analyzed: etad āśayena upasaṃharati tathā ca saṃskṛta vat ityādi nanu yadi saṃskṛta vat bhāṣā śabdāḥ api śaktāḥ ced tarhi āpaḥ strī bhūmni vār vāri salilam kamalam jalam itivat gagarī gāvi ityādayaḥ bhāṣā śabdāḥ api saṃskṛta paryāya tvena kośa ādau parigaṇanīyāḥ syuḥ iti āśaṅkatena ca paryāyatayā iti apabhraṃśānām kośa ādau aparigaṇane kāraṇayā āha sādhūnām eva iti

original: evakāreṇāsādhūnāṃ=apabhraṃśānāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ| sādhutvagharmaviśiṣṭānāṃ śabdānāṃ kośādau parigaṇanaṃ, na tu vācakatādharmaviśiṣṭamātrasyetyarthaḥ| vibhāgābhidhānāditi| indro marutvān maghavā biḍaujāḥ pākasāsanaḥ, ityevaṃrītyā vibhāgena tratipādanādityarthaḥ|

original: tathā cāsaḥ śiva ityādau nañarthābāvasya viśeṣyatve tadāderupasarjananvena sarvādibahirbhāvena sarvanāmatvābhāvādeva sulopāprāptyā'nañsamāsagrahaṇaṃ vyarthaṃ satpūrvoktārtha jñāpamiti bhāvaḥ kiṃ caitattacchabdamātragrahaṇe'pi atitadityādāvivopasarjane'tvābhāvena halṅ‌yādilopasya durvāratathā'nañsamāsagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyamityapi bodhyam|

original: jñāpakamiti| nañsamāsasya pūrvapadārthaprādhānye'pi uttarapadārthaprādhānyaprayuktakāryapravṛttau jñāpakamityarthaḥ| tenātvaṃ bhavasi, ayuvāṃ bhavathaḥ, ityādau puruṣavacanavyavasthā'pi sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ| viśeṣyānurodhāditi|

original: vyutpattivirodha iti| usrerityatra tṛtīyāpratyayasya svaprakṛtibhūtosrapadārthānvitakaraṇabodhakatvaṃ pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthetyādiniyamānna ghaṭata ityarthaḥ| tadeva viśadayati-tathā hīti| na cosro'tra karaṇamiti| asrairiti karaṇe tṛtīyā kṛtā, kiṃ tu atra-udagdeśīyarājoddharaṇakriyāyāṃ, usrapadārthaḥ karaṇaṃ na bhavati|
analyzed: vyutpatti virodhaḥ iti usreḥ iti atra tṛtīyā pratyayasya sva prakṛti bhūta usra padārtha anvita karaṇa bodhaka tvam pratyayānām prakṛti artha ityādi niyamāt na ghaṭate iti arthaḥ tat eva viśadayati tathā hi iti na karaṇam iti asraiḥ iti karaṇe tṛtīyā kṛtā kim tu atra audagdeśīya rāja uddharaṇa kriyāyām usra padārthaḥ karaṇam na bhavati

original: usrapadārthasyevārthe sadṛśe'nvayana karaṇībhūtaśaraviśeṣaṇatvābhāvāt| api tu ivavācyaḥ sadṛśo'rthaḥ karaṇam| taducyate-ivārthasadṛśasya karaṇatve'pīti|
analyzed: usra padārthasya iva arthe karaṇībhūta śara viśeṣaṇa tva abhāvāt api tu iva vācyaḥ sadṛśaḥ ṛthaḥ karaṇam tat ucyate iva artha sadṛśasya karaṇa tve pi iti

original: usrasadṛśasyābhedena śaraviśeyaṇatayā uddharaṇakriyānirūpitakaraṇatvasaṃbhave'pītyarthaḥ tasya-sadṛśasya, karaṇatvaṃ sadṛśārthagatakaraṇatvamityarthaḥ anena usnapadottaravartitṛtīyāpratyayena, bodhayituṃ na śakyamityanvayaḥ| tatra hetamāha-aprakṛtyarthatvāditi| ivārthasadṛśasya tṛtīyāprakṛtibhūtosrapadārthatvābhāvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: usra sadṛśasya abhedena śara viśeyaṇatayā uddharaṇa kriyā nirūpita karaṇatva saṃbhave pi iti arthaḥ tasya sadṛśasya karaṇa tvam sadṛśa artha gata karaṇatvam iti arthaḥ anena usna pada uttara varti tṛtīyā pratyayena bodhayitum na śakyam iti anvayaḥ tatra hetum āha aprakṛti artha tvāt iti iva artha sadṛśasya tṛtīyā prakṛti bhūta usra padārtha tva abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: tathā cevārthe sadṛśe usrapadottaravartitṛtīyayā karaṇatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ na śakyate, pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthetyādiniyamāditi bhāvaḥ| ivārthasadṛśasyābhedena karaṇībhūtaśaraviśeṣaṇatayā karaṇatvasaṃbhavādivaśabdāttṛtīyā'stvityāśaṅkyā''ha-ivaśabdasyeti| asattavārthakatayeti| sattvaṃ dravyaṃ, tacca liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānvayi|
analyzed: tathā ca iva arthe sadṛśe usra pada uttara varti tṛtīyayā karaṇa tvam pratipādayitum na śakyate pratyayānām prakṛti artha ityādi niyamāt iti bhāvaḥ iva artha sadṛśasya abhedena karaṇībhūta śara viśeṣaṇa tayā karaṇa tva saṃbhavāt iva śabdāt tṛtīyā astu iti āśaṅkya āha eva śabdasya iti asattava arthaka tayā iti sattvam dravyam tat ca liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka anvayi

original: tadbhinnamasattvamadravyam| adravyaṃ ca liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānanvayi| tathā ca liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānanvayyarthakatayetyarthaḥ| `cādayo'sattve' ityanenādravyārthakacādīnāṃ nipātasaṃjñāyā vihitatvānnipātānāṃ liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānanvayitvarūpāsattvārthakatvamiti bhāvaḥ| tṛtīyāyā asaṃbhavāditi|
analyzed: tad bhinnam asattvam adravyam adravyam ca liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka ananvayi tathā ca liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka ananvayi arthakatayā iti arthaḥ ca ādayoḥ sattve iti anena adravya arthaka ca ādīnām nipāta saṃjñāyāḥ vihita tvāt nipātānām liṅga saṃkhyā kāraka ananvayi tva rūpa asattva arthaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ tṛtīyāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt iti

original: kārakānanvayitvenopasthite sadṛśarūpe ivārthe kārakānvayāsaṃbhavenevaśabdātkaraṇatvārthakatṛtīyāyā asaṃbhavādityarthaḥ| tataścevaśabdāttṛtīyāyā abhāvena sadṛśasya karaṇatvaṃ na labhyeta ustrapadārthasya karaṇatvābhāvādustrapadottaratṛtīyāyā anarthakatvamasādhutvaṃ ca syādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: kāraka ananvayi tvena upasthite sadṛśa rūpe iva arthe kāraka anvaya asaṃbhavena ivaśabdāt karaṇa tva arthaka tṛtīyāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ tatas ca ivaśabdāt tṛtīyāyāḥ abhāvena sadṛśasya karaṇa tvam na labhyeta ustra pada arthasya karaṇa tva abhāvāt ustra pada uttara tṛtīyāyāḥ anarthaka tvam asādhu tvam ca syāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu avyayādāp‌supaḥ, ityatra supa iti pratyāhāragrahaṇasāmartyādavyayātsarvavibhaktiprāpteḥ sūcitatvādivaśabdasya sadṛśadharmyarthakatve sattvārthakatayā tata utpannāyāstṛtīyāyā luki sati ivārthasadṛśasya karaṇatvaṃ budhyetetyāśaṅkyā''ha-saṃbhave veti| śravaṇaprasaṅgāditi|
analyzed: nanu avyayāt āp supaḥ iti atra supaḥ iti pratyāhāra grahaṇa sāmartyāt avyayāt sarva vibhakti prāpteḥ sūcita tvāt iva śabdasya sadṛśa dharmi arthaka tve sattva arthaka tayā tatas utpannāyāḥ tṛtīyāyāḥ sati iva artha sadṛśasya karaṇa tvam budhyeta iti āśaṅkya āha saṃbhave vā iti śravaṇa prasaṅgāt iti

original: ivaśabdārthasya sadṛśasya karaṇakārakatvenoddharaṇakriyāyāmanvaye sati tādṛśevaśabdasya kārakānanvayitvarūpāsattvārthakatāyā vaktumaśakyatvenāsattvārthakatāmupajīvya vihitāyā nipātasaṃjñāyā apavṛttau `avyayādāp‌supaḥ' ityasyāpravṛttyā lugabhāvenevaśabdottaravartitṛtīyāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ prasajyetetyarthaḥ| vāśabdo'nāsthāyām|
analyzed: iva śabda arthasya sadṛśasya karaṇa kāraka tvena uddharaṇa kriyāyām anvaye sati tādṛśa iva śabdasya kāraka ananvayi tva rūpa asattva arthaka tāyāḥ vaktum aśakya tvena asattva arthaka tām upajīvya vihitāyāḥ nipāta saṃjñāyāḥ apavṛttau avyayāt āpsupaḥ iti asya apravṛttyā luk abhāvena iva śabda uttara varti tṛtīyāyāḥ śravaṇam prasajyeta iti arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ ūna āsthāyām

original: asattvārthakevaśabdātkaraṇatṛtīyotpattyanupapattiṃ sūcayati| śabdaśaktisvābāvyādivaśabdopasthāpyasya sadṛśasyāpyasattvarūpatvameva dhātūpasthāpyavyāpārasyeveti bhāvaḥ| `avyayādāpsupaḥ' iti lugvidhānasāmarthyājjāyamānāyāstṛtīyavibhakteranarthakatvena tayā sadṛśagatakaraṇatvapradarśanasya durvacatvaṃ ca| dūṣaṇāntaramāha-ananvayaprasaṅgācceti|
analyzed: asattva arthaka iva śabdāt karaṇa tṛtīya utpatti anupapattim sūcayati śabda śakti svābāvyāt iva śabda upasthāpyasya sadṛśasya api asattva rūpatvam eva dhātu upasthāpya vyāpārasya iva iti bhāvaḥ avyayāt āpsupaḥ iti luk vidhāna sāmarthyāt jāyamānāyāḥ tṛtīyavibhakteḥ anarthaka tvena tayā sadṛśa gata karaṇatva pradarśanasya durvacatvam ca dūṣaṇa antaram āha ananvaya prasaṅgāt ca iti

original: ustrapadārthasyoddharaṇakriyānirūpitakaraṇatvābhāvena tatra tṛtīyārthakaraṇasyānanvayaprasajya ityarthaḥ| supāṃ ca śravaṇamityatra cakāro bhinnakrama ityāha-supāṃ śravaṇaṃ ceti| nanvivaśabdasya sattvārthakatve'pi svarādipāṭhādavyayatvena supaḥ śravaṇaprasaṅgo netyato mūle caśabda upāttastatsaṃgrāhyaṃ darśayati-cakāradusrapadottaretyādi|
analyzed: ustra padārthasya uddharaṇa kriyā nirūpita karaṇa tva abhāvena tatra tṛtīyārtha karaṇasya ananvaya prasajyaḥ iti arthaḥ supām ca śravaṇam iti atra cakāraḥ bhinnakramaḥ iti āha supām śravaṇam ca iti nanu iva śabdasya sattva arthaka tve api svara ādi pāṭhāt avyaya tvena supaḥ śravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ na iti atas mūle caśabdaḥ upāttaḥ tat saṃgrāhyam darśayati cakāra dusra pada uttara ityādi

original: samuccīyata iti| tṛtīyānanvayaḥ saṃgṛhyata ityarthaḥ ityādāviḥ tyādipadasaṃgrāhyaṃ darśayati-vāgarthāvivetyādi| vandikarmatvābhāvāditi| vāgarthayorivārthena sahānvayātsaṃpṛktāvityatrānvayābhāvena tayorvandanakriyānirūpitakatmavābhāvāttatra taduttarakarmadvitīyāyā anvayo na syāt|
analyzed: samuccīyate iti tṛtīyā ananvayaḥ saṃgṛhyate iti arthaḥ ityādau iḥ tyādi pada saṃgrāhyam darśayati vāc arthau iva ityādi vandi karma tva abhāvāt iti vāc arthayoḥ iva arthena saha anvayāt saṃpṛktau iti atra anvaya abhāvena tayoḥ vandana kriyā nirūpita katma vā abhāvāt tatra tad uttara karma dvitīyāyāḥ anvayaḥ na syāt

original: vandikriyānirūpitakarmaṇā saha vāgarthayorabhedenānvayābhāvenāpi karmatvasya bādhitatvāt| ivārthasadṛśasya pārvatīparameśvararūpakarmaṇā sahābhedānvayena karmatve'pi vāgarthapadottaravartidvitīyāyāḥ-ivārthe yaḥ karmatvānvayastadbodhakatvasyāsaṃbhava eva, ivārthasya dvitīyāprakṛtibhūtavāgarthapadārthatvābhāvāt|
analyzed: vandi kriyā nirūpita karmaṇā saha vāc arthayoḥ abhedena anvaya abhāvena api karmatvasya bādhita tvāt ivārtha sadṛśasya pārvatī parameśvara rūpa karmaṇā saha abheda anvayena karmatve pi vāc artha pada uttara varti dvitīyāyāḥ ivārthe yaḥ karmatva anvayaḥ tad bodhaka tvasya asaṃbhavaḥ eva ivārthasya dvitīyā prakṛti bhūta vāc artha padārtha tva abhāvāt

original: ivārthasya dvitīyāprakṛtyarthatvābhāvātpratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvaniyamāditi yāvat| saṃgṛhya iti| vāgarthapadārthena saha taduttaradvitīyāyā ananvayaḥ, tādṛśadvitīyāyāścevārthagatakarmatvabodhakatvāsaṃbhavaśca saṃgṛhyata ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: iva arthasya dvitīyā prakṛti artha tva abhāvāt pratyayānām prakṛti artha anvita sva artha bodhaka tva niyamāt iti yāvat saṃgṛhya iti vāc artha padārthena saha tad uttara dvitīyāyāḥ ananvayaḥ tādṛśa dvitīyāyāḥ ca iva artha gata karmatva bodhaka tva asaṃbhavaḥ ca saṃgṛhyate iti arthaḥ

original: asmanmate tu vāgarthapadasyaiva vāgarthasadṛśaparatayā ivaśabdasya tad‌dyotakatvena ca vāgarthasadṛśayorabhedena pārvatīparameśvaraviśeṣaṇatayā vandikriyā| nirūpitaṃ karmatvaṃ susaṃgatam|
analyzed: asmad mate tu vāc artha padasya eva vāc artha sadṛśa para tayā iva śabdasya tad dyotaka tvena ca vāc artha sadṛśayoḥ abhedena pārvatī parameśvara viśeṣaṇa tayā vandi kriyāḥ nirūpitam karmatvam su saṃgatam

original: tathā usrairityatrostrapadasyaivosrasadṛśārthakatvādusrasadṛśasyābhedena śaraviśeṣaṇatayoddharaṇakriyānirūpitakaraṇatvānna tṛtīyānupapattiḥ nipātānāṃ vācakatve, sadṛśa ivaśabdārthaḥ| usrā upamānaṃ, śarā upameyamupamānasya viśeṣaṇatayā, upameyasya ca viśeṣyatayā pratītiriti sthitiḥ|
analyzed: tathā usraiḥ iti atra ustra padasya eva usra sadṛśa arthaka tvāt usra sadṛśasya abhedena śara viśeṣaṇatayā uddharaṇa kriyā nirūpita karaṇatvāt na tṛtīyā anupapattiḥ nipātānām vācaka tve sadṛśaḥ iva śabda arthaḥ usrāḥ upamānam śarāḥ upameyam upamānasya viśeṣaṇa tayā upameyasya ca viśeṣya tayā pratītiḥ iti sthitiḥ

original: tatropameyaśarāṇāmuddharaṇakriyāyāṃ karaṇatvāttatra karaṇakārakavācinī tṛtīyā| upamānaṇttu `vibhaktiḥ punarekaiva upamānopameyayoḥ' iti niyamādupameyottaravibhaktisajātīyavibhakterevocitatvāttṛtīyaiva, sā cābhedārthiketyāśayenā''ha-viśeṣaṇavibhaktirabhedārtheti|
analyzed: tatra upameya śarāṇām uddharaṇa kriyāyām karaṇa tvāt tatra karaṇa kāraka vācinī tṛtīyā upamāna aṇ tu vibhaktiḥ punar ekā eva upamāna upameyayoḥ iti niyamāt upameya uttara vibhakti sajātīya vibhakteḥ eva ucitatvāt tṛtīyā eva sā ca abheda arthikā iti āśayena āha viśeṣaṇa vibhaktiḥ abheda arthā iti

original: nīlaṃ kamalaṃ paśyetyādau nīlābhinnakamalakarmakaṃ darśanamiti bodānnīlakamalayorabhedānvayādviśeṣaṇavibhakterabhedo'rthaḥ, na tu karmatvamityarthaḥ| tathā cavāgarthāvityatratyā dvitīyā, usrairityatratyā tṛtīyā cābhedārthikā, na tu karmatvavācinī karaṇatvavācinī vā| tataśaaca viśeṣaṇavibhakterdivatīyāyāstṛtīyāyāścānanvayo neti bhāva-|
analyzed: nīlam kamalam paśya ityādau nīla abhinna kamala karmakam darśanam iti bodāt nīla kamalayoḥ abheda anvayāt viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ abhedaḥ ṛthaḥ na tu karmatvam iti arthaḥ tathā ca vāc arthau iti atratyā dvitīyā usraiḥ iti atratyā tṛtīyā ca abheda arthikā na tu karmatva vācinī karaṇatva vācinī vā viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ divatīyāyāḥ tṛtīyāyāḥ ca ananvayaḥ na iti bhāvaḥ

original: sādhutvamātrārthā veti| apadaṃ na prayuñjītiti bhāṣyātpadasādhutvamātrasaṃpādikā viśeṣaṇavibhaktirityarthaḥ| sā ca viśeṣyavācakapadottaravibhakti sajātīyaiva kartumucitā, vibhaktiḥ puranekaiveti niyamāt| viśeṣyasthavibhaktiviruddhavibhaktau kriyamāṇāyāṃ tūpamānopameyayorabhedānvayo na syāt|
analyzed: sādhutva mātra arthā vā iti apadam na prayuñji iti bhāṣyāt pada sādhutva mātra saṃpādikā viśeṣaṇa vibhaktiḥ iti arthaḥ sā ca viśeṣya vācaka pada uttara vibhakti sajātīyā eva kartum ucitā vibhaktiḥ pur anekā eva iti niyamāt viśeṣya stha vibhakti viruddha vibhaktau kriyamāṇāyām tu upamāna upameyayoḥ abheda anvayaḥ na syāt

original: abhedānvayabodhe viruddhavibhaktirāhityasya prayojakatvāt| ata eva candra ivi mukhamāh‌lādakamityādau upamānabhūtacandrābhinnamāh‌lādakaṃ mukhamiti| candramukhayorupamānopameyayorabhedenāmvayabodhaḥ saṃgacchate| ananvaya eveti|

original: yadā ca viśeṣaṇavibhaktirabedārthā, sādhutvamātrārthā vā tadā'pi nipātevaśabdasya vācakatve viśeṣaṇavibhakterananvaya evetyarthaḥ| ananvayameva spaṣṭayati-usrasadṛśaśarāṇāmityādinā| usrāśca sadṛśāśca śarāśceti tripadadvaṃdvo'yam| usrādipadārthatritayasyetyarthaḥ| samānādhikaraṇeti| viruddhavibhaktirahitapadajanyopasthitikatayetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yadā ca viśeṣaṇa vibhaktiḥ abeda arthā sādhutva mātra arthā vā tadā api nipāta iva śabdasya vācaka tve viśeṣaṇa vibhakteḥ ananvayaḥ eva iti arthaḥ ananvayam eva spaṣṭayati usra sadṛśa śarāṇām ityādinā usrāḥ ca sadṛśāḥ ca śarāḥ ca iti tripada dvaṃdvaḥ yam usra ādi padārtha tritayasya iti arthaḥ samāna adhikaraṇa iti viruddha vibhakti rahita pada janya upasthitikatayā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu jñarairusrairivetyatrosraśarapadayoḥ samānavibhaktikatvena viruddhavibhaktyanavaruddhatve'pi kathīmavaśabdasyosraśarapadābhyāṃ samānavibhaktikatvamiti cecdhruyatām-ivaśabdārthaḥ sadṛśaḥ| tasya karaṇabhūtaśaraiḥ sahābhedenānvayātkaraṇatvāttṛtīyā|
analyzed: nanu jñaraiḥ usraiḥ iva iti atra usra śara padayoḥ samāna vibhaktika tvena viruddha vibhakti anavaruddha tve pi kathīm ava śabdasya usra śara padābhyām samāna vibhaktika tvam iti ced dhruyatām iva śabda arthaḥ sadṛśaḥ tasya karaṇa bhūta śaraiḥ saha abhedena anvayāt karaṇa tvāt tṛtīyā

analyzed: samāna vibhaktika tvam api samāna arthaka vibhaktika tvam bodhyam tena rājñaḥ sutasya dhanam iti atra na rāja sutayoḥ abhedena anvayaḥ ekatra janyatva artha tvena aparatra sva tva artha tvena ṣaṣṭhyoḥ vibhanna artha tvena samāna arthaka tva abhāvāt

original: ghaṭaścetyādau tu ghaṭacetiprātipadikayoḥ samānavibhaktimattve'pi samuccayasya nipātārthatvena ghaṭasamuccayayorghaṭapratiyogikaḥ samuccaya ityevaṃ pratiyogitātmakabhedasaṃbandhenānvayo bhavatyeva|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ ca ityādau tu ghaṭa ca iti prātipadikayoḥ samāna vibhaktimat tve pi samuccayasya nipāta ārtha tvena ghaṭa samuccayayoḥ ghaṭa pratiyogikaḥ samuccayaḥ iti evam pratiyogitā ātmaka bheda saṃbandhena anvayaḥ bhavati eva

original: anubhavasākṣātkārādernipātavācyatve'pi dhātoḥ sakarmakatvasiddhyarthaṃ `sva-svayuktanipātānyatarārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācitvaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ vaktavyam| svaṃ-dhātuḥ, sa ca tadyuktanipātaśca tayoranyatarasyārthabhūtaṃ yatphalaṃ tadvyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: anubhava sākṣātkāra ādeḥ nipāta vācya tve api dhātoḥ sakarmaka tva siddhi artham sva sva yukta nipāta anyatara artha phala vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vāci tvam sakarmaka tvam vaktavyam svam dhātuḥ sa ca tad yukta nipātaḥ ca tayoḥ anyatarasya artha bhūtam yat phalam tad vyadhikaraṇa vyāpāra vācaka tvam iti arthaḥ

original: anubhūyata ityādau dhātuyukto nipāto'nvādiḥ, tadarthabhūtaṃ yatphalaṃ sākṣātkārānubhavādikaṃ guruśivādiniṣṭhaṃ, tadvyadhikaraṇadevadattādiniṣṭhavyāpāravācakatvena dhātoḥ sakarmakatvākṣatyā sākṣātkriyata ityādau karmaṇi lakārādiḥ sidhyati|
analyzed: anubhūyate ityādau dhātu yuktaḥ nipātaḥ nu ādiḥ tad artha bhūtam yat phalam sākṣātkāra anubhava ādikam guru śiva ādi niṣṭham tad vyadhikaraṇa devadatta ādi niṣṭha vyāpāra vācaka tvena dhātoḥ sakarmaka tva akṣatyā sākṣātkriyate iti ādau karmaṇi lakāra ādiḥ sidhyati

original: pratiṣṭhate ityatra propasargasyā''digamanāvācakatve tasya ākhyātārthe'nvayasiddhyarthaṃ prakṛtisamabhivyāhṛtanipātārthaprakṛtyarthānyatarānvitasvārthabodhakatvaṃ pratyayānāmiti vyutpattiḥ paṭhanīyā|
analyzed: pratiṣṭhate iti atra tasya ākhyāta artha īnvaya siddhi artham prakṛti samabhivyāhṛta nipāta artha prakṛti artha anyatara anvita sva artha bodhaka tvam pratyayānām iti vyutpattiḥ paṭhanīyā

original: tena pratiṣṭhate ityatra `te' iti tiṅarthakartari prakṛtisamabhivyāhṛtanipātārthasyā''digamanasyānvayena kartṛniṣṭhamādigamanamiti bodho'nubhavasiddho nirvoḍhuṃ śakyo bhavati| evaṃ bhedasaṃbandhena nāmārthaprakārakaśābdabodhaṃ prati pratyayanipātānyatarajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamiti kāryakāraṇabhāvo'ṅgīkāryaḥ|
analyzed: tena pratiṣṭhate iti atra te iti tiṅ artha kartari prakṛti samabhivyāhṛta nipāta arthasya ādi gamanasya anvayena kartṛ niṣṭham ādi gamanam iti bodhaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ nirvoḍhum śakyaḥ bhavati evam bheda saṃbandhena nāma artha prakāraka śābda bodham prati pratyaya nipāta anyatara janya upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ uṅgīkāryaḥ

original: ata eva rājā puruṣaḥ, ityatra rājanirūpitasvātāsaṃbandhavān puruṣa ityevaṃ rājarūpanāmārthaprakārako bhedasaṃsargakaḥ śābdabodho na bhavati| bhedasaṃbandhasya rājapadottaravartipratyayādanupasthiteḥ| bhavati ca rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra nāmārthaprakārakī bhedasaṃsargako bodhaḥ| bhedasaṃsargasya rājapadottaravartiṣaṣṭhīpratyayajanyopasthiteḥ sattvāt|
analyzed: atas eva rājā puruṣaḥ iti atra rāja nirūpita svāti asaṃbandhavān puruṣaḥ iti evam rāja rūpa nāma artha prakārakaḥ bheda saṃsargakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ na bhavati bheda saṃbandhasya rāja pada uttara varti pratyayāt anupasthiteḥ bhavati ca rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti atra nāma artha prakārakaḥ bheda saṃsargakaḥ bodhaḥ bheda saṃsargasya rāja pada uttara varti ṣaṣṭhī pratyaya janya upasthiteḥ sattvāt

original: ghaṭaścetyatra ghaṭasya pratiyogitāsaṃbandhena samuccaye'nvayād ghaṭapratiyogikaḥ samuccaya ityevaṃ ghaṭarūpanāmārthaprakārako bhedasaṃsargakaḥ sābdabodho bhavati| samuccayopasthiternipātajanyatvāt| nāmārthaprakārakabhedasaṃsargakaśabdābodhaṃ prati nipātajanyopasthiterhetutvāṅgīkārādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ ca iti atra ghaṭasya pratiyogitā saṃbandhena samuccaya anvayāt ghaṭa pratiyogikaḥ samuccayaḥ iti evam ghaṭa rūpa nāma artha prakārakaḥ bheda saṃsargakaḥ sābda bodhaḥ bhavati samuccaya upasthiteḥ nipāta janya tvāt nāma artha prakāraka bheda saṃsargaka śabda bodham prati nipāta janya upasthiteḥ hetutva aṅgīkārāt iti arthaḥ

original: na caivaṃ kvacid‌vyutpattau nipātātirikteti niveśe, kvacid vyutpatto nipātapadaniveśe ca gauravaṃ syāditi vācyam| anvayavyatirekarūpayuktyā nipātānāṃ vācakatve sthite'gatyā gauravasya svīkaraṇīyatvāt| vācakatvādeva ca `na' ityetāvanmātroccāraṇādabhāvapratītiḥ kasyeti jijñāsā ca dṛśyate'bhāvaśabda iva|
analyzed: na ca evam kvacid vyutpattau nipāta atiriktā iti niveśe kvacid vyutpattaḥ nipāta pada niveśe ca gauravam syāt iti vācyam anvaya vyatireka rūpa yuktyā nipātānām vācaka tve sthitegatyāḥ gauravasya svīkaraṇīya tvāt vācaka tvāt eva ca na iti etāvat mātra uccāraṇāt abhāva pratītiḥ kasya iti jijñāsā ca dṛśyate bhāva śabdaḥ iva

original: dyotakatve tu padāntarasamabhivyāhāraṃ vinā dyotakatvāsaṃbhavaḥ| nanu nipātānāṃ vācakatve kevalānāmapi teṣāṃ prayogāpattiriti cenna| keṣāṃcit `te prāgdhātoḥ' ityanena niyamanāt keṣāṃcinnetyādīnāṃ kevalānāmapi prayogasyeṣṭatvāt, anyeṣāṃ vācakatve'pi kevalaprakṛtipratyayayoraprayogavatkevalānāmaprayogaḥ|
analyzed: dyotaka tve tu pada antara samabhivyāhāram vinā dyotaka tva asaṃbhavaḥ nanu nipātānām vācaka tve kevalānām api teṣām prayoga āpattiḥ iti ced na keṣāṃcid te prāk dhātoḥ iti anena niyamanāt keṣāṃcid na ityādīnām kevalānām api prayogasya iṣṭatvāt anyeṣām vācaka tve pi kevala prakṛti pratyayayoḥ aprayoga vat kevalānām aprayogaḥ

original: taduktaṃ vākyapadīye-pratyayo vācakatve'pi kevalo na prayujyate| samuccayābhidhāne'pi vyatireko na vidyate| iti| yadyapi pratyayavadeṣāṃ paratvaṃ na smaryate tathāpi tairbodhyaprakarṣādervinā saṃbandhinamananvayātkevalaprayogāsaṃbhavaḥ| samuccitābhidhāyakatve'pi viśeṣatastayorupasthitiṃ vinā pratīteraparyavasānānnityaparatantrataiveti na prayogaḥ|
analyzed: tat uktam vākyapadīye pratyayaḥ vācaka tve pi kevalaḥ na prayujyate samuccaya abhidhāne api vyatirekaḥ na vidyate iti yadi api pratyaya vat eṣām paratvam na smaryate tathā api taiḥ bodhya prakarṣa ādeḥ vinā saṃbandhinam ananvayāt kevala prayoga asaṃbhavaḥ samuccita abhidhāyaka tve pi viśeṣataḥ tayoḥ upasthitim vinā pratīteḥ aparyavasānāt nitya paratantra tā eva iti na prayogaḥ

original: evaṃ nipātānāṃ vācakatve yathāyathaṃ doṣābhāve'pi kvacid‌dyotakatvamapi svīkāryam| anyathā pratiṣṭhate ityatra gamanattvarūpeṇānubhavasiddho bodho na syāt|
analyzed: evam nipātānām vācaka tve yathāyatham doṣa abhāve pi kvacid dyotaka tvam api svīkāryam anyathā pratiṣṭhate iti atra gamana ttva rūpeṇa anubhava siddhaḥ bodhaḥ na syāt

original: nāmārthadhātvarthayorbhedanānvayo na vyutpanna iti vyutpatternipātetaratvena saṃkoce'pi propasargasyābhāve śaktau svīkṛtāyāmapi dhātorgatinivṛttyarthakatvena gatinivṛttirūpadhātvarthasya pratiyogitvasaṃbandhena propasargavācye'bhāve'nvayena gatinivṛttipratiyogikābhāva iti bodhād gamananivṛttyamāvatvarūpeṇaiva bodhaḥ syāt|
analyzed: nāma artha dhātvarthayoḥ bhedana anvayaḥ na vyutpannaḥ iti vyutpatteḥ nipāta itaratvena saṃkoce pi pra upasargasya abhāve śaktau svīkṛtāyām api dhātoḥ gati nivṛtti arthaka tvena gati nivṛtti rūpa dhātvarthasya pratiyogitva saṃbandhena pra upasarga vācya bhāva invayena gati nivṛtti pratiyogika abhāvaḥ iti bodhāt gamana nivṛtti amāva tva rūpeṇa eva bodhaḥ syāt

original: dyotakatve tu tiṣṭhaterdhātoreva lakṣaṇayā gatipratipādakatvād gamanatvarūpeṇa bodho'nāyāsena sidhyati| natvitīti| prādayo dyotakāścādayastu vācakā ityevaṃ yannaiyāyikaiḥ prādicādyorvaiṣamyaṃ kṛtaṃ tadapi na yuktamityarthaḥ| yattu kaiściduktam-nipātānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vācakatve `nipātasyānarthakasya' iti prātipadikasaṃjñāvidhirvyarthaḥ|
analyzed: dyotaka tve tu tiṣṭhateḥ dhātoḥ eva lakṣaṇayā gati pratipādaka tvāt gamana tva rūpeṇa bodhaḥ ūna āyāsena sidhyati na tu iti iti pra ādayaḥ dyotakāḥ ca ādayaḥ tu vācakāḥ iti evam yat naiyāyikaiḥ prādi cādyoḥ vaiṣamyam kṛtam tat api na yuktam iti arthaḥ yat tu kaiścid uktam nipātānām sarveṣām vācaka tve nipātasya anarthakasya iti prātipadika saṃjñā vidhiḥ vyarthaḥ

original: arthavatsūtreṇaiva prātipadikatvasya siddhatvāt| sarveṣāṃ dyotakatve'pi `nipātasya' ityetāvataiva prātipadikatve siddhe `anarthakasya' ityaṃśaḥ sarvathā vyartha eva| tasmātkecidevārthavanta iti vaktavyam| tathā copasargā eva dyotakāścādayastu vācakā iti|
analyzed: arthavat sūtreṇa eva prātipadika tvasya siddha tvāt sarveṣām dyotaka tve pi nipātasya iti etāvatā eva prātipadika tve siddhe anarthakasya iti aṃśaḥ sarvathā vyarthaḥ eva tasmāt kecid eva arthavantaḥ iti vaktavyam tathā ca upasargāḥ eva dyotakāḥ ca ādayaḥ tu vācakāḥ iti

original: tadayuktam-sarvathā'narthakānāṃ `tu-hi-ca-sma-ha-vaipādapūraṇe, ityamarakośāt, kamīmidviti pādapūraṇe, iti niruktāt, adhiparī anarthakau' iti sūtrāccāvagatānāṃ saṃgrahārthaṃ tadvacanamiti kaiyaṭādau spaṣṭatvāt| ke vācakā ityatra vinigamanābhāvāccādīnāmeva dyotakatvaṃ prādīnāṃ tu vācakatvamiti vaiparītyasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvācca|
analyzed: tat ayuktam sarvathā anarthakānām tu hi ca sma ha vai pāda pūraṇe iti amarakośāt pāda pūraṇe iti niruktāt adhi parī anarthakau iti sūtrāt ca avagatānām saṃgraha artham tat vacanam iti kaiyaṭa ādau spaṣṭa tvāt ke vācakāḥ iti atra vinigamana abhāvāt ca ādīnām eva dyotaka tvam pra ādīnām tu vācaka tvam iti vaiparītyasya api vaktum śakya tvāt ca

original: vastuta etadvārtikasya bhāṣyakāraiḥ pratyākhyātatvāttanmūlakametadaśraddheyameveti bhāti| vyaryamiti| dyotakatāpakṣe sarveṣāmeva nipātānāṃ nirarthakatayā vyāvartyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| pratyākhyātatvāditi| `adhiparī anarthakau' iti sūtreṇānarthakayoradhiparyorgatyupasargasaṃjñābādhanārthaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā vidhīyate|
analyzed: vastutas etat vārtikasya bhāṣya kāraiḥ pratyākhyāta tvāt tad mūlakam etat aśraddheyam eva iti bhāti vyaryam iti dyotaka tā pakṣe sarveṣām eva nipātānām nirarthaka tayā vyāvartya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ pratyākhyāta tvāt iti adhi parī anarthakau iti sūtreṇa anarthakayoḥ adhi paryoḥ gati upasarga saṃjñā bādhana artham karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhīyate

original: gatyupasargasaṃjñe ca `upasargāḥ kriyāyoge' gatiśca' iti sūtradvayena kriyāyoga eva vidhīyate| tatrādhiparyoranarthakayoḥ kriyāyogāsaṃbhavād gatyupasargasaṃjñayoḥ prāptireva na saṃbhavatīti tad‌bādhānārthaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ vyartham|
analyzed: gati upasarga saṃjñe ca upasargāḥ kriyā yoge gatiḥ ca iti sūtra dvayena kriyā yogaḥ eva vidhīyate tatra adhi paryoḥ anarthakayoḥ kriyā yoga asaṃbhavāt gati upasarga saṃjñayoḥ prāptiḥ eva na saṃbhavati iti tad bādhāna artham karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhānam vyartham

original: na ca `karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā' iti dvitīyārtha karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ sārthakaṃ syāditi vācyam| anarthakatvena karmapravacanīyayuktatvasya nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt| evaṃ ca vyarthībhūya karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ jñāpayati-yadanarthakānāmapi nipātānāmarthavattvaṃ gṛhītvā tatprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ karaṇīyamiti|
analyzed: na ca karmapravacanīya yukte dvitīyā iti dvitīyā artha karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhānam sārthakam syāt iti vācyam anarthaka tvena karmapravacanīya yukta tvasya nirūpayitum aśakya tvāt evam ca vyarthībhūya karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhānam jñāpayati yat anarthakānām api nipātānām arthavat tvam gṛhītvā tad prayuktam kāryam karaṇīyam iti

original: tataśca kriyāyo saṃbhavād gatyupasargasaṃjñe syātāṃ te mā bhūtāmiti tadbādhanārthaṃ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāvidhānaṃ caritārtham| tena kuto'dhyāgacchatītyādau `gatirgatau' iti nighāto na bhavati| anarthakānāmapi nipātānāmarthavattvaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatītyantra phalam|
analyzed: tatas ca saṃbhavāt gati upasarga saṃjñe syātām te mā bhūtām iti tad bādhana artham karmapravacanīya saṃjñā vidhānam caritārtham tena kutodhyā āgacchati ityādau gatiḥ gatau iti nighātaḥ na bhavati anarthakānām api nipātānām arthavat tva prayuktam kāryam prātipadika saṃjñā bhavati iti antra phalam

original: tathā ta nipātasyānarthakasyetivacanaṃ na kartavyamiti pratyākhyātatvādityarthaḥ| bahuvacanaṃ mīmāṃsaketi| mīmāṃsakānāṃ bhāṣyakārādibhedena nānātvāda bahuvacanamiti bhāvaḥ| mīmāṃsakamataṃ pradarśayati-kevaletyādinā| mīmāṃsakamataṃ nirasyati-tathā hītyādinā na śaktadvayakalpanāpītyantena| asmākamiti|
analyzed: tathā nipātasya anarthakasya iti vacanam na kartavyam iti pratyākhyāta tvāt iti arthaḥ bahuvacanam mīmāṃsaka iti mīmāṃsakānām bhāṣyakāra ādi bhedena bahuvacanam iti bhāvaḥ mīmāṃsaka matam pradarśayati kevala ityādinā mīmāṃsaka matam nirasyati tathā hi ityādinā na śakta dvaya kalpanā api ityantena asmākam iti

original: nipātānāṃ vācakatvaṃ dyotakatvaṃ ceti pakṣadvayāṅgīkartṝṇāmityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇāgraheti| yadā ca ghaṭādipadānāṃ samuccitādyarthe lakṣaṇāṃ gṛhītvā prakaraṇādivattātparyagrāhakaścādirityāśrīyate tadaiva ghaṭādipadātsamuccayādyarthapratīteḥ samuccayādiviśiṣṭaghaṭādyarthaviṣayakaśābdabodhaṃ prati ghaṭādipadanirūpitalakṣaṇājñānaṃ kāraṇamiti
analyzed: nipātānām vācaka tvam dyotaka tvam ca iti pakṣa dvaya aṅgīkartṝṇām iti arthaḥ lakṣaṇā graha iti yadā ca ghaṭa ādi padānām samuccita ādi arthe lakṣaṇām gṛhītvā prakaraṇa ādi vat tātparya grāhakaḥ ca ādiḥ iti āśrīyate tadā eva ghaṭa ādi padāt samuccaya ādi artha pratīteḥ samuccaya ādi viśiṣṭa ghaṭa ādi artha viṣayaka śābdabodham prati ghaṭa ādi pada nirūpita lakṣaṇā jñānam kāraṇam iti

original: śābdabodhalakṣaṇājñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāva āvaśyakaḥ| samabhivyāhṛtapadasya viśiṣṭārthe lakṣaṇāyāṃ gṛhītāyāṃ lakṣyārthasya bodāllakṣyārthabodhe lakṣaṇājñānaṃ kāraṇamityevaṃ lakṣyārthabodhalakṣaṇāgrahayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vaśyaṃ svīkārya iti yāvat| śaktigrahasyāpīti|
analyzed: śābdabodha lakṣaṇā jñānayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ āvaśyakaḥ samabhivyāhṛta padasya viśiṣṭa arthe lakṣaṇāyām gṛhītāyām lakṣya arthasya bodāt lakṣya artha bodhe lakṣaṇā jñānam kāraṇam iti evam lakṣya artha bodha lakṣaṇā grahayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ uvaśyam svīkāryaḥ iti yāvat śakti grahasya api iti

original: vācakatvapakṣe vṛkṣādyarthaviṣayakaśābdabodhe vṛkṣādipadaniṣṭhaṃ śaktijñānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, samuccayādyarthabodhe prādinipātaniṣṭhaśaktijñānaṃ kāraṇamityevaṃ śābdabodhaśaktijñānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pyāpaśyakaḥ| kalpyāntarābhāveneti| vācakatvapakṣe dyotakatvapakṣe ca klṛkāryakāraṇabhāvadvayāpekṣayā'dhikakalpitavyaviraheṇetyarthaḥ| ubhayamapīti|

original: yathā paṭatvadharmāvacchinnapaṭaviṣayakaśābdabodhaṃ prati paṭatvadharmāvacchinnapaṭanirūpitā yā paṭapadaniṣṭhā śaktiḥ, tasyā jñānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, kāryaṃ tu paṭatvadharmāvacchinnapaṭaviṣayakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ| yena puruṣeṇa, paṭapadasya paṭatvāvacchinne śaktiriti paṭapadaniṣṭhā śaktirjñātā, tasyaiva puruṣasya paṭapadātpaṭatvāvacchinnaviṣayakabodho jāyate|

original: śakyatāvacchedakaṃ cātra paṭatvameva, na dravyatvam| anyūnānatiriktavṛttidharmasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatvāt| paṭatvaṃ ca paṭapadavācyeṣu sarveṣu paṭaiṣū vidyata iti na nyūnavṛtti, nāpi paṭāpekṣayā'tiriktaghaṭādivṛttīti tadevātra śakyatāvacchedakaṃ, dravyatvaṃ tu atiriktaghaṭādivṛttitvānna śakyatāvacchedakaṃ bhavitumarhati|

original: yena dharmeṇāvacchinne śaktiḥ sa dharmaḥ śakyatāvacchedakaḥ| paṭatvadharmeṇāvacchinne paṭe paṭapadasya śaktiriti paṭatvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam| sa ca dharmaścatuṣṭayī śabdānāṃ pravṛttiriti bhāṣyoktapakṣe kvacijjātiḥ, guṇaḥ, kriyā, yadṛcchā(saṃjñā)śabdaśceti bodhyam|

original: nanu pa़ṭavṛttidravyatvadharmeṇāvacchinne paṭe paṭapadasya śaktiḥ kalpitā ced‌dravyatvamapi paṭapadaśakyatāvacchedakaṃ bhavitumarhatīti cenna| anyūnānatiriktavṛttinaiva dharmeṇāvacchinne tattatpadaśakteḥ kalpanīyatvāt| nanvatraiva kiṃ pramāṇamiticetsamarthasūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyameva pramāṇamiti gṛhāṇa|

original: tatrāpyānantyādyabhāvena bhāvapratyaya iti kutvakuśabdayoḥ paryāyataiva| bhādipadānāṃ tuyūṣṇaḥ, rājña ityādau yūṣanūrājannityādiśakyavyaktyānantyena śakyatāvacchedakāpekṣaṇād bhādipadameva śakyatāvacchedakaṃ, tadeva ca taduttaratvādyarthaḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva vṛddhirādaica sūtre bhāṣya uktaṃ-kutvaṃ kasmānna bhavati coḥ kuḥ padasyeti| bhatvāt|
analyzed: tatra api ānantya ādi abhāvena bhāva pratyayaḥ iti ku tva ku śabdayoḥ paryāya tā eva bha ādi padānām tu yūṣṇaḥ rājñaḥ ityādau bha ādi padam eva śakya tā avacchedakam tat eva ca tad uttaratva ādi arthaḥ etad abhiprāyeṇa eva sūtre bhāṣye uktam ku tvam kasmāt na bhavati coḥ kuḥ padasya iti bha tvāt

original: kathaṃ bhasaṃjñeti| anena kutvakupadayorbhatvabhasaṃjñāpadayoḥ paryāyatā spaṣṭamevoktā| evaṃ ca `tavāpīdaṃ kathaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ' ityetādṛśo ya ākṣepo vaiyākaraṇopari mīmāṃsakairuktastasyedamuttaram-tasya bhāva iti sūtre bhāvapadena prakṛtijanyabodhe prakāratayā bhāsamānaḥ śabdapravṛttinimittarūpo dharmo gṛhyate|
analyzed: katham bha saṃjñā iti anena ku tva ku padayoḥ bha tva bha saṃjñā padayoḥ paryāya tā spaṣṭam eva uktā evam ca tava api idam katham vaiṣamyam iti etādṛśaḥ yaḥ ākṣepaḥ vaiyākaraṇa upari mīmāṃsakaiḥ uktaḥ tasya idam uttaram tasya bhāvaḥ iti sūtre bhāva padena prakṛti janya bodhe prakāratayā bhāsamānaḥ śabda pravṛtti nimitta rūpaḥ dharmaḥ gṛhyate

original: śabdapravṛttiśca kvaciddharmasvarūpajñānātkvacitsaṃbandhajñānāditi ghaṭatvadāmodaratvādau saṃbandhānavagamena śabdapravṛttinimittātmake dharme jātau tvādibhāvapratyayaḥ, pācakatvadaṇḍitvādau tu saṃbandhāvagamātsaṃbandhe bhāvapratyaya iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: śabda pravṛttiḥ ca kvacid dharma svarūpa jñānāt kvacid saṃbandha jñānāt iti ghaṭa tva dāmodara tva ādau saṃbandha anavagamena śabda pravṛtti nimitta ātmake dharme jātau tu ādi bhāva pratyayaḥ pācaka tva daṇḍi tva ādau tu saṃbandha avagamāt saṃbandhe bhāva pratyayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu bhāvapadena tvādipratyayaprakṛtijanyabodhe prakāratayābhāsamānaḥ śabdapravṛttinimittarūpo dharmo gṛhyate ced ghaṭatvatvamityādau ghaṭatvasyāpi prakāratayā bhāsamānatvād ghaṭatvapadottarasyāpi tvapratyayasya ghaṭatvameva vācyaṃ syādityāśayena śaṅkate-nanvityādinā| prakāratvāditi|
analyzed: nanu bhāva padena tu ādi pratyaya prakṛti janya bodhe prakāratayā ābhāsamānaḥ śabda pravṛtti nimitta rūpaḥ dharmaḥ gṛhyate ced ghaṭa tva tvam ityādau ghaṭa tvasya api prakāratayā bhāsamāna tvāt ghaṭa tva pada uttarasya api tva pratyayasya ghaṭa tvam eva vācyam syāt iti āśayena śaṅkate nanu ityādinā prakāratvāt iti

original: yadyapi ghaṭatvāvacchinne ghaṭe ghaṭapadasya śaktiriti ghaṭapadenaiva śakyatāvacchedakaṃ ghaṭatvamuktaṃ bhavati, tathāpi ghaṭapadena tad‌viśeṣaṇatayocyate, ghaṭapadād ghaṭatvaprakārakaghaṭaviśeṣyakabodhānubhavāt| viśeṣyatayā bodhārthaṃ tvādibhāvapratyayena tadeva śakyatāvacchedakamabhidhīyate|
analyzed: yadi api ghaṭa tva avacchinne ghaṭe ghaṭa padasya śaktiḥ iti ghaṭa padena eva śakyatā avacchedakam ghaṭa tvam uktam bhavati tathā api ghaṭa padena tad viśeṣaṇatayā ucyate ghaṭa padāt ghaṭa tva prakāraka ghaṭa viśeṣyaka bodha anubhavāt viśeṣyatayā bodha artham tu ādi bhāvapratyayena tat eva śakyatā avacchedakam abhidhīyate

original: prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti nyāyena ghaṭatvamityādau tvapratyayena prādhānyena taducyata iti yuktaṃ śakyatāvacchedake tvādibhāvapratyayavidhānam|
analyzed: prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti nyāyena ghaṭa tvam ityādau tva pratyayena prādhānyena tat ucyate iti yuktam śakya tā avacchedake tva ādi bhāva pratyaya vidhānam

original: ghaṭatva śabdāttvādibhāvapratyayacikīrṣāyāṃ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ ghaṭatvatvaṃ vācyaṃ, yadyapi tadaghaṭatvapadenaivoktaṃ tathāpi viśeṣaṇatayā tena tasyoktatvātprādhānyena bodhārthaṃ punastvapratyayena tadevābhidātavyamiti prakṛtijanyabothe prakāratayā bhāsamānaḥ śakyatāvacchedako dharmo ghaṭatvatvameveti mantavyam|
analyzed: ghaṭa tva śabdāt tva ādi bhāva pratyaya cikīrṣāyām śakyatā avacchedakam ghaṭa tva tvam vācyam yadi api tat aghaṭa tva padena eva uktam tathā api viśeṣaṇatayā tena tasya uktatvāt prādhānyena bodha artham punar tu apratyayena tat eva abhidātavyam iti prakṛti janya bothe prakāratayā bhāsamānaḥ śakyatā avacchedakaḥ dharmaḥ ghaṭa tva tvam eva iti mantavyam

original: paraṃ tu tasya(ghaṭatvatvasya)śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ na svīkriyate| saṃbhavati laghau gurau tadabhāvāt| laghudharme'vacchedakatvakalpane saṃbhavati sati gurudharme'vacchedakatvakalpanaṃ na karaṇīyaṃ gauravāditi tadarthaḥ|
analyzed: param tu tasya ghaṭa tva tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tvam na svīkriyate saṃbhavati laghau gurau tad abhāvāt laghu dharma ivacchedaka tva kalpane saṃbhavati sati guru dharma ivacchedaka tva kalpanam na karaṇīyam gauravāt iti tad arthaḥ

original: ata eva prameyavah‌nyabhāvavānityatra prameyavahnitvasyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvaṃ parityajya prameyavahnitvasya samaniyato vahnitvarūpo dharma evābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvenāṅgīkṛto laghutvānnaiyāyikaiḥ|
analyzed: atas eva prameya vahni abhāvavān iti atra prameya vahni tvasya abhāva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tvam parityajya prameya vahni tvasya samaniyataḥ vahni tva rūpaḥ dharmaḥ eva abhāva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tvena aṅgīkṛtaḥ laghu tvāt naiyāyikaiḥ

original: satyevaṃ yadi gurudharme śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svīkriyate cennyāyaviruddhatvādayuktaṃ taditi ghaṭatvatvasya śakyatāvacchedakatvābhāvena ghaṭatvapadottaratvapratyayavācyatā tasya na saṃbhavatīti `vācyatā syāt, ityanena vācyatāpattiḥ syāta, sā cāniṣṭeti sūcitam|
analyzed: sati evam yadi guru dharme śakyatā avacchedaka tvam svīkriyate ced nyāya viruddha tvāt ayuktam tat iti ghaṭa tva tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tva abhāvena ghaṭa tva pada uttaratva pratyaya vācyatā tasya na saṃbhavati iti vācyatā syāt iti anena vācya tā āpattiḥ syāta sā ca aniṣṭā iti sūcitam

original: ghaṭatvatvasya śakyatāvacchedakatva kalpanāyāṃ yadyapi gauravaṃ bhavati tathāpi tadiṣṭāpattigrastamevetyāha-dharmamātramitīti| gotvagotvatvādi dharmamātraṃ dharmatvena rūpeṇa tvādibhāvapratyayavācyaṃ na tu tattadrūpeṇa śaktyānantyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭa tva tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tva kalpanāyām yadi api gauravam bhavati tathā api tat iṣṭāpatti grastam eva iti āha dharma mātram iti iti go tva go tva tva ādi dharma mātram dharma tvena rūpeṇa tu ādi bhāva pratyaya vācyam na tu tat tad rūpeṇa śakti ānantya āpatteḥ

original: anye tu gotvādijātirapi gavādidravyaniṣṭho dharmaḥ, nīlādiguṇo'pi ghaṭādidravyaniṣṭho dharmaḥ, tathā pākādikriyā'pi caitrādidravyaniṣṭho dharma iti jātigumakriyāsu dravyaniṣṭhadharmatvasādhāraṇyenaikaśaktau saṃbhavantyāṃ jātyāditisṛṣu pṛthakaśaktikalpane gauravādastu jātyādināṃ dharmatvena rūpeṇa tvādibhāvapratyayavācyatā|
analyzed: anye tu go tva ādi jātiḥ api gavādi dravya niṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ nīla ādi guṇaḥ api ghaṭa ādi dravya niṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ tathā pāka ādi kriyā api caitra ādi dravya niṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ iti jāti guma kriyāsu dravya niṣṭha dharma tva sādhāraṇyena eka śaktau saṃbhavantyām jātyāt itisṛṣu pṛthaka śakti kalpane gauravāt astu jāti ādinām dharma tvena rūpeṇa tu ādi bhāva pratyaya vācya tā

original: tathā ca na śaktyānamtyam| sa ca dravyaniṣṭho jātyādirdharmo yogyadravyetarāvṛttitve sati sakalayogyadravyavṛttitvādasādhāraṇa ityucyate| evaṃ gotvatvādidharmo'pi paramparayā dravyavṛttitvādasādhāraṇa iti ghaṭatvaṃ ghaṭatvatvamityādau ghaṭādivṛttirasādhāraṇo dharma iti bodha iti vadanti|
analyzed: tathā ca na śakti ānamtyam sa ca dravya niṣṭhaḥ jāti ādiḥ dharmaḥ yogya dravya itara avṛtti tve sati sakala yogya dravya vṛtti tvāt asādhāraṇaḥ iti ucyate evam go tva tva ādi dharmaḥ api paramparayā dravya vṛtti tvāt asādhāraṇaḥ iti ghaṭa tvam ghaṭa tva tvam ityādau ghaṭa ādi vṛttiḥ asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ iti bodhaḥ iti vadanti

original: tvādipratyayaprakṛtyarthe prakāratāmāpannaṃ dharmamātraṃ tvādibhāvapratyayavācyamitīṣyata ityarthaḥ| kṛtsnārathakamātraśabdenobhayavidhasyāpi śakyatāvacchedakadharmasya saṃgrahaḥ|
analyzed: tva ādi pratyaya prakṛti arthe prakāra tām āpannam dharmamātram tva ādi bhāva pratyaya vācyam iti iṣyate iti arthaḥ kṛtsnārathaka mātra śabdena ubhayavidhasya api śakyatā avacchedaka dharmasya saṃgrahaḥ

original: saca śakyatāvacchedako dharmo gururlaghurvā kīdṛśo'pyastu na tatra vai myaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ māvagrahaṇasāmarthyāt, kambugrīvādimānnāstīti pratītyā kambugrīvādimattvasyābhāvapratiyogitāvacchedakatvasvīkāreṇa gurudharmasyāpyavacchedakatvasvīkāre bādhakābhāvācceti bhāvaḥ| tadetadāha-na tvatra laghuguruvicāra iti|
analyzed: saca śakyatā avacchedakaḥ dharmaḥ guruḥ laghuḥ vā kīdṛśaḥ upi astu na tatra vai kartum śakyam māva grahaṇa sāmarthyāt kambu grīvā ādimān na asti iti pratītyā kambu grīvā ādimat tvasya abhāva pratiyogitā avacchedaka tva svīkāreṇa guru dharmasya api avacchedaka tva svīkāre bādhaka abhāvāt ca iti bhāvaḥ tat etat āha na tu atra laghu guru vicāraḥ iti

original: vastutastu gurudharme'vacchedakatvakalpane gauravameva nāstītyāha-tattavyaktīti| rājjau sarpavatsarvasyāpi jagato brahmaṇyāropeṇa brahmasattaiva sarvatrāvabhāsate| sā ca brahmasattā goghaṭāditattadvyaktiviśeṣaiḥ paricchinna satī gautva-ghaṭatva, gotvatva-ghaṭatvatvādirūpeṇa vyavahāraviṣayā jāyate| taduktaṃ vākyapadīye-saṃbandhibedāditi|
analyzed: vastutas tu guru dharma iva chedakatva kalpane gauravam eva nā asti iti āha tad tad vyakti iti sarpa vat sarvasya api jagataḥ brahmaṇi āropeṇa brahma sattā eva sarvatra avabhāsate sā ca brahma sattā go ghaṭa ādi tad tad vyakti viśeṣaiḥ paricchinna satī gau tva ghaṭa tva go tva tva ghaṭa tva tva ādi rūpeṇa vyavahāra viṣayā jāyate tat uktam vākyapadīye saṃbandhi bedāt iti

original: gotvādidharmāśrayāṇāṃ gavādivyaktīnāṃ bhedād bhidyamānā-gavetarāvṛttitve sati sakalagovṛttitvena bhinneva pratīyamānā gavādiṣu vidyamānā yā brahmasattā saiva jātirityucyate| tasyāṃ jātiśabdavācyāyāṃ sattāyāṃ sarve śabdā vācakatvena vyavastitā iti tadarthaḥ| jātiḥ padārtha iti vādināṃ mate'nukūlamidam|
analyzed: go tva ādi dharma āśrayāṇām go ādi vyaktīnām bhedāt sati sakala go vṛtti tvena bhinnā iva pratīyamānā gavādiṣu vidyamānā yā brahma sattā sā eva jātiḥ iti ucyate tasyām jāti śabda vācyāyām sattāyām sarve śabdāḥ vācaka tvena iti tad arthaḥ jātiḥ padārthaḥ iti vādinām mata inukūlam idam
