original: sakalaśabdavācyā brahmasattaivetyetadviśadayati-tāmiti| tattadvyaktiviśeṣoparaktāṃ brahmasattāmityarthaḥ| prātipadikārthaṃ dhātvarthaṃ ca-kriyāṃ ca pracakṣate-kathayanti, ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenetyarthaḥ| nityā-utpattivināśādivikārarahitā, ata eva saiva sattā mahānātmetyucyate, tvatalādayaśca bhāvapratyayāstāmāhuriti yojanā|
analyzed: sakala śabda vācyā brahma sattā eva iti etat viśadayati tām iti tat tat vyakti viśeṣa uparaktām brahma sattām iti arthaḥ prātipadika artham dhātvartham ca kriyām ca pracakṣate kathayanti ākṛti adhikaraṇa nyāyena iti arthaḥ nityā a utpatti vināśa ādi vikāra rahitā atas eva sā eva sattā mahān ātmā iti ucyate tva tala ādayaḥ ca bhāva pratyayāḥ tām āhuḥ iti yojanā

original: evaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ brahmasattārūpatvād brahmasattāyāśca nityatvānna tatra gurulaghuvicārāvasara iti bhāvaḥ| śabdapravṛttinimittarūpadharmasya tvatalādibhāvapratyayavācyatve vārtikakārasaṃmatimāha-uktaṃ cetyādinā| tasya bhāvastvatalāviti sūtre vārtikakārairyaduktaṃ tadanuvadati-yasya gumasyetyādinā tvatalāvitītyantena| yasya guṇasyeti|
analyzed: evam ca sarveṣām dharmāṇām brahma sattā rūpatvāt brahma sattāyāḥ ca nitya tvāt na tatra gurulaghu vicāra avasaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ śabda pravṛtti nimitta rūpa dharmasya tva tala ādi bhāva pratyaya vācyatve vārtikakāra saṃmatim āha uktam ca ityādinā tasya bhāvaḥ tu atalau iti sūtre vārtikakāraiḥ yat uktam tat anuvadati yasya ityādinā tu atalau iti ityantena yasya guṇasya iti

original: atra guṇapadaṃ na rūparasādiguṇaparaṃ, kiṃtūpakākaparimityāśayenā''ha-viśeṣaṇatayā bhāsamānamiti| uktaṃ ca kaiyaṭena-`guṇaśabdena yāvān, kaścitparāśrayo bhedako jātyādiḥ sarva iha gṛhyate' iti| evaṃ ca prakṛtasthale guṇaśabda upasarjanabhūtārthavācaka iti yāvat| bhāvādityasyārthaṃ vyācaṣṭe-āśrayatvāditi| dravya ityasyārthamāha--viśeṣya iti|
analyzed: atra guṇa padam na rūpa rasa ādi guṇa param kiṃtu upakākaparimiti āśayena āha viśeṣaṇatayā bhāsamānam iti uktam ca kaiyaṭena guṇa śabdena yāvān kaścid para āśrayaḥ bhedakaḥ jāti ādiḥ sarvaḥ iha gṛhyate iti evam ca prakṛta sthale guṇa śabdaḥ upasarjana bhūta artha vācakaḥ iti yāvat bhāvāt iti asya artham vyācaṣṭe āśraya tvāt iti dravye iti asya artham āha viśeṣyaḥ iti

original: śabdaniveśa iti vyācaṣṭe-śabdapravṛttiriti| yaṃ jātyādimupasarjanabhūtamarthaṃ puraskṛtya śabdo'rthamabhidhātuṃ pravartata ityarthaḥ| tasmin vācya iti| tādṛśe viśeṣaṇībhūte jātyādāvarthe vācye satītyarthaḥ| tvatalāviti| tvatalādayo bhāvapratyayā bhavantīti śeṣaḥ|
analyzed: śabda niveśaḥ iti vyācaṣṭe śabda pravṛttiḥ iti yam jāti ādim upasarjana bhūtam artham puraskṛtya śabdaḥ ūrtham abhidhātum pravartate iti arthaḥ tasmin vācye iti tādṛśe viśeṣaṇībhūte jāti ādau arthe vācye sati iti arthaḥ tva talau iti tva tala ādayaḥ bhāva pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti śeṣaḥ

original: tataśca jātyādiśabdānāṃ madhye kīdṛśaḥ śabdātkīdṛśe'rthe tvādirbhāvapratyayaḥ paryavasitastaddarśayati-tathā ceti| rūpādīti| ādinā rasagandhāderguṇaparaśuklādeśca grahaṇam| jātāviti| rūpatvaśuklatvādijātāvityarthaḥ| tvādirbhāvapratyayo bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| guṇa iti| guṇiparaśuklādibhyo guṇa ityarthaḥ| guṇaparebhyastu tebhyo jātāviti jñeyam|
analyzed: tatas ca jāti ādi śabdānām madhye kīdṛśaḥ śabdāt kīdṛśa ṛthe tva ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ paryavasitaḥ tat darśayati tathā ca iti rūpa ādi iti ādinā rasa gandha ādeḥ guṇa para śukla ādeḥ ca grahaṇam jātau iti rūpa tva śukla tva ādi jātau iti arthaḥ tva ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ bhavati iti śeṣaḥ guṇaḥ iti guṇi para śukla ādibhyaḥ guṇaḥ iti arthaḥ guṇa parebhyaḥ tu tebhyaḥ jātau iti jñeyam

original: aṇvādiśabdā nityaṃ guṇiparā eveti tebhyaḥ parimāṇarūpe guṇa eva tvādirbhāvapratyayaḥ| parimāṇaṃ caturvidhaṃ-aṇu pahaddīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ cetyasyāṇvādivastuvṛtti aṇutvādi parimāṇaṃ caturvidhamityartho bodhyaḥ| pācakādīti| kriyāśabdebhyaḥ kriyāyāṃ, ghaṭādijātiśabdebhyastu jātau tvādirbhāvapratyayo bhavatīti bodhyam| rūpādiśabdānāmiti|
analyzed: aṇu ādi śabdāḥ nityam guṇi parāḥ eva iti tebhyaḥ parimāṇa rūpe guṇaḥ eva tu ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ parimāṇam caturvidham aṇu pahat dīrgham hrasvam ca iti asya aṇu ādi vastu vṛtti aṇu tva ādi parimāṇam caturvidham iti arthaḥ bodhyaḥ pācaka ādi iti kriyā śabdebhyaḥ kriyāyām ghaṭa ādi jāti śabdebhyaḥ tu jātau tu ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ bhavati iti bodhyam rūpa ādi śabdānām iti

original: yato rūpādiśabdānāṃ jātiprakārakabodhajanakatvamatastebhyo jātaubhāvapratyaya iti bhāvaḥ| pācakādīti| pākakriyāśrayaścaitra ityevaṃ kriyāyakārakabodhajanakatve kriyāśabdebhyaḥ kiyāyāṃ bhāvātyayaḥ| saṃsargaprakāraketi|
analyzed: yatas rūpa ādi śabdānām jāti prakāraka bodha janaka tvam atas tebhyaḥ jātaubhāva pratyayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ pācaka ādi iti pāka kriyā āśrayaḥ caitraḥ iti evam kriyā ya kāraka bodha janaka tve kriyā śabdebhyaḥ kiyāyām bhāva atyayaḥ saṃsarga prakāraka iti

original: kṛdante hi kriyayā niyamena bhedapratīteḥ pācaka ityādau pākakriyāsaṃbandhavān devadatta ityevaṃ saṃbandhaprakārakabodhānubhavātkriyākārakasaṃbandhajñānādeva pācakādiśabdapravṛttiriti kriyāśabdebhyaḥ saṃbandha eva bhāvapratyaya iti saṃsargaprakārakabodhajanakatvavādināṃ matamiti bhāvaḥ| sūpapādeti|
analyzed: kṛt ante hi kriyayā niyamena bheda pratīteḥ pācakaḥ ityādau pāka kriyā saṃbandhavān devadattaḥ iti evam saṃbandha prakāraka bodha anubhavāt kriyā kāraka saṃbandha jñānāt eva pācaka ādi śabda pravṛttiḥ iti kriyā śabdebhyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ eva bhāva pratyayaḥ iti saṃsarga prakāraka bodha janaka tva vādinām matam iti bhāvaḥ sūpapādā iti

original: tvādirbhāvapratyayo jātāvevetyādiniyamābhāvādityaśayaḥ| tatra-jātyādivācakabhāvapratyayāntānāṃ madhye| ghaṭatvatvādiśabdeṣu vyaktaya eva tvādibhāvapratyayavācyā iti pakṣāntaramāha-jātivācakānāmiti| ghaṭatvādiśabdānāmityarthaḥ| prādhānyena jātivācakānāmiti yāvat|
analyzed: tva ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ jātau eva ityādi niyama abhāvāt iti aśayaḥ tatra jāti ādi vācaka bhāva pratyaya antānām madhye ghaṭa tva tva ādi śabdeṣu vyaktayaḥ eva tva ādi bhāva pratyaya vācyāḥ iti pakṣa antaram āha jāti vācakānām iti ghaṭa tva ādi śabdānām iti arthaḥ prādhānyena jāti vācakānām iti yāvat

original: yadyapi ghaṭādiśabdā api jātivācakā eva tathāpi na te prādhānyena jātibhāhūḥ, kiṃtu prakāratayeti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca jātivācakānāmityasya prādhānyena jātivācakānāṃ tvādibhāvapratyayānāmityarthaḥ| paryavasyati| vyaktaya eveti| tvādibhāvapratyayāḥ śaktāḥ| tādṛśabhāvapratyayānāṃ śakyā jātiḥ|
analyzed: yadi api ghaṭa ādi śabdāḥ api jāti vācakāḥ eva tathā api na te prādhānyena jāti bhāhūḥ kiṃtu prakāratayā iti bhāvaḥ evam ca jāti vācakānām iti asya prādhānyena jāti vācakānām tu ādi bhāva pratyayānām iti arthaḥ paryavasyati vyaktayaḥ eva iti tu ādi bhāva pratyayāḥ śaktāḥ tādṛśa bhāva pratyayānām śakyā jātiḥ

original: tādṛśajāteḥ śakyatāvacchedakaṃ ghaṭatvatvādikaṃ na, kiṃtūpasthitatvāttvādipratyayaprakṛtivācyā ghaṭādivyaktaya eva śakyatāvacchedikā bhavanti| brahmasattārūpā yā ghaṭatvajātiḥ sā ghaṭatvaśabdasya śakyā, tasyāṃ śakyatā'sti tādṛśaśakyatāvacchedakaṃ tu ghaṭavyaktireva| brahmasattāyā vyaktirūpopādhibhireva bheda iti siddhāntācceti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśa jāteḥ śakyatā avacchedakam ghaṭa tva tva ādikam na kiṃtu upasthita tvāt tva ādi pratyaya prakṛti vācyāḥ ghaṭa ādi vyaktayaḥ eva śakyatā avacchedikāḥ bhavanti brahma sattā rūpā yā ghaṭa tva jātiḥ sā ghaṭa tva śabdasya śakyā tasyām śakyatā asti tādṛśa śakyatā avacchedakam tu ghaṭa vyaktiḥ eva brahma sattāyāḥ vyakti rūpa upādhibhiḥ eva bhedaḥ iti siddhāntāt ca iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu śakyaniṣṭhasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ sarvatra dṛśyate| yathā śakyā govyaktiḥ, tanniṣṭhagotvasya śakyatāvacchedakatvam| svetarāvṛttitve sati sakalasvavṛttitvāt| svapadena govyaktigrahaṇena lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| vyaktiniṣṭhā hi jātiḥ, na tu jātiniṣṭhā vyaktaya iti kathaṃ jāteravacchedakā vyaktaya iti cenna|
analyzed: nanu śakya niṣṭhasya eva śakyatā avacchedaka tvam sarvatra dṛśyate yathā śakyā go vyaktiḥ tad niṣṭha go tvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tvam svetara avṛtti tve sati sakala sva vṛtti tvāt sva padena go vyakti grahaṇena lakṣaṇa samanvayaḥ vyakti niṣṭhā hi jātiḥ na tu jāti niṣṭhāḥ vyaktayaḥ iti katham jāteḥ avacchedakāḥ vyaktayaḥ iti ced na

original: śakyaniṣṭhasyaiva śakyatāvacchedakatve pramāṇābhāvena śakyādhikaraṇasyāpi śakyatāvacchedakatve bādhakābhāvāt| tathā ca svetarāvṛttitve sati sakalasvavṛttitvarūpādheyatāsaṃbandhena vyaktīnāṃ jātyavacchedakatvaṃ suvacamiti bhāvaḥ| atra svapadena vyaktirgnāhyā|
analyzed: śakya niṣṭhasya eva śakyatā avacchedaka tve pramāṇa abhāvena śakya adhikaraṇasya api śakyatā avacchedaka tve bādhaka abhāvāt tathā ca svetara avṛtti tve sati sakala sva vṛtti tva rūpa ādheyatā saṃbandhena vyaktīnām jāti avacchedaka tvam suvacam iti bhāvaḥ atra sva padena vyaktiḥ gnāhyā

original: yatpūrvaṃ prādhānyena jātivācināṃ ghaṭatvādiśabdānāṃ ghaṭatvatvādikaṃ śakyatāvacchedaktvamuktaṃ tadapekṣayedaṃ pakṣāntaramuktamiti dhyeyam| evaṃ jātiguṇādicaturvidheṣu śabdeṣu tatra tatra tvādyarthamuktvā śābdabodhamāha-tathā ceti|
analyzed: yat pūrvam prādhānyena jāti vācinām ghaṭa tva ādi śabdānām ghaṭa tva tva ādikam śakyatā avacchedak tvam uktam tad apekṣayā idam pakṣa antaram uktam iti dhyeyam evam jāti guṇa ādi caturvidheṣu śabdeṣu tatra tatra tu ādi artham uktvā śābda bodham āha tathā ca iti

original: ghaṭatvamityatra prakṛtyarthasya ghaṭatvadharmasya svetarāsamavetatvaviśiṣṭanikhilasvasamavetatvasaṃbandhena prakāratvādasādāraṇadharmalābha ityāśayenā''ha-ghaṭavṛttirasādhāraṇo dharma iti bodha iti| asādhāraṇadharmatvena bodho, natu jātyādineti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭa tvam iti atra prakṛti arthasya ghaṭa tva dharmasya sva itara asamaveta tva viśiṣṭa nikhila sva samaveta tva saṃbandhena prakāra tvāt asādāraṇa dharma lābhaḥ iti āśayena āha ghaṭa vṛttiḥ asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ iti bodhaḥ iti asādhāraṇa dharma tvena bodhaḥ na tu jāti ādinā iti bhāvaḥ

original: prakāratayā jātivācakaghaṭaśabdād ghaṭatvāvacchinno ghaṭa iti bodhāttatra ghaṭatvasya prakāratayā bhānāttatraiva tvādirbhāvapratyayaḥ, kiṃtu ghaṭatvasya ghaṭatvātmakaviśeṣarūpeṇa jātyātmakasāmānyarūpeṇa vā na bodho'pitu asādhāraṇadharmarūpeṇa bodha iṣyata ityāśayenā''haghaṭavṛttirasādhāraṇo dharma iti bodha iti|
analyzed: prakāratayā jāti vācaka ghaṭa śabdāt ghaṭa tva avacchinnaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti bodhāt tatra ghaṭa tvasya prakāratayā bhānāt tatra eva tu ādiḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ kiṃtu ghaṭa tvasya ghaṭa tva ātmaka viśeṣa rūpeṇa jāti ātmaka sāmānya rūpeṇa vā na bodhaḥ upitu asādhāraṇa dharma rūpeṇa bodhaḥ iṣyate iti āśayena āha ghaṭa vṛttiḥ asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ iti bodhaḥ iti

original: bodha ityasya ghaṭatvaśabdāditi śeṣo bodhyaḥ| ghaṭatvaśabdād dvitīyatvādibhāvaprayayacikīrṣāyāṃ prādhānyena tvādibhāvapratyayavācyaghaṭatvajāteravacchedakaṃ-ghaṭavyaktiriti tatraiva dvitīyabhāvapratyayaḥ| tathā ca ghaṭatvatvamityasya ghaṭavyaktirityarthātprādhānyena ghaṭavyaktirbudhyata iti jñeyam|
analyzed: bodhaḥ iti asya ghaṭa tva śabdāt iti śeṣaḥ bodhyaḥ ghaṭa tva śabdāt dvitīya tva ādi bhāva prayaya cikīrṣāyām prādhānyena tu ādi bhāva pratyaya vācya ghaṭa tva jāteḥ avacchedakam ghaṭa vyaktiḥ iti tatra eva dvitīya bhāva pratyayaḥ tathā ca ghaṭa tva tvam iti asya ghaṭa vyaktiḥ iti arthāt prādhānyena ghaṭa vyaktiḥ budhyate iti jñeyam

original: yaduktaṃ `siddhānte tu sthitaṃ pakṣadvayaṃ tvādiṣu tacchuṇu' iti tatra dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ vaktītyāśayenā''ha-pakṣāntaramiti| prakṛtijanyabodhe jātiguṇādivacchabdasyāpi prakāratayā bhāsamānatvāttattacchabda eva tvādibhāvapratyayavācya iti pakṣāntaramityarthaḥ| yadveti-kārikāsthayadvāśabdo yadvāśabdaghaṭitavārtikasūcnāyetyāha-tatsūcanaprayojanako'pīti|
analyzed: yat uktam siddhānte tu sthitam pakṣa dvayam tu ādiṣu tat śuṇu iti tatra dvitīyam pakṣam vakti iti āśayena āha pakṣa antaram iti prakṛti janya bodhe jāti guṇa ādi vat śabdasya api prakāratayā bhāsamāna tvāt tad tad śabdaḥ eva tu ādi bhāva pratyaya vācyaḥ iti pakṣa antaram iti arthaḥ yadvā iti kārikā stha yad vā śabdaḥ yad vā śabda ghaṭita vārtika sūcnāya iti āha tad sūcana prayojana kopī iti

original: tasya-yadvāśabdaghaṭitavārtikasya, sūcanaṃ prayojanaṃ yasya sa tathārthaka ityarthaḥ| apiśabdo ghaṭādivṛttirasādhāraṇo dharmastvādivācya iti pūrvoktapakṣasaṃgrāhakaḥ| yadvāśabdaghaṭitaṃ vārtikamanuvadati-yadvā sarve bhāvā iti| vārtikokterityuktyā'yaṃ pakṣo vārtikakārasaṃmata iti nātrāprāmāṇyaśaṅkā'pi kāryeti sūcitam|

original: bṛhad‌bhūṣaṇoktaṃ vārtikavyākhyānamāha-vantīti| vācakatveneti| vācakatāsaṃbandhenetyarthaḥ| pravartanta ityasyārtheṣviti śeṣaḥ| dhātūnāmanekārthatvād‌bhūdhāturatra pravṛttyarthakaḥ| pravṛttiścātra prayogarūpā| tathācārtheṣu vācakatvena prayujyante te bhāvā ityarthādbhāvaśabdo'tra śabdārthaka ityāha-bhāvā śabdā iti| svenārtheneti|
analyzed: bṛhadbhūṣaṇa uktam vārtika vyākhyānam āhavanti iti vācaka tvena iti vācakatā saṃbandhena iti arthaḥ pravartante iti asya artheṣu iti śeṣaḥ dhātūnām aneka artha tvāt bhūdhātuḥ atra pravṛtti arthakaḥ pravṛttiḥ ca atra prayoga rūpā tathā ca artheṣu vācaka tvena prayujyante te bhāvāḥ iti arthāt bhāva śabdaḥ utra śabda arthakaḥ iti āha bhāvāḥ śabdāḥ iti svena arthena iti

original: svasyārthe, ityarthaḥ| bhavantītyasyārthamāha-pravartanta iti| evaṃ ca sarve śabdāḥ, svasya vācyo yo'rthastena bhavanti tatra vācakatvena pravartanta iti vācyo'rthaḥ| arthapratyāyanāyaiva hi śabdaprayogācchabdapravṛttāvarthasya karamatvavivakṣayā svenārtheneti tṛtīyeti bhāvaḥ| śabdapravṛttau nimittabhūto yo'rthaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ|
analyzed: svasya arthe iti arthaḥ bhavanti iti asya artham āha pravartante iti evam ca sarve śabdāḥ svasya vācyaḥ yaḥ ṛthaḥ tena bhavanti tatra vācaka tvena pravartante iti vācya ūrthaḥ artha pratyāyanāya eva hi śabda prayogāt śabda pravṛttau arthasya karama tva vivakṣayā svena arthena iti tṛtīyā iti bhāvaḥ śabda pravṛttau nimitta bhūtaḥ yaḥ ṛthaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ

original: vācyaḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ ca| vācyaṃ ca dravyaṃ śabdo vā| pravṛttinimittaṃ ta ghaṭapaṭādijātiśabdeṣu ghaṭatvādijātiḥ, pācakādiśabdeṣu ktiyā, rājapuruṣādiśabdeṣu saṃbandhaḥ, ḍityādiṣu saṃjñetyādisarvamanubhavānurodhādavaseyam| ata iti| yataḥ śabdapravṛttau dravya-śabda-jātyādirūpo'rtho nimittamastītyato hetorityarthaḥ| sa iti|
analyzed: vācyaḥ pravṛtti nimittam ca vācyam ca dravyam śabdaḥ vā pravṛtti nimittam ghaṭa paṭa ādi jāti śabdeṣu ghaṭa tva ādi jātiḥ pācaka ādi śabdeṣu ktiyā rāja puruṣa ādi śabdeṣu saṃbandhaḥ ḍiti ādiṣu saṃjñā ityādi sarvam anubhava anurodhāt avaseyam atas iti yatas śabda pravṛttau dravya śabda jāti ādi rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ nimittam asti iti atas hetoḥ iti arthaḥ saḥ iti

original: dravya-śabda-jātyādirūpo'rtha ityarthaḥ| teṣāmiti| sarvaśabdānāmityarthaḥ| bhāva iti| pravṛttinimittamityartha iti samudito'rthaḥ| evaṃ ca jātyādivacchabdasyāpi śabdapravṛttau nimittatvācchabdo'pi śabdapravṛttinimittaṃ bhavati| sāre tu svenārthenetyatra svaśabda ātmavācī na tvātmīyavācītyāśayena svena rūpeṇetyuktam|
analyzed: dravya śabda jāti ādi rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ iti arthaḥ teṣām iti sarva śabdānām iti arthaḥ bhāvaḥ iti pravṛtti nimittam iti arthaḥ iti samuditaḥ ūrthaḥ evam ca jāti ādi vat śabdasya api śabda pravṛttau nimitta tvāt śabdaḥ api śabda pravṛtti nimittam bhavati sāre tu svena arthena iti atra sva śabdaḥ ātma vācī na tu ātmīya vācī iti āśayena svena rūpeṇa iti uktam

original: śabdasya svaṃ rūpaṃ śabda eva, na tvarthaḥ, tasyā''tmīyatvāt| tathā ca śabdāḥ svarūpe-śabdasvarūpe'rthe vācakatvena pravartante iti vyākhyātam| etadanurodhena `sa teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ' ityatra saḥ-śabdasvarūpātmako'rthaḥ, teṣāṃ--śabdānām, bhāvaḥ-pravṛttinimittamityartha ityuktam|
analyzed: śabdasya svam rūpam śabdaḥ eva na tu arthaḥ tasya ātmīya tvāt tathā ca śabdāḥ vācaka tvena pravartante iti vyākhyātam etad anurodhena sa teṣām bhāvaḥ iti atra saḥ śabda sva rūpa ātmakaḥ ṛthaḥ teṣām śabdānām bhāvaḥ pravṛtti nimittam iti arthaḥ iti uktam

original: etena sarveṣāṃ śabdānāṃ śabda eva pravṛttinimittamiti spaṣṭamevoktamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu śabdasya pravṛttinimittatvaṃ katham? śakye prakārasyaiva-śakyārthanirūpitaviśeṣaṇasyaiva pravṛttinimittatvāt|
analyzed: etena sarveṣām śabdānām śabdaḥ eva pravṛtti nimittam iti spaṣṭam eva uktam iti bhāvaḥ nanu śabdasya pravṛtti nimitta tvam katham śakye prakārasya eva śakya artha nirūpita viśeṣaṇasya eva pravṛtti nimitta tvāt

original: ghaṭaḥ, paṭaḥ śuklaḥ, pācakaḥ, ityādau jātiguṇakriyāṇāṃ ghaṭādidravyanirūpitaprakāratāyāḥ sarvānubhavasiddhatvāttattulyanyāyena śabdasyāpi dravyanirūpitaprakāratāṃ sādhayitumāha-arthavāditi| jātyādyarthavadityarthaḥ|

original: tathā ca dadhyādipadāntarāśravaṇasthale jāyamānadravyapratīteranyatha nupapattyā taddhitasya deyadravye śaktikalpanamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ| deyadravye taddhitaśaktikalpane sādhakāntaramāha-sāmānādhikaraṇyācceti| taddhitasya devatāmātrārthakatve, `indrābhinnadevatā' ityarthakasyaindrapadasya dadhyādipadena sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt|
analyzed: tathā ca dadhi ādi pada antara aśravaṇa sthale jāyamāna dravya pratīteḥ anyathā taddhitasya deya dravye śakti kalpanam āvaśyakam iti bhāvaḥ deya dravye taddhita śakti kalpane sādhaka antaram āha sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ca iti taddhitasya devatā mātra arthaka tve indra abhinna devatā iti arthakasya aindra padasya dadhi ādi padena sāmānādhikaraṇyam na syāt

original: yata aindradadhnoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena-abhedenānvayo bhavati tatastadanurodhena taddhitasya dravye śaktirāvaśyakīti bodhyam| kiṃca devatādadhnornāmārthayornirūpakatvādibhedasaṃbandhenānvayastu sutāraṃ durvacaḥ| nāmārthayorabhedānvaya iti vyutpattivirodhāt| tataśca deyadravye taddhitaśaktikaspanātmakaḥ pāśastavāpi gale patatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yatas aindra dadhnoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyena abhedena anvayaḥ bhavati tatas tad anurodhena taddhitasya dravye śaktiḥ āvaśyakī iti bodhyam kiṃca devatā dadhnoḥ nāma arthayoḥ nirūpaka tva ādi bheda saṃbandhena anvayaḥ tu sutāram durvacaḥ nāma arthayoḥ abheda anvayaḥ iti vyutpatti virodhāt tatas ca deya dravye pāśaḥ tava api gale patati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu devatāviśiṣṭadravye prakṛternirūḍhā lakṣaṇaivāstu, kiṃ pradeye taddhitaśaktikalpaneneti cenna| tathā sati pradeyasya prakṛtyarthatvaṃ taddhitasya tu tad‌dyotakatvamarthātparyavasannamiti kṛtvā pradeyasya prakṛtyarthanirūpitaviśeṣyatvānāpatteḥ| dyotyārthasya prakāratayā bhānaniyamāt|
analyzed: nanu devatā viśiṣṭa dravye prakṛteḥ nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā eva astu kim pradeye taddhita śakti kalpanena iti ced na tathā sati pradeyasya prakṛti artha tvam taddhitasya tu tad dyotaka tvam arthāt paryavasannam iti kṛtvā pradeyasya prakṛti artha nirūpita viśeṣya tva anāpatteḥ dyotya arthasya prakāratayā bhāna niyamāt

original: ata eva `striyām'iti sūtre bhāṣye'jākhaṭ‌vetyādau ṭābādibodhyastrītvasya pratyayārthatvena prādhānyādasattvarūpatvena ca tasya tatra vacanānupapattimāśaṅkya srītvasya dyotyatayā strītvaviśiṣṭā ajetyevaṃ strītvasya prakāratayā bhānānna tadgatasaṃkhyābodhakaṃ vacanaṃ, kiṃtu viśeṣyabhūtājāvyaktigatasaṃkhyābodhakaṃ vacanamiti nānupapattiriti
analyzed: atas eva striyām iti sūtre bhāṣya ija ākhaṭvā ityādau ṭāp ādi bodhya strītvasya pratyaya artha tvena prādhānyāt asattva rūpatvena ca tasya tatra vacana anupapattim āśaṅkya srī tvasya dyotya tayā strītva viśiṣṭā ajā iti evam strītvasya prakāra tayā bhānāt na tad gata saṃkhyā bodhakam vacanam kiṃtu viśeṣya bhūta aja avyakti gata saṃkhyā bodhakam vacanam iti nā anupapattiḥ iti

original: samāhitam| yadī ca dyotyatve'pi viśeṣyatayā bhānaṃ syāttarhi samādhānāsaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭevetyanusaṃdhāyā''ha-anyatheti| sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhātpradeye taddhitasya śaktyanaṅgīkāre, ityarthaḥ| na syāditi| asya vaiyākaraṇamata ityādiḥ|
analyzed: samāhitam yadī ca dyotya tve api viśeṣyatayā bhānam syāt tarhi samādhāna asaṃgatiḥ spaṣṭā iva iti anusaṃdhāya āha anyathā iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt pradeye taddhitasya śakti anaṅgīkāre iti arthaḥ na syāt iti asya vaiyākaraṇa mate ityādiḥ

original: vaiyākaraṇā hi pacati devadattaḥ, pacyate taṇḍula ityatrā''khyātasya kartṛkarmavācakatve svīkṛte sati ākhyātavācyayoḥ kartṛkarmaṇordevadattataṇḍulābhyāṃ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyenānavayo bhavatīti tadanurodhenā''khyātapratyayasya kartṛkarmavācakatvamaṅgīkurvate| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca prakāradvayaviśiṣṭaikavastubodhakatvam|
analyzed: vaiyākaraṇāḥ hi pacati devadattaḥ pacyate taṇḍulaḥ iti atra ākhyātasya kartṛ karma vācaka tve svīkṛte sati ākhyāta vācyayoḥ kartṛ karmaṇoḥ devadatta taṇḍulābhyām saha sāmānādhikaraṇyena anavayaḥ bhavati iti tad anurodhena ākhyāta pratyayasya kartṛ karma vācaka tvam aṅgīkurvate sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca prakāra dvaya viśiṣṭa eka vastu bodhaka tvam

original: ākhyātasya kartukarmavācitve sati tādṛśākhyātapratyayātkartṛtvena karmatvena vā yasyā vyakterbodho bhavati tasyā eva vyakterdevadattapadād devadattatvena, taṇḍulapadācca taṇḍulatvena bodho bhavati, ubhayatra viśeṣyabhūtā vyaktirekaiveti| evaṃ cā''khyātasya kartṛkarmārthe śaktasvīkāre sāmānādhikaraṇyopapattirbījamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: ākhyātasya kartu karma vāci tve sati tādṛśa ākhyāta pratyayāt kartṛ tvena karma tvena vā yasyāḥ vyakteḥ bodhaḥ bhavati tasyāḥ eva vyakteḥ devadatta padāt devadatta tvena taṇḍula padāt ca taṇḍula tvena bodhaḥ bhavati ubhayatra viśeṣya bhūtā vyaktiḥ ekā eva iti evam ca ākhyātasya kartṛ karma arthe śakta svīkāre sāmānādhikaraṇya upapattiḥ bījam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi tu sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhena taddhitasya pradeye śaktirna svīkriyate tarhi etattulyanyāyādākhyātasyāpi kartṛkarmaṇoḥ śaktirna sidhyet| tataśca pacati devadatta ityādāvanubhūyamānaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ durvacaṃ syāt, tathā aindraṃ dadhītyādāvapi sarvānubhavasiddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na ghaṭetetyāśayaḥ|
analyzed: yadi tu sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhena taddhitasya pradeye śaktiḥ na svīkriyate tarhi etad tulya nyāyāt ākhyātasya api kartṛ karmaṇoḥ śaktiḥ na sidhyet tatas ca pacati devadattaḥ ityādau anubhūyamānam sāmānādhikaraṇyam durvacam syāt tathā aindram dadhi ityādau api sarva anubhava siddham sāmānādhikaraṇyam na ghaṭeta iti āśayaḥ

original: bhāvanāyā antarā''śrayamavasthānāsaṃbhavādanyathānupapattyā''kṣepādinā lakṣyamāśrayamādāya, tathā `sā'sya devatā' ityatrāsyeti ṣaṣṭhyantapadaghaṭakaprakṛtyarthaṃ varjayitvā ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhe devatāyāṃ ceti militvā devatāsaṃbandhe taddhitaśaktikalpanena, saṃbandhena cānyathānupapattyā svāśrayasaṃbandhirūpadharmiṇa ākṣepādākṣiptaṃ dharmiṇamādāya
analyzed: bhāvanāyāḥ antara āśrayam avasthāna asaṃbhavāt anyathā anupapatti ākṣepa ādinā lakṣyam āśrayam ādāya tathā sā asya devatā iti atra asya iti ṣaṣṭhī anta pada ghaṭaka prakṛti artham varjayitvā ṣaṣṭhī artha saṃbandhe devatāyām ca iti militvā devatā saṃbandhe taddhita śakti kalpanena saṃbandhena ca anyathā anupapattyā sva āśraya saṃbandhi rūpa dharmiṇaḥ ākṣepāt ākṣiptam dharmiṇam ādāya

original: tasya devadatta-dadhyādibhirabhedenānvayānmīmāṃsakoktasāmānādhikaraṇyopapattistu sutarāṃ durvacā| ākṣepādinā labdhārthasya viśeṣyatayā bhānābhāvācchābdānvaye mānābhāvācca| anyathā ghaṭamānayeti vākyātsamavāyasaṃbandhenopasthitākāśasyāpi śābdānvayenā''kāśamānayeti bodhāpatteriti vibhāvanīyama|
analyzed: tasya devadatta dadhi ādibhiḥ abhedena anvayāt mīmāṃsaka ukta sāmānādhikaraṇya upapattiḥ tu sutarām durvacā ākṣepa ādinā labdhārthasya viśeṣya tayā bhāna abhāvāt śābda anvaye māna abhāvāt ca anyathā ghaṭam ānaya iti vākyāt samavāya saṃbandhena upasthita ākāśasya api śābda anvayena ākāśam ānaya iti bodha āpatteḥ iti vibhāvanīyam asya

original: evaṃ vaiyākaraṇān prati ākhyātasya kartṛkarmavācakatvasiddhyabhāvātmikāmāpattimuktatvā mīmāṃsakān pratyāha-mīmāṃsakānāṃ punariti| pratyayasya-sā'sya devatetyarthe vihitasya taddhitapatyayasya| devatātvameveti| devatātvaviśiṣṭadevatāyāṃ taddhitaśaktikalpanāpekṣayā lāghavād devatātva eva taddhitaśaktikalpanamucita| evakāreṇa devatāyā vyāvṛttiḥ|
analyzed: evam vaiyākaraṇān prati ākhyātasya kartṛ karma vācaka tva siddhi abhāva ātmikām āpattim ukta tvā mīmāṃsakān pratyāha mīmāṃsakānām punar iti pratyayasya sā asya devatā iti arthe vihitasya taddhita patyayasya devatā tvam eva iti devatā tva viśiṣṭa devatāyām taddhita śakti kalpana apekṣayā lāghavāt devatā tve eva taddhita śakti kalpanam ucitaḥ evakāreṇa devatāyāḥ vyāvṛttiḥ

original: dravyaṃ tu padāntarāllabhyata evetyuktatvāt| devatātvasya svanirūpakatvasaṃbandhena dravye'nvayo bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāyaḥ| tathā cendravṛttidevatātvanarūpakaṃ haviriti bodhaḥ| kartṛvadvācyatvaṃ mā'stviti| yathā mīmāṃsakamata ākhyātasya kartā na vācye'pitu bhāvanaiva vācyā lāghavāt| āśrayasya devadattādipadāntarāllābhasaṃbhavāt|
analyzed: dravyam tu pada antarāt labhyate eva iti ukta tvāt devatā tvasya sva nirūpaka tva saṃbandhena dravya anvayaḥ bhaviṣyati iti abhiprāyaḥ tathā ca indra vṛtti devatā tva narūpakam haviḥ iti bodhaḥ kartṛ vat vācyatvam mā astu iti yathā mīmāṃsaka mate ākhyātasya kartā na vācye pitu bhāvanā eva vācyā lāghavāt āśrayasya devadatta ādi pada antarāt lābha saṃbhavāt

original: padāntaralabhyāśraye bhāvanātmakakartṛtvasyānvayenaiva kartṛtvaviśiṣṭatvamāśraye budhyeteti bhāvaḥ| tadvatprakṛtasthale pradeye samabhivyāhṛtapadāntaralabhye taddhitārthadevatātvasyānvayenaiva devatātvaviśiṣṭatvasya pradeye lābhasaṃbhavāttaddhitapratyayasya pradeye śaktirna sidhyediti bhāvaḥ| nanu taddhitasya pradeye śaktyabhāva iṣṭa eveti cenna|
analyzed: pada antara labhya āśraye bhāvanā ātmaka kartṛ tvasya anvayena eva kartṛ tva viśiṣṭa tvam āśraye budhyeta iti bhāvaḥ tadvat prakṛta sthale pradeye samabhivyāhṛta pada antara labhye taddhita artha devatā tvasya anvayena eva devatā tva viśiṣṭa tvasya pradeye lābha saṃbhavāt taddhita pratyayasya pradeye śaktiḥ na sidhyet iti bhāvaḥ nanu taddhitasya pradeye śakti abhāvaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti ced na

original: `jāmikṣāṃ devatāyuktāṃ vadatyevaṣa taddhitaḥ' iti vacanena mīmāṃsakaiḥ pradeye taddhitaśaktyaṅgīkārasya spaṣṭamevoktatvāt| tataścātra cetsāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhena pradeye taddhitasya śaktiḥ kalpyate tarhi ākhyāte'pi kartṛvācakatvaṃ syāddevadattaḥ pacatītyatra kartṛdevadattayoranubhūyamānasāmānādikaraṇyānurodhāditi draṣṭavyam|
analyzed: jāmikṣām devatā yuktām vadati eva eṣa taddhitaḥ iti vacanena mīmāṃsakaiḥ pradeye taddhita śakti aṅgīkārasya spaṣṭam eva ukta tvāt tatas ca atra ced sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhena pradeye taddhitasya śaktiḥ kalpyate tarhi ākhyāte api kartṛ vācaka tvam syāt devadattaḥ pacati iti atra kartṛ devadattayoḥ anubhūyamāna sāmānādikaraṇya anurodhāt iti draṣṭavyam

original: nanvagnyādipadena śaktyaivāgnyādidevatāyā lābhe siddhe kiṃ lakṣaṇayetyata āha-devatātveneti| agnyādīnāṃ devatātparūpeṇopasthityarthaṃ lakṣaṇāśrayaṇamityarthaḥ| gaṅgāyāstīrasaṃbandhāvyabicāre'pi lakṣaṇāṃ vinā tīrapadārathānupasthitidgnyādīnāṃ devatātvāvyabhicāre'pi vinā lakṣaṇāmagnyādipadāddevatāpadārthopasthitirna syādityāvaśyakī lakṣaṇeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: nanu agni ādi padena śaktyā eva agni ādi devatāyāḥ lābhe siddhe kim lakṣaṇayā iti atas āha devatā tvena iti agni ādīnām upasthiti artham lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇam iti arthaḥ gaṅgāyāḥ tīra saṃbandha avyabicāre api lakṣaṇām vinā tīra padāratha anupasthiti dgni ādīnām devatā tva avyabhicāre api vinā lakṣaṇām agni ādi padāt devatā padārtha upasthitiḥ na syāt iti āvaśyakī lakṣaṇā iti bhāvaḥ

original: sā ca lakṣaṇā na prayojanavatītyāha-nirūḍheti nirūḍhāyāḥ svarūpaṃ nirvakti-anupapattīti| anvayādyanupapattijñānaśūnyatvaṃ, anāditātparyavattvaṃ vā, tattvaṃ-nirūḍāsvamityarthaḥ|| 54 ||
analyzed: sā ca lakṣaṇā na prayojanavatī iti āha nirūḍhā iti nirūḍhāyāḥ svarūpam nirvakti anupapatti iti anvaya ādi anupapatti jñāna śūnya tvam anādi tātparyavat tvam vā tattvam nirūḍā svam iti arthaḥ

original: devatātaddhitārthanirūpaṇaprasaṅgena smṛtānyataddhitārthaviṣaye'pyuktarītirevānusarvatyetyāha-krīḍāyāṃ ṇastadasyāstīti| ityatreti| tadasyāṃ praharaṇamiti niriktasūtravihitaṇapratyayāntadāṇḍādiśabda ityarthaḥ| praharaṇaviśiṣṭā krīḍeti| krīḍāyāṃ praharaṇavaiśiṣṭyaṃ cā''śrayāśrayibhāvasaṃbandhena, krīḍā-āśrayaḥ, praharaṇaṃ cā''śrayatīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: devatā taddhita artha nirūpaṇa prasaṅgena smṛta anya taddhita artha viṣaye pi ukta rītiḥ eva anusarvatyā ityāha krīḍāyām ṇaḥ tat asya asti iti iti atra iti tat asyām praharaṇam iti nirikta sūtra vihita ṇa pratyaya anta dāṇḍa ādi śabdaḥ iti arthaḥ praharaṇa viśiṣṭā krīḍā iti krīḍāyām praharaṇa vaiśiṣṭyam ca āśraya āśrayi bhāva saṃbandhena krīḍā āśrayaḥ praharaṇam ca āśrayati iti bhāvaḥ

original: asya `arthaḥ' ityatrānvayaḥ| artha iti| praharaṇaviśiṣṭā krīḍā dāṇḍetyatratyaṇapratyayārtha ityarthaḥ| tatra prakṛtyarthasya daṇḍasya praharaṇaviśiṣṭakrīḍātmakaṇapratyayārthaikadeśe praharaṇe'bhedenānvayaḥ| daṇḍābhinnapraharaṇāśrayaḥ krīḍetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: asya arthaḥ iti atra anvayaḥ arthaḥ iti praharaṇa viśiṣṭā krīḍā dāṇḍa iti atratya ṇapratyaya arthaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra prakṛti arthasya daṇḍasya praharaṇa viśiṣṭa krīḍā ātmaka ṇapratyaya artha eka deśe praharaṇe bhedena anvayaḥ daṇḍa abhinna praharaṇa āśrayaḥ krīḍā iti arthaḥ

original: padārtheḥ padārthenānveti natu padārthaikadeśeneti nyāyavirodhādekadeśānvayamasahamāna āha-prāharaṇakrīḍe iti| praharaṇe krīḍāyāṃ ca khaṇḍaśaḥ śaktirṇapratyayasyetyarthaḥ| tataśca naikadeśānvayadoṣaprasaktiriti bhāvaḥ| atra pakṣe'bhedena daṇḍānvitapraharaṇasya krīḍāyāmāśrayatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ|
analyzed: padārtheḥ padārthena anveti na tu padārtha ekadeśena iti nyāya virodhāt eka deśa anvayam asahamānaḥ āha prāharaṇa krīḍe iti praharaṇe krīḍāyām ca khaṇḍaśas śaktiḥ ṇa pratyayasya iti arthaḥ tatas ca na eka deśa anvaya doṣa prasaktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ atra pakṣe bhedena daṇḍa anvita praharaṇasya krīḍāyām āśraya tva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ

original: ubhayatra pṛthak‌śaktikalpane gauravaṃ matvā lāghavānurodhenā''ha-krīḍāmātramiti| mātrapadena praharaṇasya ṇapratyayārthatvaṃ nāstītyuktam| daṇḍādipadena śaktyaiva daṇḍādipraharaṇasya lābhasaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| praharaṇaṃ prahārasādhanam| prahriyate'neneti karaṇaghañā praharaṇaśabdasya niṣpannatvāt|
analyzed: ubhayatra pṛthak śakti kalpane gauravam matvā lāghava anurodhena āha krīḍā mātram iti mātra padena praharaṇasya ṇapratyaya artha tvam na asti iti uktam daṇḍa ādi padena śaktyā eva daṇḍa ādi praharaṇasya lābha saṃbhavāt iti bhāvaḥ praharaṇam prahāra sādhanam prahriyate enā iti karaṇa ghañā praharaṇa śabdasya niṣpanna tvāt

original: nanu daṇḍatvena praharaṇalābhe'ṣi praharaṇatvena tallābhārthaṃ praharaṇe ṇapratyayaśaktiristviti cet-daṇḍādipadasya daṇḍādipraharaṇe nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā svīkriyatām| asmin pakṣe prakṛtyarthasya daṇḍādipraharaṇasya svaniṣṭhapraharaṇatvanirūpakatvādisaṃbandhena krīḍāyāmanvayāddaṇḍādipraharaṇaviśiṣṭā krīḍetyarthātkrīḍāyāṃ praharaṇavaiśiṣṭyalābhaḥ|
analyzed: nanu daṇḍa tvena praharaṇa lābheṣi praharaṇa tvena tad lābha artham praharaṇe ced daṇḍa ādi padasya daṇḍa ādi praharaṇe nirūḍhā lakṣaṇā svīkriyatām asmin pakṣe prakṛti arthasya daṇḍa ādi praharaṇasya sva niṣṭha praharaṇa tva nirūpaka tva ādi saṃbandhena krīḍāyām anvayāt daṇḍa ādi praharaṇa viśiṣṭā krīḍā iti arthāt krīḍāyām praharaṇa vaiśiṣṭya lābhaḥ

original: atredaṃ bodhyam-yadā praharaṇe krīḍāyāṃ ca ṇapratyayasya pṛthakśaktikalpanaṃ tadā yadyapi haripadādupasthitayoraśvasūryayoḥ parasparamādhārādheyabhāvenā nvayavāraṇāya tatpadajanya-taddharmāvacchinnaviṣayakānvayabodhaṃ prati aparapadajanyapadārthopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāva āvaśyakaḥ|
analyzed: atra idam bodhyam yadā praharaṇe krīḍāyām ca ṇapratyayasya pṛthak śakti kalpanam tadā yadi api hari padāt upasthitayoḥ aśva sūryayoḥ parasparam ādhāra ādheya bhāvena anvaya vāraṇāya tad pada janya tad dharma avacchinna viṣayaka anvaya bodham prati apara pada janya padārtha upasthitiḥ kāraṇam iti evam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ āvaśyakaḥ

original: tenaikapadopasthāpyayorarthayoḥ parasparamanvayabodho'vyutpanna iti ṇapratyayopasthāpyayoḥ praharaṇakrīḍayorarthayoḥ parasparamanvayo(praharaṇaviśiṣṭakrīḍetyevaṃ)durvacastathāpi vyutpattivaicitryādekapadopasthāpyayorapyarthayoḥ parasparamanvayo bhavati|
analyzed: tena eka pada upasthāpyayoḥ arthayoḥ parasparam anvaya bodhaḥ vyutpannaḥ iti ṇa pratyaya upasthāpyayoḥ praharaṇa krīḍayoḥ arthayoḥ parasparam anvaya upraharaṇa viśiṣṭa krīḍā iti evam durvacaḥ tathā api vyutpatti vaicitryāt eka pada upasthāpyayoḥ api arthayoḥ parasparam anvayaḥ bhavati

original: yathā prācīnamate phalavyāpārayordhātoḥ pṛthak‌śaktāvapi phalasyānukūlatāsaṃbandhena vyāpāre'nvayo vyāpārasya ca janyatvasaṃbandhena phale'nvayo bhavati vyutpattivaicitryāttadvatprakṛte'pi jñeyamiti| kārikāyāṃ-eṣaiva digityasya devatātaddhitārthe yā ritiḥ proktā saiva rītirṇapratyayārthaviṣaye'nusartavyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: yathā prācīna mate phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātoḥ pṛthak śaktau api phalasya anukūla tā saṃbandhena vyāpāra invayaḥ vyāpārasya ca janya tva saṃbandhena phala invayaḥ bhavati vyutpatti vaicitryāt tadvat prakṛte api jñeyam iti kārikāyām eṣā eva diś iti asya devatā taddhita arthe yā ritiḥ proktā sā eva rītiḥ ṇa pratyaya artha viṣaye anusartavyā iti arthaḥ

original: ādipadasaṃgrāhyaṃ pradarśayati-so'sya nivāsa ityādi| atra nivasatyasminniti vasadhātorghañā niṣpanno nivāsaśabdo'dhikaraṇasādhano bodhyaḥ|
analyzed: ādi pada saṃgrāhyam pradarśayati saḥ sya nivāsaḥ ityādi atra nivasati asmin iti vasa dhātoḥ ghañā niṣpannaḥ nivāsa śabda udhikaraṇa sādhanaḥ bodhyaḥ

original: asyetyatra yadyapi prakṛtibhūtedamśabdopāttārthopasarjanakaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ saṃbandho viśeṣyatayā pratīyata iti tasyaiva pratyayārthatvaṃ prāpnoti tathāpi `āmikṣāṃ devatāyuktāṃ vadatyevaiṣa taddhataḥ' iti nyāyena ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhopasarjanakaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ pradhānatayā''śrīyate|
analyzed: asya iti atra yadi api prakṛti bhūta idam śabda upātta artha upasarjanakaḥ ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ viśeṣyatayā pratīyate iti tasya eva pratyaya artha tvam prāpnoti tathā api āmikṣām devatā yuktām vadati eva eṣa tat hataḥ iti nyāyena ṣaṣṭhī artha saṃbandha upasarjanakaḥ prakṛti arthaḥ pradhānatayā āśrīyate

original: tathā ca saṃbandhavān prakṛtyartha iti rītyā'syeti ṣaṣṭhyantasya saṃbandhītyarthaḥ paryavasyati| ata eva sā'syetyatredabhśabdopāttaṃ deyadravyaṃ devatāpratyayārtha ityuktaṃ purastāt| evaṃ ca nivāsaḥ saṃbandhī ca, so'syetyādisūtravihitanivāsapratyayārthaḥ| atrāpinivāsaviśiṣṭaḥ saṃbandhī pratyayārthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca saṃbandhavān prakṛti arthaḥ iti rītyā asya iti ṣaṣṭhī antasya saṃbandhī iti arthaḥ paryavasyati atas eva sā asya iti atra idam śabda upāttam deya dravyam devatā pratyaya arthaḥ iti uktam purastāt evam ca nivāsaḥ saṃbandhī ca saḥ usya ityādi sūtra vihita nivāsa pratyaya arthaḥ atra api nivāsa viśiṣṭaḥ saṃbandhī pratyaya arthaḥ

original: saṃbandhini nivāsādhikaraṇavaiśiṣṭyaṃ cā''dhārādheyabhāvādisaṃbandhena bodhyamnivāsaḥ saṃbandhī ca pṛthak‌pratyayārthaḥ,-kevalaḥ saṃbandhī vā pratyayārtha iti pūrvavatpakṣatrayaṃ bodhyam| strughno nivāsādhikaraṇabhūto'syeti sraughno devadattaḥ|
analyzed: saṃbandhini nivāsa adhikaraṇa vaiśiṣṭyam ca ādhāra ādheya bhāva ādi saṃbandhena bodhyam nivāsaḥ saṃbandhī ca pṛthak pratyaya arthaḥ kevalaḥ saṃbandhī vā pratyaya arthaḥ iti pūrvavat pakṣa trayam bodhyam strughnaḥ nivāsa adhikaraṇa bhūtaḥ usya iti sraughnaḥ devadattaḥ

original: atra prathame pakṣe srughnasya prakṛtyarthasya nivāsādhikaraṇaviśiṣṭasaṃbadhirūpapratyayārthaikadeśe nivāsādhikaraṇe'bhedenānvayaḥ, nivāsādhikaraṇasya cā''dheyatāsaṃbandhena saṃbandhinyanvayaḥ| evaṃ ca srughnābhinnanivāsādhikaraṇanirūpitādheyatāvatsaṃbandhyabhinno devadatta iti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: atra prathame pakṣe srughnasya prakṛti arthasya nivāsa adhikaraṇa viśiṣṭa saṃbadhi rūpa pratyayārtha eka deśe nivāsa adhikaraṇe bhedena anvayaḥ nivāsa adhikaraṇasya ca ādheyatā saṃbandhena saṃbandhini anvayaḥ evam ca srughna abhinna nivāsa adhikaraṇa nirūpita ādheyatāvat saṃbandhya bhinnaḥ devadattaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: dvitīyapakṣe'bhedena srughnānvitasya nivāsādhikaraṇasya saṃbandhini pūrvavadevānvayaḥ| tṛtīyapakṣe srughnapadasya srughnanivāsādhikaraṇe lakṣaṇā bodhyā| anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavadevāvagantavyam| srughnābhinnanivāsādhikaraṇasaṃbandhīti pakṣatrayasādhāraṇaḥ śābdabodhaḥ| nivāsaśca pratyāsattyopasthitapratyayārthasaṃbandhikartṛka eva grāhyaḥ|
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe bhedena srughna anvitasya nivāsa adhikaraṇasya saṃbandhini pūrvavat eva anvayaḥ tṛtīya pakṣe srughna padasya srughna nivāsa adhikaraṇe lakṣaṇā bodhyā anyat sarvam pūrvavat eva avagantavyam srughna abhinna nivāsa adhikaraṇa saṃbandhi iti pakṣa traya sādhāraṇaḥ śābda bodhaḥ nivāsaḥ ca pratyāsattyā upasthita pratyaya artha saṃbandhi kartṛkaḥ eva grāhyaḥ

original: sā'sminpaurṇamāsītiti| seti prathamāntātpaurṇamāsī asminnityarthe'ṇādiḥ pratyayo bhavati, prakṛtipratyayasamudāyaścesaṃjñā-rūḍho bhavatītyarthaḥ| puṣyeṇa yuktā pauṣī, pauṣī paurṇamāsī asminniti pauṣo māsa ityudāharaṇam| paurṇamāsī, rūḍhaḥ saṃbandhī ca pratyayārthaḥ|
analyzed: sā asmin paurṇamāsī iti iti sā iti prathama antāt paurṇamāsī asmin iti artheṇa ādiḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati prakṛti pratyaya samudāyaḥ ca isaṃjñā rūḍhaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ puṣyeṇa yuktā pauṣī pauṣī paurṇamāsī asmin iti pauṣaḥ māsaḥ iti udāharaṇam paurṇamāsī rūḍhaḥ saṃbandhī ca pratyaya arthaḥ

original: paurṇamāsīviśiṣṭaḥ saṃbandhī pratyayārthaḥ, paurṇamāsī, saṃbandhī ca pṛthagarthaḥ, kevalaṃ saṃbandhī ca pratyayārtha iti pakṣatrayamūhyam| atra pauṣyādiśabdo `nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kāla-' iti sūtravihitāṇantaprakṛtikaṅīvantaḥ| tatra puṣyādiśabdaḥ svārthatattannakṣatrayuktavandraparaḥ|
analyzed: paurṇamāsī viśiṣṭaḥ saṃbandhī pratyaya arthaḥ paurṇamāsī saṃbandhī ca pṛthak arthaḥ kevalam saṃbandhī ca pratyaya arthaḥ iti pakṣa trayam ūhyam atra pauṣya ādi śabdaḥ nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ iti sūtra vihita aṇ anta prakṛtika ṅīvantaḥ tatra puṣya ādi śabdaḥ svārtha tad tad nakṣatra yukta vandra paraḥ

original: anyathā sarveṣāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ sarvadā sattvena sarvadaivādya caitramaharityādiprayogāpatteḥ| atra yukta eva pratyayārthaḥ, natu kālo'pi lāghavena vastusata eva tasya pratyayotpattinimittatvaucityāt| aharādipadena tallābhasaṃbhavācca| tathā ca puṣyuktacandrayukteti pauṣīśabdajanyabodhaḥ|
analyzed: anyathā sarveṣām nakṣatrāṇām sarvadā sattvena sarvadā eva adya caitram ahar ityādi prayoga āpatteḥ atra yuktaḥ eva pratyaya arthaḥ na tu kālaḥ api lāghavena vastu sataḥ eva tasya pratyaya utpatti nimitta tva aucityāt ahar ādi padena tad lābha saṃbhavāt ca tathā ca puṣī ukta candra yuktā iti pauṣī śabda janya bodhaḥ

original: pauṣyādiśabdottarataddhitapratyayasya tādṛśapauṇamāsyadhikaraṇādirarthaḥ| tattatpaurṇamāsyāṃ puṣyādiyogāniyame'pi pauṣī paurṇamāsītyādau tattannakṣatrayogayogyataiva vivakṣitā| tattannakṣatrayogābhāve'pi caitrī paurmamāsī, caitro vaiśākha ityādiprayogācca| yogyatā ca svasvasamīpanakṣatrānyatarayuktatvarūpā|
analyzed: pauṣī ādi śabda uttara taddhita pratyayasya tādṛśa pauṇamāsī adhikaraṇa ādiḥ arthaḥ tad tad paurṇamāsyām puṣya ādi yoga aniyame pi pauṣī paurṇamāsī ityādau tad tad nakṣatra yoga yogyatā eva vivakṣitā tad tad nakṣatra yoga abhāve pi caitrī paurma māsī caitraḥ vaiśākhaḥ ityādi prayogāt ca yogyatā ca sva sva samīpa nakṣatra anyatara yukta tva rūpā

original: caitrādiśrāvaṇāntānāṃ māsānāṃ citrādidvaṃdvamadhye pasyacidyogastathāvidhabyavahāre prayojakaḥ, bhādrapadāśvayujostu śatabhiṣagrevatyāditrikānyatamayogaḥ, kārtikādimāgāntānāṃ kṛttikādidvaṃdvānyatarayogaḥ, phālgunasya tu p‌rvāphalgunyāditrayānyatamayoga iti vivekaḥ| taduktam-antyopāntyau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaśca tribho mataḥ|
analyzed: caitra ādi śrāvaṇa antānām māsānām citra ādi dvaṃdva madhye tathāvidha byavahāre prayojakaḥ bhādrapada āśvayujoḥ tu śatabhiṣa grevatī ādi trika anyatama yogaḥ kārtika ādi māga antānām kṛttikā ādi dvaṃdva anyatara yogaḥ phālgunasya tu prvāphalgunī ādi traya anyatama yogaḥ iti vivekaḥ tat uktam antya upāntyau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaḥ ca tribhaḥ mataḥ

original: śeṣā māsā dvibhā jñeyāḥ kṛttikādivyavasthayā|| iti| antyopāntyau-bhādrapadāśvayujau| bhaṃ nakṣatram| caitrādipadasya śuklapratipadidarśāntasamudāye rūḍhiḥ| kṛṣaaṇapratipadādipaurṇamāsyantasamudāye tu na rūḍhiḥ, tatra pracuraprasiddhyabhāvāt|
analyzed: śeṣāḥ māsāḥ dvi bhāḥ jñeyāḥ kṛttikā ādi vyavasthayā iti bham nakṣatram caitra ādi padasya śukla pratipadi darśa anta samudāye rūḍhiḥ kṛṣa aṇa pratipad ādi paurṇamāsī anta samudāye tu na rūḍhiḥ tatra pracura prasiddhi abhāvāt

original: paurṇamāsīghaṭitamāsasya cāndratvena tasya ca `cāndraḥ śuklādidarśāntaḥ' ityādismṛtibhyaḥ śiṣṭācārabāhulyācca śuklādidarśāntasyaiva grahītumucitatvāt| kṛṣṇapratipādipūrṇimānte tu lākṣaṇiko vyavāha iti jñeyam| tadusyāstyasminniti|
analyzed: paurṇamāsī ghaṭita māsasya cāndra tvena tasya ca cāndraḥ śukla ādi darśa antaḥ ityādi smṛtibhyaḥ śiṣṭa ācāra bāhulyāt ca śukla ādi darśa antasya eva grahītum ucita tvāt kṛṣṇa pratipādi pūrṇimā ante tu lākṣaṇikaḥ vyavāhaḥ iti jñeyam tat usya asti asmin iti

original: tadasyāstīti tadasminnastīti vā vigrahe'stisamānādhikaraṇātprathamāntādasyeti ṣaṣṭhyarthe saṃbandhini, asminnityadhikaraṇe cārthe matubbhavatīti tadarthaḥ| yadyapyasyetyukteḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandha eva matuvvidhānamiti pratīyate tathā'pi gaumāṃścaitra iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhātsaṃbandhinyeva matubvidhiryuktaḥ|
analyzed: tat asya asti iti tat asmin asti iti vā vigraheḥ ti samāna adhikaraṇāt prathamā antāt asya iti ṣaṣṭhī arthe saṃbandhini asmin iti adhikaraṇe ca arthe matup bhavati iti tad arthaḥ yadi api asya iti ukteḥ ṣaṣṭhī artha saṃbandhe eva matup vidhānam iti pratīyate tathā api gaumān caitraḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt saṃbandhini eva matup vidhiḥ yuktaḥ

original: tathā ca gomānityādau gonirūpitasvāmitvasaṃbandhavānityanvayabodhaḥ| atra saṃbandhī pratyayārthaḥ, saṃbandha āśrayaścetyubhayaṃ vā pratyayārthaḥ| atrāstīti vartamānakālo vivakṣitaḥ| anyathā gavādiśabdaḥ| evaṃca vartamānasattāvad‌gosaṃbandhīti bodhaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca gomān ityādau go nirūpita svāmi tva saṃbandhavān iti anvaya bodhaḥ atra saṃbandhī pratyaya arthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ āśrayaḥ ca iti ubhayam vā pratyaya arthaḥ atra asti iti vartamāna kālaḥ vivakṣitaḥ anyathā gavā ādi śabdaḥ evam ca vartamāna sattāvat go saṃbandhi iti bodhaḥ

original: gomānāsīdityādau tu gomatpadasya tatpadavyavahāraviṣaye lakṣaṇeti nānupapattiriti kaiyaṭādau sthitam| bhūmanindāpraśaṃsāsu--iti ślokavārtike saṃbandhasamakakṣatayā bhūmādyarthānāmupādānātteṣāmapi matub‌vācyatvaṃ yadyapi pratīyate tathā'pi sūtrādbācyavṛttyā bhūmādyarthānāṃ matubarthatvānupālambhātteṣāmastyarthavatprayogopādhitvameva yuktam|
analyzed: gomān āsīt ityādau tu gomat padasya tad pada vyavahāra viṣaye lakṣaṇā iti na anupapattiḥ iti kaiyaṭa ādau sthitam bhūma nindā praśaṃsāsu iti ślokavārtike saṃbandha samakakṣatayā bhūma ādi arthānām upādānāt teṣām api matup vācyatvam yadi api pratīyate tathā api sūtrāt bācya vṛttyā bhūma ādi arthānām matup artha tva anupālambhāt teṣām asti arthavat prayoga upādhi tvam eva yuktam

original: prayogopādhitvaṃ nāma-vācyatvābhāve'pi ārthikasattāmātreṇa śabdaprayoge-nimittabūtatvam| matubadyotyā iti yāvat| tathā ca matuprakṛtibhūtagavādiśabdānāṃ bhūmādyarthaviśiṣṭe lakṣaṇeti bhāvaḥ| ityādikamiti| ādipadāttasya pūraṇeo īṣadasamāptauo prakāravacane thāl, tasyāpatyamityādi grāhyam| pañcānāṃ pūraṇaḥ pañcamaḥ|
analyzed: prayoga upādhi tvam nāma vācyatva abhāve api ārthika sattā mātreṇa śabda prayoge nimitta būta tvam iti yāvat tathā ca matu prakṛti bhūta go ādi śabdānām bhūma ādi artha viśiṣṭe lakṣaṇā iti bhāvaḥ ityādikam iti ādi padāt tasya īṣat asamāptau prakāra vacane thāl tasya apatyam ityādi grāhyam pañcānām pūraṇaḥ pañcamaḥ

original: atra tasya pūraṇe, iti vihitasya ḍaṭaḥ-nāntādasaṃkhyāderiti maḍāgamaḥ| tasyeti saṃkhyeyārthakasaṃkhyāvācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyantāprakṛtyarthasaṃkhyāyāḥ pūraṇe vācye ḍaṭ syādityarthaḥ| pūryate'neneti pūraṇo'vayavaḥ sa pratyayārthaḥ| prakṛtyarthasya svaniṣṭhapañcatvasaṃkhyāpūrakatvasaṃbandhena pratyayārthe'nvayaḥ|
analyzed: atra tasya pūraṇe iti vihitasya ḍaṭaḥ na antāt asaṃkhya ādeḥ iti maṭ āgamaḥ tasya iti saṃkhyeya arthaka saṃkhyā vācinaḥ ṣaṣṭhī anta a prakṛti artha saṃkhyāyāḥ pūraṇe vācye ḍaṭ syāt iti arthaḥ pūryate enena iti pūraṇa uvayavaḥ sa pratyaya arthaḥ prakṛti arthasya sva niṣṭha pañcatva saṃkhyā pūraka tva saṃbandhena

original: prakṛtyarthaniṣṭhapañcatvasaṃkhyāpūraṇa iti bodhaḥ| yathā haristathā hara ityatra prakāravacane thāliti thāl‌pratyayaḥ prakāravadarthakaḥ| sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt| prakāraśca prakṛte sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ| evaṃ ca yadviśeṣadharmavān haristadviśeṣadharmavān hara iti bodhaḥ| yattad‌bhyāṃ dharmayoraikyāvagatau harisādṛśyaṃ hare paryavasyati|
analyzed: prakṛti artha niṣṭha pañcatva saṃkhyā pūraṇaḥ iti bodhaḥ yathā hariḥ tathā haraḥ iti atra prakāra vacane thāl iti thāl pratyayaḥ prakāra vat arthakaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt prakāraḥ ca prakṛte sāmānyasya bhedakaḥ viśeṣaḥ evam ca yad viśeṣa dharmavān hariḥ tad viśeṣa dharmavān haraḥ iti bodhaḥ yat tadbhyām dharmayoḥ aikya avagatau hari sādṛśyam hare paryavasyati

original: nanu sādṛśyameva thāl‌pratyayārtho'stu| tathā ca yatsadṛśo haristatsadṛśo hara ityanubhavasiddhaḥ sādṛśyaprakārakaḥ śābdabodha upapadyata iti cenna| sarvathā'nyatherathetyādau sādṛśyāpratīteḥ|

original: yathā saṃbandhasāmāyanye ṣaṣṭhītyādau kartṛtvakarmatvādisaṃbandhaviśeṣāṇāmavivakṣayā parityāgenaurvarito yaḥ saṃbandhatvasāmānyadharmāvaccinnaḥ saṃbandhaḥ so'sau saṃbandhasāmānyamityucyate tadvaditi bhāvaḥ|

original: evaṃ ca parityaktāḥ-kenāpi kāraṇenājñātāḥ, viśeṣā ekatvatvādiviśeṣadharmā yasyaitādṛśaṃ yatsaṃkhyāsāmānyaṃ=sāmānyarūpā saṃkhyā saiva ca tat-abhedaikatvasaṃkhaayāśabdavācyamityarthaḥ| asminnapyarthe vākyapadīyaṃ pramāṇayati-bhedānāṃ veti| bhedānāmiti| ekatvatvadvitvatvādiviśeṣadharmāṇāmityarthaḥ| parityāgāditi| agrahaṇādityarthaḥ| abhānāditi yāvat|

original: saḥ-ekatvādiḥ| saṃkhyātmā-saṃkhyātvarūpasāmānyadharmāvacchinnatvāsaṃkhyāsāmānyasvarūpaḥ| tathāvidhaḥ abhedraikatvasaṃkhyāpadavyavahāryaḥ| bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| abhedaikatvasaṃkhaayāpadavyavahāryatve saṃkhyātmeti heturuktaḥ|

original: yataḥ parityaktaikatvatvādiviśeṣadharmakaḥ sa ekatvādiḥ saṃkhyātvasāmānyadharmāvacchinnatvātsaṃkhyāsāmānyamityeva pratīyate'tastādṛśapadena vyavahriyate iti bhāvaḥ| nanu nirviśeṣasāmānyābhāvātkathamidamityata āha vyāpārājjātibhāgasyeti| vṛttāvupasarjanapade saṃkhyātvarūpajātereva vyāpārātsaṃkhaayātvenaivaṃ rūpeṇa saṃkhyābhānarūpavyāpārādityarthaḥ|

original: bhedāpoheneti| bhedasyaika tvatvādiviśeṣaṇadharmasyāpoho vyāvṛttistena vartate nāma viśeṣarahitasāmānyarūpeṇa vartata ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-vṛttāvupasarjanapadārthānāmapi sattvabhūtatvātsaṃkhyāyogāvaśyakatvena|

original: viśeṣasaṃkhyābhāvena ca sāmānyasaṃkhyārūpasya samastasaṃkhyāviśeṣānugatabhedāpoharūpasyābhedaikatvasya bhānād rājapuruṣa ityādau matadvaye'pi saṃkhyāvān rājapadārtha ityetāvatpratīyate, na tvavyayārthavadasaṃkhyo nāpi ghaṭādivaddhiśeṣasaṃkhyāvacchinna iti|
analyzed: viśeṣa saṃkhyā bhāvena ca sāmānya saṃkhyā rūpasya samasta saṃkhyā viśeṣa anugata bheda apoha rūpasya abheda eka tvasya bhānāt rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau mata dvaye pi saṃkhyāvān rāja padārthaḥ iti etāvat pratīyate na tu avyaya artha vat asaṃkhyaḥ nā api ghaṭa ādi vat hi śeṣa saṃkhyā avacchinnaḥ iti

original: saṃkhyātvenaiva ekatvādisaṃkhaayāpratiterviśeṣāṇāṃ tattadrupeṇapratīteśca bhedāpoho'tra bodhya iti bhāvaḥ| pūrvaṃ sarvauṣadhirasaviśeṣāṇāmekatra madhuni saṃsargamivopasarjanapade sarvasaṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāṃ saṃsargeṇāvasthānarūpamabhedakaitvamuktam| asmin pakṣe saṃkhyātvena saṃkhyāviśeṣāṇāṃ bhānaṃ, madhuni rasatvena rasaviśeṣāṇāṃ bhānamiva|

original: idānīṃ tu sarvasaṃkhyāviśeṣānugataṃ bhedāpoharūpabhedaikatvamuktamiti pūrvasmādviśeṣaḥ| asmin pakṣe sarvasaṃkhyātvena rūpeṇa saṃkhyāsāmānyasyaiva bhānaṃ natu viśeṣasyeti bodhyam| saṃkhyāsāmānyasyaiva bhānaṃ na viśeṣasyetyetadeva samarthayati-agṛhītaviśeṣeṇetyādinā| agṛhīto viśeṣaḥ śuklatvādirūpo yasya yanniṣṭhastādṛśena rūpeṇa|
analyzed: idānīm tu sarva saṃkhyā viśeṣa anugatam bheda apoha rūpa bheda eka tvam uktam iti pūrvasmāt viśeṣaḥ asmin pakṣe sarva saṃkhyā tvena rūpeṇa saṃkhyā sāmānyasya eva bhānam na tu viśeṣasya iti bodhyam saṃkhyā sāmānyasya eva bhānam na viśeṣasya iti etat eva samarthayati agṛhīta viśeṣeṇa ityādinā agṛhītaḥ viśeṣaḥ śukla tva ādi rūpaḥ yasya yad niṣṭhaḥ tādṛśena rūpeṇa

original: yathā dūrādrūpatvena rūpaṃ pratīyate, na śuklakṛṣṇādirviśeṣastathā rājapuruṣa ityādivṛktāvupasarjanapade saṃkhyātvena sāmānyasaṃkhyaiva pratīyate, na tvekatvadvitvādirviśaya iti bhāvaḥ| evamabhedaikatvasaṃkhyāśabdārtha nirvarṇya tad‌ghaṭitakārikārthaṃ pratipādayati-asyā iti| abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyā ityarthaḥ|

original: vigalitabhedāyāḥ saṃkhyāyā abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāśabdena vyavahāra iti bhāvaḥ| vṛttau-samāsādivṛttau bhānaṃ pratītiryuktisiddhetyarthaḥ| matasthitiriti| darśanāntara etādṛśasaṃkhyāyā anaṅgīkārād‌vaiyākaraṇānāmiti pūritam| abhedaikatvasaṃkhyāyā vṛttau bhāne pramāṇaṃ yuktimāha-ayaṃ bhāva ityādinā|

original: rājapuruṣa ityukte rājñā rājño rājñāṃ veti viśeṣajijñāsāyā anubhavasiddhatvādviśeṣajijñāsāyāśca sāmānyajñānapūrvakatvaniyamācchabdātsaṃkhyāsāmānyapratīterāvaśyakatvamityarthaḥ| sāmānyajñānapūrviketi| sāmānyajñānakāraṇiketyarthaḥ| tatpratītiriti| sāmānyarūpeṇa-saṃkhyātvarūpeṇa, tatpratītiḥ--saṃkhyāpratītirityarthaḥ| āvaśyakīti|

original: kāraṇībhūtasāmānyajñānamantarā viśeṣījajñāsodayāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca pīnatvānyathānupapattyā rājñibhojanamiva viśeṣajijñāsānyathānupapattyā vṛttāvupasarjanapadātsaṃkhyātvena saṃkhyāpratītiḥ kalpyata iti tātparyam| budhyate ca kvacitsaṃkhaayāviśeṣo'pi yathā dviputrastriputra ityādau| viśeṣasaṃkhyābodhakābhāve cābhedaikatvaṃ pratīyate|

original: nanu tumunādīnāṃ dhātorvidhānāddhātvarthaphale'pi prakṛtyarthatvāviśeṣāttatrāpyarthe tumunādayaḥ syurata āha-bhāva iti| dhātvarthapradhāne vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| ādipadaṃ ktvādisaṃgrahārtham| tumunādīnāṃ vyāpārārthakatve pramāṇaṃ vaktiṃ-avyayakṛta iti| vārtikāditi| avyayasaṃjñāprayojakāḥ kṛtpratyayā bhāva bhavantīti vārtikārthaḥ|
analyzed: nanu tumuna ādīnām dhātoḥ vidhānāt dhātvartha phale api prakṛti artha tva aviśeṣāt tatra api arthe tumuna ādayaḥ syuḥ atas āha bhāvaḥ iti dhātvartha pradhāne vyāpāraḥ iti arthaḥ ādi padam ktvā ādi saṃgraha artham tumuna ādīnām vyāpāra arthaka tve pramāṇam vakti avyaya kṛtaḥ iti vārtikāt iti avyaya saṃjñā prayojakāḥ kṛt pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti vārtika arthaḥ

original: bhāṣyakārā api tumunādīn bhāva evābhyupagacchanti| paraṃtu tumunāderasattvabhūta eva bhāvo'rthaḥ| pāka ityādāviva tumunādyarthe liṅgasaṃkhaayānvayānanubhavāt| tathā ca dhātvarthānuvādaka eva tumunādiriti paryavasyati| tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyāmiti tumunvidhāyakaṃ sūtram| asyārthaḥ-arthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasyāḥ sā kriyārthā|
analyzed: bhāṣyakārāḥ api tumuna ādīn bhāve eva abhyupagacchanti param tu tumuna ādeḥ asattva bhūtaḥ eva pākaḥ ityādau iva tumuna ādi arthe liṅga saṃkha ayā anvaya ananubhavāt tathā ca dhātvartha anuvādakaḥ eva tumuna ādiḥ iti paryavasyati tumun ṇvulau kriyāyām kriyā arthāyām iti tumun vidhāyakam sūtram asya arthaḥ arthaḥ prayojanam yasyāḥ sā kriyā arthā

original: tādṛśyāṃ kriyāyāmupapade sati kriyāphalakakriyāvācaka upapade sati dhātoḥ-arthāt‌phalabhūtakriyāvācakāddhātorbhaviṣyatyarthe tumunṇvulau bhavata iti| atra kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmityukteruddeśyatvarūpatādarthyamapi tumun‌dyotyam| tacca saṃsargaḥ| prakṛtyupapadārthayostādarthyavatsamānakartṛtvamapīhābhidhānabalalabhyaḥ saṃsargaḥ|
analyzed: tādṛśyām kriyāyām upapade sati kriyā phalaka kriyā vācakaḥ upapade sati dhātoḥ arthāt phala bhūta kriyā vācakāt dhātoḥ bhaviṣyati arthe tumun ṇvulau bhavataḥ iti atra kriyā arthāyām kriyāyām iti ukteḥ uddeśya tva rūpa tādarthyam api tumun dyotyam tat ca saṃsargaḥ prakṛti upapadārthayoḥ tādarthya vat samāna kartṛ tvam api iha abhidhāna bala labhyaḥ saṃsargaḥ

original: kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpavaijātyena tu na bhānam| tumunarthe kriyāntarākāṅ‌kṣādarśanāt| kārakānvayayogyatāvacchedakavaijātyena tu bhānamastyeva| etadvihito ṇvul kartaryeva|
analyzed: kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā anutthāpaka tā avacchedaka rūpa vaijātyena tu na bhānam tumun arthe kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā darśanāt kāraka anvaya yogya tā avacchedaka vaijātyena tu bhānam asti eva etad vihitaḥ ṇvul kartari eva

original: kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti, kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yātītyādau kṛṣṇakarmakaṃ bhaviṣyaddarśanoddeśyakaṃ darśanakartṛkartṛkaṃ yānam, kṛṣṇakarmakabhaviṣyaddarśanakartṛkartṛkaṃ taddarśanoddeśyakaṃ yānamiti rītyā bodhaḥ| ghañādivācyo bhāvaḥ siddhāvasthāpanna eva| pāka ityādau sarvasaṃkhyādiyogadarśanāt|
analyzed: kṛṣṇam draṣṭum yāti kṛṣṇam darśakaḥ yāti ityādau kṛṣṇa karmakam bhaviṣyat darśana uddeśyakam darśana kartṛ kartṛkam yānam kṛṣṇa karmaka bhaviṣyat darśana kartṛ kartṛkam tad darśana uddeśyakam yānam iti rītyā bodhaḥ ghañ ādi vācyaḥ bhāvaḥ siddha avasthā āpannaḥ eva pākaḥ ityādau sarva saṃkhyā ādi yoga darśanāt

original: siddhatvaṃ ca kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthāpakatāvacchedakaṃ yadbaijātyaṃ tadrūpavattvamityuktaṃ prāk| tatrāpi prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāpannasyaivopasthitiḥ| ata evaudanasya pāka ityatra odanasyetyasya kārakaṣaṣṭhītvaṃ, bhoktuṃ pāra datyādau tumun siddhaśca saṃgacchate|
analyzed: siddha tvam ca kriyā antara ākāṅkṣā utthāpaka tā avacchedakam yat baijātyam tat rūpavat tvam iti uktam prāk tatra api prakṛtyā sādhya avasthā āpannasya eva upasthitiḥ atas eva odanasya pākaḥ iti atra odanasya ityasya kāraka ṣaṣṭhī tvam bhoktum siddhaḥ ca saṃgacchate

original: ata eva bhoktuṃ gataḥ, devadattena grāmo gataḥ, kṛtapūrvī kaṭamityādau kārakāṇāṃ guṇabhūtakriyāyāmanvayo'nubhūyamānaḥ saṃgacchate| vastuto bhoktuṃ pāka ityādyasādhveva|

original: kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmityuktatvānpratyāsattyā nimittanimittikriyayorekajātīyatvalābhena yathā tumun‌pratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātūpasthāpyā nimittikriyā svaprakṛtikatumunarthaṃ pratyaguṇībhūtā sādhyāvasthāpannā gṛhyate tathā upapadabhūtāyā nimittakriyāyā api svaprakṛtikapratyayārthaṃ pratyaguṇībhūtāyāḥ sādhyāvasthāpannāyā eva grahaṇāt|

original: etadanusaṃdhāyaiva śabdenduśekhare tumunṇvulāvitisūtre bhaṭṭanāgeśairuktaṃ nimittabhūtopadakriyā cātra tiṅ‌ntopasthāpyaiveti| bhoktuṃ gata ityādau copapadabhūtā nimittakriyā gamidhātūpasthāpyā, sā ca svaprakṛtikaktapratyayārthakartāraṃ prati guṇabhūteti na tādṛśakriyopapade sati tumunaḥ sādhutvamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca tumun dhātvarthānuvādaka eva|
analyzed: etat anusaṃdhāya eva śabdenduśekhare tumun ṇvulau iti sūtre bhaṭṭa nāga īśaiḥ uktam nimitta bhūta upada kriyā ca atra tiṅ ntā upasthāpyā eva iti bhoktum gataḥ ityādau ca upapada bhūtā nimitta kriyā gami dhātu upasthāpyā sā ca sva prakṛtika kta pratyaya artha kartāram prati guṇa bhūtā iti na tādṛśa kriyā upapade sati tumunaḥ sādhu tvam iti bhāvaḥ evam ca tumun dhātvartha anuvādakaḥ eva

original: ata eva ghañādivācyo bhāvo bāhyaḥ prakṛtyarthāt, tumunādivācyastvābhyantara ityuktaṃ tumartha iti sūtre bhāṣye| evoktvāṇamulādīnāmapyasattvabhūto bhāva evārthaḥ| nanu ktvāpratyayasyāsattvabhūtabhāvamātrārthakatvasvīkāre samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāla ityādīnāṃ vaiyarthyāpattirityāśaṅkate-nanvityādi| kā gatiriti|
analyzed: atas eva ghañ ādi vācyaḥ bhāvaḥ bāhyaḥ prakṛti arthāt tumuna ādi vācyaḥ tu ābhyantaraḥ iti uktam tumarthaḥ iti sūtre bhāṣye eva uktvā ṇamul ādīnām api asattva bhūtaḥ bhāvaḥ eva arthaḥ nanu ktvāpratyayasya asattva bhūta bhāva mātra arthaka tva svīkāre samāna kartṛkayoḥ pūrva kālaḥ ityādīnām vaiyarthya āpattiḥ iti āśaṅkate nanu ityādi kā gatiḥ iti

original: pūrvakāla ityādīnāmupādānātpūrvakālādīnāṃ ktvāpratyayavācyatā pratīyate| bhāvamātrārthakatve tu tadasaṃgatiḥ| ataḥ kartṛtvādeḥ ktvāpratyayavācyatvaṃ svīkāryam| ktvāpratyayasya kartṛrūpārthavācakatvādeva roṭikāḥ paktvā'haṃ bhokṣya ityatrāsmacchabdāttṛtīyā na| ktvāpratyayena pākakarturabhidhānāt|

original: pākakarturbhojane svaniṣṭhakartṛtvanirūpakatāsaṃbandhenānvayātasamānakartṛkatvamapi labhyata ityāśayenā''ha-samānakartṛkatvādīti| ktvāvidhāyakaṃ tu `samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle' iti sūtram| tadarthastu-samānakartṛkayoriti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī| pūrvakāla iti karmadhārayaḥ|

original: samāna ekaḥ kartā yayostau, tayoḥ samānakartṛkayoḥ kriyārūpārthayormadhye pūrvakālaviśiṣṭakriyārūpārthavṛtterdhātoḥ ktvāpratyayo bhavatīti| tathā ca pūrvakālaḥ ktvāprakṛtyarthe prakāraḥ| pūrvakāla ityasya sthāne bhūta iti tunoktaṃ, lāghavānādarāt| bhūtatvena bodhānanubhavācca|

original: prācīnāstu samānakartṛkayoḥ krayārūpārthayormadhye pūrvakālasaṃbandhyarthavācakāddhātoḥ ktvetyarthaḥ| pūrvakāla iti ca bahuvrīhirityāśayaḥ| tataśca vākyaśakyoktasaṃbandhatātparyagrāhakāḥ ktvādaya ityabhipretyā''ha-ayaṃ bhāva iti| ekavākyateti|
analyzed: prācīnāḥ tu samāna kartṛkayoḥ kraya a rūpa arthayoḥ madhye pūrva kāla saṃbandhi artha vācakāt dhātoḥ ktvā iti arthaḥ pūrva kālaḥ iti ca bahuvrīhiḥ iti āśayaḥ tatas ca vākya śakya ukta saṃbandha tātparya grāhakāḥ ktvā ādayaḥ iti abhipretya āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti ekavākyatā iti

original: bhaviṣyadbhojanaphalikā vartamānakālikī pākakriyā, bhojanottarakālikaṃ vartamānaṃ vrajanamityevaṃrītyā ekakriyāmukhyaviśeṣyakabodhānamavādekavākyatetyarthaḥ| sarvasiddhā-sarvānubhavasiddhā| natu bhuṅkte pacati cetivadekakartṛkaṃ bhojanaṃ, ekakartṛkaṃ ca pacanamityevaṃ kriyādvayamukhyaviśeṣyakā bhinnavākyateti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: bhaviṣyat bhojana phalikā vartamāna kālikī pāka kriyā bhojana uttara kālikam vartamānam vrajanam iti evaṃrītyā eka kriyā mukhya viśeṣyaka bodha anamavāt ekavākyatā iti arthaḥ sarva siddha asarva anubhava siddhā natu bhuṅkte pacati ca iti vat eka kartṛkam bhojanam eka kartṛkam ca pacanam iti evam kriyā dvaya mukhya viśeṣyakā bhinna vākyatā iti bhāvaḥ

original: sā caikavācakyatā bhojanapākakriyayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvamantarā nopapadyata ityāha-anyatheti| viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaṃ ninā'pyekavākyatvāṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| ekavākyatāpatteriti|
analyzed: sā ca eka vācakyatā bhojana pāka kriyayoḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvam antarā na upapadyate iti āha anyathā iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvam ekavākyatva aṅgīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ ekavākyatā āpatteḥ iti

original: ekakartṛkā vartamānakālikī bhujikriyā, ekakartṛkā vartamānakālikī vrījikriyeti kriyādbayamukhyaviśeṣyatāśālī bodho'nubhavasiddhaḥ, natu tatraikamukhyaviśeṣyatāśālirūpaikavākyatā'nubhavasiddhetyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapādakaḥ saṃbandho'vaśyaṃ vaktavya ityāha-tathā cati| tayoriti| bhujipacikriyayorityarthaḥ|
analyzed: eka kartṛkā vartamāna kālikī bhuji kriyā eka kartṛkā vartamāna kālikī vrīji kriyā iti kriyā dbaya mukhya viśeṣya tā śālī bodhaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ na tu tatra eka mukhya viśeṣya tā śāli rūpa eka vākyatā anubhava siddhā iti arthaḥ evam ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva upapādakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ vaśyam vaktavyaḥ iti āha tathā ca iti tayoḥ iti bhuji paci kriyayoḥ iti arthaḥ

original: viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvanirūpakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ samānakartṛkatvapūrvottarakālitvavadanyo'pi bahuvidhaḥ saṃbhavatīti so'pi ktvādyotya ityāśayavānāha-janyatvamityādi| sāmānādhikaraṇyamiti| ekāśrayavṛttitvamityarthaḥ| ekakartṛkatvamiti yāvat| pūrvottarabhāva iti| pūrvakālavṛttitvottarakālavṛttitvasamudāya ityarthaḥ| vyāpyatvamiti| bhojanajaniketi|
analyzed: viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva nirūpakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ samāna kartṛkatva pūrva uttara kāli tva vat anyaḥ api bahuvidhaḥ saṃbhavati iti saḥ upi ktvā dyotyaḥ iti āśayavān āha janya tvam ityādi sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti eka āśraya vṛtti tvam iti arthaḥ eka kartṛka tvam iti yāvat pūrva uttara bhāvaḥ iti pūrva kāla vṛtti tva uttara kāla vṛtti tva samudāyaḥ iti arthaḥ vyāpya tvam iti bhojana janikā iti

original: bhoktuṃ pacatītyatra bhojanapacanakriyayorjanyajanakabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, sa ca tumun‌dyotyaḥ| tumunṇvulāyityatra krayārthāyāmityuktaḥ| kriyārthatvaṃ ca janyajanakabhāvarūpamiti bhāvaḥ pare tūddeśyatvanirūpakatvarūpaṃ tādarthyaṃ tumunādidyotyaṃ saṃsargatayā bhāsate, tacca-tadicchādhīnecchāniṣayatvam|
analyzed: bhoktum pacati iti atra bhojana pacana kriyayoḥ janya janaka bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sa ca tumun dyotyaḥ kraya arthāyām iti uktaḥ kriyā artha tvam ca janya janaka bhāva rūpam iti bhāvaḥ pare tu uddeśya tva nirūpaka tva rūpam tādarthyam tumuna ādi dyotyam saṃsargatayā bhāsate tat ca tad icchā adhīna icchā niṣayatvam

original: bhojanecchādhīnecchāviṣayatvātpākasya bhojananiṣṭhoddeśyatvanirūpakatvam| bhaviṣyattvamapi tumun‌dyotyam| tumunṇvulāvityatra bhavityatītyanuvṛtteḥ| tathā ca bhaviṣyadbhojanoddeśyako bhojanakartṛkartṛkaḥ pāka iti bodhaḥ| bhojanajanyeti| bhuktvā tṛpta ityatra bhojanatṛptyorjanyajanakabhāvasaṃsargadbhojanajanyā yā tṛptistadāśraya ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: bhojana icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya tvāt pākasya bhojana niṣṭha uddeśyatva nirūpaka tvam bhaviṣyat tvam api tumun dyotyam tumun ṇvulau iti atra bhaviti ati iti anuvṛtteḥ tathā ca bhaviṣyat bhojana uddeśyakaḥ bhojana kartṛ kartṛkaḥ pākaḥ iti bodhaḥ bhojana janyā iti bhuktvā tṛptaḥ iti atra bhojana tṛptyoḥ janya janaka bhāva saṃsargat bhojana janyā yā tṛptiḥ tad āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: gatyarthākarmaketi kartari ktapratyayavidhānāt| nanu bhuktvā tṛpta ityatra tatkartṛkabhojanānantaryavatī yā tṛptistadāśraya ityevamānantaryasamānakartṛkatvayoreva saṃsargatayā bhānamastu kiṃ guruśarīrasya janyatvasya saṃsargatayā bhānasvīkāreṇetyata āha-ata eveti| janyatvasya saṃsargatayā bhānasvīkāradevetyarthaḥ| na prayoga iti|
analyzed: gati arthā akarmakā iti kartari ktapratyaya vidhānāt nanu bhuktvā tṛptaḥ iti atra tad kartṛka bhojana ānantaryavatī yā tṛptiḥ tad āśrayaḥ iti evam ānantarya samāna kartṛka tvayoḥ eva saṃsargatayā bhānam astu kim guru śarīrasya janya tvasya saṃsargatayā bhāna svīkāreṇa iti atas āha atas eva iti janya tvasya saṃsargatayā bhāna svīkāra deva iti arthaḥ na prayogaḥ iti

original: bhojanajanyatṛptau jalapānānantaryasattve'pi pītvā tṛpta iti na prayogo bhavati| niruktatṛptau jalapānajanyatva bhāvādityarthaḥ| ya eva bhojanāśrayaḥ sa eva tṛptyāśraya iti bhojanatṛptyorekāśrayavṛttirūpasāmānādhikaraṇyasya saṃsargatayā pratīteḥ samānakartṛkatvamapi labdhamiti bodhyam| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca saṃsarga iti|
analyzed: bhojana janya tṛptau jala pāna ānantarya sattve pi pītvā tṛptaḥ iti na prayogaḥ bhavati nirukta tṛptau jala pāna janya tva bhāvāt iti arthaḥ yaḥ eva bhojana āśrayaḥ saḥ eva tṛpti āśrayaḥ iti bhojana tṛptyoḥ eka āśraya vṛtti rūpa sāmānādhikaraṇyasya saṃsargatayā pratīteḥ samāna kartṛka tvam api labdham iti bodhyam sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca saṃsarge iti

original: tathā ca bhuktvā vrajatītyatra tatkartṛkapūrvakālavṛttibhojanottarakālavṛtti tatkartṛkaṃ vrajanamiti bodhaḥ| pūrvottarakālavṛttitvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ceti dvayasya saṃsargatvena bhānādyādṛśo bodhākāraḥ saṃpadyate tamāhabhojanasamāneti| bhojanena samānādhikaraṇamāśrayo yasyā vrajanakriyāyāḥ setyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca bhuktvā vrajati iti atra tad kartṛka pūrva kāla vṛtti bhojana uttara kāla vṛtti tad kartṛkam vrajanam iti bodhaḥ pūrva uttara kāla vṛtti tvam sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca iti dvayasya saṃsarga tvena bhānāt yādṛśaḥ bodha ākāraḥ saṃpadyate tam āha bhojana samāna iti bhojanena samāna adhikaraṇam āśrayaḥ yasyāḥ vrajana kriyāyāḥ sā iti arthaḥ

original: ya eva bhojanakriyāyā āśrayaḥ sa eva vrajanakriyāyā āśraya iti bhāvaḥ| taduttarakālikīti| pūrvakālavṛttibhojanottarakālikī vrajanakriyetyarthaḥ| matprasūtimanārādhya prajeti tvāṃ śaśāpa sā(raghu vaṃ. sa.1 ślo.77)asya, avajānāsi māṃ yasmādataste na bhaviṣyatīti pūrvārdham| atra sthitasyetyadhyāhāraḥ|
analyzed: yaḥ eva bhojana kriyāyāḥ āśrayaḥ saḥ eva vrajana kriyāyāḥ āśrayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tad uttarakālikī iti pūrva kāla vṛtti bhojana uttara kālikī vrajana kriyā iti arthaḥ mad prasūtim an ārādhya prajā iti tvām śaśāpa sāraghu avajānāsi mām yasmāt atas te na bhaviṣyati iti pūrva ardham atra sthitasya iti adhyāhāraḥ

original: matprasūtimanārādhya sthitasya te prajā na bhaviṣyatīti surabhikartṛko rājakarmakaḥ śāpa ityarthaḥ| tathā ca sthitikriyāmādāya samānakartṛkatvādernirvāhānna ktvāpratyayānupapattiḥ| tathā ca sthitikriyāmādāya samānakartṛkatvādernirvāhānna ktvāpratyayānupapattiḥ|
analyzed: mad prasūtim an ārādhya sthitasya te prajā na bhaviṣyati iti surabhi kartṛkaḥ rāja karmakaḥ śāpaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca sthiti kriyām ādāya samāna kartṛka tva ādeḥ nirvāhāt na ktvāpratyaya anupapattiḥ tathā ca sthiti kriyām ādāya samāna kartṛka tva ādeḥ nirvāhāt na ktvāpratyaya anupapattiḥ

original: tathā ca matprasūtikarmakārādhanābhāvasamānādhikaraṇā yā sthitistādṛśasthityāśrayābhinnatvatsaṃbandhī bhaviṣyatprajākartṛkabhavanābhāva iti bodhaḥ| pūrvottarakālavṛttitve'vyavadhānāṃśo'pi niveśanīyaḥ| tena pūrvavarṣotpannaṃ śvaśuragṛhe bhojanaṃ sāṃpratikavarṣādhikaraṇakaṃ ca vrajanamādāya śvaśuragṛhe bhuktvā vrajatīti na prayogaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca mad prasūti karmaka ārā dhana abhāva samāna adhikaraṇā yā sthitiḥ tādṛśa sthiti āśraya abhinna tvad saṃbandhī bhaviṣyat prajā kartṛka bhavana abhāvaḥ iti bodhaḥ niveśanīyaḥ tena pūrva varṣa utpannam śvaśura gṛhe bhojanam sāṃpratika varṣa adhikaraṇakam ca vrajanam ādāya śvaśura gṛhe bhuktvā vrajati iti na prayogaḥ

original: tādṛśabhojanavrajanayodardhirghakālakṛtavyavadhānasattvādityarthaḥ| avyavadhānaṃ ca tātparyavaśātkvaciddaṇḍena kvacinmuhūrtena kvacitprahāraharādinā yathāyathaṃ grāhyam| tenādya bhuktvā śvo ganteti na prayogānupapattiḥ| nanvevaṃ pūrvottarakālatvādeḥ saṃsargatvāṅgīkāre mukhaṃ vyādāya svapitīti prayogo na syāt|
analyzed: tādṛśa bhojana vrajana yodardhiḥ gha kāla kṛta vyavadhāna sattvāt iti arthaḥ avyavadhānam ca tātparya vaśāt kvacid daṇḍena kvacid muhūrtena kvacid prahāra hara ādinā yathāyatham grāhyam tena adya bhuktvā śvas gantā iti na prayoga anupapattiḥ nanu evam pūrva uttara kāla tva ādeḥ saṃsarga tva aṅgīkāre mukham vyādāya svapiti iti prayogaḥ na syāt

original: svāpakāla eva mukhavyādānamiti vyādānasya svāpapūrvakālatvābhāvāt| tathā'dhītya tiṣṭhatīti prayogasyāpyanupapattiḥ| adhyayanasthityoḥ sahabhāvenāvasthānādadhyayanānantaryasya sthitāvasattvādityāśayavānāha-adhītya tiṣṭhatītyādi| atrādhyayanasahitasthiṣṭhatīti bodhaḥ| na tvādāvadhyayanaṃ kṛtvā taduttarakāle tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: svāpa kālaḥ eva mukha vyādānam iti vyādānasya svāpa pūrva kāla tva abhāvāt tathā adhītya tiṣṭhati iti prayogasya api anupapattiḥ adhyayana sthityoḥ sahabhāvena avasthānāt adhyayana ānantaryasya sthitau asattvāt iti āśayavān āha adhītya tiṣṭhati ityādi atra adhyayana sahitaḥ iti bodhaḥ na tu ādau adhyayanam kṛtvā tad uttarakāle tiṣṭhati iti arthaḥ

original: yadā hi tatkartṛkādhyayanottarakālikatvena tatkartṛkasthitirbodanīyatvena vivakṣyate tadā'dhītya tiṣṭhatīti prayogo bhavatyeva| atratyaprayogastu yadā yadā tiṣṭhati tadā tadā'dhyayanasahabhāvenaiva tiṣṭhatītyarthabodhanavivakṣayeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: yadā hi tad kartṛka adhyayana uttara kālika tvena tad kartṛka sthitiḥ bodanīya tvena vivakṣyate tadā adhītya tiṣṭhati iti prayogaḥ bhavati eva atratya prayogaḥ tu yadā yadā tiṣṭhati tadā tadā adhyayana sahabhāvena eva tiṣṭhati iti artha bodhana vivakṣayā iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ mukhaṃ vyādāya svapitītyatrāpi yadā yadā hi svapiti tadā tadā tu mukhavyādānasāhityenaiva svapitītyarthavivakṣeti bodhyam| tathā ca `abhāvakāle'prayogāt' pūrvakālikādhyayanasvāpottarakālikyau sthitisvāpakriye ityarthabodhanecchayā niruktaprayogayorakaraṇādityarthaḥ| na tu tādṛśe'rtha tādṛśeprayogau na bhavata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: evam mukham vyādāya svapiti iti atra api yadā yadā hi svapiti tadā tadā tu mukha vyādāna sāhityena eva svapiti iti artha vivakṣā iti bodhyam tathā ca abhāva kāle prayogāt pūrva kālikā adhyayana svāpa uttara kālikyau sthiti svāpa kriye iti artha bodhana icchayā nirukta prayogayoḥ akaraṇāt iti arthaḥ na tu na bhavataḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra yadā yadeti vīpsayā sthitisvāpayorvyāpyatvaṃ, tadā tadetyanena cādhyanavyādānayorvyāpakatvaṃ ca sūcitam| evaṃ ca vyāpakamadhyayanaṃ vinā kadāpi na tiṣṭhati, kiṃtu nirantarādhyayanaśālītyarthaḥ| tathā mukhavyādānaṃ vyāpakaṃ vinā kadāpi na svapiti, kiṃtu nirantaramukhavyādānavatsvāpaśalītyartha iti bhāvaḥ| kālaviśeṣāvacchinneti|
analyzed: atra yadā yadā iti vīpsayā sthiti svāpayoḥ vyāpya tvam tadā tadā iti anena ca adhyana vyādānayoḥ vyāpaka tvam ca sūcitam evam ca vyāpakam adhyayanam vinā kadāpi na tiṣṭhati kiṃtu nirantara adhyayana śālī iti arthaḥ tathā mukha vyādānam vyāpakam vinā kadāpi na svapiti kiṃtu nirantara mukha vyādāna vat svāpa śalī iti arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kāla viśeṣa avacchinna iti

original: tattatkālaviśeṣāvacchinnaṃ yattatkartṛmadhyayanaṃ mukhavyādānaṃ ca, tanniṣṭhavyāpakatānirūpitavyāpyatā tatkartṛkasthitisvāpayorbudhyata iti tatra vyāpyatvaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca saṃsarga iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca svasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitvādadhyayanaṃ vyādānaṃ ca vyāpakam|
analyzed: tat tat kāla viśeṣa avacchinnam yat tat kartṛm adhyayanam mukha vyādānam ca tad niṣṭha vyāpaka tā nirūpita vyāpya tā tad kartṛka sthiti svāpayoḥ budhyate iti tatra vyāpya tvam sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca saṃsargaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam ca sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvāt adhyayanam vyādānam ca vyāpakam

original: svaṃ-tatkālaviśeṣāvacchinnau sthitisvāpau, tadadhikaraṇaṃ-tādṛg‌devadattaḥ, tanniṣṭho yo'tyantābāvaḥ-adhyayanamukhavyādānayoratyantābhāvo nā''yāti, devadatte tayoḥ sattvāt|
analyzed: svam tad kāla viśeṣa avacchinnau sthiti svāpau tad adhikaraṇam tādṛś devadattaḥ tad niṣṭhaḥ yaḥ atyanta abāvaḥ adhyayana mukha vyādānayoḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ na āyāti devadatte tayoḥ sattvāt

original: apitu ghaṭātyantābhāvaḥ,pratiyogī ghaṭaḥ, apratiyogi adhyayanaṃ mukhavyādānaṃ ca, apratiyogitvaṃ ca tayo riti kṛtvā sthitisvāpanirūpitavyāpakatvamadhyayanamukhavyādānayorvartate| tathā svābhāvavadavṛttitvaṃ vyāpyatvam|
analyzed: apitu ghaṭa atyanta abhāvaḥ pratiyogī ghaṭaḥ apratiyogi adhyayanam mukha vyādānam ca apratiyogi tvam ca tayoḥ riti kṛtvā sthiti svāpa nirūpita vyāpaka tvam adhyayana mukha vyādānayoḥ vartate tathā sva abhāvavat avṛtti tvam vyāpya tvam

original: svaṃ-adhyayanamukhavyādāne, svābhāvaḥ-adhyayanavyādānayorabhāvaḥ, svābhāvavān-tādṛgdevadattaḥ, tad‌vṛttigamanapacanādi, tadavṛtti--sthitisvāpau, tadavṛttitvaṃ sthitisvāpayoriti kṛtvā adhyayanavyādānanirūpitaṃ vyāpyatvaṃ sthitisvāpayorbodhyam|
analyzed: svam adhyayana mukha vyādāne sva abhāvaḥ adhyayana vyādānayoḥ abhāvaḥ sva abhāva vān tādṛś devadattaḥ tad vṛtti gamana pacana ādi tad avṛtti sthiti svāpau tad avṛtti tvam sthiti svāpayoḥ iti kṛtvā adhyayana vyādāna nirūpitam vyāpya tvam sthiti svāpayoḥ bodhyam

original: tataśca kālaviśeṣāvacchinnetyādigranthasyāyamarthaḥ-tatkālavācchinnasvādhikaraṇoniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakādhyayanamukhavyādānatvavatsāmānādhikaraṇyarūpaṃ vyāpyatvaṃ sthitisvāpaniṣṭhaṃ tadbodhāditi| evaṃ ceti| janyatvādīnāṃ saṃsargatayā bhāne cetyarthaḥ| anyalabhyatvāditi|
analyzed: tatas ca kāla viśeṣa avacchinna ityādi granthasya ayam arthaḥ vyāpyatvam sthiti svāpa niṣṭham tad bodhāt iti evam ca iti janya tva ādīnām saṃsargatayā bhāne ca iti arthaḥ anya labhya tvāt iti

original: vākyaśaktilabhyatvānna teṣāṃ ktvāpratyayavācyatvamiti paramamūle yaduktaṃ `avyayakṛto bhāve' bhavantīti tatsamyageveti bhāvaḥ| itamatra bodhyam-samānakartṛketisūtravihitaktvāntaprayogasthale samānakartṛkatvāpūrvottarabhāvayoḥ saṃsargatayā bhānaṃ sārvatrikam| janyatvādīnāṃ tu tātparyavaśātkvacideva tathā bhānamiti|

analyzed: guṇa kriyā nirūpita kāraka śakteḥ pradhānī kriyā nirūpita kāraka śakti anurodhi tva anusaraṇe tu tiṅ anta upātta pradhāna buji kriyā nirūpita karmatva śakteḥ tiṅā abhidhānāt guṇa bhūta paci kriyā nirūpitāyāḥ tasyāḥ śakteḥ na dvitīya āpattiḥ iti saṃpiṇḍitaḥ ūrthaḥ

original: api ca vācakatvapakṣe ktvādīnāṃ janyatvavyāpyatvādinā'nekārthatvāpattiḥ| janyatvādīnāṃ vācyatve pratyayārthatvātprakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti nyāyena teṣāṃ viśeṣyatvāpattyā bhuktvā bhuktvā vrajītyatra ābhīkṣṇye dve vācye' iti dvitvānāpattiḥ| kriyāprādhānyabhāvāt|

original: naca siddhānte'pi ktvāntopasthitakriyāṇāṃ tiṅantopāttakriyāyāṃ viseṣaṇatvātkriyāprādhānyaviraheṇa bhuktvā bhuktveti dvitvānāpattistadavasthaiveti vācyam|

original: bhāvapradhānamākhyātamityasya pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti nyāyāpavādakatve pratyayārthāpekṣayā tatprakṛtibhūtadhātvarthasya prādhānyamityarthasyaiva vivakṣitatvena kriyāntaraṃ prati viśeṣaṇatve'pi ktvāntopāttakriyāṇāṃ na kriyāprādhānyasya hāniḥ| janyatvādīnāṃ ktvāvācyatve tu teṣāṃ pratyayārthatvena viśeṣyatvātkriyāprādhānyaṃ bhajyeteti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti asya pratyaya arthasya prādhānyam iti nyāya apavādaka tve pratyaya artha apekṣayā tad prakṛti bhūta dhātvarthasya prādhānyam iti arthasya eva vivakṣita tvena kriyāntaram prati viśeṣaṇa tve api ktvā anta upātta kriyāṇām na kriyā prādhānyasya hāniḥ janya tva ādīnām ktvā vācya tve tu teṣām pratyaya artha tvena viśeṣya tvāt kriyā prādhānyam bhajyeta iti bhāvaḥ

original: atredaṃ bodhyam-autsargikapratyayārthaprādhānyāpavādakena bhāvapradhānamākhyātamitivacanena tiṅantopāttakriyāyāḥ prādhānyabodhanātsnātvā bhuktvā pītvā vrajatītyādau vrajanakriyā(nirūpita)vadhikapūrvakālatvamādāyaiva sarvatra ktvā, natu bhojanādikriyāvadhikaparvakālatvamādāya|
analyzed: atra idam bodhyam autsargika pratyaya artha prādhānya apavādakena bhāva pradhānam ākhyātam iti vacanena tiṅ anta upātta kriyāyāḥ prādhānya bodhanāt snātvā bhuktvā pītvā vrajati ityādau vrajana kriyā nirūpita vadhika pūrva kālatvam ādāya eva sarvatra ktvā na tu bhojana ādi kriyā vadhika parva kālatvam ādāya

original: tathā sati tasyāpatyamityādāvekatvāderiva prakṛtesamānakartṛkayoriti dvivacanopāttasya dvitvasyāvivakṣāyāmapyamīṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ pūrvamānīyatāmityukte sarvebhyaḥ pūrva evā''nīyate, natu yasyātkasmāccit pūrvo madhyamastathā'trāpi snārereva ktvāpratyayaḥ syānnatu bhujyādeḥ| evaṃ snānādipānāntakriyāṇāṃ vrajanakriyāyāmevānvayaḥ|
analyzed: tathā sati tasya apatyam ityādau ekatva ādeḥ iva prakṛte samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti dvivacana upāttasya dvitvasya avivakṣāyām api amīṣām brāhmaṇānām pūrvam ānīyatām iti ukte sarvebhyaḥ pūrvaḥ eva ānīyate na tu yasyāt kasmāccid pūrvaḥ madhyamaḥ tathā atra api snāreḥ eva ktvāpratyayaḥ syāt na tu bhuji ādeḥ evam snāna ādi pāna anta kriyāṇām vrajana kriyāyām eva anvayaḥ

original: natu snānakriyāyā bhojanādau| guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāditi nyāyena snānādipānāntakriyāṇāṃ parasparamasaṃbandhādityarthaḥ| ata eva tatra bhuktvā pītvā snātvā vrajatīti viparītaprayogo'pyupapadyate| āvāhya ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjayedityatrā''vāhanaviśiṣṭe pūjane ṣoḍaśopacārairityasya karaṇatvam| pūjane āvāhanavaiśiṣṭyaṃ vā'ntaryasaṃbandhena|
analyzed: na tu snāna kriyāyāḥ bhojana ādau guṇānām ca parārtha tvāt iti nyāyena snāna ādi pāna anta kriyāṇām parasparam asaṃbandhāt iti arthaḥ atas eva tatra bhuktvā pītvā snātvā vrajati iti viparīta prayogaḥ upi upapadyate āvāhya ṣoḍaśa upacāraiḥ pūjayet iti atra āvāhana viśiṣṭe pūjane ṣoḍaśa upacāraiḥ iti asya karaṇa tvam pūjane āvāhana vaiśiṣṭyam vāntarya saṃbandhena

original: tathāca āvāhanottarakālikaṃ ṣoḍaśopacārakaraṇakaṃ pūjanamityarthabodhādāvāhanasya ṣoḍaśopacārāntargatatve'pi na doṣa iti bodhyamityalam|| 59 ||
analyzed: tathā ca āvāhana uttara kālikam ṣoḍaśa upacāra karaṇakam pūjanam iti artha bodhāt āvāhanasya ṣoḍaśa upacāra antargata tve pi na doṣaḥ iti bodhyam iti alam 59

original: pūrvoktaprakṛtipratyayādyarthavicārasyāvāstavikatvaṃ dhvanayitumāha-siddhānteti| sphoṭasyaiva vācakatvamiti siddhāntaniścayamityarthaḥ| āha-brūte-vākyasphoṭo'tīti| aṣṭo pakṣā iti| tānevāṣṭa pakṣān‌krameṇa nāmato nirdiśativarmasphoṭa ityādinā| aṇḍapadavākyeti| akhaṇḍapadasphoṭo'khaṇḍamākyasphoṭaśceti dvayamityarthaḥ| jātisphoṭā iti|
analyzed: pūrva ukta prakṛti pratyaya ādi artha vicārasya avāstavika tvam dhvanayitum āha siddhānta iti sphoṭasya eva vācaka tvam iti siddhānta niścayam iti arthaḥ āha brūte vākya sphoṭaḥ iti aṣṭa pakṣāḥ iti tān eva aṣṭa pakṣān krameṇa nāmataḥ nirdiśati varma sphoṭaḥ ityādinā aṇḍa pada vākya iti akhaṇḍa pada sphoṭa ukhaṇḍa mākya sphoṭaḥ ca iti dvayam iti arthaḥ jāti sphoṭāḥ iti

original: varṇajātispoṭaḥ, padajātisphoṭo, vākyajātisphoṭa iti traya ityarthaḥ| padasya vākyasya cākhaṇḍatve'pi tatra jātirnāstīti na mantavyam| ata eva caramaṃ pakṣadvayamūd‌bhūtamiti jñeyam| sphuṭati prakāśate'rtho'smāditi vyutpattyā'rthabodhakaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭa iti paryavasyati|
analyzed: varṇa jāti spoṭaḥ pada jāti sphoṭaḥ vākya jāti sphoṭaḥ iti trayaḥ iti arthaḥ padasya vākyasya ca akhaṇḍa tve pi tatra jātiḥ na asti iti na mantavyam atas eva caramam pakṣa dvayam ūdbhūtam iti jñeyam sphuṭati prakāśate ṛthaḥ usmāt iti vyutpattyā artha bodhakaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭaḥ iti paryavasyati

original: uccāritādvyañjakācchabdāttatsadṛśasphoṭākhyaśabdasya jñānaṃ tasmāccārthajñānamiti kramaḥ| śabdanityatvavicāre sphoṭākhyaśabd eva nityaḥ sa eva ttārthavānityaṣṭānāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ bhāṣyādyākarasaṃmatatayā vyāvartyābhāvādvākvagrahaṇaṃ vyarthamityāha-anardhakamiti| durarthakaṃ ceti| bhāṣyasiddhāntasiddhavarmādītarasphoṭānāṃ vyāvṛttibodhakatvādityarthaḥ|
analyzed: uccāritāt vyañjakāt śabdāt tad sadṛśa sphoṭa ākhya śabdasya jñānam tasmāt ca artha jñānam iti kramaḥ śabda nitya tva vicāre sphoṭa ākhya śabdaḥ eva nityaḥ saḥ eva tta arthavān iti aṣṭānām pakṣāṇām bhāṣya ādi ākara saṃmata tayā vyāvartya abhāvāt vāku agrahaṇam vyartham iti āha anardhakam iti durarthakam ca iti bhāṣya siddhānta siddha varma ādi itara sphoṭānām vyāvṛtti bodhaka tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kimarthaṃ tarhi vākyagrahaṇamata āha-vākyasphoṭātiriktānāmiti| avāstavatvamiti| aṣṭānāṃ sphoṭānāṃ madhye vākyasphoṭa eva mukhyaḥ| śaktigrāhakaśiromaṇinā vṛddhavyavahāreṇa prathamato vākya vākya eva śaktigraheṇa lāke vākyasphoṭasyaivārthabodhakatvāt|
analyzed: nanu kimartham tarhi vākya grahaṇam atas āha vākya sphoṭa atiriktānām iti avāstava tvam iti aṣṭānām sphoṭānām madhye vākya sphoṭaḥ eva mukhyaḥ śakti grāhaka śiromaṇinā vṛddha vyavahāreṇa prathamatas vākye eva śakti graheṇa vākya sphoṭasya eva artha bodhaka tvāt

original: varṇasphoṭādīnāṃ tu kevalaṃ sāsraprakriyānirvāhāya svīkāra ityarthaḥ|etadāśayenaivā''ha-atiniṣkarṣa iti| iti matasthitiriti| vaiyākaraṇānāṃ mahābhāṣyakārādīnāmityarthaḥ| sphoṭaśabdasya paṅgajādiśabdavadyogarūḍhatvena vākyasphoṭa ityasya vākya vācakamityarthaḥ| evaṃ varṇasphoṭānīnāṃ varṇādayo vācakā ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: varṇa sphoṭa ādīnām tu kevalam sāsra prakriyā nirvāhāya svīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ etad āśayena eva āha ati niṣkarṣaḥ iti iti mata sthitiḥ iti vaiyākaraṇānām mahābhāṣyakāra ādīnām iti arthaḥ sphoṭa śabdasya paṅgaja ādi śabda vat yoga rūḍha tvena vākya sphoṭaḥ iti asya vākya vācakam iti arthaḥ evam varṇa sphoṭa anīnām varṇa ādayaḥ vācakāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatra krameṇa sarvāṃstānnirūpayan prathamaṃ tāvadvarmasphoṭamāha-sādhuśabde'ntariti| vipratipattirvivādaḥ| atra naiyāyikā evamāhuḥ-sādhuśabdaghaṭatibravisargādibhiḥ samāritā lādayaḥ svādayaśca sthānibhūtā eva vācakāḥ| la karmaṇi cao svaujasamityādibhisteṣāmeva vācakatvasya pratipāditatvāt|
analyzed: tatra krameṇa sarvān tān nirūpayan prathamam tāvat varmasphoṭam āha sādhu śabdentar iti vipratipattiḥ vivādaḥ atra naiyāyikāḥ evam āhuḥ sādhu śabda ghaṭa ti bra visarga ādibhiḥ samāritāḥ la ādayaḥ su ādayaḥ ca sthāni bhūtāḥ eva vācakāḥ karmaṇi svaujasam ityādibhiḥ teṣām eva vācaka tvasya pratipādita tvāt

original: tibvisargādīnāṃ tvādeśilakārādismṛtidvārā bodhakatvaṃ lipivaditi| tathā ca lakārādayo vācakā iti vidhikoṭiranyeṣāṃ naiyāyikānāmityarthaḥ| lādayo vācakā neti niṣedhakoṭirasmākaṃ vaiyākaraṇānāmityarthaḥ| evaṃ cā''deśadvārā sādhuśabdāntagatāḥ sthānibhūtā lādayaḥ svādayaśca vācakā na veti vipratipattiśarīramiti phalati|
analyzed: tip visarga ādīnām tu ādeśi lakāra ādi smṛti dvārā bodhaka tvam lipi vat iti tathā ca lakāra ādayaḥ vācakāḥ iti vidhi koṭiḥ anyeṣām naiyāyikānām iti arthaḥ la ādayaḥ vācakāḥ na iti niṣedha koṭiḥ asmākam vaiyākaraṇānām iti arthaḥ evam ca ādeśa dvārā sādhu śabda anta gatāḥ sthāni bhūtāḥ la ādayaḥ su ādayaḥ ca vācakāḥ na vā iti vipratipatti śarīram iti phalati

original: yadi tu sādhuśabdāntargatāstib‌visargādayo vācakā na veti vipratipattiśarīramabhyupagamyeta tarhi vidhikoṭiranyeṣāṃ, niṣedhakoṭirvaivākaraṇānāmityuttaragranthaḥ procyamāno'tyantaṃ visaṃgataḥ syāt| naiyāyikaistibādīnāṃ vācakatvasyānabhyupagamāt| vaiyākaraṇaistibādīnāmeva vācakatvasya siddhāntitatvācca|
analyzed: yadi tu sādhu śabda antargatāḥ tip visarga ādayaḥ vācakāḥ na vā iti vipratipatti śarīram abhyupagamyeta tarhi vidhi koṭiḥ anyeṣām niṣedha koṭiḥ vaivākaraṇānām iti uttara granthaḥ procyamānā utyantam visaṃgataḥ syāt naiyāyikaiḥ tip ādīnām vācaka tvasya anabhyupagamāt vaiyākaraṇaiḥ tip ādīnām eva vācaka tvasya siddhāntita tvāt ca
