analyzed: yat vā nayana anayana ādi vyavahāhasya loḍa ādi vidhi pratyaya anta prayogam vinā anupapatteḥ tena prayogeṇa vidhi pratyaya anta prayoga antaḥpāti varmānām vācaka tva siddhau api vidhi pratyaya rahita prayoga ghaṭaka varṇānām vācaka tvam laḥ karmaṇi ca ityādi śāstra vihitam eva aṅgīkartavyam

original: śāstreṇa cā''deśini lādāveva śaktirukteti vidhipratyayāntāntargatavarṇānāṃ vācakatāyāḥ siddhāvanyatrāpi ādeśiṣu sā kalpanīyetyaruceḥ sādhakāntaramāha-kiṃ ceti| taddhetunyāyata iti| taddhetoreva tadastu kiṃ teneti nyāyasvarūpam| tasya hetustaddhetustasya taddhetoriti vigrahaḥ|
analyzed: śāstreṇa ca ādeśini la ādau eva śaktiḥ uktā iti vidhi pratyaya anta antargata varṇānām vācaka tāyāḥ siddhau anyatra api ādeśiṣu sā kalpanīyā iti aruceḥ sādhaka antaram āha kim ca iti tad hetu nyāyataḥ iti tad hetoḥ eva tat astu kim tena iti nyāya svarūpam tasya hetuḥ tad hetuḥ tasya tad hetoḥ iti vigrahaḥ

original: tasya-kapālādeḥ, hetoḥ-mṛdādereva, tat-ghaṭādikāraṇatvaṃ, astu kiṃ tenāntargaḍunā kapālādirūpakāryeṇetyarthaḥ| lāghavamūlakaścāyaṃ nyāyaḥ| kapālādikāraṇasya mṛdādereva ghaṭādikāraṇatvakalpanenaikasminneva kāraṇatvamiti lāghavaṃ, satyevaṃ punaḥ kapālāderapi| ghaṭādikāraṇatvakalpane tūbhayatra kāraṇatvakalpanayā gauravāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tasya kapāla ādeḥ hetoḥ mṛd ādeḥ eva tat ghaṭa ādi kāraṇatvam astu kim tena antargaḍunā kapāla ādi rūpa kāryeṇa iti arthaḥ lāghava mūlakaḥ ca ayam nyāyaḥ kapāla ādi kāraṇasya mṛd ādeḥ eva ghaṭa ādi kāraṇa tva kalpanena ekasmin eva kāraṇa tvam iti lāghavam sati evam punar kapāla ādeḥ api ghaṭa ādi kāraṇa tva kalpane tu ubhayatra kāraṇa tva kalpanayā gauravāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: taddhetorevetyādyākārako nyāyastaddhetunyāyaḥ| taddhetunyāyapadayoḥ saṃbhāvanāpūrvapadakaḥ karmadhāraya iti tātparyam| tamimaṃ nyāyaṃ prakṛte saṃgamayati-lakārasyeti| ādeśina ityarthaḥ| bodhakatve-vācakatāśaktimattve, abyupagate satīti śeṣaḥ| `bhū-la' ityato'pīti| alaukikaprakriyāvākyato'pītyarthaḥ bodhāpattirita|
analyzed: tad hetoḥ eva ityādi ākārakaḥ nyāyaḥ tad hetu nyāyaḥ tad hetu nyāya padayoḥ saṃbhāvanā pūrva padakaḥ karmadhārayaḥ iti tātparyam tam imam nyāyam prakṛte saṃgamayati lakārasya iti ādeśinaḥ iti arthaḥ bodhaka tva vācakatā śaktimat tve a byupagate sati iti śeṣaḥ iti atas api iti alaukika prakriyā vākyatā upi iti arthaḥ bodha āpattiḥ itas tatas api iti arthaḥ bodha āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ bodha āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: sattākartṛkabodhapratītyāpattirityarthaḥ| tādṛśavākyāttādṛśārthabodho lokānāṃ naiva jāyata ityanubhavaviruddhaṃ sthānino vācakatvamiti bhāvaḥ| tādṛśabodha iti| ekakartṛkavartamānakālikasattānukūlo vyāpārā ityākārake āpādite bodha ityarthaḥ| bhav‌-atīti samabhivyāhāro'pīti|
analyzed: sattā kartṛka bodha pratīti āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ tādṛśa vākyāt tādṛśa artha bodhaḥ lokānām na eva jāyate iti anubhava viruddham sthāninaḥ vācaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ tādṛśa bodhe iti eka kartṛka vartamāna kālika sattā anukūlaḥ vyāpārāḥ iti ākārake āpādite bodhaḥ iti arthaḥ bhavati iti samabhivyāhāraḥ upi iti

original: avyavahitottaratvasaṃbandhena bhūdhātuviśiṣṭātighaṭitaṃ bhavatīti śabdarūpaṃ sahoccāraṇamapi kāraṇatvenābhyupeyata iti cedityarthaḥ| tathā ca samabhivyāhṛtātibādyādeśādupasthito yaḥ sthānī lakāraḥ sa eva vācakaḥ, natu sākṣāduccārita iti bhāvaḥ| āvaśyakatvāditi|
analyzed: avyavahita uttara tva saṃbandhena bhū dhātu viśiṣṭa ati ghaṭitam bhavati iti śabda rūpam saha uccāraṇam api kāraṇatvena abhyupeyate iti ced iti arthaḥ tathā ca samabhivyāhṛta atip ādi ādeśāt upasthitaḥ yaḥ sthānī lakāraḥ saḥ eva vācakaḥ na tu sākṣāt uccāritaḥ iti bhāvaḥ āvaśyaka tvāt iti

original: pīnatvānyathānupapattyā rātribhojanasyeva bhū-la, ityasya bodhajanakatvānyathānupapattyā bhavatītyādisamabhivyāhārasyā''vaśyakatvātyantāpekṣitvāttadṛśasamabhivyāhārasyaiva vācakatvarūpā śaktiḥ svīkriyatāṃ lāghavādityarthaḥ sthānino vācakatvābhyupaganturgauravaṃ bhavatītyāha-anyatheti| sthānino vācakatvasvīkāra ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: pīnatva anyathā anupapattyā rātri bhojanasya iva bhūlaḥ iti asya bodha janakatva anyathā anupapattyā bhavati ityādi samabhivyāhārasya āvaśyaka tva atyanta apekṣi tvāt tadṛśa samabhivyāhārasya eva vācakatva rūpā śaktiḥ svīkriyatām lāghavāt iti arthaḥ sthāninaḥ vācakatva abhyupagantuḥ gauravam bhavati iti āha anyathā iti sthāninaḥ vācakatva svīkāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: gauravameva pradarśayati-lakārasyeti| upalakṣaṇatvāllakārāderityarthaḥ| vācakatvaṃ-vācakatvarūpā śaktiḥ, samabhivyāhārasya ca kāraṇatetyevamubhayaṃ kalpanīyamiti gauravamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: gauravam eva pradarśayati lakārasya iti upalakṣaṇa tvāt lakāra ādeḥ iti arthaḥ vācakatvam vācaka tva rūpā śaktiḥ samabhivyāhārasya ca kāraṇatā iti evam ubhayam kalpanīyam iti gauravam iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca kartrādyarthabodhahetorlakārajñānasya hetoḥ samabhivyāhārasyaiva vācakatvamāstāṃ ekatraiva vācakatvakalpanena lāghavāt, kiṃ tenāntargaḍunā lakāravācakatvakalpanena gurūbhūteneti bhāvaḥ| nanvetāvatā yauktikavivecanena samabhivyāhārasya vācakatve siddhe'pi na sādhuśabdaghaṭakadhātupratyayāntargatavarṇānāṃ tatsiddhamata āha-tathā ceti|
analyzed: tathā ca kartṛ ādi artha bodha hetoḥ lakāra jñānasya hetoḥ samabhivyāhārasya eva vācaka tvam āstām ekatra eva vācaka tva kalpanena lāghavāt kim tena antargaḍunā lakāra vācaka tva kalpanena gurūbhūtena iti bhāvaḥ nanu etāvatā yauktika vivecanena samabhivyāhārasya vācaka tve siddhe api na sādhu śabda ghaṭaka dhātu pratyaya antargata varṇānām tat siddham atas āha tathā ca iti

original: samabhivyāhārasya vācakatve cetyarthaḥ| vinigamanāvirahāditi| bhavatītyādisamabhivyāhārasya vācakatvamuta tādṛśasamabhivyāhāraghaṭakavarṇānāṃ vācakatvamityevamanyatarakoṭiniścāyakapramāṇābhāvātsamabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmapi vācakatvaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: samabhivyāhārasya vācaka tve ca iti arthaḥ vinigamana avirahāt iti bhavati ityādi samabhivyāhārasya vācaka tvam uta tādṛśa samabhivyāhāra ghaṭaka varṇānām vācaka tvam iti evam anyatara koṭi niścāyaka pramāṇa abhāvāt samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām api vācaka tvam sidhyati iti arthaḥ

original: kecittu samabhivyāhārasya vācakatve sati tad‌ghaṭakānekavarṇānāṃ vācakatāvacchedakatvaṃ kalpanīyamiti gauravaṃ bhavati| varṇānāṃ vācakatve tu niruktānupūrvyā ekasyā eva vācakatāvacchedakatvamiti lāghavaṃ bhavatīti lāghavameva varṇānāṃ vācakatve'nugamakam|
analyzed: kecid tu samabhivyāhārasya vācaka tve sati tad ghaṭaka aneka varṇānām vācakatā avacchedaka tvam kalpanīyam iti gauravam bhavati varṇānām vācaka tve tu nirukta ānupūrvyāḥ ekasyāḥ eva vācakatā avacchedaka tvam iti lāghavam bhavati iti lāghavam eva varṇānām vācakatva anugamakam

original: anye tu ādeśenā''deśī smāryate tena cārtho bodhyata iti mate ye'smanmate vācakatāvacchedakāste tanmate smārakatāvacchedakā vācyāstathā ca taddhetunyāyena smārakatāvacchedakānāmeva vācakatāvacchedakatvamāstāṃ lāghavāt, kiṃ tena punarlakārādiṣu vācakatāvacchedakatvaparikalpanenāntargaḍunā gauravādityāhuḥ|
analyzed: anye tu ādeśena ādeśī smāryate tena ca arthaḥ bodhyate iti mate ye smad mate vācaka tā avacchedakāḥ te tad mate smāraka tā avacchedakāḥ vācyāḥ tathā ca tad hetu nyāyena smāraka tā avacchedakānām eva vācaka tā avacchedaka tvam āstām lāghavāt kim tena punar lakāra ādiṣu vācaka tā avacchedaka tva parikalpanena antargaḍunā gauravāt iti āhuḥ

original: samabhivyāhṛtatāvadvarṇavṛttirvācakatetyaṅgīkārānna tadaghaṭakaikaikādivarṇāttattadarthabodhāpattiriti dhyeyam| lakārasya vācakatve tvaduktasiddhāntabhaṅgāpattiriti tata evā''deśānāmeva vācakatvaṃ sidhyatītyāha-kiṃ cetīti|
analyzed: samabhivyāhṛta tāvat varṇa vṛttiḥ vācakatā iti aṅgīkārāt na tad aghaṭaka ekaika ādi varṇāt tad tad artha bodha āpattiḥ iti dhyeyam lakārasya vācaka tve tvad ukta siddhānta bhaṅga āpattiḥ iti tatas eva ādeśānām eva vācakatvam sidhyati iti āha kim ca iti iti

original: ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-paktetyādau kṛtpratyayasya kartṛvācakatvaṃ, pacatītyādau tiṅanate ca tiṅo bhāvanāvācakatvamiti mītmāṃsakaprācīnanaiyāyikaiḥ siddhāntim| lakārasyaiva vācakatve tūbhayatra sthānino lakārasyaikatvācśatrādirūpe kṛti kartṛvācakatvāsaṃbhavāllakārasya bhāvanāmātravācakatvanniruktasiddhānto durupapāda iti tadbhaṅgaḥ syāt|
analyzed: ayam bhāvaḥ paktā ityādau kṛt pratyayasya kartṛ vācaka tvam pacati ityādau tiṅanate ca tiṅaḥ bhāvanā vācaka tvam iti mīt māṃsaka prācīna naiyāyikaiḥ siddhāntim lakārasya eva vācaka tve tu ubhayatra sthāninaḥ lakārasya eka tvāt śatṛ ādi rūpe kṛti kartṛ vācaka tva asaṃbhavāt lakārasya bhāvanā mātra vācaka tva nirukta siddhāntaḥ durupapādaḥ iti tad bhaṅgaḥ syāt

original: tathā ca lakāravācakatvavādinastava svoktivirodha iti bhāvaḥ| navyanaiyāyikamate nāyaṃ virodhaḥ| taiḥ siddhaprayogaghaṭakaśrūyamāṇavibādīnāmeva vācakatvāṅgīkārāditi jñeyam| nanvādeśānāṃ vācakatve kathamasau kṛttiṅoḥ kartṛbhāvanāvācakatvavibhāgo vyavatiṣṭhata ityapekṣāyāmāha-ādeśānāṃ vācakatve ceti|
analyzed: tathā ca lakāra vācakatva vādinaḥ tava sva ukti virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ navya naiyāyika mate na ayam virodhaḥ taiḥ siddha prayoga ghaṭaka śrūyamāṇa vip ādīnām eva vācaka tva aṅgīkārāt iti jñeyam nanu ādeśānām vācaka tve katham asau kṛttiṅoḥ kartṛ bhāvanā vācakatva vibhāgaḥ vyavatiṣṭhate iti apekṣāyām āha ādeśānām vācaka tve ca iti

original: ādeśānāṃ bahutvāttanniṣṭhavācakatāvacchedakatvasyāpi bahutvena tiṅ‌tvena bhāvanāvācakatvaṃ śānajāditvena ca kartṛvācakatvamityabhyupagamādupapadyate'sau vibhāgavyavastheti bhāvaḥ| atha lakāravācakatvavādī śānajādeḥ kartṛvācakatvaṃ sādhayituṃ śaṅkate-na ceti| kṛtirlakārārtha iti| prācīnanaiyāyikairlakārāṇāṃ kṛtau śaktirlāghavāt|
analyzed: ādeśānām bahutvāt tad niṣṭha vācakatā avacchedaka tvasya api bahutvena tiṅ tvena bhāvanā vācaka tvam śānaca ādi tvena ca kartṛ vācaka tvam iti abhyupagamāt upapadyate asau vibhāga vyavasthā iti bhāvaḥ atha lakāra vācaka tva vādī śānaca ādeḥ kartṛ vācaka tvam sādhayitum śaṅkatena ca iti kṛtiḥ lakāra arthaḥ iti prācīna naiyāyikaiḥ lakārāṇām kṛtau śaktiḥ lāghavāt

original: na tu kartṛri, kṛtimataḥ kartṛtvena tatra śaktau gauravādityucyate| tasyāyamāśayaḥ-kṛtyāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvamiti hi tanmatam| tathā sati lakārasya kartṛkācakatve vācakatavacchedikāḥ kṛtayo vaktavyāḥ| tāścānantā ityanantāsu kṛtiṣu kṛtināmanantatve'pi kṛtirityupalakṣaṇaṃ gauravaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: na tu kartṛri kṛtimataḥ kartṛ tvena tatra śaktau gauravāt iti ucyate tasya ayam āśayaḥ kṛti āśraya tvam kartṛ tvam iti hi tat matam tathā sati lakārasya kartṛ kācaka tve kṛtayaḥ vaktavyāḥ tāḥ ca anantāḥ iti anantāsu kṛtiṣu kṛtinām ananta tve pi kṛtiḥ iti upalakṣaṇam gauravam bhavati

original: kṛtivācakatve tu lakārasya kṛtīnāmanantatve'pi kṛtitvajāterekatvenaikasyāmeva vācakatāvacchedakatvakalpanamiti lāghavaṃ spaṣṭameveti| kṛtirityupalakṣaṇaṃ bhāvanāyāḥ| mīmāṃsakairhi bhāvanāvataḥ kartṛtvena tatra śaktau niruktarītyā gauraveṇa tatparityajya lāghavānurodhāllākārasya bhāvanāmātravācakatvāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: kṛti vācaka tve tu lakārasya kṛtīnām ananta tve pi kṛti tva jāteḥ ekatvena ekasyām eva vācakatā avacchedaka tva kalpanam iti lāghavam spaṣṭam eva iti kṛtiḥ iti upalakṣaṇam bhāvanāyāḥ mīmāṃsakaiḥ hi bhāvanāvataḥ kartṛ tvena tatra śaktau nirukta rītyā gauraveṇa tat parityajya lāghava anurodhāt lākārasya bhāvanā mātra vācaka tva aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca pacamāna ityādiśānajādyantasthale kṛtyādirlakārārthaḥ, jañjabhyamānādhikaraṇanyāyenā'śrayastu(kartā tu) śānajādyarthaḥ kartari kṛdityanuśāsanāditi śaṅkāśayaḥ| tathā cānuśāsanadvayenobhayatra śaktipatipādanācśānajāderbhinnayā śaktyā kartṛvācakatvaṃ labhyata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca pacamānaḥ ityādi śānaja ādi anta sthale kṛtya ādiḥ lakāra arthaḥ jañjabhyamāna adhikaraṇa nyāyena āśrayaḥ tu kartā tu śānaja ādi arthaḥ kartari kṛt iti anuśāsanāt iti śaṅkā āśayaḥ tathā ca anuśāsana dvayena ubhayatra śakti patipādanāt śānaja ādeḥ bhinnayā śaktyā kartṛ vācaka tvam labhyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: tadetanna yuktaṃ śānajādau kartari kṛdityasyāpravṛtterityāha-sthānyartheneti| ayamarthaḥ--laḥ karmaṇi cetyādinā sakarmaṃkebhyaḥ karmaṇi kartari cākarmakebhyo bhāve kartari ca lakārā vihitāḥ| laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāvityādinā laṭaḥ sthāne śatṛśānacāvādeśau vihitau|
analyzed: tat etat na yuktam śānac ādau kartari kṛt iti asya apravṛtteḥ iti āha sthāni arthena iti ayam arthaḥ laḥ karmaṇi ca ityādinā sakarmaṃkebhyaḥ karmaṇi kartari ca akarmakebhyaḥ bhāve kartari ca lakārāḥ vihitāḥ laṭaḥ śatṛ śānacau ityādinā laṭaḥ sthāne śatṛ śānacau ādeśau vihitau

original: tatra tathā lakāravidhāyake karmaṇi cetyādyarthanirdeśaḥ kṛte'sti tadvannātra śatrādividhāyake tadarthanirdeśo dṛśyate, kiṃtu laṭaḥ sthāne tāvādeśatayoktau|
analyzed: tatra tathā lakāra vidhāyake karmaṇi ca ityādi artha nirdeśaḥ kṛtyāḥ ti tadvat na atra śatṛ ādi vidhāyake tad artha nirdeśaḥ dṛśyate kiṃtu laṭaḥ sthāne tau ādeśatayā uktau

original: tathā ca śatrādeḥ ko'rthaḥ, kamarthaṃ śatrādiḥ pratipādayatītyarthāṃśe ākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāṃ sthānyarthābhidhānasamarthasyaivā''deśateti bhāṣyasiddhāntātsthānī yamarthaṃ brūte tamevārthamādeśo'bhidhatta iti labhyate|
analyzed: tathā ca śatṛ ādeḥ kaḥ ṛthaḥ kam artham śatṛ ādiḥ pratipādayati iti artha aṃśe ākāṅkṣāyām satyām sthāni artha abhidhāna samarthasya eva ādeśa tā iti bhāṣya siddhāntāt sthānī yam artham brūte tam eva artham ādeśaḥ abhidhatte iti labhyate

original: tataśca sthānino laṭo yo'rthaḥ kartrādistenaivārthenārthavāṃstadādeśaḥ śatrādiriti sānajādeḥ karvādyarthakatvenārthāṃśe nirākāṅkṣatayā śānajādau kartari kṛdityasyārthavidhāyakasya sutarāmapravṛttiḥ| ata eva taiḥ śayyamāne, āsyamāne cāyaṃ gata iti bhāve, kriyamāṇa iti karmaṇi ca śānaco na kartṛbodhakatvam|

original: etāvanayaṃ prakṛtibhāva etāvāṃścāyaṃ pratyayabhāga ityevaṃ sāmānyato jñānaṃ saṃbhavatyevetyato viśiṣyetyuktam| etāvānayaṃ prakṛtibhāma etāvāṃścāyaṃ pratyayabāga ityevaṃ viśeṣarūpeṇa jñānāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ| na vācakatvamiti| na pratyekaṃ tayorvācakatvaṃ saṃbhavati| prakṛtipratyayayorvibhāganirṇayāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: etau an ayam prakṛti bhāvaḥ etāvān ca ayam pratyaya bhāgaḥ iti evam sāmānyataḥ jñānam saṃbhavati eva iti atas viśiṣya iti uktam etāvān ayam prakṛti bhāmaḥ etāvān ca ayam pratyaya bāgaḥ iti evam viśeṣa rūpeṇa jñāna asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ na vācaka tvam iti na pratyekam tayoḥ vācaka tvam saṃbhavati prakṛti pratyayayoḥ vibhāga nirṇaya asaṃbhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvavaiyākaraṇānāṃ prakṛtipratyayayorvibhāgasya viśeṣarūpeṇa jñānāsaṃbhavāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvavaiyākaraṇānāṃ prakṛtipratyayayorvibhāgasya viśeṣarūpeṇa jñānāsaṃbhave'pi vaiyākaraṇānāṃ sa sujñeyaḥ vyākaraṇaśāstrasya tattatpadaghaṭakaprakṛtipratyayādivibhāgamakriya pratipādakatvādatyāśayavānāha-ks‌nasādāvitīti| na tadvibhāga iti|
analyzed: nanu avaiyākaraṇānām prakṛti pratyayayoḥ vibhāgasya viśeṣa rūpeṇa jñāna asaṃbhavāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu avaiyākaraṇānām prakṛti pratyayayoḥ vibhāgasya viśeṣa rūpeṇa jñāna asaṃbhave pi vaiyākaraṇānām sa su jñeyaḥ vyākaraṇa śāstrasya tat tat pada ghaṭaka prakṛti pratyaya ādi vibhāgam akriya pratipādaka tvāt atyāśayavān āhak snasa ādau iti iti na tad vibhāgaḥ iti

original: subantasamudāyasyaiva vas‌nasādyādeśavidānadarśanānna sarvatra prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgajñāpakatvaṃ vyākaraṇaśāstrasya| tathā ca mathā vaiyākaraṇānāmapi vasnasādau prakṛtipratyayavibhāganirmayaḥ sutarāṃ na saṃbhavati tathā sarve sarvapadādeśā iti pakṣe ghaṭenetyādāvapīti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sup anta samudāyasya eva vasnasa ādi ādeśa vidāna darśanāt na sarvatra prakṛti pratyaya ādi vibhāga jñāpaka tvam vyākaraṇa śāstrasya tathā ca mathā vaiyākaraṇānām api vasnasa ādau prakṛti pratyaya vibhāga nirmayaḥ sutarām na saṃbhavati tathā sarve sarva pada ādeśāḥ iti pakṣe ghaṭena ityādau api iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ ca rāmeṇetyādito rāmābhinnaḥ kartetyādyanubhūyamānaboghānyathānupapattyā subantādyātmakapade bodhajanakatāśaktirāstheyetyāśayaḥ|
analyzed: evam ca rāmeṇa ityāditaḥ rāma abhinnaḥ kartā ityādi anubhūyamāna bogha anyathā anupapattyā sup anta ādi ātmaka pade bodha janakatā śaktiḥ āstheyā iti āśayaḥ

original: kecittu yatra prakṛtyādivibhāgakalpanā śāstrasāhāyyenāpi naiva kartuṃ śakyā tādṛśasyaiva padasya vācakatvaṃ, yatra tu tathā kalpanā saṃbhavati tatra prakṛtipratyayayoreva vācakatvamiti vadanti, bhāṣyatattvavidastu yavra prakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ kalpayituṃ sutarāmaśakyastādṛśasthale padasya vācakatvaṃ'vaśyaṃ kalpayitavye sati tadanurodhena sarvatraiva
analyzed: kecid tu yatra prakṛti ādi vibhāga kalpanā śāstra sāhāyyena api nā eva kartum śakyā tādṛśasya eva padasya vācaka tvam yatra tu tathā kalpanā saṃbhavati tatra prakṛti pratyayayoḥ eva vācaka tvam iti vadanti bhāṣya tattva vidaḥ tu prakṛti ādi vibhāgaḥ kalpayitum sutarām aśakyaḥ tādṛśa sthale padasya vācaka tvam vaśyam kalpayitavye sati tad anurodhena sarvatra eva

original: padasya vatcakatvaṃ kalpayituṃ yuktam| anyathā kvacitpadasya vācakatvaṃ kvacicca prakṛtipratyayorityevamardhajaratīyatvāpatteḥ| śaktigrāhakaśiromaṇervṛddhavyavahārātsubantādyātmakapada eva śaktigrahācceti prāhuḥ| evaṃ vākyasphoṭe'pi pakṣadvayaṃ bodhyam|| 64 ||
analyzed: padasya kalpayitum yuktam anyathā kvacid padasya vācaka tvam kvacid ca prakṛti pratyayoḥ iti evam ardhajaratīya tva āpatteḥ śakti grāhaka śiromaṇeḥ vṛddha vyavahārāt sup anta ādi ātmaka pade eva śakti grahāt ca iti prāhuḥ evam vākya sphoṭe api pakṣa dvayam bodhyam

original: atha vākyasphoṭaṃ nirūpayaṃstadavataraṇikāṃ brūte-suptiṅantacayeti subantacaya-tiṅantacaya-suptiṅantacayātmakavākyatyāpītyarthaḥ| apinā subantādyātmakapadasaṃgrahaḥ| tena ca yayā yuktyā padasya vācakatvaṃ siddhaṃ tayaiva yuktyā vākyasyāpi tat-vācakatvaṃ sidhyatīti sūcayannāha-hare'vetyādīti| lakṣaṇādadhunā cettatpadeo|
analyzed: atha vākyasphoṭam nirūpayan tad avataraṇikām brūte sup tiṅ anta caya iti subanta caya tiṅ anta caya sup tiṅ anta caya ātmaka vākya tyā api iti arthaḥ apinā sup anta ādi ātmaka pada saṃgrahaḥ tena ca yayā yuktyā padasya vācaka tvam siddham tayā eva yuktyā vākyasya api tad vācaka tvam sidhyati iti sūcayan āha har eva ityādi iti lakṣaṇāt adhunā ced tad pada obhaya api

original: atrā''depadena viṣṇo'va gaṅgevetyādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ| padayoriti varmayorādeśa iti pakṣe padāvayavavarmayorityarthaḥ| sarve sarvapadādeśā iti pakṣe tu yathāśrutameva sādhu|
analyzed: atra ādi padena viṣṇo iva gaṅgā iva ityādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ padayoḥ iti varmayoḥ ādeśaḥ iti pakṣe pada avayava varmayoḥ iti arthaḥ sarve sarva pada ādeśāḥ iti pakṣe tu yathāśrutam eva sādhu

original: eṅaḥ padāntādityanenaikādeśe jāte sati hara ityekaṃ padaṃ, eve-tyaparaṃ, athavā hare ityekaṃ padamaparaṃ ca vetyevetyatra vinigamakābhāvāt-na tadvibhāga-padayorvibhāgaḥ suspaṣṭaṃ jñeyo na bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu mā jñāyi padayorvibhāgastataḥ kiṃ tadāha-tathāceti| pratyekaṃ padājñāne'pīti| pratyekaṃ padayoḥ spaṣṭaṃ jñānābhāve'pītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: e ṅaḥ pada antāt iti anena eka ādeśe jāte sati hare iti ekam padam eva iti aparam athavā hare iti ekam padam aparam ca vā iti eva iti atra vinigamaka abhāvāt na tad vibhāga padayoḥ vibhāgaḥ su spaṣṭam jñeyaḥ na bhavati iti arthaḥ nanu mā jñāyi padayoḥ vibhāgaḥ tatas kim tat āha tathā ca iti pratyekam pada ajñāne api iti pratyekam padayoḥ spaṣṭam jñāna abhāve pi iti arthaḥ

original: na hyatra pratyekaṃ padayorvisiṣyajñānaṃ saṃbhakti, yena tābhyāṃ pratyekamarthāvagamottaraṃ viśiṣṭabodhaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ| kiyān bhāga ekaṃ padaṃ kiyāṃśca bhāgo'paraṃ padamityevaṃ sāmānyato jñānasattve'pi padārthajñāne padajñānasya kāraṇatvātpratyekaṃ padayoryādṛśajñānādarthāvagamottaraṃ viśiṣṭabodhaḥ| syāttādṛśaspaṣṭaṃ padayorjñānaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: na hi atra pratyekam padayoḥ yena tābhyām pratyekam artha avagama uttaram viśiṣṭa bodhaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ kiyān bhāgaḥ ekam padam kiyān ca bhāga uparam padam iti evam sāmānyatas jñāna sattve api padārtha jñāne pada jñānasya kāraṇa tvāt pratyekam padayoḥ yādṛśa jñānāt artha avagama uttaram viśiṣṭa bodhaḥ syāt tādṛśa spaṣṭam padayoḥ jñānam na asti iti arthaḥ

original: viśiṣya padajñānameva padārthajñānopayogi, na sāmānyato jñānaṃ śaktatāvacchedakānupūrvyajñānāditi bhāvaḥ| atrāpiśabdena pratyekaṃ padayoḥ spaṣṭajñānābhāve'pi nārthabodhānupapattiriti sūcitaṃ tadupapādayati-samudāyaśaktīti subantādyātmakapadasamudāyarūpavākye bodajanakatārūpaśaktijñānasattvena tasmādārthabodha upapadyate|
analyzed: viśiṣya pada jñānam eva padārtha jñāna upayogi na sāmānyatas jñānam śakta tā avacchedaka ānupūrvya jñānāt iti bhāvaḥ atra apiśabdena pratyekam padayoḥ spaṣṭa jñāna abhāve pi nā artha bodha anupapattiḥ iti sūcitam tat upapādayati samudāya śakti iti sup anta ādi ātmaka pada samudāya rūpa vākye boda janakatā rūpa śakti jñāna sattvena tasmāt ārtha bodhaḥ upapadyate

original: tathā ca pratyekaṃ padayoḥ spaṣṭajñānābhāve'mi yato lokānāṃ samudāyādhariniṣṭhaṃ yatsaṃbodhanaṃ tadviṣayo, vidhiviṣayībhūtamavanaṃ-rakṣaṇavityādyarthabodho jāyate'taḥ padasamudāyarūpavākye bodhajanakatāśaktiravaśyaṃ kalpanīyeti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca pratyekam padayoḥ spaṣṭa jñāna abhāvemi yatas lokānām yat saṃbodhanam tad viṣayaḥ vidhi viṣayībhūtam avanam rakṣaṇau ityādi artha bodhaḥ jāyata itas pada samudāya rūpa vākye bodha janaka tā śaktiḥ avaśyam kalpanīyā iti bhāvaḥ

original: yathā pratyekaṃ padayorviśiṣya jñānasaṃbhave'pi tatrānubhūyamānavākyartthabodhānyathānupapattyā padasamudāyātmake vākye śaktiḥ parikalpitā tathā yatra prakṛtipratyayorvibhāgasya viśiṣyajñānaṃ na saṃbhavati tatrāpi anubhūyamānaviśiṣṭabodhānyathā'nupapattyā prakṛtyādisamudāyātmakapade śaktirabhyupeyetyatidiśannāha-evamiti| viśiṣyājñāyamāneṣviti|
analyzed: yathā pratyekam padayoḥ viśiṣya jñāna saṃbhave api tatra anubhūyamāna vākya arttha bodha anyathā anupapattyā pada samudāya ātmake vākye śaktiḥ parikalpitā tathā yatra prakṛti pratyayoḥ vibhāgasya viśiṣya jñānam na saṃbhavati tatra api anubhūyamāna viśiṣṭa bodha anyathā anupapattyā prakṛti ādi samudāya ātmaka pade śaktiḥ abhyupeyā iti atidiśan āha evam iti viśiṣya ajñāyamāneṣu iti

original: etacca pañcaṣaṣṭitamakārikāyāṃ `ghaṭenetyādiṣu na hi' ityatra vistareṇa nirūpitamiti tattatraiva draṣṭavyam| samudāyavyutpattyeti| prakṛtipratyayasamudāyātmakapade śaktigraheṇetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: etat ca pañcaṣaṣṭitama kārikāyām ghaṭena ityādiṣu na hi iti atra vistareṇa nirūpitam iti tat tatra eva draṣṭavyam samudāya vyutpattyā iti prakṛti pratyaya samudāya ātmaka pade śakti graheṇa iti arthaḥ

original: nanu vākyārthajñāne vākyaghaṭakībhūtayāvatpadapadārthajñānasya kāraṇatvādyayā yuktyā padaspoṭaḥ sādhanīyastayaiva muktyā vākyasphoṭo'pi sidhyedityāśayena padasphoṭānantaraṃ vākyaraphoṭa uktaḥ| tathā ca vākyasphoṭe sādhanīye tatra padasphoṭo dṛṣṭāntatvenodāhaṃrtu yuktaḥ|
analyzed: nanu vākya artha jñāne vākya ghaṭakībhūta yāvat pada padārtha jñānasya kāraṇa tvāt yayā yuktyā pada spoṭaḥ sādhanīyaḥ tayā eva muktyā vākya sphoṭaḥ api sidhyet iti āśayena pada sphoṭa anantaram vākya raphoṭaḥ uktaḥ tathā ca vākya sphoṭe sādhanīye tatra pada sphoṭaḥ yuktaḥ

original: satyevaṃ kathamatra tadvaiparītyena padasphoṭe sādhanīye vākyasphoṭasya dṛṣṭāntatvamuktam| kiṃca yatra pratyekapadayorvibhāgajñānaṃ spaṣṭaṃ na saṃbhavati tatra vākyasphoṭasya siddhāvapi na sarvatra tatra vākyasphoṭaḥ sidhyatītyata āda-vastuta iti| padaiḥ padārthabodhavaditi|
analyzed: sati evam katham atra tad vaiparītyena pada sphoṭe sādhanīye vākya sphoṭasya dṛṣṭānta tvam uktam kiṃca yatra pratyeka padayoḥ vibhāga jñānam spaṣṭam na saṃbhavati tatra vākya sphoṭasya siddhau api na sarvatra tatra vākya sphoṭaḥ sidhyati iti atas āda vastutas iti padaiḥ padārtha bodha vat iti

original: yathā ghaṭapaṭādiprātipadikaiḥ, tatprakṛtikasubantairvā ghaṭādirūpo'rtho bodhyate tathā ghaṭo'stītyādivākyairghaṭakartṛkā vartamānakālikī sattetyādyarthaḥ pratyāyyate| padārthaśaktiriti|
analyzed: yathā ghaṭa paṭa ādi prātipadikaiḥ tad prakṛtika sup antaiḥ vā ghaṭa ādi rūpaḥ ṛthaḥ bodhyate tathā ghaṭaḥ asti ityādi vākyaiḥ ghaṭa kartṛkā vartamāna kālikī sattā ityādi arthaḥ pratyāyyate padārtha śaktiḥ iti

original: tatra yathā ghaṭādyarthanirūpitā bodhajanakatārūpā śaktirghaṭādiprātipadikeṣu tatprakṛtikasubanteṣu vā padeṣu kalpitā tadvadvākyārthanirūpitā bodhajanakatvaśaktirghaṭo'stītyādivākyeṣvabhyupagantavyetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra yathā ghaṭa ādi artha nirūpitā bodha janaka tā rūpā śaktiḥ ghaṭa ādi prātipadikeṣu tad prakṛtika sup anteṣu vā padeṣu kalpitā tadvat vākya artha nirūpitā bodha janaka tva śaktiḥ ghaṭaḥ asti ityādi vākyeṣu abhyupagantavyā iti arthaḥ

original: tatreyān viśeṣaḥ-vākye kalpyamānā śaktiḥ prāptāprāptavivekanyāyena saṃsargāṃśe viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvāṃśe ca paryavasyati, ghaṭādyarthasya klṝptāvayavaśaktyaivopasthānasya siddhatvāditi| padasphoṭavākyasphoṭāviti| padaṃ vācakaṃ, vākyaṃ vācakamityarthakāvityarthaḥ| vyavasthitāviti| yuktyādipramāṇena nirdhāritāvityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatra iyān viśeṣaḥ vākye kalpyamānā śaktiḥ prāpta aprāpta viveka nyāyena saṃsarga aṃśe viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāva aṃśe ca paryavasyati ghaṭa ādi arthasya klṝpta avayava śaktyā eva upasthānasya siddha tvāt iti pada sphoṭa vākya sphoṭau iti padam vācakam vākyam vācakam iti arthakau iti arthaḥ vyavasthitau iti yukti ādi pramāṇena nirdhāritau iti arthaḥ

original: pramāṇenārthanirdhāraṇaṃ vyavastheti bhāvaḥ| etena padasphoṭaṃ dṛṣṭāntīkṛtya vākyasphoṭasādhanājjñātājñātaprakṛtyādivibhāgeṣu sakalapadeṣviva jñātājñātapadavibhāgeṣvapi sakalavākyeṣu śaktirāstheyeti sūcitam| ardhajaratīyatvādidoṣāprasaṅgāyeti bhāvaḥ|

original: tadevaṃ pakṣadvayasya vyavasthitatve'pi bhāṣyādāvupavarṇitatve'pi ca vākyasphoṭasya mukhyatvāttatkaspanamevā''śyakaṃ na padasphoṭakalpanamityāha-anyatheti| vākye bodhajanakatvaśaktyanaṅgīkāre ityarthaḥ| ghaṭaḥ karmatvamānayanaṃ kṛtirityādāviti|
analyzed: tat evam pakṣa dvayasya vyavasthita tve api bhāṣya ādau upavarṇita tve api ca vākya sphoṭasya mukhya tvāt tad kaspanam eva āśyakam na pada sphoṭa kalpanam iti āha anyathā iti vākye bodha janakatva śakti anaṅgīkāre iti arthaḥ ghaṭaḥ karmatvam ānayanam kṛtiḥ ityādau iti

original: ghaṭamānayeti vākye ye padārthāḥ pratīyante te'tra viśakalitatayā śabdāntareṇa nirdiṣṭāḥ, etādṛśasthala ityarthaḥ| tādṛśavyutpattīti| ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanarūpārthabodhajanakamityetādṛśavākyaśaktijñānarahitasyāpītyarthaḥ|

original: atrāpiśabdo dṛṣṭāntārthaḥ-yatā ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyaśaktijñānavataḥ puṃso ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyād‌ghaṭakarmakānayanamiti bodho niṣṭaṅkaṃ jāyate tathā vākyaśaktigrahaśūnyasya tādṛśavākyāttathā bodha āpadyetetyāśayāt|

analyzed: ghaṭam ānaya iti vākyāt pratīyamāna padārthānām atra upasthiti sattvāt iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca ghaṭam ānaya iti atra iva atra api vṛtti jñāna janya padārtha upasthiti ādi sāmagrī sattvāt ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti bodha prasaktiḥ iti āśayaḥ atra lakārāṇām kṛtau śaktiḥ iti naiyāyika mata anusāreṇa ghaṭaḥ karmatvam ityādi vākye kṛtiḥ iti uktam

analyzed: nanu vākya artha jñāne tātparya jñānasya kāraṇa tvāt prakṛta sthale ghaṭaḥ karmatvam ityādi vākyam ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti artham bodhayatu iti icchayā uccharita tva rūpa tātparya jñāna abhāvena tātparya jñāna rūpa kāraṇa abhāvāt eva na pūrvokta vākyāt tādṛśa artha bodha āpattiḥ iti atas āha ghaṭam ānaya ityatra eva iti ayam bhāvaḥ tad artha pratīti icchā vaktuḥ tātparyam

analyzed: yadi tātparya jñānam na syāt tarhi saindhava padasya nānā arthaka tvena aśvaḥ vā lavaṇam vāneyam iti saṃśayāt saṃśayasya ca pravṛtti pratibandhaka tva darśanāt tādṛśa vākyāt artha bodhaḥ eva na udiyāt attaḥ tātparya jñānam vākya artha bodhe kāraṇam iti avaśyam vaktavyam tādṛśa tātparya grāhakam ca loke gamana prakaraṇa ādi

original: ghaṭamānayetyādau ca ghaṭakarmakānayanamityarthapratītirniruktavākyādbhatviti vakturicchaiva tātparyam tādṛśatātparyagrāhakaṃ ca dgitīyāpratyayāntaghaṭamitiprayogānantaramānayeti tiṅantoccāraṇam| tataśca tātparyajñānasattvād‌ghaṭamānayeti vākyād‌ghaṭakarmakānayanamityākārakaḥ śābdabodho jāyata iti yuktameva|
analyzed: ghaṭam ānaya ityādau ca ghaṭa karmakā ānayanam iti artha pratītiḥ nirukta vākyāt bhatu iti vaktuḥ icchā eva tātparyam tādṛśa tātparya grāhakam ca dgitīyā pratyaya anta ghaṭam iti prayoga anantaram ānaya iti tiṅ anta uccāraṇam tatas ca tātparya jñāna sattvāt ghaṭam ānaya iti vākyāt ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti ākārakaḥ śābda bodhaḥ jāyate iti yuktam eva

original: ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanamityarthapratītīcchayā vaktroccaritamityarthe tātparyagrāhakābhāvena tātparyajñānarūpakāraṇābhāvādeva na ghaṭaḥ karmatvapityādivākyād‌ghaṭakarmakānayanamiti bodhaḥ prasajjate| tathā ca kathaṃ vākyaśaktijñānarahitasyeyaṃ bodhāpattiścodyata iti śaṅkakāśayaḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādi vākyam ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti artha pratīti icchayā vaktrā uccaritam iti arthe tātparya grāhaka abhāvena tātparya jñāna rūpa kāraṇa abhāvāt eva na ghaṭaḥ karma tva pityādi vākyāt ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti bodhaḥ prasajjate tathā ca katham vākya śakti jñāna rahitasya iyam bodha āpattiḥ codyate iti śaṅkaka āśayaḥ

original: samādhātustu-ghaṭamānayetyatra yāvanto ya ca padārthāḥ padaniṣṭhavṛttijñānajanyopasthitiviṣayāḥ santi tāvantaste ca padārthā ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyātpadaniṣṭhavṛttijñānajanyopasthitiviṣayāḥ santīti kṛtvā tātparyajñānaṃ vartate| vṛttijñānajanyapadārthopasthitirapi tātparyagrahikā, natu ghaṭamānayetyādyānupūrvyevetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: samādhātuḥ tu ghaṭam ānaya iti atra yāvantaḥ ca padārthāḥ pada niṣṭha vṛtti jñāna janya upasthiti viṣayāḥ santi tāvantaḥ te ca padārthāḥ ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādi vākyāt pada niṣṭha vṛtti jñāna janya upasthiti viṣayāḥ santi iti kṛtvā tātparya jñānam vartate vṛtti jñāna janya padārtha upasthitiḥ api tātparya grahikā na tu ghaṭam ānaya ityādi ānupūrvī eva iti arthaḥ

original: tathā ca tātparyajñānasattve'pi yatastādṛśavākyādvākyaśaktijñānarahitasya ghaṭakarmakānayanamiti bodho na jāyata ityanubhavasiddhaṃ tato vākyaśaktirāvaśyiketi bhāvaḥ| tadetatsarvamanusaṃdhāyā''ha sāre-ghaṭamānayetyatrevetyādi| ghaṭamānayeti vākye yathā padārthopasthitistadvad‌ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākye padārthopasthitau satyāmityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca tātparya jñāna sattve api yatas tādṛśa vākyāt vākya śakti jñāna rahitasya ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti bodhaḥ na jāyate iti anubhava siddham tatas vākya śaktiḥ āvaśyikā iti bhāvaḥ tat etat sarvam anusaṃdhāya āha sāre ghaṭam ānaya ityatra iva ityādi ghaṭam ānaya iti vākye yathā padārtha upasthitiḥ tadvat ghaṭaḥ karmatvam ityādi vākye padārtha upasthitau satyām iti arthaḥ

original: atra ghaṭaḥ karmatvamitivākyajanyapadārthopasthitau ghaṭamānayetivākyajanyapadārthopastiterdṛṣṭāntatvenopādānādavṛttijanyapadārthopasthitistātparyagrāhikā, natu ghaṭamānayetyetādṛśānupūrvyeveti sūcitam| tathā padārthānāmupasthitāviti satsaptabhyā siddhasādhyasamabhivyāhāranyāyena tādṛśapadārthopāsthatestātparyajñānakāraṇatvaṃ ca sūcitam|
analyzed: atra ghaṭaḥ karmatvam iti vākya janya padārtha upasthitau ghaṭam ānaya iti vākya janya padārtha upastiteḥ dṛṣṭānta tvena upādānāt avṛtti janya padārtha upasthitiḥ tātparya grāhikā na tu ghaṭam ānaya iti etādṛśa ānupūrvī eva iti sūcitam tathā padārthānām upasthitau iti sat saptabhyā siddha sādhya samabhivyāhāra nyāyena tādṛśa padārtha upāsthateḥ tātparya jñāna kāraṇa tvam ca sūcitam

original: tadāha-satyapi tātparyajñāna iti| vṛttijñānajanyapadārthopasthitinimittake tātparyajñāne satyapītyarthaḥ| bodhābhāvācceti| atrāpi tādṛśavyutpattirahitasyetyanuṣañjanīyam|
analyzed: tat āha sati api tātparya jñāne iti vṛtti jñāna janya padārtha upasthiti nimittake tātparya jñāne sati api iti arthaḥ bodha abhāvāt ca iti atra api tādṛśa vyutpatti rahitasya iti anuṣañjanīyam

original: tathā ca ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti vākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanaṃ bodhayatvitacchiyā vaktroccāritamityevamātmake tātparyajñāne satyapi, ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanadhodhajanakamityevaṃvākyaśaktijñānaśūnyasya puruṣasya yato niruktavākyāttathā bodho naiva jāyataityanubhūyate tato vākyaśaktiravasyamabyupagantavyā'nicchatā'pi
analyzed: tathā ca ghaṭaḥ karma tvam iti vākyam ghaṭa karmaka ānayanam bodhayatu itad śiyā vaktrā uccāritam iti evam ātmake tātparya jñāne sati api ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādi vākyam ghaṭa karmaka ānayana dhodha janakam iti evam vākya śakti jñāna śūnyasya puruṣasya yatas nirukta vākyāt tathā bodhaḥ nā eva jāyate eti anubhūyate tatas vākya śaktiḥ avasyam abyupagantavyā an icchatā api

original: vākyaśaktijñānetarasakalakāraṇakalāpasattve'pi tathā bodhābhāve'bhiyuktānubhavasya prasiddhatvādvākyaśaktyaṅgīkāra iti bhāvaḥ| ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti vākyaśaktijñānasattve'pi tatastathā bodho naiva jāyate ākāṅkṣāvirahādityāha-tatraiveti| ghaṭamānayetyatraivetyarthaḥ| kaṭakarmakānayanamiti bodha iti| etādṛśākārakabodhe jananīye satītyarthaḥ|
analyzed: vākya śakti jñāna itara sakala kāraṇa kalāpa sattve api tathā bodha abhāva abhiyukta anubhavasya prasiddha tvāt vākya śakti aṅgīkāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ ghaṭaḥ karmatvam iti vākya śakti jñāna sattve api tatas tathā bodhaḥ na eva jāyate ākāṅkṣā virahāt iti āha tatra eva iti ghaṭam ānaya iti atra eva iti arthaḥ kaṭa karmaka ānayanam iti bodhaḥ iti etādṛśa ākāraka bodhe jananīye sati iti arthaḥ

original: ghaṭārthaprātipadiketi| śratra ghaṭārthetyuktyā tādṛśārthakakalasādiprātipadikasaṃgrahaḥ sūcitaḥ| karmatvavācakavibhakteriti| am-auṭ-śas, ityevaṃrūpāyā vibhakterityarthaḥ| dhātoriti| ā-nītyāderityarthaḥ| ākhyātasyeti| tiṅapratyāhārāntargatasivāditiṅa ityarthaḥ| atra yadyapi dhātoranantaraṃ vikaraṇasyeti vaktumucitam|
analyzed: ghaṭa artha prātipadikā iti ghaṭa artha iti uktyā tādṛśa arthaka kalasa ādi prātipadika saṃgrahaḥ sūcitaḥ karmatva vācaka vibhakteḥ iti iti evaṃrūpāyāḥ vibhakteḥ iti arthaḥ dhātoḥ iti āni ityādeḥ iti arthaḥ ākhyātasya iti iti tiṅa pratyāhāra antargata siva ādi tiṅaḥ iti arthaḥ atra yadi api dhātoḥ anantaram vikaraṇasya iti vaktum ucitam

original: dhātoranantaraṃ śabādivikaraṇānāṃ vihitatvāt| tathāpi vikaraṇasya sarvatrādarśanāddhātoranantaraṃ na tanniveśaḥ| papācetyādau vikaraṇasyāsattvādityarthaḥ| ānayetyādau yadyapyākhyātaṃ na śrūyate tathāpi ākhyātasyārthopasthityarthamanusaṃdhānamāvaśyakamiti dhātoranantaramākhyātasyetyuktam|
analyzed: dhātoḥ anantaram śap ādi vikaraṇānām vihita tvāt tathā api vikaraṇasya sarvatra adarśanāt dhātoḥ anantaram na tad niveśaḥ papāca ityādau vikaraṇasya asattvāt iti arthaḥ ānaya ityādau yadi api ākhyātam na śrūyate tathā api ākhyātasya artha upasthiti artham anusaṃdhānam āvaśyakam iti dhātoḥ anantaram ākhyātasya iti uktam

original: vikaraṇasya tvanarthakatvānna tadanusaṃdhānamāvaśyakamiti na tanniveśaḥ kṛta ityāśayaḥ| samabhivyāhāra iti| sahoccāraṇamityarthaḥ|kāraṇamiti| heturityarthaḥ| baṭakarmakānayanabodhaḥ kāryam| kāryakāraṇeti|
analyzed: vikaraṇasya tu anarthaka tvāt na tad anusaṃdhānam āvaśyakam iti na tad niveśaḥ kṛtaḥ iti āśayaḥ samabhivyāhāraḥ iti saha uccāraṇam iti arthaḥ kāraṇam iti hetuḥ iti arthaḥ baṭa karmaka ānayana bodhaḥ kāryam kārya kāraṇa iti

original: tathā ca ghaṭakarmakamānayanamityākārakabodhaṃ prati ghaṭārthaprātipadikottaramamādivibhaktyuttaramānītyādidhātūttaratiṅuccāraṇamiti kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitaḥ| etādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvaviṣayakajñānavato niruktabodhasya jāyamānatvānniruktakāryakāraṇabhāvajñānamapi tathā bodhe heturityāśrīyate|
analyzed: tathā ca ghaṭa karmakam ānayanam iti ākāraka bodham prati ghaṭa artha prātipadika uttara mama ādi vibhakti uttara māni ityādi dhātu uttara tiṅ uccāraṇam iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ phalitaḥ etādṛśa kārya kāraṇa bhāva viṣayaka jñānavataḥ nirukta bodhasya jāyamāna tvāt nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāva jñānam api tathā bodhe hetuḥ iti āśrīyate

original: tadidaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvajñānaṃ ghaṭaḥ karmatvamityādivākyasthale nāstīti kṛtvāna tato tathā bodhaḥ| so'yaṃ niruktakāryakāraṇabhāva evā''kāṅ‌kṣetyarthaḥ| ākāṅkṣaiva ca vākyaśaktiḥ| ākāṅkṣā, śaktiriti nāmamātre bhedaḥ| tadarthastveka eveti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ cā''kāṅkṣārūpaśaktyabhāvādeva na ghaṭaḥ karmatvamiti vākyāttathā bodhaḥ|
analyzed: tat idam kārya kāraṇa bhāva jñānam ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādi vākya sthale na asti iti tathā bodhaḥ saḥ yam nirukta kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva ākāṅkṣā iti arthaḥ ākāṅkṣā eva ca vākya śaktiḥ ākāṅkṣā śaktiḥ iti nāma mātre bhedaḥ tad arthaḥ tu ekaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ evam ca ākāṅkṣā rūpa śakti abhāvāt eva na ghaṭaḥ karma tvam iti vākyāt tathā bodhaḥ

original: tathā ca tādṛśavākye śaktikalpane pramāṇābhāva iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ niruktarītyā kāryakāraṇabhāvajñānaraya hetutvāṅgīkāreṇa rki siddhaṃ tadāha-siddho vākyasphoṭa iti| padasamūhātmakavākyasya vācakatvaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tathā ca tādṛśa vākye śakti kalpane pramāṇa abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ evam nirukta rītyā kārya kāraṇa bhāva jñāna raya hetutva aṅgīkāreṇa siddham tat āha siddhaḥ vākya sphoṭaḥ iti pada samūha ātmaka vākyasya vācaka tvam siddham iti arthaḥ

original: nanuyadi padasamūhātmakavākye bodhajanakatārūpā śaktiḥ sidhyettadaiva vākyasphoṭo-vākyasya vācakatā siddhā syātkiṃtu saiva śaktirvākye kathaṃ sidhyatīti dṛṣṭāntena spaṣṭayannāha-ghaṭādipadārtheti|
analyzed: nanu yadi pada samūha ātmaka vākye bodha janakatā rūpā śaktiḥ sidhyet tadā eva vākya sphoṭaḥ vākyasya vācakatā siddhā syāt kiṃtu sā eva śaktiḥ vākye katham sidhyati iti dṛṣṭāntena spaṣṭayan āha ghaṭa ādi padārtha iti

original: ghaṭapaṭādipadārthabodhaṃ prati ghaṭādipadaṃ kambugrīvādimadādyartha śaktamityevaṃ ghaṭādipadaniṣṭhaśaktijñānaṃ kāraṇamityevaṃ padaniṣṭhaśaktijñānakāryakāraṇabhāvasya hetutvamavaśyaṃ vaktavyam| agṛhītavṛttikasya puṃso'gṛhītavṛttikapadādarthabodhādarśanāt| viśiṣṭavākyārthabodha iti|
analyzed: ghaṭa paṭa ādi padārtha bodham prati ghaṭa ādi padam śaktam iti evam ghaṭa ādi pada niṣṭha śakti jñānam kāraṇam iti evam pada niṣṭha śakti jñāna kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya hetu tvam avaśyam vaktavyam agṛhīta vṛttikasya puṃsaḥ gṛhīta vṛttika padāt artha bodha adarśanāt viśiṣṭa vākya artha bodhaḥ iti

original: tadvad‌ghaṭakarmakamānayamityādyākārakavākyārthaviśeṣabodha ityarthaḥ| padasamabhivyāhāretyādi| ghaṭakarmakamānayanamityevaṃ vākyārthaviśeṣabodhaṃ prati ghaṭamānayeti vākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanārthe śaktamityevaṃ padasamūhātmakaghaṭamānayeti vākyaniṣṭhaśaktijñānaṃ kāraṇamityevaṃ ghaṭamānayetivākyaniṣṭhaśaktijñānakārvakāraṇabhāvasya

analyzed: tatra akhaṇḍaḥ pada atirikta ukhaṇḍa pada vyaṅgaḥ lāghavāt svīkriyate tat ca astraṇḍa pada sphoṭe nirūpitam anyat ca ākāṅkṣā yogyatā āsattīnām kāraṇatā na vācyā iti mahat lāghavam sakhaṇḍaḥ tu prasiddhaḥ eva yat vā harā iva ityādau eka ādeśe kṛte pada vibhāgaḥ durvāraḥ tasmāt tatra akhaṇḍa vākya sphoṭaḥ anyatra sakhaṇḍaḥ iti vivekaḥ evam ca dūṣaṇānām garbhasrāvaḥ eva

analyzed: tathā syonam te sadanam karomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suṣevam kalpayāmi iti sadana pratipādakaḥ mantraḥ pratyakṣa grantha vat tasmin sīda amṛte pratitiṣṭha vrīhīṇām medha sumanasyamānaḥ iti sādana pratipādakaḥ mantraḥ anumāna vat pramāṇa nirūpaṇa vādi āga aṅga nirūpaṇam tātparya viṣayaḥ evam anumānasya pratyakṣa apekṣa tve pratipādakasya na tad apekṣa tvam

analyzed: vyavahāreṇa vākye śakti grahāt vākyasya eva vācaka tvāt vākya spoṭaḥ na ca pūrvam gṛhītā api vākye śaktiḥ āvāpa udbāpābhyām tyaktvā pade gṛhyate iti vācyam evam sati padārtha jñānam prati vākya artha jñānasya hetutā āpattau vākya artha jñānam prati padārtha jñānasya hetutvam iti sarva siddhānta bhaṅga āpatteḥ vākya sphoṭaḥ dvidhā sa khaṇḍa ukhaṇḍaḥ ca akhaṇḍaḥ dvidhā

analyzed: varṇa atiriktaḥ ūnatiriktaḥ ca yadā varṇāḥ na svīkriyante gauravāt lāghavāt dhvanibhiḥ eva akhaṇḍaḥ vākya sphoṭaḥ vyajyate iti matam tadā atiriktaḥ asmin pakṣe varṇa abhāvena yāvat varṇa vyaṅgyaḥ ityādi dūṣaṇa ābhāsāḥ garbhasrāveṇa eva parāhatāḥ yadā tu dhvanibhiḥ varṇāḥ vyajyante iti matam tadā ghaṭam ānaya iti sakhaṇḍa vākya sphoṭaḥ
